title: abanyarwanda batuye canada bibutse abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro by’umujyi ottawa ahabereye imihango kwibuka nyuma y’indirimbo zubahiriza ibihugu byombi hakurikiyeho umunota kwibuka inzirikarengane zishwe jenoside padiri callixte kabalisa wayoboye isengesho yasabiye abahuye n’ibibazo binyuranye harimo abafashwe ngufu asaba imana gukomeza impfubyi n’abapfakazi n’abandi bagize ibibazo bikomeye uhagarariye u rwanda canada edda mukabagwiza perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda content: ibi bimwe byavugiwe kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kane tariki akaba ikiganiro cyateguwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima ishami rishinzwe kurwanya sida iki kiganiro kikaba cyari kigamije kumenyekanisha ibizigirwa nama y’igihugu ngarukamwaka kurwanya icyorezo sida bana izabera i kigali tariki kugeza ugushyingo mwaka ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rwanda biomedical center rbc kivuga nubwo gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye igifite ingorane kutumvikanwaho bitazatuma gahunda idashoboka dr anita asiimwe umuyobozi mukuru wungirije rbc avuga kubera imyaka y’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye ibarirwa hagati gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye niyemerwa hazabaho ubushakashatsi bw’udukingirizo tuberanye n’abo banyeshuri dr anita asiimwe agira hazabaho ubushakashatsi bwihuse hagamijwe kumenya udukingirizo turi isoko dutoya cyangwa tunini bana ubu hari ubushakashatsi dufite bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima buvuga hari abavuga udukingirizo duhari isoko ry’u rwanda tudafite impumuro nziza n’ibi tuzabyigaho hazanwe udukingirizo dufite impumuro zidatuma hari abanga gukoresha udukingirizo ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita muryango un family naryo rivuga u rwanda nirwemeza ikwirakwiza ry’udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye rugomba gukora ubushakashatsi dukingirizo tuberanye n’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye dr landry tsigain akorera un family avuga kumenya udukingirizo tungana kuko hari udukingirizo dushobora kuba tunini bamwe utundi tukaba duto bandi yatanze urugero bihugu by’afurika y’amajyepfo kuko higeze kuza udukingirizo tunini bagabo ubushakashatsi bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima mwaka buzima bw’imyororokere y’ingimbi n’abangavu bugaragaza abakobwa batangira gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina myaka abahungu bagatangira myaka inzego z’ubuvuzi zivuga kuba hari abakobwa batwara inda mashuri yisumbuye ikimenyetso cy’uko hadafashwe ingamba zikomeye habaho ubwiyongere bw’ubwandu sida mashuri yisumbuye rubyiruko rusange jean baptiste micomyiza

content: kigalitoday yegereye itsinda bamwe bakorera uburaya i nyamirambo bayibwira bamenye ububi sida bakurikije babona sida imerera nabi bamwe bagenzi itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo ryemeye kuganira kigalitoday rivuga ntawabona cyangwa abe yumva ububi sida abure gufata ingamba kwirinda sida ntitucyemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo n’abakiriya bacu kuko twamenye ingaruka mbi z’imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiyeabagabo badakoresha agakingirizo bafite virusi itera sidaiyo yanze dukoresha agakingirizo acaho njye nkacaho nubwo ariko bamwe bakora uburaya i nyamirambo bavuga batacyemerera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina abakiriya banga gukoresha agakingirizo hari abakora uburaya bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ubukene kubura abakiriya itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo riti hari bagenzi bacu bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ategereza umwanya munini umukiriya wemera agakingirizo akamubura kandi yenda abana baburaye ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuvuzirwanda bio-medical center bugashyirwa ahagaragara mwaka buragaragaza bakora uburaya umuntu umwe babiri yanduye virusi itera sida umukozi rbc dr mwumvaneza mutagoma uyoboye itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje imibare y’ubwandu virusi itera sida rwanda dr mwumvaneza avuga imibare yavuye bushakashatsi bakoze igaragaza gihugu hose rwanda abakora uburaya abagera banduye virusi itera sida mujyi kigali ijanisha rikaba riri hejuru ugereranije gihugu rusange kuko ho abagera banduye virusi itera sida inzobere ndwara sida zivuga indaya itsinda ry’abantu rifite ibyago byinshi kwandura virusi itera sida kurusha andi matsinda ibi biterwa indaya abantu bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina inshuro nyinshi kandi n’abantu batandukanye barimo abanduye vihsida u rwanda ubushakashatsi bugaragaza rutuwe n’abaturage barenga gato miliyoni muri rusange gihugu hose abantu babana virusi itera sida by’abanyarwanda ni ukuvuga rwanda abantu bagera bihumbi babana virusi itera sida jean baptiste micomyiza

title: umugore gen nsabimana yamennye ibanga agathe habyarimana wishimiraga kwicwa kw’abatutsi
content: amateka y’u rwanda agaragaza jenoside yakorewe abatutsi izari ingabo z’igihugu far forces armes rwandaises zatatiriye inshingano y’ibanze arizo kurinda abaturage n’ibyabo zikayoboka politiki mbi y’ivangura irondabwoko n’indi migambi mibisha kwica abaturage zari zishinzwe kurengera cyane cyane izarinda urugo perezida habyarimana n’umugore ukuriye akazu gusa nyuma yaje gutamazwa n’umugore gen nsabimana umugore gen nsabimana witwa uwimana athanasie yatangarije artiges guy umugenzacyaha i bruxelles taliki mbere guhamagarwa aherekeze perezida habyarimana mishyikirano y’amahoro yagombaga gusinyirwa arusha umugabo ahangayikishijwe n’ikintu gishobora guturika bigatuma intambara yongera kwegura uwimana avuga urebye ukuntu imitwe myinshi yakusanyaga intwaro n’ukuntu abanyapolitiki batumvikanaga n’uburyo umugabo yategujwe igitaraganya agomba guherekeza perezida i dar- es- salam taliki byamuteye impungenge bitewe kutumva impamvu y’urwo rugendo uwimana athanasie yavuze yarabwiwe n’umugabo gen nsabimana hari abantu bazatsembwa nubwo atamubwiye urutonde yahoraga amusaba kwitegura igihe cyose akavuga ukwicwa gatabazi kwari kugiye kuba nk’imbarutso y’ubwicanyi bwari bwarateguwe ariko gen nsabimana arabihagarika umugore gen nsabimana yavuze iraswa ry’indege twaye perezida habyarimana n’abari kumwe yabimenyeshejwe taliki saa mbiri mirongo ine taliki nyuma saa sita ajya kureba umurambo w’umugabo umugore perezida habyarimana yamubwiye ibyabaye byagombaga kuba abakobwa dr akingeneye umuganga wihariye perezida habyarimana babitangarije ababiligi bakoraga iperereza ry’iraswa ry’indege itwaye perezida habyarimana agathe habyarimana n’umuryango bashimishwaga n’amakuru y’iyicwa ry’abatutsi gihe jenoside uwanyigira jeanne uwimbabazi marie claire bavuga nyuma y’iraswa ry’indege itwaye perezida habyarimana n’abari bayirimo bagiye kanombe kureba umurambo se taliki mata ahagana ma saa moya y’igitondo batwawe n’abasirikali barindaga perezida uwanyigira uwimbabazi bavuga basanze imirambo harimo n’uwase ukwabo iy’abapilote b’abafaransa ukwayo n’iy’abarundi bakavuga imbere y’inzu hari abafaransa bavugaga indege yahanuwe n’isasu ryo bwoko stinger bavuga igihe batangiye gusenga umugore habyarimana yasabye interahamwe zafashwa kwikiza umwanzi kandi ingabo z’u rwanda zikegura intwaro godeliva mushiki perezida umubikira avuga abatutsi bakwiye kwicwa uwimbabazi claire buhamya bwe avuga kumwe n’abasirikare camp kigali taliki mata bamweretse ababirigi biciwe irunde rw’inzu y’umuryango uwanyigira jeanne abasirikali bamubwira bariya basilikali b’ababirigi bakwiye kwicwa kugirango bazacirwe urubanza uwanyigira uwimbabazi bavuga italiki mata abagize umuryango perezida habyarimana bamaze kuhagera harimo n’abihaye imana barishimaga umwe mubo bita abanzi bicwaga cyane cyane amakuru yatangwaga n’abarindaga perezida kandi bakigamba bw’ubwo bwicanyi uwanyigira uwimbabazi bavuga baherekeje umurambo se buruhukiro muganga i kanombe umuganga witwa baransalitse yavuze umurambo minisitiri w’intebe agata ushyirwa ahandi ukwawo jean juc habyarimana ababwira agiye gushota umupira agata ariko ntiyabikora bareba abari perezida habyarimana bavuga mobutu yamenyesheje umugore habyarimana iby’iryo hanurwa ry’indege mbere gato ariko ntaburire umugabo kugirango abashe guhirika umugabo butegetsi kuko avuye gusinyana amasezerano n’inkotanyi bitaga inyenzi bamubujije agata kanziga akimara kugira uruhare kwica umugabo perezida habyarimana n’inshutiye magara gen nsabimana bahise bashyira umugambi cdr kurimbura abatusi rwego guhisha abahutu n’abakiga bakundaga habyarimana kugirango batihorera ahitamo gushibura umutego mbere yarateganye n’umugabo kurimbura abatutsi ariko baraburiye imbarutso uramuhitana nk’uko byemezwa bamwe nkora mutima zabo umwe muribo yabwiye muhaburarw kanziga mugambi wabishe habyarimana n’akazu kabahezanguni bagera mirogwitanu kabakiga yagize ati’’ agathe habyarimana umuntu ukunda ubutegetsi cyane afatanyije benewabo bamaze kugwira m’ubutegetsi bakaba bamaze kurusha imbaraga habyarimana hari byinshi yagombaga kubumviraho atabyumvira agapfa akaba arinako byagenze bamubuzaga gusinyana amasezerano n’inkotanyi akarenga akabikora bahise bamwica bahita batangiza umugambi bamaranye iminsi kurimbura abatutsi ndetse bawukoresha murwego rwoguhisha abahutu n’abakiga bavuga habyarimana yishwe n’inkotanyi kugirango nabo batihorera bivugwa icyatumye kanziga ayobora politiki y’akazu k’abakomokaga majyaruguru y’iburengerazuba bw’u rwanda by’umwihariko zahoze perefegitura ruhengeri gisenyi ho yakomokaga ndetse akaba anafitanye isano bugufi n’abayobozi bakuru b’igihugu abandi bavukanaga n’umugabo bahuje imyumvire gutsemba abatutsi imbaraga agathe kanziga zatangiye kwigaragaza perezida habyarimana yongera kwiyamamariza kuba perezida akamubwira yumva yasimburwa col stanislas mayuya yabonaga nk’umuntu washobora kuyobora igihugu leta y’u rwanda hamwe n’umuryango survie banditse inshuro nyishi basaba agathe habyarimana hawe ubuhungiro gihugu cy’u bufaransa yatabwa yombi kubera uruhare yagize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi umushakashatsi w’ibitabo akaba n’impuguke mateka y’u rwanda cyane cyane arebana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi witwa franois graner akaba n’umwe bagize umuryango survie washyiriweho kwamagana ibikorwa bibi byakozwe n’u bufaransa afurika gihe cy’ubukoroni nyuma mu kiganiro yagiranye radio mpuzamahanga y’u bufaransa yashimangiye nyuma y’iminsi ibiri kabuga atawe yombi hakiri byinshi bikwiye kubazwa ubutabera bw’u bufaransa bantu bagikingiwe ikibaba kandi uruhare rwabo jenoside rungana cyangwa ruruta urwa kabuga franois graner asanga kabuga afitanye isano bugufi n’umugore perezida habyarimana juvenali wavuzweho uruhare rukomeye itegurwa n’ishyirwa bikorwa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi akaba akwiye gutabwa yombi salongo richard muhaburarw

title: abandi bantu karere rusizi basanzwemo coronavirus
content: abantu basanganywe ubwandu bushya batumye umubare w’abamaze kwandura coronavirus karere rusizi burengerazuba bw’u rwanda bagera minsi itatu gusa minisiteri y’ubuzima itangazo ryayo kamena yatangaje abarwayi bashya bagaragaye karere rusizi bashyizwe kato n’abo bahuye bahise bakurikiranwa’’ mu ntangiriro gicurasi rusizi rubavu twari turere tw’u rwanda tutari twakagezemo cyorezo kimwe nyamasheke rubavu gakenke burera nyagatare gatsibo nyabihu ngororero rutsiro gisagara nyanza ruhango nyaruguru rwamagana kayonza nyamagabe kuva gicurasi nibwo i rusizi hatangiye kuboneka abantu banduye coronavirus barimo abacuruzi abashoferi batwara ibintu babivanye cyangwa babijyanye i bukavu repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo n’umumotari kuri karere rusizi hafashwe ingamba gufata abacyekwaho gucuruza magendu bagahurizwa hamwe ndetse n’abashoferi batwara amakamyo yambuka umupaka rwego kwirinda ikwirakwira coronavirus hanakajijwe umutekano mupaka uhuza u rwanda rdc inama y’abaminisitiri yateranye kamena yafashe ingamba zitandukanye zigamije gukomeza kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo coronavirus zirimo moto zitwara abagenzi zemerewe gusubukura ibikorwa uretse turere twa rusizi rubavu ndetse ingendo hagati y’intara zemewe ariko kujya karere rusizi rubavu bibujijwe kuva umurwayi mbere covid- iterwa n’agakoko gashya coronavirus agaragaye rwanda werurwe hamaze kuboneka banduye bipimo bimaze gufatwa barayikize gihe bakiri bitaro babiri bitabye imana abarwayi babiri bitabye imana barimo umushoferi w’imyaka utuye gihugu cy’abaturanyi wahisemo gutaha rwanda nyuma title: gen patrick nyamvumba yabwiye abapolisi bagomba guhesha igihugu isura nziza
content: minisitiri w’umutekano gihugu gen patrick nyamvumba yatangizaga inama nkuru polisi yahuje abayobozi polisi batandukanye baturutse hirya hino gihugu bakorera mashami yayo yabibukije ubunyamwuga n’ikinyabupfura bigomba gukomeza kuranga buri mupolisi wese kugira inshingano kurinda umutekano w’abantu n’ibyabo zikomeze kugerwaho ni inama yabaye kabiri tariki ukuboza ibera cyicaro gikuru polisi y’u rwanda kacyiru minisitiri gen patrick nyamvumba yabwiye abapolisi bagomba guhesha igihugu isura nziza nk’urwego rushinzwe umutekano w’imbere gihugu yagize mu rwego kurushaho gukora neza akazi mushinzwe kugeza serivisi nziza mushinzwe gucungira umutekano mukwiye kuba urugero rwiza murwanya ikibi cyose cyahesha isura mbi polisi y’u rwanda ndetse n’igihugu rusange ikindi kandi mugakumira ibyaha bitaraba yavuze polisi yonyine ubwayo itabasha kubera hose icyarimwe avuga kugira umutekano ugerweho bisaba ubufatanye n’abaturage ndetse n’izindi nzego zitandukanye binyuze guhanahana amakuru minisitiri gen nyamvumba yanavuze inzego zizakomeza gufatanya gushakira hamwe ibisubizo n’ingamba kubaka igipolisi cy’umwuga hagamijwe kwimakaza umutekano usesuye banyarwanda n’abaturarwanda yagarutse kw’ikoranabuhanga avuga ikoranabuhanga ryakomeza gutezwa imbere kugira serivisi nyinshi abaturage bajye bazikemurirwa bitagombeye bahura n’umupolisi umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda igp dan munyuza yagaragaje intego nyamukuru y’inama nkuru polisi ugusuzumira hamwe polisi ivuye igeze n’aho igana ndetse kurebera hamwe imirongo migari gukomeza kuyiteza imbere yagize inama nkuru polisi rubuga rugari polisi y’u rwanda ruganirirwamo imirongo migari guteza imbere ubunyamwuga hagamijwe kurushaho gukangurira abapolisi gukomeza imikorere myiza nshingano zayo kubungabunga umutekano gukumira ibyaha igp munyuza yagaragaje n’ubwo hari byinshi byagezweho kubungabunga umutekano hagikenewe imbaraga gukumira ibyaha birimo nko gukubita gukomeretsa ubujura ikoreshwa ry’ibiyobyabwenge n’ihohotera rikorerwa abana yagize hari ibyaha bimwe bimwe byagabanutse binyuze bukangurambaga butandukanye kandi byose byagezweho bufatanye n’abaturage ndetse n’izindi nzego ariko hari n’ibindi byaha bikigaragara birimo nko gukubita gukomeretsa ubujura ikoreshwa ry’ibiyobyabwenge n’ihohotera rikorerwa abana kugira tubikumire birasaba ubufatanye n’abaturage hagatangwa amakuru y’ababigiramo uruhare kugira bafatwe bashyikirizwe ubutabera umuyobozi mukuru polisi yavuze zimwe ngamba polisi ifite harimo gukomeza kongerera abapolisi ubumenyi n’ubushobozi guteza imbere imikoranire myiza n’abaturage kongera ibikorwaremezo n’ikoranabuhanga mitangire serivisi chief editor muhaburarw

title: amwe magambo akomeye yavuzwe bob marley umaze imyaka apfuye
content: kugeza n’ubu imvugo ze zifashishwa n’abantu batandukanye mbwirwaruhame zitandukanye ibintu bishimangira ubuhanga n’ubwenge bw’uyu mugabo ufatwa nk’umukurambere w’abarasta robert nesta marley yavutse tariki gashyantare jamaica nyina witwa cedella marley booker yamubyaye afite imyaka se w’umuzungu witwa norval marley afite imyaka bob marley yaririmbaga injyana reggae akitsa cyane butumwa ibihangano byinshi dore yagurishije ama-cd agera miliyoni bob marley yatabarutse yariki gicurasi aguye mujyi miami leta florida leta zunze ubumwe amerika yasize abana yabyaranye n’abagore batandukanye hari amagambo atandukanye yagiye avuga kugeza n’ubu akigenderwaho benshi bitewe n’ubuhanga yayavuganye amwe ubuzima umuhanda munini wuzuyemo ibimenyetso kugenda unyura mikoki ntukagore ubwonko bwawe hunga urwango ikibi n’ishyari wihamba ibitekerezo byawe shyira icyerekezo cyawe haguruka kandi ubeho itandukanye sebiki ukoresheje urukundo ubuhangange bw’umuntu ntiburi mitungo afite ahubwo bunyangamugayo bwe n’uburyo ashobora guhindura abamuri impande buryo bwiza amafaranga imibarwa kandi ntijya irangira niba ibyishimo bitangwa n’amafaranga ntuzigera urekera gushaka ibyishimo kubera wishimye ntabwo bivuze munsi mwiza cyane ahubwo warebye kure y’ibibi byawo muvuga mukunda imvura nyamara yagwa mugakoresha imitaka muyigendamo muvuga mukunda izuba ariko mugashaka ubwugamo rivuye muvuga mukunda umuyaga ariko uje mufunga amadirishya yanyu ni mpamvu ngira ubwoba mumbwiye munkunda umukobwa ashobora kuba atari icyamamare cyangwa ihoho ariko agukunda agatuma umwenyura kindi gikenewe ntawe umenya umunyembaraga kugeza igihe kuba umenyembaraga mahitamo yonyine afite umunsi urekera gusiganwa niwo munsi utsinda irushanwa umugabo mbere w’ikigwari uzamura urukundo rw’umukobwa ntego kumukunda afite kunda ubuzima ubayemo ubeho buzima ukunze wapfa urwanira ubwingenge kuba imbohe ubuzima bwawe bwose ntukizere abantu bafite ibyiyumviro bihindukana n’ibihe izere umuntu uhorana ibyumviro bimwe kabone n’ubwo ibihe byahinduka umuntu ntashobora gukora adafite imana nk’uko ukenera amazi ufite inyota ntushobora kugenda udafite imana umuziki wanjye uzahoraho iteka birashoboka ubucucu kubivuga ariko ufite ibimenyetso urabivuga umuziki wanjye uzahoraho ntukwiye gushyirwa hasi n’ibikubaho ahubwo ukwiye gukoresha ibikubaho nk’ibikuzamura kugushyira hasi ntugace urubanza utaraca urwawe sindi ruhande rw’abirabura cyangwa abazungu ndi ruhande rw’imana ntuzategereze imana igukorera udakorera abandi urumogi umuti w’igihugu inzoga izigisenya iyo unyweye urumogi rutuma wisobanukirwa umwa zimwe ndirimbo bob marley zanditse amateka akomeye

title: inkomoko y’inyito nyabugogo igice mbere
content: tugiye kubatekerereza imvano y’inyito y’umugezi nyabugogo wisuka ruzi nyabarongo wabaye imvano y’inyito y’utugali n’imidugudu myinshi rwanda umutekereza w’amateka y’u rwanda akaba n’umusizi title: nyanza abarwara malaria bavuye bihumbi bagera bihumbi
content: byatangajwe n’ubuyobozi bw’ibitaro by’akarere nyanza mbere tariki werurwe hatangizwaga mugaragaro igikorwa gutera umuti wica imibu itera malaria nzu z’abaturage umuyobozi mukuru w’ibitaro nyanza dr tuyishime emille yavuze ubukangurambaga bwakozwe baturage kwirinda malaria kuyivuza hakiri kare bayirwaye bwatanze umusaruro mwiza ati mu mavuriro twakiraga abantu barenga ibihumbi barwaye malaria ariko twakiriye abatarenga ibihumbi karere kose’’ yakomeje avuga karere nyanza muntu wishwe malaria ariko bihe byashize hari hapfaga abagera mwaka umwe dr tuyishime yagaragaje ibyatumye malaria ihashywa birimo serivisi kuyivura zitangwa n’abajyanama b’ubuzima buryo bwihuse kandi bukorerwa y’abaturage abaturage bivuza kare ntibanduze abandi gutera imiti yica imibu nzu z’abaturage kuvanaho ibinogo n’ibidendezi imibu ishobora kororokeramo kuryama nzitiramibu iteye umuti n’ibindi bamwe baturage karere nyanza babwiye igihe bamaze imyaka irenga itatu batarwara malaria kandi mbere hari n’abayirwaga buri kwezi ntihinyuzwa kuva natangira kurara nzitiramibu bakaduterera n’imiti nzu malaria mperuka kurwara hashize imyaka irenga ibiri ubundi buryo nkoresha kuyirinda ukuvanaho ibihuru byakorora imibu nkakuraho ibiziba byarekamo amazi nyirakamana franoise murenge kigoma avuga adaheruka kurwara malaria bitewe n’ingamba yafashe ati nubahiriza ingamba zose kuyirinda umwana wanjye uheruka kuyirwara ariko hashize nk’umwaka kandi naketse umubu wamuririye hanze kuko aryama nzitiramibu kandi inzu yacu bayiteyemo umuti nahise muvuza ahita akira ntabwo yamuzahaje umuyobozi w’akarere nyanza ntazinda erasme yavuze ingamba kurwanya malaria kuyikumira zikomeje gushyirwamo ingufu hagamijwe kuyirandura burundu yasabye abaturage gukomeza gukurikiza inama bagirwa zigamije kuyihashya mu karere nyanza igikorwa ngarukamwaka gutera umuti wica imibu nzu z’abaturage kiri kuba nshuro kane kizamara iminsi hazaterwa inzu zirenga ibihumbi ibipimo by’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuzima rbc byerekanye malaria rwanda ntara y’amajyepfo n’i burasirazuba kandi nyanza gisagara huye two turere two majyepfo twibasiwe kurusha utundi email protected

title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize uruhare bikorwa bitandukanye muri harimo kuba yarakoranye atizigamye guverinoma yakoraga jenoside iyo raporo kandi ivuga kuba tariki mata alain jupp yarakiriye jrme bicamumpaka jean bosco barayagwiza guverinoma y’abatabazi ikibazo gikomeye kuko umuryango mpuzamahanga warafashe icyemezo guha akato guverinoma ndetse u bubiligi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika bakaba bamaze kubigaragaza bima viza bagabo inkuru dukesha igihecom

title: umwihariko udasanzwe birori by’imideli y’ibwami rwanda hambere amafoto
content: igikorwa rwanda cultural fashion show cyabereye mbere gice cy’icyaro i nyakinama cyahuriranye n’ibirori bikomeye gusoza icyumweru cyahariwe ubukerarugendo bushingiye muco cultural tourism week’ nzeri igikorwa kwerekana imideli n’ubuzima gakondo abanyarwanda babagamo ngoma cyami cyateguwe rwanda cultural fashion showisanzwe itegura ibirori by’imideli gakondo ifatanyije red rocks’ muri mwaka ibirori kurimba rwanda cultural fashion show’ byabaye bice bibiri icya mbere cyabereye ahitwa i nyakinama karere musanze gihe igice kabiri kizabera mujyi kigali kuwa nzeri byari ibirori binogeye ijisho kandi bitanga ishusho nyakuri y’ubuzima umwami yabanagamo n’abaturage umunsi wundi akarusho gakomeye birori byari byitabiriwe n’abiganjemo abanyamahanga n’abaturage aka gace umukino wigishije benshi ibwami bishimiraga umusaruro w’igihugu bagasangira n’indi migenzo yabiherekezaga umushengero wanyuze benshi ni ibirori byari byihariye ugereranyije n’ibindi by’imideli bisanzwe bibera rwanda by’umwihariko ababiteguye berekanye ubudasa mukino w’umushengero abanyamideli bashushanya abanyarwanda hambere biyerekaga umwami bafite amaboko mahire’ urebye ishusho mbumbe y’umukino wabonaga byasabye imbaraga guhuza imyambarire gakondo n’ubutumwa bwatanzwe carlos gerolf umudage witabiriye birori yabwiye igihe umwihariko nabikunze nakunze kuriya abasore basokoje n’indirimbo zabo wumvaga zihariye abanyamideli bahuje imbaraga birori berekanya imihango kuraguza guterekera gutera icyuhagiro n’ubuvuzi kinyarwanda bwakorwaga hambere muri birori kandi hasobanuwe akamaro k’ingoma gihe hambere amagambo akwiye yakoreshwaga ibwami n’ibindi muri red rocks ahabereye birori hanatangiwemo amasomo babishaka buryo kwenga inzoga kinyarwanda byakorwaga gusya kubumba kwivuga kuraguza n’ibikoresho byabaga ndaro kumasha n’ibindi byihariwe n’u rwanda umuyobozi rwanda cultural fashion show ntawirema celestin yavuze bateguye gikorwa gace k’icyaro rwego kugaragaza byeruye ubuzima gakondo bw’abanyarwanda myaka hambere bitandukanye n’igikorwa gisanzwe kibera i kigali ati iki gikorwa twashatse kiba umwihariko i kigali byari bigoye cyane kubona ibikoresho birimo nk’uruho umuheto umuvure urusyo n’ingasire urutara n’ibindi byerekana akarango k’umuco nyarwanda yongeraho ntabwo byadukundiraga gikorwa dutegura i kigali twerekana gukama ibitoki bikorwa urwagwa rutegurwa imibereho y’umwami kwigisha abantu gusya n’ibindi urebye twakoze urabonamo umwihariko n’itandukaniro abanyamideli biyerekanye bambaye impu imideli biyerekanyemo yiganjemo iyambarwaga hambere by’umwihariko impu n’ishabure ndetse kogosha amasunzu nabyo bishushanya imimerere y’umunyarwanda hambere mu gukina umwami yabagaho hambere abanyamideli berekanye umuyobozi mukuru wabaga wubashywe n’abaturage babigaragaje kumuheka berekana imihango yamukorerwaga kumuha ikuzo ibi birori byahujwe gusoza icyumweru cyahariwe ubukerarugendo bushingiye muco cyabaye kuwa kanama kugeza kuwa nzeri yavuze myaka itaha n’itsinda rimufasha bazashyiramo ingufu kugira bijye byitabirwa n’abandi bice by’igihugu ati nk’icyanshimishije cyane twakoresheje abanyamideli hano musanze hari abana biga mashuri yisumbuye twahuje n’abagore cyaro n’bagabo hano kugira babigishe batazi murabona nko kwerekana umwami yabagaho abenshi biyerekanye bataranavuka buryo kugira babikore neza byadusabye abakecuru babizi babahaye amasomo natwe ntabwo twari tubizi byose ibindi bikorwa byerekanwe harimo kwigisha abantu kuraguza kwenga urwagwa umusaruro watunganywaga mbere guhunikwa gucunda amata guhamiriza guhiga ishyamba ubusabane ntango ubuvuzi gakondo kubumba inkono n’ibibindi ntawirema abanyamideli babitojwe igihe kinini uriya mukino wadutwaye imbaraga ntibyari byoroshye kwigisha abana bakiri bato umwami yabagaho rugo rwe yasabanaga n’abaturage abaja bakoraga akazi abakobwa bakuburaga ndetse ukabasaba babikora kandi bakabikina neza by’umwihariko abanyamideli benshi biyerekanye birori abavuka musanze hakiyongeramo bake baturutse i kigali ntawirema yijeje abazitabira rwanda cultural fashion show izabera i kigali kuwa nzeri bazabona ibirori birusha iby’imyaka yatambutse

title: perezida kagame yasabye abayobozi kutazatungurwa n’ibyemezo agiye gufatira bamwe bakora nabi
content: perezida paul kagame asoza umwiherero w’abayobozi nzego nkuru bamaze iminsi ine i gabiro karere gatsibo baganira ngamba kurushaho gukomeza guteza imbere igihugu yasabye bayobozi title: ubuzima i rusizi gupima coronavirus biri gukorwa urugo rundi hamaze gupimwa abarenga
content: mu ntangiriro gicurasi rusizi turere tw’u rwanda tutari twakagezemo coronavirus kimwe nyamasheke rubavu gakenke burera nyagatare gatsibo nyabihu ngororero rutsiro gisagara nyanza ruhango nyaruguru rwamagana kayonza nyamagabe gusa gicurasi aka karere kabaye izingiro coronavirus rwanda nyuma y’uko abantu batanu mbere bagaragaweho cyorezo barimo abacuruzi abashoferi batwara ibintu babivanye cyangwa babijyanye i bukavu repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo ndetse n’umumotari umwe watwaraga ibintu byari byemewe byatumye kamena imirenge kamembe nyakarenzo mururu n’igice gihundwe igize umujyi kamembe karere rusizi ishyirwa gahunda guma rugo gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri kwirinda ikwirakwira coronavirus abayobozi nzego z’ubuzima cyane abari bikorwa gukumira cyorezo niho bimukiye ndetse n’itsinda ryagize uruhare kurwanya ikwirakwira ryacyo kigali rijyanwayo kugira ritange umusanzu bikorwa bifasha gukumira ndwara umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rbc dr sabin nsanzimana karere rusizi yabwiye igihe aka karere hamaze kugaragara abantu banduye coronavirus ikiri gukorwa ugupima abantu benshi bashoboka cyane ingo zegereye umupaka w’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo bigakorwa urugo rundi ati ubu abaturage gahunda guma rugo biratworohereza kuko hari uwaba urwaye tukaba tutaramubona ntabwo kwanduza abandi masoko kandi kazi ubu turi gupima abantu tuva rugo tujya rundi hari gahunda y’uko byumweru bibiri twahawe abantu tuza kubikora nk’uko twabikoze kigali igihe twari twatangiye kubona abantu bafite uburwayi kwezi gatatu n’ukwa kane muri aka karere bantu bafite ibimenyetso guhamagara inzego z’ubuzima basaba kwitabwaho abashinzwe ubuzima basobanura bishobora kuba biterwa n’uko hari n’uwanduye yaba yaranduye vuba buryo ataragaragaza ibimenyetso yakomeje agira twe ntabwo turi gupima dushingiye bimenyetso ukugenda urugo rundi tukanapima n’abahuye n’abo twamaze kubona barwaye muri gahunda hagombaga gupimwa abantu barenga ibihumbi icumi by’umwihariko minsi itatu imbere harafatwa ibipimo by’abantu barenga ibihumbi bitanu kubera uburyo umupaka munini kandi ugizwe n’amazi inzego z’umutekano zakajije ingamba buryo baturage bambuka banyuze nzira zitari nkuko byakundaga kugenda ati i rusizi honyine tumaze gusuzuma abantu barenga ibihumbi bitatu turateganya gufata ibipimo birenga nk’ibihumbi bitanu minsi nk’itatu imbere i rusizi honyine dushobora kugera bipimo nk’ibihumbi icumi icyo gihe nk’imirenge nk’ibiri ariko tugenda tureba urugo rundi tureba abantu bakoze ingendo hari n’abatwihamagarira bakatubwira bati natwe turatekereza twahuye n’abo bantu ibi bipimo bishobora kwiyongera gihe haba hagaragaye abantu benshi banduye buryo barenga n’uwo mubare uteganyijwe usibye rusizi uturere twose turi nkengero z’ikiyaga kivu ukuvuga nyamasheke karongi rubavu hose hari gufatwa ibipimo buryo hashakishwa abanduye coronavirus mu rwanda hamaze kugaragara abantu banduye coronavirus gihe babiri aribo bamaze kwitaba imana bazize cyorezo bakaba barakize mu banduye umubare munini abagabo kuko bihariye bingana n’abantu ikindi abari kigero cy’imyaka hagati aribo bibasiwe cyane kuko abamaze kugaragaza cyorezo myaka

content: mu kiganiro cyihariye twagiranye yadutangarije amafaranga amaze iminsi akorera kongo-kinshasa azamufasha gusohora indirimbo sitidiyo mu ikubitiro arashaka gukorana lick lick cyangwa masota indirimbo nyampinga ntibishoboka minsi vuba akomeza avuga azanye umuziki w’umwimerere njyana afrobeat idasondetse uzamuhesha itike guhiga abahanzi bakunzwe minsi kamichi kitoko king james knowless yadutangarije n’ubwo atagaragaraga ruhando rw’umuziki amaze iminsi akora indirimbo z’ibigo n’amasosiyete zamuhaga amafaranga atari make ku mpamvu zatumye ava ruhando rw’umuziki gihe gisaga imyaka ibiri avuga mwaka mafaranga muziki none abona abanyarwanda batangiye gukunda umuziki yagize icyanshimisha ugushimisha abakunzi banjye nanjye nkagira mbona birababaje kujya scene ukaririmba ugashishimisha abantu ejo ukaba usaba ababyeyi tike fulgence afite indoto gukora umuziki akamenyekana rwego mpuzamahanga kandi ukamuteza imbere fulgence amaze ibyumweru bitatu gihugu kongo-kinshasa yakoraga ikiraka kuririmba komisiyo y’amatora ifatanyije n’ishami loni rikorerayo nk’uko abivuga kiraka cyari icya meddy wamenyekanye cyane i goma kubera indirimbo amayobera ariko bw’amahirwe meddy yarabuze fulgence akibonye gutyo nshimiyimana leonard

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru army week police week n’ibindi byakozwe n’abanyarwanda banyuranye nzego zitandukanye hari kandi n’ibyakorewe mahanga babaga butumwa rwego kumenyekanisha umuco mwiza igihugu cyacu gifite aha twavuga ingabo z’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye majyaruguru darfur ahitwa el-fasher batangizaga umuganda buri kwezi bafatanyije n’ingabo z’ibindi bihugu ziri butumwa nyuma y’umuganda hagendaga habaho ibiganiro bitandukanye bigamije gukangurira abaturage kwitabira gahunda leta hamwe kugira uruhare bikorwa bibakorerwa batanga umusanzu wabo rwego kwiyubakira igihugu cyane cyagerwaho batabigizemo uruhare anne niwemwiza

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi title: gatsibo ibitaro kiziguro birashinjwa n’abaturage kuraza abarwayi gitanda kimwe
content: ibitaro kiziguro biherereye karere gatsibo ntara y’iburasirazuba birashinjwa n’abaturage kugira inyubako zishaje zitakijyanye n’igihe n’ikibazo cy’ibitanda bike abaturage bavuga ikibazo bitaro bifite ugusaza kw’inyubako ndetse n’ibitanda bike bituma gitanda haryama abarwayi cyangwa uwitwa nyirabahire uturuka murenge remera yavuze ibitaro babishinja ibintu yagize atiibitaro tubishinja ibintu icya mbere inyubako zishaje zitakijyanye n’igihe icya kabiri ikibazo cy’ibitanda bike bituma hari igihe usanga gitanda haryamye abarwayi babiri cyangwa batatu bacurikiranye hari nubwo usanga umubyeyi akimara kubyara akabura igitanda bakamusasira matora hasi mugenziwe uwitwa bamporiki yavuze hari n’ubwo gitanda hashyirwa abarwayi barwaye indwara zitandukanye buryo umwe yakwanduza gusa ashima abaganga kuko bakora bashoboye bakavura abarwayi usibye kuba bucucike bugira ingaruka barwayi bavurirwa ahantu hatoya bunagira ingaruka barwaza b’abo barwayi kuko rimwe rimwe barara hanze cyakora bitewe n’uburemere bw’ikibazo cy’inyubako nkeya barwaza babona kiri bitaro muntu barenganya ahubwo basanga baramutse bafite ibitaro byagutse bishoboka batahura n’ibibazo nk’ibyo bahura mukazitoni yagize turara hanze cyakora ntitwarenganya n’abandi tubura dukwirwa kuko n’abarwayi babura bakwirwa ku gitanda kimwe hakajyaho abarwayi babiri n’abana twebwe tugashoberwa tukarara hanze tubonye ibitaro byiza binini birambuye wenda natwe twajya tubona agaciro nk’abarwaza kuruhande rw’ ubuyobo zi bw’ ibitaro kiziguro nti buhakana kibazo dr mbayire vedaste uyobora ibitaro kiziguro yavuze bafite ibitanda akaba bike bitanda haba hariho abarwayi mbayire yagize a ti turifuza twabona ibitaro bigezweho bibasha kwakira abarwayi kubaha serivisi bakeneye vedaste yavuze bijyanye n’inyubako zishaje zitajyanye n’igihe minisitiri w’intebe yabasuraga yabemeye bazohereza ikigo cy’igihugu cy’imyubakire harebwe agaciro k’ibikenewe bityo ibitaro byubakwe vuba ibitaro kiziguro byatangiye mwaka bitangira ikigo nderabuzima kiriziya gatorika diyoseze byumba cyayoborwaga n’ababikira b’abazungu bitewe n’uko cyari kure y’ibindi bitaro kandi bagikoragamo hakaba harimo n’umuganga cyaje guhabwa inyito rural hospital ugenekereje bivuga ibitaro cyaro salongo richard muhaburarw

cyangwa avugaguzwa yafatwa nk’uwafashwe n’abadayimoni cyangwa amashitani kuko hari abafite umuco kujyana abantu nk’abo nsengero kubasengera kandi rimwe rimwe igicuri barwaye ugasanga indwara irushijeho kwiyongera ni ngombwa abantu nk’abo bagomba kujyanwa muganga bagasuzumwa indwara bafite ikindi kandi si byiza urwaye igicuri yakwegerezwa umuriro kuko iruhande rw’umuriro mwuka mwiza jenoside byagaragaye turere twa musanze burera ntara y’amajyaruguru umugabo witwa ndagijimana pierre w’imyaka murenge remera karere musanze kiganiro kwibuka cyatangwaga kabera donatille mugabo yasabye yakorewe abatutsi umugabo witwa ndagijimana pierre yasabye ijambo abaza agira abantu bose barapfuye n’abacu barapfuye’ ngo yongeye agira twese twabigiriyemo ingorane kandi bapfuye hari abahungaga hari abagongwaga n’imodoka abandi bakicwa n’abacengezi munyemana dsir avuga mugabo bamusobanuriye bamubwira uburyo akwiye kwitwara n’amagambo akwiye gukoresha bihe kwibuka jenoside abasubiza anyuzwe nk’uko gitifu ndagijimana yakomeje kubivuga byabaye ngombwa mugabo ajyanwa polisi station remera kugira akomeze abazwe yavuze ati kuba yajyanywe polisi ugufasha abaturage kubakura rujijonk’ubu hari abaturage karere musanze ho haravugwa abagabo batatu bakoreye urugomo umwana w’umukobwa w’imyaka ukora nzu zicuruza amafunguro restaurant bamubwira amagambo ashingiye moko amakuru avuga restaurant hinjiye abagabo batatu basanzwe biyakiriramo umwe yegera mukobwa amufata mutwe arawuhindukiza aramubwira ariko aka ntabwo agatutsi bagenzi kumwe baramusubiza ese ntubireba arangije amukubita urushyi itama content: polisi y’u rwanda iratangaza abapolisi burinzi sibomana jean pierre w’imyaka afungiye bamurashe gitondo saa kumi n’imwe ashaka gutoroka babafunguye bage bwiherero polisi y’u rwanda iratangaza abapolisi burinzi sibomana jean pierre w’imyaka afungiye bamurashe gitondo saa kumi n’imwe ashaka gutoroka babafunguye bage bwiherero tariki mata nibwo sibomana karere rubavu murenge kanzenze kagari nyamikongi mudugudu rwamikungu yafashwe akurikiranyweho kwica atemye inka nyiramagori rachelle w’imyaka umupfakazi w’abana batatu warokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ibi byabaye ijoro ryo gatatu tariki mata saa z’ijoro umuvugizi polisi ntara y’iburengerazuba chief inspector of police cip bonaventure karekezi gihe yavuze uriya sibomana yitwikiriye ijoro ajya abashumba baragirira inka harimo n’iriya nyiramagori rachelle asanga baryamye basinziriye akabakubita nyamara inka yamaze kuyitera icyuma nda y’amaganga yagize muri ririya joro yasanze abashumba bikuyu arabakubita ababwira inka yaramburuye bariryamiye bahungiye muturanyi wabo aza kureba ibyabaye ahura sibomana ipantaro iriho amaraso arakomeza ajya kureba inka asanga inka nyiramagori rachelle iryamye hasi iva amaraso nda y’amaganga bigaragara yatewe icyuma muri iryo joro nibwo amakuru yatangiye gutangwa kugira sibomana afatwe kuko akimara gukora yahise ajya iwe afata igare arahunga afatirwa murenge cyanzarwe nawo karere rubavu cip karekezi yagize polisi yahawe amakuru iryo joro hatangira igikorwa gufata uriya mugizi nabi sibomana gitondo afatirwa murenge cyanzarwe bigaragara yahungaga kuko ubusanzwe atuye title: kigeme abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka banduye sida bazahazwa kubura indyo yuzuye
content: abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka barwaye sida batuye mudugudu gakoma akagari kigeme murenge gasaka ho karere nyamagabe bavuga babura ibiribwa bikize ntungamubiri byabafasha kutazahazwa n’ingaruka content: muri kamena turere ingabo fpr-inkotanyi zari zitarigarurira abicanyi bamaze gutsemba abatutsi ntibahagarariye bakomeje ibikorwa gusahura kujya kwica bice abatutsi bataricwa muri ngororero title: inyungu kuba u rwanda rwarabashije kwikorera umuti ugabanya uburibwe barwayi
content: umuti usanzwe ukoreshwa buvuzi witwa opioid ukorerwa leta zunze ubumwe amerika uhenda inshuro esheshatu isoko ryo bihugu bikennye ibituma miliyoni z’abaturage bihugu batabasha kuwigurira ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuzima rbc kivuga gukora umuti ugabanya uburibwe morphine’ rwanda byatangiye mwaka bikorerwa kigo cy’ubushakashatsi miti labophar giherereye karere huye ntara y’amajyepfo bigakorwa hifashishijwe ifu morphine’ ibyazwamo umuti usukika mbere gukora muti ubushakashatsi bwari bwagaragaje abarwayi bapfaga bishwe kanseri cyangwa virusi itera sida buri mwaka bapfaga bababara cyane kuko miti igabanya ububabare babaga bahawe iyo mubare uza kubona imiti igabanya ububabare hari gukenerwa ibiro morphine’ hatabariwemo abandi barwayi bakenera ubuvuzi kugabanya ububabare nk’inkomere abahiye ababagwa ababyara n’abandi mu rwanda hakoreshejwe ibiro gusa baturage bakeneye imiti igabanya ububabare ibi bigaragaza igihugu cyari gikeneye gushyira imbaraga gushaka imiti igabanya ububabare ikagezwa bayikeneye kandi buryo buboroheye rbc ivuga muti watangira gukorerwa rwanda hari impinduka zagaragaye buvuzi zirimo kuba minisiteri y’ubuzima yarashyizeho politiki ngenderwaho kuvura abarwayi bakeneye ubufasha renzamunsi palliative care bityo ubukangurambaga kuvura gutanga imiti igabanya ububabare barwayi bayikeneye bukaba bwariyongereye bigo byose by’ubuvuzi rwanda iyi minisiteri yanatangije indi gahunda igamije gusuzuma kuvura ububabare murwayi wese ukeneye umuti w’ububabare iyi gahunda ikaba ishishikariza cyane abaganga kugira umuco gusuzuma ububabare kwandika imiti y’ububabare kuzuza igipimo cy’ububabare n’ibyo bakoreye umurwayi ifishi abakora muganga bahuguwe gusuzuma kuvura ububabare kandi ibitaro byose gihugu bibasha gusaba guhabwa morphine’ ikorerwa rwanda buntu bisa n’ibitoroshye kumenya imibare nyayo y’abarwayi bahabwa imiti kugabanya ububabare kuko ikusanyamibare rikiri ikibazo nubwo ibitaro byose gihungu bifite miti kandi igahabwa abarwayi bafite ububabare bwinshi kugera rbc ivuga hakiri imbogamizi kugira ububiko buhagije bw’imiti igabanya ububabare kuko ifu morphine’ igitangwa n’abaterankunga bivuze hatabayeho gutangira kuyigura ngengo y’imari leta y’u rwanda hashobora kuzavuka ikibazo cy’ingano y’iyo miti gihe abaterankunga bahagarika inkunga iki kigo kinongeraho nubwo ubukangurambaga bwakozwe bigo nderabuzimana bitandukanye hagikenewe imbaraga nyinshi kongera ubumenyi n’ubushobozi gusuzuma gutanga imiti igabanya ububabare ikindi kandi bamwe baganga baracyatinya kwandikira abarwayi imiti morphine’ bityo umurwayi uyikeneye ntahite ayibonera igihe umuti ugabanya ububabare morphine’ ukorerwa rwanda wagiye wiyongera bitewe n’uko abawukeneye basigaye bawubona buryo wavuye biro hakaba hateganywa gukorwa ibilo bitarenze umwaka kugera miti iracyatangirwa ubuntu ariko guverinoma nitangira kuyigura bizasaba abarwayi bazajya bayishyura mituweli abaharanira ubuvuzi bugera bavuga igisubizo cy’u rwanda kwikorera imiti igabanya ububabare bafite amikoro make igakwirakwiza gihugu hose binyuze bajyanama b’ubuzima ikimenyetso ubucuruzi opioid butari bukwiye kureberwa mafaranga ashobora gukurwamo umuyobozi mukuru w’umuryango ufasha abababaye rwanda diane mukasahaha abantu bagomba guhabwa ubuvuzi nk’uko umunyamerika abuhabwa twese turi abantu kandi umubiri umwe umuryango udaharanira inyungu hospice africa uganda uvuga ibihugu mugabane afurika bifite umuti wizewe kandi uhendutse ugabanya uburibwe ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye rigenzura iyubahirizwa ry’amasezerano ikoreshwa ry’imiti international narcotics control board rivuga by’imiti opioid bikoreshwa n’ibihugu bikize ahari gusa y’abaturage isi mu bihugu bikiri nzira y’amajyambere igiciro kiri hejuru amategeko akakaye n’umuco kwanga imiti igabanya uburibwe bimwe bituma abayikenera benshi batayibona niyo bageze minsi nyuma kuba igiciro cy’imiti igabanya uburibwe kikuba inshuro esheshatu bihugu bikennye kuruta bihugu bikize abahanga bavuga biterwa n’umubare ukiri muto w’abayikoresha bihugu bituma guciririkanya buryo kuyigura giciro gito binanirana meg o’brien ufite ikigo gifasha ibihugu bikennye kwikorera imiti igabanya uburibwe avuga miti igabanya uburibwe ishobora kugira imbata uyikoresha gusa leta igenzura ikwirakwizwa ryayo rwego kwirinda ibyabaye leta zunze ubumwe amerika ibinini byoherezwaga mijyi mito rugero ruruta ingano ikenewe

title: drc babanza gutanga umusoro fdlr kugirango babashe kugira bakorera butaka bwabo
content: aba baturage bavuga gihe umwe aramutse yanze cyangwa akabura barwanyi fdlr bahita bamufata bunyago aba baturage bakaba bashinja ingabo z’igihugu cyabo zibatererana bikabije kuburyo babona muntu wita mutekano w’abaturage umuturage w’umugore kigero cy’imyaka aravuga yibuka ibyamubayeho mezi abiri ashize yanze kubahiriza amabwiriza atangwa n’abarwanyi fdlr gihe yahingaga umurima uherereye ahitwa i mukongo parike y’igihugu y’ibirunga abana bagerageje kurwana n’umwe barwanyi fdlr babasha kumwambura imbunda afite bayishyikiriza ingabo z’igihugu cyabo fardc agira nyuma y’iminsi mike bibaye umuntu ntazi yaje murima wanjye avuga yoherejwe nyiri mbunda twatwaye kugirango ntavaho mbura ubuzima bwanjye byabaye muha amadorari y’amerika bitaba sinari kuzongera gukandagira ukundi ikinyamakuru syfia grand lacs dukesha nkuru gitangaza barwanyi fdlr aka gace basanzwe batunzwe n’ibikomoka mirima y’abaturage aha buri muhinzi cyangwa wese ufite akora agomba kugira yishyura kugirango abashe kuba yagira akorera butaka bwe tuba dusabwa kugira dutanda twarabimenyereye kuko nibo bayoboye aka gace kose hari badusubiza amafaranga tubagurire bakeneye tutabikoze twaba tudashaka kugaruka bukaba ubuhamya bw’umwe batuye ako gace abasirikare congo n’imiryango yigenga bahora basubiranamo bitana bamwana batumye aka karere kagira umutekano mukemu mnsi ishize ingabo fardc ziherutse gushyira guhamya neza abamaze igihe barabibasiye abarwanyi fdlr kuko aka gace hari urubyiruko ruba rushaka gukira byihuse bityo bakaba aribo boherezwa fdlr nyuma bakagabana inyungu mahono agira mezi atatu ashize twanditse abantu batatu bishwe nyuma y’iperereza twaje gusanga bazize baranze kumvira abatumwe n’uwo mutwe bagabane inyungu y’ibyabo fdlr umutwe w’inyeshyamba usigaye ufatwa nk’umutwe w’iterabwoba karere ukaba ugizwe ahanini n’abanyarwanda bahunze mwaka uyu mutwe ukaba ubarizwa mashyamba congo gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: leta y’u rwanda igiye kubaka ibyambu bigezweho kiyaga kivu
content: leta y’u rwanda bufatanye n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo ikomeje gukusanya miriyoni z’amadorari y’amerika miriyari zikabakaba z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gushyira bikorwa umushinga kuvugurura ubwikorezi mazi kiyaga kivu hubakwa ibyambu turere dutanu duhana imbibi ikigo gishinzwe iterambere ry’ubwikorezi rtda kiremeza imirimo kubaka ikiciro mbere k’ibyambu bigezweho kiyaga kivu izaba yarangiye kwezi kamena k’umwaka ibyambu bizaba bije nk’igisubizo gikomeye bakoresha ikiyaga kivu ngendo zabo buri munsi bavuga ubwikorezi mazi kiyaga kivu bukiri hasi cyane kubera ibikorwa bikorwaremezo biciriritse ahari ibura ry’ubwato bujyanye n’igihe ndetse n’ibyambu byubatswe kijyambere mu masaha gitondo nubwo abaturage bavuye turere dutandukanye tugize intara y’iburengerazuba batega ubwato berekeza ahantu hatandukanye bavuga kokuba bikorwa remezo bigezweho birashyirwa kiyaga bibagiraho ingaruka zitandukanye zirimo kurara mazi bagenda ahenshi abaturage bakoresha ubwato bukozwe mbaho kandi butihuta uretse bumwe bwato bukoreshwa mukerarugendo ndetse n’ubw’ingabo zirwanira mazi na none kandi usibye ubwato buke buto cyane bigoye bwageza abagenzi turere turi kure kubera imbaraga nke zabwo kiyaga kivu habonekamo ubutwara imizigo sima umucanga inzoga amakoro n’ibindi bicuruzwa kubera kutagira ibyambu bigezweho abatwara bwato basobanura bagorwa kubona baparika bikaba byabatera impanuka umwe baturage baherutse kuvugana rba yagize dukeneye ubwato bunyaruka kuko hari n’andi mato ava i rusizi atwara mukerarugendo natwe bibaye ngombwa tukabona nk’ubwo bwato bugezweho byadufasha nava hano i rubavu nkagera i rusizi masaha ane gusa abaturage bavuga haramutse hubatswe n’ibyambu bigezweho byahindura ubucuruzi bwabo burimo n’ubwambukiranya imipaka ihuza u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo rdc ibyambu kijyambere kandi bizifashishwa koroshya kwagura ibikorwa mukerarugendo cyane cyane ahegereye ikiyaga kivu leta y’u rwanda yatangiye umushinga mugari kubaka byambu kijyambere turere dutanu duhana imbibi n’ikiyaga kivu usibye byambu bizatanga akazi bantu bantu benshi harateganywa gushyiraho ikigo kizigisha gutwara ubwato kubuteranyiriza rwanda kubukanika n’indi mirimo ijyanye kubwitaho ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubwikorerezi rtda gitangaza bitarenze mpera z’uyu mwaka u rwanda ruzakira ubwato bushya kijyambere bufite ubushobozi kwikorera toni eshatu z’imizigo n’abagenzi ubundi bwato bufite ubushobozi kwikorera toni z’ibicuruzwa imodoka esheshatu n’abagenzi buzaba bwarageze rwanda bitarenze mpera z’umwaka byitezwe umushinga wose utazarenza umwaka utaruzura ubuyobozi rtda bugira buti kwakira bwato bizajyana kubaka ibyambu rusizi karongi nkora rubavu bizajya byakira ubwato butwaye abantu n’imizigo umushinga none ugizwe kubaka amagaraji y’ubwato kwigisha kuyakora kuyakanika ndetse kwigisha abanyarwanda gutwara ubwato rtda itangaza inkunga kubaka byambu yatanzwe leta y’u rwanda ikigo cy’u bwongereza gishinzwe iterambere mpuzamahanga dfid ikigo cy’ababiligi gishinzwe ubutwererrane belgian cooperation kibinyujije ihuriro ryo karere k’afurika y’iburasirazuba rishinzwe guteza imbere ubucuruzi tmea hamwe n’ikigo cy’u buholandi rvo muhaburarw

title: nyagatare guverineri w’uburasirazuba yasuye uruganda rw’amakaro ruzakorera
content: guverineri odette yatemberejwe urwo ruganda bamwereka imirimo kurwubaka igeze ndetse banamwereka urutare bazakuraho amabuye gukoramo makaro ukuriye imirimo kubaka urwo ruganda igr rwizinkindi dominique avuga bakoze iyigo babifashijwemo sosiyete y’abashinwa basanze amabuye y’urwo rutare azavamo amakaro meza itegura mbere ryakozwe mabuye y’urwo rutare ryakorewe bushinwa inzu urwo ruganda ruzakoreramo imaze kuzura ndetse n’imashini azifashishwa mirimo gukora amakaro zamaze kugeramo igr rwizinkindi dominique avuga imirimo igenda neza kandi bakaba bateganya rugomba kuba rwatangiye gusohora amategura mbere bitarenze mutarama umwaka utaha igr rwinkindi yavuze amakaro bazakora bazayatangira giciro kibereye abanyarwanda amakaro azakorwa azakorwa mabuye granite gihe abanyarwanda bamenyereye yabumbwe cyakora abanyarwanda bashobora kutayagura kuko granite ahenda ugereranyije n’amabumbano igr rwizinkindi yamaze impungenge guverineri n’abandi bayobozi b’intara bazanye avuga bazagerageza kuyatanga giciro kitagoye abanyarwanda uru ruganda rw’amategura ruzajya kuzura rutwaye amafaranga asanga amadorari y’amerika miliyoni icumi rukazaba rufite ubushobozi gukora amakaro yasasa hagati metero kare n’ munsi ruzaba rufite ubushobozi gutanga akazi bakozi basaga igihumbi uretse nyagatare amabuye y’intare ziri karere karongi ashobora kuvamo makaro bakaba basanga kibazo cy’amabuye uruganda ruzagira niyonzima oswald

title: bk group plc yemeje abagize inama y’ubutegetsi yizeza abakiliya kubaba bihe
content: byatangajwe gatatu tariki gicurasi abanyamigabane bayo bakoraga inama ngarukamwaka y’inteko rusange yabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga barebeye hamwe umwaka ushize wagenze bafata n’ingamba kigo gikomeze gutera imbere umwaka ushize bk group plc yungutse miliyari frw bingana n’izamuka ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje inguzanyo zatanzwe ziyongereyeho ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje zigera miliyari frw ubwizigame bw’abakiliya bwiyongereyeho bugera miliyari frw gihe imigabane bk group plc nayo yiyongereyeho igera gaciro miliyari frw bk group plc ibumbiye hamwe ibigo birimo banki kigali bk techouse bk general insurance bk capital umuyobozi mukuru bk group plc dr diane karusisi yavuze ingamba kwirinda coronavirus zagize ingaruka banyarwanda barimo n’abakiliya buryo kigo cyishatsemo miliyoni frw gufasha bihe nk’ibi dr karusisi yijeje abakiliya n’abanyamigabane b’iki kigo nubwo hariho ibibazo by’ubukungu kizakomeza kubaba bikorwa byabo kuko banki kigali imaze gushinga imizi bijyanye n’imari shingiro mu minsi ishize guverinoma y’u rwanda yatangije ikigega miliyoni z’amadolari kizafasha kuzahura ubukungu hibandwa nzego zazahajwe cyane n’ingamba kwirinda coronavirus dr karusisi yavuze nabwo uburyo buzafasha bk group plc gukomeza gufasha abakiliya bayo kuko mafaranga azajya anyuzwa mabanki kandi agafasha abarimo abakiliya bk group plc gukomeza gukora ati izi nkunga zizatangwa binyuze banki hari nk’uburyo bwihariye buzafasha abakora rwego rw’ubukerarugendo n’amahoteli buzatuma bongera guhabwa inguzanyo nyungu ntoya bikazaba ubufasha bakiliya bukerarugendo n’amahoteli nka banki kigali yagiye ishyiraho uburyo korohereza abakiliya bayo bagizweho ingaruka coronavirus haba guhabwa inguzanyo kuzishyura abakiliya bafite ibikorwa byahungabanye bahawe uburyo kutishyura bushobora kugeza gihe cy’amezi atatu iyi banki kandi yashyizeho uburyo butandukanye bw’ikoranabuhanga bufasha abakiliya guhererekanya amafaranga gukora ubucuruzi badafashe amafaranga ntoki biri murongo guteza imbere ubukungu kugabanya ibyago kwandura coronavirus banki kigali kandi yashyizeho inguzanyo idasanzwe yise turi kumwe special loan’ igamije kugoboka abakiliya bayo bihe kurwanya coronavirus ndetse guhangana n’ingaruka z’iki cyorezo turikumwe special loan iboneka masaha gusa iguhesha inshuro ebyiri z’umushahara wemerewe gutangira kwishyura nyuma y’amezi atatu yishyurwa mezi nyungu kandi kuyisaba bizarangira gicurasi mu bindi byaganiriwe nteko rusange y’abanyamigabane bk group plc harimo kwemeza raporo y’umwaka raporo y’ubugenzuzi bw’imari yakozwe mwaka warangiye tariki ukuboza kwemeza iyishyurwa ry’inyungu ingana frw mugabane banyamigabane bk group plc iyi nyungu yabonetse umwaka ushize izishyurwa bimaze kwemezwa banki nkuru y’u rwanda bnr ikazaba igize by’inyungu ikigo cyabonye hemejwe kandi abagize inama y’ubutegetsi bk group plc bayobowe marc holtzman usanzwe ayobora inama y’ubutegetsi y’iki kigo mu bashya binjiye nama harimo umuyobozi mukuru rssb rugemanshuro rgis ahagarariye umunyamigabane munini kuko rssb ifitemo abandi bemejwe alline kabbatende lilian kyatengwa reuben karemera umwaka warangiye bk group plc ifite imitungo y’agaciro miliyari kiyongereyeho ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje

title: umusore w’ umunyarwanda yakunze umukobwa aramutinya kumwitegereza biramumuhesha
content: iyi inkuru mpamo y’ urukundo rw’ umusore w’ umunyarwanda ukomoka karere gakenke muryango utishoboye wakunze umukobwa muryango w’ abakire bigana ishuri rimwe mwaka kane w’ amashuri yisumbuye iyi inkuru mpamo y’ urukundo rw’ umusore w’ umunyarwanda ukomoka karere gakenke muryango utishoboye wakunze umukobwa muryango w’ abakire bigana ishuri rimwe mwaka kane w’ amashuri yisumbuye uyu musore wigaga indimi n’ubuvanganzo rimwe mashuri ntara y’ amajyepfo y’ u rwanda umuhanga ishuri ariko akomoka muryango w’abatishoboye tuganira yadutangarije buryo atazi yisanze akunda umukobwa bakire biganaga ishuri rimwe uyu musore wadusabye amazina atajya itangazamakuru twahisemo kumwita jacques jacques nubwo yiganaga n’ umukobwa yakundaga ntiyashobora kumwegera amuvugishe kuko aziko amaboko atareshya ataramukanya uyu musore yakoze ukujya yitegereza mukobwa ubutamukuraho ijisho baba ishuri akamwitegereza umukobwa yareba hirya yagarura amaso agasanga jacques aracyamureba jacques avuga yamaze nk’ukwezi kose yitegereza mukobwa buri munsi umukobwa abura amahoro ariwe utera intambwe atangira kumwegera bavugane kuko yumvaga atumva ikintu gituma jacques amuhanga amaso hose uyu musore amahirwe yabonye ntiyayapfushije ubusa kuko n’ ubusanzwe umusore uzi gusetsa kubara inkuru yahise atangira gutera urwenya mukobwa uyu mukobwa afite musore bakundanaga w’ umukire ariko yatangiye kugenda gake gake ava mukunzi kubera gukururwa n’ inkuru n’ urwenya jacques bageze jacques inshuti zisanzwe bakajya bahura kenshi bakaganira jacques avuga umunsi umwe umukobwa yamubajije ikintu cyatumaga ahora amwitegereza agira isoni kukivuga kuko nubwo yabonaga bahura kenshi bakaganira akimutinya yabonaga umukobwa uvuka muryango ukize uwo munsi jacques yaramubajije nanjye reka mbanze title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka
content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko uretse bakoroni safali yakomeje avuga natwe ubwacu twabigizemo uruhare cyane cyane ubutegetsi butandukanye bwagiye busimburana bwahembereye macukubiri kugeza abanyarwanda barangajwe imbere n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside tukubakira mateka meza bidufasha kandi kumenya twatsinzwe n’aho twatsinze nk’abanyarwanda ni byiza kwiga amateka kuko ushaka kwiyibagiza amateka ashaka kuyasubiramo ibyo bigamije kubaka ejo hazaza h’igihugu cyacu kizira amacakubiri n’ingengabiterezo jenoside umutekano isoko y’iterambere lt muhozi charles ubarizwa batayo ikorera karere gakenke watanze ikiganiro mutekano yavuze iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora kuhungabanya umutekano koloneli karegeya claudien komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe witandukanyije fdlr yabasabye gukangurira abavandimwe ndetse n’inshuti zabo zikiri mashyamba kongo gutahuka bagafatanya n’abandi banyarwanda kubaka igihugu cyabo kandi abizeza kuzabafasha kubagezaho butumwa izo nkeragutabara zitandukanyije fdlr zinjijwe gahunda zitandukanye z’iterambere barihirwa amashuri y’imyuga barubakiwe bavanwa nyakatsi ndetse baninjizwa gahunda gira inka mushimiyimana jeannette umwe mubakurikiranye mahugurwa avuga mahugurwa yayungukiyemo byinshi yavuze yasobanukiwe imvano baturutse turere twa rulindo gakenke batahutse bava mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo guhera kugeza mwaka turimo nshimiyimana leonard

content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: impinduka ziba nyuma kurushinga n’uko wazitwaramo
content: nyuma gushyingiranwa wabishaka utabishaka haba hari impinduka zizabaho buryo wabanagamo n’umusore cyangwa se inkumi mwarushinganye izo mpinduka ziba ntibivuze zitera ibibazo bashakanye ahubwo igitera ibibazo ukutamenya uburyo bwiza kuzibamo kugeza muzimenyereye dore mpinduka ziba nyuma gushyingirwa wazitwaramo uburyo bw’imicungire y’amafaranga utarubaka urugo hari uburyo wakoreshaga amafaranga n’uwo mwashakanye akagira uburyo bwe iyo mutabiganiriyeho bibateza amakimbirane mugitangira kubana kuko uba wibwira uburyo bwawe aribwo bwiza n’undi akibwira uburyo bwe aribwo bwiza bibaye byiza mwabiganiraho mbere kurushinga ariko nyuma kurushinga mukajya mubishyira ngingo mugomba kuganiraho ni byiza kandi kubiganiraho mutarabitonganira mukumvikana muzajya mukoresha umutungo wanyu guhindura inshingano mbere gushyingirwa hari inshingano wabaga ufite ariko zitandukanye n’izo ufite nyuma gushyingirwa ubu ufite inshingano kwiyitaho kwita k’uwo mwashakanye ndetse hakazaziramo n’abana mutarabyara umugore n’umugabo mwese buri wese afite nshingano buri akwiye kuba y’undi kuko nyuma kurushinga nshingano zigomba gushyirwamo ingufu kurusha mbere mukirambagizanya niba waramwandikiraga ubutumwa bw’urukundo kabiri munsi ugomba gukuba kabiri bukaba bune izi inshingano zoroshye kuzikora kandi zigira umusaruro mwiza rukundo rw’abashakanye impinduka itumanaho mbere mutarabana akenshi mwakoreshaga ikoranabuhanga mugahura gake amaso maso ubu noneho murabana kandi uburyo uganira n’umuntu kumwe bitandukanye n’uburyo uganiriza umuntu muganirira telephone ubu noneho mwashakanye akaneye cyane amagambo wamwandikiraga ukayamubwira telefoni uyamubwira amaso maso azarushaho kunezerwa abikwiture imibanire n’abandi bantu mutarashyingiranwa wumvaga ufite uburenganzira kujya ushaka ntawe ubanje kubimenyesha ukajya gusura inshuti ugasohokana n’inshuti ntawubikubuza ndetse muryango wawe ukajyayo ubyifuza nyuma gushyingirwa bishobora guhinduka ukaba ufite ahantu utagomba kurenza banza umenye umunezero wabonaga kumwe n’inshuti n’abavandimwe ugomba mbere mbere kuwukura k’uwo mwashakanye kuko asa nkaho myanya y’abo ayihariye nubwo bitaba burundu akubuze gukomezanya n’inshuti n’abavandimwe gusa menya urugero byari biriho atarirwo uzakomezaho kuba mudahuje nzozi mufite n’ibyifuzo by’ahazaza mbere buri wese yabaga afite inzozi ze z’ibyo yifuza kugeraho ariko kugirango bigende neza musabwa kugira inzozi z’urugo buri wese agashyigikira kugera nzozi ze gihe zifitiye urugo rwanyu umumaro kwibeshya urugendo rwarangiye izindi mpinduka zishobora kuba bamaze gushyingiranwa buri wese yituriza akumva yageze yumvaga ashaka kugera mbese intego kubona abanye n’umukobwa cyangwa se umusore yakundaga ubundi bikarangiriraho mugasigara ntego y’ubuzima bw’urukundo rw’ahazaza mufite imbere na nyuma gushaka urukundo rurakomeza ugakomeza guha agaciro mwashakanye nkuko wakamuhaga mbere mutarabana kumenya ingeso utari uzi hari kandi nyuma kubana ushobora kubona ingeso utari uzi k’uwo mwashakanye mbere ikaba yagutungura cyangwa se waba usanzwe uyizi ikarushaho gukura witangira kwicuza impamvu wemeye kubana ahubwo komeza umugaragarize urukundo rurenze n’urwo wamwerekaga mbere iga kwirengagiza ibibi ubona k’uwo mwashakanye uhange amaso byiza bye bizabafasha izi zimwe mpinduka zishobora kuba bashakanye bamaze igihe gito bashakanye bikaba bishobora kubasenyera kuba intandaro y’amakimbirane igihe mutabyitwayemo neza mubiganireho kandi mufashanye mwese mube mufite intego kugira urugo rwiza

title: u rwanda rufite icyuho toni zisaga rwihaze buki
content: kuri gicurasi isi yizihije umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe inigwahabiri z’inzuki rwego kuzirikana akamaro kazo buzima muntu mu rwanda inzuki zizwi buvumvu kuko zikora ubuki bwifashishwa benshi bintu bitandukanye umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe ubworozi bw’inzuki kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuhinzi n’ubworozi rab mwiza kazimbaya willy yabwiye igihe ubuvumvu bukomeje gutera imbere ariko hakenewe imbaraga kwita nzuki kugira zitange umusaruro uhagije abavumvu bakomeje kugaragaza kenshi bituma umusaruruo wabo utiyongera inzuki zabo zicwa n’imiti yica udusimba iterwa myaka zajya guhova zigapfa umuvumvu wabigize umwuga karangwa sewase yabwiye igihe hakwiriye kwigwa uburyo hakorwa ubuhinzi budakoresha imiti yica inzuki ati ese umuntu ahinze ntakoreshe iriya miti yica inzuki ntabwo yakweza nibwo bushakashatsi ndimo ubusimba bwinshi buzanwa n’ibyo twita inyongeramusaruro umuntu akoresheje ubundi bwoko bw’ifumbire gakondo ubwayo iba yifitemo acide zikabwica buryo umusaruro wacu ushobora kuba mwinshi ntihavuke utundi dusimba turya imyaka n’inzuki zikabaho mwiza yemera hari imiti yifashishwa buhinzi yica inzuki ariko akavuga hari n’ubumenyi buke bavumvu badashaka ibindi biryo byunganira inzuki zihova buryo hari igihe zishobora kwicwa n’inzara bakabyita zishwe n’imiti ati hari abigeze kumpamagara i nyamagabe ndebe ikibazo abavumvu bahuye nacyo bavugaga imiti ariko gusuzuma rugatera amagi menshi umuzinga ukiyongera mwiza yagize iyo inzuki zitabonye kurya umuzinga ugenda usubira inyuma kugeza igihe umuvumvu ashobora kuzasanga inzuki zararangiye abantu bafite imirima bwite bashobora gutera n’ibiti by’indabo kugira inzuki zabo zitajya zijya kure ahubwo zibone kurya twatangiye kubakangurira kororera mashyamba leta hirya hino turere karangwa yavuze ubworozi bw’inzuki bwitaweho bushobora kuza bimwe byinjiriza u rwanda amadevizi menshi ati inzuki ntawe uziragira ntabwo zirwana ziriragira zikicyura gusa zikabangamirwa n’aho zagiye gutara abantu dushoyemo imari yaba made in rwanda izanira amafaranga igihugu tubonye umusaruro mwinshi twasagurira n’amahanga ubuki bugakurikira icyayi kuzanira igihugu amadovize kuba ubuki bwose bukenewe gihugu butaboneka biha urwaho ubuki bindi bihugu kwigarurira isoko ry’u rwanda karangwa yavuze igihombo banyarwanda atari buryo bw’amafaranga gusa ahubwo buryo bw’ireme ry’ubuki bagura ati ubuki rwanda buraryoha by’umwihariko majyaruguru ahantu hakonje mashyamba buba buryoshye kuruta ubw’ahandi umuvumvu karangwa sewase yavuze isoko ry’ubuki rwanda rihari cyane ahubwo igikenewe ugukomeza gufasha abavumvu kongera umusaruro mu rwanda habarirwa abavumvu basaga ibihumbi ariko ababikora kinyamwuga ntibarenze habarirwa kandi imizinga kijyambere igera bihumbi gihe isaga ibihumbi gakondo mwiza yavuze bagiye gukomeza gukorera ubuvugizi abavumvu kugira bahabwe ibyangombwa nkenerwa byose bituma bongera umusaruro uretse ubuki bukoreshwa ngeri zitandukanye nko nganda z’imiti izenga inzoga izikora amabombo n’ibindi hari n’ibindi bitandukanye kandi bikomoka nzuki bigira akamaro mu bindi biva nzuki bigira akamaro harimo nk’ibishashara byifashishwa gukora buji insinda zifashishwa buvuzi urucumbu propolis rukoreshwa gukora amavuta n’ibindi bikoresho by’ubwiza ubumara bw’inzuki bukoreshwa buvuzi bw’indwara rubagimpande ndetse n’igikoma cy’urwiru gele royale gikorwamo amavuta afite intungamubiri amafoto umuryango title: bugesera nyuma y’inzara yaharanzwe karahahira utundi turere
content: mu myaka yashize cyane cyane umwaka w’ akarere bugesera kagaragayemo ikibazo cy’amapfa akabije hari abantu bicwaga n’inzara abandi bagasuhukamuri gihe uhatembereye ushobora kugira amateka cyangwa se amakabyankuru y’abantu abenshi baturage hari bahatuye nibo bivugira kibazo cy’inzara kihaherutseniyonzima joseph w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari maranyundo amaze imyaka aka karere avuga inzara yatangiye kugaragara bugesera mpera y’ ariko ikaza gukaza umurego mwaka w’ avuga gihe ibintu byose byari byarabuze biryo mvaruganda kugeza bijumba bihingiragaagira umva ibijumba ibijumba gihe inaha byaribwaga n’umuntu ufite imodoka ndakubwiza ukuri mukene wapfaga kubyigondera niyonzima yongeraho impamvu yateraga byose izuba ryari ryaracanye buryo batirirwaga bahinga n’uwahinganga ntiyeze avuga igihe ahantu hapfaga kwera ibijumba hari bishanga kandi byajyaga kubageraho byahenze yongeraho mwaka w’ abantu bishwe n’inzara buryo bukabije duce twa gashora ngenda gahembe maranyundo abandi barasuhuka ati gihe abagabo benshi barahungaga kubera kubura bagaburira imiryango abagore bakishyira migozi kubera kubura bagaburira abana mukanzaramba feresita umugore w’imyaka y’amavuko atuye murenge mayange avuga ikintu cyaje kubarokora bugesera haje imishinga n’imwe igatangira kubaha imfashanyo z’ibiribwaagira muri gihe tutarabona imfashanyo amahirwe yasekeraga yabonaga rukacarara icyo gihe twayitaga shira umuteto kuko mbere wasangaga hari abantu batarya umutsima w’amasaka gusa abatuye aka gace bavuga ibintu bisa n’ibyasubiye buryo kuko imyaka irera abantu bakabona ibiryo bavuga ufite inoti y’igihumbi urya amanywa n’ijoro nyirabitanga jolie utuye bugesera avuga nzara ikiharangwa aka karere gahagaze neza isoko ibintu biraboneka ibiboneka kurusha ibindi harimo imboga ibishyimbo imyumbati inanasi ibigori n’ibindi ugeze isoko nyamata gice gicururizwamo imboga abacuruzi bazo nabo bemeza imboga ziboneka bwinshi mukarwema annonciata umucuruzi soko nyamata umaze imyaka igera acuruza avuga ibicuruzwa byabonetse nyuma y’aho mbere gucuruza byasaga n’ibigoranye kubera baburaga barangurira agira ibintu biriho ikibigaragaza inyanya intoryi n’izindi kandi urabona hano isoko abacuruza imboga babaye benshi kandi n’abo tundi turere basigaye baza kurangura hano aganira kigalitodaycom rwagaju louis uyobora akarere bugesera avuga icyatumye inzara igabanuka aka karere leta yafashe ingamba gutera ibiti n’amashyamba hirya hino kariya gace avuga iterwa ry’ibiti ryatumye imvura itangira kugwa n’imyaka ikaboneraho gutangira kwera ati ubu hari ibicuruzwa abacuruzi b’ i kigali buhinzi gusa muri ako karere hari igihe cyageze bitoroshye kubona n’igiti kubera izuba ryari ryarahibasiye umuntu yashoboraga gusanga amatungo yapfiriye nzira kubera kubura ubwatsi n’amazi kuko hendaga kuba ubutayu egide kayiranga
