title: rwamagana abagabo babiri bafunzwe bakekwaho ubujura bw’inka karere gatsibo
content: ku italiki nzeli kagari manunu umurenge fumbwe abagabo babiri batawe yombi polisi ikorera karere rwamagana nyuma gukekwaho uruhare bikorwa by’ubujura bw’inka bikekwa bazibye karere gatsibo abafashwe gasajya theogene w’imyaka y’amavuko rutimbo claude bivugwa baziguze n’ abashumba bazo bakazicisha inzira y’amazi bazizana murenge fumbwe zafatiwemo umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda ntara y’i burasirazuba ip emmanuel kayigi yavuze gihe saa munani z’amanywa italiki nzeli abaturage kagari mununu babonye inka zambutswa ikiyaga muhazi zerekeza murenge fumbwe ip kayigi yagize twahawe amakuru n’abaturage hari inka zambukijwe zerekezwa ibagiro nyagasambu kandi barimo gukeka zaba inyibano nibwo twahise tuzihagarika ndetse abazifatanywe bakaba bafunze ip emmanuel kayigi akaba avuga bakekwa kugira uruhare bujura bw’aya matungo harimo abashumba b’izo bajura ndetse bamwe bacuruzi bakorera ibagiro zari zigemuweho hagati ariko umugabo witwa kimenyi john usanzwe utuye karere gatsibo unavuga ize nyuma gutanga ibimenyetso bigaragaza ize yavuze yazororeraga murenge murundi karere kayonza akaba ataramenya uburyo zageze murenge fumbwe kuri umuvugizi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba akaba avuga ubundi abacuruzi b’amatungo kuyavana gace kamwe bayajyana kandi bafite amabwiriza kuyatwara modoka uburyo bwakoreshejwe kuyazana anyuze mazi bukaba butemewe nacyo cyatumye abaturage babikemanga polisi nayo ikaba yatangije iperereza hamenyekane ababiri inyuma ip kayigi yongeyeho polisi y’u rwanda yahagurukiye kibazo harimo gufata abishora bujura gukorana inama n’aborozi duce turimo ubworozi bwinshi hagamijwe kubakangurira gukoresha abashumba bizeye neza kandi bafite umwirondoro uzwi ndetse gukorana n’inzego z’ibanze hagamijwe gukaza amarondo ip kayigi asoza asaba abaturage kujya batanga amakuru y’abantu babona bafite amatungo buryo budasobanutse kuko uretse kuba bikorwa bibi by’ubujura byahombya igihugu n’abaturage rwego rw’ubukungu matungo ashobora gutera n’indwara kuko habayeho bujura inyama zayo akenshi zigurishwa zidapimwe indwara n’abaganga b’amatungo babifitiye uburenganzira abo bajura nibaramuka bahamwe n’icyaha bazahanishwa igifungo kiri hagati y’amezi kugera myaka nk’uko bikubiye ngingo gitabo cy’amategeko mpanabyaha repubulika y’u rwanda viarnp yanditswe niyomugabomuhaburarw

content: mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kabiri tariki ukwakira dr kayiteshonga yvonne ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iby’ubuzima mutwe minisiteri y’ubuzima yagaragaje intera urwanda rumaze gutera mubijyanye guteza imbere ubuzima umutwe ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu karere hakaba harimo politiki nshya kwegereza abanyarwanda ubuvuzi bujyanye n’indwara umutwe kuburyo nibura byazagera kurwego rw’ibigo nderabuzima kuko kugeza hari abaganga b’ubuvuzi bw’uburwayi umutwe rwego rw’akarere gusa hashyizweho kandi serivisi yakira ikanasuzuma abafite ibibazo by’uburwayi umutwe yunganira ibitaro ishinzwe gusezerera gusubiza mubuzima busanzwe ingabo zavuye kurugeroyasobanuye kandi uburwayi umutwe uburwayi nk’ubundi ndetse hari n’ubushobora kuvurwa bugakira ikibazo cy’uburwayi mumutwe rwanda kigenda gifata intera umwaka utashye nkuko imibare y’abitabira servise z’ubu buvuzi ibigaragaza mwaka umubare w’abagannye buvuzi abantu mwaka mwaka bamaze kugera umwaka ushize abagannye serivisi uretse kuba u rwanda rwarahuye jenoside ndetse n’ingaruka zayo zimwe muzindi mpamvu zitera kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare abanyarwanda bamaze gukangukira kwitabira gahunda z’ubuvuzi cyane cyane kuko banafite ubwisungane kwivuza ikindi imyumvire igenda ihinduka kuko ubundi wasangaga abafite burwayi barafungiranwaga bagahezwa bagahishwa cyangwa bakavurizwa mubavuzi gihanga mubapfumu bumwe buvuzi buhabwa abafite burwayi harimo imiti gufashwa buryo bw’ibiganiro hamwe kubafasha kwongera gusubira buzima busanzwe buryo butatu hari ushobora kubuhabwa bwose hari n’ushobora guhabwa bumwe cyakora uburyo nk’amadayimoni bakaguma nsengero ntibavuzwe ikindi umubare w’inzobere buvuzi ukiri muto rwanda mu butumwa bwatanzwe harimo kumva ikibazo cy’uburwayi umutwe icya buri wese kandi uwahuye nabwo akitabwaho mumuryango hakabaho guhindura imyumvire ndwara hakorwa ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira imikoranire hagati ministeri y’ubuzima n’abavuzi gihanga kuko usanga abafite burwayi abenshi ariho babanza bigatuma bagera kubuvuzi nyabwo batinze ikindi nabagize ibyago kuzirwara bakwiye gufashwa bakanitabwaho muryango nyarwanda kuko uburwayi umutwe nabwo uburwayi nkubundi ndetse nuwahuye nabwo akongera kwakirwa buzima busanzwe marie jose ikibasumba

title: uko yandikiye habyarimana amusaba kwemera amashyaka menshi yanze kuba padiriikiganiro antoine mugesera
content: antoine mugesera w’imyaka y’amavuko yavukiye karere nyaruguru ni umwe mpuguke n’inararibonye u rwanda rufite amashuri abanza yayize iwabo nyaruguru ayisumbuye ayiga iseminari nto i kabgayi n’i kansi kaminuza yayize i burundi zare repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo ni umwe banyamuryango b’imena b’umuryango fpr inkotanyi dore yanawubereye komiseri yayoboye uruganda rw’ikawa rwandex yayoboye ibuka umusenateri imyaka umunani bagize urwego rw’igihugu ngishwanama muzehe mugesera yagiranye ikiganiro kirambuye igihe atubwira byinshi rugendo rwe politike yanze kuba padiri n’uko yahirimbaniye impinduka gihe cy’ubutegetsi habyarimana igihe wize iseminari kuki utabaye padiri mugesera nagiye iseminari gushaka imana sinayibona ndahava nta wanyirukanye wankoreye urugomo giti cyanjye mvuge arandenganyije abapadiri bera bameze nk’abaparimehutu nako bagiraga urugomo n’ivangura ariko sinavuga nibo batumye mvamo navuyemo giti cyanjye nashakaga sibyo nabonye ndavuga nti nzajya gushaka imana ahandi igihe uri umwe bandikiye habyarimana musaba amashyaka menshi ni cyabateye gushira amanga mugesera hari igihe kigera hakabaho abantu bashaka impinduka twari turi abasore bize hirya hino tugasoma tukagakurikira ibibera hirya hino tukabigereranya n’ibyo tubona gihugu muri - twishyize hamwe turi abasore bajijutse twari tuziranye kandi duhuje ibitekerezo twese twashakaga impinduka ariko ntitwari dufite ishyirahamwe ryanditse twaragendaga tugakorera inama zacu tukavuga tubona bikwiye guhinduka iby’izo nama twakoraga byageze biramenyekana umusore umwe twe baramufunga baramubabaza cyane ariko ntitwacika intege twakomeje kujya dukora inama rwihishwa bukeye umwe twe witwa karemera gaspard n’ubu aracyariho bubiligi aduha igitekerezo nimureke twandike ibaruwa tuyisinyeho twandikire habyarimana hagomba kubaho amashyaka menshi’ ibaruwa yanditswe n’uwitwaga seruvumba anastase tukajya dusinyisha inshuti zacu tumaze kugera bantu hari umwe twe uziranye n’umuntu nzego z’iperereza atubwira byamenyekanye ibyo gusinyisha abantu turabihagarika abantu baratatana igiheiby’iyo baruwa mwabihonotse mute mugesera mu buri bucye inkotanyi zitere nari nagiye butumwa bw’akazi togo ariko njya kugenda hari abantu twari tuziranye nkotanyi ndangije ubutumwa sinagarutse rwanda ahubwo nagiye zare nari narahize mpafite inshuti nagezeyo banshakira akazi bucyeye inkotanyi zintumaho nzisanga rugamba nagumanye nazo kugeza urugamba kubohora igihugu rurangiye igihe uko niko wagiye nkotanyi mugesera oya nari nsanzwe ndiyo mfite bagenzi banjye tuziranye bari kumenya bate se ntariyo nari nsanzwe ndiyo kandi ndi hano igihe hari igitabo wanditse uvuga revolusiyo yapfubye mwashakaga kuvuga mugesera twashingiye kubyo yagezeho gupfuba se si umusaruro wawe ibikorwa uzanye nibyo byerekana umusaruro wawe barebye ubwoko bumwe kandi revolusiyo ivugira ubwoko ivugira igihugu ikavugira abarengana baratsinzwe kubohoza umunyarwanda ntibabikoze ahubwo batuziritse irondakoko n’irondakarere igihe mubona mute uruhare amadini yagize gucamo ibice abanyarwanda mugesera sintandukanya amadini yazanywe n’abakoloni n’ubukoloni ubwabwo ni bimwe ariya madini yazanwe n’abakoloni azana n’ibitekerezo by’ubukoloniabamisiyoneri bashyiragaho umutware bashatse bakanyagisha bashatse bariya kimwe leta gikoloni ntiwabitandukanya ni bamwe leta parmehutu ndetse leta habyarimana kimwe ikimenyimenyi title: ibintu uwigisha ijambo ry’imana asabwa kugendera kure
content: kuvuga ijambo ry’imana impano itangwa n’umwuka wera w’imana ariko kandi ntibivuze ubikora akwiye kubura ubwenge kuko bishobora kudatanga umusaruro witezwe biturutse myitwarire yagize imbere bwanagarutsweho linda melvern umwanditsi akaba n’umunyamakuru ukora inkuru zicukumbuye wasabye abantu barwanya guhakana kwagaragara ariho hose umuyobozi ushinzwe amasomo ishuri ryitwa harrow dr title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize uruhare bikorwa bitandukanye muri harimo kuba yarakoranye atizigamye guverinoma yakoraga jenoside iyo raporo kandi ivuga kuba tariki mata alain jupp yarakiriye jrme bicamumpaka jean bosco barayagwiza guverinoma y’abatabazi ikibazo gikomeye kuko umuryango mpuzamahanga warafashe icyemezo guha akato guverinoma ndetse u bubiligi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika bakaba bamaze kubigaragaza bima viza bagabo inkuru dukesha igihecom

title: caf confederation cup as kigali yasezerewe marushanwa nyafurika
content: ikipe as kigali ihagarariye u rwanda irushanwa caf confederation cup yamaze gusezererwa marushanwa nyuma gutsindwa proline fc - mukino kwishyura wabereye i kampala gatandatu tariki nzeri ni nyuma yaho umukino ubanza wabereye i kigali makipe yombi yanganyije - bityo proline fc ikaba yakomeje giteranyo cy’ibitego - ni umukino as kigali yinjiyemo nabi kuko minota gusa abasore b’umutoza eric nshimiyimana bamaze kwinjizwa ibitego bibiri byatsinzwe byombi ivan bogere munota n’uwa gihe igitego cy’impozamarira bakibonye munota gitsinzwe farouk ssentogonsabimana eric zidane bagenzi ntibabashije kwikura startimes stadium lugogo kugeza kipe ihagarariye u rwanda marushanwa nyafurika y’uyu mwaka kuko rayon sports champions league yasezerwe rugikubita al hilal sudan uretse amakipe rwanda abakinnyi mpuzamahanga b’abanyarwanda nabo bakina makipe atandukanye afurika benshi bamaze gusezererwa uretse petro atletico y’i luanda angola jacques tuyisenge yabashije kwinjira matsinda caf champions league young africans sibomana patrick pappy nubwo yasezerewe rushanwa champions league iacyafite andi mahirwe kuba yakwinjira matsinda confederation cup gihe yaramuka itsinze bizahura mukino kamarampaka uzayihuza n’imwe makipe yabashije gukomeza kindi kiciro rushanwa

title: gitwaza yaguze urusengero miliyoni amerika
content: uru rusengero rwari rusanzwe urw’umuvugabutumwa ukomeye amerika witwa mike murdock yari asanzwe yararushyize isoko cyamunara nk’uko bigaragara mbuga internet amakuru avuga umushumba w’itorero zion temple aptre dr paul gitwaza yaje kumenya murdock kugurisha uru rusengero yuririra bushuti bafitanye amusaba yarugura kugira zion temple ariho izajya isengera dore hari amakuru avuga narwo rushobora kuba icyicaro gikuru cy’iri torero bivugwa gitwaza yasabye murdock kumudohorera akarumuhera mafaranga make yemera gukura agaciro karwo miliyoni z’amadolari yemera arwegukana nguzanyo miliyoni umunani z’amadolari izishyurwa gihe cy’imyaka itanu mu materaniro yabaye cyumweru leta zunze ubumwe amerika gitwaza yashimiye abakirisitu b’itorero rye amerika gihe cy’umwaka rimaze rihakorera yavuze gihe ryari rimaze kwimuka inshuro ebyiri ariko ubwa gatatu tuzabayo burundu’ aha niho yahereye ahishura iby’igurwa ry’urwo rusengero kandi uwabigizemo uruhare umubyeyi dr murdock yavuze murdock yabwiwe n’imana urwo rusengero akwiye kurureka ariko akaruha umuntu imana izamushyira mutima ati bamuhaye amafaranga miliyoni z’amadolari njye yarabimbwiye ngira inkuba zikubise matwi nagize ukwizera guke ariko nabisabiye imbabazi arambwira wowe ndumva nzu imana yambwiye nyiguhe anshyira mutego arambwira urampa angahe ndananirwa natashye ntavuze namubwiye nshobora kumuha mbere ariko sinayavuga hano kuko ateye isoni ariko nyuma ndabaza ngisha inama nandikira n’inshuti yanjye nti nakoze ishyano irambwira iti ntutinye murdock umubyeyi ngo yabajije nshuti ashobora kuba yakongera kuvuga yakwishyura imubwira yabikora kibazo ati turandika musaba yahaduhera miliyoni umunani umubyeyi ntiyanze abandi bamuhaye miliyoni akuraho miliyoni eshanu mwibaze gitwaza yavuze yabwiye murdock mafaranga afite ashobora kuba yakwishyura myaka itanu amubwira kibazo ati ndamubwira nti nanjye ngiye gukora imyaka itanu ntizagera yavuze abakirisitu zion temple n’imana aribo bazatuma bigerwaho bityo kuko bamaze igihe basembera bukode murdock witabiriye materaniro yemereye gitwaza azamufasha bikorwa gukusanya amafaranga agamije kwishyura deni muri masengesho abakirisitu bitanze ibihumbi by’amadolari urwo rusengero rufite buri kimwe cyose nkenerwa itorero nk’icyumba gusengeramo ibiro ibyumba bito kwigiramo n’iby’inama icyumba televiziyo n’ibindi zion temple yatangiye itariki nyakanga bigizwemo uruhare n’abantu inkuru wasoma aptre gitwaza yahishuye byinshi ubuhanuzi amadini ikiganiro gikomeye n’intumwa papa n’ibindi video amafoto agaragaza uru rusengero ruherereye denton leta dallas

title: ese rwanda haba harabantu bakiraguza
content: abanyarwanda bajyaga gukora igikorwa aricyo cyose guhiga rugamba gukora ubukwe cyangwa bagiraga ikibazo kibakomereye bagombaga kubiraguriza kugirango bamenye bizatungana cyangwa se bitazatungana birimo inzitizi bakabamenyesha bagomba gukora kugirango bizatungane aribyo bitaga guhabwa insinzi kuraguza byafatwaga gihe kera nko kubaza gusesenguza cyangwa guhanuza bakurambere kugirango umenye gahunda uteganya gukora nzitizi cyangwa se ibihato zizagira ukabasaba kugutsindira abanzi kugutsindira abagome kugutsindira abambuzi kugutsindire abajura gahunda zawe zose ese muhango wakorwaga ute iyo wajyaga kuraguza wagombaga kujya kureba umupfumu wafatwaga nk’umuhanuziu kamugezaho gahunda zose uteganya ubundi akakuragurira akoresheje inzuzi zakwera ukaba ufite amahirwe gahunda zawe zakwirabura ukaba mahirwe ufite gahunda ukaba wazireka cyangwa se akagushakira insinzi kugirango gahunda zawe zizagende nk’uko ubyifuza mu rwanda baragurizaga ibintu byinshi birimo n’iyo bajyaga kugushinga imirimo bagombaga kujya kuguhanuriza kukubariza cyangwa se kubaza abakurambere kugirango barebe murimo bu kwerere busange ugukwiriye koko cyangwa bukwiraburire busange utawukwiye bakabona kuwugushinga cyangwa bakawukwima kubera ndagu zabaga yerekanye muri byinshi baragurizaga harimo gusaba umugeni iyo bajyaga gusaba umugeni babanzaga kumuraguriza barebe adafite amaraso y’indurwe amaraso asama bagahanuza mugeni atazabazanira ubujyahabi n’ibindi mu kuraguriza umugeni bajyanaga imbuto n’inkoko bakayuhira amacandwe y’umuhungu bakayibwira bati mana y’i rwanda ndahaguruka nkajya gusaba nyiranaka mwene naka ntansame sinzire uruhanga rwe sinzire twararanye sinyagwe n’amaherere nusanga ntabizira were inkoko bakayibaga yirabuye cyane baramurekaga n’iyo yeze cyane barayirekaga iyo yeze gato bayikurikiza inzuzi n’ingimbu byera byose bakabona kumusaba ibi bikaba byerekana abanyarwanda bitwararikaga byose kandi batapfaga kugira bakora batabanje kukiraguriza kubaza cyangwa guhanuza kugirango bamenye kiri bugende neza cyaba gifite inzitizi bakazishakira igisubizo gihamye aricyo bitaga insinzi denis fabrice nsengumuremyi muhaburarw

title: perezida kagame yakuye mirimo general patrick nyamvumba gukorwaho iperereza byinshi wamumenyaho
content: perezida repubulika y’u rwanda akaba n’umugaba w’ikirenga w’ingabo z’u rwanda mbere tariki mata yakuye mirimo general patrick nyamvumba umaze amezi macye minisitiri w’umutekano w’imbere gihugu perezida repubulika y’u rwanda akaba n’umugaba w’ikirenga w’ingabo z’u rwanda mbere tariki mata yakuye mirimo general patrick nyamvumba umaze amezi macye minisitiri w’umutekano w’imbere gihugu itangazo ryashyizwe hanze n’ibiro minisitiri w’intebe rivuga general nyamvumba yakuwe mirimo kugirango akorweho iperereza akekwaho iri tangazo kandi rivuga agomba kuba asubiye gukorera cyicaro cy’ingabo z’u rwanda gihe hagikorwa iryo perereza general patrick nyamvumba yavutse tariki kamena yagiye ashingwa imirimo itandukanye ngabo z’u rwanda twavuga nko kuyobora batayo y’ingabo zirwanira butaka umutwe mechanised ndetse brigade y’ingabo zirwanira butaka iyo mitwe yagiye ayiyobora aha gen patrick nyamvumba yarahiriraga inshingano kuba umugaba mukuru w’ingabo hagati y’umwaka w’ n’ general patrick nyamvumba yabaye umuyobozi ukuriye operasiyo n’imyitozo rwego rw’icyicaro gikuru cy’ingabo general nyamvumba yayoboye ikigo gishinzwe gutegura abasirikare bajya butumwa bw’amahoro kugera indi mirimo yashinzwe harimo kuyobora itsinda ryiga ihurizwa hamwe ry’umutwe umwe w’ ingabo z’u rwanda kuyobora komite ishinzwe ingengo y’imari y’ingabo ayobora n’umushinga ushinzwe kwiga ishyirwaho ry’ ishuri rikuru gisirikare gen patrick nyamvumba yanabaye intumwa ihuza u rwanda n’urwego rw’ umuryango w’afurika yunze ubumwe au n’ umuryango w’abibumbye un yagiye ashingwa kuganira n’izo nzego gusinya amasezerano y’ubufatanye ahagarariye igihugu cy’u rwanda general patrick nyamvumba yarangije ishuri rikuru gisirikare nigeria ndetse yize ishuri rikuru gisirikare zambia ryitwa title: leta uganda yemeje cyumweru gitaha izarekura abanyarwanda bafungiwe magereza atandukanye
content: kuri kane tariki kamena intumwa z’u rwanda n’iza uganda zakoranye inama komite igizwe n’intumwa z’angola repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo yashyiriweho gufasha rugendo gukemura amakimbirane hagati y’ibihugu byombi muri biganiro byabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga leta uganda yahishuye ifunze abanyarwanda barimo byitezwe bazarekurwa cyumweru gitaha intuma z’u rwanda zayobowe minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane dr biruta vicent ruhande uganda ziyoborwa minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga sam kutesa ku ruhande rw’abahuza repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo rdc yahagarariwe minisitiri wungirije ushinzwe umutekano n’imibereho y’abaturage gilbert kankonde malamba ho angola ihagarariwe minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga tete antonio leta uganda yemeje cyumweru gitaha izarekura abanyarwanda bafungiwe magereza atandukanye gihugu nk’uko byashimangiwe minisitiri sam kutesa nama minisitiri kutesa yavuze nyuma y’iperereza ryakozwe banyarwanda bafungiwe magereza atandukanye uganda basanze abagera bagomba gushyikirizwa u rwanda bitarenze cyumweru gitaha muhango ukazabera mupaka kagitumba milama yakomeje avuga hari abandi banyarwanda bagifunzwe bakurikiranywe n’ubutabera uganda iyo nama ibanze gusuzuma intambwe imaze guterwa n’ibihugu byombi kubahiriza amasezerano luanda angola yashyizweho umukono perezida repubulika y’u rwanda paul kagame mugenzi uganda yoweri kaguta museveni kanama ibyo biganiro biharurira amayira inama yitezwe guhuza bakuru b’ibihugu n’abahuza ikurikira iheruka kubera i gatuna gashyantare tariki minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda dr biruta vincent yagaragaje u rwanda rutewe impungenge kuba leta uganda ikomeje kurenga nkana myanzuro yafatiwe nama zabanje kugaragaza gukemura ikibazo kiri mubano w’ibihugu byombi minisitiri biruta yatanze urugero rw’aho itariki z’ukwezi gushize gicurasi abanyarwandakazi babiribajugunywe mupaka w’ibihugu byombi nyuma guhohoterwa n’inzego z’umutekano uganda uganda kandi ikomeje kwinangira intwaro igamije guhungabanya umutekano w’u rwanda chief editor muhaburarw

title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye mashanyarazi azagera baturage tugali twa byahi kanembwe karukogo ibarizwa mirenge rubavu cyanzarwe bahige yashimangiye mashanyarazi afite ingufu zihagije zizafasha abaturage kwivana bukene bahige yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma y’ubunani uru rugendo rwasorejwe isoko kijyambere ry’akarere rubavu riri kubakwa mujyi rwagati murenge gisenyi imirimo kubaka soko iracyari hasi ariko irimo kwihutishwa kugira rizatangire gukoreshwa aho riri isoko risanzwe rikorera hazazamurwa irindi gorofa hanubakwe imodoka zihagarara asoza gikorwa umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheh bahame hassan yibukije inshingano buri wese kurinda gukoresha neza ibikorwa remezo gihe bizaba byuzuye bahame yagize ibikorwa nk’ibi iby’umuturage turifuza buri wese agira uruhare kubibungabunga kubikoresha kuko uburenganzira bweumwe baturage utuye kagari karukogo seth mugema asanga amajyambere kwihuta abagana buryo yiteguye gutangiza umushinga iwabo cyaro nogosha imisatsi mujyi none kubera batuzaniye amashanyarazi ngiye kwimurira salon yanjye karukogo nk’uko byagaragaye akarere rubavu kari kwihutisha ibikorwa remezo bijyanye n’icyerekezo ariko cyane cyane hubakwa imihanda ariko inzira ikiri ndende akarere karateganya kuganira n’abafite amazu mujyi rwego kubafasha kwihutisha bikorwa bakihutisha iterambere aka karere pascaline umulisa

title: kagame yavuze u rwanda ruzafasha tshisekedi ugiye kugaba ibitero simusiga nyeshyamba
content: perezida w’ u rwanda paul kagame yavuze u rwanda ruzafasha repubulika demukarasi kongo igiye kugaba ibitero simusiga barwanyi burasirazuba bwayo barimo abanyamahanga n’ gihugu imbere mu barwanyi b’ abanyamahanga harimo fdlr irwanya ubutegetsi bw’ u rwanda perezida w’ u rwanda paul kagame yavuze u rwanda ruzafasha repubulika demukarasi kongo igiye kugaba ibitero simusiga barwanyi burasirazuba bwayo barimo abanyamahanga n’ gihugu imbere mu barwanyi b’ abanyamahanga harimo fdlr irwanya ubutegetsi bw’ u rwanda yabitangarije kiganiro n’ abanyamakuru cyagarukaga kwibohora nshuro cyabaye kabili tariki nyakanga umunyamakuru yabajije perezida kagame u rwanda ruzingira ntambara kongo igiye kugaba nyeshyamba perezida kagame tuzayinjiramo mu mpera z’ icyumweru gishize tariki kamena repubulika demukarasi kongo yizihizaga umunsi mukuru w’ ubwigenge nibwo perezida tshisekedi yavuze igihugu cye kigiye kugaba ibitero bikomeye nyeshyamba zirwanira gihugu yagize namaze gutegeka ingabo zacu kugaba ibitero simusiga djugu mahagi utu duce tubiri twiciwemo abasivile benshi bikozwe n’ inyeshyamba nk’ bivuga n’ abategetsi kongo perezida tshisekedi avuga bitero bizagera minembwe kivu y’ amagepfo ituri hakunze kumvikana ibitero by’ inyeshyamba cyane mu kwezi umwaka ushize tshisekedi yiyamamarizaga kuyobora repubulika demukarasi kongo kimwe yasezeranyije abaturage burasirazuba kongo ukugarura amahoro n’ umutekano bimaze igihe byarabuze aka gace perezida kagame avuga atewe ishema kuba habonetse umuntutshisekedi ufite ubushake guhashya inyeshyamba kongo kagame yavuze u rwanda ruzafasha kongo ntambara kurwanya inyeshyamba yagize ku ruhande kongo n’ tshisekedi yavuze tuzinjiramo twari tubitegereje ntewe ishema dufite umuntu hariya uvuga ashaka gukorana n’ abaturanyi gukuraho kibazo kigira ingaruka kongo kigira ingaruka baturanyi twese perezida kagame avuga kuntu kibazo cy’ inyeshyamba cyakomeza kuba imbogamizi iterambere ry’ bihugu ibihugu bikomeze byicare birebere gusa mu minsi mike ishize hari ibitero byagabwe nyeshyamba kongo bivuze bitero tshisekedi yavuze agiye kugaba nyeshyamba bishobora kuba byaratangiye mu mpera z’ ukwezi mwaka nibwo perezida kagame w’ u rwanda uwa kongo tshisekedi n’ uwa angola joo loureno bahuriye rdc biyemeza bagiye kurandura inyeshyamba ziri kongo

usanishwa n’ubutumwa perezida kagame nk’uko bigaragara binyamakuru ndetse n’abakoresha imbuga nkoranyambaga impamvu igagaragara abarimo victoire basanzwe bavugwaho kwihisha inyuma politiki demukarasi n’ubwisanzure ibi perezida kagame yatangaje n’ubwo yigeze avuga izina ndashaka kuburira bamwe hano bihisha inyuma y’ibintu politiki demokarasi ubwisanzure ibintu natwe dushaka kandi tukaba twe mbere content: ubushakashatsi bushya bw’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima oms bwagaragaje icyorezo coronavirus cyagize ingaruka zikomeye buvuzi ndetse serivisi zihabwa abafite izindi ndwara cyane imbaraga nyinshi ziri gushyirwa gukumira indwara coronavirus yagize abagomba kuvurwa baravurwa amavuriro yacu afunguye gihe ingendo zitari zemewe kuba umuntu afite transfert’ cyangwa se afite abarwayi bakomeza kuvurwa nk’uko bisanzwe buryo ruhande rw’u rwanda muntu ukeneye ubuvuzi bwose abubure ati ntabwo by’ukuri ruhande rw’u rwanda twavuga hariho cyuho kuvuga coronavirus yatwibagije cyangwa yatumye abari bakeneye ubundi buvuzi batabubona indege nto zitagira abapilote drones’ zisanzwe zimenyerewe gutwara amaraso n’imiti bitaro bitandukanye rwanda zifashishijwe kugeza ibinini bagiye gufata umuti uretse kwifashisha drones gufasha abarwayi kanseri hari abasigaye bohererezwa imodoka zijya kubafata batuye bakajya kwivuza i butaro hashyizweho kandi uburyo bitaro gisirikare i title: genmubaraka yahishuye u rwanda rwishyuriye uburundi miliyoni kwinjira eac
content: umuyobozi w’ingabo ntara y’iburasirazuba n’umujyi kigali genmubaraka muganga yahishuye u rwanda rwatangiye igihugu cy’u burundi amafaranga kwinjira muryango w’ibihugu afurika y’iburasirazuba eac n’ubwo batazirikana neza bagiriwe yatumye babasha kugera abandi ibi yabivugiye karere ngoma kiganiro yahaye urubyiruko rusaga muryango uharanira uburenganzira bw’abakomoka afurika pan african movement ishami ry’u rwanda rwaturutse turere twose tugize intara y’iburasirazuba genmubaraka yavuze nyuma y’uko abakurambere batekerereza u rwanda bakarugarura rwari rwahabyeumutima gukunda afurika watumye baravuga bati ntibihagije reka tugerageze dufashe n’abaturanyi afurika yacu batangira gufasha ibihugu by’abaturanyi muri baturanyi u rwanda rwafashije barimo kongo bakijije uwahoze perezida wabo mobutu genmubaraka marenga yavuze hari n’abandi u rwanda rwafashije kwinjira muryango afurika y’iburasirazuba ariko neza ntibayibuke atiariko dufite n’abaturanyi bacu hirya barabuze n’amafaranga gushyira muryango eac babuze kotizasiyo umusanzu u rwanda rutanga miliyoni zirenga kugira tubishyurirenubwo twayatanze nti biteguye kwakirwa byari nko kujya isoko bababwiye nimutayazana mwigumire iyousibye twumvaga tugomba kujyana nabo eac byose tubibafashamo abicishije marenga kandi yakomeje avuga icyatumye batabasha kubona mafaranga bahora bitekereza ibindi kugira batekereze cyabahuza bagenzi rwego gutera imbere kubaka afurika atiturangije twamenye impamvu yatumye batagira mafarangaiyo mpamvu bahora bitekerereza kumesaumuntu uhora atekereza kumesa ntabwo yatekereza ibindi birenze bakaririmba tuzabamesatuzabamesaimvura yabaye nyinshi ntabwo babona banikaariko u rwanda rwabishyuriye amafaranga kugira bajye muryango eac kandi nubwo tubishyuza yasabye urubyiruko kwishyiramo umugambi kwigira nk’uko biri murage w’u rwanda kandi bakaba aribo bazaragwa igihugu atiicyo nicyo duhora tuvuga u rwanda rugomba kwigira ejo ntituzajye gucunaguzwa natwe badutangiye amafaranga tugire ahandi twinjira kandi bizakorwa namwe usibye rdc bakijije mobutu n’uburundi batangiye amafaranga kwinjira eacgenmubaraka avuga u rwanda rwakomereje gahunda gutanga ubufasha bihugu malisudansudan y’epfosierra leonecentrafrika n’ahandi ariko kugira abanyafurika basubirane ijambo yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: u rwanda rwatahanye umwanya kabiri mikino y’i bujumbura
content: amakipe y’u rwanda yitabiriye mikino afite umugambi kwitegura imikino y’akarere gatanu izabera rwanda tariki - muri mikino yitabiriwe n’amakipe burundi rdc n’u rwanda amakipe yagombaga guhura hagati yayo hakarebwa amakipe abiri mbere agakina umukino nyuma mu bahungu u rwanda rwatsinze umukino umwe gusa rutsindwa imikino ibiri u rwanda rwatsinzwe n’amakipe abiri y’uburundi yitabiriye irushanwa ariko rutsinda ikipe yaturutse congo mu bakobwa ikipe y’u rwanda nayo yakoze nk’ibya basaza kuko yatsinze ikipe congo ariko itsindwa n’amakipe abiri y’uburundi ukurikije amakipe yitabiriye iryo rushanwa yitwaye amakipe abiri y’uburundi niyo yabaye mbere u rwanda ruba urwa kabiri congo iza mwanya gatatu nawo nyuma kuko yatsinzwe n’amakipe yitabiriye irushanwa umunyamabanga mukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino basketball rwanda ferwaba richard mutabazi waherekeje ikipe burundi yavuze intego yabajyanye bayigezeho kuko bashakaga ikipe y’u rwanda itinyuka gukina n’amakipe akomeye dore yakinaga n’abayirusha imyaka mutabazi avuga umutoza w’iyo kipe amonovic nenad yishimiye abakinnyi bitwaye mikino kuko hari abakinnyi batunguranye cyane mikino bakora byinshi batabatekerezagaho buryo byatanze icyizere cy’uko gikombe cy’akarere gatanu bashobora kuzahangana n’amwe makipe ahabwa amahirwe kenya mu irushanwa ry’akarere gatanu rizitwabirwa n’u rwanda uganda kenya tanzania ethiopia sudan ethiopia ikipe izaba iya mbere izahita ibona itike kuzakina igikombe afurika afrobasket u’ kizabera mozambique tariki - theoneste nisingizwe

title: gishubi barasaba ibyiciro by’ubudehe mijyi byaro byatandukanywa
content: abaturage batuye umurenge gishubi akarere gisagara intara y’amajyepfo barasaba inzego zibishinzwe kuvugurura ibyiciro by’ubudehe bishya basaba ibyiciro by’ubudehe baturage batuye mijyi byatandukana niby’abaturage batuye bice by’icyaro rwego kutabangamira bamwe abandi babyungukiremo gishubi barasaba ibyiciro by’ubudehe mijyi byaro byatandukanywa nyandwi vestine atuye mudugudu banga akagari nyakibungo umurenge gishubini umuhinzi wibiraka avuga ataboanye umuntu uhingisha ntahandi yakura amaramuko yagize ntabwo bikwiye umuturange winaha kiciro gatatu anganya numuturage mumujyi kiciro gatatu kuko ntibahuje imibereho nonese mwari womu mujyi cyagatatu umushoferi utwara igikamyo kijya hanze akaba mucya gatatu urumva duhuje imibereho nubushobozi koko leta bintu izabitandukanye kuko ntabwo bihuye rwose niyibizi clementine umudugudu gicaca akagari nyakibungo umurenge gishubi akarere gisagara ntajya kure yibyo umuturanyi avuga koko abona babangamirwa nibyiciro bashyirwamo yagize dutsikamirwa cyane nibi byiciro se umunyamujyi ukorera umushahara waburi kwezi ufite amazu akodesha nindi mitungo gatatu nange umururage rwimbi wumujyene ndi mukiciro kimwe nuwo muzungu wikigali urumva bihuye koko bikwiye guhinduka bigatandukanywa kuko bitari twaba tugitsikamiwe bikomeye cyane niyibizi yakomeje avuga ibice byicyaro byagakwiye kugira ibyiciro byabo byihariye nabatye mubice byumujyi bitandukanye nabo bakagira ibyiciro byabo bitandukanye nibyabo nibyo byakuraho twita nkakarengane babona basa nkaho bakorewe umunyamabanga shingwabikorwa w’umurenge gishubi renzaho jean damascene yagize ibyo abaturage bavuga nibyo gusa igikenewe cyane ubuvugiza kugirango hagire igikorwa ibyiciro by’ubudehe bishyirwa hakurikijwe amakuru abaturage batanze bifuza ibyiciro by’ubudehe mijyi byaro byatandukanywa nabyo inzego zibishinzwe zizabyigaho bibifatire umwanzuro renzaho jean akomeza avuga bibabye byiza kuko abaturage babivuze mugihe hategerejwe ivugururwa ry’ibyiciro by’ubudehe bishya cyane ibiriho abaturage byumvikanye kenshi banenga bashizwemo kuko bitajyanye n’ubushobozi bwabo umurenge gishubi n’umwe mirenge igize akarere gisagara ukaba uhana imbibi content: iyi mikino izitabirwa n’amakipe y’ibihugu biri munsi y’ubutayu sahara izatangira tariki ugushyingo uretse u rwanda ruzakira mikino andi makipe azaryitabira harimo burundi cameroon drc kenya namibia nigeria tanzania uganda zambia nk’uko bitangazwa bizimana dominique umuyobozi w’ishyirahamawe ry’imikino y’abamugaye rwanda npc akaba n’umukinnyi abakinnyi bameze neza kandi n’umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu w’umuholandi peter karreman yaraye ageze rwanda gusa dominique bizimana giti cye ufite akabazo kirenge gusa yizeye gukira vuba akazakina amarushanwa uretse guhatanira igikombe abakinnyi bazaba banashaka itike kuzakina imikino olympique izabera i londres bwongereza kwezi karindwi umwaka utaha abakinnyi bahamagawe bakaba banatangiye imyitozo bizimana dominique rutikanga james ngirinshuti eric ntagawa charles murema jean baptiste tuyishime vincent twagirayezu callixte hirwa danny vuningabo emile kuramba prosper ngizwenimana jean bosco ntawiha fidele gahamanyi jean baptiste kugeza makipe y’u rwanda mikino itandukanye hamaze kuboneka amatike abiri gusa afitwe muvunyi hermas ukina sitting volleyball adrien niyonshuti ukina umukino gusiganwa magare thoneste nisingizwe

title: gatsibo tariki mata itariki itazibagira mitwe benshi by’umwihariko abari batuye komine
content: gatete jean baptiste burugumesitiri komine murambi yahoze byumba yategetse interahamwe kwica abatutsi babaga komine buryo n’umwe usigara tariki mata itariki itazibagira mitwe benshi by’umwihariko abari batuye murambi kuko aribwo abatutsi ibihumbi n’ibihumbi bahungiye paruwasi gatolika kiziguro bishwe bigizwemo uruhare gatete umurenge kiziguro umwe mirenge igize akarere gatsibo ahahoze komini murambi aka karere kazwiho kuba karabereyemo ubwicanyi bukaze gihe jenoside abatutsi benshi batawe rwobo kizuguro abenshi biciwe kiliziya yaho abashyirwa majwi gukora mahano uwari burugumesitiri komini murambi gatete jean baptiste ku itariki mata abatutsi barenga ibihumbi bitatu baturutse duce dutandukanye tw’iyi komini bahungiye kiliziya kiziguro bishwe itegeko gatete umupadiri witwa rutinduka laurent wagerageje gukora ubucukumbuzi bwimbitse mateka y’uru rwobo kiziguro avuga ibyahabereye biteye ubwoba ndetse navuze amateka yicyobo cyajugunywe mo abatutsi padiri rutinduka avuga kubera agace k’iburasirazuba kazwiho kutagira amazi cyari komini murambi bikaba byari nibyo byatumye mwaka umupadiri witwa melchior fuyana ukomoka gihugu esipanye akaba yarayoboraga kiliziya kiziguro yafashe umugambi guha abatuye aka gace amazi meza abanje gukora igikorwa gucukura hantu kuko yahapimye abona hashobora kuboneka amazi padiri fuyana gihugu yakomokamo bice by’igiturage habaga amariba afasha abaturage kubona amazi meza nibyo byatumye mwaka acukuza mwobo ashaka guha amazi abaturage kiziguro ariko bigeze metero yaje kugira ikibazo gikomeye guhura n’urutare kuzimu bituma asubika gato gikorwa nyuma padiri melchor yaje kwitabaza uwitwaga muramutsa joachim yaje kwicwa gatete jenoside wayoboraga ibirombe by’amabuye y’agaciro by’ahitwa bugarura komini muhura amusaba yamuha urutambi kumena uru rutare kugirango akomeza umushinga gushakira abaturage amazi agera metero z’ubujyakuzimu ariko amazi arayabura kandi mbere yarapimye agasanga arimo ngo yifuzaga azajya ashyiramo imashini ikogota amazi abanyakiziguro bakavoma nyuma padiri melchor yaje guhindurirwa imirimo avanwa i kiziguro hazanwa abandi bapadiri cyobo nticyasibwa gikomeza cyasamye umushinga wibagirana gutyo nyuma y’imyaka irenga cyobo cyamaze cyidasibwe mwaka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi itangiye guhera tariki mata abantu bamwe bageragezaga guhungira kiliziya kiziguro bagiye bicirwa nzira bugufi kiliziya abicanyi barimo gatete batangira kwibaza bashyira imibiri y’abo bantu bamaze kwicwa tariki mata abari bahungiye kiliziya kiziguro bagabweho igitero simusiga kigizwe n’abasirikare n’interahamwe bafashijwe gatete n’uwitwa rwabukombe wayoboraga komini muvumba abarenga ibihumbi bitatu barishwe ikibazo gikomeza kuba kumenya gushyira mibiri kubera cyobo cyari cyizwi n’abari batuye haje kuba inama ikomeye hamenyekane mibiri ishyirwa nibwo baje kwibuka uru rwobo ruhari batangira kujyanayo mibiri n’abakiri bazima bakajugunywamo bagihumeka kugeza imibiri irenga ibihumbi nibo bashyinguwe rwibutso jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kiziguro karere gatsibo padiri rutinduka kandi avuga ingabo fpr zateraga tariki ukwakira aribwo gatete yifashishije kinyamakuru bagatangaza amazina bamwe batutsi injijuke gihe bakabashinja kuba ibyitso by’inkotanyi ubundi tariki ukwakira bakajya kwicirwa i byumba kugeza gatete yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka n’urukiko mpuzamahanga rwari rwashyiriweho u rwanda umwe bahembereye amacakubiri yahoze komine murambi yabereye umuyobozi kugera ruhumuriza richard muhaburarw

title: u bubiligi rukumberi ntikizimye twararokotse’- mukayiranga
content: abarokotse jenoside bafite urugamba rukomeye gusigasira amateka bakusa ikivi cyasizwe n’abishwe uyu mukoro butumwa mukayiranga adorata uvuka i rukumberi agace kiciwemwo benshi muryango jenoside yakorewe abatutsi uyu mubyeyi utuye bubiligi yaganiriye igihe atanga ubuhamya mateka n’umuryango wishwe agaragaza uwarokotse afite inshingano zikomeye mateka n’ahazaza mu buryo bujimije kandi buri kinyarwanda cyiza mukayiranga aragarurira rukumberi ishusho yayo avuga rukumberi avuga abe igihe cyiza yahagiriye haba buto bukuru ibihe byiza yamaranye n’abe bahiciwe cyangwa biciwe hirya hino gihugu barashatse cyangwa bakoreraga iyi rukumberi ayivuga agira ndavuga rukumberi ariko mvuga buri wese wabaye mateka ibye kuko tugenda duhuza amateka si umwihariko wanjye gusa mukayiranga wavutse babyeyi baciriwe ako gace n’ubutegetsi bubi bwifuzaga abatutsi bazicwa n’isazi tse tse agira ariko babishakaga siko byagenze kuko barahabaciriye baraza batema ishyamba barahahinga barahubaka rukumberi igira imiharuro igira imigendererano igira abakobwa n’abahungu barorora baratunga bahagira ahantu heza bivuye ngufu zabo avuga ariko bitabujije umwanzi kurangiza umushinga yaratangiye kubacira mashyamba bazicwe tsetse kuko jenoside yawushyize bikorwa mukayiranga jenoside yakozwe se wabo i kigali ariko nzu yarimo abantu barishwe arokokamo wenyine muri rukumberi ahari urwibutso jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rushyinguyemo imibiri irenga ibihumbi mirongo ine harimo abaturanyi mukayiranga n’abandi bishwe bazira ubusa kugeza muvandimwe yigeze amenya urwo yishwe abone umubiri ibi ariko ntibimubuza kuza kenshi gusura kwifatanya n’abandi igihe cyose habayeho imihango gushyingura cyubahiro imibiri igenda iboneka bikamufasha kumva wenda haba harimwo abe basaza mukayiranga babiri bombi bishwe jenoside yakorewe abatutsi akomeza agir nubwo rukumberi harokotse abantu bake ntihazimye bazirikana ubutwari bw’ababyeyi bahageze bagatema ishyamba hagaturwa bagatunga bakabyara abana ku barokotse mubyeyi agaragaza igihe gusana imitima gufasha ababakomokaho kuzusa ikivi cy’ababyeyi bishwe yagize uretse rukumberi turi intumwa ntabwo tugomba kuba abasigariye ubusa tugomba gukora twishimira ubuzima turimo twishimira leta yacu idahwema kudufasha tugomba kuvuga ukuri byatubayeho agaragaza hatabayeho kurwanya abashaka kugoreka amateka hari abafite umugambi mubi bayasibanganya ati abantu batwishe bakatwicira imiryango bakatwicira igihugu bazatugorekera amateka bitubabaze yibutsa kubwira abana amateka nyakuri n’inzira guharanira jenoside itazongera ukundi mukayiranga asanga abanyarwanda bagize uruhare jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi bakica ababyeyi n’impinja baranganga igihugu cyabo ntabwo wakunda u rwanda umene amaraso y’abanyarwanda ashimira ingabo z’inkotanyi zabohoye igihugu zikarokora abari bataricwa bakabakura rufunzo n’ahandi ikiganiro vido

title: uruhinja mbere rwavutse hifashishijwe nyababyeyi yakuwe murambo w’umuntu
content: umwana w’uruhinja w’umukobwa yavutse afite ubuzima bwiza hifashishijwe nyababyeyi yakuwe murambo w’umuntu igikorwa cyamaze amasaha gutera nyababyeyi mubyeyi w’uru ruhinja - cyaje gukurikirwa kumwongerera ubushobozi kuba yabyara - cyabereye i so paulo brezile mwaka uyu mubyeyi w’imyaka y’amavuko yavutse nyababyeyi afite kuri nshuro uwatanze nyababyeyi umubyeyi w’abana batatu ugeze kigero cy’imyaka y’amavuko wapfuye azize amaraso bwonko uyu yahaye nyababyeyi yaje gutuma uru ruhinja ruvuka arwaye indwara izwi mayer-rokitansky-kster-hauser syndrome yibasira buri mugore umwe buri bagore isi ituma igitsina cy’umugore nyababyeyi bitirema neza ariko intanga ze zari zimeze neza kibazo zifite ni mpamvu abaganga bashoboye kumukuramo intanga ngore ze bakazihuza n’intanga ngabo z’uwaje kuba se w’urwo ruhinja uyu mugore yahawe imiti yaciye intege urwungano rw’ubwirinzi bw’umubiri rwe umubiri utahava urwanya nyababyeyi yatewemo ukayisohora hanze ’intambwe ndende itewe buvuzi’ hashize ibyumweru bitandatu yatangiye kujya mihangoubwo amezi arindwi arangiye yatewemo ntanga zahujwe nuko igihe gisanzwe gutwita kirangiye umwana w’uruhinja w’umukobwa upima ibiro bibiri n’igice avuka umubyeyi abazwe mwaka ushize tariki ukuboza dr dani ejzenberg bitaro das clnicas by’i so paulo yagize atinyababyeyi mbere zatewe zikuwe bantu bakiriho zabaye intambwe ndende itewe buvuzi bituma abagore benshi b’ingumba bashobora kubyara hifashishijwe abatanga nyababyeyi bakwiye n’ibikoresho buvuzi bicyenewe ’ibintu bishimishije cyane’ ariko gucyenera utanga nyababyeyi ukiriho imbogamizi ikomeye kuko abazitanga bacye cyane bikaba bimenyerewe muntu uyitanga muryango ufite bushake kandi abyemerewe n’amategeko cyangwa akaba umwe nshuti cyane dr srdjan saso kaminuza imperial college london bwongereza yavuze kuvuka k’urwo ruhinja ibintu bishimishije cyane yongeyeho atibishishikariza kuba hazakoreshwa nyababyeyi z’abandi benshi batandukanye bikoresha ikiguzi kiri hasi kandi bituma hirindwa ibyago bituruka kubaga abatanga nyababyeyi bakiriho hamaze kubaho ibikorwa gutera nyababyeyi zitanzwe n’abantu bakiriho harimo n’ababyeyi bahaye abakobwa nyababyeyi bikorwa bikaba byaravutsemo abana ariko ibikorwa byari byarabanje gutera nyababyeyi ikuwe murambo w’umuntu hamwe ntibyagenze neza ahandi inda zivamo niyomugabo albertmuhaburarw

content: muri minsi aharimo kuvugururwa agace k’ubucuruzi kazwi izina ryo mucyarabu akabarizwamo amahoteli ibisi faucon ndetse n’amabanki ecobank kbc ahandi harimo kuvugururwa ahahoze sitade huye tangiranye n’umwaka bikaba kandi bigikomeza ubu hoteli ibis hamwe banki ecobank bikaba byaramaze gusenywa kugirango hubakwe amazu agezweho pascal sahundwa umunyamabanga mpuzabikorwa w’umurenge ngoma ibirometero umunani by’imihanda gace kwitaba kandi nyuma yaho hazavugururwa imihanda ijya tundi duce ngoma matyazo hazakorwa kandi amatara mihanda ndetse haterwe ubusitani n’ibiti by’imirimbo rwego kongera ubwiza nyaburanga ndetse n’isuku y’uyu mujyi pascal asobanura ivugururwa ry’uyu mujyi inyungu buri muturage uwutuyemo ndetse n’igihugu rusange uyu mujyi murangiza kuvugururwa abaturage bazabona ibikorwa by’amajyambere birimo imihanda myiza n’amazu y’ubucuruzi yagutse ibi bizatuma haboneka abacuruzi baturutse bihugu bigize umurwango w’afrika y’iburasirazuba eac habeho ubuhahirane hagati y’uyu mujyi n’ibyo bihugu n’ubwo ubuyobozi bw’umujyi huye butegeka abafite amazu mujyi kuyavugurura bamwe banyiri mazu ntibabyumva kimwe n’ubuyobozi kuko bavugako basabwa kubaka amazu badafitiye ubushobozi umunyamabanga nshingwa bikorwa huye avuga ubuyobozi bw’uyu mujyi bugerageza kubavuganira banki kugirango babone inguzanyo buryo bworoshye hari kandi n’abavuga amwe mazu adakwiye gusenywa kuko afatwa nk’inzibutso z’uwo mujyi umuyobozi hotel ibis yagize kuvugurura ntibivuga gukuraho ibyagakwiye twibutsa ibihe byiza byashize twagiriye hoteli ibis pascal ariko avuga hakiri imbogamizi nyinshi iterambere ry’umujyi huye kuko abagafashije mujyi gutera imbere aribo bawusubiza inyuma aha aragaya abashoramari babona amafaranga nk’aho bayashoye iwabo huye bakajya i kigali n’ahandi bavugako i huye ntakigenda aranenga kandi igikorwa kwimurira amashami amwe n’amwe kaminuza nkuru i kigali abivuga magambo hari ikibazo cy’inyubako kaminuza niyubake kwimura mashami ahamya kaminuza mubiha agaciro mujyi huye clarisse umuhire

title: aborozi b’inzuki rwanda bahangayikishijwe n’inzuki zirushaho kugabanuka
content: aborozi b’inzuki rwanda baravuga bahangayikishijwe n’uko inzuki zirushaho kugabanuka gihe bikaba bishobora kugira ingaruka musaruro woherezwa isoko mu rwego gushakira umuti kibazo ministeri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi ikaba yemeza ikomeje gukorana n’impande zose bireba umuvumvu naho joseph mujyi kigali arabanza gufatisha ifumba abone yinjira ruvumvu neza n’ubwo bitoroshye ukurikije ubukana utu dusimba dufite tumudwinga imbori imyaka irihiritse akora ubworozi bw’inzuki aremeza ho hashingiye imibereho buri munsi ati kugeza mfite company imeze neza nishimira mbere kugeraho naho avuga afite indi mizinga hirya hino buryo ashobora guhakura toni nibura z’ubuki mwaka akurikije yatangiye urugendo n’uko bimeze hari intambwe yateye icyakora ntishimishije kubera ibibazo biri buvumvu bikomoka bikorwa muntu ati abantu basigaye bakoresha imiti myinshi yica inzuki cyane ugasanga abantu batarabyumva neza bumve umumaro wazo bakangiza imitiba bwende hari n’ubumenyi buke gukora ubworozi kijyambere bamwe batunganya bakanagurisha ubuki bemeza isoko ryabwo rihari haba imbere gihugu mahanga ariko bavuga ibibazo biri bworozi bw’inzuki bikoma nkokora ubucuruzi bwabo kabayiza gilbert ubuki kubucuruza si ikibazo ahubwo icyakwiye gukemuka mbere dukura ubuki abavumvu bavuga umwaka mwaka ubuki bugabanuka kubera ibibazo biba birimo nzuki nkumva bibazo bibashije gukemuka twabasha kubona twohereza isoko na ho musoni charles ubuki rwanda burakundwa cyane basanga buri rwego hejuru ibyo bigatuma basaba nk’ubu bati bishoboka mujye mutwohereza toni cyangwa buri kwezi iyo ubigereranije n’umwero w’igihugu dufite hari igihe ubusabe nk’ubwo utabwemera ugashaka busabe quantit ingano hasi bivuze birasaba dushyira imbaraga bworozi bw’inzuki minisiteri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi ivuga yahagurukiye ibibazo bigaragara buvumvu igasaba abahinzi kwirinda gutera imiti yica udukoko myaka gihe igifite indabyo abavumvu bagasabwa gutera ibiti bigira indabyo y’imizinga kugira inzuki zidakomeza kujya guhova kure mukasekuru mathildeumukozi ushinzwe ubworozi bw’amafi n’inzuki minisiteri yagize kuba bavuga zagabanutse gusa si rwanda honyine biraterwa n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere ushobora gusanga imvura igwa cyane kandi ikangiza byinshi zahovagaho ariko n’iyo izuba ribaye ryinshi ziba harangirika abavumvu tukaba mpamvu tubasaba gukoresha imizinga kijyambere abahonzi b’ikawa kimwe n’indi myaka tukabasaba kwirinda gutera imiti gihe ikawa zifite uruyange inzuki zidahuye n’ibizica zishobora gutanga umusaruro igihe kirekire inzobere by’ubuzima bw’inzuki zivuga uruyuki rushobora kurama imyaka rubaye rutahuye n’impanuka iruhitane ku munsi rushobora gukora urugendo rw’ibirometero kazi karwo guhova ubuki bukunzwe benshi kubera uburyohe bwabwo ndetse abenshi babukoresha mwanya w’isukari uretse hari bamwe babukoramo imiti ndetse n’amavuta kwisiga gihe ubworozi bw’inzuki bukaba bukurura abatari bake kugeza ubumu rwanda hari abavumvu makoperative hari imizinga ibihumbi gakondoibihumbi kijyambere n’indi ibihumbi y’iminyakenyaibi byose bikaba bitanga umusaruro toni buri mwaka mu gihugu kandi hari amakusanyirizo y’ubuki n’inganda zibutunganya chief editor muhabura rw

title: usa abanyarwanda batuye leta arizona bizihije umuganura bashishikarizwa kwigira
content: icyo gitaramo cyitabiriwe n’abanyarwanda batuye leta arizona n’inshuti zabo mu bashyitsi bitabiriye umunsi w’umuganura harimo musenyeri john rucyahana rev past dr antoine rutayisire n’abakozi ambasade y’u rwanda gihugu jean de dieu niyomugabo uhagarariye umuryango w’abanyarwanda batuye leta arizona yavuze umuganura umwanya gusuzuma imihigo y’umwaka ushize guhiga indi y’umwaka dutangiye yavuze abanyarwanda batuye arizona nabo bafite umuhigo kwiteza imbere buryo uba umuzigo gukomeza gufashwa leta musenyeri rucyahana n’ umujyanama mbere ambasade y’u rwanda leta zunze ubumwe amerika manzi lawrence bagarutse kamaro k’ umuco w abanyarwanda nawo bavomamo indangagaciro zibaranga n’ubumwe bwabo musenyeri rucyahana yasobanuriye abari umuco w’umuganura wakorwaga ashishikariza abanyarwanda hirya hino gufatana urunana bagakomera muco wabo bumwe bwabo bakirinda amacakubiri yaturuka hose yaboneyeho gusobanurira abari uburyo nyuma gusarura imbuto mbere zabaga umuganura w’ababyeyi ashimangira bidakwiye abanyarwanda batuye mahanga bibagirwa ababyeyi basize rwanda bigatuma umutwaro leta ikaba ariyo ibamenya ntege nke zabo zabukuru manzi lawrence waje ahagarariye ambasaderi mathilde mukantabana yashimye abanyarwanda batuye arizona ukuntu bakomeje kuba indashyikirwa bikorwa binyuranye bakorera hamwe bikaba bigaragaza ukuntu bashyize hamwe yagarutse ndangagaciro ziranga umunyarwanda asaba abari bateraniye gikorwa cy’umuganura kudatezuka muco wabo bumwe bwabo yavuze ubumwe bw’abanyarwanda gukunda igihugu byatumye u rwanda rutera intambwe igaragara nyuma jenoside yakorewe abatutsi akaba igihugu ntangarugero haba bumwe bw’abagituye ndetse iterambere yagize u rwanda rushyize imbere iterambere rirambye hamwe kwagura amarembo rugahahirana n’ibihugu cyane cyane mugabane w’afurika’ manzi yashishikarije abanyarwanda batuye arizona gukomera bumwe bwabo gushishikariza abashoramari bahatuye gushora imari rwanda ndetse nabo ubwabo yagize muze mushore imari mishinga yunguka ubuyobozi bw’igihugu buzabibafashamo kandi isoko rinini kuko u rwanda rwaguye amarembo ufite ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi rwanda afite amahirwe kugera isoko ryagutse ryo karere ndetse afurika igitaramo cyaranzwe n’imbyino kinyarwanda guha abana amata ndetse gusangira amafunguro yiganjemo imbuto zera rwanda

title: nukorera umukobwa azagerageza akore ashoboye kugira akwereke agukunda
content: kimwe n’abasore cyangwa abagabo abakobwa cyangwa abagore bafite ibintu bifuza bagabo bashatse cyangwa basore bakundanaumukobwa ugiye kubaka urugo akunda guhangayikishwa n’uko bashakanye ashobora kuba ataramwiyeretse bityo akagira ubwoba nibagera rugo azahinduka umukobwa kimwe n’umuhungu bahora barota kuzakomeza kuba rukundo nk’urwo buto urubuga the discovery news ruvuga bikurikirana nk’ibyo umuhungu cyangwa umukobwa bakunda ndetse bigakomeza bubatse n’urugo kuganira n’imvugo nziza igitsina gore cyangwa se abagore rusange abantu bakunda kwitabwaho kubwirwa neza buri gihe umukobwa arimo kurambagizwa akunda umusore umubyinirira umubwira amagambo meza yuzuye ubwuzu n’urukundo amubwira amukundira n’icyo yamukundiye zimwe ingingo z’umubiri akunda n’ibindiiyo anageze igihe kurushinga yumva umugabo agomba gukomeza akabikora uku akirinda cyose gishobora kumuhutaza kabone n’iyo yaba makosa umugore yifuza wamukosora umubwira neza kumwambika neza muri kamere y’abagore bahora bashaka gusa neza kwambara neza ukuvuga imyenda ijyanye n’igihe bakanisiga bagacya iyo umugore ashatse umugabo yumva agomba kumurimbisha akamwambika imyenda myiza izamuhesha icyubahiro azajya anyura isaha inigi amaherena n’ibindi kwihangana gutanga imbabazi umugore ahora yifuza umugabo uzamwihanganira igihe cyose cyane cyane gihe yagize intege nke ndetse akanamubabarira igihe kosheje nta mugore ukunda umugabo uhora umuncyurira cyangwa umuhoza nkeke z’ibintu atatunganyije neza ahubwo akunda wundi umuhora kandi agahora yiteguye kumubabarira kumwihanganira byose kumukunda mbere kandi ukabimwereka abagore cyangwa abakobwa bakunda abagabo badacika intege rukundo n’ukuvuga umugabo cyangwa umusore uhora ubereka urukundo atari umukunda minsi mbere yamara gufatisha agaterera abagore cyangwa umugabo ubasohokana umugore yifuza umugabo amuhindurira uburyo babanamo atari ukwirirwa rugo cyangwa kwirirwa bamenyereye kujya kazi kugaruka rugo gusa aba yifuza rimwe rimwe bihe week-end’ title: ibintu bitatu bigenderwaho gutoranya nyampinga w’u rwanda
content: ku nshuro gatanu hari gushakishwa abakobwa bazahagararira intara enye numujyi kigali bazatoranywamo uzambikwa ikamba nyampinga w’u rwandamu myaka hambere nyampinga yahozeho yabaga umukobwa uharanira guhesha ishema umuryango aho yajyaga yagombaga kwigaragaza neza nk’uwarezwe kinyarwanda wigishijwe ikinyabupfura kubaha kwirinda kugaragaraho ikosa ryaba rimeze kose mu gutoranya umukobwa wambikwa ikamba nyampinga w’u rwanda harebwa ibintu bitatu by’ingenzi bitangirwa amanota mu birebwa mukobwa harimo uburanga n’igikundiro ubuhanga kuba ashabutsemu kiganiro miss rusaro carine umwe bagize akanama nkemurampaka gatoranya abahatanira miss rwanda yavuze birebwa cyane harimo ubwiza bw’umunyarwandakazi n’ireme ry’ubumenyi afite ubwiza mubiri mu bishingirwaho batoranya uwitwa nyampinga babanza kureba uburanga igikundiro n’ikimero byose bikabarirwa amanota mirongo itatu ijana rusaro carine mu bintu dukurikiza harimo uburanga ndetse n’igikundiro judges turi batatu buri wese afite abibona eminante batanga amanota avuga ubwiza bw’umukobwa buterwa n’umuntu umureba bitewe n’ibyo yifuza cyangwa akunda bantu b’igitsinagoreireme ry’ubumenyi umukobwa wemezwa nyampinga ahiga abandi bumenyi kumenya gusubiza ibibazo abazwa iyi ngingo yagenewe amanota mirongo ine ijana ngo niyo ihabwa agaciro cyane kurusha izindi miss rusaro carine tureba ibisubizo atanga bibazo tuba twamubajije gifite amanota mirongo ine nacyo gifite menshi nyampinga umukobwa utorwa bagenzi kugirango ababere urugero abavugire ndetse anaheshe isura nziza igihugu cye mu bigenderwaho hatorwa mukobwa ntiharebwa ubwiza n’ikimero gusa ahubwo bareba cyane ubuhanga bwe yitwara kuvuga ashize amanga ruhamekuvuga ashize amanga ati ikindi gatatu tureba uburyo umukobwa asubiza ashobora kuba uhagaze neza kandi umuntu ufite ibitekerezo ariko wareba uburyo asubiza ugasanga ubutumwa ntabwo butambuka ingingo kureba imyitwarire y’umukobwa kuvuga n’uko yitwara biganiro bagenzi yagenewe amanota mirongo itatu ijana mu biranga nyampinga nyawe harimo kuba umukobwa ushabutse utagira ubwoba imbere y’abantu akaba umuhanga wanahagararira igihugu cye ntagisebye ku itariki gashyantare nibwo hazamenyekana umukobwa uzahabwa ikamba miss rwanda ’ birori bizabera camp kigali azahembwa imodoka bwoko suzuki swift

kuguma rugo ni icyemezo cyagize ingaruka bukungu bw’igihugu n’imibereho y’abagituye ariko kiba inyungu kirere cyongeye gusubirana umwimerere wacyo dr kalisa egide umwarimu kaminuza y’u rwanda ishami title: abandi bantu karere rusizi basanzwemo coronavirus
content: abantu basanganywe ubwandu bushya batumye umubare w’abamaze kwandura coronavirus karere rusizi burengerazuba bw’u rwanda bagera minsi itatu gusa minisiteri y’ubuzima itangazo ryayo kamena yatangaje abarwayi bashya bagaragaye karere rusizi bashyizwe kato n’abo bahuye bahise bakurikiranwa’’ mu ntangiriro gicurasi rusizi rubavu twari turere tw’u rwanda tutari twakagezemo cyorezo kimwe banduye coronavirus barimo abacuruzi abashoferi batwara ibintu babivanye cyangwa babijyanye i bukavu repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo n’umumotari kuri karere rusizi hafashwe ingamba gufata abacyekwaho gucuruza magendu bagahurizwa hamwe ndetse n’abashoferi batwara amakamyo yambuka umupaka rwego kwirinda ikwirakwira coronavirus hanakajijwe umutekano mupaka uhuza u rwanda rdc inama y’abaminisitiri yateranye kamena yafashe ingamba zitandukanye zigamije gukomeza kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo coronavirus zirimo moto zitwara abagenzi zemerewe gusubukura ibikorwa uretse turere twa rusizi rubavu ndetse ingendo hagati y’intara zemewe ariko kujya karere rusizi rubavu bibujijwe kuva umurwayi mbere covid- iterwa n’agakoko gashya coronavirus agaragaye rwanda werurwe hamaze kuboneka banduye bipimo bimaze gufatwa barayikize gihe bakiri bitaro babiri bitabye imana abarwayi babiri bitabye imana barimo umushoferi w’imyaka utuye gihugu cy’abaturanyi wahisemo gutaha rwanda nyuma kuremba ndetse n’umupolisikazi w’imyaka waragiye butumwa bw’akazi mahanga aba bombi bagaruwe rwanda barembye cyane bitabwaho n’abaganga kigo cyagenewe kuvura coronavirus ariko baza gupfa kugeza muti title: polisi y’u rwanda irashima amadini ruhare rwayo kurwanya ibyaha bigisha
content: polisi y’u rwanda irashima amadini ruhare rwayo kurwanya ibyaha bigisha abayoboke bayo kuba intangarugero mu rwego guteza imbere bufatanye kubushimangira polisi y’u rwanda igirana ibiganiro n’abayoboke b’amadini atandukanye cyane cyane urubyiruko ikabaha ubumenyi buryo barushaho kugira uruhare gukumira ibyaha guhugura abayoboke b’amadini atandukanye bigamije kubasobanurira uruhare rwabo kurwanya ikibi muryango nyarwanda kandi byabyaye umusaruro ushimishije ni urwo rwego itariki nyakanga polisi y’u rwanda yagiranye ikiganiro n’ urubyiruko rw’abadivantisite b’umunsi karindwi rugera ruri ngando karere nyanza bubi bw’ibiyobyabwenge urwo rubyiruko ruturuka turere twa nyanza kamonyi muhanga ruhango polisi y’u rwanda yarwigishije ubwoko bw’ibiyobyabwenge kandi irusobanurira ingaruka kubyishoramo mu butumwa bwe ushinzwe imikoranire polisi y’u rwanda n’abaturage ndetse n’izindi nzego karere nyanza inspector of police ip jean baptiste bizimana yabwiye urwo rubyiruko atizimwe ngaruka urubyiruko runywa ibiyobyabwenge ruhura harimo gutwara inda zitateganyijwe gukora ibyaha birimo ubujura gukubita gukomeretsa n’ibindi ni mpamvu ikoreshwa n’ikwirakwizwa ryabyo bigomba kurwanywa kandi buri wese akumva bimureba yakomeje ababwira uretse gushyira ubuzima bw’ababinywa kaga ibiyobyabwenge biteje ikibazo rusange kubera bituma abantu bakora ibikorwa binyuranije n’amategeko ip bizimana yabwiye kandi urwo rubyiruko nk’uko bivugitse ibiyobyabwenge bihindura imitekerereze y’uwabinyoye uretse kumutesha ubwenge ubinywa buzima afite mugomba kwirinda ikintu cyose gishobora kwangiza ahazaza content: mu ishuri ryisumbuye rwabicuma karere nyanza gatatu habereyemo igisa n’akavuyo umwana uvuka yaryo yavunaga umukoropesho umuyobozi arawumukubita uyu mwana yahise yirukanwa hamwe n’abavandimwe ubwire so kanyishyure amatafari yanjye nyuma aramupfukamisha umwana ariruka amukubita inkoni yikubita hasi abanyeshuri twese turahurura gitifu ahageze badukoresheje inama akavuga ibishyimbo by’injonjori bikorwa bindi hagasigara ibizima ngo bana bagomba kwirukanwa bakazagaruka ishuri ryarahinduye izina ritakitwa gs rwabicuma naho mwana mushiki w’uwakubiswe agira umuyobozi yamukubise inkoni raclette agiye kongera janvier arayifata wirengera tudasererera ahubwo wampa weekend ariruka ajya murugo abwira papa ahageze ahasanga gitifu dasso mu kanya mama aza kureba byifashe bigeze content: kubera impamvu z’ibiza byaturutse mvura nyinshi bigatuma igice cy’umuhanda kigali-musanze cyangirika bikomeye kigacikamo kabiri muhanda wabaye ufunzwe kubera modoka zishobora kunyura kuryegukana cyangwa atware agace karyo umunyarwanda aheruka kwegukana agace tour du rwanda tariki kanama ni mugisha samuel watwaye agace kigali- huye ndetse akaba gihe yaratwaye tour du rwanda kuva siganwa rizamuriwe urwego mwaka ushize ryatangiye kwitabirwa n’amakipe akomeye arimo n’akina amarushanwa rwego rw’isi umwanya mwiza umunyarwanda yabonye myaka ibiri uwa kabiri rutonde rusange watwawe mugisha mose ukinira skol adrien cycling academy saca gihe areruya joseph yabaye uwa cyenda kubwa ntiyamira jean sauveur komiseri w’umukino w’amagare asanga abanyarwanda bagenda bazamura urwego kuko byibuze nshuro hari uwabashije kuza batatu mbere ati umwaka ushize irushanwa ryabaga mbere riri umukinnyi w’umunyarwanda waje yabaye uwa cyenda areruya joseph ariko twuriye podium myanya itatu mbere biraturuka ukuntu twashyizemo imbaraga twungutse indi kipe saca nayo ifite umukinnnyi wabaye uwa kabiri rutonde rusange ikaba yariyongereye benediction n’ikipe y’igihugu ni ibigaragaza umukino w’amagare ugenda uzamuka muri kiganiro yagiranye igihe ntiyamira yavuze myaka itatu imbere abanyarwanda bazaba bafite ubushobozi kwegukana siganwa riri rwego ati ukurikije ibyabaye nubwo tutabashije gutwara etape agace k’isiganwa ariko ndaguha imyaka ibiri uwa gatatu tuzatwara tour du rwanda kuba dufite amakipe abiri ashobora gusohokera igihugu birashimishije tugeze harashimishije twabonye n’umushyitsi umuyobozi mukuru uci mwabibonye aba-minisitiri baje gutanga ibihembo nituramuka twemerewe gutegura shampiyona y’isi tuzahagera twaratwaye tour du rwanda ariko ibyiza biri imbere nkurikije twitwaye umwaka utaha bizahindura isura abajijwe migendekere y’irushanwa ry’uyu mwaka ryarimo imihanda myinshi igoranye basiganwa ntiyamira yavuze ryari irushanwa riteguye neza kuko mpanuka nyinshi zabaye muhanda ati nashimira tour du rwanda umutekano wagenze neza mpanuka nyinshi zabaye nubwo imihanda mibi cyane kandi inagoye biriya ibikwereka iba iteguye neza urebye tour du rwanda iraduha icyizere uretse gutsinda bakinnyi b’abanyarwanda ndetse mitegurire u rwanda rumaze kwigaragaza rushoboye gutegura umukino w’amagare rwego rw’isi ntiyamira yasabye abafite bahurira n’itegurwa ry’abakinnyi kujya babakurikirana cyane kugira barusheho kugira imyiteguro myiza ibafasha kwitwara neza marushanwa ati ubutumwa natanga ababishinzwe bakurikirana abakinnyi bitoza bitwara bagashyiramo imbaraga bakurikiranwa kandi bakagira imyitozo ihanitse ahantu igare rikomerera si imbaraga gusa ahubwo n’uburyo umukinnyi yitwara nabyo bigiramo uruhare mu marushanwa abanyarwanda bamaze kwitabira rwego afurika areruya joseph wegukanye la tropicale amissa bongo rwego amafoto niyonzima mose

title: bamwe banyarwanda bagaragaje igiciro bifuza agapfukamunwa kagura kugira buri wese agatunge
content: bamwe banyarwanda baravuga igiciro cy’amafaranga frw gapfukamunwa menshi kubera bamwe ubuzima bumeze nabi kubera guma rugo ariyo mpamvu bifuza nibura kagura hagati y’amafaranga bamwe bantu baganiriye n’umuryango batishoboye bavuze bikwiriye leta yabafasha kubona utu dupfukamunwa buntu cyangwa mafaranga munsi frw kuko bigoye kubona amafaranga kubera gahunda guma rugo ibi babihuje n’abaganiriye rba kuwa mbere nabo bavuze amafaranga frw kubona umugabo agasiba kubera gahunda guma rugo umwe yavuze udupfukamunwa turadutegereje ariko bakwiriye kutuzana giciro gihendutse frw ntabwo umuntu yayabona buri munsinibura bazakagire amafaranga frw undi yagize byibura bazakagire frw nibura umuntu ufite umuryango yagerageza ngayo akavuga ndagura akanjyengurire umugore n’abana umunyabanga inganda zisaga ziri gukora udupfukamunwa zavuze cyumweru kirangira hakozwe uturenga miliyoni buryo abanyarwanda bazabasha kutubona abakozi bakora nganda gukora cyane kugira haboneke udupfukamunwa duhagije isoko ariko ababishinzwe bavuze nibura kugera gatatu turaba twabonetse uhagarariye inganda zikora udupfukamunwa witwa kanyonya andrew kanyoya yavuze inganda zimwe zatangiye gukora udupfukamunwa mbere gihe izindi zatangiye minsi ishize zikimara kubyemererwa yagize inganda nyinshi zamaze kwegeranya ibikoreshokuri mbere nibwo twavuga twatangiye akaziturizeza abanyarwanda guhera kuwa gatatu utu dupfukamunwa tuzaba turi isoko uyu muyobozi yavuze habayeho gahunda yihutirwa ibigo bifite abakozi benshi kazi bikadukenera byatubona mbereyavuze kuwa mbere nibura bagombaga gukora udupfukamunwa ibihumbi ariko bagowe n’abakozi bake kubera coronavirus umuyobozi w’ikigo fda gishinzwe kugenzura ibiribwa n’imitikarangwa charles yabwiye rba inganda ziri gukora udupfukamunwa zahawe title: musanze uko urubyiruko gataraga rwatekereje guhinga ingano
content: urubwiruko rwibumbiye matsinda kora wikorera akazi kanozeari murenge gataraga ho karere musanze rurashishikariza bagenzi barwo gukura amaboko mifuka bakabyaza umusaruro amahirwe akikije batuye urubyiruko rugera ruri matsinda abiri akorera bice bitandukanye rukaba rwarahuguwe porogaramu yitwa akazi kanoze kora wikorera yateguwe n’umushinga usaid huguka dukore akazi kanoze bufatanye n’abafatanyabikorwa harimo n’urugaga rw’imiryango y’abantu bafite ubumuga kurwanya sida guteza imbere ubuzima uphls bahuguwe amasomo arimo kugena intego kwimakaza ubuzima bwiza kwizigama guhagarara neza byerekeye amafaranga ruri bikorwa by’ubuhinzi bw’ingano kimwe bihingwa byera gace batuyemo bavuga batekereje igihingwa k’ingano nyuma y’amahugurwa babonye basanze kizabyara umusaruro bitewe n’uko kiri byera cyane gace babamo kandi kikaba gifite isoko muhire joseph itsinda kora wikorera twahuguwe kwezi kabiri kugeza gatatu umwaka ushize hanyuma tuza gukora itsinda kugira dushyire bikorwa amasomo twari tumaze kwiga mu kwezi kane nibwo batangiye kwizigama buri muntu yizigama frw kwezi nyuma bakodesha umurima bahinga ingano bageze isarura agira turacyafite intumbero gutera imbere tukagira imirima yacu n’ibindi bikorwa uretse itsinda buri muntu agiye afite ibikorwa bijyanye n’umushinga yateguye uwitonze claudine afite umugabo n’abana babiri habanabakize jean de dieu ufite ubumuga bw’ingingo bavuga kuba barabonye amahugurwa byatumye bitinyuka ndetse byongera imibanire bagenzi uwitonze yatangiye gucura akabari gahagaze frw yatangiye akabarira frw umukozi ushinzwe guhuza ibikorwa by’amahugurwa y’ubumenyi bukenewe murimo akazi kanoze access twajamahoro constanin avuga amahugurwa agamije ugutegura urubyiruko uwahuguwe asoza afite gahunda y’iterambere rirambye anavuga urubyiruko rudakomeje gukurikiranwa rushobora gucika intege gihe ibikorwa rukora bitabonye isoko yagize muri mahugurwa dufatanyije n’abafatanyabikorwa bacu dutegura urubwiruko mutwe rusoza rufite intego y’iterambere kandi y’igihe kirambye ubona urubyiruko rusoza rufite inyota kuyishyira bikorwa avuga umufatanyabikorwa akomeza kubakurikirana gihe cy’amezi cyangwa nyuma yaho ibikorwa bakabimurikira inzego z’ibanze umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge gataraga sebashotsi jean paul avuga biteguye gufatanya n’urubyiruko rwatangiye ibikorwa biteza imbere umurenge harimo gukora imihanda ndetse kubakira abatishoboye asaba urubyiruko gushaka ubuzima gatozi kugira byorohere ubuyobozi kuruhuza n’ibigo by’imari bitandukanye umushinga usaid huguka dukore akazi kanoze ufite intego kugera rubyiruko rugera bihumbi mwaka ukorana n’imishinga itandukanye ifasha gushyira bikorwa amahugurwa gukurikirana abahuguwe umushinga ukurikirana urubyiruko karere musanze urugaga rw’imiryango y’abantu bafite ubumuga kurwanya sida guteza imbere ubuzima uphls buri tsinda abiri rimaze kugera bikorwa bifite agaciro k’amafaraga asaga ibihumbi frw gihe kitageze mwaka ndikumwenayo thierryumusekerwmusanze

title: bugesera nyuma y’inzara yaharanzwe karahahira utundi turere
content: mu myaka yashize cyane cyane umwaka w’ akarere bugesera kagaragayemo ikibazo cy’amapfa akabije hari abantu bicwaga n’inzara abandi bagasuhukamuri gihe uhatembereye ushobora kugira amateka cyangwa se amakabyankuru y’abantu abenshi baturage hari bahatuye nibo bivugira kibazo cy’inzara kihaherutseniyonzima joseph w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari maranyundo amaze imyaka aka karere avuga inzara yatangiye kugaragara bugesera mpera y’ ariko ikaza gukaza umurego mwaka w’ avuga gihe ibintu byose byari byarabuze biryo mvaruganda kugeza bijumba bihingiragaagira umva ibijumba ibijumba gihe inaha byaribwaga n’umuntu ufite imodoka ndakubwiza ukuri mukene wapfaga kubyigondera niyonzima yongeraho impamvu yateraga byose izuba ryari ryaracanye buryo batirirwaga bahinga n’uwahinganga ntiyeze avuga igihe ahantu hapfaga kwera ibijumba hari bishanga kandi byajyaga kubageraho byahenze yongeraho mwaka w’ abantu bishwe n’inzara buryo bukabije duce twa gashora ngenda gahembe maranyundo abandi barasuhuka ati gihe abagabo benshi barahungaga kubera kubura bagaburira imiryango abagore bakishyira migozi kubera kubura bagaburira abana mukanzaramba feresita umugore w’imyaka y’amavuko atuye murenge mayange avuga ikintu cyaje kubarokora bugesera haje imishinga n’imwe igatangira kubaha imfashanyo z’ibiribwaagira muri gihe tutarabona imfashanyo amahirwe yasekeraga yabonaga rukacarara icyo gihe twayitaga shira umuteto kuko mbere wasangaga hari abantu batarya umutsima w’amasaka gusa abatuye aka gace bavuga ibintu bisa n’ibyasubiye buryo kuko imyaka irera abantu bakabona ibiryo bavuga ufite inoti y’igihumbi urya amanywa n’ijoro nyirabitanga jolie utuye bugesera avuga nzara ikiharangwa aka karere gahagaze neza isoko ibintu biraboneka ibiboneka kurusha ibindi harimo imboga ibishyimbo imyumbati inanasi ibigori n’ibindi ugeze isoko nyamata gice gicururizwamo imboga abacuruzi bazo nabo bemeza imboga ziboneka bwinshi mukarwema annonciata umucuruzi soko nyamata umaze imyaka igera acuruza avuga ibicuruzwa byabonetse nyuma y’aho mbere gucuruza byasaga n’ibigoranye kubera baburaga barangurira agira ibintu biriho ikibigaragaza inyanya intoryi n’izindi kandi urabona hano isoko abacuruza imboga babaye benshi kandi n’abo tundi turere basigaye baza kurangura hano aganira kigalitodaycom rwagaju louis uyobora akarere bugesera avuga icyatumye inzara igabanuka aka karere leta yafashe ingamba gutera ibiti n’amashyamba hirya hino kariya gace avuga iterwa ry’ibiti ryatumye imvura itangira kugwa n’imyaka ikaboneraho gutangira kwera ati ubu hari ibicuruzwa abacuruzi b’ i kigali baza kurangura inaha ndetse nubu dufitanye ubuhahirane n’intara kirundo gihugu cy’u burundi yongeraho byose babigezeho bakangurira abaturage gukora cyane guhinga kuzigama gukora imirimo itegamiye buhinzi gusa muri ako karere hari igihe cyageze bitoroshye kubona n’igiti kubera izuba ryari ryarahibasiye umuntu yashoboraga gusanga amatungo yapfiriye nzira kubera kubura ubwatsi n’amazi kuko hendaga kuba ubutayu egide kayiranga

burushaho kubakomererera nk’abantu bafite ubumuga habanabakize innocent umwe bafite ubumuga abagize komite nyobozi ncpd rwego rw’utugari n’imirenge turere tugize umujyi kigali bagaragaje iki kibazo nk’imbogamizi ituma ubuzima mo bugenda burushaho kubakomererera nk’abantu bafite ubumuga muri rusange bashima bitabwaho mishinga itandukanye ihindura imibereho myiza bashima ubwisungane kwivuza mutuel de sante ibavuza ariko ikagira igarukira ntibashe kubakemurira ibibazo byabo byose buvuzi bakeneye gukemurirwa bimwe mubyo bavuga itajya ibasha kubavuza harimo guhabwa ingingo gihe ufite ubumuga abwiwe yakemura ikibazo cye twaganiriye bamwe uwitwa habanabakize innocent umwe bantu bafite ubumuga akaba visi korudinateri w’abafite ubumuga kagari nyabugogo agira nkanjye mba kiciro cy’ubudehe kandi sindararanya ntishyuye mituwele yanjyen’umuryango wanjye nayamra ariko bwisungane hari bugera bugahagarara bigatandukana n’uko tuba twayisunze nk’ubui ucitse akaguru ntabwo buguhesha insimburangingo cyangwa inyunganirangingoubaye ufite ubumuga mutwe ntabwo mituwele yakujyana inderarwose nanjye nsanga hakenewe ubundi buvugizi mutuele yagure imbibe ibashe kujya ituvuza ndwara zose kuko rwose usanga yifashishwa bidukoma nkokora nk’abantu bafite ubumuga cyakora uyu mugabo avuga babasha guhabwa ubutabazi bw’ibanze hifashishijwe ubwisungane kwivuza bigahagarara bitewe n’uko ubumuga bwao bugenda burushaho gusaba ibikomeye umumararungu jeanne ahamya mutuel de sante igera ihagarara ntibafashe agira nibyo dufite imbogamizi kuba tutarimo kwivuza neza mituwele iratuvuza ariko ikagira igarukira tturasaba abadukuriye bashaka baduha ubundi bwishingizi nk’abantu bafite ubumuga bityo bujye budufasha gihe mutuel de sante iba igeze idashoboye kudufasha nk’ubu ntiwaba ukeneye poruteze mituwele iyiguheshe indorerwamo zihenze ntiyaziguhesha umumararungu jeanne uwizeyimana venuste afite ubumuga agira ubundi dukurikije ubumuga bwacu buba buteye buri mwakadusabwa kujya duhura muganga akareba ubumuga bwacu buhagaze ariko hari igihe akubwira ukeneye imiti insimburngingo n’iyi ugasanga mutuel de sante ntibasha kubiguhesha kibazo turagifite byaba byiza mituwele de sante ifashe ubumuga tuba dufite ikabutuvuza ijana ijana ikaduhesha ingingo dukenera inkoni z’abantu batabona apareye matwi poruteze byose umuyobozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abantu bafite ubumuga karere nyarugenge madamu mukakamanzi marthe ashimangira hari indwara nyinshi zifashwa mutuel de sante ariko hakaba n’izindi itajya ibasha gufasha nyirazo cyakora avuga hari ubuvugizi buri gukorerwa abantu bafite ubumuga umuyobozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abantu bafite ubumuga karere nyarugenge madamu mukakamanzi marthe agira ubu kwiga buryo ki umuntu ufite ubumuga yabona insimburangingo n’inyunganirangingo hifashishijwe mutuel de sante ariko hari ubumuga buba bukomeye bukeneye kubagwa bukeneye imiti ihambaye buryo mutuel itabasha gutanga serivisi avuga nk’inzego z’ubuyobozi zihagarariye abantu bafite ubumuga bagiye kurushaho gukora ubuvugizi buyobozi hejuru ibi kandi binashimangirwa bwana kananga richardumuhuzabikorwa w’inama y’igihugu y’abantu bafite ubumuga karere nyarugenge uvuga ngengo y’imari y’akarere habanza kurebwa abababaye kurusha abandi bagashyirirwaho ingengo y’imari igomba kubavuza by’umwihariko bityo ubushake kuvuza abantu bafite ubumuga buri rwego rw’ubumuga burahari honorable rusiha gaston uhagarariye inyungu z’abantu bafite ubumuga nteko ishinga amategeko asobanura hateganyijwe abantu bafite ubumuga bagomba kujya bahabwa iya mbere serivisi z’ubuvuzi n’ubwo bitarafata imbaraga nyinshi biteganyijwe igihe kizagera inyunganirangingo n’insimburangingo zikazajya zihabwa abantu bafite ubumugaibi bizashoboka kuko inama y’igihugu y’abantu bafite ubumuga sosiyete budage bagiranye amasezerano kukora uruganda rukora inyunganirangingo n’insimburangingo kandi ruri kubakwa i gahini karere kayonza ruri gutangira gukora kandi ruzaba rufite ubushobozi guhaza isoko ry’u rwanda n’ibindi bihugu bidukikije honorable rusiha gaston uhagarariye inyungu z’abantu bafite ubumuga ashimangira igihe bizaba byamaze gukunda mbogamizi abantu bafite ubumuga bakenera nsimburangingo n’inyunganira ngingo bazongera guhura nazo kuko ubwisungane kwivuza mutuel de sante buzaba bubyishyura imbogamizi zadidije gahunda nk’uko abigaragaza ibiciro bihuriweho bikoresho byose bikenerwa n’abantu bafite ubumuga common tarrif n’iboneka ry’insimburangingo ubwazo byose bikaba gusa nk’aho byabonewe umuti n’ubwo utaravugutwa neza

title: leta yahagurukiye imihanda iteyeje bazo amafoto
content: minisitiri w’ibikorwa remezo musoni james yatangije mugaragaro imirimo kwagura gusana umuhanda kagitumba-kayonza-rusumo kane tariki gashyantare uyu umuhanda umuze imyaka irenga kuburyo warangiritse bikomeye wakundaga gutezaga impanuka hato hato uyu muhanda mpuzamahanga uherereye ntara y’iburasirazuba uhuza u rwanda n’ibihugu uganda tanzania unyuze turere twa kayonza gastibo nyagatare ngoma kirehe ufite uburebure kilometero magana abiri n’umunani km guverineri w’intara y’iburasirazuba mufulukye fred yavuze kuba imirimo gusana kwagura muhanda itangiye bigaragaza ubuyobozi bwiza kandi bushyira bikorwa bwemereye abaturage dore ubwo nyakubahwa perezida repubulika paul kagame yiyamamarizaga karere kayonza kwezi nyakanga yijeje abaturage muhanda uzubakwa gihe vuba guverineri yasabye abaturage kubyaza umusaruro mahirwe bakabona imirimo gukora muhanda ndetse minisitiri musoni yavuze kwagura gusana umuhanda bizafasha kunoza ubuhahirane hagati y’ibihugu uganda tanzania ndetse guteza imbere ishoramari ubukerarugendo guteza imbere imibereho y’abawuturiye abaturage barenga bahawe akazi muhanda minisitiri musoni kandi avuga muhanda wose uzashyirwaho amatara rwego korohereza abawukoresha kandi matara ateganywa gushyirwa muhanda kayonza-rwamagana-kigali uyu muhanda watangiye gusanwa kwagurwa kwezi gicurasi biteganyijwe uzuzura kwezi kw’ugushyingo utwaye amadorali amerika asaga miliyoni ijana mirongo inani n’enye imirimo gusana kwagura muhanda irakorwa nkunda leta y’urwanda banki nyafurika itsura amajyambere ikigo cy’u buyapani cy’ubutwererane mpuzamamahanga jica ndetse n’ umuryango w’ubumwe bw’ibihugu by’uburayi eu yanditswe ruhumuriza richard

title: imvura yaguye iminsi rwanda yahitanye abantu umunani
content: tariki n’iya gicurasi hirya hino gihugu haguye imvura nyinshi itera ibiza byahitanye abantu bikomeretsa n’inzu zirasenyuka imyaka irengerwa n’imyuzure n’imihanda itandukanye igwirwa n’inkangu iyo mvura ije ikurikira indi yaguye ijoro ryo rishyira mata hirya hino gihugu haguye imvura nyinshi itera ibiza byahitanye abantu n’amatungo magufi hakomereka isenya inzu yagiza imyaka hegitari imihanda n’ibiraro byayo ndetse n’imiyoboro y’amazi minisiteri ishinzwe ibikorwa by’ubutabazi minema yatangaje ukurikije ingorane zikomeje guterwa n’imvura idasanzwe ikomeje kugwa minsi abatuye manegeka bakwiye kwimuka vuba ikigo k’igihugu k’iteganyagihe meteo rwanda cyatangaje hagati tariki gicurasi hateganijwe imvura nyinshi hagati milimetero - litiro zizajya zigwa meterokare mujyi kigali intara y’amajyaruguru n’akarere rubavu nyabihu rutsiro ngororero muhanga n’aka ruhango minema irakangurira abantu gukomeza kwitwararika kwirinda ibyabateza ibiza bihe by’imvura nyinshi itwara ubuzima bw’abantu yangiza imitungo itandukanye n’ibikorwaremezo minema itangaza ibiza byiganje biterwa n’imvura nyinshi irimo inkubaiteza inkanguimyuzure inkubi y’umuyaga ndetse n’urubura minema irasaba abaturarwanda gufata ingamba kwirinda ibiza harimo kuzirika neza gukomeza ibisenge nkuta z’inzu hakoreshejwe ibikoresho byabugenewe ndetse igihe imvura igwa yiganjemo imirabyo n’imihindagano y’inkuba abantu bagomba kwihutira kujya kugama nzu bakihutira mazi nzuzi abareka abashoye inka n’abandi igihe imvura itangiye kugwa ikindi kandi barasabwa kwirinda gukoresha ibyuma bikoresha amashanyarazi kwirinda gukoresha terefone gihe k’imvura irimo inkuba abanyarwanda kandi barasabwa guhoma neza inzu harindwa amazi yakwinjira nkuta bakimuka nzu zidakomeye zigaragaza ibimenyetso by’uko zishobora gusenyuka gusibura inzira z’amazigusukura ruhurura kwirinda kujugunyamo imyanda barasabwa kandi gushishoza mbere kwambuka umugezi n’ibiraro kwitondera amazi menshi atemba ava misoziruhurura imigendeimikoki n’imyuzi ndetse n’abatwara ibinyabiziga bakirinda kunyura mihanda irimo amazi afite umuvuduko mwinshiinkanguahandi babujijwe polisi y’u rwanda n’izindi inzego denis fabrice nsengumuremyi muhaburarw
