title: abaturage ntibemeranya n’umujyi kigali ushaka kwambura ibibanza ababimaranye imyaka batabyubakaho
content: bavuga igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi nyirabayazana umunyamategeko ’’kwambura abaturage ubutaka binyuranye n’itegeko nshinga’’ umujyi kigali uvuga ubanza kwihanangiriza ugiye kwamburwa ikibanza nyuma y’uko umujyi kigali utangaje ugiye gufatira ibibanza bimaze imyaka bidakoreshwa byagenewe abaturage b’ingeri zinyuranye baravuga cyemezo kibangamye ndetse bamwe banyamategeko bakagaragaza cyaba kinyuranye n’itegeko nshinga hirya hino mujyi kigali usanga hari ibibanza biba bimaze igihe bitubakwa nyirabyo kuba mikoro ahagije n’ibibazo bishingiye gishushanyo mbonera bimwe abaturage bagaragaza nk’inzitizi zituma batubaka ibibanza byabo kamanzi eric utuye karere gasabo yagize impamvu mbere ibaho kuba umuturage yamara imyaka atubatse ikibanza cye iya mbere habaho ubushobozi buke bw’amafaranga murabizi ugushakisha ushatse kubaka inzu igendanye n’ubushobozi ufite ntabwo ubuyobozi bubikwemerera bakagutegeka wubaka bigendanye n’igishushanyo mbonera cy’umujyi kigali bityo ukadindira ukaguma bukode’’ ryahama charles utuye karere gasabo avuga kutubaka ibibanza biterwa n’ikibazo cy’igishushanyo mbonera ati igenamigambi leta ishaka hano hakubakwa inzu z’icyerekezo abafite ubushobozi ntabwo barahabwa igishushanyo mbonera y’icyo bakora mpereye muturanyi wacu yagerageje gutangira yazanye engeniyeri atangire ariko bamubwira ibijyanye n’icyerekezo bitaratangwa bitewe n’ibisabwa’’ ubuyobozi bw’umujyi kigali buratangaza bwafashe ingamba nshya zigamije gushyira bikorwa itegeko rigenga imikoreshereze y’ubutaka rwanda ryo rigena umuntu yamburwa ubutaka gihe amaze imyaka atabubyaza umusaruro umuyobozi w’ishami ry’imiturire n’imitunganyirize y’umujyi kigali fred mugisha avuga bishyirwa bikorwa nyuma kwihanangirizwa yagize mu bwamburwa haba harabayeho ibiganiro banyiri butaka leta twibutsa amategeko ateganya bigaragaye muntu yabyihoreye mpamvu ifatika agaragaraza bibanza bindi twavuze twatangiye kubibaka n’irindi tangazo dukanga barengeje igihe twatangiye gahunda kubibaka tutongeye kujya kubibutsa icyiciro abashobora kuba baribukijwe ariko phase’ igarukira bakaba bashaka kubikora nk’uko cyiciro babikoraga turabibutsa dushigaje kubibutsa rimwe’’ umunyamategeko bayingana janvier avuga cyemezo gihabanye n’ibyo itegeko nshinga riteganya butaka yagize uburenganzira butaka rwanda abantu babukomora itegeko nshinga itegeko nshinga riteganya uburyo umuntu abona ubutaka kandi rikagaragaza umungo bwite w’umuntu n’ukomoka butaka biri ntavogerwa leta ikaba igomba kwishingira ntawe ubwamburwa yaba bwose cyangwa igice cyabwo itegeko ry’ubutaka ryo rigaragaza umuntu abukomora ntabwo ntekereza impamvu y’uko umuntu atabukoresheje neza cyangwa atabukoresheje neza nk’uko umujyi kigali wabyifuje ntabwo bihagije kugira umuntu abe yakwamburwa ubutaka bwe nshingiye mategeko impamvu rukumbi iteganywa n’amategeko igihe butaka abwambuwe bw’inyungu rusange kwimura abantu bw’inyungu rusange kandi agahabwa ingurane ikwiye ku rundi ruhande impuzamiryango iharanira uburenganzira muntu cladho ivuga kwaka ubutaka umuturage atari kintu kibanze gikwiye gukorwa kuko hari ibikorwa remezo bigikenewe hirya hino mujyi kigali nk’uko umuvugizi w’iyi mpuzamiryango sekanyange jean leonard abisobanura yagize kuri mwanya ntabwo aricyo umujyi kigali wakabaye wihutira kuko hari ibindi bikorwa mbere y’uko ushyira bikorwa cyemezo kuko nabariya baturage ukubanza kureba uburyo bibanza babibonye kuko ntabwo umuntu yagura ikibanza munsi ahite abona n’ubushobozi kucyubaka bisaba agenda yisuganya bigendanye n’amikoro y’abanyarwanda icya umujyi kigali ugomba kureba ugomba gukora warabikoze hari ibireba umuturage hari ibireba umujyi kigali nko kuhashyira ibikorwa remezo nk’amazi imihanda amashanyarazi hari umujyi kigali ugomba gukora bagomba kureba ibyabo barabirangije kuko kugira umuturage agire imbaraga kugira akora abona iby’ibanze byahageze’’ ku ikubitiro umujyi kigali utangaza ibibanza bisaga bigiye kwakwa nyirabyo kubera bidakoresha byagenewe rba chief editor muhaburarw

content: mukamudenge umwe bazindukiye isoko ry’inyama mujyi muhanga tariki aje kugura kurya yitwaje akadobo gato kavuyemo isabune omo atwayemo inyama zigera ndiba gihe avuga ahahiye umuryango mugari agira wahaha izirenze ikilo ukazabonahe amafaranga yazo ndajyana singombwa bazihaga erega mayi aka kongeye kuba akaboga k’abifashije vedaste mpagaritswenimanaushinzwe ubuhinzi n’ubworozi karere muhanga avuga ibura ry’inyama ikibazo gihangayikishije kubera borozo bajya bakunda korora inka z’inyama agira abaturage benshi usanga biyororera inka z’amata baturage bafata icyemezo korora inka z’inyama kandi hagize ubigira umushinga yakunguka cyane mupenzi umubazi akaba n’umucuruzi w’imyama avuga imyama bacuruza ziba zirimo amoko atandukanye bitewe n’ubushobozi buri umwe wese avuga hari imyama z’inka ikiro kigura amafaranga y’u rwanda izindi zikaba inyama nda hari izindi zitwa iroti zigura amafaranga benshi bavuga zirya umugabo zigasiba mupenzi avuga ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka ikiro cy’inyama make zaguraga amafaranga y’u rwanda mpagaritswenimana avuga batangiye gushishikariza abaturage korora n’amatungo magufi kuko byafasha kugabanya ikibazo cy’inyama kigaragara aka karere gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: menya inkomoko y’imvugo ’yagiye kwangara’
content: uyu mugani bawuca bumvise umuntu yikuye bususuruke ahantu heza akajya guhobagizwa n’akaga kumera nabi abyiteye imihanda nibwo bavuga yagiye kwangara wakomotse nyiramataza muka rukali ahasaga umwaka yikuye bususuruke yicyura ngara amaze kugerayo hamuhindukira inka y’inkungu hamumerera nabi cyane atangira guhobagizwa n’umuruho kubaho nabi mibambwe sekarongoro bitaga maboko atanga ataziganya rugabishabirenge afite umugaragu akitwa rukali akaba umutware w’insanga yari yaramutonesheje by’akadasohoka birenze urugero rukali afite umugore umwe rukumbi witwa nyiramataza yaramugize inkundwakazi bitavugwa arahira kutazamuharika yari afite n’ingo nyinshi turere yagabiwe sekarongoro zose zikagengwa nyiramataza urugo rumwe rwari i rugobagoba bugaba kamonyi urundi ruri i buguli bugoba i rukoma ngamba urwa gatatu ruri i bugaragara shyorongi bumbogo huro urundi ruri i zoko mugina buyaga byumba hakaba n’urw’i ntebe rukara buganza ruguru imisozi hagati y’izo yatwaraga rukali i rugobagoba kugeza i ntebe ikayoboka nyiramataza nuko nyiramataza abumba ibya rukali byose arakira aradabagira umurengwe uramusaguka bituma inshuti z’umugabo n’abavandimwe ndetse n’abagaragu bamubaza bati ariko ureba ubukire bwawe bungana igituma nyiramataza yakwihariye arabasubiza sinziharikira umugore nzamutunga wenyine bakurayo amaso bati si gusa yaramuroze ibyo bamubwiye biherereye agahita ajya kubibwira umugore biba bityo imyaka irahita indi irataha bukeye hakaba umugabo witwa ngara atuye i gahini rukara azindukira i ntebe rukali ho nyiramataza asanga rukali yaragiye i nduga rugo rw’i rugobagoba aravunyisha bamubwira rukali adahari nimumbwirire umugore aze mumutumehobashyikirije nyiramataza ubutumwa nimumubwire aze ngara araza bararamukanya baraganira bishyira kera ngara inganirizi kabuhariwe agasetsa agati kagaturika akandi kakamera aganiriza nyiramataza asigaho kumuganirira aramunyura aramushimisha amuzinutsaamwibagiza umugabo kuva baruzura agati k’inkubirane bukeye rukali akubuka i rugobagoba nduga asubira i ntebe buganza ageze iwe nyiramataza ntiyamwikoza akamureba nk’icyo imbwa ihaze uko baganiriye akamwimyoza kuko umushyikirano ngara waramumuhugije kumwishimira akimyoza rubanda batangira kubihwihwisa bigera ngara amaze kumenya nyiramataza yirozonga umugabo aramugenderera binikiza ikiganiro kimaze kunoga ngara aramubaza mbese waje nkakwicyurira ukabisa rukali biba nko korosora uwabyukaga nyiramataza ahubwo unkuye isoni n’ubundi sinkwiye gutungwa kiriya gihondogoro baherako barabyemeranya inama iranoga nyitamataza arara ataraye gitondo asezera rukali urabeho ngurwo urugo rwawe aramwimura yigira ngara agezeyo amusangana abagore batatu ababamo uwa kane ngara aramuharara by’amareshyamugeni iminsi y’ubuki imaze gushira atanga ibihe gutaha ze zose nyiramataza abonye iminsi irenze icumi ataramugeraho ararakara kubera akamenyero rukali yarihariye birashyira aratahirwa ngara atungutse umugore umukubise amaso atera hejuru ntabwo nashobora gutungwa n’umugabo uraraguza ngara afata ubushungu ararakara ahamagaza ingobyi bayisasamo igisura cyari ikimenyetso cy’umugore usenzwe n’ubusambanyi bananguriramo nyiramataza baraheka bamujyana iwabo asendwa atyo umukiro ugenda nyomberi nuko nyiramataza amaze gusendwa umuruho uramwokama aratindahara karahava atangira guhobagira imihanda rubanda bakamushungera bamuba urw’amenyo bati reka abone niwe wikuye bususuruke agiye ngara kuva n’undi wese witesheje ubususuruke abitewe n’umurengwe akajya kurindagira azerera bakavuga bati yagiye kwangara ngara aka nyiramatazakujya kwangara guhobagira cyangwa guhobagizwa n’umuruho hifashishijwe igitabo cy’ibirari by’insigamigani icapwa gatatu

title: bugesera umurego kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge
content: ibi baturage babitangaje cyumweru polisi y’igihugu bufatanye n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere bagiye kariya gace guta yombi abaturage bacuruza ibinyobwa bitemewe n’amategeko abaturage batuye aka gace mirambi bavuga gakunda kugaragaramo ikibazo cy’umutekano muke bikururwa n’ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ubujura n’icuruzwa ry’ibiyobyabwenge kanyanga irimo cyane mezi abiri ashije hiciwe abantu babiri karemera sam umuyobozi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba witabiriye igikorwa guta yombi abaturage bakoze uruganda gucuruza kanyanga kariya gace yatangarije abaturage gihe kitari gito polisi igiye gushyira bikorwa icyifuzo cyabo gufungura ishami ryayo aka gace icyakora ariko karemera yababwiye icyihutirwa kurusha ibindi ukugira ubushake gufatanya n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere guhangana n’ibikorwa bibahungabanyiriza umutekano rwagaju louis umuyobozi w’akarere bugesera kubufatanye n’abari bahagarariye inzego z’umutekano bitabiriye gikorwa yabwiye abaturage bagomba kwirinda ibikorwa gucuruza kanyanga n’ibindi biyobyabwenge byose kuko nyir’abayazana w’umutekano muke karere bugesera rwagaju kandi yavuze ubuyobozi bw’akarere bwari busanzwe buzi ibihakorerwa icyari gisigaye ukuza guta yombi abacurizi kanyangaati’’twari tubizi icyari gisigaye cyari umwanya kuza kubafata iyo uhamwe n’icyaha gucuruza kanyanga inzoga itemewe n’amategeko y’u rwanda uhanishwa igihano cy’igifungo kiri hagati y’amezi atatu n’imyaka itanu cyangwa ihazabu y’amafaranga ibihumbi byaba ngombwa ukabihanishwa byombi mimi rachel mukandayisenga

title: rubavu rusizi abaturage ibihumbi bagiye guhabwa urukingo ebola
content: mu turere twa rubavu rusizi abaturage ibihumbi bagiye guhabwa urukingo ebola rwego kwirinda kwandura ndwara yamaze guhitana abantu kivu y’amajyaruguru repubulika demukarasi kongo mu gikorwa cyatangijwe munsi minisitiri w’ubuzima dr diane gashumba kumwe dr jean jacques muyembe waturutse minisiteri y’ubuzima akaba n’umuyobozi wungirije w’intara kivu y’amajyaruguru urukingo ruri kwifashishwa urwakozwe n’ikigo cy’abanyamerika johnson and johnson’ rwageze mbere rdc kwezi k’ukwakira mwaka ni urukingo rwakoreshejwe bihugu guinea uganda kandi kibazo rwateje biteganyijwe turere twa rubavu rusizi hazakingirwa abaturage ibihumbi buri karere hakazakingirwa abantu ibihumbi ni gihe turere twa rusizi rubavu turi duhana imbibe n’igihugu repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo cyagaragayemo icyorezo ebola kandi tukaba tugaragaramo urujya n’uruza rwinshi baturage b’ibihugu byombi kubera turimo imipaka ihuza ibihugu byombi biteganyijwe uru rukingo ebola ruzahabwa umuturage wese ubishaka bafite imyaka ibiri kuzamurarukaba rutangwa byiciro bibiri harimo intera y’amezi abiri uhereye igihe wafatiye urwa mbereuhabwa urukingo asabwa gutanga imyirondoro gufatwa amafoto kugira azafashwe guhabwa urukingo kabiri hatabaye kwibeshya guhabwa urukingo ebola kiguzi bisaba ahubwo uruhabwa agomba kuba afite ubushake kurufata ukingirwa agomba kwemera gutanga umwirondoro kandi akaba yemera kuboneka nshuro kabiri y’itangwa ry’urukingo umuhanga buvuzi akaba n’umuyobozi guhangana ebola rdc dr jean-jacques muyembe avuga urukingo ruri gutangwa rwatangiye gutangwa guinea uganda kandi abaruhawe ngaruka bahuye akizeza abazaruhabwa rwanda kongo kurugirira icyizere agira uru rukingo rwakoreshejwe guinea myaka itatu cyangwa ibiri ishize kandi kibazo bazigizeho muri uganda ho rwarakoreshejwe kandi kugeza ngaruka minisitiri w’ubuzima dr diane gashumba avuga urukingo mbere kurwanya ebola n’izindi ndwara ukugira isuku nubwo urutangwa johnson and johnson rugomba kunganira isuku akavuga rwageragejwe bihugu bitandukanye kandi rwemerwa n’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima oms minisitiri gashumba avuga abaturage rubavu n’inzego z’ibanze bafashije igihugu bakumira ebola kwinjira rwanda gihe gihugu cy’abaturanyi yagize ndashimira abayobozi n’abaturage rubavu bagize uruhare gukumira ebola yinjira rwanda nubwo tugiye gutanga urukingo urukingo mbere ebola n’izindi ndwara nyinshi isuku minisitiri gashumba avuga gufata urukingo rumwe bimaze ndetse rutemewe guhabwa umugore utwiteavuga kandi umugore uruhawe yirinda gusama mbere y’uko ahabwa urwa kabiri ubuyobozi gahunda umurinzi’ butangaza nk’izindi nkingo urukingo ebola rushobora gutera ingaruka zoroheje harimo kubabara bateye urushinge kubabara umutwe nubwo atari buri wese ugira ingaruka nyuma guhabwa urukingongo bibaye urufashe agira ikibazoahamagara nomero telefoni ikarita ahabwa akingirwa uru rukingo ebola rwandaruje rukurikira izindi ngamba zafashwe leta y’u rwanda zirimo nko gukaraba intoki gupima umuriro mipaka ndetse kongera isuku ahantu hose hakunze guhurira abantu benshi muri rdc urukingo ruzahabwa abaturage bice byagaragayemo ebola birimo beni butembo mujyi goma ruhabwe abaturage bakora ibikorwa byambukiranya umupaka hirindwa ikwirakwizwa ebola urukingo ruri gutangwa gahunda yiswe umurinzi’ karere rubavu rukazatangirwa bigo nderabuzima n’ahateguwe nko mupaka muto uhuza u rwanda kongo kinshasa petite barriere bugeshi busasamana busigari byahi gacuba gisenyi kigufi karere rusizi rukazatangirwa ahitwa islamic i rwinzuki i nyakarenzo i mibirizi i rusizi i gihundwe mont cyangugu chief editor muhaburarw

content: ubundi muco nyarwanda umukobwa washakaga umugabo agasanga atari isugi byatezaga ikibazo ndetse bikaba byamuviramo gusendwa iyo witegereje minsi yubu usanga ikintu cy’ubusugi gisa kigenda gitakaza agaciro kuko rubyiruko hari kugenda hagaragaramo inda z’indaro nyinshi twegereye bamwe rubyiruko bamubwira kuba isugi gihe bitoroshye kandi ntawabyirata kuko hari benshi babifatwa nko kuba ikigwari umukobwa w’imyaka bita dorothe avuga gihe bidapfa gushoboka umukobwa yagera myaka akiri isugi drothe avuga rimwe rimwe biterwa n’umukobwa ukiri isugi adashobora kubivuga kuko ubivuze bandi batabyemera ndetse banamukwena bavuga bitabaho bityo uku gukwenwa kukaba gushobora guca intege uwabashije kwihangana nubwo bimeze gutya ariko drothe yemera kuba isugi byiza kayishema eugene umusore w’imyaka avuga imanzi atigeze aryamana n’umukobwa kandi abyishimira kandi bimuteye ishema atiyandaritse gusa ariko rungano ntiyavuga imanzi kuko bamuseka cyane yabisobanuye magambo kuvuga imanzi cyangwa isugi baragukwena bakagufata nk’umuntu utazi iterambere iyo ubagezemo ugerageza kwirarira ukavuga ubikora bityo ntibaguseke ariko wowe ukaba uzi ukuri mutima wawe imibare iva bushakashatsi bukorwa mibare y’abandura icyorezo sida ugaragaza bantu batandatu bandura rubyiruko abakobwa batanu umuhungu akaba umwe none se dukurikije bushakashatsi twavuga umubare w’amasugi riwo muto ugereranije n’uwabahungu jean claude gakwaya

title: ubukene isi izagira kubera covid- bwaherukaga myaka ishize-
content: kristalina georgieva uyobora ikigega mpuzamahanga cy’imari imf avuga covid- izatera ubukene bukomeye isi hose ubukene nkabwo bwaheruka myaka ishize isi yahuraga n’ubukene kiswe great depression - mu myaka isi yahuye n’ikibazo gikomeye cyaturutse ngaruka z’intambara mbere y’isi ndetse gutakaza agaciro k’idolari usa bituma amasoko y’imari ahomba bityo ubukungu bwose isi burahungabana cyane kubera usa ariyo ihagaze neza bukungu amadolari yayo niyo inkingi mwamba bukungu bwose bw’isi ubwo amasoko y’imari wall street n’ayandi new york stock exchange yahombaga ibintu byahise biba bibi usa ariko cyane cyane burayi kuko ariho n’ubundi ubukungu bwari bwarazahajwe n’intambara mbere y’isi georgieva avuga kugira isi izazanzamuke ive bukene izaterwa covid- bizasaba ibihugu bifashanya ibikennye bigafashwa n’ibikize kuzanzamuka vuba ariko akemeza bizasaba amafaranga menshi kubera iriya virus yihuta cyane kwandura kandi ikaba yarahitanye abantu bagera bihugu yagezemo byatumye ibihugu hasi byose isi bihagarika ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi n’ibindi byashoboraga gushyira abaturage babyo kaga izi ngamba zatumye ubukungu budindira kandi bigaragara butazazanzamuka vuba umuyobozi mukuru imf avuga ntangiriro biteze ubukungu bw’ibihugu isi buzazamuka neza umusaruro mbumbe muturage ukiyongera icyorezo covid- cyakomye nkokora kizere gituma ubucuruzi isi buhagarara kristalina georgieva avuga igiteye impungenge kurushaho bitazwi neza igihe cyorezo kizahagararira kugira ibintu bisubire buryo ati iyo mbyitegereje mbona biteye ubwoba ntituzi by’ukuri igihe bihe turimo bizarangirira biteganyijwe kabiri w’icyumweru gitaha hazaba taliki mata ikigega mpuzamahanga cy’imari kizasohora raporo yerekana giteganya ubukungu bw’isi mwaka n’uzakurikiraho imf ariko iherutse gutangaza ubukungu bw’isi buzazamukaho igipimo gihe buzazamuka gipimo muri usa hari abakozi bagera miliyoni batakaje akazi gihe banki y’isi ivuga ubukungu bw’africa buri kumanuka cyane kurusha ikindi gihe myaka ishize guhangana n’ingaruka z’ubukene bwatewe covid- bitangire vuba bishoboka georgieva avuga kugira ibihugu bizivane bukene bizaterwa covid- bizaterwa n’ingamba bizafata vuba bishoboka kuri gufata ingamba bukungu gihe gutangira kuzishyira bikorwa intambwe y’ingenzi izatuma ibihugu bitazahara cyane avuga ikigega ayoboye cyarangije guteganya miliyari gufasha ibihugu kugira bikumire ubukungu bwabyo bwarunduka yemeza hari ibihugu byarangije gusaba inguzanyo ariya mafaranga byose hamwe bikaba byarasabye miliyari gusa ntibihagije asaba n’ibihugu bikize kwaka amafaranga yabifasha gusigasira ubukungu bwabyo akemeza kubusigasira byafasha n’ibihugu bikennye byari bisanzwe bibikenerago imfashanyo cyangwa inguzanyo igihugu gisabwa gukora kurusha ibindi usa kuko ariyo ubukungu bw’isi bwubakiyeho kurusha ibindi bihugu kandi ikaba ariyo yibasiwe n’iki cyorezo kurusha ahandi gihe the telegraph jean pierre nizeyimana umusekerw

title: etienne kaberuka arusha amafaranga abarangije kaminuza ntaho yize
content: nk’uko tubikesha urubuga internet igihecom rwamusuye musaza kigero cy’imyaka y’amavuko yemeza mbere y’uko ahabwa inka umukene utagira yakwifasha avuga inka nibura ikamwa litiro z’amata munsi akabona litiro munsi eshatu kuri litiro agurisha abasha kubona amafaranga y’u rwanda ahwanye n’ibihumbi kwezi kubwe akaba abona akayabo diploma agira yewe atarigeze akandagira ishuli kaberuka yabashije kurihira abana babiri amashuri yisumbuye bararangiza kubera umukamo w’inka zendetse akaba ageze rwego gufasha abandi kuko arihira amashuri yisumbuye abandi batandatu bane bakaba impfubyi uyu musaza yabashije kwiyubakira inzu abamo ndetse n’izindi kwifashisha gusa nyuma kugabira abaturanyi batari bake bamwe bagafata nabi yatangiye kubaka ishuri rigizwe n’ibyumba bibiri binini azajya yigishirizamo abaturanyi korora kijyambere ibi akaba yarabitewe n’uko bimubabaza kubona umuntu atunze inka agakama litiro munsi kandi abantu nk’abo baracyari benshi uyu mugabo kimwe n’abandi bagenzi bafashwa n’ imishinga ihuriye guteza imbere ubworozi n’ubuhinzi harimo umushinga mpuzamahanga send a cow umushinga ushinzwe guteza imbere ubworozi kijyambere afurika y’iburasirazuba n’iyo hagati asareca bufatanye n’ikigo cy’igihu gishinzwe guteza imbere ubuhinzi rab ndetse kaminuza nkuru y’u rwanda unr anne marie niwemwiza

title: polisi y’u rwanda yamusubije imodoka yaratwawe bihemu
content: kuri gatatu tariki gashyantare polisi y’ u rwanda yashyikirije imodoka umugabo w’umugande witwa kananura ndizeye moses yaribiwe gihugu uganda nyuma ikaza gufatirwa rwanda kuboza k’umwaka ushize umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda assistant commissioner of police acp celestin twahirwa yavuze modoka bwoko posh markx ifite uan c yafashwe tariki ukuboza umwaka ushize ifatirwa mupaka gatuna abari bayitwaye bagerageza kuyizana rwanda polisi mpuzamahanga interpol nyuma kumenya modoka yibwe gihugu cy’ u buyapani yahise isohora inyandiko ziyifata acp enock ndyomugenyi yemereye ubufatanye bwana acp twahirwa celestin hagati polisi y’u rwanda uganda acp twahirwa yagize tukimara gufata modoka twamenyesheje inzego bireba gihugu cy’u buyapani uganda tumaze kugirana ibiganiro n’izi nzego cyane buyapani bivugwa modoka yibwe twemeranijwe modoka isubizwa kananura wayiguze dore cyaha kimwe cy’ubujura akurikiranyweho nyuma gusubizwa modoka kananura yashimiye ubushishozi ndetse n’ubunyamwuga polisi y’u rwanda ndetse n’imbaraga yakoresheje itahura modoka yavuze yayiguze gihugu uganda madolari y’amerika ibihumbi uyu mugabo yagize n’ubwo nari ntunze modoka ntabwo nigeze menya injurano nkaba narabimenye ngeze mupaka gatuna ruhande rw’u rwanda namenyeshejwe modoka ishakishwa polisi mpuzamahanga kuko injurano yakomeje agira hejuru y’ibi byose ariko ndagira nshimire polisi y’u rwanda bwitange ikomeza kugaragaza kurwanya gukumira ibyaha ndengamipaka kuko buri gihe yihutira gusuzuma buri kintu cyose kinjiye rwanda kugira hamenyekane koko kinjiye buryo bwemewe n’amategeko ubu uburyo bunoze kandi buzakomeza gufasha abanyarwanda bumva batekanye ndetse n’ibyabo byakwibwa bigatahurwa ndetse bakanabisubizwa nguwo umugabo wibwe imodoka polisi yayimusubije kumugaragaro polisi y’u rwanda imaze gufata imodoka zibwe bihugu by’ibituranyi n’ahandi hatandukanye isi modoka zikaba zari zizanywe rwanda cyangwa zijyanywe bindi bihugu zinyujijwe rwanda zose zikaba zarafashwe myaka itatu ishize yanditswe francois nelsonmuhaburarw

content: bagosora nsengiyumva barajuririra igihano cy’igifungo burundu bahawe kubera ibyaha jenoside n’ibindi byaha byibasiye inyoko muntu ntawukulilyayo yajuririye igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka yakatiwe kubera uruhare yagize jenoside ku itariki ukuboza nibwo bagosora wahoze ayobora ibiro minisitiri w’ingabo yakatiwe nyuma guhamwa n’ibyaha jenoside ibyaha byibasiye ikiremwamuntu n’ibyaha by’intambara birimo kwica uwari minisitiri w’intebe agathe uwilingiyimana n’abandi basirikare b’ababiligi onu bagosora anashinjwa kugira uruhare ishyirwaho bariyeri hirya hino kigali gisenyi hagati y’itariki mata nsengiyumva ukuriye ibikorwa gisirikare gisenyi yahamijwe ubwicanyi bakorewe kaminuza mudende paruwasi nyundo ndetse n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe abasivili gice ayoboye yanahamijwe kandi kuba yarohereje ibitero by’interahamwe bisesero kwica abatutsi bagosora nsengiyumva baburanishirijwe igihe kimwe hamwe n’abandi basirikare babiri aribo brigadier-general gratien kabiligi major aloys ntabakuze kabiligi yahisevarekurwa ntabakuze ajurira rubanza rwabaye itariki werurwe urubanza ntabakuze rwaje gutandukanywa n’urwabandi nyuma y’aho uwamwunganiraga mategeko umunyamerika peter erlinder ananiriwe kwitaba urukiko tariki werurwe ubujurire bwe bwaje gusomwa tariki nzeri na nubu buracyakomeza ntawukulilyayo yakatiwe igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka kubera uruhare yagize bwicanyi bwakorewe kibuye n’i butare umunyamakuru kigali today

acuruza imyenda isoko nyabugogo yatawe yombi gicamunsi nzeli kagari nyabugogo umurenge kimisagara karere nyarugenge nyuma y’uko ahaye umuntu amadolari agende amuvunjishirize biro by’ivunjisha biri content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi ukurikiyeho ariko ahakana byaha byose yashinjwaga nyuma y’aho bidashobokeye yoherezwa kuburanishirizwa rwanda nyuma kugirana imishyikirano yihariye n’ubushinjacyaha bagaragaza yemeye kuba yaragize uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko kandi yahaga interahamwe imodoka z’uruganda bazikoreshe ngendo zabo ariko yongeraho yabikoraga akiza amagara n’umuryango uko gufasha interahamwe bikaba aribyo byatumaga ubushinjacyaha buvuga ugushyingo bagaragaza yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka umunani kandi urukiko rutegeka hakurwamo igihe yafunzwe michel bagaragaza azafungurwa itariki ukuboza bivuze ashigaje ukwezi kumwe n’iminsi itandatu buroko ernestine musanabera

title: icyorezo coronavirus cyongereye igihe gufata umwanzuro bibazo by’u rwanda uganda
content: u rwanda rwahaye uganda igihe gukomeza gushyira bikorwa imyanzuro y’inama gatuna irimo kugenzura ibirego byose rwagaragaje bikorwa bibera butaka bwayo by’imitwe irubangamiye kurekura abantu bafunzwe binyuranyije n’amategeko inama yabereye i gatuna yahurije hamwe abayobozi b’u rwanda uganda angola repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo inama yahurije i gatuna abayobozi b’u rwanda uganda angola repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo gashyantare yemeranyije uganda igenzura ibirego byose by’u rwanda byabonerwa umuti hakazahura inama igamije kongera gufungura imipaka inama yasabye repubulika uganda kwezi kumwe igenzura ibirego repubulika y’u rwanda bikorwa bibera butaka bwayo by’imitwe ibangamiye guverinoma y’u rwanda byaba ukuri uganda igafata ingamba zose kubihagarika kwirinda byakongera kubaho ibyo bikorwa bigomba kugenzurwa kandi bikemezwa komisiyo ihuriweho ishyirwa bikorwa ry’amasezerano luanda iyi nama yavuze umunsi myanzuro yashyizwe bikorwa bikagezwa bakuru b’ibihugu abahuza bazakoranya inama minsi i gatuna katuna igamije gufungura imipaka gusubiza murongo umubano hagati y’ibihugu byombi ubaze igihe inama gatuna yabereye kugeza mbere tariki werurwe igihe cy’ukwezi uganda yahawe kugenzura ibirego by’u rwanda kimaze kurengaho iminsi ibiri mu kiganiro igihe yagiranye n’umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga ushinzwe umuryango afurika y’iburasirazuba amb nduhungirehe olivier yavuze ubungubu ibintu byose byahagaze igishyizwe imbere uguhashya icyorezo coronavirus ati ubungubu ibintu byose byarahagaze turimo guhashya cyorezo coronavirus nama n’imwe ikiba n’inama yagombaga kuba ntayabaye ntawe ugisohoka ntawinjira nama ishobora kuba n’imwe ubungubu turabanza duhashye cyorezo coronavirus nduhungirehe avuga u rwanda rwandikiye uganda ruyibwira yiyemeje gukora yabikora kuko bidakeneye inama hanyuma icyorezo cyarangira impande zombi zikazahura itariki zizumvikanaho ati i gatuna hari uganda yemeye kuzakora minsi bashobora gukomeza kubikora twaranabibabwiye nubwo nama zihari kubigenzura ahubwo bafatirana gihe tudashobora guhura bagashyira bikorwa biyemeje biriya gufungura abantu guhagarika ubufasha baha imitwe yitwaje intwaro ntabwo bikeneye inama hanyuma kibazo coronavirus nikirangira nyuma tuzahura tubigenzure u rwanda rushinja uganda gucumbikira abakekwaho ibyaha binyuranye bahunze ubutabera gukingira ikibaba ibikorwa by’imitwe igamije kuruhungabanyiriza umutekano birimo iby’imitwe rnc fdlr rud urunana n’indi u rwanda kandi rukomeje gusaba uganda gukurikirana ibikorwa n’ikusanywa ry’inkunga ihabwa imitwe guhungabanya u rwanda bikorwa n’abarimo prossy bonabaana sula nuwamanya dr rukundo rugali emerithe gahongayire emmanuel mutarambirwa byose bigashyigikirwa rnc binyuze muryango washinzwe self-worth initiative u rwanda kandi rusaba ifatwa n’iyoherezwa ry’abari abarwanyi rud urunana bagabye igitero kinigi barimo mugwaneza eric capt nshimiye aka gavana wayoboye igitero kinigi u rwanda kandi rusaba uganda gukurikirana abayobozi bakorana rnc rud urunana barimo umunyamabanga leta philemon mateke brig gen abel kandiho uyobora cmi brig gen fred karara col ck asiimwe major fred mushambo col kaka bagyenda n’abandi bayobozi bagira uruhare bikorwa srcigihe

title: mu rwanda hagiye kubakwa ishyamba ry’icyitegererezo
content: akarere k’amajyaruguru y’uburengerazuba bw’u rwanda kagizwe n’uturere dutandatu tw’u rwanda kagiye kubakwamo ishyamba ry’icyitegererezo foret model rwego gufasha kwihutisha iterambere gushyiraho uburyo burambye gucunga amashyamba utwo turere aritwo nyabihu musanze burera rubavu rutsiro ngororero iryo shyamba rizaba rigizwe n’urusobe rw’ibidukikije bifite uruhare buzima bw’abantu yasabye buri rwego rwakwbona muriuyu mushinga kuko uzagirira akamaro ababanyarwanda madamu mukaminani angele umuyobozi w’agateganyo foret modele rwanda yavuze ikibazo cy’ubukungu n’imibereho myiza kizabonerwa umuti igihe buri muntu azaba yamaze kwiyumvisha uruhare rwe mukwita kubidukikije mugihe urugaga foret model rwego rw’isi rufite icyicaro canada rusaba ishyamba ry’icyitegererezo riba riri buso butari munsi hegitari ibihumbi rwanda rizubakwa kuburenga hegitari ibihumbi urugaga rw’uruherekana rw’amashyamba y’icyitegererezo afurika rseau africain des forets modles-rafm rufite icyicaro cameroun nacyo gihugu cyatangije gahunda mugabane afurika ubu ibindi bihugu maroc tuniziya algerie congo kinshasa centre afrique n’u rwanda byaratangiye gahunda babifashwa mo n’inararibonye zituruka bihugu biri gahunda foret modele yateye imbereabayobozi b’akarere ngororero hamwe n’abafatanyabikorwa bako batandukanye babwiye kigalitodaycom nayo dukesha nkuru bishimiye gahunda bakaba biteguye kuyishyira mubikorwa igitekerezo kubaka ishyamba ry’icyitegererezo cyakiye canada bimaze kugaragara abantu b’imyuga inyuranye nk’abubatsi abavumvu abahinzi abasoroma imbuto ababaji abavuzi gakondo n’abacukura amabuye y’agaciro babangamira ibidukikije byabaye ngombwa nzego zose zihuzwa kugira ikibazo kubungabunga amashyamba cyumvikane kandi buri wese abone inyungu ze mu inama mpuzamahanaga bidukikije yabereye i rio de janeiro bresil yashimangiye igitekerezo kurema amashyamba y’icyitegererezo mu rwanda politiki kubungabunga ibidukikje harimo amashyamba imaze gushinga imizi iki gitekerezo title: indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina zitari sida zikomeje kwiyongera
content: oms ivuga abantu barenga miliyoni barwaye ndwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina zitari sida muri abagera miliyoni bakaba abarwara inzoka tirikomunase trichomonase abagera miliyoni barwara indwara yitwa chamydiase miliyoni zikarwara uduheri tutandukanye dufata myanya y’igitsina imitezi buri mwaka rwego rw’isi yandurwa n’abantu bagera miliyoni ibibembe bifata gitsina bikibasira miliyoni mburugu igeza miliyoni gihe indwara z’umwijima bwoko b hpatite b zandurwa n’abantu basaga miliyoni ku ndwara sida nk’uko bitangazwa oms abayandura bagera miliyoni buri mwaka isi yoseubushakashatsi bwakozwe myaka cumi n’itatu ishize bwagaragaje indwara zendaga gucika ziyongera kubera abantu batagikora imibonano mpuza bitsina ikingiye mbere ibi biterwa habonetse imiti igabanya ubukana sida indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina ziterwa n’udukoko duto bactries nko mitezi cyangwa se none tugaterwa virusi nko ndwara z’umwijima bita hpatite b sida zikaba zishobora kandi guterwa n’indiririzi champignon ou parasite nko ndwara tirikomunase mu bisobanuro bitangwa n’impuguke zakoze igenzura zivuga icyerekana indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina maladies sexuellement transmissibles usibye sida zikiriho hari ibimenyetso byazo biranga abazirwaye afrika irugarijwe umugabane afurika kimwe bice by’isi byibasiwe bitewe n’uko ibihugu byishi bigize mugabane bikiri nzira ibipimo ibibembe bifata gitsina ikagira imibare iteye inkeke ndwara z’umwijima zandurira mibonano hpatite b kuri ndwara afurika ikubye inshuro zose umubare w’abazandura burayi bitewe n’uko bihugu by’uburayi babona inkingo z’izo ndwara gihe afurika bagitangira kuzitanga atari bihugu byose kuri sida afurika abagore bibasiwe cyane kuko bagore bakora umwuga w’uburaya byabo bafite ubwandu sida muri rusange by’abagore bakomoka afurika munsi y’ubutayu sahara bafite ubwandu sida dr nyatanyi thierry ushinzwe gukumira indwara z’ibiza indwara zidakira kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rbs yavuze u rwanda kimwe bihugu bike afurika bikingira abana bavutse indwara z’umwijima harimo n’izo twavuze zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiye avuga abibwira sida yonyine ikomeye ndwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina bakwiriye kumenya hari n’izindi nyinshi kandi mbi cyane ngo umuntu yandura ndwara niko byorohera sida kwinjira bitewe n’ibisebe biza gitsinabimwe bimenyetso biranga uwanduye indwara zifata imyanya ndangagitsina ukuribwa myanya bagore kubona ibimenyetso bigenda bitandukana bitewe n’ubwoko bw’indwara umuntu yanduye ku bagore ho akenshi uburwayi buboneka bubobere buba gitsina scrtions vaginales ariko hakabaho n’ibindi bimenyetso nko kuribwa kuzana udusebe kwishimagura kuzana ubushye guhinda umuriro ndetse kubabara igihe bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina akenshi abagore hari n’igihe batabimenya banduye ndwara bakabibwirwa muganga ariko bagiye kwivuza ntibibuza ariko bazanduza ubonanye nabo aramutse adakoresheje agakingirizo avuga ndwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina zishobora kwirindwa abantu bareka ubusambanyi gihe byananiranye kwifata bagakoresha agakingirizoikindi uzirwaye yivuje kare kandi muganga akira ariko gihe uzirwaye ativuje ndwara zimunga umubiri zikangiza imyanya ndangagitsina bikaba byanavamo ubundi bumuga buzageza gucika igitsina cyangwa gupfa ernestine musanabera

title: ofisiye karere mahugurwa basuye urwibutso jenoside kigali
content: mu rwanda hateraniye ofisiye bagera baturuka bihugu africa guhabwa amahugurwa ajyanye n’ibikorwa kubungabunga amahoro ofisiye bakaba abateraniye i musanze ntara y’amajyaruguru ahaherereye ikigo gitanga amahugurwa kubungabungano kugarura amahoro aba ofisiye basobanuriwe imvo n’imvano jenocide kuri nzeri ofisiye basuye urwibutso jenocide i kigali basobanuriwe uburyo jenocide yarateguwe gihe cy’ubukoroni ndetse banagaragarizwa zimwe ngaruka jenocide n’uburyo kuyirinda bihugu bitandukanye bagiye baturukamo col leonard makunga col leonard makunga gihugu kenya yatangaje biteye isoni ndetse bidakwiye kuba byazagira n’ahandi biba ndetse col makunga yanatangaje uburyo ibihugu karere byatekereje gufata ingamba kuzana amahoro intambwe ikomeye kandi kwishimirwa yanditswe akayezu snappymuhaburarw

title: rwamaganaabanyerondo b’umwuga bahondaguye umuryango wose bawuziza ibihumbi by’irondo
content: umugabo witwa mutungirehe celestin kagari ruhunda umurenge gishali avuga abanyerondo b’umwuga bamuteye rugo masaha y’ijoro aryamye bakamuhondagura n’umuryango babaziza ibihumbi y’irondo uru rugo rwahohotewe rwakubiswe mugaboumugore ndetse n’umwana w’umukobwa basanze gitanda aryamyeku buryo umugabo bamurambitse byatsi bagahuragura nk’abahura ibishyimbo banamuciraho ipantaro yambaye umugore urwo dugo yagize atinjyewe ikintu cyambabaje cyane cyanteye n’agahinda uburyo dutanga amafaranga tunishyura neza ariko bakarengaho bakaza gukurura umuntu nk’abakurura ihene bakamutesha agaciro yakomeje avuga igitenge yifubitse yacyambuwe n’umwe banyerondo witwa kigube mutungirehe avuga bamusanze rugo baramucakira agerageza kubabaza bamuhoye nako abahunga ariko baranga bamusanga nzu baramukubita n’umuryango atinagiye kubona mbona batangiye kumfata ndababaza nti murimo muranshakaho bati turashaka amafaranga y’irondonanjye ndababwira nti irondo nishyura neza ikibazo mumfiteho igiki’ntangira mbahunga bankubitira rugo umudamu nzu arahururakuburyo twese n’abana baryamye twese badusanze nzu baradukubita uyu mugabo avuga umugore yakubiswe akanamburwa igitenge telefonengo ikindi ntibagarukiye kuko n’inzu nayo bayisahuye gihe bamaze guhunga bayibasigiye abaturage mudugudu nabo bemeza iby’ihohoterwa ry’uyu muryango kuko bakimara kumva bahurujwe baje basanga kubakubita nabo bahita bahuruza akagari umwe yagize atimutungirehe bamukubise n’umugore ndetse n’abana undi atimugusohoka twasanze mugabo bamurambitse biriya byatsi urebabakubita bakubita induru zivuga abantu babashije kuvuza induru abadamu abagore ku ruhande rw’abanyerondo bavuga babavugaho ukubeshya kuko abaturage basanzwe babagirira urwango umwe yagize atiabaturage baratwanga kuko ugeze ahantu habaye ikibazobyanga bikunda ntabwo bakuvuga neza ukora akazi neza bahakana kandi batigeze bajya nzu y’umuturage babe bakiba nk’uko bivugwa ahubwo biterwa n’uko bangwa n’abaturage umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge gishali rushimisha marc yavuze kibazo bakizi ndetse bagiye gushaka muryango warenganurwa kuko abanyerondo bateshutse nshingano zabo yagize atiabanyerondo barakurikiranwa kuko bafite ubuyobozi bubakurikiranaiyo akoze ikosa araribazwa nk’undi muturage yakomeje avuga nubwo muturagi arimo amaze abiri atishyuye y’irondo ntibyari gucyemurwa kumukubita bityo uwabikoze agomba kubiryozwa atikuba byonyine bafashe inkoni bagakubita umuturage icyaha ubwo uwabikoze twamaze kumukurikirana araza gushyikirizwa inzego zibishinzwe kugira akurikiranwe rwego rw’amategeko buryo uwakubiswe arenganurwe irondo ry’umwuga ryashyizweho kugirango risimbuzwe irindi ryari rihari buryo gukora akazi karyo kinyamwunga kuko akazi bahemberwamuri murenge buri rugo rutanga amafaranga kwezibiyo muryango wazize amafaranga by’amanyarwanda kuko barimo ibirarane mezi abiribagiye gutanga ikibazo cyabo kagari barenganurwe bavuye muganagaiyi nkoni y’icyatsi iruhande rwabo muzo bakubitishijwe bayizanye kuyereka ubuyoboziumugabo baramukubise kugeza ipantalo yambaye yamucikiyehonzabandora theogenemuhaburarw

title: hakozwe agapfukamunwa korohereza abantu kurya batagakuyemo
content: ni agapfukamunwa kameze nk’utundi twose ariko gafite umwanya hasi ushobora kunyuzwamo ibiryo gihe umuntu meza uwo mwanya ufungurwa umuntu agiye kurya yarangiza akongera akawufunga cyangwa ukifunga asaf gitelis umuyobozi w’ikigo avtipus patents and inventions cyakoze utwo dupfukamunwa yavuze hari udufungurwa buryo busanzwe hakoreshejwe intoki n’utundi twifungura ikanya cyangwa ikiyiko cyegereye umunwa dukoze buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga yagize ushobora kurya kunywa ukishimisha hanyuma wamara kurangiza kurya ugafunga ukirinda kandi ukanarinda kumwe icyo kigo cyatangaje gihe kitarenze ukwezi baraba atangiye gukora udupfukamunwa tw’ubwo bwoko twinshi kamwe kazajya kagurwa hagati y’amadolari n’amadolari

title: zambia yisubiyeho bihano yafatiye icyamamare koffi olomide
content: polisi leta zambia bemereye koffi olomide umuririmbyi w’icyamamare njyana rhumba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo kuhakorera igitaramo mpera y’icyumweru gitaha ibi bitandukanye n’amakuru cyumweru gishize yavugaga umuririmbyi olomide yahita atabwa yombi akigera zambia ibi bije kandi bikurikira inkuru yasohotse kinyamakuru times of zambia leta zambia irega bwana olomide yakubise umunyamakuru ufotora aheruka zambia anaregwa guhohotera bamwe babyinnyi ashaka kubakoresha imibonano mpuzabitsina gahato kubakoresha gihugu cy’ubufaransa kandi byangombwa bibemerera kuhakorera bafite iyo nkuru yatumye bwana olomide w’imyaka y’amavuko ashaka abunganizi mategeko kumuvugira butegetsi zambia kugira yisobanure none umuvugizi polisi zambia esther katongo aravuga bwana olomide yemerewe kwinjira zambia kibazo yavuze mpapuro polisi mpuzamahanga interpol zihari zisaba kumuta yombi kandi dosiye yindi y’ibyaha afite zambia madamu katongo yongeyeho ikirego gukubita cyatanzwe polisi n’umunyamakuru cyarahagaritswe kubera kubura ibimenyetso bwana olomide uzwiho kwambara imyenda ihenze cyane kubaho buzima bw’iraha si ubwa mbere atavugwaho rumwe mu mwaka videwo yamugaragaje atera imigeri umugore babyinnyi yageraga kenya ako kanya yahise yirukanwa kenya mu mwaka nabwo yahamijwe n’urukiko kongo icyaha gukubita umwe bamufasha gutunganya umuziki icyo gihe urukiko rwamuhanishije igihano gisubitse gufungwa amezi atatu urukiko rwabwiwe ubushyamirane bwe n’uyu diego lubaki wamufashaga gutunganya umuziki bwatewe kwishyuza umwenda bwana olomide amubereyemo ungana n’ibihumbi by’amadolari y’amerika mu mwaka bwana olomide yashinjwe gukubita imigeri umunyamakuru ufata videwo televiziyo yigenga rtga kongo hanyuma akanamena kamera gitaramo cyaberaga murwa mukuru kinshasa bivugwa bapfaga uburenganzira gufata amashusho icyo gihe byasabye umukuru w’inteko inshingamategeko kongo yinjira makimbirane yunga bwana olomide nyiri televiziyo yakubitiwe umunyamakuru yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: abahindi bifatanyije n’abanyarwanda kwibuka jenoside y’abatutsi
content: icyo gikorwa kwibuka cyabereye ishuri rikuru bangalore murwamukuru new delhi cyitabirwa n’abantu bagera magana ane nyuma y’urugendo kwibuka umuyobozi uhagarariye u rwanda buhindi williams nkurunziza yavuze jenoside yakorewe abatutsi itazongera ukundi ati twibagiwe ubumuntu duhinduka inyamaswa dutsemba abavandimwe bacu iyi inkovu itari ikwiye kubaho turizeza ibyabaye bizasubira ukundi yatangaje u rwanda ruviriye jenoside rwateye intambwe itangaje ubukungu bw’igihugu bwiyongereye kigereranyo ijana ugereranyije n’imyaka ishize n’ubukene bukagabanuka gipimo ijana myaka itanu ishize iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha perezida paul kagame nyuma kuyobohoza u rwanda agahagarika jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mwaka yahitanye ubuzima bw’inzirakarengane zisaga miliyoni nk’uko nkurunziza akomeza abitangaza ibikorwa nk’ibyo kwibuka byabereye kandi n’i pune salem kuri cyumweru tariki biteganyijwe abanyarwanda bagera i chidambaram coimbatore bangalore nabo baza kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi nshimiyimana leonard

title: islam yagize ivuga nyuma yokubuzwa gukoresha indagururamajwi misigiti
content: nyuma yuko umurenge nyarugenge gatatu tariki werurwe usohoye itangazo rivuga hafashwe icyemezo guhagarika indangururamajwi misigiti umujyanama mufti w’ rwanda yatangaje kiriya cyemezo nyarugenge havuguziga charles yagize mbandikiye ngira mbasabe guhagarika gukoresha ndangururamajwi mugashaka ubundi buryo budateza urusaku muhamagara abayoboke isaha y’isengeshonyuma y’iki cyemezo umujyanama mufti w’ rwanda sheikh mbarushimana suleiman yabwiye itangazamakuru guhagarika gukoresha indangururamajwi guhamagarira abayoboke gusenga icyemezo cyababangamiye yagize twumva igikwiye atari uguhagarika adhana’ ahubwo ukuyikora neza umuhamagaro ugakorwa buryo n’umwe ubangamirwa ubundi ahari nk’amikoro ifite ijwi rirangira bigatuma hari ribuza gusinzira cyangwa kuruhuka rwose tugasaba bikorwa ijwi ryiza rigera bandi bakora isengesho musigitiyakomeje avuga gutora adhana’ bishingiye kwemera kw’ibanze islam agira atikuko n’ubundi uba uhamagarira abantu kuza gusingiza mana gusenga mana iruta byose kubakura murongo w’ibindi bikorwa bakibagirwa igihe gushimira imana ku buryo kuba hari uwavuga muhamagaro nuhagarare’ yaba ahagaritse kwemera imana kuyiha agaciro ikwiye gihe cyayo mu gihe leta yahakanira islam gukomeza gukoresha indangururamajwi sheikh mbarushimana yavuze hari izindi nzira eshatu bahita bifashisha gutora adhana’ yagize twasaba ziriya ndangururamajwi amajwi agarukira imbere rusengero tukongera tugakoresha ubundi buryo kabiri kumenyereza abayisilamu igihe gusenga kigeze bakizi bakahagera mbere y’igihe ku buryo wundi utegereje bwumve ijwi rimuhamagara rirangurura ridahari akabimenya akibwiriza akaza mbere uretse sheikh mbarushimana yavuze ikoranabuhanga rifasha buryo adhana yashyirwa telefone igihe cyagera ikibutsa nyirayo isaha gusenga ibura iminota akitegura inzego leta zimaze iminsi igenzura ry’insengero hirya hino gihugu zisanze hari zibura zigafungwa i kigali majyaruguru gusa hafunzwe insengero zirenga mu birebwa harimo kuba zidateza urusaku zikorera yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: nyabihu umugore numugabo bafatanwe udupfunyika tw’urumogi

title: perezida kagame yagaragaje ibyiyumviro bye gusezera arsene wenger ntagikombe gikomeye asigiye ikipe
content: umukunzi akaba n’umufana mukuru w’ikipe arsenal perezida paul kagame yagaragaje ibyiyumviro bye k’ukuba arsene wenger asezeye ntagikombe gikomeye asigiye kipe umukuru w’igihugu cy’u rwanda akundanyuma kutitwara neza ikipe arsenal ibura amahirwe kugera mukino nyuma w’igikombe cy’i burayi kizwi europa league’aho yasezerewe n’ikipe atletico madrid espagne wenger umaze imyaka atoza arsenal aherutse gutangaza mwaka w’imikino nyuma atoza kipe y’amateka ruhando mpuzamahanga ikundwa n’abatuye imigabane y’isi barimo perezida w’u rwanda paul kagame nyuma y’umukino waraye uhuje arsenal atletico madrid espagne europa league abakunzi bayo bamaze imyaka myinshi banyotewe igikombe cy’icyubahiro ntibahishe amarangamutima banenga ikipe ndetse n’umutoza wenger ubasigiye amarira n’agahinda kenshi perezida kagame usanzwe umufana ukomeye arsenal abinyujije twitter yanenze uburyo kipe n’umutoza wayo bashoje nabi imyaka myinshi bamaranye anenga nyiri ikipe ariko yizeza azakomeza kuyifana yagize igitekerezo cyanjye ikipe nkunda arsenal ikipe nziza mukino n’umutoza mwiza arsene wenger uku si yakabaye irangiza igihe kirekire cy’amateka umutoza aragiye ikipe ikomeje igihe cyayo gikombe ndacyari umufana wayo gihe kizaza gusa ndanenga nyir’ikipe umukuru w’igihugu ntiyahwemye kuvuga ikipe akunda hakenewe impinduka yaba bantu cyangwa se ibintu bigomba guhinduka kuri nshuro yongeye kugaragaza impinduka zigikenewe kandi hari n’izabaye atari zari zikenewe yagize nkuko nakunze kubivuga nk’umuntu uyikurikiranira hari ikintu cy’ibanze gikwiye guhinduka ikipe niba hari icyahindutse ntabwo cyari gikwiye ndifuriza ibyiza abakunzi arsenal turacyakeneye arsenal igaruka yahoze makipe meza perezida kagame yagaragaje ibyiyumviro bye gusezera arsene wenger ntagikombe gikomeye asigiye ikipe akunda usibye kuba perezida kagame umufana arsenal fc n’umwe bayobozi bakunda umupira w’amaguru ndetse afite n’igikombe cyimwitirirwa cecafa kagame cup mu ikipe arsenal yamugeneye impano azishyikirizwa tony adams wahoze kapiteni wayo tony adams yatangaje kipe yamugeneye umupira gukina arsenal imuha imipira itatu kwambara arsenal hariho umwe uriho amazina numero mu perezida kagame yizihizaga isabukuru y’imyaka y’amavuko umutoza arsene wenger yamuhaye impano y’idarapo ry’iyi kipe ririho imikono y’abakinnyi kumushimira mu ukwakira perezida kagame kibuga arsenal emirates title: ibiribwa bitumizwa karere biri bituma ifaranga ry’u rwanda rikomeza guta agaciro
content: mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kabiri nyuma kugeza raporo y’ingengo y’imari yakoreshejwe umwaka ushize imbere y’inama y’abaminisitiri john rwangombwa yavuze ibituruka hanze bikomeza gutuma ibintu rwanda bizamba asubiza ikibazo abajijwe bantu benshi bakomeza kwibaza uburyo litiro lisansi hagabanutseho amafaranga ariko ibiciro bigakomeza kuzamuka yasubije n’ubwo lisansi yagabanyutse ariko ifaranga ryo ritigeze rireka guta agaciro ati ibiribwa bitumizwa hanze nko kenya bigira uruhare izamuka ry’ibiciro guta agaciro kw’ifaranga ryacu kuko nabyo biba byaguzwe mafaranga atagifite agaciro yagaragaje ingero z’uburyo u rwanda rufite ifaranga rikigerageza kugira agaciro karere n’ubwo umwaka ushize guta agaciro ifaranga ry’u rwanda byari uku kwezi bikaba bigeze nyuma y’u rwanda kenya nicyo gihugu kigerageza aka karere kuko ifaranga ryacyo ryataye agaciro kugeza hejuru muri kiganiro kizajya kibaho buri gihe minisitiri w’imari amaze gushyikiriza raporo inama y’abaminisitiri rwangombwa yasobanuye u rwanda rwabonye amafaranga angana miliyari ugereranyije miliyari rwabonye mwaka kuba mafaranga yariyongeryeho byaturutse bikorerwa imbere gihugu byatanze amafaranga y’u rwanda miliyari zingana y’inyungu miliyari z’ayaturutse hanze zingana by’inyungu emmanuel hitimana

baturage yakorakoye muhungu wishwe ebola bituma ahita yandura birangira yitabye imana ibihugu bihana imbibi congo kinshasa byahagurukiye gushyiraho ingamba zikumira cyorezo kiriyo katambuka imipaka u title: inzovu zisaga ibihumbi ziricwa buri mwaka afurika
content: ibi byagarutsweho nama nyunguranabitekerezo yabereye karere musanze ugushyingo ihuje abacunga umutekano abakozi bashinzwe kurengera ibidukikije n’abakora nzego leta yateguwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambererdbku bufatanye n’umuryango urengera inyamaswa gasozirwanda wildlife conservation association iyi nama igamije kungurana ibitekerezo kurwanya ibyaha gushimuta gucuruza inyamaswa by’umwihariko imisambi rwanda inkura n’inzovu zikunze kwibasirwa haba rwego rw’igihugu karere rwego mpuzamahanga kureba uburyo ibyaha nk’ibi bihanwa umunyakenyakazi dr winnie kiiru umaze imyaka isaga bikorwa kurengera ubusugire bw’inyamaswawari witabiriye nama yemeza igitiza umurindi rushimusi harimo ibikoresho biciriritse barinda inyamaswa ndetse n’amategeko adakarishye ahana byaha yagize hagomba gushyirwaho uburyo bwose abarinzi bagira ibikoresho bikomeye urugero usanga rushimusi bateye parike bafite imbunda zikomeye indege n’imodoka zikaze ariko abarinzi bafite inkoni cyangwa amabuye murumva mbaraga ntizahangana n’aba rushimushari n’aho usanga amategeko ahana byaha adakaze kurusha inyungu bashimuta bifuzamo bikwiye kuranduka kuko rwanda byarashobotse umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe gucunga imishinga iterwa leta rdb felix siboniyo umukozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb yemera koko amategeko ahari hari igihe usanga atanga icyuho cyane kubungabunga ibidukikije ati hagomba kubaho amategeko yihariye rwanda inzovu ziri gucika ngombwa habaho amategeko yihariye azirengera gihe zabonetse kugira zororoke akomeza avuga udashobora kugira ubukerarugendo utarengeye ibidukikije kandi udashobora kurengera ibinyabuzima utagamije iterambere ry’abantu ati kugira tubigereho hakenewe ubufatanye bwimbitse hagati y’inzego zose kuko nubwo rwanda parike zicunzwe neza hanakenewe ubukangurambaga rubanda bakora bibuga by’indege mipaka n’abashinzwe umutekano kugira tugire ubukerarugendo buteye imbere kuri habarurwa inzovu ziri hagati y’ibihumbi zicwa buri mwaka afurika hagamijwe kuzikuraho amahembe yazo akoreshwa bugeni inyinshi zikaba kenya botwana afurika y’epfo abitabiriye nama basabwe buri wese yaba ijisho ry’igihugu kurwanya ubushimusi n’ubucuruzi bunyuranyije n’amategeko harengerwa inyamaswa cyane cyane izigenda zikendera abitabiriye nama baturutse bihugu kenya malawi uganda tanzania repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo n’u rwanda rwayakiriye u rwanda rwashoye imbaraga bikorwa kurengera inyamaswa urugamba gufasha amatsinda ashinzwe gukumira ishimutwa ry’inyamaswa gukorana n’inzego zitandukanye gukurikirana gutanga amakuru kugeza butabera abakora ibyaha kuzishimuta rurakomeje

title: darfur ingabo z’u rwanda ntizizacika intege
content: ibi umuvugizi w’ingabo yabitangaje nyuma yaho abasirikare babiri b’u rwanda ukwakira masaha n’ijoro biciwe ntara darfur umuvugizi w’ingabo z’u rwanda avuga basirikare mubikorwa by’irondo baza kugwa mugico cy’inyeshyamba n’ubu zitari zamenyekana koroneli joseph nzabamwita agira abagizi nabi bateze abasirikare bacu barabarasa habaho imirwano mirwano hapfa abasirikare bacu babiri abasirikare bacu mukwivuna umwanzi bica umusirikare umwe n’umubiri n’ibikoresho afite turabifata ariko none hakomeretse abasirikare bacu bane barimo kuvurirwa i khartoum yemeza aka gace hiciwe abasirikare b’u rwanda mubutumwa bw’umuryango w’abibumbye hari inyeshyamba zitandukanye zirimo n’aba janjaweed bakomeje kwibasira abaturage b’intara darfur hari kandi ingabo leta sudani u rwanda ruvuga rudashobora gucibwa intege n’ibikorwa nk’ibi byibasira ingabo mpuzamahangakoloneli nzabamwita yagize icyambere twagiye butumwa tuzi neza ukwitanga abana b’u rwanda baritanze kugira dushobore kurengera n’ubuzima bw’abandi kandi twitanga n’ubuzima bwacu nicyo mbereubuyobozi bw’ingabo z’u rwanda zikaba zihanganisha imiryango y’abasirikare baguye muntara darfur leta y’u rwanda yamaganye mugaragaro igitero cyahitanye abasirikare babiri b’u rwanda n’umupolisi senegal itangazo minisiteri y’ingabo yashyize ahagaragara nyuma y’iraswa ryabo kuri loni yohereje itsinda rishinzwe gukora iperereza ryimbitse gitero abagikoze n’icyo bagamije mu ntara darfur habarizwa abasirikare b’u rwanda bagera egide kayiranga

title: abatandikisha ubutaka kubera kudasobanukirwa turabegereza itegeko govgatabazi
content: amajyaruguru hari abaturage batinya kwandikisha umutungo wabo utimukanwa bitewe gutinya gusoreshwa ndetse n’abawandikisha ntibawusorere bitewe n’imyumvure ubuyobozi buvuga impamvu kwandikisha title: umukobwa yapfuye arimo gutabara umugabo warohamye
content: abakora ibikorwa by’ubutabazi batahuye umurambo w’umukobwa w’umwangavu warohamye agerageza kurokora umugabo kurohama mugezi warengewe n’imyuzure kenya kuri kabiri tariki ukuboza nibwo ann nduku w’imyaka y’amavuko yarohamye mugezi witwa kandisi w’ahitwa ongata rongai nkengero y’umurwa mukuru nairobi nduku yarohamye yumvaga umugabo utabaza unagannye gice kimwe cy’iteme riri kubakwa mugezi uwo mugabo yararokotse ariko madamazela nduku yageragezaga kumutabara yahise agwa mugezi nyina elizabeth mutuku yavuze yabonye umukobwa mbere gupfa rwana n’amazi yagize naramubonye arwana n’amazi ndetse ngerageza kumurokora naramuhamagaye nti ’anna anna’ nashakaga kumujugunyira inkoni ngerageze kumukurura mukuremo akomeza agira atiariko umugezi warengewe kuburyo amazi yagendaga amujugunya hirya hino aramutwara uwo mugezi waruzuye nyuma y’imvura nyinshi yatangiye kugwa mbere w’iki cyumweru ikagera bindi bihugu afurika y’uburasirazuba ariko abahaturiye bavuga abantu barenga barindwi bamaze gutwarwa n’amazi y’uwo mugezi myaka ibiri ishize maryam zenneth mukuru madamazela nduku yavuze urupfu murumuna arwegeka bayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze bananiwe kurangiza kubaka iryo teme rihuza icyaro batuyemo n’isoko rinini ryo mujyi baturanye rongai ati imyaka ibiri irashize abantu benshi bapfa abayobozi barebera baraza mugafatanya kiriyo ariko kindi gikorwa uyu munsi bibaye murumuna wanjye nde uzakurikiraho iri teme nzira y’ibanze abana bagiye ishuri banyuramo kuki bakuyeho iteme hano bagatangira kubaka irindi none bakaba batari kurirangiza

title: abaturage bakwiye kurushaho kubungabunga ubuzima bwabo bihe by’imvura
content: mu bihe by’imvura aribyo tunarimo rwanda usanga aribwo hamera ibigunda nkike z’ingo nyinshi cyane biturage nk’uko mukambungo esperance umujyanama w’ubuzima mudugudu rubugurizoumurenge shyogwe karere muhanga abivuga yongeraho bihuru bishobora kuba indiri y’imibu ishobora kurya abantu ikabanduza malariya niyo mpamvu asanga abaturage bakwiye kugira ingamba nshashya kwirinda indwara zabo bihe by’imvura iyo imvura igwa usanga imyanda izanwa n’imvura yakwiriye hamwe hamwe ni nayo mpamvu asanga isuku ikwiriye kurushaho kwitabwaho cyane gihe cy’imvura kuko usanga gihe haboneka indwara nyinshi abantu batirinze zimwe ndwara nk’uko abivuga harimo choleraumusongainzoka ndetse malaria kubera ndwara zangiza umubiri w’uzanduye buryo hari n’ubwo zamwica ziramutse zitavuwemukambungo esperance nk’umujyanama w’ubuzima aboneraho gukangurira abaturage kwita gutema ibihuru bishobora kwihishamo imibu itera maralia uyu mujyanama w’ubuzima akomeza avuga kwirinda ibinogo birekamo amazi nabyo ngombwa kuko indiri y’inzoka zinjirira birenge igihe umuntu ayakandagiramo iyo umuntu abyirinze hakiri kare ndiri z’inzoka ntizibasha kuboneka rugo rwe ikindi ugutema ibihuru bizengurutse ingo byakwihishamo imibu kandi bikajyana kurara nzitiramibu ziteye umuti gihe nk’iki cy’imvura ibi bishobora kugabanya malariya kunywa amazi atetse cyangwa arimo umuti wica mikorobe sur’eau nabyo n’ingenzi kuko usanga gihe cy’imvura cyane cyane amasoko arushaho kuzana amazi yanduyebityo rwego kwirinda inzoka akaba yatekwa cyangwa agashyirwamo sur’eau mbere kunyobwa ababyeyi bakwiye gushishikarira gufubika abana bihe by’imvura kugira babarinde indwara ziterwa n’imbeho nk’umusonga n’izindi kwambara inkweto bihe buri wese nabyo byaba byiza cyane kuko birinda uzambaye inzoka zinjirira birenge n’izindi mikorobe zishobora gukurura indwara zitandukanye nk’uko umujyanama w’ubuzima mukambungo yabigarutseho kuri ningombwa abaturage babungabunga biruseho ubuzima bwabo gihe cy’imvura kandi n’abandi bajyanama b’ubuzima barusheho kubikangurira abaturage b’imidugudu bashizwe safari viateur

title: icyo abanyamadini bavuze gitwaza wiyise umuhanuzi uruta abandi’
content: guhera ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru mbuga nkoranyamabaga rwanda hari gucicikana amashusho agaragaza umuyobozi w’itorero zion temple aptre dr gitwaza paul avuga wundi muhanuzi umuruta rwanda afurika ni amashusho yafashwe mugoroba tariki kanama rusengero zion temple gatenga yatangaga icyigisho gifite umutwe ugira uti ibimenyetso by’ibitangaza’ uwo munsi gitwaza yagize sinzi gihugu hari umuhanuzi unduta ibi mbabwira si ukwirata kandi imana ibimbababarire hari akantu kwirata kandimo sinzi gihugu afurika mufite umuhanuzi umeze nkanjye amashyi birashoboka azaza ariko gihe ndiho ntimuzamubona muzamushakishe mumumbwire gitwaza yemeje muhanuzi umuruta gihugu gitwaza yagarukaga amaze kuvuga by’uko yagiye ahura n’ibigeragezo byinshi akitwa igisambo umusambanyi umupfumu n’ibindi ariko agakomeza gukora umurimo w’imana kandi akabitsinda yavuze nubwo batakwemera muhanuzi ukomeye bazabyemera atakiriho ati ndababwiza ukuri muzabimenya naragiye hari ahandi bazanyemera kubakwa kw’iki gihugu mbifitemo uruhare runini cyane nahanuye ezekiyeli kugira amagufwa yongere abeho kandi intambara naciyemo wundi mukozi w’imana uzazicamo cyangwa waziciyemo nyuma gusakara kw’ayo mashusho gitwaza ntiyavuzweho rumwe haba binyamakuru mbuga nkoranyambaga ubusanzwe amadini ntiyemera abahanuzi batari abagaragara bibiliya ku babemera umuhanuzi umuntu ushobora kubona ibizaba akoreshejwe n’umwuka w’imana akabivuga igihe cyagera bikazagaragara yabivuze ikinyamakuru igihe cyaganiriye n’abandi banyamadini batandukanye rwanda bagaragaza bafashe magambo gitwaza umuvugizi kiliziya gatolika akaba n’umwepiskopi diyosezi butare philippe rukamba yavuze batemera iby’ubuhanuzi yagize hari ibintu wenda nk’amabonekerwa ashobora kubaho nayo tuyemera buhoro cyane buriya kibeho kugira yemerwe hari hashize imyaka nibura ibyo dukora ibisanzwe ufata bibiliya ukayisoma ukagerageza kuyishyira buzima bwawe ariko kuvuga isi izashira ejobundi cyangwa hagiye kuba ntabwo tubyemera musenyeri philippe rukamba rukamba avuga ahubwo hari ubuhanuzi asigaye yumva bukamutera ubwoba ati hari ubuhanuzi bukomeye buntera n’ubwoba busigaye buriho barakubwira bati turahanura wowe imana iragukiza ntuzongere kunywa imiti ntuzongere kureba muganga emera gusa usenge’ ibyo ntabwo twe ntitubyemera amafuti niba imana igukijije yerekana wakize kuvuga gusa emera kintu kibigaragaza ushobora kubimbwira utarakize bishop marguerite rwandamura umushumba w’itorero united christian church ishami gikondo yavuze itorero rye bemera ubuhanuzi gusa yamenya ikigenderwaho umuntu avuge mbere yagize njye simuhakanya umuhanuzi ariko kumenya urwego ariho sindi imana cyangwa umwuka wera ntabwo nzi abarusha abandi ntabwo nzi abaza mwanya mbere nemera abahanuzi bariho kandi ubuhanuzi bw’ukuri n’ubw’ibinyoma bubaho rwandamura avuga abakiristo basabwa guhagarara ijambo ry’imana kugira babashe gutahura abahanura ukuri n’ibinyoma ati iyo umuntu ahamye ijambo ry’imana akaryiga akarisobanukirwa akaryemera abahanuzi baje ntibashobora kumutesha umurongo bishop murekezi simon masasu uyobora restoration church i rubavu yavuze bemera ubuhanuzi ariko uvuga hari uruta sibyo avuga ivugabutumwa hagomba kubaho abantu batanu bafite imihamagaro itandukanye barimo intumwa umuhanuzi umuvugabutumwa umupasitori n’umwarimu kandi buzuzanya yagize uwo aribeshya kuko bibiliya ivuga mihamagaro itanu biruzuzanya kugira imana ikore uwo afite kamere gusa imukoreshaumuntu w’imana umuntu uca bugufi akumva akagirwa inama kandi akamenya imana imuhaye ubutumwa kugira abusoze neza umwuka w’imana niwo umukoresha masasu yavuze bitanashoboka umuntu umuhanuzi abe n’intumwa icyarimwe ati kuki yiyita intumwa kandi akiyita n’umuhanuzi urumva agiye ukuvanga ibintu bibiri icyarimwe haba harimo akantu k’ubuyobe abahanuzi babayeho kera baracyariho kandi si wenyine umuyobozi w’itorero zeraphath holy church bishop harerimana jean bosco yavuze muhanuzi umenya akorera ibitangaza nibo bamumenya ati eliya yigeze kubwira imana muhanuzi usigaye imana iramubwira iti uribeshye hari ibindi bihumbi by’abahanuzi biri inyuma imana yahise imusaba kurangiza umurimo imusaba kwimika uzamusimbura elisa akarangiza urugendo rwe yavuze igihe umuntu atangiye kwivuga ibigwi murimo w’imana atangiye kunanirwa ati ibyo ukora nibyo bikwamamaza utangiya kwiyamamaza uba watangiye kunanirwa aptre paul gitwaza yakunze kumvikana buhanuzi bihe bitandukanye butavuzweho rumwe mu yahanuye iby’imperuka y’isi bica igikuba rubanda ariko birangira itabaye ibi nyuma yarabihakanye avuga ibinyoma sinavuze isi izarangira itariki nzeli impamvu ntabivuga bibiliya itatubwira umunsi icya kabiri nanjye nzi umunsi isi izarangirira ngendo najyamo sinakwigisha abantu gukora gutekereza kureba imbere’’ gitwaza yahanuye imperuka si gitwaza wenyine wakunze guhanura ibintu ntibivugweho rumwe kuko umwaka ushize bishop innocent rugagi uyobora redeemed gospel church yahanuriye umwe bakobwa bahataniraga ikamba miss rwanda azaritwara ntibyakunda muri mwaka kandi hari amashusho ataravuzweho rumwe yamugaragaje yaturira imigisha bakiristo bifuza amafaranga imodoka inzu n’ibindi bitewe n’icyo umuntu yifuza bagiye kubibona gihe gito inkuru igihe

title: saka baka bluez yakoze indirimbo irikuvugisha benshi yahurije hamwe abahanzi mozambiquevideo
content: umuhanzi w’umunyarwanda saka baka bluez yakoze indirimbo kuvugisha abatari bake kumbugankoranyambaga uyu muhanzi ukomoka rwanda asigaye mozambique yanahurije hamwe abahanzi gihugu bagakorana indirimbo irigukundwa benshi mukiganiro sakabaka yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru ibyamamarecom yatubwiyeko ndirimbo muzikunzwe mozambique yakozwe n’aba producer babiri harimo mozambique witwa master flash wafashe amajwi barick rwanda watunganyije beatumudiho amashusho yafashwe nando muteto sakabaka yaduhamirijeko amashusho y’iyi ndirimbo arikurwego hejuru kuko yafashwe n’ibyuma bigezweho bifata amashusho mukireredrone iyi ndirimbo bahanzi bise rap de luxo amashusho yayo yafatiwe kirwa bita ponta do ourogiherereye majyepfo mozambique rap de luxo bisobanuye rapu irikurundi rwego ururimi rw’igiporutigari gikoreshwa cyane gihugu abahanzi bumvikana ndirimbo umunyarwanda sakabaka hamwe n’itsinda r bulla musik umuhanzi ukomeye witwa kico da kivu boi wax ndoreko boi wax kanda hano wumve ndirimbo saka baka bluez umwe mubahanzi bavuye rwanda bakunzwe munjyana hip hopyakoranye n’abahanzi bazwi barimo joddy phibi pacson p-fla umugabo wubatse afite umugore n’umwana yanakoze indirimbo yitiriye mwana yise niyo afatanyije kico da kivu saka baka bluez yakoreye nzu itunganya umuziki yamamaye cyane hano rwanda bmcg yayoborwaga n’umugabo witwa barick

title: bamwe bakorera uburaya i nyamirambo ntibacyemera imibonano mpuzabistina idakingiye
content: kigalitoday yegereye itsinda bamwe bakorera uburaya i nyamirambo bayibwira bamenye ububi sida bakurikije babona sida imerera nabi bamwe bagenzi itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo ryemeye kuganira kigalitoday rivuga ntawabona cyangwa abe yumva ububi sida abure gufata ingamba kwirinda sida ntitucyemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo n’abakiriya bacu kuko twamenye ingaruka mbi z’imibonano mpuzabitsina idakingiyeabagabo badakoresha agakingirizo bafite virusi itera sidaiyo yanze dukoresha agakingirizo acaho njye nkacaho nubwo ariko bamwe bakora uburaya i nyamirambo bavuga batacyemerera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina abakiriya banga gukoresha agakingirizo hari abakora uburaya bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ubukene kubura abakiriya itsinda ry’indaya z’i nyamirambo riti hari bagenzi bacu bageraho bakemera gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina gakingirizo kubera ategereza umwanya munini umukiriya wemera agakingirizo akamubura kandi yenda abana baburaye ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubuvuzirwanda bio-medical center bugashyirwa ahagaragara mwaka buragaragaza bakora uburaya umuntu umwe babiri yanduye virusi itera sida umukozi rbc dr mwumvaneza mutagoma uyoboye itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi bwagaragaje imibare y’ubwandu virusi itera sida rwanda dr mwumvaneza avuga imibare yavuye bushakashatsi bakoze igaragaza gihugu hose rwanda abakora uburaya abagera banduye virusi itera sida mujyi kigali ijanisha rikaba riri hejuru ugereranije gihugu rusange kuko ho abagera banduye virusi itera sida inzobere ndwara sida zivuga indaya itsinda ry’abantu rifite ibyago byinshi kwandura virusi itera sida kurusha andi matsinda ibi biterwa indaya abantu bakora imibonano mpuzabitsina inshuro nyinshi kandi n’abantu batandukanye barimo abanduye vihsida u rwanda ubushakashatsi bugaragaza rutuwe n’abaturage barenga gato miliyoni muri rusange gihugu hose abantu babana virusi itera sida by’abanyarwanda ni ukuvuga rwanda abantu bagera bihumbi babana virusi itera sida jean baptiste micomyiza

title: diaspora nyarwanda australia yamaganye ibiherutse gutangazwa maneko z’u rwanda’
content: iyi nkuru y’umunyamakuru amy greenbank yasohotse kanama yavugaga abanyarwanda australia maneko ndetse uruzinduko minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga dr richard sezibera gicurasi rwari rugamije gucecekesha mpunzi zakoze ubwicanyi pariki bwindi dr sezibera yagiye australia atumiwe adc australian devos connections cyiswe australian leadership retreat’ iba buri mwaka igahuza abashoramari bakomeye n’ibigo bikomeye kaminuza n’abayobozi guverinoma cyangwa ababaye avuge ijambo nyamukuru mu butumwa bwe yakanguriye abashoramari australia bazitabira inama y’abakuru b’ibihugu guverinoma bigize umuryango w’ibihugu bikoresha icyongereza chogm kuza kureba amahirwe y’ishoramari rwanda ikindi nkuru abc ivuga ambasaderi w’u rwanda australia ufite icyicaro i singapore yafatiye imbunda gakanu umwe banyarwanda bahigwa leta y’u rwanda abc news kandi yavuze abanyarwanda diaspora australia batoteza abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’u rwanda gihugu umuyobozi diaspora nyarwanda australia karekezi emmanuel yabwiye igihe ibinyoma bikwirakwiza n’abo mutwe w’iterabwoba rnc kayumba nyamwasa ndetse n’indi cyitwa p abari isonga ry’uyu mugambi mubisha akaba paul rusesabagina ishyaka mrcd condo gervais rnc n’abandi batumirwa n’abatavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi bw’u rwanda australia mubarak kalisa amiel nubaha uyu wagize uruhare rugaragara itumirwa ry’abo bagabo gutegura umuhango kwibuka mata wahuje abafobya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi queensland parliament house mu kubatumira bakusanyirije amafaranga gufasha imitwe y’iterabwoba fln agaruka ibaruwa diaspora nyarwanda yandikiye igitangazamakuru abc news nzeri bakibwiye cyahawe ibinyoma n’abantu barwanya u rwanda babeshyere abanyarwanda australia n’igihugu rusange bakaba baribasiye cyane ngoga clestin akaba n’umuhuzabikorwa diaspora australia n’abandi benshi ati twasabye uriya munyamakuru kwandika ibindi bibeshyuza atabikora tukazamujyana rwego rugenzura abanyamakuru australia impamvu yanditse ibinyoma akwiye kuvuguruza imvugo zifutamye kandi zuzuye kubogama icyakora kugeza munsi ntabwo gitangazamakuru kiranyomoza cyatangaje cyangwa gisabe imbabazi mu ibaruwa diaspora nyarwanda igaruka witwa kalisa mubarak wavuganye mwishywa patrick karegeya witwa david batenga ndetse akaba umutangabuhamya rubanza rw’abaketsweho kurasa kayumba nyamwasa afurika y’epfo ibaruwa igira iti nubwo yiyita umutangabuhamya iraswa kayumba hari amakuru kalisa mubarak ahubwo mugambi w’abagambanye kumwica kubera amakimbirane rnc nyuma kwizezwa amafaranga menshi nyuma kubona umugambi umupfubanye yirukankiye polisi afurika y’epfo yiyita umutangabuhamya ivuga kandi kalisa umunyabyaha ugerageza kwigira umwere abinyujije kuvuga ahigwa guverinoma y’u rwanda akwirakwiza amajwi n’amashusho hirya hino maradiyo n’abandi henshi ayishinja gukora ibyaha afurika y’epfo u burayi none ageze australia mu nkuru abc news kalisa avuga yaje kohererezwa ubutumwa telefoni igendanwa nimero mahanga itagaragaza umwirondoro diaspora nyarwanda ivuga bigamije gutera impuhwe arebe yabona ubufasha bw’amafaranga iti izina rye urishyize google ubona uwagize uruhare jenoside wahunze bikaba biteye ikimwaro kubona itangazamakuru australia rimwita uwihisha kubera ubwoba bw’ubuzima bwe’’ karekezi avuga abakoresha bitangazamakuru abagerageza gusebya leta n’abanyarwanda australia kuko usanga banababuza kujya rwanda bavuga barazana uburozi n’ibindi yakomeje avuga ikinyoma mubarak bagenzi bacuze kidashinga kuko bitumvikana ambasaderi yavuye singapore atwaye imbunda akayihitisha bashinzwe kugenzura imipaka akayinjirana australia akayitunga ijosi ry’uwabitangaje bikarangirira ntiyitabaze polisi iyimwambure australia kandi irasa n’iyabaye indiri y’abafite imigambi mibisha rwanda hari n’abakekwa gukora amahano jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bakidegembya buri mwaka batumira bita abashyitsi barimo rusesabagina paul condo gervais david himbara serge ndayizeye padiri nahimana thomas bagakusanya inkunga gushyira bikorwa byabo bigamije guhungabanya igihugu

content: umukozi ushinzwe siporo n’imyidagaduro minisiteri siporo n’umuco uwambaza jean marie vianney avuga sitade ishobora kuba ahantu nyaburanga iramutse itunganyijwe neza kuko ifite amateka akomeye rwanda uwambaza yabivuze abakozi minisiteri akorera basuraga sitade rugendo barimo gusura ibibuga gukiniraho inzibutso z’abazize jenoside n’ibintu nyaburanga biboneka karere kayonza gahunda kubibungabunga kugira birusheho kwitabwaho yavuze by’umwihariko kumva hari sitade umwami w’u rwanda yakiniragaho ikintu gikomeye muntu wese wabyumva avuga sitade ishobora gukurura mukerarugendo baje kureba umwe bami b’u rwanda yacongeraga ruhago iyo sitade yubatse neza muhanda werekeza parike y’akagera inyubako z’igice cyari urwambariro rw’iyo sitade zarasenyutse ariko ikibuga kimeze neza hari abaturage baturanye bifuza yazavugururwa kugira abantu basura parike y’akagera bajye bagira n’umwanya gutemberera umwami w’u rwanda yakiniraga abo twaganiriye bavuga batazi neza igihe sitade yaba yarubakiwe gusa benshi bahurizaho yatunganywa kuko uretse kuba ibumbatiye amwe mateka y’u rwanda yanatuma agace yubatsemo gatera imbere ubwo umukozi minisiteri y’umuco yasuraga sitade yavuze azatanga raporo minisiteri kugira barebe babikoraho yongeyeho hari icyizere bazabyakira neza kuko sitade ishobora kubyazwa umusaruro haba siporo muco hagaragazwa ukuntu n’abami kera bitabiraga siporo cyprien m ngendahimana

title: ingaruka z’ihohoterwa rishingiye gitsina zigera miryango bombi polisi y’u rwanda
content: polisi y’u rwanda karere kicukiro itariki ugushyingo yagiranye inama n’abaturage barenga mirenge kicukiro niboyi y’akarere kicukiro ibigisha ubwoko bw’ibyaha by’ihohoterwa rishingiye gitsina title: iby’umuyobozi w’itorero inkuru nziza wagaragaye yikinisha byahagurukije komite idasanzwe
content: nyuma y’amahano yagaragaye muvugizi mukuru w’itorero inkuru nziza rwanda pastor ngaboyisonga theoneste wagaragaye mashusho yakwirakwijwe mbuga nkoranyambaga arimo kwikinisha bamwe bayobozi b’iri torero bitandukanyije n’uyu muyobozi wabo bashyiraho bise komite igamije kugarura isura nziza itorero’ nyuma y’amahano yagaragaye muvugizi mukuru w’itorero inkuru nziza rwanda pastor isura nziza itorero’ kuri kane tariki gashyantare nibwo komite yamurikiwe mugaragaro itangazamakuru igizwe n’abayobozi barimo umuyobozi komite ishinzwe kugarura isura nziza y’itorero inkuru nziza kamanugire elijah akaba n’umubitsi rwego rw’intara kigali pasiteri komite pastor muhirwa josue pastor ruzindana rambert umunyamabanga region kigali harimo kandi pastor bazatsinda fred umuyobozi wungirije kigali pastor biziyaremye leonce ushinzwe imirimo y’ivugabutumwa ntara kibungo ndetse ev gikundiro rwamigabo james ushinzwe ivugabutumwa ntara kigali pasiteri kanamugire elijah muyobozi mukuru w’iyi komite yavuze komite ishingiye ijambo ry’imana ndetse yanashimangiye kugeza umuvugizi wabo yamaze guhagarikwa umuyobozi biro gusa kuko ageze matorero agiye kwigisha abakirisitu basohoka kubera imana yamaze kumukuraho yakomeje avuga gukora kwifashisha bibiliya ndetse bagamije ukuvugira itorero ryose rusange yagize hari umugani abanyankore uganda baca bati ikinyoma cyabyutse kare ukuri kugitangayo tuvuga biri hejuru kandi impamvu turi ntabwo ukurwanira ubuyobozi ahubwo ukurwanira ubusugire bw’izina ry’imana niyo mpamvu twakoresheje imirongo bibiliya muzabona bibiliya hari abandi batabashije kuyobora imana ibakuraho natwe tugiye kumukuraho atari ukugirango biteze akaduruvayo ahubwo turavugira itorero ev gikundiro rwamigabo james ushinzwe ivugabutumwa ntara kigali yagize iyi komite igomba kwita bibiliya ivuga kwita abantu bavuga ndetse ibyagaragaye muvugizi w’itorero ryacu twebwe byose turashaka kubirenza amaso tugakomeza imirimo y’imana kuko inteko rusange yamukuyeho kandi uburyo umuyobozi ajyaho n’uko ashyirwaho byose bigaragara bibiliya james kandi akomeza avuga bakomeza gushaka umuyobozi mushya wayobora torero dore muvugizi mukuru bamaze kumwambura inshingano binyuze nteko rusange yateranye iyi komite yabonye ibibazo by’ingutu biri itorero aba abagize komite ishinzwe kugarura isura nziza itorero inkuru nziza nk’uko bigaragara itangazo rigenewe abanyamakuru ryashyizwe ahagaragara n’abagize komite bavuga hari ibibazo by’ingutu babonye bikomeje kugariza torero nabyo ahanini byabateye guhaguruka bagafatanyiriza hamwe kugarura isura nziza itorero ryabo iyi komite ivuga hashize imyaka itatu nama rusange iba kandi ubundi iba igomba kuba rimwe mwaka bavuga kandi kugeza batazi umutungo w’itorero ukoreshwa myaka ngengo y’imari igaragazwa raporo y’umutungo itangwa bavuga ibigo by’itorero byinjiza amafaranga birimo ibigo by’amashuri ibitaro n’ibindi ntawe uzi imikoreshereze n’imicungire yabyo hari n’ikindi komite igaragaza kirimo kuba tariki gashyantare harabaye inteko rusange yatumijwe n’umuvugizi theoneste kandi atayiteguranye n’abo bakorana abagize komite baratabaza inzego bwite leta kwinjira kibazo abagize komite bavuga basaba inzego bwite leta n’abakirisitu rusange kumenya itorero inkuru nziza rikiri itorero kandi rigendera mahame n’imyemerere gikirisitu ndetse bibiliya bavuga kandi inzego bireba n’imiryango gikirisitu bakomeza gufasha torero kugarura umwuka mwiza n’isura nziza isimbura ryambitswe n’umuvugizi waryo yagaragaraga arimo kwikinisha aba bayobozi b’iyi komite kandi bavuga basabye umuvugizi w’iri torero ngaboyisonga theoneste yarekeraho kugandisha abakirisitu bamwe torero itorero inkuru nziza rwanda ryatangiye gukora ariko riza kwemererwa gukorera gihugu ryagiye rikora ibikorwa binyuranye rwanda iri torero rifite amatorero gihugu hose rikaba rifite ibitaro biri i gikondo rikagira n’ishami iri torero rifite ibigo by’amashuri ayisumbuye n’abanza banafite ikigo cy’amahugurwa kiri i gihogwe karere gasabo umujyi kigali umuyobozi komite ishinzwe kugarura isura nziza y’itorero inkuru nziza kanamuugire elijah wambaye lunette pastor bazatsinda fred umuyobozi wungirije kigali ufite mikoro ev gikundiro rwamigabo james ushinzwe ivugabutumwa ntara kigali

title: mwakoze ibitangaza- umugenzuzi w’imari abwira bnr yagaruje miliyari zambuwe
content: umugenzuzi mukuru w’imari leta obadiah biraro yashimye banki nkuru y’u rwanda yabashije kugaruza miliyari frw zambuwe ibigo by’imari biciriritse sacco mwakoze igitangaza izi miliyari frw zabuze zirimo amafaranga yibwe abayobozi nzego z’ibanze bitije banyereje ndetse n’izo abantu bambuye bigo by’imari biciriritse birimo gahunda umurenge sacco iki kibazo cyagarutsweho nama y’igihugu y’umushyikirano perezida paul kagame agasaba hashyirwa ingufu kugaruza mafaranga kugira biriya bigo bibone amafaranga kuzamura imibere y’abatishoboye nk’uko ntego byashyiriweho iki gitekerezo mafaranga muri nzeri banki nkuru y’u rwanda yatangaje hari hamaze kugaruzwa miliyari frw uyu munsi biganiro byateguwe n’iyi banki bigaragaza agaciro k’ifaranga n’ubukungu by’u rwanda bihagaze title: nyagatare kurya inyama bimusaba kugurisha ibiro by’ibishyimbo
content: aba baturage batanga urugero biciro by’inyama byazamutse cyane buryo umuturage uhinga ibishyimbo bimusaba kugurisha nibura ibiro by’ibishyimbo kugira ashobore kugura ikiro kimwe cy’inyama rutikanga murenge gatunda karere nyagatare yagize nk’inyama ukuzivaho ubundi twazicwa n’inzara uyu muturage yatanze urugero umufuka w’ibiro by’ibishyimbo uhwanye n’ibiro by’inyama si abatuye duce tw’icyaro gusa karere nyagatare bafite kibazo kuko mujyi nyagatare ikiro cy’inyama kigura amafaranga gihe ikiro cy’ibishyimbo bagihaha mafaranga bisobanura uguze ikiro cy’inyama yigomwe ibiro by’ibishyimbo rudahunga ladislas umwe bagize cooperative y’abacuruzi b’inyama mujyi nyagatare yavuze zamuka ry’ibiciro by’inyama ridaterwa kwifuza kunguka menshi ahubwo inka ziyongereye agaciro bityo bakaba bakoreraga gihombo rudahunga akomeza avuga kwiyongera kw’igiciro cy’inyama byatumye abaguzi bagabanuka nubwo kibazo bafite kuko ikigamijwe inyungu atari ugucuruza byinshi safari francis ushinzwe ubworozi murenge nyagatare avuga bacuruzi bajya kongera igiciro babanje kubijyaho inama n’ubuyobozi bukabibemerera kuko igiciro cy’inka cyazamutse niyonzima oswald

title: umuyobozi w’ikinyamakuru rushyashya burasa jean gaulbert yitabye imana
content: kuri gicurasi nibwo hamenyekanye inkuru y’ akababaro ivuga umuyobozi w’ikinyamakuru rushyashya burasa jean gaulbert yitabye imana aguye king faisal hospital uyu mugabo umaze imyaka myinshi mwuga w’ itangazamakuru rwanda yitabye imana bitaro byitiriwe umwami faisal arwariye guhera mpera mata yazize guturika k’udutsi tw’ubwonko stroke burasa jean gaulbert umuntu ugira igitsure kitarimo ubugome nzika yagiraga mwahuraga mwagiranye ikibazo mukakiganiraho byabaga birangiye yari umuntu ukunda iterambere ry’ igihugu burasa jean gualbert yatangiye itangazamakuru mbere jenoside yakorewe abatutsi akorera ikinyamakuru rwanda rushya cyari kiyobowe andr kameya nyirarume burasa bantu inkotanyi zarokoreye st paul akora radiyo muhabura y’inkotanyi nyuma jenoside ajya radiyo rwanda ariho yavuye ajya kuyobora rushyashya yakomotse rwanda rushya burasa asize umugore n’abana batatu stroke’ indwara y’udutsi dukwirakwiza amaraso bwonko duturika bitewe n’umubyimba watwo utabasha kwakira ingano y’amaraso acamo bigatuma yivanga n’ubwonko hemorrhagic stroke cyangwa tukaziba bitewe kuvura kwayo bigatuma adatemberamo bikwiye igice cyatwo atageramo kikangirika imana imuhe iruko ridashira ruhumuriza richard muhaburarw

title: ubukerarugendo isura nshya i kigali kubera imodoka zoroshya kuyizenguruka amafoto
content: bitewe n’imiterere n’uburyo bukoreshwa ngendo ariko ntibyari byoroshye gusura byiza nayo mpamvu hazanywe imodoka nini izajya ifasha mukerarugendo baturutse mahanga ndetse n’abanyarwanda bifuza kumenya byinshi mujyi wabo kuri kane nibwo modoka zifite imyanya igerekeranye double decker yatangiye gukora ingendo zizenguruka umujyi kigali gikorwa cyatangijwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe iterambere rdb bufatanye sosiyete kigali city tour nayo nyiri mushinga umuyobozi mukuru rdb ushinzwe ubukerarugendo belise kariza yagaragaje kimwe bintu byaburaga bukerarugendo bw’u rwanda imodoka zitembereza abantu mujyi by’umwihariko igihe hari itsinda ry’abashyitsi rwego hejuru bifuza kumenya byimbitse kigali ati izi modoka zizatanga umusanzu byiciro byinshi kimwe uguteza imbere ubukerarugendo mujyi kigali ikindi ukwigisha by’umwihariko urubyiruko kubera amateka yacu benshi twe ntitwavukiye rwanda modoka izaha urubyiruko urubuga kwiga gutembera umujyi ibi kandi yabihurijeho n’umuyobozi w’akarere nyarugenge kayisime nzaramba wavuze ubukerarugendo kimwe bintu umujyi kigali ushyizemo imbaraga kandi nubwo u rwanda rwakira mukerarugendo b’abanyamahanga bagera miliyoni mwaka umubare ukiri muto ugereranyije n’ibindi bihugu yakomeje avuga ariyo mpamvu u rwanda rugikeneye gushyira imbaraga nyinshi kongera umubare w’abakora ubukerarugengo abanyamahanga n’abanyarwanda modoka zikaba zije kurushaho gushyira rundi rwego ibirebana uburyo bukoreshwa kubatembereza umuyobozi kigali city tour munyandamutsa augustin yavuze modoka yahawe izina sightseeing bus’ ifite imyanya bakaba baratekereje kuzizana rwanda nk’uburyo kongera ibikorwa mukerarugendo bashobora gukora igihe basuye kigali uwayo honorine ushinzwe kuyobora mukerarugendo kigali city tour yabwiye igihe modoka zizatuma
