title: sitting volleyball ikipe y’igihugu yatangiye kwitegura imikino nyafurika izabera i kigali
content: iyi mikino izitabirwa n’amakipe y’ibihugu biri munsi y’ubutayu sahara izatangira tariki ugushyingo uretse u rwanda ruzakira mikino andi makipe azaryitabira harimo burundi cameroon drc kenya namibia nigeria tanzania uganda zambia nk’uko bitangazwa bizimana dominique umuyobozi w’ishyirahamawe ry’imikino y’abamugaye rwanda npc akaba n’umukinnyi abakinnyi bameze neza kandi n’umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu w’umuholandi peter karreman yaraye ageze rwanda gusa dominique bizimana giti cye ufite akabazo kirenge gusa yizeye gukira vuba akazakina amarushanwa uretse guhatanira igikombe abakinnyi bazaba banashaka itike kuzakina imikino olympique izabera i londres bwongereza kwezi karindwi umwaka utaha abakinnyi bahamagawe bakaba banatangiye imyitozo bizimana dominique rutikanga james ngirinshuti eric ntagawa charles murema jean baptiste tuyishime vincent twagirayezu callixte hirwa danny vuningabo emile kuramba prosper ngizwenimana jean bosco ntawiha fidele gahamanyi jean baptiste kugeza makipe y’u rwanda mikino itandukanye hamaze kuboneka amatike abiri gusa afitwe muvunyi hermas ukina sitting volleyball adrien niyonshuti ukina umukino gusiganwa magare thoneste nisingizwe

title: leta yubakiye abakene ikora abana bazashobore kwiyubakira
content: umudugudu etage wubakiwe abatishoboye karere nyamagabemu turere dutandukanye tw’u rwanda hagaragara imidugudu yubakirwa abatishoboye ni imidugudu intwara leta amafaranga atari make abayituyemo akanyamuneza kaba kose kuko leta iba ibubakiye amazu meza nyamara kwiyubakira byari byarabananiye umudugudu etage wubakiwe abatishoboye karere nyamagabe mu turere dutandukanye tw’u rwanda hagaragara imidugudu yubakirwa abatishoboye ni imidugudu intwara leta amafaranga atari make abayituyemo akanyamuneza kaba kose kuko leta iba ibubakiye amazu meza nyamara kwiyubakira byari byarabananiye bamwe bayobozi b’intara y’amajyepfo baganiriye ukwezi bavuga gukora bashoboye kugira abana bavuka miryango yarananiwe kwiyubakira bazashobore kwiyubakira icyizere kubaho batuzwa midugudu kirazamuka mukeshimana jacqueline umwe batujwe mudugudu etaje murenge tare karere nyamagabe avuga yimukira mudugudu ubwa mbere ageze etaje ngo nubwo leta yabubakiye arabizi umuturage ariwe ufite inshingano y’ibanze kwiyubakira ati natagiye guhinga imboga amafaranga nzabonamo nzayakoramo imishinga ibyara inyungu niteze imbere kuko nari kuzayubakisha none leta yaratwukiye nyiransabimana mariya atuye amazu yabomaguritse ibiti byanamye ariko twageze nzu nziza tubona ducanira tubona amazi meza rwose tumerewe neza avuga iterambere nk’iri atari aryiteze ahubwo yahoranaga impungenge inzu n’imugwaho atazashobora kwiyubakira umukobwa witwa umuhoza betty w’umwe miryango yatujwe mudugudu w’ ikitegererezo avuga ahantu batuye hari habi cyane buryo yagiraga isoni kuba inshuti yahamusura ati hari hahandi wanagira ibirori ukavuga uti ese nzicazahe abantu ahantu twari dutuye ntiwabonaga ucaginga telefone nyirarukundo ignatienne umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ ubutegetsi bw’igihugu ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage avuga kubakira abakene bitabashimisha nk’uko ubwabo bakwiyubakira ngo leta ikwiye guha abakene imirimo bakiyubakira kuko aribwo bumva bafite ishema ry’inzu barimo abayobozi b’uturere baganiriye ukwezi bavuga bakora kugira abana bavuka miryango ikennye iba yahawe amazu bazabashe kwiyubakira ukubashishikariza kwiga gufasha imiryango bavukamo kwirinda amakimbirane umuyobozi w’akarere gisagara rutaburingoga jerome avuga bafite gahunda ikomatanyije kuzamura imiryango ikennye cyane muri gahunda n’abana bavuka miryango bitabwaho agira umuryango ntabwo tuwureba nk’umugabo gusa dufashije umugabo tumureba buryo bugari umugabo umugore n’abana niyo mpamvu gahunda y’ubufasha bukomatanyije harimo kwigisha abana bivuze bukene turabibarira mugabo yakora tukabara bana bakora harimo kureba abana kureba umugore kureba imibanire dukemura amakimbirane harimo abantu bakena kubera babanye nabi nabyo duhita tubyinjizamo umuyobozi w’ akarere kamonyi kayitesi alice avuga nk’akarere bakora kugira umwana wavutse miryango ikennye akarere kaba kubakiye azabashe kwiyubakira ukumuha amahirwe kwiga ati kubakira umuryango ukennye nk’intangiro umuryango uba uhawe abana b’abanyarwanda igishoro bahabwa kirushije ibindi ugushyirwa mashuri bakiga kandi amashuri ubuntu bana ahantu twubaka imidugudu n’ubundi amashuri icya mbere tubamarira nk’akarere ukubashishikariza kubakundisha ishuri abasesenguzi babivugaho umwarimu wigisha ishuri ryisumbuye ryo murenge kansi karere gisagara avuga abana bavuka miryango ikennye yubakiwe leta barimo kwiga bitamuha amahirwe kuzagira ubushobozi kwiyubakira ati biragoye umwana wazamukiye nine twelve arangiza kaminuza ashobora kubona akazi aziyubakire inzu leta yafasha bana cyane ukubafasha bakarangiza secondaire abafite amanota menshi bagakomeza kaminuza abafite amanota make bajyanwa mashuri y’imwuga kuko niho azarangiza akabona ikiraka cyangwa agahanga akazi akabona amafaranga akabasha kuzamura inzu umunyamakuru akaba n’umusesenguzi mibereho y’abaturage umutesi scovia aganira ukwezi yabwiye abana bavuka miryango ikennye yubakiwe leta umwana akiri muto afite amahirwe kuzatera imbere akiyubakira ati kuri baturage batishoboye batuzwa midugudu kuko mwana afite amahirwe kwiga rwanda ishingiro ry’ubuzima bw’umuntu rishingiye kwiga aziga sinshaka kuvuga amasomo runaka mwana mudugudu muryango ukennye ufashwa wubakiwe ashobora kuba umuntu udasanzwe ashobora kuba umutegetsi ukomeye kuko umwana produit ishobora kubyara ikintu aricyo cyose akomeza agira mu myaka itaha dushobora gusanga uwiswe intwari umuntu ukomoka bantu biswe abakuwe manegeka abamugariye rugamba abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka ngo byose igishobora gutuma bishoboka abana bavuka miryango ikennye bajya ishuri bakiga

title: kamonyi urwego rw’umuvunyi rwibukije ruswa icyaha kidasaza kandi kigira ingaruka mbi
content: umurungi emeline umukozi w’urwego rw’umuvunyi wifatanije n’abanyakamonyi gusoza ukwezi kwahariwe kurwanya ruswa n’akarengane ukuboza yibukije abari bateraniye mugina ahanabereye umukino w’umupira w’amaguru ruswa mbi ibyaha byayo bidasaza igira ingaruka muntu umuryango n’igihugu ibyiza ukuyirinda ukayigendera kure unagira uruhare mukuyitangaho amakuru umurungi kiganiro kurwanya ruswa n’akarengane yahaye abitabiriye gikorwa nyuma y’igice cyambere cy’umukino w’umupira w’amaguru warimo uhuza umurenge runda mugina yasabye buri wese kurwanya ruswa abigira ibye atari urugamba rw’umwe cyangwa urwego rumwe yibukije ibihano ruswa byazamuwe ndetse igashyirwa byaha bidasaza yagize ruswa icyorezo kandi koko irahari ntabwo twahagarara tuvuge idahari ariko none kuyirwanya birashoboka ntabwo urugamba rwatsindwa n’urwego rumwe ntabwo abantu runaka bashobora kurwana urwo rugamba barutsinde bisaba ubufatanye twese akomeza avuga kuyirwanya bisaba buri wese yitandukanya nayo n’abayigenderamo ahubwo agatanga amakuru kandi gihe bityo ingamba zigafatwa igakumirwa guhanwa bagahanwa akomeza ibihano ruswa byarakajijwe kuko ntabwo bikiri ibihano byoroshye icyambere ruswa yabaye icyaha kidasaza mbere umuntu yatangaga ruswa cyangwa yayakira yakatirwa agatoroka ubucamanza cyangwa ubutabera akagenda adakoze igihano yahawe cyangwa adakurikiranyweho ruswa nyuma y’igihe runaka kubera ubuzime gusaza kw’icyaha nyuma y’imyaka itanu akagaruka akaba adashobora gukurikiranwaho cyaha ariko ng’ubu icyaha kidasaza kuko icyaha cy’ubugome uzagikora nyuma y’imyaka nufatwa cyangwa numenyekana ukurikiranwe amategeko abiteganya umurungi yakomeje yibutsa abaturage ruswa idindiza iterambere igihugu irimo kitagira iterambere mutekano igira ingaruka muntu giti cye ikagira ingaruka muryango n’igihugu rusange yasabye buri wese kwitandukanya nayo n’uwo ariwe wese uyigenderamo tuyizere thadee umuyobozi w’akarere kamonyi wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu yabwiye abaturage kurwanya ruswa bisaba ubufatanye bisaba gutanga amakuru kandi agatangirwa gihe urugamba buri wese ahamagariwe ati ntabwo ushobora kugera iterambere rirambye hari ruswa hari akarengane hari imvugo tugira dufatanya n’inzego z’umutekano tugira tuti tugire umutekano buri wese abe ijisho mugenzi dukumira icyaha kitaraba dutangira amakuru gihe kandi vuba amakuru ngombwa kugira dukumire ibijyanye ruswa ibijyanye n’akarengane icyo tubifuriza ugukoresha mahirwe twahawe kugira kamonyi izire ruswa izire akarengane ibyo bimara gucika n’imihigo tuzayesa mu gusoza uku kwezi kwahariwe kurwanya ruswa n’akarengane karere kamonyi byanyujijwe mikino hagamijwe guha abaturage ibyishimo kubakururira kuza kumva ubutumwa bubashishikariza gukumira kurwanya ruswa hakinwe umupira w’amaguru imivugo n’indirimbo kandi abarushije abandi babihembewe mu mukino w’umupira w’amaguru wahuje umurenge runda mugina ikipe y’umurenge runda yatsinze iya mugina ibitego bitatu busa iyabaye iya gatu ikipe y’umurenge gacurabwenge iya kane iba iya rukoma ikipe runda yabaye iya mbere yahembwe igikombe n’imyambaro gukinana hamwe n’ibihumbi magana abiri iya kabiri ihembwa imyenda n’amafaranga ibihumbi ijana mirongo itanu iya gatatu ihembwa imyenda n’ibihumbi ijana gihe iya kane yahembwe ibihumbi mirongo itanu abarwa mafaranga y’u rwanda munyaneza theogene intyozacom

title: umuhanzi fulgence nzira kugaruka ruhando rw’umuziki
content: mu kiganiro cyihariye twagiranye yadutangarije amafaranga amaze iminsi akorera kongo-kinshasa azamufasha gusohora indirimbo sitidiyo mu ikubitiro arashaka gukorana lick lick cyangwa masota indirimbo nyampinga ntibishoboka minsi vuba akomeza avuga azanye umuziki w’umwimerere njyana afrobeat idasondetse uzamuhesha itike guhiga abahanzi bakunzwe minsi kamichi kitoko king james knowless yadutangarije n’ubwo atagaragaraga ruhando rw’umuziki amaze iminsi akora indirimbo z’ibigo n’amasosiyete zamuhaga amafaranga atari make ku mpamvu zatumye ava ruhando rw’umuziki gihe gisaga imyaka ibiri avuga mwaka mafaranga muziki none abona abanyarwanda batangiye gukunda umuziki yagize icyanshimisha ugushimisha abakunzi banjye nanjye nkagira mbona birababaje kujya scene ukaririmba ugashishimisha abantu ejo ukaba usaba ababyeyi tike fulgence afite indoto gukora umuziki akamenyekana rwego mpuzamahanga kandi ukamuteza imbere fulgence amaze ibyumweru bitatu gihugu kongo-kinshasa yakoraga ikiraka kuririmba komisiyo y’amatora ifatanyije n’ishami loni rikorerayo nk’uko abivuga kiraka cyari icya meddy wamenyekanye cyane i goma kubera indirimbo amayobera ariko bw’amahirwe meddy yarabuze fulgence akibonye gutyo nshimiyimana leonard

title: ibiribwa bitumizwa karere biri bituma ifaranga ry’u rwanda rikomeza guta agaciro
content: mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kabiri nyuma kugeza raporo y’ingengo y’imari yakoreshejwe umwaka ushize imbere y’inama y’abaminisitiri john rwangombwa yavuze ibituruka hanze bikomeza gutuma ibintu rwanda bizamba asubiza ikibazo abajijwe bantu benshi bakomeza kwibaza uburyo litiro lisansi hagabanutseho amafaranga ariko ibiciro bigakomeza kuzamuka yasubije n’ubwo lisansi yagabanyutse ariko ifaranga ryo ritigeze rireka guta agaciro ati ibiribwa bitumizwa hanze nko kenya bigira uruhare izamuka ry’ibiciro guta agaciro kw’ifaranga ryacu kuko nabyo biba byaguzwe mafaranga atagifite agaciro yagaragaje ingero z’uburyo u rwanda rufite ifaranga rikigerageza kugira agaciro karere n’ubwo umwaka ushize guta agaciro ifaranga ry’u rwanda byari uku kwezi bikaba bigeze nyuma y’u rwanda kenya nicyo gihugu kigerageza aka karere kuko ifaranga ryacyo ryataye agaciro kugeza hejuru muri kiganiro kizajya kibaho buri gihe minisitiri w’imari amaze gushyikiriza raporo inama y’abaminisitiri rwangombwa yasobanuye u rwanda rwabonye amafaranga angana miliyari ugereranyije miliyari rwabonye mwaka kuba mafaranga yariyongeryeho byaturutse bikorerwa imbere gihugu byatanze amafaranga y’u rwanda miliyari zingana y’inyungu miliyari z’ayaturutse hanze zingana by’inyungu emmanuel hitimana

title: scholastique mukasonga yasohoye igitabo kivuga kibogo wafatwaga nk’umukiza w’abanyarwanda
content: mbere y’uko abamisiyoneri bazana inkuru nziza yezu i rwanda bivugwa kibogo wafatwaga nkuko abakristu bafata yezu scholastique mukasonga umwanditsi w’umunyarwanda abakunda gusoma ibitabo n’abakurikiranira ibijyanye sinema bibuka filimi notre dame du nil ishingiye gitabo cye yasohotse gashyantare igitabo mukasonga ’ kibogo est mont au ciel’gifite paji cyasohowe n’inzu isohora ibitabo bufaransa ditions gallimard ni ubwoko bw’ibitabo by’inkuru ndende mpimbano cyangwa se roman novel ugendeye mateka kibogo uvugwa mateka y’u rwanda wumva igitabo kigaragaza imyemerere cyangwa ibisa n’ibyo abanyamadini bigisha yezu hari uwari uhari kandi abifite mbere agace gasa gutera amatsiko yashyize rubuga gallimard kabaza uwaba yaragiye ijuru hagati kibogo w’i rwanda yezu yita uw’abamisiyoneri ndetse nyuma kujya ijuru akagirira abantu ineza ati ari kibogo umuhungu w’umwami yezu w’abamisiyoneri nde wazamutse ijuru wongeye kugusha imvura agakiza abantu amapfa n’inzara akomeza yibaza abantu bakwiye kwizera inkuru cyangwa imigani baciriwe n’abera kurusha kwizera babwiye n’ababyeyi amanywa n’ijoro ati ese birakwiye twakwizera imigani twaciriwe n’abagabo b’abera b’ubwanwa burebure cyangwa twakwemera ababyeyi bacu baducira buri mugoroba igitabo cyitwa le rwanda ancien cyanditswe de lacger rupapuro kugeza kigaragaza mbere y’umwaduko w’ubukirisitu rwanda hari imyizerere gakondo idafite itandukaniye n’ubukirisitu ndetse ikaba ifite akarusho kuba ishingiye muco gakondo w’abanyarwanda ayo makuru yemeza rwanda hahoze inkuru nziza y’umukiza umutabazi kibogo yaje guteshwa agaciro n’inkuru nziza y’umukiza umutabazi yezu yazanywe n’abakoloni mu rwanda kera umutabazi umuntu wemeraga gutanga amaraso bushake akameneka butaka bw’umwanzi bigatuma umwica cyangwa amenekeye gihugu atsindwa ibi byaba byaratangiwe kibogo izina ry’ikinyarwanda rikomoka nshinga kubogora ihwanye n’iyo gifaransa bita sauver redresser cyangwa se gutabara’ igitekerezonkomoko cyumutabazi kibogo rwanda mu mateka y’u rwanda dutangira kumva iby’umutabazi mbere mugani w’ibimanuka gice cy’umugani uvanze n’igitekerezo lacger yanditse agira ubwo kigwa n’umuvandimwe mututsi mushiki wabo nyampundu bacibwaga ijuru bitewe n’icyaha nyina wamennye ibanga ry’imana bururukiye mubali bavuye ijuru bagera mubali bibonye bambaye ubusa bakennye hashize iminsi icumi bafite agahinda gakabije bafite inzara ibyuma n’amasuka bati imana itwoherereje byose ngo gihe bahinze batihingishije muri ako karere bamanukiyemo hari hatuye imiryango itatu abasinga abazigaba n’abatwa ishyamba abo bantu barakomotse ijuru sekuruza barirukanywe bitewe n’icyaha bahakoreye kubera batari barigeze basaba imana imbabazi cyatumye ibarekera butindi n’ubukene abo baje nyuma nibo babatungishije ubwo kibogo yicwaga n’abagome title: akarere rubavu karishimira ibikorwa by’amajyambere kagezeho
content: mu bikorwa byamuritswe harimo umuhanda uhuza imipaka yombi y’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo grande et petite barierre ukazatwara akayabo k’amafaranga akabakaba miliyoni ndetse n’ umuhanda pave ujya biro by’akarere watangiye gukorwa munsi umuyobozi w’akarere sheh bahame hassan yavuze akarere kabwiye rwiyemezamirimo imodoka zikora mihanda zitazasubirayo utugari tutazikoresheje dusane uduhanda tujya hasuwe kandi umusozi wimuweho imiryango kubera ikibazo cy’isuri yicaga abahatuye gihe cy’imvura uyu musozi murenge gisenyi guterwamo ibiti binyuranye bifata ubutaka hakazubakwamo uduhanda intebe n’ibitare kuruhukiramo mukerarugendo iki gikorwa kizatwara amafaranga miliyoni bavuye musozi ubuyobozi b’akarere rubavu bwasuye akagari karukogo umurenge rubavu birebera ibikorwa ndengera foundation uyu muryango wubatse amasoko y’amazi agemurira abaturage amazi meza ndetse n’ibitaro kijyambere umuyobozi w’akarere yasabye umuyobozi ndengera foundation gufatanya n’akarere bakareba masoko y’amazi yakwaguka abaturage benshi bakavomaho abayobozi banagejejwe ahari kubakwa amashanyarazi ako kagali jean berchmas bahige ukuriye ewsa rubavu yasobanuye mashanyarazi azagera baturage tugali twa byahi kanembwe karukogo ibarizwa mirenge rubavu cyanzarwe bahige yashimangiye mashanyarazi afite ingufu zihagije zizafasha abaturage kwivana bukene bahige yagize mushinga wizwe neza ibikoresho byose birahari igikorwa cyose gikoreshwa n’amashanyarazi kizahakora kirahari mpungenge hasuwe n’isoko ryo ako kagali ariko rizatangira gukorerwamo mutarama nyuma y’ubunani uru rugendo rwasorejwe isoko kijyambere ry’akarere rubavu riri kubakwa mujyi rwagati murenge gisenyi imirimo kubaka soko iracyari hasi ariko irimo kwihutishwa kugira rizatangire gukoreshwa aho riri isoko risanzwe rikorera hazazamurwa irindi gorofa hanubakwe imodoka zihagarara asoza gikorwa umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheh bahame hassan yibukije inshingano buri wese kurinda gukoresha neza ibikorwa remezo gihe bizaba byuzuye bahame yagize ibikorwa nk’ibi iby’umuturage turifuza buri wese agira uruhare kubibungabunga kubikoresha kuko uburenganzira bweumwe baturage utuye kagari karukogo seth mugema asanga amajyambere kwihuta abagana buryo yiteguye gutangiza umushinga iwabo cyaro nogosha imisatsi mujyi none kubera batuzaniye amashanyarazi ngiye kwimurira salon yanjye karukogo nk’uko byagaragaye akarere rubavu kari kwihutisha ibikorwa remezo bijyanye n’icyerekezo ariko cyane cyane hubakwa imihanda ariko inzira ikiri ndende akarere karateganya kuganira n’abafite amazu mujyi rwego kubafasha kwihutisha bikorwa bakihutisha iterambere aka karere pascaline umulisa

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: igihembwe cy’ihinga a kizagira imvura ihagije rusange twahirwa antoine
content: iyi mvura izagwa buryo buhagije gihe cy’amezi nk’uko isesengura ry’ibipimo byakozwe service y’ubumenyi bw’ikirere ryabyerekanye gusa turere tumwe tumwe imvura izagwa ariko igende igabanuka ibihe bizagenda bishira tumwe turere tuzabonekamo imvura nyinshi kurusha utundi cyane turere tw’imisozi miremire cyane majyaruguru n’igice kimwe cy’intara y’iburengerazuba ibi bikaba byaratangajwe itandukanye tumwe turere tuzagwamo imvura ihagije ariko ikazagenda igabanuka izagenda igwaharimo rusizi nyamasheke karongi rutsiro rubavu nyagatare ngoma kirehe rwamagana gatsibo kayonza bugesera gasabo kicukiro nyarugenge ndetse gisagara twinshi utu turere tukaba utw’intara y’iburasirazuba kubera imiterere yayo gusa iteganyagihe risesengura ibipimo by’imvura bafite hanyuma bakabigeza minisiteri ifite ubuhinzi n’ubworozi nshingano zayo nayo igira abahinzi inama y’ibyo bahinga bitewe n’ibihe by’imvura biriho kugeza ntara zitandukanye ubuhinzi bukaba bwaritabiriwe buryo bushimishije guhinga vuba kuko agace k’uburasirazuba imvura ikunze gucika mbere ako gace nk’uko musabyimana yabitangaje safari viateur

title: aebr yimitse umuvugizi mukuru asabwa kurwanya abahanuza inda n’abatukisha itorero ry’imana
content: ishyirahamwe ry’amatorero y’ababatisita rwanda aebr ryimitse umuvugizi waryo mukuru rev ndagijimana emmanuel ahabwa impanuro zirimo gusigasira ubusugire bw’itorero yirinda icyatukisha itorero ry’imana kiva kikagera ishyirahamwe ry’amatorero y’ababatisita rwanda aebr ryimitse umuvugizi waryo mukuru rev ndagijimana emmanuel ahabwa impanuro zirimo gusigasira ubusugire bw’itorero yirinda icyatukisha itorero ry’imana kiva kikagera uyu muhango wabaye cyumweru tariki ukwakira birori byitabiriwe n’imbaga y’abakirisitu baturutse matorero anyuranye umuvugizi mushya aebr mukuru rev ndagijimana emmanuel ahawe nshingano asimbuye rev dr gato corneille munyamasoko umaze imyaka mwanya umuhango kwimika rev ndagijimana emmanuel nk’umuvugizi mushya kumushyikiriza inkoni n’intebe by’ubushumba wabanjirijwe n’inyigisho yatanzwe bishop john rucyahana yananyuzagamo agaha impanuro uwahawe inshingano nshya rev ndagijimana emmanuel wabaye umuvugiz mukuru agiye gushyikirizwa inkoni y’ubushumba rev dr gato munyamasoko mwanya bishop rucyahana yibukije rev ndagijimana agiye kuyobora itorero riri gihugu kiri gukira ibikomeye byatewe n’amateka mabi cyanyuzemo birimo jenocide yakorewe abatutsi amusaba gukomeza kubafasha komora ibikomere binyuze mbaraga z’imana ati emmanuel uyoboye itorero riri gihugu kirimo gikira ibikomwere byatewena jenocide yakorewe abatutsi urayiobora itorero ririmo rikira inzzangano u rwanda rwarozwe n’abaruroze abantu bakicana abagabo bakica abana n’abagore babontimukagendere hejuru y’ibishanga mwibwira kaburimbo iyi myuka mibi yaje rwanda inshingano zawe ugiye gufata haguruka wambare imbaraga uhoshe mizimu izina yesu bishopjohn rucyahana niwe wigishije ijambo ry’imana bishop rucyahana kandi yaboneyeho gusaba umuvugizi mushya gusuzuma ibitukisha ijambo ry’imana akabisanga akabirwanya izina yesu ati ibyo goriath ndagusaba kubisanga ukabirwanya izina yesuntukagende izina ryawe emmanuel ca bugufi umenye intambara urwana atrari iyawe ahubwo ugende izina ry’imana ndagusabye ujyane umuhumetso w’ijambo ry’imana yanibukije kandi wahawe inshingano nshya mubyo akwiye guhagurukira itorero harimo kurwanya abiyita abahanuzi aribo koko ahubwo ababa bashaka amaramuko yagize haguruka ukore imana ishaka nturwane n’impano z’abakirisitu bawe cyangwa z’abayobozi muzakorana ahubwo uzifumbire uzikuze ubasengere abayoba ubayobore ubereke inzira harimo abahanuza inda badahanujwe n’umwuka w’imana abo ujye ubacyaha izina yesu yavuze itorero ry’imana riri kurushgaho kugenda ryangwa kubera bimwe bikorwa bigayitse bikorwa n’abiyita abakozi b’imana rev dr gato munyamasoko wasimbuwe rev ndagijimana buyobozi bw’itorero aebr yahaga mugenzi umusimbuye inkoni y’umuvugizi mukuru aebr yamusabye kuzatanga mahoro inkoni y’umuvugizi amuhaye nk’uko yabiharaniye akaba ayitanze mahoro mu kiganiro n’itangazamakuru nyuma y’umuhango kumwimika mugaragaro nk’umuvugizi aebr rev ndagijimana emmanuel yavuze icya mbere azzakora ugushyira imbaraga murimo w’itorero rigakomeza kugera murimo yesu mu bitabiriye muhango harimo kangwagye justus ushinzwe imitwe politiki n’imiryango itari iya leta rgb n’umuyobozi mukuru rev pastor ephrem karuranga umuvugizi mukuru adepr rev dr bashaka faustin wabayeho umuvugizi aebr nyuma akaza gutangiza itorero rye rev dr samuel rugambage umunyamabanga mukuru cpr n’abandi benshi batandukanye rev ndagijimana emmanuel arahirira inshingano yahawe kuba umuvugizi mukuru aebr

title: musanze umukobwa n’umuhungu bafatanwe amafaranga y’amiganano
content: polisi y’u rwanda ikomeje kugira inama abacuruzi n’abandi bantu kujya bashishoza gihe bavunja cyangwa bakiriye amafaranga bakabanza kureba mafaranga yuzuje ubuziranenge kuri mbere tariki gashyantare masaha saa sita z’ijoro polisi y’u rwanda ikorera karere musanze murenge kimonyi bufatanye n’izindi nzego z’umutekano bafashe murwanashyaka faustin w’imyaka uwingeneye solange w’imyaka bafite amafaranga y’u rwanda y’amiganano ibihumbi frw umuyobozi polisi karere musanze superitendent of policesp gaspard rwegeranya avuga bafashwe bagiye kuyaha umukozi sosiyete y’itumanaho ucuruza serivisi kubitsa kubikuza koherereza abantu amafaranga bari bagiye kumusaba ayababikire konti zabo telefoni ayagenzuye asanga amiganano ahita atanga amakuru sp rwegeranya yagize aba bombi bazanye amafaranga ibihumbi frw mucuruzi sosiyete y’itumanaho ababikire mafaranga mucuruzi ayarebye neza asanga bihumbi ibihumbi amiganano ibihumbi ariyo mazima niko guhita yihutira gutanga amakuru barafatwa umuyobozi polisi karere musanze yashimiye mucuruzi watanze amakuru gihe akangurira abaturage kujya bihutira gutanga amakuru k’uwo ariwe wese bacyetseho amafaranga y’amiganano kuko agira ingaruka k’ubukungu bw’igihugu yagize amafaranga nk’aya atesha agaciro ifaranga ry’igihugu kandi akanateza igihombo abayahawe niyo mpamvu akwiye kwamaganwa buri wese yakomeje agira inama abacuruzi abatarabona ubushobozi kugura imashini itahura amafaranga y’amiganano bakwiye kujya babanza bagasuzuma neza inoti nshya zose bahawe mbere y’uko uzibahaye agenda kugira barebe zujuje ubuziranenge basanga zifite ikibazo bakihutira kumenyesha polisi cyangwa izindi nzego zibegereye abafashwe polisi yahise ibashyikiriza urwego rw’igihugu rw’ubugenzacya rib ikorera sitasiyo polisi cyuve kugira bakurikiranwe ingingo y’itegeko no ryo riteganya ibyaha n’ibihano rusange ivuga umuntu wese bw’uburiganya wigana uhindura amafaranga y’ibiceri cyangwa inoti akoreshwa rwanda cyangwa mahanga ibyakwitiranywa nayo impapuro zifite agaciro k’amafaranga y’igihugu zashyizweho umukono n’inzego zibifitiye ububasha ziriho tembure yayo cyangwa ikirango cyayo cyangwa izindi mpapuro zikoreshwa rwanda cyangwa mahanga uzana cyangwa ukwiza rwanda mpapuro n’izo noti azi ziganywe cyangwa zahinduwe akoze icyaha iyo abihamijwe n’urukiko ahanishwa igifungo kitari munsi y’imyaka itanu ariko kitarenze imyaka irindwi chief editor muhaburarw

title: byinshi wamenya mikino olimpiki imaze kwigarurira imitima benshi
content: mu ibendera rigizwe n’ibara ry’ubururu icyatsi kibisi umukara umweru umuhondo ndetse n’umutuku nicyo kirango cy’amarushanwa y’imikino izwi mubumbe dutuyenubwo mikino imaze kwigarurira imitima benshi si hari byinshi abantu bataramenya birimo n’inkomoko zayo mu ibendera rigizwe n’ibara ry’ubururu icyatsi kibisi umukara umweru umuhondo ndetse n’umutuku nicyo kirango cy’amarushanwa y’imikino izwi mubumbe dutuyenubwo mikino imaze kwigarurira imitima benshi si hari byinshi abantu bataramenya birimo n’inkomoko zayo iki kimenyetso cy’aya mabara yometswe mwenda w’igitare ashushanya imigabane itanu yitabira marushanwa itandatu igize isi gusa nanone wakwirengagiza mabara atandatu agaragara mabendera y’ibihugu bitandukanye biri isi ku ikubitiro sinabura kukubwira mikino iba buri myaka ine yitabirwa n’ibihugu birenga kuva kinyejana kugera marushanwa aracyaba ucyumva ushobora kuba wibajije impamvu yatumye maruyshanwa akizihizwa kugera imbaraga ziyihishe inyuma ndetse n’uko yatangiye nturambirwe byose birasobanuka kugira mikino igere rwego iriho magingo byatangiriye mikino yaberega gace kitwaga olympia bugiriki kera guhera kinyejana mbere y’ivuka yezu krisitu kugera kinyejana nyuma y’urupfu rw’uwo mucunguzi n’ubwo abanyamateka batabyumva kimwe kuko bamwe bavuga mikino yaba yaratangiye mbere y’iki gihe kivugwa iyi mikino yakinwaga rwego guha icyubahiro imana bugiriki yitwaga zeus ihagarariye izindi mana zose athena hera ndetse n’izindi mana zari gihugu ubwo mikino yakinwaga mbere umutetsi witwaga coroebus niwe wahigitse abandi isiganwa metero icyo gihe gusiganwa birenge niwo mukino ugize marushanwa n’ubwo nyuma y’imyaka mike indi mikino nk’iteramakofe koga gusiganwa binyabiziga kumasha gukirana byagiye byongerwamo ubugiriki ntibwagize amahirwe gukomeza guhirwa mikino kuko nyuma y’ibinyejana byonyine bwami bwafashwe n’abaromani mikino imaze kubaka izina iba icwekereye ityo ndetse n’ikibumbano zeus nticyasigaye amahoro kuko cyamenaguriwe ntambara ndetse kiranatwikwa agace olympia kaje kwibagirana nyuma y’imyaka mike bitewe n’imyuzure ndetse n’imitingito yashegeshe bikomeye ibikorwa muntu byose byari byarubatswe ako gace nubwo zimwe nkingi z’inyubako zari i olympia marushanwa yabaga zigihari aka gace kameze nk’inzu ndangamurage y’imikino olimpiki kuko kugera marushanwa atakihabera mu mwaka umugabo witwaga baron pierre de coubertin umufaransa yasabye urugaga rwateguraga imikino ngororamubiri itandukanye paris rwagarura mikino kera yakundwaga n’imbaga nyamwinshi igitekerezo coubertin cyakiranwe ubwuzu ndetse ahita yemererwa gushyiraho ihuriro mpuzamahanga rihagarariye marushanwa ndetse rigikora magingo mu w’ amarushanwa mbere olimpiki yarakozwe abera bugiriki ahitwaga athens imbere y’abafana basaga ibihumbi abagabo basaga baturutse bihugu bitandukanye nibo bitabiriye marushanwa abagore ntibari bemerewe gukina mikino gihe ndetse abagabo b’ abagaragu n’abacakara bemerewe gusiganwa mafarashi byonyine nk’uko kumenya impamvu nyamukuru yatumye mikino itangira nshuro yayo mbere gusa nanone inkomoko y’aya marushanwa igaruka cyane myizerere ndetse n’indangagaciro zubahirizwaga bugiriki kera abagiliki bimakazaga gukomera gihagararo ndetse gutyara kw’ibitekerezo kandi bizeraga gutsinda byiciro byombi byaheshaga imana yitwaga zeus icyubahiro uretse kuba imyizerere n’imyemerere y’abantu itandukanye akenshi usanga byombi binatangaje igihe kimwe mana yitwaga zeus yigeze gukozanyaho n’iyayibyaraga yitwaga kronos bipfa gutegeka isi zeus yaje gutsinda kronos ntambara yabereye kibaya cyari majyepfo y’iburasirazuba bw’ubugilikia hitwaga i olympia muri kibaya hahise hubakwa urusengero rw’iyi mana yarayobotswe n’imbaga y’abantu bazaga kuhakorera imihango itandukanye yakorwaga iryo dini iyi mihango yaba ifitanye isano n’iyi mikino kuko byose byakorwaga hagambiriwe kunezeza zeus mu isi none marushanwa olimpiki ageze aharyoshye kuko uretse abantu bakuru abana hagati y’imyaka bashyizwe igorora ingengo y’imari y’aya marushanwa yikubye iy’ibihugu bitari bikeya inshuro zitabarika urugero miliyaridi zirenga z’amadolari y’amerika zakoreshejwe marushanwa olimpiki muri mafaranga ntushakiremo imyizerere y’abagiriki cyera

title: umubare muke w’abaganga utuma batabona umwanya kwihugura

title: kwitwara neza buroko gufasha urukiko bimwe bitumye bagaragaza agiye kurekurwa
content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano gufungwa imyaka mwaka ushize amakuru kigalitodaycom gikesha itangazo ry’uryo rukiko aravuga mpamvu zatanzwe kumurekura harimo kuba urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho yougoslavia tpiy rufite imikorere ijya gusa n’iya tpir ruteganya imfungwa zakatiwe zishobora kurekurwa nyuma kumara bitatu kane by’igifungo barakatiwe kandi bagaragaza amaze imyaka afunze ukuvuga by’imyaka umunani yakatiwe izindi mpamvu michel bagaragaza ubwe yiyemeje kwishyikiriza urukiko akanemera yashinjwaga ndetse akerekana azi uburemere bwabyo akanabyicuza kuba yararanzwe n’imyitwarire myiza afungiye sude mugabane w’u burayi nyakanga umunyarwanda michel bagaragaza yahoze umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo ocir- ishami ry’icyayi akaba yarafatwaga nk’umwe nkoramutima juvnal habyarimana perezida w’u rwanda yamaze igihe ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi ukurikiyeho ariko ahakana byaha byose yashinjwaga nyuma y’aho bidashobokeye yoherezwa kuburanishirizwa rwanda nyuma kugirana imishyikirano yihariye n’ubushinjacyaha bagaragaza yemeye kuba yaragize uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko kandi yahaga interahamwe imodoka z’uruganda bazikoreshe ngendo zabo ariko yongeraho yabikoraga akiza amagara n’umuryango uko gufasha interahamwe bikaba aribyo byatumaga ubushinjacyaha buvuga yazorohereje akazi bigatuma zibasha kwica abantu bahungiye musozi kesho kiliziya nyundo utwo duce twose turi karere rubavu kubera kwemera yaregwaga kubisabira imbabazi imbere y’urukiko tariki ugushyingo bagaragaza yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka umunani kandi urukiko rutegeka hakurwamo igihe yafunzwe michel bagaragaza azafungurwa itariki ukuboza bivuze ashigaje ukwezi kumwe n’iminsi itandatu buroko ernestine musanabera

title: intara y’amajyaruguru yatangije imurikagurisha ry’iminsi
content: afungura imurikagurisha minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda francois kanimba yashimiye urugaga rw’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru n’ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwabigizemo uruhare kugira ishobore gutangira yavuze imurika gurisha rigaragaza abanyarwanda bageze iterambere kuko rituma abantu bashobora kungurana ibitekerezo rikaba n’ishuri benshi baboneramo batari bazi bagashobora kwiga kubikora abitabiriye imurikagurisha bavuga bishimiye umwanya bahawe kugaragaza bakora ndetse bagashobora kubona ibyahandi bashobora kwigiraho bakora ibintu byiza kanimba yasobanuye leta gushyira ingufu kongerera ubushobozi ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse hihutishwa serivise bacyenera ikoranabuhanga kubafasha gushaka isoko ry’umusaruro bakora abaturage hamwe n’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru baratangaza aribwo bagira imurikagurisha ryitabirwa n’abanyamahanga bavuye bihugu muryango w’afurika y’iburasirasuba eac n’abashoramari bihugu asiya repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo abanyarwanda bakaba bagomba guhangana n’isoko rinini u rwanda rwagiye ry’umuryango w’ibihugu by’iburasirazuba eac yves hirwa akora top sai ikora ibijyanye n’ubugeni yvuze ibikorwa byabo byatunguye benshi kuko ababasura hari batari bazi yemeza kuba ibikorwa byabo bimenywa n’abantu benshi bizongera umubare w’ababagurira ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwitabiriye imurika gurisha bukaba buvuga bwasanze umwanya kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa turere iri murikagurisha riteganyijwe gusoza taliki ugushyingo cyakora hari imbogamizi imvura nyinshi ikunze kugwa ntara y’amajyaruguru ishobora kuzangiza ibicuruzwa n’ibimurikwa nkuko byagenze cyumweru yagwaga nyuma gufungura imurika gurisha sylidio sebuharara

title: u rwanda rwatewe amacumu atari make ariko rugakomeza ruhagaze-perezida kagame
content: yabigarutseho ijambo yavugiye rwanda day yabereye mujyi bonn budage ahari hateraniye abasaga perezida kagame yavuze kubona umwanya kuganira banyarwanda hose bifite bishingira kuko u rwanda igihugu cyiyubaka kandi kiva kure agaruka byabaye habaga jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze igihugu cyasenyutse kitariho ibyabaye kwari uguhuhura yavuze gusenyuka u rwanda rwanyuze byinshi bigamije kuruhungabanya ariko rukabicamo neza ati hari njya nibaza twahuye dutya n’ikindi gihe kuko u rwanda rumaze kunyuramo gusenyuka ruterwa amacumu atari make hirya hino amwe u rwanda rukayizibukira ayandi akarufata rugakomereka ariko rugakomeza ruhagaze naho ruguye ntiruhere hasi rugahaguruka nubwo byabaye urwo rugendo yavuze imyaka ishize byagiye bigabanyuka ntabwo bikiri nkuko byari bimezeabarukoreraga imyaka yagendaga ihita niko bibagora kuba bitakiri nkuko byari bimeze myaka cyangwa ishize perezida kagame yavuze bigaragaza kwiyubaka ati ntabwo mbuvuga kugira ngi nirate ndabivugira kuko ukuri ni ukuri kwigaragaza yavuze ababangamira u rwanda bameze nk’imiyaga iba ishaka gusubiza indege inyuma ariko ikanga ikagera ijya ati iyo igenda ihura n’imiyaga y’ubwoko bubiri hari uturuka imbere usa n’uyisubiza inyuma hari n’uturuka inyuma ugasa n’uyisunika twe twagiye duhura n’ituruka imbere gusa ariko nshaka kuvuga ndege kubera imbaraga iba ikoresha ijye imbere nubwo hari miyaga iragenda ikagera ijya nuko tugenda natwe nk’indege imiyaga iduturutse imbere ikadusunika tuyinyuramo tukagenda ku bundi buryo hari imiyaga iduturuka inyuma idusunika mwebwe nimwe musunika u rwanda mwanga hari ikirubuza gukomeza rugere rwajyaga ibyo bigaragarira iterambere ry’u rwanda kuko buri mwaka rutera imbere buri rwego harimo ubucuruzi ubuhinzi inganda n’izindi yabwiye abitabiriye rwanda day mbaraga zisunika u rwanda rukanyura bibazo byose rwahura nabyo kagame yashishikarije abanyarwanda mahanga guhoza igihugu cyabo mutima bakagifasha gutera imbere rwanda day umunsi umaze kumenyekana cyane kandi wagize uruhare runini gukangurira abanyarwanda mahanga kugira uruhare iterambere ry’igihugu cyabo uyu mwaka ibaye nshuro cumi

title: banki y’isi igiye guha u rwanda inkunga y’asaga miliyari azafasha bikorwa by’iterambere
content: banki y’isi yatangaje yageneye u rwanda inkunga miliyoni z’amadorali amerika asaga miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda azifashishwa bikorwa by’iterambere nzego zirimo iz’ingufu kubaka ibikorwaremezo n’ibindi gihe cy’imyaka itatu imbere iyi nkunga yatangajwe gatanu tariki gicurasi imurikabikorwa nzego zinyuranye byagizwemo uruhare banki y’isi ibinyujije nkunga igenera u rwanda uhagarariye banki y’isi rwanda yasser el-gamal yashimiye u rwanda buryo rukoresha inkunga ruhabwa n’abafatanyabikorwa barwo iyi banki itera inkunga imishinga migari nzego zirimo ingufu ubwikorezi ubuhinzi ibikorwaremezo kongerera ubushobozi abantu b’ingeri zinyuranye imibereho myiza n’ibindi iyi banki ivuga yateye inkunga imishinga igera icumi y’imbere gihugu ifite agaciro miliyoni z’amadorali ndetse kinahabwa miliyoni z’amadorali yindi ine ruhuriyeho n’ibihugu karere banki y’isi ishimangira u rwanda ruri bihugu bikoresha neza inkunga ibigenera rukarushaho gushyira bikorwa rwiyemeje kandi gihe ivuga kandi bitagarukira nkunga banki irugenera gusa kuko n’izindi zituruka bandi bafatanyabikorwa ruzikoresha neza umuyobozi uhagarariye banki y’isi rwanda yasser el-gamal yagize navuga ruri bihigu bishyira bikorwa imishinga gihe bikagera ntego bugenzuzi bwakozwe nzego zinyuranye banki igiramo uruhare butwereka u rwanda rwakoze akazi keza gukoresha inkunga ziva hanze uretse n’izivuye banki y’isi ahubwo bandi bafatanyabikorwa baturutse hanze ndatekereza urugero rwiza rw’abakoresha neza inkunga z’amahanga uyu muyobozi yavuze banki y’isi yiteguye gukomeza gutera inkunga u rwanda bikorwa by’amajyambere isanzwe igiramo uruhare akaba mpamvu yarugeneye inkunga miliyoni z’amadolari myaka itatu imbere azabyifashishwamo bamwe bagezweho n’inkunga banki y’isi bashimangira yabagiriye akamaro bituma babasha gutangiza ibikorwa bibateza imbere kajebukeye mymoon ubarizwa koperative tuzamurane ihuje abamugariye rugamba ikorera karere rwamagana igakora amasabune yifashishwa bikorwa by’isuku yagize dukorana banki y’isi ibinyujije komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe gusubiza buzima busanzwe abari ingabo kuko yadutuje tumaze kubona tuba baduteye inkunga kutwigisha bijyanye n’amakoperative natwe tubona kwishyira hamwe duhitamo gukora masabune avuga amasabune bakora utugari n’imirenge biyagura nabo bakabasha kubona amafaranga abafasha kwiteza imbere imibare banki y’isi igaragaza imaze kugira uruhare itunganywa hegitari ibihumbi z’ibishanga n’imisozi hamaze gutunganywa imihanda ireshya kilometero ingo ibihumbi zahawe amashanyarazi gihe abahoze ngabo bangana n’ibihumbi batujwe neza

title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka

imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora jenoside amateka yagoretswe akaba agiye gufata iya mbere akayarwanya avuga amateka y’ukuri kandi agomba kubaka igihugu cy’u rwanda ayo mahugurwa yitabiriwe n’inkeragutabara hamwe n’abafasha basaga title: icyonnyi cy’inzige minagri irasaba abaturage gutanga amakuru bakirinda ibihuha
content: mu rwego kurwanya icyonnyi cy’inzige zimaze kuyogoza bimwe bihugu bituranye n’u rwanda ministeri y’ubuhinzi n’ubworozi irasaba abahinzi gusura imirima buri munsi bagatangira amakuru gihe ariko bakirinda ibihuha itangazo ryashyizweho umukono n’umunyamabanga uhoraho minisiteri musabyimana jean claude minagri iravuga n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo biteguye guhanga n’icyonnyi cy’inzige zaturuka hose inzige ziri muryango munini w’udukoko bita ibihore dufite uduhembe tugufi inzige zisumbya ibihore zishobora gukora urungendo rw’ibilometero zidahagaze kandi zigenda matsinda zigera miliyoni iki cyonnyi cyatangiriye bihugu bigize ihembe ry’africa somalia kenya ethiopia ariko biravugwa zageze gihugu uganda kiri majyaruguru y’u rwanda mu rwanda bivugwa zaherukaga myaka hari n’bavuga zateye uduce tumwe tumwe tw’u rwanda nubwo urujya n’uruza rw’abantu n’ibintu rugiye kuzuza umwaka ruhagaze hagati uganda n’u rwanda inzige n’izindi nyamanswa bidakenera umupaka ndakumirwa karegeya omar

title: bugesera ikawa y’ibitumbwe irafasha abahinzi guhangana covid- badasabirije
content: abahinzi murenge juru bavuga kugurisha ikawa y’ibitumbwe biboroheye bihe by’ikumira ry’ubwandu bushya bw’icyorezo covid- kuko umusaruro bakuramo ubafasha kubona amafaranga bigatuma bahangana n’ibihe bikomeye byatewe n’icyorezo coronavirus kibasiye isi aba bahinzi bemeza kugeza kibazo kiragaragara kijyanye n’imibereho gishamikiye kuba bimwe bikorwa byarahagaze bihe byahuriranye n’uko ikawa bahinze ziri mwero wazo mberimana leonard mudugudu kinihira kagari rwinume umwe bahinzi kawa bibumbiye cooperative cotemuka avuga minsi imirimo y’ubuhinzi yakomeje nk’ibisanzwe bityo kubona amafaranga gukemura ibindi bibazo by’ibanze muturage mibereho buri munsi bayakuye musaruro kawa kugurisha ikawa bikorwa hubahirizwa amabwiriza agamije gukumira ikwirakwira coronavirus itera covid- agira umusaruro kawa wabonetse abahinzi bawukusanyiriza hamwe bakawugeza koperative abashoramari bawusanga bakawujyana ruganda yadutangarije bishimira kuyigurisha igitumbwe kuko amafaranga babona abafasha guhaha ibindi biribwa bitunga umuryango kandi bigabanyiriza umuhinzi imvune guhera ikawa’ umuyobozi w’iyi koperative y’abahinzi kawa yitwa cotemuka ikorera kagari rwinume nzigira pascal yemeza umusaruro kawa kugoboka abaturage rusange ahanini bigaturuka kuba kindi gihingwa bafite kigeze igihe k’isarura ati bitewe n’uko wundi musaruro w’ubuhinzi dufite mezi kugurisha ikawa y’ibitumbwe ho hantu abahinzi turi gukura amafaranga guhahira ingo zacu bigatuma n’abandi bayabonaho kuko amafaranga yasohotse uyahawe si agumaho wenyine agoronome ushinzwe gukurikirana ibikorwa by’ubuhinzi murenge juru nzabonitegeka ildephonse avuga ubuyobozi buri gukurikirana ibikorwa by’abahinzi gihe basarura kawa bubafasha kugurisha umusaruro wabo buryo bworoshye kandi giciro cyagenwe ndetse kubakurikirana nyuma covid- batazicwa n’inzara ati abahinzi rusange by’umwihariko abafite kawa kibazo k’imibereho bafite kandi biri gutanga akazi bandi batayihinze bigatuma babona amafaranga tubafasha kubona bagurishiriza umusaruro wabo kugira udapfa ubusa tukanabafasha kwita bindi bihingwa bitarageza igihe gusarurwa kuva mpera z’ukwezi gatatu kugeza mwaka ibikorwa gusarura kawa y’ibitumbwe byatangiye bahinzi murenge juru kugeza hamaze gusarurwa igera toni abahinzi bakaba bagurisha ikiro kimwe giciro cyemejwe kingana frwkg kandi ibikorwa gusarura birakomeje ubu umusaruro kawa y’ibitumbwe ugurishirizwa site ebyiri iherereye ahitwa gatesanya kagari juru nestse n’indi y’ahitwa kabagore kagari rwinume umusaruro uvanwa ukajya gutunganirizwa ruganda rtc -shyara dieudonne title: impamvu kubita abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka’ bibadindiza kurushaho
content: nubwo njye atari mbibona ngereranije n’imiryango nagiye nsura myaka ishize nk’umunyamakuru- kuko iterambere ryabo umuntu abishatse anarirebesha amaso- ariko hari imbogamizi ikomeye izakomeza gutuma izina bitwa ubwaryo rishobora gutuma bakomeza kuba inyuma y’abandi banyarwanda yego bakaba batera imbere ugereranyije n’aho bahoze ariko ntibagendere muvuduko umwe n’abandi banyarwanda abahanga by’imitekerereze y’abantu bagaragaza amakuru uhaye ubwonko kenshi gashoboka atuma ubwenge bw’umuntu buyahinduramo ibikorwa bigendanye makuru wahaye ubwonko ibi nibyo bita subconscious mind power’ cyongereza impamvu abahanga batubuza guhora twatura amagambo mabi bana ni kenshi twumva abahanga mitekerereze y’abantu batubuza guhora tubwira abana amagambo y’urucantenge urugero bahanga bavuga atari byiza guhora ubwira umwana umuswa’ igicucu’ umunebwe’ n’andi magambo menshi y’urucantege impamvu babitubuza ubwira umwana kenshi igicucu makuru ageraho akaba menshi bwonkoubwenge subconscious mind noneho ubwonko bukageraho bukayakira bukayabyaza ibikorwa by’ubucucu koko kugira bubisanishe makuru buhora bwakira umuntu igicucu ibi ibintu biba nyirabyo atabigizemo uruhare kuko ubwenge bukora gikorwa nabwo bwenge butuma umutima wacu utera kandi atari twe tubisabye nabwo butuma duhumeka twayura igifu kigasya ibiryo n’ibindi bikorwa tudafiteho ubushobozi nyamara tukisanga twabikoze subconscious mind’ ubu nabwo bwenge butuma dutwara imodoka tugahinduranya amavitese tutabanje kubitekerezaho cyane nyamara igihe twigaga imodoka twarabanzaga gukora imibare myinshi irimo ukuntu bubanze gukandagira embrayage hanyuma ukayirekura gake uko tubikora kenshi bwenge burabifata bukajya bubyikorera butabanje kubinyuza bwenge busanzwe tubitekerezeho uku nako kwaturiraho umuntu amagambo atari meza bimusubiza inyuma kumukangura ibi bihuriye he n’izina abasigajwe inyuma n’amateka’ nahereyeho amagambo tubwira umuntu kenshi niyo ubwonko bubyazamo ibikorwa bihuye magambo tumubwira nkuko nabivuze hejuru gusubiramo buri gihe umuntu yasigajwe inyuma n’amateka igihe cyose ubwonko bwe bumufasha gukora ibikorwa nk’iby’umuntu amateka yasubije inyuma nyine iyi siyanse izwi hose iyo uhora ubwirwa umuswa igicucu n’ibindi kabuza ubwonko bukomeza kugufasha gukora ibikorwa bigaragaza igicucu koko iyo uhora ubwirwa amateka yagusubije inyuma ndetse hakavamo n’inyito bakwitirira kabuza ubwonko bugufasha gukomeza gusigara inyuma buryo buri gihe cyose umuntu akureba akabona koko wasigajwe inyuma n’amateka kugira bize gusa n’ibyo ubwonko buhora bwumva ku bizera iyobokamana umwami salomo niwe wavuze umuntu atekereza mutima nako abayeho buzima bwe imigani hanyuma namwe mwizera siyanse umugabo witwa william james akaba mbere wigishije isomo ry’imitekerereze muntu psychology niwe wavuze mbere guhindura imitekerereze bihindura imibereho y’umuntu nkurikije mpamvu zose umuntu kuba abantu bamwita yasubijwe inyuma n’amateka biragoranye mateka amurekura rwego rwifuzwa gihe cyose tukimubona isura y’uwasigajwe inyuma n’amateka ndetse tukagera tubimushakiramo izina izina umunyarwanda’ rirahagije kimwe n’abandi hanyuma haba hari ibikorwa byihariye ashaka guhabwa bigakorwa bitabaye ngombwa kumushakira izina rihora rimwemeza yasigaye inyuma y’abandi binabaye ngombwa cyane ahabwa izina ryihariye reka ahabwe izina ritanga icyizere rikamwemeza gutera imbere ibi bibe babyeyi bita amazina abana umwanditsi inzobere itangazamakuru n’itumanaho ibikubiye nyandiko ibitekerezo bye bwite

title: uwari burugumesitiri wishe nyina padiri ubald basigaye bafatanya kwigisha
content: padiri ubald rugirangonga amaze kubera impano idasanzwe afite gusengera abarwayi bagakira ubumuga butandukanye n’indwara zikomeye ziba zarananiye abaganga b’inzobere uretse ariko anazwiho kugira uruhare kwigisha abanyarwanda ubumwe n’ubwiyunge ibintu akora yihereyeho kuko yabashije kubabarira abamwiciye umuryango jenoside uwishe nyina padiri ubald aherutse gufungurwa agasanga padiri ubald yararihiriye amashuri abana none asigaye afatanya n’uyu mupadiri kwigisha padiri ubald rugirangonga amaze kubera impano idasanzwe afite gusengera abarwayi bagakira ubumuga butandukanye n’indwara jenoside uwishe nyina padiri ubald aherutse gufungurwa agasanga padiri ubald yararihiriye amashuri abana none asigaye afatanya n’uyu mupadiri kwigisha jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda mwaka w’ yabaye padiri ubald umupadiri paruwasi nyamasheke n’ubwo nyuma yaje kwimurirwa paruwasi mushaka ndetse nyuma anahabera padiri mukuru se yishwe mbere jenoside azizwa ubwoko bwe ndetse gihe nibwo padiri ubald yaje guhungira mahanga nyuma gutotezwa azira ubwoko ariko akaza kugaruka rwanda nyuma kumva ijwi ry’imana rimusaba kuza kwigisha urukundo abanyarwanda mu nyirizina jenoside yavukije padiri ubald nyina n’abandi benshi muryango nyamara abamwiciye yaje kubababarira ndetse arihira amashuri abana babiri umuhungu n’umukobwa b’abamwiciye umuryango jenoside mu kiganiro kirambuye padiri ubald yagiranye n’ikinyamakuru ukwezi yadutangarije gahunda y’ivugabutumwa rigamije kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubwiyunge nyabwo asanzwe akora asigaye afatanya n’uwamwiciye umubyeyi jenoside padiri ubald aherutse kudutangariza yababariye uwamwiciye umubyeyi akanarihirira abana yagize njye nageze buri wese ishusho y’imana imbere yanjye n’uwishe mama naramubabariye ndihirira amashuri abana aherutse gufungurwa burugumesitiri kuko yaburanye yemera icyaha baramufunguye umugore yapfuye akiri gereza abana ndabarihira afite umukobwa wiga medecine njyewe umurihira minsi micye araba yabaye dogiteri ikinyamakuru ukwezi cyabajije padiri ubald abanye n’uwo wamwiciye umubyeyi jenoside nyuma gufungurwa adutangariza basigaye bafatanya kwigisha gahunda y’ivugabutumwa rigamije kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubwiyunge padiri ubald ubu turafatanya kandi mbona bimurimo kuko mubwiye amfashe hose araza njyewe nigisha gutanga imbabazi hanyuma akigisha gusaba imbabazi mbona bimurimo ikibazo benewabo mbona bamwanga ntibishimira avugisha ukuri padiri ubald avuga bazanajyana bavuka i nyamasheke vuba bakajya kwigisha abakoze jenoside n’abayirokotse bakabafasha kubohorwa imitima binyuze gusaba imbabazi kw’abayikoze ndetse gutanga imbabazi ruhande rw’abayirokotse biciwe ababo ibyo kujya i nyamasheke byatewe n’uko bamutumiye azajye kwifatanya nabo kanama mwaka yubile y’imyaka paruwasi imaze padiri ubald akabahakanira akababwira yubile ishingiye kinyoma adashobora kuyijyamo ati nababwiye nzajyayo ariko ntagiye kwifatanya nabo ahubwo nkajya birori byabo ngasakuza nkavuga barimo kubeshya bakora ibirori byubakiye kinyoma padiri mukuru waho yumva ndavuga ukuri tuzabanza tujyaneyo n’uwo nakubwiraga dufatanya kwigisha azajyayo anavugishe ukuri tunafashe abandi kubohoka bavuge ukuri padili ubald avuga hari gahunda afite kuzajya hanze y’u rwanda kanama mwaka ariko bemeye azabanza gukorayo ivugabutumwa rigamije kwimakaza ubumwe n’ubwiyunge gahunda yindi azayihorera ajye gufatanya nabo kwizihiza yubile ariko ibe baramaze gusasa inzobe bakareka kubakira kinyoma

title: bugesera nyuma y’inzara yaharanzwe karahahira utundi turere
content: mu myaka yashize cyane cyane umwaka w’ akarere bugesera kagaragayemo ikibazo cy’amapfa akabije hari abantu bicwaga n’inzara abandi bagasuhukamuri gihe uhatembereye ushobora kugira amateka cyangwa se amakabyankuru y’abantu abenshi baturage hari bahatuye nibo bivugira kibazo cy’inzara kihaherutseniyonzima joseph w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari maranyundo amaze imyaka aka karere avuga inzara yatangiye kugaragara bugesera mpera y’ ariko ikaza gukaza umurego mwaka w’ avuga gihe ibintu byose byari byarabuze biryo mvaruganda kugeza bijumba bihingiragaagira umva ibijumba ibijumba gihe inaha byaribwaga n’umuntu ufite imodoka ndakubwiza ukuri mukene wapfaga kubyigondera niyonzima yongeraho impamvu yateraga byose izuba ryari ryaracanye buryo batirirwaga bahinga n’uwahinganga ntiyeze avuga igihe ahantu hapfaga kwera ibijumba hari bishanga kandi byajyaga kubageraho byahenze yongeraho mwaka w’ abantu bishwe n’inzara buryo bukabije duce twa gashora ngenda gahembe maranyundo abandi barasuhuka ati gihe abagabo benshi barahungaga kubera kubura bagaburira imiryango abagore bakishyira migozi kubera kubura bagaburira abana mukanzaramba feresita umugore w’imyaka y’amavuko atuye murenge mayange avuga ikintu cyaje kubarokora bugesera haje imishinga n’imwe igatangira kubaha imfashanyo z’ibiribwaagira muri gihe tutarabona imfashanyo amahirwe yasekeraga yabonaga rukacarara icyo gihe twayitaga shira umuteto kuko mbere wasangaga hari abantu batarya umutsima w’amasaka gusa abatuye aka gace bavuga ibintu bisa n’ibyasubiye buryo kuko imyaka irera abantu bakabona ibiryo bavuga ufite inoti y’igihumbi urya amanywa n’ijoro nyirabitanga jolie utuye bugesera avuga nzara ikiharangwa aka karere gahagaze neza isoko ibintu biraboneka ibiboneka kurusha ibindi harimo imboga ibishyimbo imyumbati inanasi ibigori n’ibindi ugeze isoko nyamata gice gicururizwamo imboga abacuruzi bazo nabo bemeza imboga ziboneka bwinshi mukarwema annonciata umucuruzi soko nyamata umaze imyaka igera acuruza avuga ibicuruzwa byabonetse nyuma y’aho mbere gucuruza byasaga n’ibigoranye kubera baburaga barangurira agira ibintu biriho ikibigaragaza inyanya intoryi n’izindi kandi urabona hano isoko abacuruza imboga babaye benshi kandi n’abo tundi turere basigaye baza kurangura hano aganira kigalitodaycom rwagaju louis uyobora akarere bugesera avuga icyatumye inzara igabanuka aka karere leta yafashe ingamba gutera ibiti n’amashyamba hirya hino kariya gace avuga iterwa ry’ibiti ryatumye imvura itangira kugwa n’imyaka ikaboneraho gutangira kwera ati ubu hari ibicuruzwa abacuruzi b’ i kigali baza kurangura inaha ndetse nubu dufitanye ubuhahirane n’intara kirundo gihugu cy’u burundi yongeraho byose babigezeho bakangurira abaturage gukora cyane guhinga kuzigama gukora imirimo itegamiye buhinzi gusa muri ako karere hari igihe cyageze bitoroshye kubona n’igiti kubera izuba ryari ryarahibasiye umuntu yashoboraga gusanga amatungo yapfiriye nzira kubera kubura ubwatsi n’amazi kuko hendaga kuba ubutayu egide kayiranga

title: abahawe amahugurwa lead rwanda bati ’ntidushaka kuzaba abashakisha akazi ahubwo tuzaba abagatanga’
content: bamwe banyeshuri christian university of rwanda chur bahawe amahugurwa n’umuryango lead rwanda byerekeye kwihangira umurimo bavuga ubumenyi bahawe bugiye kububyaza umusaruro nyuma y’amasomo kaminuza bakazareka kwitwa abashaka akazi ahubwo bakaba abagatanga umuryango lead rwanda ugizwe n’urubyiruko rw’abanyarwanda ruba rwaritabiriye gahunda yali young african leaders initiative rwandamuri amerika ndetse kenyaaba bihurije hamwe kugirango nabo bagire baha ubumenyi bakuye gahunda yali ziri byiciro bitatu ibyerekeranye n’ubuyobozi bw’ibanze civic leadshipgucunga ibya rubanda public management ndetse n’ibijyanye n’ubucuruzi business lead rwanda leadership entrepreneurship and acountability for development yatangiye mwaka ikaba iteza imbere urubyiruko biciye gutanga amahugurwa kubaha ubushobozi kugira ibitekerezo byabageza iteramberea umuhuzabikorwa lead rwandamuhire jean claudeavuga barahuguwe gahundabihuriza hamwe kugirango nabo babashe gufasha urubyiruko barwongerera ubumenyi atitwihurije hamwe kugira tujye duhuze ibitekerezo byacu tubashe gufasha urubyirukoiyi gahunda kugira duhugure urubyiruko kaminuza tubahe ubumenyi kwihangira umurimo kwizigamira usibye gahunda gutanga amahugurwabafite n’ibindi bintu bakora bifitiye igihugu akamaro nko kwigisha urubyiruko rukiri ruto ruri mashuri makuru bakarukundisha ubuhinzi ati uwo mushinga ugamije gushishikariza urubyiruko rukunda ubuhinzi rukiri ruto kuko ubuhinzi ikintu abanyarwanda bitabira cyane kandi gifite akamaro kanini cyane kuko butunze abantu benshi bafite mushinga guhugura urubyiruko ruri kaminuza bakaruhugura bijyanye n’ubuyobozi kugira babafashe kuzaba abayobozi b’ahazaza muhire avuga ikubitiro bahisemo kaminuza enye zirimo chur inafite ubunararibonye gutoza gukundisha abanyeshuri bahiga kwihangira umurimokaminuza yigenga kigali ulkkaminuza mount kenya ndetse n’ikigo kepler ariko barateganya kugera makaminuza rwanda mu rwego kongera umubare w’abanyamuryango lead rwanda bakava bakagera mubare wisumbuyemuhire avuga bafite gahunda gushishikariza urundi rubyiruko kugira bagire abanyamuryango benshi kuko hari n’ibindi bikorwa bakora bimwe bamaze kugeraho muryango wabona izubabirimo gukora imishinga itandukanye ifitiye akamaro umuryango nyarwanda nk’iyiteza imbere uburezi nko gusana amashuriibindi nko gukora imiganda karere bugeseraguhugura abantu bakaba baratangiye kwikorera imishinga ndetse n’abandi banyeshuri kugenda bahugura bakishimira ubumenyi guhabwa ’’tugomba guhinduka abatanga akazi kuba abagasaba’’ abitabiriye mahugurwa bahawe lead rwanda bavuga ubumenyi bungutse batazabupfusha ubusa dore barangizaga kwiga batekereza gukorera abandi ariko ubumenyi bahakuye bagiye kubwifashisha bakabasha kuba abatanga akazi kuba abagashakisha uwitwa bakita musabyemariya wiga icunga muntungo christian university of rwanda churwe avuga ubumenyi yungukiye mahugurwa buzamufasha kurangiza agahita yishingira umushinga ubyara inyungu atinungukiyemo kwitinyuka nkumva ikintu nshaka kuba ejo hazaza ngomba kugitegura mpereye ngubuturi kaminuza ariko umuntu yumva adashaka kurangiza akomeze gushaka akazi biro oya numva nshaka kuzarangiza nkahita nishingira umushinga wanjye nifashishije nigiye ngaha cyangwa n’ibyo nakuye mahugurwa naho mugenzi witwa turimaso innocent wiga kaminuza chur mwaka kabiri ishami ry’icungamutungo bitabiriye mahugurwa avuga bigiyemo yabibonye agasanga hari yakoraga atari azi uburyo bwiza byakorwamo ariko kuba abisobanukiwe agiye kubishyira ngiro akazaba miliyoneri atiikintu narebyeho kikantsinda ahantu batubajije ese uzigama angahe munsiuburyo ki nayabikagamo amafaranga sinarimfite ahantu nyandika kuburyo nibura umuntu yakaza akambaza nkabasha kumusubiza cyangwa nibuke hari amafaranga ngomba kuzigama munsi mbese nagenderaga ngaho nkapfa kuzigama rimwe nkaba nayasesagurabyanyigishije kuba nahindura uburyo kuzigama ahubwo nkazigama buryo bukomeye bwazatuma mba umumiliyoneri

title: ibintu by’ingenzi byagufasha kudashwana n’umukunzi wawe
content: nta zibana zidakomanya amahembe nubwo mwakundana ariko kuba mwarahuye buri wese afite uburyo yarezwe afite imico yagiye afata myaka ishize nta gitangaza kuba mwangira mutabona kimwe cyangwa mutumva kimwe ikibazo kiba intonganya gushwana bihoraho bigatangira gutera umwuka mubi hagati yanyu dore ibintu byagufasha kudashwana n’umukunzi wawe gutega amatwi iyo abantu bafite batumvikanaho usanga buri wese ashaka kumvikanisha ibye kungufu ndetse ntiyite kubyo mugenzi amubwira niba wifuza umubano mwiza n’umukunzi wawe ukwiriye kwiga gutega amatwi ukumva avuga n’impamvu atanga kandi ntukamwumve ugambiriye kumwereka igitekerezo cye kiri munsi y’icyawe ujye wishyira mwanya burya hari wumva ibyawe aribyo bikwiriye ndetse ukumva ibyo mugenzi wawe akubwira bidafite ishingiro ariko ujye wibuka kwishyira mwanya wibaze uti ese mba ndi njye nakumva meze nte akoze nkora aho gutongana wakwicecekera ururimi rwoshywa n’urundi iyo ikiganiro gitangiye kugana makimbirane uba ubyumva aho kugirango uvuge ibintu udafitiye igaruriro wakwicecekera mwazatuza ukazamubwira utekereza mudatongana kwihutira gusaba imbabazi ni ikintu gifasha cyane ushaka kubana neza n’umukunzi wawe nta kintu kibabaza nko kuba umuntu yaguhemukiye yarangiza akakurusha kurakara kwihutira gusaba imbabazi igihe wakosheje kandi ubikuye mutima utabikoze kwiyerurutsa yego utabimenyereye birakugora ariko ubyimenyereje ubona ukuntu byoroshye bituma amakimbirane ahosha gusaba imbabazi ntibikugabanyiriza icyubahiro ufite cyangwa agaciro ahubwo bituma uzisabye akubaha kurushaho kandi bigahosha umubano wanyu mpamvu kubika inzika kuko bimunga ibihe biri imbere izuba ntirikarenge ukirakaye ugomba kwiga kubabarira kuko ubwawe biruhura umutima wawe ikindi kandi ujye uzirikana hari abandi bashaka umukunzi wawe bashobora kuguca urwaho gihe wivumbuye bakamwitaho kandi wowe wanze kumuvugisha ugasanga bagiye bamwigarurira buhoro buhoro ukazashiduka agusezeyeho kubera ukuntu umugora cyangwa uhora ubika inzika ukajya uhora uzura akaboze

title: uburwayi umutwe indwara nk’izindi kandi buravurwa
content: mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kabiri tariki ukwakira dr kayiteshonga yvonne ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iby’ubuzima mutwe minisiteri y’ubuzima yagaragaje intera urwanda rumaze gutera mubijyanye guteza imbere ubuzima umutwe ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu karere hakaba harimo politiki nshya kwegereza abanyarwanda ubuvuzi bujyanye n’indwara umutwe kuburyo nibura byazagera kurwego rw’ibigo nderabuzima kuko kugeza hari abaganga b’ubuvuzi bw’uburwayi umutwe rwego rw’akarere gusa hashyizweho kandi serivisi yakira ikanasuzuma abafite ibibazo by’uburwayi umutwe yunganira ibitaro by’indera hatanzwe ibitabo bifasha abunganira ibikorwa by’ubuzima habayeho gufatanya n’izindi nzego leta guhangana niki kibazo igihe bibaye ngombwa nko gihe cy’inkiko gacaca gufatanya komisiyo ishinzwe gusezerera gusubiza mubuzima busanzwe ingabo zavuye kurugeroyasobanuye kandi uburwayi umutwe uburwayi nk’ubundi ndetse hari n’ubushobora kuvurwa bugakira ikibazo cy’uburwayi mumutwe rwanda kigenda gifata intera umwaka utashye nkuko imibare y’abitabira servise z’ubu buvuzi ibigaragaza mwaka umubare w’abagannye buvuzi abantu mwaka mwaka bamaze kugera umwaka ushize abagannye serivisi uretse kuba u rwanda rwarahuye jenoside ndetse n’ingaruka zayo zimwe muzindi mpamvu zitera kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare abanyarwanda bamaze gukangukira kwitabira gahunda z’ubuvuzi cyane cyane kuko banafite ubwisungane kwivuza ikindi imyumvire igenda ihinduka kuko ubundi wasangaga abafite burwayi barafungiranwaga bagahezwa bagahishwa cyangwa bakavurizwa mubavuzi gihanga mubapfumu bumwe buvuzi buhabwa abafite burwayi harimo imiti gufashwa buryo bw’ibiganiro hamwe kubafasha kwongera gusubira buzima busanzwe buryo butatu hari ushobora kubuhabwa bwose hari n’ushobora guhabwa bumwe cyakora uburyo gusubizwa buzima busanzwe bakaba babuhuriraho nubwo ariko hari ibyakozwe nibiteganywa gukorwa inzitizi ziracyahari izagarutsweho nk’ikibazo cy’imyumvire itari myiza ndwara mumutwe abantu bagitekereza uzirwaye atakiri umuntu muzima wagira akamaro bityo agahabwa akato imyumvire nimwe ijyana n’umuco ndetse n’imyizerere benshi bazita amarozi bagahitamo kugana abapfumu cyangwa hakaba abazifata nk’amadayimoni bakaguma nsengero ntibavuzwe ikindi umubare w’inzobere buvuzi ukiri muto rwanda mu butumwa bwatanzwe harimo kumva ikibazo cy’uburwayi umutwe icya buri wese kandi uwahuye nabwo akitabwaho mumuryango hakabaho guhindura imyumvire ndwara hakorwa ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira imikoranire hagati ministeri y’ubuzima n’abavuzi gihanga kuko usanga abafite burwayi abenshi ariho babanza bigatuma bagera kubuvuzi nyabwo batinze ikindi nabagize ibyago kuzirwara bakwiye gufashwa bakanitabwaho muryango nyarwanda kuko uburwayi umutwe nabwo uburwayi nkubundi ndetse nuwahuye nabwo akongera kwakirwa buzima busanzwe marie jose ikibasumba

title: kamonyimusambira ku myaka isaga y’amavuko atiinzara n’imibereho mibi biranyahuranije
content: atuye mudugudu mbari akagari karengera umurenge musambira ho karere kamonyi akitwa ugirashebuja yohani imibereho byose avuga mbarubukeye abagiraneza nibo bakimufashije gusunika iminsi nkuko abivuga gihe ubuyobozi bumusiragiza ugirashebuja yohani munzu itagira ikiyiromo arambika umusaya musambi kwiyorosa ntacyo kandi atekera agize amahirwe kubona umugiraneza umufungurira cyangwa se nk’ubuyobozi bukamwibuka nabwo biba gake kuko nk’ubu nubwo aturanye n’umurenge amezi ashize arenga atatu n’umuyobozi umugeraho aho icumbi yahawe n’umugiraneza ugirashebuja nzu ayibamo wenyine myaka y’amavuko guhaguruka yicaye biramugora kubw’intege nke ahanini zimufatanya n’inzara aganira n’umunyamakuru intyozacom kamena ahagana i saa cyenda yicaye yota akazuba avuga adaheruka kugira ashyira mukanwa inzara n’imibereho mibi biganisha ubuzima bwe ahabi avuga afite ibibazo kubaho nabi nzu ntacyo kurya n’ibindi amaranye igihe kirenga imyaka itanu nyamara agasiragizwa n’ubuyobozi bumurerega yagize hari igihe social w’umurenge ushinzwe imibereho myiza yaje ansanga karere ndimo ntekerereza abantu bahari barimo n’abasirikare abasirikare barigendera ngiye kubona mbona baramuzanye hagati bati tubwire ikibazo cy’uyu musaza uyu musaza n’ubundi yaje kurushya abayobozi atahe ikibazo cye nzagikemura kuwa mbere nje kuwa mbere genda uzaze kuwa gatatu nje kuwa gatatu genda uzaze kuwa gatanu kuwa gatanu genda uzaze kuwa mbere ndagumya ndiruka ndananirwa bigeze ndarorera akomeza avuga nyuma yaje kongera gusubira karere bagahamagara terefone ariko yababwiye ntabwo yigeze amenya aribyo yaratashye kera kabaye aza gusubira karere bati baramwandika imyirondoro baragije bati hoshi genda ikibazo cyawe kizakiranuka tugiye kumva ikibazo cyawe giteye akomeza avuga aheruka muri make musaza ibibazo avuga bimukomereye inzara kutagira kuko munsi kumugiraneza buryo abaho mpungenge igihe aricyo cyose uwamugiriye neza akamuha arara ashobora kuhisubiza ni nabyo bibazo avuga yatuye ubuyobozi ariko bugakomeza kumurerega bumusiragiza ashinja ubuyobozi kutamwitaho bumufashe kubona ahubwo bukabikorera abamerewe neza kuko hari n’ingero z’abo azi bagiye bubakirwa nyamara bafite ubushobozi busumbye ubwe bafite n’abakabitayeho gihe muryango mpozenzi providence umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge musambira yabwiye intyozacom musaza bamuzi kandi bamufasha ati uriya musaza afite umuntu content: ikipe y’igihugu amavubi imaze iminsi gihugu maroc irimo ikina imikino gicuti n’amakipe atandukanye kariya kage africa y’i burengerazuba mugoroba cyumweru tariki ukwakira amavubi yaraye atsinzwe n’ikipe olempike tuniziya y’abatarengeje imyaka igitego - kuwa gatanu w’icyumweru twasoje amavubi akaba atsinzwe imikino ine yikurikiranya kandi atsindwa igitego - ni nyuma gutsindwa ghana igitego - atsindwa gabon igitego - gihe yaherukaga gutsindwa burkina faso igitego - title: umuyobozi akwiye kubera ayobora urumuri n’urugero kugira amwigireho- soeur uwamariya
content: soeur uwamariya immacule yabwiye abakirisitu umurimo ugomba gukoranwa ubwenge ubwitonzi n’ubushishozi kandi ugatagatifuza uwukora kandi imana yahaye umuntu ubwenge buhagije butuma akora ibintu neza yabigarutseho ejo hashize tariki gicurasi isengesho ryabereye i gikondo ryari rifite insanganyamatsiko igira iti umurimo ukozwe neza isoko y’urukundo ryahuje abakozi b’ibigo binyuranye bikorera gice gikondo rwego kwizihiza umunsi w’umurimo gushimira imana mbaraga yabahaye kuwunoza mu nyigisho yatanzwe soeur uwamariya immacule yagize umurimo ukwiye gukoranwa ubwenge ubwitonzi n’ubushishozi kandi ugatagatifuza uwukora cyane kwitagatifuza impano mwenemuntu yahawe n’imana n’ubwenge burenze ubw’ibindi biremwa byose soeur uwamariya yagarutse mikoranire ikwiye kuranga umukozi n’umuyobozi bakwiye gushyira hamwe bakungurana inama ati umuyobozi akwiye kubera ayobora urumuri n’urugero kugira amwigireho umukozi akwiye gushyira bikorwa inshingano ze nk’uko ziri kandi byose bikaza bifatanyiriza hamwe n’ibindi byinshi gusingiza imana yasabye abakoresha gufata neza bayobora wowe mukoresha jya umenya umwanya ufite kazi n’umurimo ukora wabihawe n’imana kandi yabiguhereye kubera abandi umugisha wukoreshe neza ugufashe kwitagatifuza kwegera imana kurushaho abakozi bakaba barasabwe gukora umurimo wabo neza kuko hari n’abandi bifuza kuhaba avuga abakozi kandi bagomba korohereza ababayobora kugira imirimo igende neza bakirinda kubananiza gukorera jisho soeur uwamariya kandi yagarutse bakozi rugo badakunze guhabwa agaciro n’abakoresha kandi bafatiye runini ingo nyinshi yanenze abakozi n’abakoresha barutisha imana akazi bakwiye gukora bakagira n’umwanya gusenga kandi imirimo ikarushaho kugenda neza yagarutse nyandiko mutagatifu benedigito igira iti habeho amasaha umunani gukora amasaha umunani gusenga n’amasaha umunani kuruhuka yongeyeho abakoresha bakwiye kujya bagira umwanya gushimira bayobora bigatera ineza n’amahoro mitima y’abakozi banyu ati kugira umurimo ube isoko y’umunezero ukoranwa ibyishimo n’amahoro ngombwa abakoresha babiba amahoro bigo bayoboye cyangwa bakoresha kugira murimo ubere uwukora isoko y’ibyishimo n’amahoro bamwe bitabiriye sengesho bavuze inyigisho bahawe zibubatse kandi zibateye imbaraga gukosora batakoraga neza mukamunana ernestine yagize iyi nyigisho iranyubatse inteye imbaraga kwisubiraho makosa nakoraga haba iwange rugo kazi kampemba hari najyaga ntaha nkinjira sinsuhuze umukozi munsi banyigishije amakosa kandi koko kabundi narcisse umwe bitabiriye sengesho n’inyigisho yavuze hari ashobora kuba yabangamiraga ayobora atabizi ariko guhera munsi amaze kumva nyigisho soeur uwamariya agiye kwivugurura age abasha gushimira abakozi gihe bakoze neza kandi n’abakoze amakosa abagire inama atabahutaje isengesho ryitabiriwe n’abakirisitu gatolika banyuranye n’abakozi bigo binyuranye birimo psf rra magerwa ishyirahamwe ry’abunganizi gasutamo naeb rsb sdv rbc rema niyomugabo albert

title: huye ababyeyi bibukijwe wabasimbura burere bw’abana
content: nyuma yuko bigaragaye umubare wabana bato muhanda bakomeza kwiyongera ndetse nuburyo gahunda ihari gukura abana bigo ngororamuco bajyanwa miryango yakorwaga ariko abana bakanga bakaba benshi muhanda byatumye hafatwa ingamba gukura abana bigo ngororamuco bagasubizwa miryango hakaboneka umwanya gushyiramo abandi bakurwa muhanda kuri gatatu tariki werurwe gikorwa cyabereye karere huye ahahurijwe abana babarizwa bigo ngororamuco bitatu nyampinga intiganda opde ababyeyi babana abarezi bigo ndetse nabarezi bigo byamashuri bana bagomba kwigaho umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu nyirarukundo ignacienne butumwa bwe yasabye ababyeyi kurwanya amakimbirane agaragara zimwe mpamvu zitera abana iwabo bakajya muhanda anabasaba kwita burere bwabana agira abantu bagufasha ariko numwe uzagusimbura muntu wakurerera kurusha wakwirerera umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu ushinzwe imibereho y’abaturage nyirarukundo ignacienne nyirarukundo kandi yabwiye abihakana abana bidakwiye ahubwo uburere bwumwana bugomba kugirwamo uruhare nababyeyi bombi umugabo numugore inshingano zabo agira niba umwana iwabo bamwihakanye ibyuma byabazungu bizamubashinja ntaguhakana si uwanjye kandi gutanga indezo itegeko bamwe babyeyi bagiye bavuga zimwe mpamvu zituma abana bajya muhanda ubukene ariko umuyobozi mukuru wikigo cyigihugu gishinzwe igororamuco bosenibamwe aimee avuga zimwe nzitwazo ariko umwana agomba kujya muryango hakenerwa nubufasha akaba ariho abuherererwa agira bya bindi muvuga muzajya mujya muryango mwongere mugaruke byarangiye tugiye gushyiraho gahunda yuko nucika ukagaruka muhanda tuzagufata tukakujyana muryango kugeza igihe uzarambirirwa kuba muhanda mubyeyi umwana aragucika ubigizemo uruhare kubera uburangare bwawe kumutoteza urafungwa aho kugira umwana ajye ’transit center’ mbazi wowe tujyanayo uryame isima wumve isima iryana nuvayo urashyira imbaraga kwita mwana wawe umuhe ashaka iki gikorwa cyubahirije uburenganzira butandukanye bwumwana burimo kurererwa muryango kwiga kuvuzwa kuba ahantu hatunganye ikaba gahunda yabanje kuganirwaho uretse abana batanu batarabonerwa imiryango ariko ikaba izakomeza gushakishwa abana bagomba gusubira miryango bavuye bigo karere huye kandi bakaba bagomba guhita bajyanwa kwiga bigo byamashuri bibegereye iki gikorwa kiri gukorwa gihugu hose kikaba kimaze amezi atatu

content: iki gikorwa umwaka ushize cyabere oslo norvge kandi mujyi kibereyemo hahita hatangarizwa kizabera umwaka ukurikiyeho umunyamabanga mbere ambasade y’u rwanda sude umulisa elise kiganiro kigufi dr ngoga innocent yavuze iby’agaciro kugira umwanya bakaganirira hamwe ati ni iby’agaciro kugira umwanya nk’uyu abana bacu inshuti zacu tukabaganiriza dukomoka kuko utagira ava ntamenya ajya ntanamenya kubana neza n’abamwakiriye ikindi kandi bituma duhora turi bikorwa bitekerezo n’igihugu cyacu u rwanda abanyarwanda batuye danemark bakereye kwakira gikorwa cy’umuganura umuyobozi title: urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwahombye miliyari frw werurwe kubera coronavirus
content: iyi raporo yashyikirijwe ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere mata igaragaza urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rukeneye inkunga gihe nyuma y’icyorezo coronavirus mu gukusanya amakuru bihombo byabayeho werurwe mwaka psf yegereye ibikorwa bingana rwego rw’ubukerarugendo imibare yerekanye abakira mukerarugendo barimo amahoteli werurwe bagize igihombo miliyari frw abatembereza mukerarugendo bahomba miliyari frw abanyamwuga bategura inama bahombye miliyari frw ibindi bigo bifasha mukerarugendo bihomba miliyoni frw ibi bihombo byaje bisanga urwego rw’ubukerarugendo rwanda rufite inguzanyo miliyari frw urwego rw’amahoteli arirwo rwihariye inguzanyo nini kuko rufite izingana miliyari frw ababajijwe bagaragaje nibura by’abakozi rwego rw’ubukerarugendo bahagaritswe kazi ndetse basigaye bagizwe nyir’ibigo bakomeje gukora bijyanye n’igenamigambi kwiga mikorere nyuma y’iki cyorezo amahoteli yakoreweho ubushakashatsi yagaragaje yamaze guhagarika abakozi abatwara mukerarugendo bahagarika abategura inama bahagarika abandi bafasha mukerarugendo bahagarika urebye mishahara yatangwaga n’uru rwego amahoteli yahembaga miliyari frw buri kwezi wateranya n’izindi nzego eshatu bigendana bikaba miliyari frw iyi raporo igaragaza nibura uru rwego ruzakenera miliyari frw kugoboka ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo kwakira abantu gihe cy’umwaka wose nyuma coronavirus ba nyir’ibi bikorwa bagaragaje abanyamahoteli buryo bukwiye buryo ikibazo guhomba hoteli kimaze iminsi gishobora gufata indi ntera raporo ikomeza iti urugero nko myaka ine ishize hoteli zisaga zaguye bihombo zitezwa cyamunara cyangwa zihindurirwa zakoreshwaga hoteli zasimbutse ibihe guhomba cyane zari zigihanganye n’imyenda minini banki buryo kwishyura inyungu zose ibikorwa bizaba bisubukuwe kugeza bisubiye rwego byari ho mbere nyuma covid- bishobora kuzatuma ikibazo kirushaho kuba kibi ibyo bigatuma uru rwego rusaba habaho uburyo koroshya inyungu nguzanyo kugeza ibintu bisubiye murongo kuba leta yabaha inkunga kwishyura imishahara gushyiraho uburyo bwafasha uru rwego kubona amafaranga adahenze yatuma ibikorwa bikomeza nibura gihe cy’amezi umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi n’imenyekanishabikorwa hilltop hotel innocent tuyishime aherutse kubwira igihe rwego rw’amahoteli ho babara igihombo cy’igihe kirekire kuko n’abari barabateguje mpera z’umwaka batarafata umwanzuro uhamye kuko batazi igihe icyorezo kizarangirira ati igihombo twe mahoteli dufite ntabwo kiri gatatu cyangwa ukwa kane gusa cyamaze gufata n’amezi imbere nk’abari baratwandikiye bagombaga kuzaza cyenda n’ukwa cumi ntabwo barafata umwanzuro ariko batwandikiye minsi ishize bavuga tuzareba tuzavugana igihombo kandi mahoteli gishobora gukomeza kuko n’iyo coronavirus yagabanya umurego itashirira rimwe isi buryo ibihugu bifungura amarembo bitikanga mbere umuryango mpuzamahanga ushinzwe ubukerarugendo the world tourism organization unwto ugaragaza ubukerarugendo buzagira igihombo miliyari ziri hagati z’amadolari

title: tariki mata umunsi abatutsi bagera biciwe kiliziya nyarubuye
content: kuri mata nibwo hasozjwe icyumweru cy’icyunamo gikurikirwa n’iminsi gukomeza kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mata ku itariki nk’iyi gihe jenoside hibukwa abatutsi basaga biciwe kiliziya nyarubuye icyo gihe impunzi z’abatutsi zisaga zaturutse komini rukira rusumo birenga kigarama rukara musozi nyarubuye ziciwe kiliziya nyarubuye n’interahamwe ziyobowe burugumesitiri sylvestre gacumbitsi wakatiwe igifungo burundu ictr afatanyije evariste rubanguka umucamaza komini n’abajandarume kigo nasho uwo munsi abatutsi gusa barokotse bwicanyi tariki mata saa cyenda z’igicamunsi nibwo abicanyi bakoresheje gerenade batangiye gutera paruwasi kiliziya gatolika nyarubuye icyo gihe kandi hari indi nterahamwe yakomokaga cyahoze komini birenga yiyitaga cyasa wakatiwe burundu akaba afungiye gereza rwamagana i nsinda ingabo fpr inkotanyi zimaze gufata nyarubuye nyuma y’ibyumweru bibiri zahasanze imirambo yarariwe n’imbwa zicukura imva rusange imbere kiliziya zirabashyingura urwibutso jenoside nyarubuye rushyinguyemo imibiri y’abatutsi ku itariki mata hashyiguwe indi mibiri yabonetse hirya hino mirenge igize akarere kirehe hagati y’itariki - mata interahamwe zishe abatutsi bahungiye kiliziya cyahinda karere nyaruguru i kamembe hishwe abatutsi kadasomwa bicirwa paruwasi katedarali cyangugu hishwe abatutsi mubuga gihombo bicirwa ahitwa muhombori kuva itariki - mata abatutsi yahoze komini taba biciwe ahitwa kiryamo cy’inzovu ingabo fpr inkotanyi zageze kiziguro zibasha kurokora abatutsi batawe cyobo ariko batarapfa na none kuva itariki - mata abatutsi bahungiye komini rukondo mbazi habarizwa karere nyamagabe barishwe

title: afurika y’epfo yagennye ambasaderi mushya wayo rwanda
content: mu ukuboza nibwo uwari ambasaderi afurika y’epfo rwanda george nkosinati twala yahamagajwe i pretoria nyuma y’uko manda yararangiye icyo gihe hari hashize iminsi hari umwuka mubi wakuruwe kwemeranya ambasaderi mushya gusa kimwe kiremera gutangaza ikinyamakuru the east african cyatangaje gifite amakuru yizewe y’uko mandisi mpahlwa w’imyaka wagizwe ambasaderi mushya afurika y’epfo rwanda w’ubucuruzi anakora yindi myanya guverinoma afurika y’epfo guhera nduhungirehe yavuze umubano w’u rwanda afurika y’epfo umeze neza ndetse n’ibibazo bihari kubikemura yagize umubano wacu afurika y’epfo mwiza twagize ibibazo minsi yashize ariko turi gukorana tubikemure ambasaderi wacu mushya afurika y’epfo yakiriwe neza i pretoria ambasaderi wabo rwanda yeremewe nduhungirehe yavuze gukemura ibindi bibazo biri hagati y’ibihugu byombi mu ukwakira perezida paul kagame yakiriye jeff radebe intumwa yihariye perezida afurika y’epfo cyril ramaphosa nyuma y’aho abakuru b’ibihugu bombi kagame ramaphosa
