content: afungura imurikagurisha minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda francois kanimba yashimiye urugaga rw’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru n’ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwabigizemo uruhare kugira ishobore gutangira yavuze imurika gurisha rigaragaza abanyarwanda bageze iterambere kuko rituma abantu bashobora kungurana ibitekerezo rikaba n’ishuri benshi baboneramo batari bazi bagashobora kwiga kubikora abitabiriye imurikagurisha bavuga bishimiye umwanya bahawe kugaragaza bakora ndetse bagashobora kubona ibyahandi bashobora kwigiraho bakora ibintu byiza kanimba yasobanuye leta gushyira ingufu kongerera ubushobozi ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse hihutishwa serivise bacyenera ikoranabuhanga kubafasha gushaka isoko ry’umusaruro bakora abaturage hamwe n’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru baratangaza aribwo bagira imurikagurisha ryitabirwa n’abanyamahanga bavuye bihugu muryango w’afurika y’iburasirasuba eac n’abashoramari bihugu asiya repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo abanyarwanda bakaba bagomba guhangana n’isoko rinini u rwanda rwagiye ry’umuryango w’ibihugu by’iburasirazuba eac yves hirwa akora top sai ikora ibijyanye n’ubugeni yvuze ibikorwa byabo byatunguye benshi kuko ababasura hari batari bazi yemeza kuba ibikorwa byabo bimenywa n’abantu benshi bizongera umubare w’ababagurira ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwitabiriye imurika gurisha bukaba buvuga bwasanze umwanya kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa turere iri murikagurisha riteganyijwe gusoza taliki ugushyingo cyakora hari imbogamizi imvura nyinshi ikunze kugwa ntara y’amajyaruguru ishobora kuzangiza ibicuruzwa n’ibimurikwa nkuko byagenze cyumweru yagwaga nyuma gufungura imurika gurisha sylidio sebuharara

title: rusizi gusenya isoko irindi ritaraboneka byarabadindije
content: isoko rinini ry’umujyi kamembe karere rusizi ryashenywe mpera z’ukwezi munani hagamijwe kubaka irya kijyambere kuva gihe abaricururizagamo baratatanye bituma havuka udusoko twinshi dutandukanye celestin nteziyaremye umwe bacururizaga iryo soko avuga abaguzi bibagora kumenya abacuruzi bimukiye bigatuma bakira abakiriya bake nteziyaremye agira abakiriya ntibamenya badushakira buryo wicara umwanya munini mukiriya ubona twinjiza amafaranga make ugereranyije nayo twagombye kwinjiza undi mucuruzi sebakungu jean paul avuga umuti w’icyo kibazo ukwihutisha imirimo kubaka isoko sebakungu avuga abona imirimo kubaka isoko yaradindiye abisobanura magambo isoko tubona ryaradindiye kubakwa kandi turimo guhomba pe igihe barituvanagamo batubwiraga nyuma y’amezi atandatu rizaba ryuzuye ariko hashize amezi ane icyakozwe gusa ugukikiza ibiti rizubakwa bigaragara mezi atandatu ritaba ryarangiye ubuyobozi bw’akarere buvuga hatinze gato kubona ibyangombwa kubaka iryo soko kuko byabonetse kwezi k’ugushyingo nsabayezu jean luc ushinzwe ubucuruzi n’amakoperative karere rusizi yagize icyatumye isoko ridahita ryubakwa ugushaka icyangombwa kubaka ibyo abacuruzi bavuga isoko rigomba kuba ryarangiye mezi atandatu uhereye igihe baviriye kera si ntabwo ariko babwiwe kuko atari biri nyigo y’iri soko uretse isoko kijyambere biteganijwe kubakwa mujyi kamembe hazubakwa n’inzu y’ubucuruzi nini iyi nzu izaba hagati y’ibice bibiri bigize ikibanza cy’isoko rikuru ry’akarere rusizi iri soko niryo abacuruzi baciriritse bibonamo nk’isoko rubanda kurusha inzu y’ubucuruzi y’abashoramari mu mijyi y’uturere rwanda hari kugenda hubakwa amasoko agezweho akenshi masoko yubakwa ahantu haba hasanzwe hari isoko bikaba nko kurivugurura mu gihe kubaka masoko agezweho abacuruzi basabwa kuba bashatse ahandi bacururiza gihe isoko riba ritararangiza kubakwa jean baptiste micomyiza

ahazaza hanyu nagatobityo bigatuma umubano utagira intego hazaza kandi bizaba bigoye kuganira hazaza kugeza muhagaritse gukundana dore aribyo yifuza amushimira gacye gashoboka cyangwa ntabyo igihe burundu yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: intara y’iburasirazuba bakekwaho ubujura bw’inka beretswe abaturage n’itangazamakuru
content: mu rwego kugaragariza abatuye ntara y’iburasirazuba ibimaze kugerwaho kurwanya ubujura bw’inka ejo tariki nzeri abaturage ntara ndetse n’itangazamakuru beretswe abantu bakekwaho kwiba inka bice bitandukanye byayo cyane cyane turere twa nyagatare gatsibo kayonza icyo gikorwa cyabereye kagari simbwa ho murenge kabarore karere gatsibo kikaba cyaritabiriwe n’abaturage bagera murenge kabarore ndetse n’abo karangazi ho karere nyagatare abo bafatiwe mikwabu yakozwe bihe bitandukanye ntara kwezi gushize bufatanye polisi y’u rwanda n’izindi nzego zirimo igisirikare n’inzego z’ibanze icyo gikorwa kuberekana cyitabiriwe minisitiri w’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu francis kaboneka umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda igp emmanuel k gasana n’umushinjacyaha mukuru w’igihugu richard muhumuza mu butumwa yagejeje baturage minisitiri kaboneka yababwiye atiumuntu wese ushaka guhungabanya umutekano gahunda z’iterambere ry’igihugu ntazihanganirwa ni urwo rwego inzego zose zifatanya kurwanya ubujura bw’amatungo ndetse n’ibindi byose bishobora kubangamira ituze n’iterambere rubanda minisitiri kaboneka yakomeje ababwira atiperezida repubulika paul kagame ashaka mukira abanga ibirama tubarwanye dukoresheje ukuri kandi tuzabatsinda gushidikanya igp gasana yabwiye baturage atihashize ukwezi tubasezeranyije tugiye kurwanya twivuye inyuma ubujura bw’amatungo ntarauyu munsi twaje kubagaragariza tumaze kugeraho tubereka tumaze gufata bakekwaho cyaha yakomeje agira atidosiye z’aba zizashyikirizwa ubushinjacyaha minsi vuba kandi igikorwa kurwanya ubujura bw’amatungo gufata ababikekwaho kirakomeje ndetse cyashyizwemo imbaraga nyinshi kugeza mutubwiye icyibwa ntara igp gasana yashimye baturage ababwira ifatwa ry’abo ryatewe n’amakuru bahaye polisi n’izindi nzego akomeza ababwira tugire umutekano buri wese abe ijisho mugenzi dukumira icyaha kitaraba dutanga amakuru gihe kandi vuba yababwiye igihugu gifite umutekano usesuye ariko abasaba kugira uruhare kuwusigasira batanga amakuru yatuma hakumirwa ikintu cyose kinyuranije n’amategeko mu ijambo rye muhumuza yababwiye ibyaha byose bizajya noneho bijya nkiko kujya bunzi nk’uko byahoze yagize atinta bwinyagamburiro abajura b’amatungo ndetse n’abandi banyabyaha bafite kuko ukekwaho icyaha wese azajya noneho ashyikirizwa ubushinjacyahaviarnp bakekwaho ubujura bw’inka beretswe abaturage n’itangazamakuruyanditswe niyomugabomuhaburarw

title: abo revive yafashije gutera akabariro barayivuga imyato
content: imibonano mpuzabitsina ifata umwanya mbere buzima bw’abashakanye buryo urugo rushobora gusenyuka igihe idakozwe neza bamwe bagabo n’abagore imibonano mpuzabitsina ifata umwanya mbere buzima wabafashije uba barawuvuga imyato bakanagira inama bagenzi kutirengagiza ikibazo gikomeye ingo zabo zahura nacyo igihe gutera akabariro byaba bidakozwe neza ni urwo rwego hari abakunzi bacu kubagezaho ubw’abantu ubw’abandi tuzabubagezaho nyandiko zacu zitaha hari uwatwandikiye agira mu minsi ishize nandikiye ukwezicom ngisha inama gihe umugore wanjye yendaga kwigendera kuko twageraga buriri twatangiraga gahunda kanya nk’ako guhumbya nkaba ndarangije kandi sinongere kubishaka vuba bigatuma madame ahorana umusonga kuko atabaga yarangije mu bantu bangiriye inama hari abambwiye kuba barampaye amakuru yatumye urugo rwanjye rukomera imana ihe umugisha buri wese wampaye amakuru revive hari n’umudame watwandikiye agira muraho neza nshuti zanjye duhurira muyoboro uduha amakuru meza kandi atanga umusaruro nejejwe kubashimira inama nziza mwampaye zatumye urugo rwanjye rushinga imizi rugakomera ndi umugore ndubatse namaze igihe kinini ntazi umugore ashobora gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina akaraniza nahoraga numva nshaka gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina kandi nararanye n’umugabo yemwe twanaraye tuyikoze ariko igihe cyose umugabo akarekeraho nkibishaka nanamusaba kongera title: kamonyiruhango abakoresha ikiraro mukunguri barahangayitse bikomeye
content: abaturage karere kamonyi ruhango bahangayikishijwe bikomeye n’isenyuka ry’ikiraro mukunguri gihuza utu turere twombi bavuga nyuma y’uko imodoka igishenye byahise bibashyira bwigunge kuko kugenderana guhahirana mpande zombi batewe ubwoba kurushaho n’imvura ishobora kuzambya ibintu ukwezi kugiye gushira ikiraro kiri ahitwa mukunguri gihuza uturere twa kamonyi ruhango gishenywe n’imodoka kikariduka kugeza tariki ukwakira twandika nkuru abaturage bakoreshaga muhanda bavuga mubwigunge n’igihombo cyatewe n’ingaruza z’isenyuka ry’ikiraro cyabahuzaga byinshi by’umwihariko abahinzi b’umuceri bavuga bahangayikishijwe n’imvura ishobora guteza ibibazo bikangiza umuceri ubura igihe gito were kamanzi eugene umuturage w’umurenge mugina karere kamonyi yabwiye intyozacom guhahirana kw’abaturage kamonyi ruhango kwazambye bitewe n’iyangirika ry’ikiraro cyabahuzaga ati kuri twe nk’abaturage turi gihombo turi bwigunge kuko twahahiranaga masoko atwegereye haba baturage ruhango baremaga isoko ryacu mugina yaba se natwe twambukaga iwabo nta modoka ikiva ruhango inyura mukunguri zijya kuzenguruka i muhanga ibiciro by’ingendo byariyongereye wagendaga moto mafaranga igihumbi hagati -frws uyu muturage akomeza dutewe ubwoba n’imvura kuko niramuka ishinze hasi neza byose biraba birangiye kuko n’akayira twari dufite gishanga nk’abanyamaguru ntako turaba tugikoresheje abahinzi b’umuceri ibibazo bikomeye kuko imvura ishobora kubasiga habi kandi habura agahe gato beza urabona n’ubusanzwe haruzura hagatwara abantu none n’ikiraro twacagaho gihari dukeneye ubutabazi kuko hari hamaze gutera imbere hari imodoka zitwara abantu none dusubiye kacu nyirahabimana doloteya karere ruhango murenge kinazi avuga gusenyuka kw’ikiraro byangije imihahiranire hagati ati iki kiraro cyari kidufitiye umumaro cyane kuko twahahiranaga abaturage tukagirana imishyikirano bitewe kwambuka tugahurira masoko isoko ryari ritugize nkatwe karere ruhango irya mugina ariko imvura nikomeza n’aha mazi twanyuraga ntabwo bizashoboka nkatwe abaturage turatabaza leta turatabaza uturere twacu badukure bwigunge kuko turababaye cyane akomeza avuga n’abana b’abanyeshuri biga bakoresheje kiraro bashobora guhura n’akaga habaye gikozwe vuba niyomugabo jean atwara abagenzi moto agakoresha kenshi muhanda avuga isenyuka ry’ikiraro ryatumye kinyabiziga kigikoresha muhanda by’umwihariko imodoka avuga moto ugushaka birwanaho gishanga ariko imvura igiye kwangiza byose kuriwe ubuyobozi bukwiye gutabara abaturage ibintu bigasubira byahoze ikiraro kitaracika uzziel niyongira umuyobozi w’uruganda mukunguri rutunganya umuceri avuga nk’uruganda n’abahinzi b’umuceri rusange byago bikomeye gihe kiraro cyatinda gukorwa ati ikiraro gusenyuka kwacyo ikibazo kuko kidakorwa ntabwo tuzabona twambutsa umusaruro turabangamiwe birenze kuko bubiko stock twubatse hakurya bigera cumi kumwe rutarakorwa urutindo ariho tuzasarura tuzaba dufite ibyago bikomeye cyane kayitesi alice umuyobozi w’akarere kamonyi yabwiye intyozacom ikibazo cy’isenyuka ry’iki kiraro ubuyobozi bukizi ndetse bwakivuganyeho rtda avuga atahamya neza igihe ikiraro kizakorerwa ariko biri nzira gukemuka imena munyampeta umuyobozi rtda yabwiye intyozacom ikibazo cy’iki kiraro kiri nzira gukemuka kuko bamaze kumvikana sosiyeti y’ubwishingizi igomba kwishyurira imodoka yakinyujijeho ibirenze ubushobozi bw’ikiraro ati kiriya kiraro uriya mugabo watwaraga iriya kamyo yarengeje igipimo kitagomba gucaho ikiraro kirasenyuka ni asiranse igomba kukishyura turi process nzira kubikemura twarabitangiye tumaze igihe asiranse igiye kuduha amafaranga kugira tugisane gihe kitarenze ukwezi kumwe turaba dufite amafaranga twatangiye kugisana abakoresha kiraro by’umwihariko abahinzi b’umuceri kibaya mukunguri basaba imirimo kubaka kiraro bahise babyivana mutwe bategura neza umukino apr kandi abatarakinnye ubushize bazaba bahari kandi n’umwuka mwiza kuko n’ubuyobozi buturi inyuma rayon sport izaba ikinisha mbere shampiyona abakinnyi babiri b’abarundi mbanza hussein ndayisaba tambwe floribert gihe mukino uheruka yatsinzwe apr yorohewe kubona amanota atatu imbere as kigali yayitsindaga ibitego busa apr irimo gushakisha igikombe shampiyona nayo ifite ibikombe byinshi izaba igendera cyane kapiteni wayo ukubutse i burayi olivier karekezi wanadutangarije n’ubwo abona rayon sport ikomeye ariko intsinzi ayizeye nyuma y’imyaka adahura n’iyi kipebiragaragara rayon sport mwaka ihagaze neza ariko kuba naragarutse apr mbona nzafasha cyane gushaka intsinzi ikindi kandi akenshi makipe ahuye ntakunda kunganya haba hagomba kuboneka ikipe itahana amanota atatu ariko ngendeye bushake dufite nk’abakinnyi apr tugomba gutsinda mu gihe rayon sport yatsinda mukino izaba ikomeje gusatira mukeba wayo apr guhatanira igikombe shampiyona ariko apr iramutse itsinze mukino yaba isize rayon sport amanota atandatu atakorohera ikipe rayon sport kuzayakuramo uyu mukino ukaba uhuriranye n’undi w’amakipe ahora ahanganye bwongereza manchester united manchester city byanatumye uwa rayon sport apr wagombaga kuzatangira saa cyenda wimurirwa saa kumi n’igice kugirango abakunda makipe bwongereza banakunda rayon apr batazacikanwa uyu mukino title: u bushinwa bwemereye u rwanda ubufatanye kugabanya ibitumizwa mahanga
content: perezida w’inteko ishinga amategeko umutwe sena bernard makuza yagiranye ibiganiro perezida w’inteko ishinga amategeko y’u bushinwa zhang dejiang ibiganiro byibanze buhahirane bw’ibihugu byombi guteza imbere inganda rwanda hagamijwe kugabanywa ibitumizwa mahanga ibiganiro bernard makuza zhang dejiang w’u bushinwa byibanze buhahirane politiki n’ubukungu hagati y’ibihugu byombi n’uburyo inteko zishinga amategeko z’ibihugu byombi zagirana imikoranire nyuma y’ibiganiro byabereye muhezo perezida sena bernard makuza yavuze u rwanda rushyize imbere iterambere ry’ubukungu bushingiye nganda kongerera agaciro ibikomoka buhinzi yagize u rwanda dushyize imbere iterambere by’ubukungu rishingiye nganda rinashingiye guhiguhindura duhinga tukabibyaza umusaruro tukabyongerera agaciro ibyo kimwe u bushinwa bwemeje buzakorana afurika mu rwanda twe tukaba tuzabishyira imbere kuko tubona bizadufasha kugabanya icyuho cy’ibyoherezwa hanze n’ibyo twinjiza gusa imikoranire y’ibihugu byombi igomba kuba ishingiye u rwanda rwifuza gushyiraho amananiza ashobora kuba atanunubahirizwa iwabo bushinwa ati twanongeye gushimangira ubutwererane n’umubano u rwanda rufitanye n’u bushinwa ushingiye bwubahane ushingiye gukorana atari ibintu biza byikubite nk’uko tujya tubona ibihugu bimwe bimwe bibikorera afurika makuza yavuze u rwanda rutakwemera ubufatanye bimwe bihugu bishaka umubano bigamije gutegeka bikorwa bitanayifitiye akamaro ibi biganiro byanagarutse mishinga inyuranye irimo kubaka imihanda ibitaro ibijyanye n’ingufu z’amashanyarazi kubaka ubushobozi bw’abakozi cyane ikoranabuhanga mu mpera z’u mwaka ushize perezida w’u bushinwa xi jinping yatangaje igihugu ayoboye cyageneye umugabane afurika miliyari z’amadoralimu rwego kuzamura iterambere ry’uyu mugabane binyuze mirongo y’ubufatanye ambasaderi w’u bushinwa rwanda pan hejun ukuboza yatangaje guverinoma y’u bushinwa izafasha iyubakwa ry’imihanda ihuza umujyi kigali ingana km ndetse inyandiko zateguwe neza buryo title: abayobozi b’uruganda rw’inzoga sofoki batawe yombi
content: bamwe bayobozi b’uruganda sofoki rukora inzoga ikomoka gitoki batawe yombi polisi bakaba bafungiwe sitasiyo remera mujyi kigali umuvugizi polisi mujyi kigali sunior superintendant ssp urbain mwiseneza yabwiye ikinyamakuru izuba rirashe bantu bakurikiranyweho icyaha cy’ubuhemu gihanwa n’ingingo y’igitabo cy’amategeko ahana y’u rwanda ssp mwiseneza aravuga hamaze gufatwa abantu bakekwaho ubufatanye cyaha ariko bishoboka hari n’abandi yirinze gusobanura byinshi byaha bakurikiranyweho avuga gusa bakurikiranyweho ubuhemu dushingiye makuru dufite ntangiriro z’uyu mwaka bayobozi b’uruganda bashobora gukurikiranwaho n’ibyaha by’ubwambuzi tariki gashyantare bamwe bakozi sofoki hamwe rwiyemezamirimo barugemuriraga ibikoresho bitandukanye birimo amacupa imifuniko y’amacupa ibisarubeti intebe n’ibindi babyukiye rwakoreraga murenge muyumbu ho karere rwamagana batera hejuru bavuga barambiwe kwamburwa n’abayobozi b’uruganda kandi leta ntacyo yakoze ibarenganure abagera bavuganye n’ikinyamakuru izuba rirashe bavuze hamwe baberewemo umwenda urenga amafaranga miliyoni abajijwe bitaba biri bakurikiranyweho ssp mwiseneza yavuze atari abizi ariko nabyo ahubwo polisi igiye kubikoraho iperereza edinah mukankuranza avuga sofoki imurimo ideni ry’amafaranga angana y’imifuniko y’amacupa yabagemuriye nk’uko bigaragazwa n’amasezerano bagiranye bakaba baragombaga kumwishyura nyuma y’iminsi mwesigye omar wagemuraga amacupa avuga aberewemo miliyoni godfrey avuga aberewemo umwenda miliyoni toni z’umuceri toni z’isukari yagemuriye uruganda nyakanga kandi akaba yaragombaga kwishyurwa minsi nyuma kugeza agemura ruganda ababerewemo imyenda bavuga ikibazo cyabo gisa n’aho hari abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze polisi bakirangaranye bw’inyungu bashobora kuba bagifitemo tariki gashyantare pierre clavers mugabushaka umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge muyumbu karere rwamagana sofoki yakoreraga yavuze uru ruganda yamenye rukorera murenge gukangurira abantu kuza muganda gushyingo kuko aribwo atangiye kuyobora murenge ati kopi dufite ofisi yemerera uru ruganda gukorera muyumbu mugabushaka yongeyeho ababajwe n’uko abayobozi b’uruganda batishyura babereyemo imyenda nk’uko babyemeye myanzuro y’inama zitandukanye bagiranye atangiye kuyobora murenge ati bahora bahindura itariki bemereye kwishyuraho kandi niko dukomeza kubona ibirego bishya by’abo babereyemo amadeni christophe gakuba umuyobozi wungirije w’uruganda yavuze impamvu yabateye kutishyura igihombo batewe n’umwe rwiyemezamirimo ariko akavuga noneho bazabishyura gashyantare gusa ababerewemo umwenda bavugaga muyobozi abeshya kuko bafite umugambi guhungira i burundi kuko bimwe bikoresho by’uruganda bamaze kubigurisha urundi ruganda rwenga inzoga y’ibitoki murenge supt benoit nsengiyumva umuvugizi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba gihe yabwiye ikinyamamkuru izuba rirashe telefoni kibazo atari akizi ariko agiye kugikurikirana guhera munsi gashyantare uru ruganda rukaba rwari ruzwi izina ac-com banana product rwayoborwaga francois xavier uwitonze murenge masaka rwimukiye murenge muyumbu ruhindura izina rwitwa sofoki ruyoborwa francois safari frederic umuhungu francois xavier uwitonze ariko safari yabwiye ikinyamakuru izuba rirashe batigeze bahindura izina ahubwo amashami yabaye menshi ssp mwiseneza yavuze bafataga bamwe bayobozi basanze uru ruganda rufite irindi zina ndetse rutaginakorera murenge muyumbu izuba rirashe

title: kwitwara neza buroko gufasha urukiko bimwe bitumye bagaragaza agiye kurekurwa
content: iki cyemezo cyafashwe tariki ukwakira n’umucamanza khalida rachid khan uyobora urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho u rwanda tpir gusaba irekurwa bagaragaza michel wakatiwe igihano gufungwa imyaka mwaka ushize amakuru kigalitodaycom gikesha itangazo ry’uryo rukiko aravuga mpamvu zatanzwe kumurekura harimo kuba urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha rwashyiriweho yougoslavia tpiy rufite imikorere ijya gusa n’iya tpir ruteganya imfungwa zakatiwe zishobora kurekurwa nyuma kumara bitatu kane by’igifungo barakatiwe kandi bagaragaza amaze imyaka afunze ukuvuga by’imyaka umunani yakatiwe izindi mpamvu michel bagaragaza ubwe yiyemeje kwishyikiriza urukiko akanemera yashinjwaga ndetse akerekana azi uburemere bwabyo akanabyicuza kuba yararanzwe n’imyitwarire myiza afungiye sude mugabane w’u burayi nyakanga umunyarwanda michel bagaragaza yahoze umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo ocir- ishami ry’icyayi akaba yarafatwaga nk’umwe nkoramutima juvnal habyarimana perezida w’u rwanda yamaze igihe ashakishwa tpir byaha kunoza umugambi jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kugira uruhare jenoside n’ubufatanyacyaha jenoside tariki kanama bagaragaza yishyikirije tpir bwende bwe yitaba urukiko munsi ukurikiyeho ariko ahakana byaha byose yashinjwaga nyuma y’aho bidashobokeye yoherezwa kuburanishirizwa rwanda nyuma kugirana imishyikirano yihariye n’ubushinjacyaha bagaragaza yemeye kuba yaragize uruhare ruziguye jenoside kuko yaremeye intwaro zari zigenewe gukora jenoside zibikwa ruganda rw’icyayi rubaya ndetse akaba yaranaguriraga interahamwe inzoga akanaziha amafaranga yemereye urukiko kandi yahaga interahamwe imodoka z’uruganda bazikoreshe ngendo zabo ariko yongeraho yabikoraga akiza amagara n’umuryango uko gufasha interahamwe bikaba aribyo byatumaga ubushinjacyaha buvuga yazorohereje akazi bigatuma zibasha kwica abantu bahungiye musozi kesho kiliziya nyundo utwo duce twose turi karere rubavu kubera kwemera yaregwaga kubisabira imbabazi imbere y’urukiko tariki ugushyingo bagaragaza yakatiwe igifungo cy’imyaka umunani kandi urukiko rutegeka hakurwamo igihe yafunzwe michel bagaragaza azafungurwa itariki ukuboza bivuze ashigaje ukwezi kumwe n’iminsi itandatu buroko ernestine musanabera

title: ikipe paris saint germain yaciye agahigo shampiyona y’iwabo
content: nyuma kunyagira ikipe troyes ibitego - pari saint germain yabimburiye amakipe mashampiyona akomeye i burayi gutwara shampiyonaiyi ikaba shampiyona kane batwaye bikurikiranya hari munsi w’imikino shampiyona ibi bivuzeko hasigayie imikino kuko shampiyona ikinwa n’amakipe iyi kipe yasuye troyes iyitsinda ibitego - as monaco kabiri yanganyije bituma ikinyuranyo kiba amanita kuko psg monaco ikagira ibi bisobanurako psg yatsindwa imikino isigaye monaco ikiyitsinda ikinyuranyo nticyavamo kuko imikino ifite amanita gusa rutahizamu zlatan ibrahimovic psg yatsinze ibitego mukino maze umukino urangiye avugako psg ishaka kumwonerera amasezerano bafata munara muremure w’i paris bakawusimbuza ishusho yeuyu mugabo w’umunyadushya cyane cyane magambo avuva yuzuye agasuzugura n’ubwirasi aherutse gusezerera ikipe chelsea kuko bitego - psg yatsinze chelsea mikino yombi iblahimovic yatsinzemo nyuma yuko haje abanyaziya b’abarabu bakamena ifaranga nuri kipe shampiyona y’ubufaransa yahinduye icyerecyezo mu myaka yashize shampiyona yasaga nk’iyihariwe olympique lyone kuko yatwaye ibikombe birenga myaka nk’icumi gusa ikimaze kwigaragaza gihugu guhangana guhari umutoza psg laurent blanc yahoraga asabwa n’abanyamuryango b’iyi kipe kgutera intambwe akarenga ibya shampiyona agasatira uefa championsleague ibi nabya arikubigendamo neza kuko cy’irangiza ndetse akaba ageze yaratsinzwe umukino umwe gusa hategerejwe kumenya azasimbuka cyiciro agashimisha abafaransa abageza muru uefa championsleague yanditswe rukundo xavermuhaburarw

title: rwambikanye kubera ruswa ivuza ubuhuha serivisi mbi by’ubutaka
content: bamwe baturage hirya hino gihugu baravuga barambiwe gusiragizwa gihe barimo gushaka ibyangombwa by’ubutaka bwabo barasaba kibazo cyashakirwa umuti urambye umuryango ushinzwe kurwanya ruswa n’akarengane transperancy internation rwanda uvuga kimwe bituma serivisi ziba mbi harimo ruswa ku rundi ruhande ariko ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubutaka kikavuga ruswa irimo mukandoli donatille umubyeyi ufite imyaka y’amavuko afite ubutaka murenge nduba w’akarere gasabo ho atuye kuva gicurasi yirukanse cyangombwa cy’ubutaka bwe ariko kugeza ntarakibona we abyita gusiragizwa n’inzengo zibishinzwe ati ntabwo murenge ubikoramo yambwiye byuzuye bibaye karere none babinshubije maboko none naje murenge bumbogo gushaka indi attetastion yataye agaciro’’ mukanyiligira charlotte murenge abashinzwe ubutaka banyimye icyemezo reba nzu ukuntu imeze irava imvura iguye irava nkareka utubasi udusahane baranjuragije bariyangira rwose umwana yarayujuje’’ uretse hirya hino gihugu abaturage title: u bubiligi bwahaye u rwanda urutonde rw’ibikoresho ndangamurage bubitse birimo igisingo cy’umwami rwabugili
content: urutonde rw’ibyo bimenyetso byashyikirijwe umuyobozi w’ingoro z’umurage w’u rwanda amb masozera robert kane hafungurwaga mugaragaro imurika ry’uruhare rw’abanyarwanda abarundi n’abanye-congo ntambara mbere y’isi umuyobozi w’ingoro y’umurage nyafurika bubiligi ibitse byinshi bikoresho guido gryseels yashyikirije masozera ’flash disk’ iriho urutonde rw’ibikoresho ndangamateka bisaga ibihumbi bibiri by’u rwanda biri hirya hino nzu ndangamurage z’u bubiligi ni nyuma y’ubusabe u rwanda rwagejeje gihugu rumenye neza umurage warwo bubuligi nyuma ruzabone kujya biganiro by’uburyo byagarurwa nubwo umwanzuro kugarura bikoresho utarafatwa guido gryseels yashimangiye umurage w’abanyafurika ubitswe i burayi ugomba kugarurwa yagize ni ibisannzwe murage nyafurika burayi ugaruka ibindi bihugu byinshi afurika byashyizeho komisiyo bamenye umurage ndangametka w’ibihugu byabo byajyanywe burayi umwaka ushize robert yansabye namufasha kumenya ibintu ndangamurage by’u rwanda biri burayi none intambwe mbere nishimiye kumuhereza urutonde rw’ibintu ndangamurage biri nzu ndangamurage zacu hariho amafoto y’igihe byajyaniwe byajyanywe byakoreshwaga guido yavuze hari n’imyiteguro igeze kure gushyikiriza u rwanda inyandiko n’amakarita byafashwe gihe cy’ubukoloni bigaragaza ibiri munsi y’ubutaka bw’u rwanda nk’umutungo kamere amabuye y’agaciro n’ibindi yavuze bigenze neza mutarama cyangwa gashyantare umwaka utaha bimenyetso ndangamurage bigaragaza munsi y’ubutaka byaba byashyikirijwe u rwanda ati hari gahunda gushyira ikoranabuhanga ishyinguranyandiko zose z’u rwanda ziri bubiligi ni intambwe ikomeye ntekereza turi igihugu mbere burayi kubikorera gutyo igihugu afurika kandi ndabizeza umucyo gusangira ibimenyetso ndangamurage inyandiko amafoto amajwi n’amashusho dufite amb masozera yabwiye igihe bishimiye kwakira urwo rutonde kuko bizagaragaza neza umutungo gakondo w’abanyarwanda bubiligi kugira u rwanda rubone rutangira ibiganiro ugarurwe yavuze ngoro ibitse amateka afurika iherereye i tervuren bubiligi hari ibikoresho byinshi by’umurage w’abanyarwanda birimo ibikoresho byakoreshwaga kera ingoma zirimo n’iz’ibwami inyamaswa zabaga rwanda nk’inyambo yumishijwe igisingo cy’umwami kigeli iv rwabugili indirimbo amashusho n’amafoto bigaragaza abanyarwanda hambere n’ibindi bivugwa bubiligi hari umugogo w’umwami yuhi v musinga icyakora masozera yavuze bitarasobanuka neza kuko gihamya wajyanyweyo yavuze kuba u rwanda ruhawe urwo rutonde intangiriro y’ibiganiro biganisha kugarura murage w’amateka rwanda yagize bafite inyandiko nyinshi buryo bazibara burebure zikaba zishobora kurenga ikirometero ni inyandiko zaba izakoreshwaga butegetsi bucukuzi bazaduha ibijyanye n’ibiri munsi y’ubutaka bw’u rwanda ubukungu buri butaka bw’u rwanda barabuzi bafite amakarita buryo abantu bashobora kumenya ahari zahabu diyama n’ibindi byinshi bihugu afurika byakolonijwe biri rugamba kugarurirwa umurage w’amateka yabyo watwawe n’abanyaburayi gihe cy’ubukoloni mu minsi ishize u bufaransa bwasubije sngal inkota yibwe indwanyi yayo omar saidou tall kinyejana uretse u bubiligi u rwanda runafite ibindi bikoresho inyandiko n’ibirango ndangamurage byajyanywe budage kuko nacyo igihugu cyarukolonije masozera yavuze ibiganiro byatangiye gihugu kibitse kibigarure igihugu cy’u butaliyani nubwo kitakolonije u rwanda ariko kibitse inyandiko zarwo kubera kiliziya harimo igiho none cyatangiye kugabanuka nyiricyubahiro musenyeri w’itorero angilikani rwanda diyoseze byumba emmanuel ngendahayo ashima kuvura amaso byagenze neza gihe cy’iminsi igi kigorwa cyamaze bugenerwa umurwayi w’amaso nubwo umubare w’abarwayi waruse ubufasha abacikanywe bashyizwe kurutonde bityo bakazaherwaho ubutahaabandi bajyanwe n’itorero kuvurirwa mubindi bitaro ishimwe title: ubwirinzi bw’umubiri ushobora kurwara coronavirus kabiri
content: ubwirinzi bw’umubiri nibwo burebwa cyane n’ibibazo nk’ibi abantu bakibaza coronavirus gusa ikibazo tuzi bicyeya ushobora gukira coronavirus ukongera ukayandura urukingo rwayo ruzakora iyi virus izahora igaruka buri gihe cy’urugaryi ni gute tuzahangana nayo buryo burambye iyi inkuru y’umunyamakuru bbc wibanda gusa siyansi n’ubuzima ni gute umubiri ugira ubudahangarwa covid- ubwirinzi bw’umubiri wacu kurwanya indwara buza byiciro bibiri ikiciro mbere igihora kiteguye kurwanya ikintu cyose kibangamiye umubiri kiwugezemo ni nk’ubutabazi bwihuse burekura ibinyabutabire bitera ubushyuhe hamwe n’insoro zera white blood cells bigatwika uturemangingo twagezweho n’uburwayi gusa buryo ntabwo bukora coronavirus kuko ntibuyimenya bityo ntabwo buyikurinda ahubwo ukenera ubundi buryo kabiri bw’imikorere nk’iyo bushobora kuyimenya ubwo burimo insoro zikora uturindamubiriabasirikare b’umubiri antibodies dushobora kumenya virus kuyihagarika n’insoro zishobora gutera zikica uturemangingo twagezweho n’iyi virus iyo buryo bw’ubwirinzi bw’umubiri bushya bukomeye bihagije buha umubiri kwibuka bihoraho iriya virus igihe cyose yazagaruka ukayirwanya ntabwo bizwi neza abantu bwibuka neza indwara zimwe zimwe ariko rimwe rimwe bukibagirwa izindi ubu bwirinzi bwibuka cyane indwara nk’iseru - kuyirwara rimwe ukayikira biha ubwirinzi ubushobozi buhoraho kuyibuka gusa hari ubwirinzi bw’umubiri bumara bukiyibuka gusa hari izindi coronavirus esheshatu zifata abantu zatanga ishusho enye zigira ibimenyetso nk’iby’ibicurane ubwirinzi buyibagirwa vuba ubushakashatsi title: umuvugizi w’ingabo yashimiye umuhate mukazi abasirikare b’u rwanda bagira
content: ingabo z’u rwanda zabungabungaga amahoro i darfur sudani zageze rwanda zivuga ibigwi by’ibikorwa zagezeho birimo kurinda abaturage ndetse n’ibikorwa birimo kubavura kubaha amazi meza kububakira ibitaro amashuri ndetse n’ibigo bifasha urubyiruko kwiga imyugan’ibindi ubwo bakirwaga i kanombeumuvugizi w’ingabo yabashimiye umuhate mukazi abashimira babaye abambasaderi beza b’u rwanda brig gen joseph nzabamwita umuvugizi w’igisirikare cy’u rwanda yagize bakoze akazi kabo umwaka wose ubuyobozi rdf bubashimiye akazi bakoze ingabo rdf ziri butumwa bw’amahoro burya ziba abambasaderi b’u rwanda brig gen nzabamwita aravuga u rwanda aricyo gihugu gishyira imbere kurinda abasivile isi yakomeje agira muzi perezida paul kagame kumwe n’uwa amerika nzeri i new york bashyize imbere ikintu kurinda abasivile perezida kagame kandi nyuma yemeye kongera batayo zizajya kurinda amahoro isi hamwe n’umutwe w’abapolisi w’abagore ndetse kongera ibitaro bindi rwego kabiri level hospital byiyongera bindi dufite central afurika brig gen nzabamwita yagize ingabo zikora rwanda niko zibikora butumwa bw’amahoro kurinda amahoro gusa si ukujya burinzi burya amahoro arambye harimo kubaka amashuri n’ibindi dukoze ibikorwa by’iterambere n’abahanganye bihugu batangira kuvuga abanyarwanda bakora bikaba byaratumye batera imbere kuki twe twabirengahoumuvugizi w’ingabo z’u rwanda kandi aravuga mutarama u rwanda ruzatangira nabwo gusimuranya basirikare barwo central afurika mujyi bangui nyuma hagakomeza basirikare sudani y’epfo mujyi juba marakai col happy ruvusha uyoboye basirikare bababaga i darfur yavuze bishimira ibikorwa basize bakoze aka gace kuko binashimwa cyane n’aba baturage bahasize col ruvusha agira twubahirije ubutumwa twatumwe n’igihugu bujyanye n’inshingano twari dufite burimo kurinda abaturage n’ibindi bikorwa gusa twe twemera umutekano atari ukurinda amahoro gusa ahubwo n’ibindi bikorwa bituma bagira umutekano birakorwa avuga abasirikare b’u rwanda bavuye abarwayi bubaka amazu amashuri ndetse harimo n’ay’imyugakugeza kandi ingabo z’u rwanda zisize zubatse ishuri gace al-fashir rizigirwamo n’abana b’abakobwa u rwanda rufite abasirikare barimo batayo ziri i darfur ziri sudani y’epfo umutwe w’ingabo zirwanira kirere batayo i bangui central afurika yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: cia iravuga antonov buhitane perezida tshisekedi yarashwe misile nkiyahanuye iya perezida habyarimana
content: urwego rw’ubutasi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika cia rwagaragaje ibimenyetso iraswa ry’indege itwaye ibikoresho felix tshisekedi antonov runamusaba kwirinda cyane nyuma y’aho bivugwa indege ’antonov ’ yarashwe buhitane ndetse bakemeza misile yarashwe imeze nk’iyarashe indege habyarimana wabaye perezida w’u rwanda bikarangira inamuhitanye iyi ndege yaburiwe irengero ukwakira yaturukaga mugi goma yerekeza murwa mukuru kinshasa ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe indege gisivile cyatangaje ndege yabuze itumanaho hashize iminota ihagurutse byatangiye bivugwa yaguye ntara maniema nyuma haza amakuru abihakana aheruka avuga ndege yaguye ntara sankuru ikoze impanuka ibimenyetso cia bihakana makuru inyandiko twakiriye iy’ukuri mu itangazo riburira perezida felix tshisekedi cia yashyize hanze ukwakira harimo ubutumwa bugira buti ibiro by’ubusesenguzi cia byafashe amafoto y’icyogajuru ihanuka ry’indege antonov itwaye ibikoresho flix thisekedi iturutse i goma ukwakira ubwo kirere amakuru yerekana igihe punia maniema ndege yarashishijwe misile bwoko sa- ariko ntiyahise igwa hasi yakomeje kuguruka ibirometero bike igenda igabanya umuvuduko igwa ntara sankuru cia ikomeze ivuga bwoko misilesa- bwarashe indege juvenal habyarimana wabaye perezida w’u rwanda hamwe n’indege gisivile congo airlines ukwakira ntara maniema cia ivuga misile eshanu sa- sa- sa- umutwe warwanyaga ubutegetsi laurent kabila rcd ubifashijwemo alex thambwe mwamba uyoboye umutwe sena congokinshasa bivugwa yazibitse uyu mutwe ushyigikiwe rwanda gihe perezida pasteur bizimungu utaravugaga rumwe n’ingoma laurent kabila ngo misile enye zabitswe maniema ho thambwe avuka cia ivuga amakuru ikura muntu uba thambwe avuga yagiraga uruzinduko ntara nzeri azanywe kumenya misile zigikora mpamvu yamuzanye cia ivuga thambwe yakoranaga theoneste twagirayesu wataziriwe twagira’ cyangwa twaribu’ twagirayezu afite ipeti colonel’ mutwe w’ingabo rcd akaba uvugwaho kurasa indege gisivile uyu giturage makunju ntara maniema ku musozo cia ivuga busesenguzi yakoze isanga flix tshisekedi ugambiriwe kwicwa bityo igasaba mukuru w’igihugu kwirinda bikomeye alexis thambwe ukekwa kuba inyuma y’igitero yaba ashaka alexis thambwe yagiye sena yinjiriye ihuriro ry’amashyaka politiki rihagarariwe joseph kabila fcc bikaba bivugwa inshuti magara birashoboka yashaka guhirika ubutegetsi tshisekedi byamukundira agahita amusimbura itegekonshinga congokinshasa rivuga haramutse habaye impamvu ituma perezida watowe atabasha kuyobora nk’urupfu kwegura cyangwa intege nke z’umubiri yasimburwa mwanya perezida sena aha alexis thambwe yahita umukuru w’igihugu fcc kabila igasubirana ubutware bwose dore isaranganyije n’ihuriro ry’amashyaka cach tshisekedi umuhango gufungura laboratwari y’ubuhinzi mbere afurika hari abakuru b’ibihugu batumiwe bazitabire umuhango gufungura laboratwari y’ubuhinzi nini ntara kivu y’amajyepfo barimo uw’ u rwanda paul kagame pierre nkurunziza w’u burundi uhuru kenyatta kenya hatumiwe kandi bamwe babayeho abakuru b’ibihugu joseph kabila wabaye uwa congokinshasa akaba n’umusenateri uhoraho gihugu nk’uko biteganywa n’itegekonshinga ndetse olusegun obasanjo wabaye perezida nigeria kugeza witiriwe laboratwari gace kalambo ikibazo cyibazwa kiragira kiti ese kutitabira kw’abatumirwa kwatewe kwikanga umutekano muke impamvu baperezida yewe joseph kabila watangije umushinga laboratwari butegetsi batahageze byasabye tshisekedi n’abari bitabiriye muhango ukwakira bategereza obasanjo igihe kirekire kuko byavuzwe yahageze akarewe mu gihe havugwa umutekano thsisekedi ku ukwakira abagize ishyaka riri butegetsi udps bakoreye imyigaragambyo y’amahoro mugi kananga ho tshisekedi avuka basaba monusco kurinda umutekakano flix tshisekedi ni ikibazo kitoroshye kuko byakomeje kuvugwa tshisekedi atatsinda amatora y’umukuru w’igihugu ahubwo yashyizweho ruhare rukomeye joseph kabila yasimbuye ukemangwa cyane n’abaturage joseph kabila avugwaho gukoresha tshisekedi harimo kubangamira imiyoborere harimo gufata ibyemezo yifuza tubibutse ihuriro ry’amashyaka fcc riyobowe kabila ryo rifite imyanya myinshi nteko ishinga amategeko guverinoma bivugwa inzego zikomeye z’igihugu igihe cyibazwa byaba bidasanzwe kuko ubundi byagaragaye n’ahandi bene masezerano atarama kuko burya bigoye kubona umuyobozi ’utegekerwaho’ aya masezerano hari abayita nk’ikiziriko tshisekedi yaba yarishyizwe ijosi cyangwa se akaba ameze nk’uwiyambitse amapingu bikaba biri kumugiraho ingaruka amasezerano y’ibanga hagati tshisekedi kabila yamaganwe bamwe batavuga rumwe n’ubutegetsi barimo martin fayulu ugize ihuriro lamuka ririmo jean pierre bemba adolphe muzito antipas bumba moise katumbi freddy matungulu gusangira imyanya buyobozi bukuru byiswe tshisekedi agambaniye abaturage kuko ntibifuzaga kabila agaruka miyoborere congokinshasa fayulu n’abo bahuje ibitekerezo bavuga tshisekedi yabatetereje rugamba baratangiye rusa n’urwo kubohora igihugu imibare y’abaguye mpanuka gatumwa title: coronavirus umukinnyi juventus arayirwaye nba yahagaritswe
content: daniele rugani umutaliyani akaba myugariro w’ikipe y’umupira w’amaguru juventus de turin basanze afite virus yamaze gutangazwa nk’icyorezo muri amerika ho umukinnyi w’ikipe basketball utah jazz basanze afite virus byatumye kane batangaza imikino nba ibaye ihagaritswe daniele rugani w’imyaka yashyizwe kato kimwe n’abantu bahuye nk’uko juventus yabitangaje ibikorwa byose by’imikino butaliyani byarahagaritswe kugeza tariki z’ukwezi kane gihe kandi butaliyani ibikorwa byinshi buzima busanzwe byahagaritswe rugani cyumweru ntebe y’abasimbura b’ikipe juve yatsindaga inter milan ibitego bibiri busa rugani kandi asanzwe umukinnyi w’ikipe y’igihugu y’ubutaliyani ku cyumweru yagaragaje ifoto rwambariro rw’abakinnyi kumwe bagenzi bishimira intsinzi inter milan coronavirus nba nba yatangaje imikino iteganyijwe isubitswe kuwa gatatu nijoro kuwa kane gitondo aka karere kugeza rindi tangazo ni nyuma y’uko hari umukinnyi utah jazz basanzemo virus nk’uko kipe yabitangaje ibi byatangajwe mbere gato y’umukino ugiye guhuza jazz oklahoma city thunder ugahita usubikwa joro ryo kuwa gatatu amerika nba yatangaje umukinnyi basanganye ndwara atari yaje mukino abakinnyi babiri jazz rudy gobert emmanuel muddiay ntibari bagombaga gukina mukino cyangwa kibuga amakuru ataremezwa n’ababishijwe avuga mukinnyi umufaransa rudy gobert nyiri ikipe dallas mavericks mark cuban yumvise ibyatangajwe nba ijoro ryakeye yagize atinatekereje nko gushyenga ndumva atari ukuri wagira filimi undi mukino ugiye guhuza sakramento kings new orleans pelicans ijoro ryakeye nawo wahise usubikwa bbc

title: guverineri gatete arasaba ubufatanye gufasha abatishoboye

title: rusizi abana b’incuke bigiraga munsi y’ibiti bubakiwe amashuri y’icyitegererezo
content: nyuma y’igihe kirekire abana hagati y’imyaka itatu n’itanu kagari ryamuhirwaumurenge nkungu karere rusizi bigira munsi y’ibiti ababyeyi n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere rusizi barishimira gikemutse nyuma kubona ibyumba by’amashuri bitatu by’icyitegererezo nk’uko bwizacom yabitangarijwe n’uhagarariye umuryango nyafurika w’ivugabutumwa aee karere rusizi uwitonze alfred safi nyuma kubona ibibazo bikomeye bana barimo kubura bigira bigatuma bamwe babyeyi batitabira gushyira abana mashuri y’inshuke muryango nkunga y’umuryango w’abaholandi witwa ’world servant’ ubinyujije wundi muryango gikirisitu witwa help a child rwanda wiyemeje kububakira amashuri meza bazajya bigiramo nk’uko akomeza abivuga bana bubakiwe ibyumba by’amashuri ibiro by’abarimu n’ububiko bw’ibikoresho by’ishuri igikoni kizifashishwa gutegurira amafunguro bana utwumba tw’ubwiherero ikigega cy’amazi litilo n’akarima k’igikoni kazafasha kubonera imboga zijya mafungora byose hamwe byuzuye bitwaye miliyoni z’amanyarwanda ibi byumba bifite ubushobozi kwakira abana kandi byujuje ibyangombwa byose bisabwa minisiteri y’uburezi bikaba bibaye igisubizo gikomeye cyane babyeyi n’abana b’aka gacenk’uko ababyeyi babigaragazaaho bashima leta y’ubumwe yita bana kugeza nshuke cyaro kayiranga jean berchimas uhagarariye ababyeyi baharererayavuze nk’ibitangaza kubona abana babonye bigira hezamu gihe mbere bigiraga munsi y’ibiti cyondo n’ivumbi n’intebe bagira ababyeyi bafite abana bato bakaba bagiye gushishikarizwa kubazana ishuri bakiga yagize ati’’ abana bacu bigiraga hari hababaje cyane ndetse byatumaga bamwe babyeyi batazana abana n’abaje bagahita bigendera kuko bumvaga atari ubuzima bashobora kwirirwa bicaye gisambu izuba ryaba ryinshi cyane bakugama biti bihariimvura yagwa bakajya kubyigana n’abo mashuri abanzaabandi ntibabe bacyize neza’’ yakomeje agira ati’’ bitwereka urukundo leta irangajwe imbere nyakubahwa perezida kagame ikunda abana kugeza kubonera amashuri nk’aya inshuke cyaro nk’iki tugiye kuyafata neza kuko tumaze kumva bagiye kutwubakira twumvise dusubijwe cyane yaje tuyakeneye bikomeye ntitwabura kuyabyaza umusaruro ufatika’’ pasiteri rukema ezchiel ushinzwe urubyiruko n’ubukungu muryango ufasha abana bato kugira imibereho myiza help a child yavuze n’ibikoresho nk’intebe nziza n’imfashanyigisho z’abarezi bizashyirwa mo bakaba bazakomeza kwita burezi aka karere bakorera hoseaho umwaka utaha bazubaka n’irindi nk’iri murenge nyakarenzo ku byerekeranye kwita barezi bw’aba bana yagize ati’’ twarabiteguye kuko tumaze gufasha ababyeyi gukora amatsinda arenga kwizigamira buryo kurihira ababigishiriza abana bitaba imbogamizi gihe leta igishakisha umuti urambye w’iki kibazokandi twizeye ngorane zizaba mo kuko natwe tuzabahora hafi’’ uretse gushyikiriza ababyeyi byumba by’amashuriabahungu n’abakobwa bigishijwe imyuga n’uyu muryango bahawe impamyabumenyi n’ibikoresho bizabafasha kwihangira imirimo umuyobozi w’ishami ry’uburezi aka karere hagenimana title: rutsiro kugurisha amatungo bahabwa bikomeje guca intege abafatanyabikorwa
content: usaid croix rouge abafatanyabikorwa iterambere akarere rutsiro baranenga abaturage baha amatungo bagahita bayagurisha kuyorora abateze imbere usaid ifatanyije caritas rwanda bafite gahunda yitwa gimbuka ifasha ababyeyi guca imirire mibi bana aha babaha amatungo ariko ugasanga hari abahise bayagurisha bityo ntakemure ikibazo cyari gihari muri mushinga itanga amatungo magufi ariyo inkoko ingurube ndetse n ihene ariko harimo abahita bayagurisha bigaca intege abayabahaye rurangirwa augustin ukuriye ishami rirwanya imirire mibi mushinga agira ibi biratudindiza ntitubashe kugera ntego tuba twariyemeje kuko duhora manza rurangirwa agustin ukorera caritas mushinga ihuriheyo usaid abaturage baganiriye numunyamakuru nonahacom bamubwiye ikibatera kuyagurisha ubukene ntaganda jonathan murenge gihango yagize abana ntibaburara kabiri ihene iziritse mbure kuyigurisha inzara ntiyarinda kumpitana kandi mfite itungo si usaid gusa ifite bazo cyabagenerwabikorwa bahita bagurisha amatungo ibagenera kuko croix rouge igifite ibi byemejwe habarugira isaac uyiyobora turere twa karongi rutsiro aya matungo yahawe abantu bakennye cyane buryo niyo bayagurishije badapfa kubona uburyo babahana

content: ikinyamakuru canada cyitwa journal de qubec cyatangaje revenu canada yagwatiriye inzu corneille i lorraine majyaruguru y’umujyi montral iyo inzu kugurishwa cyamunara ifite agaciro k’amadorali y’amerika amafaranga y’u rwanda arenga miliyoni magana atatu minisiteri canada ishinzwe imisoro ivuga corneille agomba kwishyura amadorali y’amerika frws harimo n’inyungu kugira hubahirizwe itegeko rigenga imisoro gihugu corneille yatangarije journal de qubec amateka y’ibyo byose aturuka bibazo by’amafaranga amaranye igihe bituruka kibazo yagiranye n’inzu imutunganyiriza umuziki yagize ndi bibazo nk’abandi bahanzi sinashoboraga gukora nshyiye ahagaragara indirimbo kubera kibazo cyatumye umutungo wanjye uhungabana corneille akomeza avuga afitanye ibibazo minisiteri ebyiri canada zishinzwe iby’imisoro ariko iya kabiri ariyo revenu qubec ntabwo yigeze ibikurikirana nk’uko revenu canada yabigenje yagize ikibazo nagiranye n’inzu intunganyiriza umuziki cyanteje igihombo gikomeye ariko ubungubu tumeranye neza buryo nizera ngiye bibazo corneille avuga minsi imbere azatangira kugurisha qubec album izina ryayo ntirizwi iriho indirimbo ze iyo album akaba yarayikoreye bufaransa mwaka norbert niyizurugero

title: rulindo barasaba kugabanyirizwa umusoro bigori bacuruza
content: jean pierre ngerageze umwe bacuruza ibigori avuga amafaranga y’ inyungu bakura bucuruzi bwabo bahita bayatanga byinshi bigatuma babona kamaro gafatika bubafitiye agira ngunguru y’ ibigori nshobora kungukaho amafaranga nkishyura umusoro ndetse n’inkwi ngasigarana gusa mukanyindo berancille avuga amafaranga babona bucuruzi bw’ibigori adahwanye n’imirimo bakoze kubitegura agira batwaka umusoro uhanitse twakuramo amafaranga y’ishyiramwe ndetse n’ayo kugura inkwi ugasanga usigaranye ubusa umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’ umurenge base mwigira antoine avuga batari bazi kibazo ariko bagiye kugikurikiranira akarengane kazagaragara kagakemuke mwigira avuga kandi bazitonda bakareba gukabya birimo kuko umuntu ashobora kuba asoreshwa bijyanye n’agaciro k’ibyo acuruza jean noel mugabo

title: ngoma abavugabutumwa barwaniye rusengero ibyari amasengesho biba induru
content: abavugabutumwa itorero inkuru nziza ryo karere ngoma ntara y’uburasirazuba bafatanye mashati barwanira rusengero imbere y’abayoboke bazanywe kumva ijambo ry’imana ndetse bamwe bayoboke bafatanya nabo kurwana bituma ibyari amasengesho bihinduka induru n’akavuyo kaje guhoshwa polisi y’u rwanda yahise itabara ita yombi nyirabayazana abavugabutumwa itorero inkuru nziza ryo karere ngoma ntara y’uburasirazuba bafatanye mashati barwanira rusengero imbere y’abayoboke bazanywe kumva ijambo ry’imana ndetse bamwe bayoboke bafatanya nabo kurwana bituma ibyari amasengesho bihinduka induru n’akavuyo kaje guhoshwa polisi y’u rwanda yahise itabara ita yombi nyirabayazana ibi byabaye gitondo cyumweru tariki gicurasi rusengero rw’itorero inkuru nziza cyasemakamba karere ngoma ntara y’uburasirazuba abavugabutumwa matsinda abiri bashyamiranye kugeza amasengesho yaje gusubikwa n’imirwano ahubwo polisi igata yombi abagera gihe iperereza ryahise ritangira amakuru y’ubu bushyamirane yanemejwe ip emmanuel kayigi umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda ntara y’uburasirazuba wabwiye ikinyamakuru ukwezicom intandaro y’ubwo bushyamirane yabaye kuba hari abashumba bahinduranyijwe bakoreraga ariko abakuwe cyasemakamba bakanga kuhava nabo bashyamiranye n’abashya bahimuriwe n’ubuyobozi bw’itorero inkuru nziza rwego rw’igihugu ip emmanuel kayigi avuga hari abayobozi b’itorero inkuru nziza boherejwe n’ubuyobozi bukuru bw’iri torero gukorera cyasemakamba karere ngoma hanyuma abari bahasanzwe nabo bakahabakura ariko cyumweru bashya bazaga bakaba bimwe uburenganzira n’abahasanzwe batangira kurwanira indangururamajwi ndetse bamwe baca insinga z’umuriro wakoreshwaga bararwana ariko ntihagira ukomeretsa kuko ubuyobozi bwahise butabara polisi igahita ita yombi abagera batangiye gukorwaho iperereza harebwe impamvu y’iyo midugararo gushyamirana ip emmanuel kayigi umuvugizi polisi ntara y’uburasirazuba polisi ntara y’uburasirazuba ivuga ibibazo by’ubushyamirane biri itorero binazwi n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere ngoma kuburyo birimo gushakirwa umuti n’inzego z’ubuyobozi zitandukanye gihe hagitegerejwe polisi inasuzuma ibyabaye irebe byahabwa inyito y’amakosa asanzwe cyangwa ibyaha bagomba gukurikiranwaho

content: mu biganiro yagiranye minisitiri w’intebe w’u rwanda gatatu tariki protais ayangma ayang yatangaje amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi akwiye kugira uruhare iterambere ry’igihugu kuko guverinoma y’u rwanda iyafasha gukora neza ayang yagize abanyamakompanyi bakwiye gukoresha umutungo wabo kuzamura ubukungu bw’igihugu uhagarariye ishyirahamawe nyarwanda ry’amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi assar marc rugenera yatangaje leta yabemereye inkunga irenzeho kugira ibikorwa byabo bikomeze bijye imbere yavuze nubwo u rwanda rukiri inyuma bijyanye n’ubwishingizi afite icyizere ariko abanyarwanda bagenda basobanurirwa bazarushaho byumva cote d’ivoire cameroun nibyo bihugu bihagaze neza bwishingizi afurika congo-brazzaville iza isonga bigo byinshi by’ubwishingizi byeguriwe abikorera u rwanda rugeze isoko ry’ubwishingizi gihe ibihugu byateye imbere bigeze ubwishingizi binyabiziga nibwo buri hejuru cyane rwanda kubera itegeko leta risaba ababitunze kubifatira ubwishingizi inama ihuje amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi afrika yibumbiye mpuzamashyirahamwe nyafurika y’uburenganzira bwishingizi fanaf iteraniye i kigali tariki - fanaf ihuriwemo n’ibigo by’ubwishingizi ikaba ifite icyicaro senegal emmanuel n hitimana

title: uburwayi umutwe indwara nk’izindi kandi buravurwa
content: mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kabiri tariki ukwakira dr kayiteshonga yvonne ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iby’ubuzima mutwe minisiteri y’ubuzima yagaragaje intera urwanda rumaze gutera mubijyanye guteza imbere ubuzima umutwe ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu karere hakaba harimo politiki nshya kwegereza abanyarwanda ubuvuzi bujyanye n’indwara umutwe kuburyo nibura byazagera kurwego rw’ibigo nderabuzima kuko kugeza hari abaganga b’ubuvuzi bw’uburwayi umutwe rwego rw’akarere gusa hashyizweho kandi serivisi yakira ikanasuzuma abafite ibibazo by’uburwayi umutwe yunganira ibitaro by’indera hatanzwe ibitabo bifasha abunganira ibikorwa by’ubuzima habayeho gufatanya n’izindi nzego leta guhangana niki kibazo igihe bibaye ngombwa nko gihe cy’inkiko gacaca gufatanya komisiyo ishinzwe gusezerera gusubiza mubuzima busanzwe ingabo zavuye kurugeroyasobanuye kandi uburwayi umutwe uburwayi nk’ubundi ndetse hari n’ubushobora kuvurwa bugakira ikibazo cy’uburwayi mumutwe rwanda kigenda gifata intera umwaka utashye nkuko imibare y’abitabira servise z’ubu buvuzi ibigaragaza mwaka umubare w’abagannye buvuzi abantu mwaka mwaka bamaze kugera umwaka ushize abagannye serivisi uretse kuba u rwanda rwarahuye jenoside ndetse n’ingaruka zayo zimwe muzindi mpamvu zitera kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare abanyarwanda bamaze gukangukira kwitabira gahunda z’ubuvuzi cyane cyane kuko banafite ubwisungane kwivuza ikindi imyumvire igenda ihinduka kuko ubundi wasangaga abafite burwayi barafungiranwaga bagahezwa bagahishwa cyangwa bakavurizwa mubavuzi gihanga mubapfumu bumwe buvuzi buhabwa abafite burwayi harimo imiti gufashwa buryo bw’ibiganiro hamwe kubafasha kwongera gusubira buzima busanzwe buryo butatu hari ushobora kubuhabwa bwose hari n’ushobora guhabwa bumwe cyakora uburyo gusubizwa buzima busanzwe bakaba babuhuriraho nubwo ariko hari ibyakozwe nibiteganywa gukorwa inzitizi ziracyahari izagarutsweho nk’ikibazo cy’imyumvire itari myiza ndwara mumutwe abantu bagitekereza uzirwaye atakiri umuntu muzima wagira akamaro bityo agahabwa akato imyumvire nimwe ijyana n’umuco ndetse n’imyizerere benshi bazita amarozi bagahitamo kugana abapfumu cyangwa hakaba abazifata nk’amadayimoni bakaguma nsengero ntibavuzwe ikindi umubare w’inzobere buvuzi ukiri muto rwanda mu butumwa bwatanzwe harimo kumva ikibazo cy’uburwayi umutwe icya buri wese kandi uwahuye nabwo akitabwaho mumuryango hakabaho guhindura imyumvire ndwara hakorwa ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira imikoranire hagati ministeri y’ubuzima n’abavuzi gihanga kuko usanga abafite burwayi abenshi ariho babanza bigatuma bagera kubuvuzi nyabwo batinze ikindi nabagize ibyago kuzirwara bakwiye gufashwa bakanitabwaho muryango nyarwanda kuko uburwayi umutwe nabwo uburwayi nkubundi ndetse nuwahuye nabwo akongera kwakirwa buzima busanzwe marie jose ikibasumba

title: urubyiruko rurakangurirwa kugira uruhare rugaragara gahunda z’icyunamo
content: mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru mbere y’amasaha make u rwanda n’isi bitangire kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi umuhuzabikorwa w’inama y’igihugu y’urubyiruko philbert uwiringiyimana yasabye urubyiruko guhagarika gahunda rwari rusanzwe rukora zagaragara nk’izidaha kwibuka agaciro uwiringiyimana yibukije urubyiruko rudakwiye gufata igihe kwibuka nk’igihe kwiryamira cyangwa guhura n’incuti bitwaje bagiye ahabera igikorwa kwibuka abanyamakuru nabo basabwe gufata iya mbere gushyira bikorwa bakangurira abandi umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’inama y’igihugu y’urubyiruko alphonse nkuranga yavuze amateka agomba gusigasirwa n’urubyiruko akabikwa buryo bujyanye n’igihe tugezemo bityo gihe kizaza bakazayasanga ku bijyanye kuba abacitse icumu nkuranga yijeje abari nama inama y’igihugu y’urubyiruko ifasha urubyiruko rwacitse icumu rushaka kwiteza imbere yatanze urugero rw’ishyirahamwe ry’ubuhinzi ry’urubyiruko rwacitse icumu ry’i nyamagabe bahawe inka ebyiri z’inzungu insanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka igira iti kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza emmanuel n hitimana

title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru army week police week n’ibindi byakozwe n’abanyarwanda banyuranye nzego zitandukanye hari kandi n’ibyakorewe mahanga babaga butumwa rwego kumenyekanisha umuco mwiza igihugu cyacu gifite aha twavuga ingabo z’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye majyaruguru darfur ahitwa el-fasher batangizaga umuganda buri kwezi bafatanyije n’ingabo z’ibindi bihugu ziri butumwa nyuma y’umuganda hagendaga habaho ibiganiro bitandukanye bigamije gukangurira abaturage kwitabira gahunda leta hamwe kugira uruhare bikorwa bibakorerwa batanga umusanzu wabo rwego kwiyubakira igihugu cyane cyagerwaho batabigizemo uruhare anne niwemwiza

title: musanze fondation kabeho irakangurira abandi kwitabira gahunda z’icyunamo

title: bamwe baturage babuze bagurira udupfukamunwa
content: mu gihe abantu basabwa kwambara udupfukamunwa hagamijwe kwirinda icyorezo covid bamwe baturage baravuga batarabona bagurira udupfukamunwa abadukora bemeza bakomeje gukora bwabaga kugira tuboneke bwinshi bamwe baturage baganiriye rba hirya hino gihugu bavuze bikibagoye kubona bagurira udupfukamunwa niyonizeye aron utuye karere rusizi yagize ’’udupfukamunwa inaha ntituraboneka buryo buhagije kugira tutubone biracyatugoye leta yadufasha abadukora bakaba benshi kugira tubashe kutugeraho’’ na ho nzisabira joseph utuye ako karere ’’njye ndagafite kuko nakoresheje ingufu zose kugira nkabone kugira ndebe nakwirinda ndinde nakwanduza abandi cyangwa nanjye bakanyanduza iki kibazo kandi kigaragara karere nyagatare bamwe baturage bavuga kubona udupfukamunwa bibagoye musafiri jmv yagize ’’abaturage rusange baradukeneye baribaza bati tuzava he bizagenda gute ariko nituramuka tubonetse twiteguye kutugura nabo duturanye tuba tubibashishikariza na ho harelimana gratienumuturage aka karere avuga akamaro k’udupfukamunwa bakamenye ariko ikibazo kikaba tutarabageraho ati ’’gahunda kwambara udupfukamunwa barayitubwiye uretse tutaratugeraho ariko buriya kuwa mbere tuzatwambara nitutugeraho kugirango tutugereho buriya tuzava karere niko tubikeka kugeza ahagurishirizwa utu dupfukamunwa farumasi yandi maguriro alimentation hamwe twamaze kuhagezwa ahandi ho baracyategereje umuhire chantal ukora farumasi avuga badufite ndetse bakaba baducuruza kibazo ati ’’nyuma yaho tubiboneye television hari utundi dupfukamunwa tworohereye dukoze myenda twahise tuturangura tutumaranye icyumweru abadukikije baraza bakadukura aha’’ umwe bakorera alementation yavuze kugeza ’’hari abakiliya baza bashaka udupfukamunwa tukababwira tutari twaboneka icyiza abaducuruza batworohereza bakatutugezaho tukaduha abakiliya bacu’’ hamwe hakorerwa utu dupfukamunwa imirimo irakomeje barakora amanywa nijoro kuko hakenewe twinshi gicanda rosalie umwe bayobozi b’inganda zikora utu dupfukamunwa avuga gukora ibishoboka tugere bantu benshi yagize ’’muri uru ruganda turimo turi companies kugeza twiyemeje nibura buri company ibasha gukora udupfukamunwa ibihumbi munsi ariko twihaye umuhigo kuzageza dupfukamunwa ibihumbi munsi turara turangiye kugirango tubashe kwambika abanyarwanda bose’’ mukaremera francine umukozi ushinzwe ibikorwa byubucuruzi company mavuta express yatsindiye isoko ryo kugeza utu dupfukamunwa hirya hino gihugu tugurishirizwa avuga barimo kwihutisha gikorwa kandi tutaragezwa gihe vuba tuba twahagejejwe ’’mu ntara zose twamaze kugerayo kugirango abanyarwanda babashe gusohoka mungo zabo bambaye udupfukamunwa twaraye tutujyana ijoro ryose ndizera umuntu wese uribukenere agapfukamunwa yaba munsi cyangwa ejo azakabona’’ mu ngamba kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo coronavirus harimo udupfukamunwa tugomba kwambarwa igihe cyose umuntu agiye ahurira n’abandi muhaburarw

title: imfubyi jenoside zirasaba kurushaho kwegerwa
content: nubwo u rwanda rufite rugeze guhangana n’ingaruka jenoside abana bagizwe imfubyi baracyakeneye inama urukundo gusurwa kwitabwaho kuko abakagombye kubibaha batagihari nk’uko byatangajwe n’uhagarariye ibuka karere rubavu kabanda innocent kabanda yasabye abanyarubavu kwita bana ndetse n’abapfakazi kabanda yongeyeho ubupfura batojwe butabemerera kwangana mpamvu biteguye gutanga imbabazi babiciye babishaka yagize ntabwo tuzizirika muntu watwiciye uzashaka imbabazi azatwegere tuzazimuha uyu munsi kwibuka tariki wabimburiwe n’urugendo ruva murenge rugerero rujya rwibutso rw’uwo murenge wanaranzwe n’indirimbo z’abana barokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bibumbiye itsinda ryitwa imanzi’ ubuhamya gushyira indabo rwibutso rugerero ku isaha saa sita abanyarubavu bunamiye inzirakarengane iminota itatu hanyuma bakurikirana radiyo ijambo nyakubahwa perezida repubulika yavugiye sitade amahoro mujyi kigali umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu sheikh bahame hassan yashimiye abaturage b’ako karere kuba bitabiriye gahunda benshi anabasaba kuzitabira gahunda z’icyumweru cy’icyunamo zizaba zirimo ibiganiro yongeyeho kwegera abacitse icumu ingenzi bagahumurizwa urwibutso rugerero rushyinguyemo imibiri y’abatutsi gusoza icyumweru cy’icyunamo karere rubavu bikazabera murenge mudende tariki mata kugeza imibare yavuye bushakashatsi bwakozwe ibuka yerekana abazize jenoside bangana rwanda hose pascaline umulisa

title: karande amayobera masezerano adasanzwe asinywa n’abakirisitu itorero masasu
content: kuva hambere abizera yesu nk’umwami n’umukiza wabo bahamya badashidikanya imbaraga z’imana zitanga ubwihisho gihe cy’ibitero by’umwanzi satani byaba ibishingiye mitekerereze imibanire n’abandi ubukungu karande miryango n’ibindi hari bamwe banarenzaho inkomoko y’umuntu n’ahahise he bishobora kumuzanira imivumo imuzitira nzira igana siyoni gihe atabohowe akorerwe bita deliverance ni ukuvuga ukomoka muryango wimitse ibigirwamana cyangwa watwawe n’imigenzo gipagani bigukurikirana igihe utabyiyomoyeho utangire amateka mashya giti cyawe bamwe bagasabwa guhindura amazina igihe basanganywe atejejwe muri torero bakorerwa icyitwa ’delivrance’ bakurweho imivumo karande ni deliverance’ itangirira bisobanuye kubohorwa cyangwa gutabarwa mu gusobanura gikorwa gisa n’iyobera hari abifashisha umurongo bibiliya abakorinto handitse mbese wahamagawe imbata ntibikubabaze icyakora ushobora kubaturwa ubikore mu isezerano kera ukubohorwa gushushanya imana yarengeraga abari minwe y’abanzi satani ikabarinda inzara gukenyuka urugero iyimukamisiri yakuraga abisiraheli buretwa ikabambutsa inyanja itukura ikabatuza gihugu cy’isezerano u rwanda nk’igihugu giha abagituye ubwisanzure gusengera idini n’itorero bifuza hari abakataje buryo bushya kubohorwa urugero evangelical restoration church itorero rizwi nk’irya aptre joshua masasu abasengera restoration church babanza gusinya kubohorwa igihango gishyirwaho umukono muri restoration church uwamaze kwakira agakiza ushaka kubohorwa yatura magambo cyangwa akuzuza urwandiko rwitwa urwo kwitandukanya n’umwanzi satani kwiyegurira imana wese gutangaza amateka mashya yesuinyandiko igihe ifitiye kopi igizwe n’ingingo zigenderwaho kugira indahiro ifatwa nk’igihamya kwitandukanya karande zose ziri buzima bw’umukirisitu yemerwe izi ngingo zirimo gusesa igihango abakurambere bagiranye satani kwiyegurira imana y’umubyeyi intumwa yoshua ndagijimana masasu kuzayiraga abazamukomokaho kugeza buvivure kwitandukanya n’amazina ahesha satani uburenganzira buzima guhabwa amashya kwitandukanya n’ubusambanyi ubutinganyi kwikinisha umujinya ubwicanyi gukuramo inda ibinyoma ubusinzi kwitandukanya n’umwuka gukenyuka n’uw’indwara zikomoka bakurambere zirimo umuvuduko w’amaraso diabte n’izindi mubyo basinyira harimo kutarwara indwara zikomeye diyabete n’umuvuduko w’amaraso nyuma gusoma nyandiko umukirisitu yiyemeza gukurikiza ibikubiyemo ndetse umushumba akemeza yakiriwe ijuru isi umwe basengera restoration church yatangarije igihe amasezerano kubohorwa ajyana n’imyizerere y’umuntu ati byose biterwa n’uburyo wabyizeye deliverance nziza kuko ituma hari abantu bahamuriweho n’ababyeyi bityo bagusengera bikavaho hari ababa bafite imiryango ikenyuka bayigukoreye birashira kuko uba wakiriye ubundi buzima icyaremwe gishya nanjye mfite gahunda kujya kuyikoresha uwitwa tuyiringire arsne wamaze gukorerwaho mugenzo ndetse wanasinye amasezerano nk’igihamya kubohorwa gusendereye ashimangira banashobora kuwugukoreraho inshuro nyinshi igihe ubyifuza yagize hari igihe usanga hari ikintu kikubase wibagiwe bikaba ngombwa nacyo kiva nzira nkanjye nagiraga umujinya mwinshi ariko byarashize biba byiza gusinya nyandiko kuko gihamya igaragara kuko buzima busanzwe ibintu byinshi bishyirwa nyandiko abasinya nyandiko babohotse burundu muri restauration church buri pasiteri akora deliverance’ ariko abashaka guhura aptre masasu ubwe bashyirwa rutonde bagahabwa igihe bazabonanira hari n’abayikorerwa rusange bahuriye itsinda rikora umurimo runaka itorero bishop murekezi simon masasu uyobora restoration church rubavu yasobanuye urwandiko rusinywa rushushanya urwo yesu yashyize musaraba yakomeje agira hari umurage n’ingoyi umuntu avukana avuga hari umugayo n’agasuzuguro umwanzi yamushyizeho bisaba kwitandukanya nabyo izina yesu hari abari bafite icyangiro abananiwe n’urushako indwara karande gukenyuka babitahuye rwandiko rwaturegaga rurabikemura ubisobanukiwe mwuka umenya hari karande ikugendaho ikwiye gusenywa umwanzi ntakomeze kubyitwaza umuntu ukenera umwuka ubimusobanurira neza ukavuga uti nkeneye kujya imbere y’umukozi w’imana uriya noteri uvuga munsi ndabohotse

title: gusazana umutwe utekereza biruta kubyirukana uwikorera imizigo
content: aya amagambo y’umukambwe gakwavu augustin w’imyaka asanga umuntu agira imitwe ibiri utekereza n’uwikorera imizigo gakwavu umuhinzi mworozi karere kayonza umurenge nyamirama yoroye inka zirenga enye kizungu zikamwa litiro zisaga munsi afite kandi urutoki ruvamo ibiro buri cyumweru ibi byose abikesha gutekereza akita ze kandi agakorera urutoki neza arurinda ibyonnyi n’indwara mu migambi avuga azasaba banki ikamuha imodoka akazajya yigereza umusaruro isoko rimuha menshi gakwavu agira nkora hari umusore utabishobora nk’uko najye ntashoboye gushyira mutwe ntureba uriya musore uhetse ubwatsi igare biriya sinabishobora ariko ntiyabasha gukorera uru rutoki rwere nk’uku ubudashyikirwa gakwavu ubwo yasurwaga n’abanyamakuru bakora ruhare rw’abaturage bibakorerwa barambagiye urutoki rwe rungana hegitari n’igice mbere kumusanga biraro by’inka ze arabereka inka ze harimo inkuru ikamwa litiro gitondo n’izayo eshatu ziyiyingayinga mu buhinzi bw’urutoki gakwavu arwanya ibyonnyi n’indwara kirabiranya ikindi ni amazi ava muhanda yayacukuriye umuferege ugenda uzenguruka rutoki buryo n’ubu mpeshyi urutoki rwe ruratohagiye ati kirabiranya njye ntitinda rutoki rwanjye insina yafashwe ndayirandura n’inguri yayo nkabishyira mwobo nkabitwika n’isuka cyangwa umuhoro nakoresheje nkabicisha muriro bitazanduza insina nzabikoreshaho ubutaha ikindi kitarangwa rutoki gakwavu ikitwa umukanana uyu nawo bikwirakwiza kirabiranya kubera inzuki inyoni cyangwa amasazi aza akurikiye umushongi ubamo ati igitoki kimaze kugaragaza iseri nyuma umukanana ndawuca bagatuma ibyari kuwutunga bitunga igitoki gisigaye kandi nzuki n’inyoni zazaga ziwukurikiye ntiziwubone ikibazo cy’isoko ry’umusaruro gakwavu avuga amata kayonza arushwa agaciro n’urwagwa kuko litiro y’amata igura amafaranga kandi urwagwa icupa agasaba ubuyobozi bwabegereza dairy ikusanyirizoikaragiro ku musaruro w’urutoki kandi gakwavu agira ibitoki yishyurwa amafaranga agera bihumbi ahabwa n’abaguzi bamwisangiye rutoki babijyana i kabarondo n’i kayonza maze urumva kuba ntabasha kubyigerezayo barampenda kandi ntibazira rimwe ubu uwampuza banki nkafata ideni ry’imodoka nkajya mbyijyanira i kabarondo cyangwa i kigali myaka itanu naba nyishyuye umukozi ushinzwe ubuhinzi murenge nyamirama kamanzi umutangana audace avuga umukamo murenge ukiri muke buryo hakiri kare basabe ikusanyirizo cyangwa ikaragiro ati ntitwasaba diary ikaragiro ikenera litiro ibihumbi bitanu kandi tutabasha kuzibona turabanza kongera umusaruro dutera intanga tuvurira gihe inka zirwaye n’ibindi umunsi litiro zagezweho nibwo tuzabwira akarere kadushakire dairy karegeya omar

title: abarundi barimo guhungira congo bwinshi gisirikare ho byakomeye

title: urwego rw’inganda rwahungabanyijwe covid- buryo bukomeye rwanda
content: ubuyobozi banki nkuru y’u rwanda bnr bwatangaje ingaruka by’ubukungu zatewe n’icyorezo koronavirusi covid- rwego mpuzamahanga zikomeje gusubiza hasi ubukungu bw’u rwanda ibipimo bigaragaza mezi mbere y’umwaka ubukungu bw’u rwanda bwari bugihagaze neza ndetse biteganywa bushobora kwiyongera kigero gihembwe mbere ariko umuvuduko covid- kwezi werurwe wagabanyije wakubise hasi ubukungu bw’igihugu buryo bugaragara cyane cyane rwego serivisi n’urw’inganda ibyo byagize ingaruka zitandukanye haba bikorera ibigo bitanga serivisi z’imari ndetse zindi nzego zitandukanye bnr ivuga abemerewe inguzanyo bagabanyutse kigero ariko abazihawe bagabwa iziyongereye kigero mu gihembwe mbere ibyoherezwa mahanga byagabanyutse kigero bitewe n’ubwiyongere bwibitumizwa mahanga byaruse cyane ibikorerwa gihugu agaciro k’ifaranga kaomeje biteganyijwe ingamba leta y’u rwanda yafashe zigamije kuzahura urwego rw’ubukungu gihe covid- yaba ihosheje zizongera umubare w’abikorera baka inguzanyo minsi imbere kuzahura ubukungu bw’u rwanda bizajyana kugabanya iyuho kiri buuruzi mpuzamahanga bukomeje kuganzwa n’ibyinjira gihugu banki nkuru y’u rwanda yagabanyije inyungu fatizo banki z’ubucuruzi rwanda zifatiraho inguzanyo rwego kuzifasha gukomeza kubungabunga ubukungu bwazo bihihe kwirinda covid- guhangana n’ingaruka inama komite ishinzwe politiki y’ifaranga mpc yabaye tariki mata yanzuye nyungu fatizo iva ikagera uretse kugabanya ingaruka covid- kugabanyirizwa inyungu banki z’ubucuruzi ziboneraho inguzanyo bizazifasha korohereza abakiriya bazo kubona inguzanyo uyu mwanzuro wafashwe nyuma gusuzuma ingaruka z’icyorezo bukungu haba rwanda ndetseno rwego mpuzamahanga ubukungu bw’isi buteganyijwe kugabanyuka kugera gihe byateganywaga buziyongera kigero ubuyobozi bnr buhamya kemezo kimwe n’ibindi byafashwe werurwe bikomeza gushyigikira ibigo by’imari bihe bitoroshye muri werurwe bnr yageneye amabanki inguzanyo y’ingoboka miriyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda zizishyurwa ijanisha fatizo rishya ryaraye ryemejwe banki y’igihugu kandi yasabye banki z’ubucuruzi kuvugurura inguzanyo bigo byazifashe biri bibazo by’ubukungu minsi nyuma y’igihe gito havugururwa inguzanyo zifite agaciro miriyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda bnr ishimangira ingamba zashyiriweho gufasha urwego rw’imari rwanda zikomeje gutanga umusaruro muhaburarw

title: perezida kagame yasobanuye gahunda guca caguwa gihugu
content: perezida paul kagame yavuze igihe kigeze abanyarwanda bahindure imyumvire gukoresha ibikorerwa rwanda harimo gahunda y’igihugu igamije guteza imbere inganda zikora imyenda rwanda buryo title: inzozi z’umukobwa ugiye gushinga urugo n’inama gihe zitabaye impamo
content: muri rusange umukobwa witegura kujya kubaka urwe hari ibintu atekereza bitandukanye umuntu yakwita inzozi z’urugo yifuza kuzagira bikaba ibintu buri mukobwa wese ugeze gihe ahora yibazaho mutima akiha ishusho ishoboka y’urugo rwe ni urwo rwego tugiye kubagezaho nzozi ndetse wabyitwaramo ziramutse zitabaye impamo dore ibintu ashyira imbere atekereza rugo yitegura gushinga ubukire umukobwa wese ugiye gushinga urugo usanga yifuza kandi akumva urugo rwe ruzaba agahebuzo bukire kimwe azigera yifuza iweiki nacyo gituma abakobwa benshi bashaka abagabo b’abakire bumva bagiye gukira kakahava hari amara kugera iwe kukire bukayoyoka neza neza bitewe n’impamvu zitandukanye iyo bigenze gutyo uba ugomba kubyihanganira kuko ntiwasubira iwanyu ubukire wagiye ureba butakibarangwaho kwigenga iyo umukobwa agiye iwabo yumva aruhutse kwirirwa agenzurwa n’ababyeyi cyangwa abandi babanaga akumva kwitwa umugore rugo bizatuma yigenga ntawe uzongera kumugendaho umukobwa utekereza gutya akenshi yibeshya cyane kuko hari asanga umugabo amugenzura kurenza abandi yigeze kubana nabo guhunga ibibazo akenshi hari umukobwa ajya gufata umwanzuro gushaka umugabo yibwira uburyo guhunga ibibazo afite cyangwa kubikemura akibwira ntaho azongera guhurira nabyo ntaho umuntu ashobora guhungira ibibazo kuko hose birahagera ariko rugo usanga birenze kuko inshingano ziba zabaye nyinshi bityo mukobwa nuhura n’ibibazo birenze wagiraga utararwubaka ntibizaguce intege cyangwa ubyinubire kuko biba bikureba kandi amahirwe uba ufite uba ufite mufatanya kubikemura kwagura umuryango buri mukobwa wese ajya gushaka yizeye agomba kubyara abana ashaka ibitsina byombi ntiyibuke bashobora kubura urubyaro cyangwa akabyara igitsina kimwe kuko siwe wiha niba warishyizemo ugomba kubyara kandi neza ubyifuza nugukomera kigabo ntuteshuke ukabyihanganira nkuko tumaze kubibona umukobwa yibwira rugo yifuza kuzagira byinshi kandi byiza gusa ariko bishobora guhinduka akumva ahise yanga urugo nyamara urugo title: rusizi abiyitaho bakeneye ubaha isoko ry’imipira yambarwa
content: abafite ubumuga butandukanye barimo abatabona n’abafite ubumuga bukomatanyije batumva cyangwa bavuge n’abatabasha kugenda banze gusabiriza bakora koperative iboha imyenda itandukanye bayita abiyitaho bavuga nubwo bamwe bavuye bwigunge bakeneye ubuvugizi kugira babone isoko ryo kuboha imipira n’ababagurira baboshye ishyirahamwe ryabo ryatangiye mwaka rigizwe n’abafite ubumuga kutabona ariko nyakanga nibwo babaye koperative iboha imyenda itandukanye irimo imipira y’imbeho n’ibindi abagize koperative bakorera mudugudu murambi kagari giheke murenge giheke bavuga nubwo baboha imyenda batarabona isoko ryagutse bimwe baboha bigatuma batiteza imbere nyirandayambaje godiberte umwe banyamuryango yagize tubura abaduha akazi tubabohere n’ibyo tuboshye ntitubona ababigura bahagije ngabonziza canesion agira kuva nagera koperative navuye bwigunge ariko ntabwo tubona abaduha akazi kubabohera mukarurangwa josephine yagize aho dukorera hato kandi turahakodesha kubona amafaranga kwishyura ubukode biratugora kubera tutabona abaduha akazi turasaba ubuyobozi kudufasha renzaho faustin umuhuzabikorwa w’inama y’igihugu y’abantu bafite ubumuga karere rusizi ndetse umujyana nama njyanama y’akarere rusizi avuga hari gahunda gufasha koperative harimo n’iriya y’abafite ubumuga bishyize hamwe ati dufite gahunda gufasha korerative zikora neza ntabwo iy’abafite ubumuga gusa tubatera inkunga milliyoni frw buri mwaka buri koperative koperative abiyitaho zikora neza renzaho faustin abasaba gutegura umushinga kwagura bakorera numara gusuzumwa bashobora kuwutera inkunga renzaho avuga kuba iriya koperative igorwa gushaka amafaranga y’ubukode akarere rusizi hirya hino mirenge kahafite inzu akabasaba bazikoreramo murenge giheke bisaba ukuvugana n’ubuyobozi bw’umurenge bambara imipira y’imbeho twatekereje kubahuza n’ibyo bigo tukabashakira amasoko buryo bagirana amasezerano bakajya babaha imipira bakenera koperative nubwo ibafasha kubona bahurira mitungo ihambaye baragira kubera imbogamizi kubura ubaha amasoko kuboha imipira cyangwa kubagurira baboshye

content: inkuru y’urupfu kizito mihigo yatangajwe polisi y’u rwanda tariki gashyantare urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha narwo ruvuga yinigishije amaashuka kasho afungiye i remera ubushinjacyaha nabwo bwamaze mukuru rivuga ubushinjacyaha bukuru nppa bwakiriye raporo itanzwe n’urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe ubugenzacyaha rib iperereza rupfu bwana kizito mihigo rwabaye taliki gashyantare rwabereye ufungiye i title: urukingo mbere malaria rugiye kugeragezwa
content: igerageza ryagutse mbere isi ry’urukingo malaria rigiye gukorerwa malawi abana bahabwa uru rukingo rubahe ubwirinzi bucagase bw’iyi ndwara uru rukingo rutoza ubwirinzi bw’umubiri kurwanya udukoko dutera malaria dukwirakwizwa n’imibu mbere yaho habayeho amagerageza mato yagaragaje kigero ijana abana hagati y’amezi bahawe uru rukingo rwabarinze kurwara malaria ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima oms rivuga bihe malaria yiyongereye gihe hari hashize imyaka umuhate kuyihashya utanze umusaruro bbc dukesha nkuru itangaza imibare vuba iheruka rwego rw’isi igaragaza malaria itakigabanuka bigatera impungenge zuko ishobora kongera kwaduka buryo bukomeye hejuru ijana y’abayirwaye n’abantu ibihumbi yishe amuri afurika abana ibibasira by’umwihariko mu mwaka abantu miliyoni eshanu barwaye malaria malawi iki gihugu kenya ghana nibyo byatoranyijwe gukorerwamo igerageza ryagutse ry’uru rukingo imyaka irenga urukingo rukorwa ibi bihugu byatoranyijwe kuko bisanzwe binafite gahunda kurwanya malaria ariko kandi bigakomeza kugira umubare munini w’abayirwara kuva mwaka abashakashatsi kompanyi yitwa gsk bwongereza batangiye gukora kugerageza urukingo malaria kugeza rukaba rumaze gutwara agera miliyari y’amadolari y’amerika igerageza riheruka ryagenzuwe oms ivuga uru rukingo hari ikigero rurindaho abana ikigero ijana cy’imbaraga kurinda k’uru rukingo ntabwo kiri hejuru ugereranyije n’izindi nkingo ariko oms ivuga hiyongereyeho ingamba zisanzwe nk’inzitiramibu kurwanya imibu bizatanga umusaruro uru rukingo ruzajya rutangwa inshuro enye rimwe kwezi mezi atatu nshuro kane umwana aruhabwe hashize amezi iri geragezwa ryatangiriye malawi byumweru biri imbere bikaba biteganyijwe rikomereza kenya ghana biteganyijwe rizarangira mwaka

title: uko ubuhanzi nyarwanda bwakoreshejwe gucengeza amacakubiri yagejeje jenoside
content: abahanzi bamwe bamwe babaye igikoresho leta gucengeza amacakubiri kubiba urwango jenoside yahitanye abatutsi bagera umuco bawuhindura ico ushakirwamo ubuhanga n’ubumenyi gucengeza amacakubiri bitewe abahanzi bamwe bifashishwa gutanga ubutumwa bukagera benshi gucengeza amacakubiri barifashishijwe twagerageje gushaka bamwe bahanzi n’indirimbo bahimbye zifashishijwe gucamo ibice abanyarwanda gushishikariza abahutu kwanga abatutsi chorale abanyuramatwi chorale abanyuramatwi y’i gitarama izwi cyane kubera ubuhanga bwari ndirimbo zabo abenshi barize iseminari bazi guhimba gucuranga injyana muzika uwari umuyobozi wabo michel habarurema abanyuramatwi bakwije ingengabitekerezo y’urwango jenoside bakoresheje indirimbo nyinshi zanyuzwaga radio rwanda bitaramo nibo baririmbye indirimbo yubahiriza igihugu mbere rwanda rwacu zimwe ndirimbo z’abanyuramatwi zatwitse igihugu zirimo jya mbere rwanda umututsi yitirirwaga kuba nk’umukoroni umunyamahanga umwanzi w’u rwanda gashakabuhake amwe magambo y’iyo ndirimbo hari bagize bati u rwanda rwari rute kazungu gatutsi bararumize nibo kandi bahimbye indirimbo turatsinze ivuga rwanda rubonye bene gahutu akwiye kuganza mu ndirimbo ibigwi by’abaparmehutu bashimira abahutu kuba baratsinze bakaba baharanira inyungu gahutu ikintu kibi gikomeye ndirimbo jambo umunyarwanda ririmo icyari gishishikaje abanyarumatwi imibereho myiza y’abahutu n’ikandamizwa ry’abatutsi abanyuramatwi bigishije ndirimbo zabo igihugu n’ibyacyo icy’abahutu niwo murongo indirimbo zabo zagendeyeho jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yaje isoza ishyirwa bikorwa ry’iyo title: clare akamanzi yasubije abanenze amasezerano y’u rwanda arsenal
content: clare akamanzi umuyobozi mukuru w’urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe iterambere rdb yavuze abanenze u rwanda kuba rwararekuye akabayo rukamamaza ubukerarugendo rukoresheje arsenal hari birengagiza cyangwa batumva ayo masezerano ay’uko kipe izajya yambara imyenda iriho ikirango visit rwanda rwego gukangurira abayikurikira n’abakurikira ruhago kumenya u rwanda bihwihwiswa masezerano yishyuwe agera miliyoni z’amadolari y’amerika myaka itatu yakiranywe ibyishimo ruhande runini cyane cyane abasobanukiwe n’ibyo kwamamaza bamwe babifataga nk’intambwe nshya u rwanda ruteye kutajenjeka isoko ry’ubukerarugendo cyane cyane masezerano yahuriranye n’uko mbere ikipe bwongereza yaba yamamaje rutugu rw’imipira bakinana abandi bumvaga mafaranga akwiye kuba akoreshwa bikorwa bizamura abaturage gihugu cyane cyane abakomeye izi mpaka zaje kuba ndende hari n’amwe mashyaka buholandi kimwe bihugu bitera u rwanda inkunga abadepite bahagarariye mashyaka bavuze u rwanda rukwiye gutanga ibisobanura mpamvu rwemeye gutanga amafaranga angana atyo rwamamaza gihe rugifite abaturage bakennye aba badepite babishingira amafaranga yakoreshejwe ashobora kuba yarakuwe batanga mu butumwa yanyujije twitter akamanzi yasobanuye impamvu u rwanda rwahisemo kwamamaza ubukerarugendo bwarwo anamara impungenge abibaza amafaranga rukoresha aturuka yagize umuntu wese unenga amasezerano twagiranye arsenal yitwaje u rwanda igihugu gikennye cyangwa gihabwa inkunga yifuza u rwanda rwazahora rukennye cyangwa ntasobanukiwe buri bizinesi amafaranga kwimenyekanisha ingenzi gishoro yakomeje agira urwego rw’igihugu rushinzwe iterambere rwinjiza amafaranga menshi avuye bikorwa by’ubukerarugendo ho rukura gukomeza kumenyekanisha ibikorwa byago kugira umusaruro wiyongere amasezerano arsenal nay o buryo yasinywemo nk’uko dusanzwe tuyasohora turimo gutegura amamurikabikorwa y’ubukerarugendo cyangwa twishyura abatwigira imishinga yasoje avuga u rwanda rwihaye intego kuba rwinjiza agera miliyoni z’amadolari amerika mwaka agasanga kibazo kirimo u rwanda rufashe make miliyoni z’amadolari rwinjiza kugira ruyakube kabiri ati ibyo ntibizagerwaho twicara turategereje ariko bizashoboka nidufata iya mbere tukamenyekanisha u rwanda hamwe hantu heza abantu basura nimutuze mureke isi itembere u rwanda niyomugabo albert
