title: uko igikomangoma robwa nyiramateke yameneye amaraso igihugu
content: mu rwanda hambere hatari kera cyane umugore yahabwaga agaciro gacye ntiyashoboraga kujya rugamba cyangwa abe yahabwa imyanya ikomeye nzego z’igihugu ariko ntibyabujije bamwe bagore kuba intwari bagakora ibikorwa by’indashyikirwa n’abagabo batari gupfa gukora amateka y’u rwanda agaragaza abagore batafatwaga nk’abantu bakora cyangwa bashobore gukora imirimo y’abagabo nta mugore wajyaga rugamba wubakaga wagirwaga umuyobozi nzego z’igihugu mbere y’abakoloni ndetse umugore yafatwaga nk’umuntu waremewe gukora imirimo rugo ubundi agategereza byose mugabo mu gihe rwanda kimwe n’andi isi hizihizwa umunsi mpuzamahanga w’abagore umunyamakuru inyarwandacom arakugezaho inkuru y’umugore wagaragaje ubutwari budasanzwe rwanda hambere y’umwaduko w’abazungu nk’uko padiri muzungu bernardin abivuga gitabo yise le patriotisme jusqu’au sang’’ robwa nyiramateke ishema n’icyubahiro bagore n’abakobwa babayeho mateka y’u rwanda mbere y’uko tuvuga butwari bwaranze mugore ufatwa nk’intwari kurusha abandi mateka y’u rwanda hambere reka turebe abandi bagore b’intwari batatu babayeho mateka y’u rwanda nyirarucyaba uyu azwi bitekerezo by’ibimanuka byanditswe gitabo inganji kalinga’ musenyeli alexis kagame bivugwa wazanye inka rwanda gihe itazwi ngo amaze kuzana gisimba inka yakamiye amata gihanga ngomijana amata ayanyoye akira indwara arwaye gihanga abwira nyirarucyaba jya kuzana gisimba hano’’ ni azana inka rwanda mbere undi mugore w’intwari uzwi cyane nyiraruganzu nyirarumaga uyu umugabekazi w’ingoboka ruganzu ndoli akaba umusingakazi yabaye umugabekazi ruganzu ndoli kuko uwari kumubera umugabekazi ukuvuga nyina ndoli yariciwe i rubi rw’i nyundo ahitwa miko y’abakobwa ndahiro cyamatare yicwaga amaze guhungishiriza ndoli i karagwe k’abahinda ubwo ruganzu amaze kuba umwami yagombaga kugira umugabekazi batwarana nk’uko byagendaga bami nyirarumaga watwaranye ruganzu ndoli umwami uzwiho ubutwari bukomeye n’ingabo ze zitwaga ibisumizi ikindi kigira nyirarumaga intwari itazibagirana mateka y’u rwanda watangije inganzo y’ibisigo agirango amateka y’abami ntazibagirane kuba amateka y’abami hambere azwi bikomoka cyane nganzo y’ibisigo nyabami kuko nko bisigo by’impakanizi hagenda havugwa buri mwami n’ibikorwa yakoze kugeza mwami uriho nyirarumaga wahanze igisigo mbere mateka y’u rwanda akaba yaracyise umunsi ameza imiryango yose’’ ni watangije intebe y’abasizi ndetse ashyiraho uburyo ibisigo byose bituwe umwami runaka byajya bibungwabungwa bigashingwa abantu runaka bakabifata mutwe ndetse bakabitoza ababakomokaho buryo ingoma cyami yagize iherezo ibisigo byose uhereye umunsi ameza imiryango yose’’ bizwi neza undi mugore wabaye intwari twavuga mbere y’uko tuvuga birambuye robwa nyirayuhi nyiratunga ndetse n’abandi bagabekazi bategekanaga n’abana ariko bakiri bato kugeza igihe bakuriye nyirayuhi nyiratunga nyina yuhi gahindiro nyiratunga yatwaye u rwanda gihe gahindiro mibambwe sentabyo akiri uruhinja ikigira nyiratunga intwari cyane ukuba yararwanye ishyaka arwana n’abana se wabo gahindiro bashakaga kumunyaga ingoma yaratwaje kugeza igihe gahindiro akuriye akaba umwami w’igihame binavugwa mwami warambye kurusha abandi reka noneho tugaruke butwari robwa padiri muzungu bernardin gitabo cyavuzwe haruguru avuga bahanga n’abandi bazi amateka y’u rwanda igikomangoma robwa nyiramateke ishema n’icyubahiro banyarwandakazi bava bakagera inyandiko nyinshi zivuga mateka y’u rwanda zirata ubutwari kigore n’ubudahemuka budasanzwe bwaranze igikomangomakazi robwa wavukaga nsoro i samukondo akaba mushiki ruganzu i bwimba guhara icyubahiro kuba umwamikazi n’umugabekazi akemera gupfira u rwanda bimugaragaza nk’intwari idasanzwe zabayeho rwanda hambere haba bagabo n’abagore robwa muntu ki robwa nyiramateke umukobwa nsoro i samukondo umwe bami b’imishumi wategetse u rwanda mwaka kugeza akaba yaramubyaranye nyiraruganzu i nyakanga yari mushiki w’umwami ruganzu i bwimba uzwiho kuba yarabaye intwari yemera kumena amaraso buryo bw’ubucengeri robwa yamenyekanye nk’intwari cyane kubera uburyo yemeye kuba umutabazi w’umucengeri akamena amaraso gisaka kugira i gisaka kitazigarurira u rwanda hanyuma twibuke yabikoze atwite inda y’umwami kimenyi w’i gisaka uko robwa yabaye intwari kimenyi bazimya ruregeya umwami w’i gisaka yashatse umugeni abajije abajyanama bamurangira rwanda bati nsoro samukondo ufite umugeni ugukwiriye’’ ati none se bushuti ngirana nsoro nzabigenza nte ni bamugira inama kwibanisha nkorokombe muramu nsoro kuko musaza nyakanga nyina robwa nyiramateke bamaze kunoza inama kimenyi yashatse amaturo n’izindi mpano nziza abyoherereza nkorokombe aboneraho kumwaka ubushuti ntiyazuyaza arabumwemerera bukeye ubucuti bumaze gukomera kimenyi atuma nkorokombe atindashaka gusaba muramu wawe umugeni none uzahambere nk’inshuti’’nkorokombe aramusubiza atiuzaze umugeni ntuzamubura rwose’’ igihe kigeze abanyagisaka baje gusaba robwa icyakora nsoro aramubima avuga yamutanze ahandi ariko bukaba bwari uburyo kubananizaibi byababaje kimenyi cyane igihe cyarageze nsoro araberana kurwara k’umwami abiru baramubaza bati ko turuzi ugiye gutanga kimenyi akaba yaragusabye umugeni ukamumwima nagaruka waratanze akamudusaba tuzamumwima tutaramubyaye nsoro arababwira atinimumpamagarire abana banjye’’ni abana baraza bahageze abwira robwa atinushaka gushyingirwa kimenyi uzagende ubizi uriumutabazi w’u rwanda ntuzagende wibwira umugeni atiuramenye kalinga ntuzayigurane rukurura ingoma ngabe gisaka arangije kuraga aherako aratanga baramwerera baramwiraburiranuko nkorokombe atuma kimenyi wa muntu wakwimaga umugeni atakiriho ntiwaza gusaba umugeni utazamubura nuko kimenyi yohereza intumwa ze gusaba robwa ruganzu bwimba warasimbuye se nsoro ngoma yemera gushyingira robwa icyakora robwa ashyingirwa abizi neza umutabazi w’umucengeri uzamenera igihugu amaraso ubwo ruganzu i bwimba yatangaga aguye gisaka atabaye nk’umucengeri kimenyi yaje guhoza robwa amumare agahinda musaza umaze gupfa aramubwira rukurura iyawe i gisaka icyawe’’ kuko robwa azi atashakiye gisaka agamije kuhabyarira cyangwa kubayo umugabekazi yasubije kimenyi amucyurira mbabajwe n’uwakwise kimenyi uza kuba kimenyi koko wakamenye icyanzanye ino aha’’ nuko robwa unatwite inda y’imvutsi y’umuhungu amaze kumubwira magambo arikusanya n’imbaraga ze zose yitera hejuru agiye kugwa bamutega ingoma ayigwa rutsike acikamo ibice bibiri umwana nda aragwa arapfa apfa nk’umutabazi kimwe musaza bwimba urupfu robwa rwamugize ikirangirire bakobwa n’abagore babayeho mateka y’u rwanda ntiyatinye kumenera igihugu cye amaraso nubwo akiri muto akaba umwamikazi kuzavamo n’umugabekazi w’i gisaka yanze kubyarana n’umwami w’i gisaka kuko nkuko kimenyi yabitekerezaga mwana w’umuhungu kubyarana kuzigarurira u rwanda akarutwarana n’i gisaka yubahirije isezerano yarasezezeranye se nsoro kugirango u rwanda rukomeze rusugire rutazigarurirwa n’abanyamahanga ibi bishimangira mugani ugira utiwanga kumenera igihugu amaraso imbwa zikayanywera title: ibintu byafasha umusore udafite amafaranga gutereta umukobwa akamwegukana
content: ikibazo gikunda kubangamira abasore benshi gutereta kureshya abakobwa ukuba umufuka wabo udahagaze neza kuba ikofi y’umusore itarangwamo inoti zifatika konti ntacyibereyeho bimubera imbogamizi kuba yabasha kugira umukobwa abaza izina akamusaba urukundo byarimba bagashinga urugo mu buzima busanzwe tuziko umusore wese agira agaciro imbere y’inkumi igihe afite ahagaze bukungu umusore wambara neza ufite imodoka nziza n’ibindi bigaragaza hari urwego ariho rufatika bituma abasha guhindukiza benshi bakobwa kubareshya bikamworohera nubwo ariko amafaranga n’ubutunzi bigira uruhare runini gutuma umusore abasha kugaragara neza imbere y’inkumi abakobwa bashobora gushiturwa n’indi mico imyitwarire y’umusore bidasabye agira amafaranga menshi cyangwa ubutunzi buhambaye kuba uriwe mu kinayrwanda baca umugani umusore utiraririye ntarongora inkumi ariko kwirarira ukigira utariwe nabyo abakobwa ntibabikunda kwigira utariwe kwiyitirira utaricyo biri mubiri gutuma abasore bagayika minsi kwigira utaricyo sibyo bizatuma umukobwa agukunda ba uriwe ni wirarira ukamubeshya nyuma akakuvumbura muzakomeza gukundana kuba byatuma hari uwabigukundira umuntu ugukunze ntacyo agukurikiyeho urukundo rwanyu ruramba kwibwira uzashituza abakobwa ibintu byaguhira igihe gito ariko se nibishira muzaba mukivuga rumwe nubwo abakobwa benshi bakururwa n’ubutunzi bw’abasore ariko hari abashyira gaciro kandi bategenzwa twinshi mwene nibo bavamo mutima w’urugo kwiyizera kwiyizera nayo indi turufu ukwiriye kwitwaza kureshya abakobwa gihe butunzi buhambaye urabona kuba ntacyo urageraho ntibisobanuye udakwiriye gukunda cyangwa gukundwa kuba konti yawe ntakiriho ntibigukuraho igikundiro kwiyizera indangamuntu y’abagabonutiyizera ninde uzagushyiramo cyizere utegereje kuzigirira icyizere kwegera inkumi ugatereta wujuje umuturirwa nutabigeraho uzasaza utarongoye utabyaye iyo si imyumvire ikwiriye kuranga umuntu w’umusore ufite icyerekezo tinyuka wimenyereze kuganiriza abakobwa nibiba ngombwa ube wasaba urukundo igaragaze kubasha gukuza impano ikurimo bituma ugaragara impano abantu bagira nyinshi kumenya kuganiriza abantu ukaba wabasetsa ukabasusurutsa abakobwa-abagore babikunda kubi kumenya kuririmba neza kumenya gukina imikino inyuranye n’izindi zinyuranyeimpano bintu byatuma abakobwa bagukunda nubwo waba mafaranga ufite uretse kuba impano wifitemo yagufasha kugira igikundiro yanagufasha kugira uva n’aho ugera ugatera imbere bukungu kuba umunyabwenge abakobwa bakunda abasore n’abagabo b’abanyabwenge niba ufite ubwenge nayo impano kandi yagufasha kugira igikundiro imbere y’abakobwa ukaba wabonamo muzibanira ubuzima musigaje isigutereta ahanini benshi basore babifiteho imyumvire itariyo urukundo nyarukundo ntirureba kuba utunze cyangwa ufite ibya mirenge ntenyo umusore wibwira azakunda ndetse agakundwa namara kugira amafaranga n’ubutunzi aribeshya ntawe umenya bwira ageze nuteretesha umukobwa amafaranga n’ubutunzi ejo bigashira azagucikaho usigare uririra myotsi ibyiza ukuba ugakuza impano ikurimo ukarangwa n’icyizere ibindi bizizana kandi bizagufasha kubona umukobwa wazavamo umugore muzabana bukene bukire

title: gael face agiye kuza kwerekana filime ’petit pays’ i kigali
content: gal faye umuraperi w’umunyarwanda ufite ubwenegihugu bw’u bufaransa yatanze integuza agiye kuza i kigali rwanda agiye kumurikira abanyarwanda firime petit pays’ ishatse kuvuga agahugu gato ishingiye gitabo yanditse mbere kuza i kigali firime yerekaniwe mujyi lille gashyantare ejo hashize yerekaniwe i toulouse munsi irerekanirwa i arles ejo izerekanirwa avignon werurwe i nice i toulon werurwe yerekanwe i aix-en province uyu muhanzi ufite indirimbo irruption imaze kurebwa n’abantu barenga miriyoni rubuga youtube yavuze firime izajya isoko werurwe muhango uzabera bufaransa anatangaza mbere y’uko munsi ugera azaba i kigali werurwe azerekana firime yise petit pays muhango uzabera century cinemayavuze nyuma i kigali firime izerekanirwa i reims ahitwa opraims werurwe yerekanirwe mujyi paris ati nzabamenyesha vuba bizabera n’amasaha indirimbo yise petit pays yasohoye werurwe shene youtube imaze kurebwa n’abantu barenga miriyoni enye imaze gutangwaho ibitekerezo abakanze akamenyetso kuyikunda n’ibihumbi uyu muraperi aheruka i kigali gashyantare yamurikaga igitabo ke yise petit pays cyahinduwe kinyarwanda olivier bahizi uwineza firime petit pays irimo nkuru y’ubuzima bw’umwana wavukiye i burundi abyarwa n’umunyarwandakazi w’impunzi n’umuzungu w’umufaransa muri gitabo mwana avuga yabonaga ubuzima gihe ibibazo by’amoko uwo mwana uba ufite hagati y’imyaka yibuka uburyo ubuto bwe bwaje kwicwa n’ibibazo poritike aka karere anavuga kibazo kuvuka babyeyi badahuje uruhu nyuma yaje guhungishirizwa i burayi nabwo yaje kubona kuba imvange bigoye kuko haba i burundi burayi hose abantu bamufataga nk’umunyamahanga amaze gukura yiyemeje kugaruka afurika kuko ariho nibura yumvaga iwabo mu byatumye yumva yigaruriye ikizere ugukunda gusoma kwandika iki gitabo kivuga mateka yaranze u burundi n’u rwanda myaka kugera nyuma yaho guhera tariki mutarama firime ifite iminota yatangiye gukinirwa karere rubavu iyobowe n’umufaransa eric barbier iyi firime yakinwemo n’abana bavutse babyeyi b’abirabura n’abazungu nk’uko bimeze gal faye izagaragaramo kandi nsanzamahoro denis wamenyekanye rwasa sinema nyarwanda akaba yaritabye imana nzeri igitabo petit pays cyaciye uduhigo dutandukanye nko inzu isohora ibitabo yitwa fnac yahembye gal faye nk’umwanditsi mwiza w’umwaka kiciro cy’abanditse ibitabo bwoko roman petit pays’ cyanatoranyijwe bitabo byitabiriye irushanwa mwaka igihembo cyatanzwe hagendewe matora y’abasomyi barenga batoranyije petit pays’ nk’igitabo gikubiyemo inkuru iryoshye kandi y’umwimerere kurusha ibindi gel faye yanegukanye igihembo prix goncourt des lycens abikesha igitabo ke petit pays’ chief editor muhaburarw

title: sena yashyize ahagaragara ubushakashatsi ku mahirwe angana n’i mibereho myiza y’abaturage
content: imwe ntego y’ubu bushakashatsi kugaragaza imyanzuro ikwiye gushyikirizwa guverinoma rwego kugira irusheho kugira imikorere n’ibikorwa bigamije kubaka leta iharanira imibereho myiza y’abaturage gushyiraho uburyo bukwiye kandi bunoze kugira abaturage bagire amahirwe angana mibereho nk’uko hon kayijire agns yabitangaje bushakashatsi bwagaragaje rwanda hatewe intambwe igaragara bijyanye n’amahirwe angana n’imibereho myiza y’abaturage kuko kuba u rwanda rwaratangiriye zeru nyuma genocide rukaba rugeze hejuru mibereho myiza y’abaturage n’amahirwe angana kwishimira ibi kandi bikaba bigaragazwa n’uburyo hagiye habaho impinduka nkingi enye guverinoma haba miyoborere myiza mibereho myiza y’abaturage bukungu butabera ubuyobozi bwegerejwe abaturage hagashyirwaho imanza zitandukanye gacaca n’abunzi ubwo bushakashatsi kandi bwerekanye n’ubwo byose byagezweho hakiri ibindi gukosora akaba mpamvu nyuma kugaragaza ibyavuye bushakashatsi itsinda ry’ubushakashatsi ryatanze inzira gukemura ibibazo muri harimo kugira igenamigambi rinoze gushaka uburyo hasuzumwa gahunda zirebana guha abaturage amahirwe angana zikorwa kurushaho gukangurira abaturage kugira uruhare gahunda leta ziteza imbere imibereho myiza gutahura kurwanya hakiri kare ibishobora kuba intandaro y’amakimbirane bantu kurushaho kunoza serivisi zitangwa nzego z’imirimo leta gufasha abatioshoboye kugira babashe kwifasha buryo burambye n’ibindi ubu bushakashatsi bwashyizwe ahagaragara kane bwatangiye gukorwa mwaka w’ anne marie niwemwiza

title: umutoza w’amavubi yatangaje kwitegura libya
content: kuri gicamunsi johnny mckinstry umutoza w’ikipe y’igihugu amavubi y’u rwanda yatangaje abakinnyi kwitegura umukino n’ikipe libya uzaba uku kwezi majonjora y’ibanze gushaka ticket y’igikombe title: kwibuka itangazamakuru umuyoboro wifashishijwe leta jenoside
content: bamwe bakoraga itangazamakuru mbere bihe jenoside yakorewe abatutsi bemeranywa bamwe baturage bakurikiraga itangazamakuru gihe abanyamakuru b’icyo gihe baza gukora kinyamwugabamwe batari gutiza umurindi leta yariho gihe kubiba urwango banyarwanda ku myaka y’amavukoumusaza karera joseph avuga yakurikira ibyaberaga itangazamakuru mbere jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ndetse bihe byayo ati hari bavugaga bati abahutu biki nka kantano abahutu kuki mwisuzugura biki muraseka bikomeye uri ruhande amushyigikiye akumva aravuga nezayashakaga kuvuga bagomba kurwanya umuntu witwa umututsi nari ndi kimisagara hari umugabo witwa jean pierre yayoboraga kimisagara umututsi bakavuga jean pierre yihishe murebe yihishe kwari ugushumuriza urabyumva bamwe abanyamakuru gihe bavuga byari bigoye gukorera mwuka wariho igihe cyose gihe wabaga utari mugambi mubi leta mbonimana silas yakoreraga radiyo rwanda avuga gihe leta yivanze cyane mikorere y’itangazamakuru buryo yagenaga radiyo itambutsa kandi biri bihembera ingengabitekerezo jenoside ati urumva nakoraga bintu gushyushyamu ndirimbo zasabwegusobanura ibintubyageze batubuza guhitisha indirimbo zimwe zimwe bavuga indirimbo ntutsi radiyo rwanda yakoreragamo abantu maneko perezidansi bategeka mpfizi wayoboraga orinfor areke kujya ahitisha indirimbo rugamba iza kayirebwa n’iza sebanani yunzemo leta yatangiye kubwira abanyamakuru igihugu cyatewe n’umwanzi igihe habyarimana yapfagabati umwanzi yafashe igihugu none namwe mugomba gukora buryo mugira uruhare kurwana nk’itangazamakuru kandi umwanzi muramuzi umwanzi umututsi umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’inama nkuru y’itangazamakuru peacemaker mbungiramihigo umwe bakoraga mwuga w’itangazamakuru gihe avuga bamwe banyamakuru nyuma kubona murongo leta bafashe ingamba akemeza umunyamakuru afite agomba kwitwara ati umunyamakuru agomba kwitandukanya n’amacakubiri yoseagaharanira gusa kuba umunyamwuga akagira umutimanama uharanira icyiza avugaicyo gihe ntaho ubogamira ni intwaro ikomeye cyane cyadufashije kwirinda kuba igikoresho cy’abashaka inyungu zabo bwite kuba igikoresho cy’abayobozi kugeza inama nkuru y’itangazamakuru rwanda itangaza hamaze kumenyekana abanyamakuru bazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ku rundi ruhandeabariho bihe ntibazibagirwa ibinyamakuru kangura rtlm ndetse bamwe banyamakuru ferdinand nahimana ndetse habimana kantano bagize uruhare rukomeye gukangurura abandi gukora jenoside denis fabrice nsengumuremyi muhaburarw

title: nyanza imihigo yashyizwe bikorwa abaturage bati ’ntabwo tuzongera kuba abanyuma’
content: meya nyanza ntazinda erasme yavuze imihigo bahize bayihiguye buryo bushimishije abaturage b’ aka karere baganiriye n’ ikinyamakuru ukwezi bavuga bafite icyizere akarere kabo katazongera kuba akanyuma meya nyanza ntazinda erasme yavuze imihigo bahize bayihiguye buryo bushimishije abaturage b’ aka karere baganiriye n’ ikinyamakuru ukwezi bavuga bafite icyizere akarere kabo katazongera kuba akanyuma mu kiganiro akarere nyanza kagiranye n’ abanyamakuru kamena gihe umwaka w’ imihigo ugeze musozo meya ntazinda yavuze mihigo bahize ariyo itarashyizwe bikorwa bitewe n’ impamvu zirimo kuba hari akarere gahuriyeho n’ izindi nzego gutinda kubona amafaranga n’ izindi mu mihigo nyanza yahize kuba yagezeho bitarenze kamena ijyanye n’ iterambere ijyanye n’ imiyoborere ijyanye n’ imibereho myiza y’ abaturage umuhigo kubahiriza inama z’ umugenzuzi mukuru w’ imari leta washyizwe bikorwa umuhigo guha abaturage bakennye cyane inkunga y’ ingoboka kandi ikabageraho gihe wahiguwe kigero umuhigo guhembera gihe abakora vup washyizwe bikorwa gihe umuhigo gukoresha ifumbire dap wagezweho kigero meya ntazinda erasme perezida jdaf kiganiro n’ abanyamakuru kamena meya ntazinda ibyo twakoze mwaka tubyishimira kuko nk’ ibijyanye n’ ibikorwaremezo kubakira abatishoboye twabigezeho musabyimana bernadette umuturage kagari rwesero umurenge busasamana yavuze hari impinduka abona mwaka buryo bafite icyizere batazongera kuba abanyuma yagize uyu mwaka imikorere yarahindutse bintu by’ iterambere mitiweri akenshi mitiweri niyo yatumye tuba abanyuma uyu munota tuvugana mbona umuyobozi wacu akora ari gukora muhanda uva werekeza i mpanga musabyimana yakomeje avuga mwaka abayobozi b’ akarere nyanza begereye abaturage cyane bakabakoresha inama ibibazo bafite bakabikemura musabyimana bernadette umuturage w’ i nyanza umuyobozi mubi utegera abaturage banezerwe uyu muturage ukorera gare nyanza yavuze kimwe bintu byatumye akarere nyanza kaba akanyuma mwaka ushize w’ imihigo harimo kuba meya ntazinda musha abaturage bataramwiyumvamo iyo umuyobozi abaturage tumaze kumwiyumvamo nibwo ibintu bitangira kugenda neza gutanga imisoro mitiweri ikindi njyewe cyari kimbangamiye ruhande rwanjye ikibazo mayibobo iyo umuyobozi mukuru aje akabona umujyi urimo mayibobo zisa nabi yavuga atavuga ahita abona ubuyobozi budakora neza sibomana andr umumotari karere nyanza yabwiye ukwezi abona mwaka hari ibyakozwe birimo imihanda kwegera abaturage kurwanya umwanda yagize uyu mwaka hari ibyahindutse imihanda yarakozwe nk’ uriya mugunzu uhinguka maranata isuku yariyongereye motari sibomana andr afite ikizere akarere atuyemo katazongera kuba akanyuma yongeyeho uyu mwaka ndabona hari ikiziyongeraho dushobora kutaba mbere ariko mwanya tukazamukaho abayobozi basigaye begera abaturage iyo abayobozi begera abaturage mitiweri barushaho kuyisobanukirwa bakayitanga ntazinda erasme watorewe kuba meya w’ akarere nyanza yavuze ingengo y’ imari bahawe imaze gukoreshwa kigero ni gihe hasigaye iminsi ibiri ukwezi gusoza umwaka w’ ingengo y’ imari kurangire

title: urwego rw’ubukerarugendo eac bihombo kubera coronavirus
content: eacb igaragaza eac nibura miliyari eshanu z’amadolari yagombaga kwinjizwa n’ubukerarugendo azagabanyuka kubera cyorezo gihe abakerarugendo bagera miliyoni bagombaga kuza gusura akarere bashobora kugabanyuka guhera werurwe mwaka ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo byatangiye guhagarara eac hirindwa ikwirakwizwa coronavirus nk’amahoteli n’amapariki byarahagaze ibihugu kandi byahagaritse ingendo z’indege hirindwa hari ababyinjiramo bafite coronavirus raporo eabc yasohotse tariki mata igaragaza ubukerarugendo rumwe nzego zinjiriza amafaranga menshi ibihugu bigize eac ruzahomba cyane raporo y’inteko ishinga amategeko eac eala yagaragaje abakerarugendo b’abanyamahanga binjira eac biyongereye bakagera miliyoni bavuye miliyoni ubukerarugendo bwagize uruhare musaruro mbumbe gdp w’ibihugu byose bigize eac sosiyete z’indege zirugarijwe eabc ivuga sosiyete z’indege eac nazo zatangiye kugerwaho n’ibihombo nyuma y’ubwiyongere coronavirus imibare itangwa sosiyete ishinzwe iby’ubwikorezi bw’indege international air transport association iata yerekana kugeza kuwa werurwe sosiyete z’indege nyafurika zari zimaze guhomba miliyari z’amadolari covid- yatangira impamvu abakerarugendo mpuzamahanga benshi basubitse ingendo bafite sosiyete z’indege zibura zitwara binagira ingaruka bandi barimo abatembereza mukerarugendo abakata amatike y’indege n’abandi bungukira bukerarugendo nka kenya airways iteganya igihombo miliyoni umunani z’amadolari kwezi kandi ibintu bishobora kurushaho kuba bibi iminsi ishira gihe icyorezo cyaba gikomeje iyo sosiyete iteganya izahomba abakiliya miliyoni bikayigusha bihombo miliyari iata ivuga sosiyete rwandair ishobora guhomba abagenzi bikayigeza gihombo miliyoni z’amadolari ibyo kandi bishobora gushyira kaga akazi k’abakozi iata ivuga kuvana sosiyete z’indege bihombo rwego rw’isi hakenewe inkunga miliyari z’amadolari amahoteli bihombo ikigo gishinzwe kumenyekanisha ubukerarugendo bushingiye nama rwanda convention bureau kigaragaza inama zigera zari kubera rwanda hagati werurwe mata zasubitswe kubera coronavirus kuba abakerarugendo bitabira inama n’abaza bukerarugendo kwinezeza barahagaze biri guhombya amahoteli menshi arimo rwanda umuyobozi ushinzwe ubucuruzi n’imenyekanishabikorwa hilltop hotel innocent tuyishime yabwiye igihe abari bariyandikishije basaba kuhakorera inama cyangwa kuharara bamaze kubihagarika ati hari inama mpuzamahanga zari zaramaze kuduteguza hari nk’inama karere abantu bagombaga kuzamo baraduteguje kwezi gatatu ukwa kane kugeza karindwi bamaze kubihagarika tuyishime avuga rwego rw’amahoteli ho babara igihombo cy’igihe kirekire kuko n’abari barabateguje mpera z’umwaka batarafata umwanzuro uhamye kuko batazi igihe icyorezo kizarangirira ati igihombo twe mahoteli dufite ntabwo kiri gatatu cyangwa ukwa kane gusa cyamaze gufata n’amezi imbere nk’abari baratwandikiye bagombaga kuzaza cyenda n’ukwa cumi ntabwo barafata umwanzuro ariko batwandikiye minsi ishize bavuga tuzareba tuzavugana igihombo kandi mahoteli gishobora gukomeza kuko n’iyo coronavirus yagabanya umurego itashirira rimwe isi buryo ibihugu bifungura amarembo bitikanga mbere umuryango title: abagabo bacyekwaho kwiba izindi moto zafashwe maboko polisi
content: mu ntangiriro z’iki cyumweru bufatanye polisi y’u rwanda n’abaturage kirehe nyagatare hafashwe moto ebyiri zari zibwe ndetse karere kicukiro umumotari yambuwe moto n’abantu bataramenyekana ariko moto yaje gusubizwa nyirayopolisi utu turere yashyikirije moto zose nyirazo ikimara kuzifata ba nyirazo bayishimiye uburyo yakurikiranye ikibazo cy’ubujura bayigejejeho kugeza ifashe moto zabo bibwe irazibashyikiriza ku mbere tariki mata hafashwe uwitwa habimana jean de dieu ukekwaho kwiba moto ifite nimero pulake rc v y’uwitwa rukundo utuye murenge kabarore karere gatsibo ayijyana karere kirehe ho yafatiweni nyuma y’aho ijoro ryo werurwe mwaka indi moto y’uwitwa cyubahiro janvier ifite nimero rd x yibiwe kagari rwisirabo murenge karangazi karere nyagatare yafashwe tariki mata mwakaumuvugizi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba chief inspector of police cip theobald kanamugire yavuze iperereza ry’ibanze rigaragaza moto habimana yafatanywe yayibye ayikuye iparitse cip theobald kanamugire yagize amaze kuyiba yayijyanye karere kirehe se wabo se wabo yagize amakenga y’aho ayikuye ahita abimenyesha ubuyobozi irafatwa ubu habimana afungiwe sitasiyo polisi kigarama na none kandi mpera z’icyumweru gishize karere kicukiro umurenge kigarama akagari bwerankori abantu bataramenyekana bateze igico umumotari witwa habimana evariste w’imyaka atwaye moto bwoko tvs re a bashaka kuyimwambura abahatuye baratabara babasha kuburizamo bujura bayishyikiriza nyirayo umuvugizi polisi mujyi kigali senior superintendent of police ssp emmanuel hitayezu yavuze mumotari yibwe moto nyuma gutegwa n’uwiyitaga umugenzi nyamara afite umugambi kuyimwambura ssp hitayezu yagize atiumuntu yaramuteze nk’umugenzi y’urusengero adepr ahazwi izina sejemu amubwira agiye kigarama mudugudu bnr umumotari yaramutwaye baragenda bagiye kuhagera aramubwira babyihorere bigarukire basubiye inyuma bageze ahari umwijima amukubita ikintu mugongo akuye gikapu afite amubwira va moto cyangwa nkwice hahise haza muntu wihishe bigaragara bafatanyije barayitwara akomeza agira atiwa mumotari wagerageje kubarwanya yaratabaje haza abaturage barabakurikira bageze hepfo kuko hari hanyereye kubera imvura baragwa bayisiga hitabazwa inzego z’umutekano moto irafatwa ishyikirizwa nyirayo polisi ikomeje gushaka abakekwaho bujura ssp hitayezu yagiriye inama abatwara moto kumenyesha vuba polisi igihe bibwe moto zabo anakangurira abatuye ntara rusange kuba ijisho ry’umuturanyi bikaba bishatse kuvuga ukugira uruhare gukumira cyose cyahungabanya umutekano w’abantu n’ibyabo ssp hitayezu yagize atiigihe habayeho ubujura moto nyirazo barasabwa kujya batangira amakuru gihe nzego z’umutekano kugira bikurikiranwe hakiri kare barasabwa kandi kwirinda kwemera gusengererwa n’abantu batazi kuko hari bigaragara bamburwa moto babanje guhabwa imiti ibasinziriza yasabye abatuye umujyi kigali kumenyesha polisi cyangwa izindi nzego z’umutekano ikintu cyose babona cyangwa bakeka cyahungabanya umutekano bakanirinda ibyaha byose biva bikagera yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: aya niyo mayeri yafasha umusore gutereta umukobwa ariwe wese wawundi wananiye abasore
content: ni kenshi usanga umuntu yakunze ariko akabura abihera abimubwira cyangwa yabimubwira bakamukurizaho bimwe ab’ubu bita gutera indobo burya umuntu aterwa indobo kubera uburyo yitwaye atereta umukobwa gahunda agufiteho ubimenya mbere y’uko umubwira ijambo ndagukunda n’ubwo hari usaba umuntu urukundo agahita arumwemerera atamugoye bitewe n’uwo ariwe burya akenshi ushobora guterwa akadobo bitewe n’uko wagiye nabi cyangwa se wabihubukiye nyamara witwara neza byashoboraga gucamo ukamwemeza dore ibyagufasha kwitwara neza igihe ugiye gutereta umukobwa ariwe wese ntabashe kukwigobotora atavuze yego kubanza kumenyana n’uwo wifuzaho urukundo bijya bibaho umuntu ahura n’undi agahita amukunda nyamara n’ubwo byabaho kwitonda biba ngombwa kugirango umenye wakunze ariwe imico n’ibyiyumviro ugenda ubona muntu agutekerezaho kuburyo agukunze ubibona mbese mukabanza gukundana bikorwa magambo akazaza nyuma kwirinda kumwereka umufuhira cyangwa se umuyobora ibi bikunze kubaho cyane ugasanga title: bureraimikoranire polisi n’abaturage yatumye hakumirwa ubucuruzi butemewe bwambukiranya imipaka
content: kuva mwaka polisi y’u rwanda yashingwaga nkingi igenderaho gukumira kurwanya ibyaha harimo imikoranire myiza yayo n’abaturage iyo mikoranire polisi n’abaturage igamije kubashishikariza kugira uruhare kurwanya ibyaha bitandukanye hagamijwe kugira u rwanda igihugu gitekanye kandi mikoranire ikaba imaze kubyara umusaruro ugaragara kuko u rwanda igihugu gitekanye nk’uko ibyegeranyo byaba rwego rw’akarere ndetse rwego mpuzamahanga bibigaragaza mu minsi yashize karere burera hakunzwe kugaragara abaturage bishoraga bucuruzi butemewe bwambukiranya umupaka wasangaga abagore n’abagabo banyura mipaka itemewe bakajya gihugu uganda bakarangurayo inzoga zitemewe gucuruzwa rwanda ndetse n’ibindi bicuruzwa bakabyinjiza rwanda bikagira ingaruka zitandukanye haba buzima bw’abanyarwanda ndetse mutekano w’igihugu nyuma y’aho polisi y’u rwanda ifatanyije n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere burera bakomereje kwigisha gushishikariza baturage bishoraga bikorwa kubivamo bagakora ubucuruzi bwemewe baturage babivuyemo bibumbira mashyirahamwe y’ubucuruzi atandukanye buryo aribo basigaye baha polisi amakuru y’abatarava bucuruzi kandi bikaba byaratumye ubucuruzi butemewe bwambukiranya imipaka n’ubw’ibiyobyabwenge bukumirwa umwe baturage wavuye bucuruzi butemwewe bwambukiranya umupaka witwa bizimana theogene w’imyaka yavuze bagenzi bavuye bikorwa bakaba baribumbiye ishyirahamwe ry’ubucuruzi bw’imyaka ryitwa ihuriron’uko bafatanya polisi y’u rwanda gukumira bucuruzi n’ibiyobyabwenge yavuze atiishyirahamwe ryacu ihuriro rigizwe n’abagabo n’abagore bahoze bacuruza magendu tukaba twarishyize hamwe mwaka nyuma gufatirwa bikorwa bitemewe n’amategeko rwanda tukigishwa ububi bwabyo tugasabwa kubivamo tukibumbira mashyirahamwe tugaterwa inkunga tukiteza imbere bizimana yakomeje avuga nyuma kwishyira hamwe guterwa inkunga hari itandukaniro buzima babayeho mbere n’ubwo babayeho munsi aha yavuze atiubu hano mupaka twahashyize ububiko bw’ibigori ibishyimbo n’amasaka turangura uganda hano karere kacu akarere kaduteye inkunga y’imashini zishya ibigori buryo minsi imbere tugiye kujya turanguza kawunga abanyamuryango bacu numwe udafite itungo ryaba inka ihene cyangwa intama mbese ubuzima bwacu bwahindutse bwiza yanavuze aribo bagira uruhare gukumira gufata abakiri bucuruzi butemewe yavuze atiubu twahagurukiye kurwanya abagishaka kwinjiza rwanda inzoga zitemewe n’ibindi biyobyabwenge kuko bahesha isura mbi icyemezo twafashe kandi inzego z’umutekano n’iz’ibanze zituri inyuma yasoje asaba abakiri bikorwa kubivamo yavuze nyungu zibamo abashshikariza kuza ishyirahamwe ryabo cyangwa cyane iby’ikoranabuhanga ku ikubitiro koranabuhanga rizakoreshwa karere rutsiro ahakunze kwibasirwa n’inkuba mont kigali ndetse nzu nshya izakoreramo rura kiyovu ubusanzwe rwanda imirindankuba ikoreshwa iyifata inkuba ikayohereza butakaariko kubera nkuba igenda igahura n’insinga n’ibindi biri butaka ihita yongera ikazamuka igahita yangiza ibintu ahanini ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga atiikibazo bagiye gukemura n’ikibikoresho by’ikoranabuhahari uburyo imirinda nkuba ihari uburyo ikorani nkuba ifatwa ikajyanwa butaka ariko kubera butaka haba harimo insingaya nkuba iragaruka ikica title: ku munsi mpuzamahanga mwarimu hagarutswe mvugo zikoreshwa zidaha agaciro mwarimu
content: uyu munsi wahariwe mwarimu wizihizwa is hose buri tariki ukwezi kukwakira buri mwakamu rwego reumujyi kigali ndetse nintara yuburasirazuba munsi wizihirijwe karere bugesera ntara y’iburasirazuba hateraniye ingeri z’abantu batandukanye barimo abarimu abanyeshuri ndetse n’abayobozi nzego nkuru leta mu biganiro byatangiwe byagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka igira itiabarimu bakiri bato nibo b’anyamwuga b’ejo hazaza umwarimu w’indashyikirwa w’uyu mwaka yitwa mukanziza drocella yagarutse byinshi byagezweho iterambere mwarimu ndetse n’iry’uburezi rusange yagarutse kandi mvugo zikoreshwa zipfobya mwarimu cyangwa se zigamije kwerekana gaciro mwarimu afite agira atihari ugera ukumva baravuze abakozi leta binjire n’abarimu usanga wagira abarimu ntibabarirwa bakozi leta akomeza avuga mwarimu atakagombye kuba urugero rw’ubukene kuko mwarimu yiteje imbere bike abona mu gihe cyera hari imvugo ndetse zimwe ndirimbo zagiraga ziti umwari wanze umwarimu n’izindi nyinshi mukanziza asaba mvugo zacika rwanda rwibohoye muri byose umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa minisiteri y’uburezi yavuze guverinoma y’u rwanda yahagurukiye ikibazo cy’abarimu rwego kugira ubizima bwiza yagarutse myanzuro yafatiwe nama y’abaminisitiri yateranye ikanzura abiga mashuri yigisha ibijyanye n’ubwarimuttcs bazajya bigira ubuntu ndetse n’abarangije ayo mashuri bakajya mwuga kwigisha bakazajya bahabwa buruse bige batange y’amafaranga y’ishuri yishyurwa ati mu kunoza itorwa n’ihabwa ry’akazi k’ubwarimu bizajya bikorerwa rwego rw’igihugu kugira hakurwemo akavuyo karangwagamo ndetse bifashe gutora abarimu bashoboye mu ijambo ryumushyitsi mukuru guverineri wintara yuburasirazuba bwana mufuruke fred yavuze ntawagira umuryango nyarwanda muzima asize inyuma mwarimu yagize atihari ingamba nyinshi leta yafashe guteza imbere mwarimu kugirango umuryango nyarwanda ugire igire indangagaciro ziwufasha gutera imbere yakomeje avuga muntu yaba uworoheje cyangwa se ukomeye utaraciye imbere mwarimu yagize atiinjeniyeriumuganga waba uricyo cyose waciye imbere mwarimu niko gaciro mwarimu ntabwo byose byagerwaho nabwo tutitaye ireme ryuburezi kandi abarimu nabo bagakora akazi kabo buri munsi bagashyizeho umutima ndetse numweteireme ry’uburezi rizagira uruhare gutuma tugira abanyarwanda basobanutse kandi bakomeye gihugu cyabo n’umuco wacyo minisiteri y’uburezi rwanda ikomeje gahunda kwita ireme ryuburezi gahunda kugabanya ubucucike bigo by’amashuri minisiteri ifite ingamba kubaka ibyumba by’amashuri bigera bihumbi cumi kimwe myaka itatu mbere abana b’aabanyarwanda bakigira heza kandi hatunganye iyi ministeri kandi ikomeje kwita buzima mwarimu kugirango akomeze atere imbere ndetse agire imibereho myiza igamije kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi rwanda denis fabrice title: intara y’amajyaruguru yatangije imurikagurisha ry’iminsi
content: afungura imurikagurisha minisitiri w’ubucuruzi n’inganda francois kanimba yashimiye urugaga rw’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru n’ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwabigizemo uruhare kugira ishobore gutangira yavuze imurika gurisha rigaragaza abanyarwanda bageze iterambere kuko rituma abantu bashobora kungurana ibitekerezo rikaba n’ishuri benshi baboneramo batari bazi bagashobora kwiga kubikora abitabiriye imurikagurisha bavuga bishimiye umwanya bahawe kugaragaza bakora ndetse bagashobora kubona ibyahandi bashobora kwigiraho bakora ibintu byiza kanimba yasobanuye leta gushyira ingufu kongerera ubushobozi ibigo bito n’ibiciriritse hihutishwa serivise bacyenera ikoranabuhanga kubafasha gushaka isoko ry’umusaruro bakora abaturage hamwe n’abikorera ntara y’amajyaruguru baratangaza aribwo bagira imurikagurisha ryitabirwa n’abanyamahanga bavuye bihugu muryango w’afurika y’iburasirasuba eac n’abashoramari bihugu asiya repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo abanyarwanda bakaba bagomba guhangana n’isoko rinini u rwanda rwagiye ry’umuryango w’ibihugu by’iburasirazuba eac yves hirwa akora top sai ikora ibijyanye n’ubugeni yvuze ibikorwa byabo byatunguye benshi kuko ababasura hari batari bazi yemeza kuba ibikorwa byabo bimenywa n’abantu benshi bizongera umubare w’ababagurira ubuyobozi bw’uturere bwitabiriye imurika gurisha bukaba buvuga bwasanze umwanya kumenyekanisha ibikorerwa turere iri murikagurisha riteganyijwe gusoza taliki ugushyingo cyakora hari imbogamizi imvura nyinshi ikunze kugwa ntara y’amajyaruguru ishobora kuzangiza ibicuruzwa n’ibimurikwa nkuko byagenze cyumweru yagwaga nyuma gufungura imurika gurisha sylidio sebuharara

title: leta yifuje abanyamigabane basanzwe aribo bagira uruhare kongera imari shingiro banki kigali
content: leta yanyuzwe n’iterambere banki kigali isaba kongera imari shingiro y’iyi banki mbere rwanda bigirwamo uruhare n’abandi banyamigabane bayo banki kigali ikomeye isoko ry’imari rwanda inteko rusange y’abanyamigabane bk group plc gicurasi yemeje kigo kijya isoko ry’imari n’imigabane nairobi hagamijwe kongera imari shingiro hagati miliyoni z’amadorali amerika ni amafaranga kigo kivuga igice kinini kizakoreshwa ishoramari ikoranabuhanga umuyobozi mukuru bk group plc dr diane karusisi yavuze kigo cyiteze kubona abashoramari benshi isoko ry’imari n’imigabane kenya umuyobozi mukuru bk group plc gatatu yatangaje mbere kugurisha imigabane basabye abasanzwe bayifitemo kongera amafaranga ariko leta igaragaza abashoramari basanzwe aribo bahabwa mahirwe ati iyo bareba ibikorwa byihutirwa guverinoma basanga bk itakiri ikibazo urwego rw’amabanki ntabwo rukiri ikibazo bashobora gushyira amafaranga bindi leta y’u rwanda yaratubwiye twebwe ntabwo tuzazamo kuko tubona mumaze kugera ahantu hashimishije amafaranga mwayakura ahandi twe tugakora ishoramari zindi nzego abakozi bk n’abayobozi bakuru bayo muhango werekaniwemo abayobozi bashya niyo mpamvu migabane tuzayijyana i nairobi kugira abandi bashoramari bashobore gushyiramo amafaranga kutitabira gikorwa bishobora gutuma imigabane leta ifite bk igabanyuka mu nibwo banki kigali yagiye isoko ry’imari n’imigabane ry’u rwanda ishaka kongera imari shingiro miliyoni dr karusisi yavuze mafaranga yakoreshejwe neza banki ikunguka ndetse igatanga inyungu banyamigabane binatuma bk imenyekana gihugu hose ndetse igaba amashami hirya hino ati twumva twakoze byiza ariko twarenzaho niyo mpamvu tubwira abashoramari bongere bikore mufuka baduhe amafaranga kuko dufite gahunda ndende cyane kongera abakiliya dufite tukagera nibura miliyoni kongera serivisi dutanga kandi murabizi dufigaye dutanga serivisi nyinshi zitari iza banki gusa iyi banki ifite ibigo biyishamikiyeho bk techouse itanga serivisi z’ikoranabuhanga bk general insurance bk capital kugeza werurwe guverinoma y’u rwanda niyo umunyamigabane munini ikigo cy’igihugu cy’ubwiteganyirize rssb kikagira hari nk’ibigo by’abashoramari b’abanyamahanga bifitemo abakozi n’abayobozi bayo bafitemo ibigo gihugu bifitemo ibigo karere bifitemo abantu giti cyabo bakagiramo izindi nzego zishamikiye leta zifitemo mu ukuboza imari shingiro bk group igeze miliyari miliyoni n’ibihumbi by’amafaranga y’u rwanda srcigihe

title: abahanzi basuye urwibutso jenoside ntarama n’urwa nyamata
content: abahanzi batorewe gukomeza cyikiro kabiri bitabiriye urwo rugendo usibye knowless bubiligi kwitabira gahunda zijyanye kwibuka nk’uko umujyanama manager abitangaza abo bahanzi babanje gusura urwibutso ntarama basobanuriwe amateka yaho ndetse n’iyicwarubozo ryahabereye basobanuriwe ukuntu mbere jenoside abatutsi bahigwaga ariko uwabaga yahungiye kiriziya ntacyo yabaga ibyo byatumye jenoside benshi bahungira kiriziya bizeye gukira nk’uko byagendaga mbere ariko siko byagenze kuko bamaze kwirundiramo interahamwe zabasanzemo zibica urw’agashinyaguro abatutsi bahungiye kiriziya central ntarama babanje kwihagararaho ariko bigeze itariki nibwo abasirikare n’interahamwe baje banakoresha n’ibisasu kuburyo haguye abagera mu rwibutso ntarama hari imibiri y’abatutsi bazize jenoside kandi hagaragara bimwe bikoresho byifashishwa rugo baje bitwaje cyangwa se bahunganye kuko batekerezaga igihe kizagera bagasubira mungo zabo hagaragara kandi n’imyenda biteye agahinda buri munyarwanda wese ava akagera yagombye kugira ntibizongere ukundi nyangezi freddy umwe baherekeje abahanzi akaba uhagarariye bralirwa gikorwa yagize kwibuka igikorwa buri wese ku ruhande rwacu bralirwa igikorwa twubaha cyane uretse guteza imbere abahanzi tugomba kubigisha amateka bralirwa yubatse inzibutso ebyiri jenoside zishyinguwemo abakozi bakoraga bralirwa bazize jenoside gisenyi kigali bralirwa kandi ikorana n’urwibutso gisozi rwego kugira busitani bwarwo hahore hasukuye ikindi abana b’imfuzi ababyeyi bishwe jenoside bakoraga bralirwa bishyurirwa amafaranga y’ishuri mashuri mato kugera secondaire ariko hari gahunda gutangira kubishyurira kaminuza ku rwibutso nyamata ahantu hafite amateka yihariye nk’uko abahanzi babisobanuriwe niho ha mbere haguye abatutsi benshi cyane gihugu abatutsi baguye hano nyamata barashinyaguriwe bitavugwa nyamata ituwe n’abatutsi barakuwe turere dutandukanye tw’amajyaruguru gisenyi ruhengeri rwego kugira bapfe kuko hari ishyamba habagamo inyamaswa nyinshi ndetse n’amasazi yateraga indwara tsetse hapfiriye benshi gihe mu mwaka habaye ubwicanyi bumeze nk’aho byari igeragezwa jenoside buhitana abatutsi bagera kandi ntawigeze ahanirwa ukwicwa kw’abo batutsi hari umuzungu w’umutariyanikazi utuye witwaga tonia locatelli bamwishe tariki bamuziza yababwiraga adashyigikiye iyicwa ry’abatutsi bahatuye buryo ndetse yaranatangiye kubatabariza miryango mpuzamahanga mu mwaka w’ haguye abatutsi barenga hakaba hashyinguye abagera muri bahashyinguye harimo umubyeyi witwaga mukandori annonciata wishwe abanje gufatwa ngufu n’interahamwe z’abagabo nyuma bamujomba igisongo gitsina kirakomeza gitunguka mutwe uwo ashyinguwe ukwe isanduku wenyine rwego kugira harusheho kugaragazwa ubugome bw’indengakamere bwakorewe mubyeyinyuma gusobanurirwa byinshi kwirebera n’amaso abahanzi bagize babivugaho ntakirutimana danny uzwi izina danny nanone yagize hari ikiyongereyeho kuko ubwa mbere nsuye nyamata hiyongereye mateka narinzi nk’uko jenoside yagizwe uruhare n’abahanzi ndateganya gukora indirimbo irimo ubutumwa ubutumwa natanga kubagezweho jenoside ukwihangana gukurikiza gahunda z’icyunamo kudaheranwa n’agahinda tukiyubaka ikivi cy’abacu tuzacyusa kandi ibyabaye ntibizongere buri muhanzi cyangwa se itsinda bagize bavuga kubyo bamaze kubwirwa ndetse kwirebera n’amaso dore magambo make ubutumwa bwatanzwe n’abahanzi nyuma gusura urwibutso ntarama n’urwa nyamata riderman yagize igihe kirageze dutange ubutumwa bwibaka banyarwanda king james ngiye kurushaho gutanga ubutumwa bwunga abanyarwanda ndirimbo zanjye bull dog abahanzi batanze ubutumwa bwanganisha abanyarwanda bakwiye kubiryozwa dream boys ijwi platini iti umuhanzi indorerwamo rubanda duharanire gusiga isi nziza kurusha twayisanze just family ijwi jimmy iti dukwiye guhindura amateka y’umuziki tukirinda ubutumwa busenya emmy yagize ibyo mbonye birandenze dukwiye gukora bwabaga kugira bitazongera young grace atinjye nari muto mbyumva mateka ariko abafana banjye n’abanyarwanda rusange nabakangurira kunga ubumwe bagakundana bakaba ubumwe jay polly iyo mbonye ibintu nkibi birandenga abakoze bashyiraga bikorwa ibitekerezo by’abategetsi babi twe twongere ingufu gushyira bikorwa iby’abayobozi beza badusaba danny dukwiye guharanira bitongera kubaho ukundi umuyobozi mukuru east african promotors yasobanuye impamvu bazanye bahanzi gusura inzibutso magambo ukugira batazakora batazanatekereza n’umunsi rimwe kuba bakora ibikorwa nk’ibi bashyigikira cyangwa bakaririmba ibikorwa nk’ibi kuko byatugejeje ahantu nakwita habi cyane ndasaba urubyiruko rusange igikorwa cyabaye rwanda cy’ubwicanyi bumeze gutya bw’indengakamere kitabaho ukundi marie clemence cyiza uwimanimpaye

title: icyo umubyeyi yakora yirinde kwangiriza umugongo nyuma kubyara
content: ababyeyi bamaze kubyara usanga bataka uburibwe bukabije bw’umugongo ubafatanya n’umunaniro basanzwe bifitiye nyuma y’amezi icyenda batwite ese mugongo uterwa n’iki umubyeyi se yakora yirinde title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye bufaransa kwezi gushize jupp yatangaje adashobora guhindura imyumvire jenoside raporo yitiriwe mucyo’ kubera izina ry’uwari umuyobozi w’iyo komisiyo mucyo jean de dieu yerekana alain jupp yagize uruhare bikorwa bitandukanye muri harimo kuba yarakoranye atizigamye guverinoma yakoraga jenoside iyo raporo kandi ivuga kuba tariki mata alain jupp yarakiriye jrme bicamumpaka jean bosco barayagwiza guverinoma y’abatabazi ikibazo gikomeye kuko umuryango mpuzamahanga warafashe icyemezo guha akato guverinoma ndetse u bubiligi leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika bakaba bamaze kubigaragaza bima viza bagabo inkuru dukesha igihecom

title: abaturage bifuza zimwe gahunda leta ziri mudugudu zahuzwa
content: mu gihe rwego rw’umudugudu hagenda hongerwa gahunda zitandukanye kandi zisaba umuturage kuzigiramo uruharebamwe baturage bagaragaza ubwazo atari mbi ahubwo zimwe zimwe zikwiye guhurizwa igihe kimwe kugira bitabangamira indi mirimo ibateza imbere umudugudu rwego rw’ubuyobozi rusha izindi zose kwegera abaturageuru rwego zingiro gahunda leta zose kuko ariho zihurizwa zikanashyirirwa bikorwa inteko z’abaturageumugandaumugoroba w’ababyeyi inama zitandukanye n’imikorere y’amatsinda atandukanye komite z’ubutakaubuhinzi kwita bana n’izindi gahunda zijyanye n’ubukangurambaga zimwe gahunda zikorerwa rwego rw’umudugudu muri rusange abaturage bavuga bumva neza akamaro k’izi gahunda icyakora rundi ruhande bakagorwa n’uruhurirane rwazo rutuma kuzigiramo uruhare bigorana buryo bumwe cyangwa ubundi uko abaturage babivuga uwanyirigira claudine-umurenge bumbogo imirimo yacu tubura tuyikora dukinga amaduka buri mwanya kubera gahunda buri kanya mukashema virginie babyutse banyoherereza mesaje bitunguranye none nabuze nabifatanya byoseari bansaba gukora ndetse n’ibyo nari napanze shyirambere jean baptiste bakwiye gushyira gahunda zose cyumweru kuko ziba nyinshi minsi y’imibyizi bitwicira akazi nkatwe b’abakanishi abakuru b’imidugudu basanzwe n’abakorerabushake bavuga batorohewe gukurikirana ishyirwa bikorwa ry’izi gahunda bagasaba zimwe nzego zikorera rwego rw’akagari manurwa mudugudu twagiranye inama zitandukanye n’abaturage kumwe n’abakuru b’imidugudubagaragaza gahunda zose rwego rw’umudugudu bigoye kuzishyira bikorwa neza kuko zirenze ubushobozi bw’umuduguduby’akarusho ukanaziha ibihembo umunyambanga uhoraho minaloc dusengiyumva samuel dukomeje gushyiraho uburyo bwose butuma inama zikenera abaturage cg abayobozi zigabanuka abanyarwanda bagiye kubona telefoni buryo bitazajya title: shoah foundation igiye kubika amateka jenoside buryo bugezweho
content: aba basore bakora akazi kubika gushyingura neza inyandiko n’ibindi bivuga mamateka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda bagiye kwiga uburyo amateka jenoside rwanda yashyingurwa buryo bugezweho cyane cyane kubika amateka buryo bw’amashusho n’amajwi iki kigo gifite uburambe kubika ubutumwa bw’amajwi amashusho ndetse n’inyandiko birebana n’amateka jenoside umuyobozi w’iyi fondasiyo karen jungblut ukurikirana mushinga gukusanya amateka jenoside rwanda yatangajeko mubyo umubano w’ibi bigo uzibandaho harimo guhana ubuhamya kugirango amateka jenoside amenyekane kw’isi bateganya gushaka amajwi n’amashusho bijyanye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda nayo ashyirwe bubiko bw’iki kigo kuko kugeza bafite ubuhamya bwanditse gusa nabwo bwaje kinyarwanda bikagerageza kubushyira zindi ndimi ikigo mpuzamahanga shoah foundation ntigiharanira inyungu kikaba gikora ubushakashatsi bijyanye n’amateka jenoside ibikorwa kwibuka abaguye ntambara kabiri y’isi iki kigo kivuga kigamije ukugerageza gufasha abantu kurenga ibibazo by’urwikekwe kugira imitima ibababarira hagati y’umwaka w’ muryango wabashije kwakira ubuhamya bw’abantu bihugu bagiye barokoka buryo butandukanye marie jose ikibasumba

title: kigaliimiterere mishya y’ubuyobozi yicaje abari meya
content: ibiro minisitiri w’intebe byatangaje gashyantare hashyizwe myanya abayobozi mujyi kigali buryo bukurikira ibiro minisitiri w’intebe byatangaje gashyantare hashyizwe myanya abayobozi mujyi kigali buryo bukurikira ibiro by’umujyi kigali madamu rugaza julian umuyobozi mukuru w’ibikorwa by’umujyi city manager bwana asaba katabarwa emmanuel umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe imyubakire n’imitunganyirize y’umujyi city engineer bwana niyongabo joseph umuyobozi mukuru w’imirimo rusange director general of corporate services madamazela muhirwa marie solange umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe igenamigambi ry’imiturire n’imitunganyirize y’umujyi chief of urban planning bwana rubangutsangabo jean umuyobozi mukuru ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu ry’umujyi urban economist mu karere gasabo madamu umwali pauline umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’akarere district executive administrator bwana mudaheranwa regis umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’akarere wungirije deputy district executive administrator mu karere kicukiro madamu umutesi solange umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’akarere district executive administrator bwana rukebanuka adalbert umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’akarere wungirije deputy district executive administrator mu karere nyarugenge bwana ngabonziza emmy umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’akarere district executive administrator madamu nshutiraguma esperance umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’akarere wungirije deputy district executive administrator izi mpinduka zishingiye itegeko n ryo rigenga umujyi kigali riherutse kuvugururwa hagakorwa impinduka miterere n’inshingano z’inzego z’ubuyobozi rwego kunoza imicungire n’iterambere ry’umujyi cyane cyane bijyanye n’ibikorwa remezo ku nyakanga nibwo umutwe w’abadepite watoye itegeko rigenga umujyi kigali risohoka igazeti leta n idasanzwe hagamijwe kunoza imitunganyirize n’imikorere by’umujyi kigali iryo tegeko rivuga uturere tw’umujyi kigali tudafite ubuzima gatozi micungire y’imari n’abakozi ahubwo abakozi bakorera turere imirenge n’utugari bakaba ab’umujyi kigali ugenera nzego ingengo y’imari gukoresha itegeko rigenga umujyi kigali kandi ryahinduye inyito n’inshingano z’abayobozi bungirije b’umujyi kigali n’urwego title: ghlid irasaba rwanda hajyaho itegeko ryo kuregera inyungu rusange
content: umuryango w’ibiyaga bigari uharanira iterambere n’uburenganzira muntu great lakes initiative for human rights and development urasaba urukiko rw’ikirenga hajyaho itegeko ryemerera umuntu kujya aregera inyungu rusange uyu muryango uvuga abanyarwanda benshi batazi uburenganzira bwabo kuba bashobora kuregera inyungu benshi michelo hansungule umwalimu kaminuza pretoria avuga abanyafurika benshi bafunzwe kubera kutamenya uburenganzira bwabo akemeza hagiyeho itegeko riha uburenganzira umuntu kuregera inyungu rusange byafasha abanyarwanda n’abanyafurika rusange yagize kubera ubujiji bw’abanyafurika abenshi ubasanga magereza bafunzwe kubera kutamenya uburenganzira bwabo ugasanga batabona n’ubushobozi gushaka abababuranira kuko abenshi abakene sam rugege kumwe n’impuguke biga buryo rwanda hajyaho itegeko ryo kuregera inyungu rusange ifotoumutesi d hansungule akomeza avuga gushyiraho tegeko bigomba kwitonderwa abanyanyarwanda bakirinda kwandukura amategeko y’abanyaburayi ameze kuko n’imico y’abanyafurika idahuye n’iy’abanayaburayi kandi amategeko agomba kujyana n’umuco w’abaturage yagize sintekereza umugore cyaro afurika ushobora kumwumvisha afite uburenganzira kujya kurega umugabo i geneve gihe yamuhohoteye gihe mugore azakubwira ngibyo iby’abazungu agiyeyo yahita yirukanwa rugo perezida w’urukiko rw’ikirenga sam rugege avuga rwanda tegeko ririho riha umuntu uburenganzira kuburana inyungu rusange ariko none n’itegeko ribibuza prof sam rugege yagize nubwo uburyo kuregera inkiko hagamijwe inyungu rusange butaragaragara rwanda bugomba kumenyekana hagasuzumwa bukenewe cyangwa budakenewe hano kubera amateka igihugu cyacu cyaciyemo buryo kuregera inkiko nyungu rusange ntabwo buratera imbere umuyobozi mukuru glihd mulisa tom avuga haramutse hagiyeho itegeko ryemerera umuntu giti cye kuburana inyungu rusange byafasha abanyarwanda benshi cyane cyane abatazi amategeko abarengera ndetse byanafasha abakene batabasha kubona amafaranga y’igarama yagize hari abaturage baherutse kujya kurega rukiko babimuye ntibabahe ingurane urukiko rubasaba buri wese gutanga igarama kandi bahuje ikibazo tuza kuba dufite tegeko umuntu umwe kuburana uru rubanza kandi hagatangwa igarama ry’umuntu umwe iyi nama ihuriyemo impuguke zitandukanye by’amategeko abasanzwe bakoresha tegeko bagaragaje bihugu byabo ryatanze umusaruro nick hulls umwalimu ishami ry’amategeko kaminuza leiden buholandi yemeza gihugu cye tegeko ryafashije abantu cyane cyane abadasobanukiwe n’iby’amategeko cyakora rikijyaho hari bamwe batumvaga rizatanga umusaruro yagize twe twatangiye gukoresha tegeko kera kugeza ritanga umusaruro kuko hari abaturage babangamiwe batazi bashobora kurenganurwa ariko kubera tegeko umuntu umwe ashobora kujya rukiko akaregera inyungu benshi umuyobozi w’umuryango uharanira uburenganzira muntu n’iterambere biyaga bigari glihd mulisa tom yemeza buryo buzatanga umusaruro rwanda kuko n’ahandi nko afurika y’epfo u buholandi gahunda kuregera inyungu rusange yagiye itanga umusaruro ubusanzwe umuntu umuntu yajyanaga ikirego rukiko bakamubaza inyungu abifitemo giti cye basanga ntazo ikirego cye kigateshwa agaciro ariko tegeko niriramuka ritowe umuntu azajya atanga ikirego n’ubwo kitaba kimufitiye inyungu ariko gifitiye inyungu abandi bantu srcizuba

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi bagiye kwifatanya n’abandi kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi gasana marcellin

title: uburwayi umutwe indwara nk’izindi kandi buravurwa
content: mu kiganiro yagiranye n’abanyamakuru kabiri tariki ukwakira dr kayiteshonga yvonne ukuriye ishami rishinzwe iby’ubuzima mutwe minisiteri y’ubuzima yagaragaje intera urwanda rumaze gutera mubijyanye guteza imbere ubuzima umutwe ugereranije n’ibindi bihugu karere hakaba harimo politiki nshya kwegereza abanyarwanda ubuvuzi bujyanye n’indwara umutwe kuburyo nibura byazagera kurwego rw’ibigo nderabuzima kuko kugeza hari abaganga b’ubuvuzi bw’uburwayi umutwe rwego rw’akarere gusa hashyizweho kandi serivisi yakira ikanasuzuma abafite ibibazo by’uburwayi umutwe yunganira ibitaro by’indera hatanzwe ibitabo bifasha abunganira ibikorwa by’ubuzima habayeho gufatanya n’izindi nzego leta guhangana niki kibazo igihe bibaye ngombwa nko gihe cy’inkiko gacaca gufatanya komisiyo ishinzwe gusezerera gusubiza mubuzima busanzwe ingabo zavuye kurugeroyasobanuye kandi uburwayi umutwe uburwayi nk’ubundi ndetse hari n’ubushobora kuvurwa bugakira ikibazo cy’uburwayi mumutwe rwanda kigenda gifata intera umwaka utashye nkuko imibare y’abitabira servise z’ubu buvuzi ibigaragaza mwaka umubare w’abagannye buvuzi abantu mwaka mwaka bamaze kugera umwaka ushize abagannye serivisi uretse kuba u rwanda rwarahuye jenoside ndetse n’ingaruka zayo zimwe muzindi mpamvu zitera kuzamuka kw’iyi mibare abanyarwanda bamaze gukangukira kwitabira gahunda z’ubuvuzi cyane cyane kuko banafite ubwisungane kwivuza ikindi imyumvire igenda ihinduka kuko ubundi wasangaga abafite burwayi barafungiranwaga bagahezwa bagahishwa cyangwa bakavurizwa mubavuzi gihanga mubapfumu bumwe buvuzi buhabwa abafite burwayi harimo imiti gufashwa buryo bw’ibiganiro hamwe kubafasha kwongera gusubira buzima busanzwe buryo butatu hari ushobora kubuhabwa bwose hari n’ushobora guhabwa bumwe cyakora uburyo gusubizwa buzima busanzwe bakaba babuhuriraho nubwo ariko hari ibyakozwe nibiteganywa gukorwa inzitizi ziracyahari izagarutsweho nk’ikibazo cy’imyumvire itari myiza ndwara mumutwe abantu bagitekereza uzirwaye atakiri umuntu muzima wagira akamaro bityo agahabwa akato imyumvire nimwe ijyana n’umuco ndetse n’imyizerere benshi bazita amarozi bagahitamo kugana abapfumu cyangwa hakaba abazifata nk’amadayimoni bakaguma nsengero ntibavuzwe ikindi umubare w’inzobere buvuzi ukiri muto rwanda mu butumwa bwatanzwe harimo kumva ikibazo cy’uburwayi umutwe icya buri wese kandi uwahuye nabwo akitabwaho mumuryango hakabaho guhindura imyumvire ndwara hakorwa ubukangurambaga buhagije kugira imikoranire hagati ministeri y’ubuzima n’abavuzi gihanga kuko usanga abafite burwayi abenshi ariho babanza bigatuma bagera kubuvuzi nyabwo batinze ikindi nabagize ibyago kuzirwara bakwiye gufashwa bakanitabwaho muryango nyarwanda kuko uburwayi umutwe nabwo uburwayi nkubundi ndetse nuwahuye nabwo akongera kwakirwa buzima busanzwe marie jose ikibasumba

title: gomawa muntu basanze afite indwara ebola birangiye imuhitanye
content: umuntu umwe basanzemo indwara ebola mujyi goma cyumweru ndwara yamuhitanye ejo mbere nk’uko byemejwe n’umuyobozi w’agace butembo uyu mugabo bivugwa umupasitori yagiye i goma modoka itwara abagenzi aturutse gace butembo agace ndwara imaze guhitanamo amagana menshi y’abantu bikekwa mupasitori yanduriye ndwara mbere kuza i goma sylvain kanyamanda umuyobozi butembo yabwiye umunyamakuru kongo mupasitori yishwe ebola nzira bamusubiza i butembo kigo cyita banduye ndwara ebola imaze guhitana abantu barenga yakwaduka - nshuro - repubulika demokarasi kongo umwaka ushize kanyamanda yagize icyatugezeho umurambo umujyi goma uhana imbibi n’uwa gisenyi rwanda ruhande rw’u rwanda hakajijwe ingamba kwirinda nk’uko ejo minisitiri w’ubuzima w’u rwanda yabitangarije mupaka gisenyi goma minisitiri dr diane gashumba yavuze umuntu basanganye ndwara yasubijwe i butembo bagendanye modoka nabo bashyizwe kato nibwo mbere ebola igeze umwe mijyi minini kongo ahantu hose abantu binjirira mijyi aka gace hari ibikorwa gupima abantu umuriro ndetse n’aho bakarabira intoki mbere kwinjira i goma ugutegereza iminsi - igihe ndwara ishobora gutangira kugaragara wayanduye - kugira bemeze wundi muntu wayanduye mujyi rubavuminisitiri gashumba yageze mupaka goma gusuzuma hakumirwa ebola ntiyinjire rwandagoma hagaragaye umuntu mbere wanduye icyorezo ebolayanditswe habarurema djamali

title: perezida kagame yasabye urubyiruko kuba umusemburo w’iterambere afurika
content: mu biganiro yagiranye n’urubyiruko rutandukanye gahunda igamije kurwongerera ubushobozi yatangijwe n’umuryango imbuto foundation perezida kagame yavuze rukwiye kuba umusemburo w’iterambere afurika gukomeza gutekereza ibyiza bizava bihugu yindi migabane yateye imbere kurusha afurika ibi umukuru w’igihugu yabisabye urubyiruko mugoroba kane tariki ukuboza yaganiraga narwo gahunda youth hagamijwe guhindura isura afurika yavuze huriro ryashyizweho kugira urubyiruko ruhurire hamwe ruganire bijyanye n’imibereho uburezi politiki n’ibyo rukoramadamu jeannette kagame yagize ibi biganiro title: indirimbo umwami yuhi musinga yaririmbye yacibwaga rwanda
content: musinga yimye ingoma ahagana werurwe ayambuye mukuru bahuje se mibambwe iv rutarindwa byakurikiwe kwitwikira nzu rutarindwa n’umuryango wose amaze kumenya yagambaniwe musinga yimye ingoma akiri muto myaka gusa nayo mpamvu minsi mbere yayoborerwaga nyina kanjogera ni imyaka iruhije kuko abakoloni b’abadage n’abamisiyoneri mbere kwinjira rwanda bashaka abayoboke banyarwanda kubera kwanga amabwiriza bamuhaga n’uburyo bashakaga kuyobora u rwanda abakoloni birukanye umwami musinga rwanda ukwakira saa yine n’igice ukwakira igihiriri ry’abaja cyahagurutse i nyanza giherekeje musinga abagore batanu n’abana icyenda nyina kanjogera n’abo muryango wabo bajyanwa nzu yabateguriwe i kamembe mu gitabo cyiswe rucunshu ruhashya pimaque ipaji kugeza kuya hagaragara indirimbo bivugwa yahimbwe n’umwami musinga yacibwaga akajyanwa i kamembe akavaha ajya i moba muri ndirimbo musinga agaragaza umwami mwiza uzi kurinda igihugu kandi ufasha abababaye agaragaza yaciwe gihugu cyaha yakoze n’agahinda atewe gusiga igihugu cye abaturage n’abana ntabwo bizwi neza ndirimbo ariyo musinga yihimbiye ubwe dore ntaho amateka amugaragaza nk’umusizi cyangwa yahimbiwe ikamwitirirwa indirimbo musinga acibwa nali rugwizarugwiza kulindanamenyaga impfubyingakiza abababaye baterambabazinkumi zikowebagore b’amalizamubeho neza jye nciwentagira igicumurohabe gitoyamba ndoga kalinga na kalingayavunnye imilishyona indamutsayabuze imitsindo jye ngiye ishyanganyuma y’ishyambaaho bagerantibagaruke nsize ibitengabitagira umutemelinsize impfubyizitagira kirera nsize rudahigwa rwigemerabakayishonga ifu iseyenaho nkuranga ingorore

title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru army week police week n’ibindi byakozwe n’abanyarwanda banyuranye nzego zitandukanye hari kandi n’ibyakorewe mahanga babaga butumwa rwego kumenyekanisha umuco mwiza igihugu cyacu gifite aha twavuga ingabo z’u rwanda butumwa bw’amahoro bw’umuryango w’abibumbye majyaruguru darfur ahitwa el-fasher batangizaga umuganda buri kwezi bafatanyije n’ingabo z’ibindi bihugu ziri butumwa nyuma y’umuganda hagendaga habaho ibiganiro bitandukanye bigamije gukangurira abaturage kwitabira gahunda leta hamwe kugira uruhare bikorwa bibakorerwa batanga umusanzu wabo rwego kwiyubakira igihugu cyane cyagerwaho batabigizemo uruhare anne niwemwiza

title: uganda n’ibindi bihugu byabonye itike kuza rwanda chan
content: ibihugu nibyo nibyo byamaze kubona itike kuzitabira irushanwa ny’afurika rihuza abakinnyi bakina imbere bihugu chan riteganyijwe kubera rwanda hagatiya tariki mutarama gashyantare issa hayatou uyoboye fifa by’agateganyo vincent de gaulle nzamwita uyobora ferwafa ayo makipe zambia angola morocco tunisia nigeria guinea ethiopia gabon zimbabwe dr congo lesotho uganda mali zone y’amajyarugu morocco tunisia nizo kipe zabashije gukatisha tike mbere kuko libya ifite chan iheruka itabashije kurenga umutaru zone y’iburengerazuba a mali yabonye itike nyuma gutsinda mauritania giteranyo k’ibitego - ikipe guinea yakatishije tike hifashishijwe igitego hanze kuko yatsinzwe ibitego - senegal ariko byarangiye igiteranyo kibitego bitatu bitatu - zone y’iburengera zuba b nigeria yasezereye burkina faso iyitsinze giteranyo kibtego - izindi kipe zibarizwa zone zone y’iburengerazuba b zizamenyekana nyuma y’umukino uzahuza ikipe cote d’ivoire ghana uteganyijwe wagatanu tariki kuno kwezi i abidjan zone y’afurika hagati ho gabon yabonye tike nyuma gutsinda tchad giteranyo cy’ibitego - gabon kandi yiyongereye dr congo yakomeje mpaga kuko centre africa yikuye irushanwa idakinnye muri zone congo cameroon ziracakirana kuwa gatandatu tariki zone y’iburasirazuba ikipe uganda ethiopia zabimburiye izindi kubona umwanya kuza chan rwanda ethiopia yakuyemo u burundi giteranyo cy’ibitego - umukino wabereye i addis ababa abarundi batsinzwe - nyamara bagiyeyo bafie impamba - batsindiye i bujumbura uganda micho milutin wahoze atoza amavubi nayo yasezereye sudan giteranyo cy’ibitego - zone y’amajy’epfo ikipe lesotho yasezerewe zimbabwe giteranyo cy’ibitego - mikino yombi mu gihe afurika y’epfo yakiriye chan iheruka yasezerewe angola bitego - mikino yombi na zambia izaba i kigali nyuma gukuramo mozambique giteranyo cy’ibitego - tombora y’uko amakipe azagabanywa matsinda iteganyijwe i kigali tariki ugushyingo srcumuseke

title: abantu basanganywe coronavirus i rusizi abanduye rwanda
content: itangazo minisante rigaragaza abarwayi bashya basanzwe karere rusizi burengerazuba bw’u rwanda rikomeza riti abarwayi bashya bagaragaye karere rusizi bashyizwe kato n’abo bahuye bahise bakurikiranwa’’ kuva gicurasi akarere rusizi kabaye izingiro coronavirus rwanda minsi ine gusa hamaze kugaragara abantu banduye cyorezo aba barimo abacuruzi bambukiranya imipaka abashoferi batwara ibintu babivanye cyangwa babijyanye i bukavu repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo n’umumotari ndetse n’abahuye inama y’abaminisitiri yateranye kamena yafashe ingamba zitandukanye zigamije gukomeza kwirinda ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo coronavirus zirimo moto zitwara abagenzi zemerewe gusubukura ibikorwa uretse turere twa rusizi rubavu ndetse ingendo hagati y’intara zemewe ariko kujya karere rusizi rubavu bibujijwe mu guhangana n’ikwirakwira coronavirus rusizi kamena hanzuwe imirenge kamembe nyakarenzo mururu n’igice gihundwe igize umujyi kamembe karere rusizi isubizwa gahunda guma rugo gihe cy’ibyumweru bibiri kwirinda ikwirakwira coronavirus abemerewe gukora ingendo abajya gutanga cyangwa gushaka serivisi ngombwa nko guhaha ibiribwa n’ibikoresho by’isuku kwivuza akarere rusizi gahana imbibi repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo ndetse ubwandu bwakagaragayemo bufitanye isano n’ingendo zambukiranya imipaka imibare igaragaza rdc bihugu byugarijwe coronavirus bikikije u rwanda kuko abantu bamaze kuyandura barayikize gihe yabahitanye u rwanda rdc byaherukaga kwemeranya kongera kunoza imikoranire bucuruzi bwambukiranya imipaka ariko hakazwa ingamba kwirinda ikwirakwira coronavirus ubwandu bushya buri kuboneka bushobora gukoma nkokora iyubahirizwa ry’uwo mwanzuro abaturarwanda rusange basabwa gukomeza kubahiriza amabwiriza leta hitabwa cyane cyane gukaraba intoki kenshi n’amazi n’isabune kwambara udupfukamunwa n’amazuru gihe umuntu avuye rugo cyangwa ahuye n’abantu benshi kuva umurwayi mbere covid- iterwa n’agakoko gashya coronavirus agaragaye rwanda werurwe hamaze kuboneka banduye bipimo bimaze gufatwa barayikize gihe bakirwaye babiri bitabye imana abitabye imana barimo umushoferi w’imyaka utuye gihugu cy’abaturanyi wahisemo gutaha rwanda nyuma kuremba ndetse n’umupolisikazi w’imyaka waragiye butumwa bw’akazi mahanga aba bombi bagaruwe rwanda barembye cyane bitabwaho n’abaganga kigo cyagenewe kuvura coronavirus ariko baza gupfa ibimenyetso coronavirus birimo inkorora ibicurane guhumeka bigoranye n’umuriro yandura binyuze matembabuzi aturuka myanya y’ubuhumekero

title: amajyaruguruumwanda ukabije w’amabagiro uhangayikishije benshi gihe bavuga bateye imbere
content: ikibazo kutagira amabagiro yujuje ibisabwa turere dutandukanye tugize intara y’amajyaruguru gihangayikishije abacuruza inyama n’abazihaha dore ziboneka kugiciro bita gihanitse ndetse ahandi zikabagirwa ahatujuju ubuziranenge guverineri w’iyi ntara akaba asaba abayobozi buturere kwihutisha imirimo y’ahari kubakwa amabagiro abandi bagashaka ahakwiyambazwa ariko hadashyira ubuzima bw’abaturage kaga ingaruka ziki kibazo zumvikanira majwi y’abamwe bagura inyama bagaragazako zibagirwa batizeye isuku yahoariko bikaba amabura kindi umwe yagize atidupfa guhaha tukarya ingaruka nyine zose ni nyine ukujya dufata imiti tukivura ntakundi nyine undi yungamo atiumwanda waturutse urebye abakozi babaga uburyo bambayeuko bameze n’ibikweto bambaye uretse abaguzi n’abakora ubucuruzi bw’amatungo bavuga ikibazo kibagoye shirimpumu jc ahagarariye ishyirahamwe ry’aborozi bingurube rwanda atanga urugero ntabagiro ryazo wabona majyaruguru kimwe mugenzi bavuga bigira ingaruka isoko shirimpumu jc yagize atink’ubu nanakubwira nti se hari abagiro ryazo wabona hari umuntu ugenda akiherera hariya wareba uburyo yazibaze akaza akazigeza k’uwuzicuruzaurumva haracyarimo inzira ndende igomba gukosoka n’igiciro kikaba kizwi iyi suku ikemangwa niyo yatumye ubuyobozi bw’intara y’amajyarugu bufunga ibagiro musanze nirya base karere rulindo mugihe akarere burera imirimo kubaka irya rugarama kugera musozo guverineri w’intara y’amajyaruguru honorable gatabazi jmv agaruka kibazo yavuze byatewe n’isuku nkeicyakora agasaba ubuyobozi kugishakira umuti vuba guverineri w’intara y’amajyaruguru honorable gatabazi jmv yagize atibyari umwanda twararifunze irindi twafunze irya base ryari ryubatse nabi rifite umwanda rifite n’ibindi bishobora kwangiriza ubuzima bw’abantu hanyuma twafashe icyemezo ibagiro rigomba gukoreshwa arya gakenkeni kure ariko nanone hafiubundi akarere kagombye kubaka ibagiro cyangwa gafatanyije n’abacuruzi bakuba ibagiro ikibazo kutagira amabagiro yujuje ibisabwa kizamuwemugihe ntara ifite gahunda kongera ubworozi buzaba bwiganjemo ubutanga inyama burimo intego gufasha urubyiruko korora byibuze ingurube zibarirwa miliyoni haziyongeraho inkoko n’inkwavu bisanga ubworozi bwinka bubarirwa kugipimo busanzwe bukorwa ntara ibisaba ubuyobozi gushyiramo imbaraga imirimo ikihutishwakugirango kibazo kitazabangamira byifuzo yanditswe ruhumuriza richard

title: sobanukirwa n’ibijyanye indwara y’igicuri
content: igicuri ndwara ki igicuri indwara ifata bwonko nyirizina umurwayi wayo agaragaza ibimenyetso bikurikiranye kandi ikaba ishobora kwigaragaza bitewe n’ubwoko bwayo kuko igira amoko menshi indwara y’igicuriimenyerewe cyane rwanda igira ibimenyetso nko gufata umuntu akitura hasi akagagaraagakubita umutwe hasiakarashya amaboko n’amaguru ariko hari n’ubundi bwoko bw’igicuri butamenyerewe abantu bagombye kumenya nk’uko musabyemeriya rosine ushinzwe service kwita buzima bitaro kabgayi abivuga icyo gicuri ntigitura umuntu hasi ariko gifata bwonko kirangwa n’uko umurwayi wacyo atakaza ubwenge yicaye cyangwa ahagaze buryo kumwe bashobora kubibona cyangwa akabyiyumvaho abutakaje akaba yamara igihe gito abutakaje nyuma bukagaruka ubwoko gatatu igicuri kidafata ibice byose by’umubiri nacyo gifata bwonko ariko bitewe n’agace k’ubwonko kafashwe hakagagara nk’igice kimwe cy’umubiri hari usanga bagagara nk’ibice by’intoki urugero nk’igikumwe ibiganza akaboko cyangwa igice kimwe maso n’ahandi muri rusange indwara y’igicuri ntivukanwa ahubwo hari bimwe bituma ifata umuntu ese ndwara yaba iterwa niki kimwe by’ingenzi bituma indwara y’igicuri ifata umuntu harimo kuba yakora impanuka ituma akomereka mutwe akaba yakwangirika bwonko kuburyo byakuviramo igicuri hari n’abandi barwara igicuri bitewe n’uburyo bavutsemo urugero nk’abana bato bakivuka hari ukuntu umubyeyi ashobora gutinda nda umwana akavuka yananiwe agatinda kurira rosine avuga hari igihe avuka yababaye bwonko akaba yakurizamo igicuri hari abakirwara bitewe n’uburwayi bahuye nabwo aha rosine atanga urugero rw’indwara mugiga ndwara ishobora gusigira uwayirwaye ubusembwa bwagera bwonko buryo byamuviramo indwara y’igicuri nzeyimana vincent ushinzwe kwita buzima mutwe bitaro kabgayi yongeraho har’abashobora kuvuka nko muryango umwe bakaba bafite udutsi tudatunganye neza bwonko bikaba byabaviramo uburwayi igicuri abarwara ibibyimba bwonko nabo bishobora kubatera ubumuga bwabaviramo igicuri hari n’izindi mpamvu z’imbere mubiri zishobora gutera igicuri ariko zitagaragaye inyuma umurwayi w’igicuri yafatwa ate kutita murwayi w’igicuri nibyo bituma adakira cyangwa indwara ikiyongerakenshi kenshi banyarwanda usanga umurwayi w’igicuri adakunze guhabwa agaciro nk’abandi barwayi basanzwe usanga kandi bakunze kunenwa kubera ibimenyetso bagaragaza hari nabumva amacandwe y’urwaye igicuri cyangwa umusuzi hari ingaruka byagira buzima bwabo vincent akomeza avuga bene myumvire atari ahubwo umurwayi w’igicuri umurwayi nk’abandi igifasha umurwayi w’igicuri kurusha ibindi yitabwaho akavuzwa gihe adatindijwe kuko atindijwe indwara ifata intera ndende ikarushaho kugenda ikomera gusa umurwayi w’igicuri akurikiraniwe maguru mashya ashobora gukira neza si byiza ufashwe n’indwara imutura hasiituma azana amacandwe cyangwa avugaguzwa yafatwa nk’uwafashwe n’abadayimoni cyangwa amashitani kuko hari abafite umuco kujyana abantu nk’abo nsengero kubasengera kandi rimwe rimwe igicuri barwaye ugasanga indwara irushijeho kwiyongera ni ngombwa abantu nk’abo bagomba kujyanwa muganga bagasuzumwa indwara bafite ikindi kandi si byiza urwaye igicuri yakwegerezwa umuriro kuko iruhande rw’umuriro mwuka mwiza mwinshi uhaba bikaba bishobora kugira ingaruka murwayi buryo yanakwituramo urwaye igicuri si byiza yakurira ahantu harehare yubaka cyangwa akora ibindisi byiza yatwara imodoka cyangwa ibindi binyabiziga kuko uburwayi bumufashe bishobora kugira ingaruka zikomeye abarwaje igicuri bakwiriye kwitabira kujyana abarwayi bitaro bitandukanye kuko imiti yabonetse hirya hino buryo umurwayi w’igicuri yahita yitabwaho ababyeyi bakwiye kwitabira kubyarira muganga buryo batagira ingorane z’uko umwana yavuka atinze buryo yaba afite umunaniro wamuviramo kuba yakwangirika bwonko bikaba impamvu kuba yarwara igicuri ni byiza kuvuza abana bafite umuriro hakiri kare kugira bitabaviramo kugagara bikaba byaba inkomoko y’igicurisi byiza kandi kunywa ibiyobyabwenge kuko nabyo bishobora kwangiza ubwonko bikaba byaviramo uwabinyweye indwara y’igicuri safari viateur

title: ngomalitiro zirenga z’inzonga z’inkorano zafatiwe rugo rw’umuturage
content: polisi y’u rwanda ikorera karere ngoma yafatiye rugo rw’umuturage inzoga z’inkorano zizwi izina gubwaneza isaba abaturage kutishora biyobyabwenge n’inzoga z’inkorano kuko zangiza ubuzima bw’uzinywa ibi byabaye ntangiriro z’uku kwezi polisi yageraga rugo muhawenimana edinace w’imyaka ruherereye kagari cyasemakamba murenge kibungo ikamusangana litiro z’izo nzoga z’inkorano umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda ntara y’uburasirazuba chief inspector of police cip theobard kanamugire yavuze zafashwe kubera amakuru yatanzwe n’abaturage anabashimira uruhare bakomeje kugaragariza polisi hagamijwe kurushaho gukumira ibyaha kwicungira umutekano yagize ati’’turashima ubufatanye abaturage bakomeje kugaragariza polisi kuko umuturage yegereye polisi akayibwira muhawenimana afite inzoga nyinshi rugo iwe polisi n’izindi nzego zibishinzwe zikwiye kugenzura zujuje ubuziranenge’’ cip kanamugire yasabye abaturage kwitandukanya n’ibiyobyabwenge kuko biri isonga bitera ibindi byaha aha yagize ati’’ umubare munini w’ibyaha bigaragara ntara usanga ababikoze babikoreshejwe n’ibiyobyabwenge n’inzoga zitujuje ubuziranenge abaturage bakwiye kubicikaho kuko biteza umutekano muke bikanadindiza ubukungu bw’umuryango n’igihugu rusange’’ cip kanamugire yasoje abwira abaturage kwitandukanya n’ibiyobyabwenge n’inzoga z’inkorano kuko uretse kuba bihungabanya umutekano binateza igihombo ubikora gihe bifashwe bikangizwa aha yagize ati’’buri wese akwiye kumva umutekano umureba akumva ibiyobyabwenge byangiza ubuzima bw’ubikoresha bikanamuteza igihombo igihe bifashwe birangizwa yashoye ntabashe kuyagaruza kandi hari ibindi bikorwa byemewe yakora akiteza imbere’’ amabwiriza y’inzego zibanze ateganya ufashwe acuruza inzoga zinkorano zangirizwa ruhame akanacibwa amande bihumbi kugeza y’amafaranga y’u rwanda n’uruganda ruzenga rugafungwa kugeza igihe rubonye ibyangombwa bitangwa n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuziranenge rbs akagali cyasemakamba uwitwa muhawenimana edinace wafatanywe nzoga atuye yanditswe habarurema djamali
