title: turukiya yirengagije amerika ivuga misile yabujijwe kugura n’uburusiya zizayigeraho ’mu karindwi’
content: perezida recep tayyip erdogan turukiya avuga yizeye ubwirinzi misile guhanura indege bukorwa n’uburusiya - leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika zibona nk’imbogamizi ndege zayo z’intambara - buzagera turukiya kwezi gutaha karindwi amerika yavuze turukiya idashobora kugura icyarimwe bwirinzi misile s- n’indege zayo z’intambara bwoko f- igomba guhitamo kimwe ariko bwana erdogan yavuze umuntu wese uzakura turukiya gahunda kugura indege z’intambara f- gihugu kizabimuryoza nkuko bitangazwa n’ibiro ntaramakuru reuters bwana erdogan yavuze yizeye gukemura bushyamirane n’amerika biciye kiganiro telefone mbere yuko perezida donald trump w’amerika bakorana inama mpera y’uku kwezi gatandatu turukiya kimwe n’amerika bihuriye muryango otan w’ubwirinzi uhuza ibisirikare by’ibihugu by’i burayi n’amerika washinzwe mwaka ufite intego kwirinda leta zunze ubumwe z’abasoviyeti burusiya bw’iki gihe turukiya yiyemeje kugura indege z’intambara f- kompanyi turukiya zikora ibice bigize indege bwoko turukiya - kabiri kugira abasirikare benshi bihugu bigize otan - ikomeje gukurikiza gahunda kwigenga gisirikare itagendera bikurikizwa n’ibindi bihugu bihuriye muryango ikomeje kandi gutsura umubano n’uburusiya nyuma yaho bihe bishize vuba umubano hagati yayo n’ibihugu by’i burayi n’amerika ucumbagiriye ubwirinzi misile s- bwoko kini bumwe bwirinzi guhanura indege bukataje cyane kurusha ubundi isi uburusiya buvuga ubwirinzi bumwe misile buzwi s- bushobora guhanura indege icyarimwe amakuru avuga bushobora guhanura indege ntera igera kilometero uvuye butaka

title: kayonza umwarimu wakubise abagenzuzi yasabwe gusezera kazi
content: mu ntangiriro z’icyumweru gishize nibwo havuzwe umwarimu wakubise abagenzuzi b’uburezi karere kayonza bivugwa amaze gukubitwa urushyi yirwanaho uyu mwarimu yaje gutumizwa karere asabwa kwandika asezera mpamvu ze bwite mbere tariki nzeri arasinya mwumvaneza geoffrey umwarimu mwaka gatandatu w’amashuri abanza rwunge rw’amashuri juru murenge gahini karere kayonza ubwo itsinda ry’abagenzuzi bavuye reb riyobowe kageruka benjamin ryageraga kigo mwarimu yasabwe ibisobanuro migendekere y’akazi arabibura kageruka amukubita urushyi umwarimu yahise amusubiza umugeri ibyari ubugenzuzi bihinduka imirwano tariki nzeri urubuga the source post rwatangaje amakuru yahererekanyijwe hagati y’inzego zitandukanye aka karere yagiraga twasuye kandi gs juru tuhasanga umwarimu wasinze kandi niko asanzwe abanyeshuri binubira abaka amafaranga kugira abahe amanota anakunda gusiba kazi kabari twasabye ubuyobozi bw’akarere guhita bumuhagarika ubu butumwa kandi bwacicikanye mbuga nkoranyambaga zihuriraho abafite bahurira n’uburezi karere kayonza ndetse ntara y’iburasirazuba rusange bukeye bwaho uru rubuga rwongeye kwandika ruvuga muhizi kageruka benjamin umukozi reb wabanjye urushyi umwarimu akamusubiza umugeri mwumvaneza geoffrey bombi bahakanye bushyamirane ishuri ryabaye isibaniro ry’inama z’urudaca tariki nzeri nibwo genzura ryabaye rikabamo n’iyi mirwano tariki nzeri umwarimu warwanye yasabwe kwitaba karere ntiyabikoze ahubwo yahisemo guhunga akihisha atinya yafungwa tariki nzeri komite ishinzwe imyitwarire gs juru yarateranye isabira mwumvaneza geoffrey guhagarikwa tariki nzeri mwumvaneza yagarutse kazi amaze kuvugana kageruka bagiranye ikibazo uyu mwarimu avuga yageze ishuri umuyobozi waryo ahamagara karere ababwira yaje ubuyobozi bw’akarere bwamusabye kwitaba byihutirwa arabikora agezeyo avuga yakiriwe n’umuyobozi ushinzwe uburezi munyensanga philbert hamwe visi meya ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage harerimana jean damascene agira bansabye kwandika nsezera kazi ninanga barahamagara polisi mpitamo kwandika ngire umutekano kandi nzabashe kubona akazi ahandi tariki nzeri umuyobozi ushinzwe uburezi karere yagiye gukorana inama n’abarimu g s juru baganira bibazo byagaragajwe kigo birimo n’abandi barimu badakora bikwiye nk’uko bitangazwa n’umukozi ushinzwe uburezi karere munsi tariki nzeri hateganijwe indi nama gufata imyanzuro kibazo cy’abarimu bataye akazi igihombo burezi umwarimu wasezeye yigishaga mwaka gatandatu abana bitegura ikizamini leta gisoza amashuri abanza ubu bana ntibari kwiga bikwiye nyuma y’icyo gikuba n’ako kavuyo kigo uru rungabangabo kigo n’inama z’urudaca ntibituma haba umutuzo kigo abanyeshuri barangara gihe abarimu nama gutekereza biri mwanya kwita masomo n’ibindi niba umwarimu koko yarakoze amakosa y’akazi yakayakurikiranweho ukuri kukajya ahagaragara kandi hagakurikizwa amategeko uyu mwarimu avuga agiye kwitabaza inzego zirenganura abantu buryo ashobora kugana inkiko akarere gatsinzwe kamwishyura impozamarira ziteganyirizwa uwarenganye kazi abanyarwanda rusange bahombye amakuru kibazo abagenzuzi babangamiwe n’uyu mwarimu nabo bahombye ubutabera iyo gikurikiranwa byari kubera isomo n’abandi bakozi bitwara batyo tundi turere hakamenyekana bigenda twasuye kandi gs juru tuhasanga umwarimu wasinze kandi niko asanzwe abanyeshuri binubira abaka amafaranga kugira abahe amanota anakunda gusiba kazi kabari birego biri butumwa birimo n’ibyaha inzego zibishinzwe zagombye gukurikirana ukuri kwabyo kukamenyekana bitari ugusezera kazi’ gusa ikindi gihombo agaciro k’umunyarwanda umuntu wujuje imyaka y’ubukure ahatirwa gukora ikintu akacyemera nk’uko mwarimu abyivugira niba koko mwarimu intakoreka mukoresha ashobora kuzamwibeshyaho akamuha akazi akongera gukora nabi gihe yashoboraga gushyirwa rutonde rw’abakozi batifuzwa harimo n’inyungu uyu mwarimu afite amahirwe kuba yashaka akazi ahandi kuko atirukanwe burundu akarere nako gafite inyungu mwarimu asezeye mpamvu ze bwite bityo mategeko ntacyo kamugomba akarere niko mukoresha kandi ntikigeze gateganya kazamwirukana uku kwezi gateganye imperekeza ze niba mwarimu yasezeye bwumvikane yaba inyungu muryango nyarwanda kwishakamo ibisubizo hakemurwa amakimbirane bwumvikane havumbuwe abarimu batanga akazi uko biri kose ubugenzuzi bwageze ntego kuko nyuma y’ubwo bushyamirane nibwo hamenyekanye hari abarimu bagera bane bamaze igihe badakora bamwe bamaze kwishyiraho ababasimbura bakabihembera nubwo bitemewe abo barimo harimo umaze imyaka ibiri umaze umwaka n’igice umaze umwaka n’umaze amezi atatu atagera ishuri umuyobozi wungirije reb ushinzwe imicungire y’abarimu nzitabakuze claudien avuga umwarimu ufite impamvu zituma ataboneka kazi gihe kirekire abimenyesha ubuyobozi bw’ikigo bugashaka umusimbura bukanamuhemba kwihembera umusimbura ntibyemewe kandi biba bivutsa uburenganzira uwasimbuwe akarere kayonza kandi kari ntara y’uburasirazuba ivugwamo abarimu baringa n’abahatirwa gusinya basezera kazi nyagatare ndetse kwaka indonke bamwe bashaka kwinjira murimo aka karere kavuzwemo abayobozi bahindura amanota y’abarimu bakoze ikizamini kwinjira kazi kanavugwamo abakoze ikizamini bakagitsina ariko title: gakenke menya amateka atangaje y’ibuye akomeje kubera amayobera abarisura n’abarituriye
content: ibuye bagenge kimwe bintu byinshi nyaburanga kandi bifite amateka akomeye biri karere gakenke amateka atangaje y’iri buye akomeje kubera amayobera abarisura iryo buye riherereye murenge gakenke karere gakenke metero uvuye gasantere gakenke werekeza bitaro nembabikaba bivugwa iryo buye rifite uburebure buri hagati metero z’ubujyakuzimu n’ibuye rinini bigaragara ridasanzwe gusa rikaba rishinze butaka munsi y’umuhanda hagati y’inzu ikorerwa ubucuruzi n’akabari k’urwagwa umunyamakuru yagize amatsiko abaza abagereye urwo rutare baruzihoumusore kigero cy’imyaka yatangaje ibuye bagenge ariko byinshi ariziho ahubwo nabaza abakuruabasaza n’abakecuru ukizuru fulgence umusaza ufite imyaka asobanura amateka y’iryo buye kera cyane mbere y’umwaduko w’abazungu rwanda ngoma y’umwami ruganzu ii ndori akaba avuga ariziho yabwiwe n’abasekuruza agira data umbyara yambwiye buye ryahoraga rizenguruka kirere rishakisha abahinzi gihe babaga bageze mezabari kuryagufungura gihe ryabateshaga ibiryo bakiruka bagahunga bimaze kubarambira babibwira umwami ruganzu watwaragawayoboraga gihe uyu musaza akomeza avuga ruganzu akimara kumenya iby’iryo buye yahise aza gutabara ahura naryo arikubita umugeri riri kirere rihita rigwa hasi arishingaho uruhembe rw’umuheto ndetse n’imbwa ze zirihagarara hejuru gihe rihagarika kongera gutesha umutwe abaturage iyo witegereje ibuye bagenge’ ubonaho amajanja y’imbwa bikaba bivugwa ay’imbwa z’umwami ruganzu ii ndori watumye rihagarika gukomeza kugenda baturage bagenge ninde cyangwa iyo bavuze ibuye bagenge’ ugendeye nyito ukeka nyiraryo yaba bagenge’ ngingo abasaza batandukanye babyirukiye gace kirimo iryo buye ntibavuga rumwe nyito tayari thomas umusaza uvuga afite imyaka agira bivugwa bagenge umuntu warwanyaga umwami akajya ateza akaduruvayo gihugu yifashishije ririya buye kubera umurozi ukomeye cyane abandi basaza bavuganye ntibumva kimwe tayari nyito y’iri buye bashimangira bagenge biva ijambo ubugenge’ bisobanuye ubuhanga buvanze n’ ibitangaza abavuga bakaba babikomora bitangaza bitandukanye byakorwaga n’umwami ruganzu yagendaga anyura hose mpatswenumugabo yakobo umusaza uvuka karere gakenke agira bambwiye inkomoko y’inyito y’iri buye iva bikorwa bitangaje kandi byuje ubuhanga byakorwa ruganzu warihagaritse bivugwa inyito ibuye bagenge’ yatangiye gukoreshwa nyuma y’uko umwami arihagaritse aba baturage kandi bashimangira baha agaciro gakomeye buye cyane hari ibitangaza bitandukanye ryagiye rikora batanga urugero nk’abana bato bafite uburwayi butandukanye babicazaga buye bahitaga bakira burundu akarere gakenke kavuga kimirije imbere amateka y’iri buye yagirira akamaro abarituriye binyuze bukerarugendo kugeza bwatangiye kurikorerwaho umuyozi karere gakenke ushinzwe umuco siporo avuga ako karere gaha agaciro ibuye bagenge kandi katangiye ibikorwa kurimenyekanisha kugira ritangire kugirira akamaro abaturage barituriye uyu muyobozi agaragaza akarere gakenke gafite n’ibindi bice nyaburanga byinshi n’ibice bibumbatiye amateka bishobora gusurwa mukerarugendo bagasigira amafaranga igihugu n’abaturage babituriye bakabasha kwiteza imbere gusa akaba avuga akarere gakenke gahura n’ibibazo by’amikoro bituma hadatunganywa hakorerwe ubukerarugendo buryo bwifuzwa mu butumwa buhabwa abaturage b’akarere gakenke baturiye ibyanya bicumbikiye amateka basabwa kubibungabunga birinda kwangiza ibimenyetso by’amateka bihagaragara kugira ubukerarugendo buhakorerwa butazahagarara bimwe byanya by’amateka biboneka karere gakenke harimo ivubiro huro riri murenge muhondo ubuvumo buri murenge mataba ahitwa masangano nyabarongo’ ahitwa mbirima matovu murenge coko’ ibuye bagenge ndetse n’ibindi bice bitandukanye salongo richard muhaburarw

title: ibimenyetso by’ ingenzi bizakwereka umukunzi wawe atakigukunda namba
content: hari abantu benshi rukundo ariko by’ukuri wareba ugasanga igihe cyari kigeze batandukana buri umwe agakomeza ubuzima bwe urubuga elcrema rwakusanyije ibimenyetso bigaragaza igihe kigeze ugafata umwanzuro gutandukana n’umukunzi wawe hari abantu benshi rukundo ariko by’ukuri wareba ugasanga igihe cyari kigeze batandukana buri umwe agakomeza ubuzima bwe urubuga elcrema rwakusanyije ibimenyetso bigaragaza igihe kigeze ugafata umwanzuro gutandukana n’umukunzi wawe nta cyizere ukigirira umukunzi wawe niba cyizere ukigira umukunzi wawe igihe kirageze mutandukana kuko icyizere ikintu cy’ingenzi gituma abakundana bagumana iyo cyizere gihari urukundo ntirushobora gushinga imizi ntimubasha kumvikana bintu by’ingenzi buzima bwanyu niba utabasha kumvikana n’umukunzi wawe bintu by’ingenzi bireba ubuzima bwanyu igihe gutandukana ibintu bijyanye n’umuryangoumutungo idini bishobora kwangiza cyane umubano w’abakundana gihe batabyumva kimwe ibishashi by’urukundo byarashize niba utakiyumvamo ibishashi by’urukundo ndetse ukanagerageza bikanga bivuze rukundo ruri hagati yanyu n’impamvu kugumana umukunzi wawe aracyakomeye mateka y’ahashize niba umukunzi wawe akomeye mateka ndetse akumva atayareka mpamvu kugumana urukundo nyarwo rwubakira mateka y’uyu munsi rugateganyiriza ejo hazaza mugorwa gukemura amakimbirane hagati yanyu nibyo koko rukundo rushobora kubura amakimbirane ariko iteka mudashobora kuyikemurira mugakenera umuhuza igihe kirageze ufate umwanzuro kubivamo kuko abakundana nyabyo babasha kwikemurira amakimbirane yavuka hagati wumva bwisanzure ahubwo umeze nk’ufungiranye niba udashobora kwisanzura ugaragaze utekereza ikimenyetso mukwiye gutandukana iyo umuntu rukundo rw’ukuri abasha kugaragaza ibyiyumviro bye ntacyo yishisha abo mubana bahora baguhangayikiye niba abantu muhorana bahora bahangayitse kubera uburyo ubanye n’umukunzi wawe bisobanuye igihe kigeze ugasuzuma imibanire yanyu byaba ngombwa ugafata icyemezo gutandukana akenshi umuntu rukundo biragoye kumenya hari ikitagenda inshuti n’umuryango nibo babanza kubibona ntimukiganira bikwiye kimwe bimenyetso by’urukundo ruhagaze neza uguhana amakuru hagati y’abakundana bidashoboka mugirana ikiganiro kirambuye kandi gikora mutima mpamvu n’imwe yatuma mugumana kuko mwaba guta umwanya ubona atakigushyikira niba utekereza umukunzi wawe atagushyigikira ukora ndetse akenshi ukabona gahunda ze arizo zibanza imbere n’ikimenyetso urukundo rwanyu ruri marembera arakubeshyaigihe umukunzi wawe atakikubwiza ukuri atakikubwira ibibazo yagize musangire akabisi n’ agahiye akabishye n’akaryoshye akwereka atakigukeneye buzima bwe kuko umuntu mukundana akubona nk’ umujyanama mukuru bigatuma agutura agahinda key yageze nsinzi agashishikazwa kubikubwira ntabushake gutera akabariro agira iyo umugabo wawe cyangwa umugore wawe atagishaka mutera akabariro ugasanga ngingo ntacyo imurebaho wabimubwira akakureba nk’icyo imbwa ihaze akakubwira yumva atameze neza gihe ubimusabye mutera akabariro bishobora kuba ariyo nzira yahisemo kukwereka urukundo rwanyu rumeze nk’ igicaniro cyazimye kutaguhamagara mu kiri rukundo rwanyarwo yaguhamagaraga inshuro zitabarika akakwandikira ubutuma bugufi ndetse rimwe rimwe akakoherereza n’amagambo meza ajyanye n’urukundo amwe tuzi izina ry’imitoma ariko ugasanga wowe wigora ukamuhamagara ubashe kumva ijwi rye ugatangira ukibaza cyabaye nta kwirushya uzahita wibwira umutima utakigutekereza habe gato gutinda kazi ese inshuti yawe y’umuhungu cyangwa y’umukobwa yaba ikubwira akazi kaba kayibanye kenshi buryo budakura ruge yego rimwe rimwe yajyaga kazi agatindayo ariko arapanga n’akazi kadashoboka nijoro kandi ntako agira agatangira akakubwira njye sinkunda umunru ushaka kungendaho cyane angenzure buri mwanya’ iki gihe uzahite ubona rukundo akigufitiye kuko hari izindi gahunda yigiriyemo zitandukanye yaguha umwanya mukagira byinshi mugeraho kwiyibagiza ibihe byiza mujya mugirana iyo umukunzi wawe ashaka urukundo rwanyu rujyaho akadomo yirinda ikintu cyose cyabagarira urukundo rwanyu ugasanga mwarajyaga musohokana nko wikendi ntibikibaho cyangwa se ntabwo umunsi mukuru nk’umunsi w’amavuko mukiwizihiza atangira akwereka bushake bwinshi akigufitiye kandi n’umwanya afite ndetse rimwe rimwe akakubwira yabyibagiwe nubona ariko bimeze uzahite wibwira urukundo rwanyu ntarwo iyo byishimo akigira ugihura content: ibi bimwe byavugiwe kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kane tariki akaba ikiganiro cyateguwe n’ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima ishami rishinzwe kurwanya sida iki kiganiro kikaba cyari kigamije kumenyekanisha ibizigirwa nama y’igihugu ngarukamwaka kurwanya icyorezo sida bana izabera i kigali tariki kugeza ugushyingo mwaka ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe ubuzima rwanda biomedical center rbc kivuga nubwo gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye igifite ingorane kutumvikanwaho bitazatuma gahunda idashoboka dr anita asiimwe umuyobozi mukuru wungirije rbc avuga kubera imyaka y’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye ibarirwa hagati gahunda gukwirakwiza udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye niyemerwa hazabaho ubushakashatsi bw’udukingirizo tuberanye n’abo banyeshuri dr anita asiimwe agira hazabaho ubushakashatsi bwihuse hagamijwe kumenya udukingirizo turi isoko dutoya cyangwa tunini bana ubu hari ubushakashatsi dufite bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima buvuga hari abavuga udukingirizo duhari isoko ry’u rwanda tudafite impumuro nziza n’ibi tuzabyigaho hazanwe udukingirizo dufite impumuro zidatuma hari abanga gukoresha udukingirizo ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita muryango un family naryo rivuga u rwanda nirwemeza ikwirakwiza ry’udukingirizo mashuri yisumbuye rugomba gukora ubushakashatsi dukingirizo tuberanye n’abanyeshuri mashuri yisumbuye dr landry tsigain akorera un family avuga kumenya udukingirizo tungana kuko hari udukingirizo dushobora kuba tunini bamwe utundi tukaba duto bandi yatanze urugero bihugu by’afurika y’amajyepfo kuko higeze kuza udukingirizo tunini bagabo ubushakashatsi bwakozwe minisiteri y’ubuzima mwaka buzima bw’imyororokere y’ingimbi n’abangavu bugaragaza abakobwa batangira gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina myaka abahungu bagatangira myaka inzego z’ubuvuzi zivuga kuba hari abakobwa batwara inda mashuri yisumbuye ikimenyetso cy’uko hadafashwe ingamba zikomeye habaho ubwiyongere bw’ubwandu sida mashuri yisumbuye rubyiruko rusange jean baptiste micomyiza

title: impunzi z’abanyafurika ziciwe musozi sinayi mt sinai

title: guverineri bosenibamwe yashimangiye nzara ishobora guhangara amajyaruguru
content: imvura idasanzwe iherutse kwibasira ibice bitandukanye by’amajyaruguru by’umwihariko karere ka gakenke yasize ihitanye abantu batari bake ndetse itwara n’ibyabo birimo imyaka ndetse n’amatungo gusa umuyobozi w’intara y’amajyaruguru yemeje biza byateye ntara ayobora bidashobora gutuma bahura n’ikibazo cy’inzara ibi biza byibasiriye uturere dutandukanye tw’iyi ntara byaba byaratangiye kugira ingaruka mbi isoko kuko ibiciro by’ibiribwa byazamutse rwego rw’uko hari miryango irya inshuro k’umunsi abagezweho cyane n’ibi bibazo bikomeye mirenge busogo musanze rwaza n’indi itandukanye ndetse turere twose two ntara hatagaragara ingaruka z’imvura idasanzwe yaguye nzigira eliab murenge busogo musanze yagize atikuri kubona amafunguro ibintu bidukomereye turya inshuro k’umunsi ariko nabwo ukureba biraza kudukwira byanze tujya buriri tukiryamira iyi nzara yatewe n’uko imirima y’imyaka imvura yayijyanye ikiro cy’ibirayi amafaranga kandi ntikizagabanuka kubera mbuto y’ibirayi ihari ntaho yava ubu imbuto igurwa karere burera uganda mafaranga igura umugabo igasiba kagungu jean baptiste murenge rwaza yagize atiubu ntawakwihanukira avuge abaturage badashonje twajyaga dutungwa n’ibishyimbo none izuba ryavuye kare birarumba twatungwaga hano n’ibijumba twaburaga ibishyimbo none ntabyo mbese tumerewe nabi kuko minsi imbere bishobora gushira burundu na wese ikiro cy’ibishyimbo amafaranga ibintu bitabayeho mateka y’u rwandaturasaba leta yareba uburyo ushakisha ibiribwa igashyiraho n’amasoko tuzajya tubiguriramo giciro hasi guverineri w’intara y’amajyaruguru bosenibamwe aime yemera bishoboka imvura idasanzwe yaguye ntara yagira ingaruka giciro isoko gusa akavuga ubuyobozi bwafashe ingamba guha abaturage imbuto guhinga buryo yemeza ntara izakomeza kuba ikigega cy’igihugu biribwa yagize ni koko intara y’amajyaruguru yahuye n’ibiza bikomeye kandi bitandukanye ariko mpamvu kuvuga hari inzara kuko ndizera ikigega cy’ igihugu kandi kizakomeza kuba nta nzara bahuye n’ibiza twavuganye rab igiye kubashakira imbuto zinyuranye ibirayi ibigori n’ibishyimboabaturage ntibagire ubwoba nzara bazagira kuko ubuyobozi bwabo buzi ibibazo bihari kandi buri kumwe title: musanze fondation kabeho irakangurira abandi kwitabira gahunda z’icyunamo

title: imitwe politiki irenga isi yahamagariye ibihugu gushyira hamwe bikarandura covid-
content: iyi mitwe politiki isohoye tangazo gihe gatanu isi habarurwa abantu bamaze kwandura icyorezo coronavirus bakaba biganjemo leta zunze ubumwe amerika kugeza kandi abagera gihe abamaze gupfa rusange iyi mitwe politiki ivuga icyorezo kireba isi rusange bityo ibihugu bigomba gushyira hamwe bikeneye kugitsinda ni nshuro mbere amashyaka atandukanye isi ahuriza hamwe akavuga ibihugu bikwiye kurwanya ibyorezo biba byibasiye isi muri tangazo imitwe politiki yavuze munsi coronavirus imaze kuba icyorezo kibasiye isi kikaba kirimo kubangamira buryo bukomeye ubuzima muntu amahoro y’isi n’ibikorwa by’iterambere iyi mitwe politiki yabanje kunamira buri wese harimo abaganga n’abandi bapfuye kubera cyorezo buri wese urimo kugirwaho ingaruka covid- ivuga mu gihe covid- yaba idakumiriwe hakiri kare izagira ingaruka zikomeye buzuma muntu imibereho y’abaturage n’ibindi bizagira ingaruka zikomeye mibereho muntu ndetse n’iterambere ry’ibihugu utaretse n’ubufatanye bw’ibihugu yakanguriye ibihugu byose gushyira imbere ubuzima muntu kurengera ubuzima bw’abari kaga imbere byose gushyiraho ingamba zikomeye kugira cyorezo gihashywe iyi mitwe politiki kandi igira iti dushyigikiye ibihugu bishyiraho ingamba zifatika n’uburyo buhamye gutsinda coronavirus iterambere ry’ikoranabuhanga ririho munsi rigomba gukoreshwa kugira hashakwe igisubizo nyakuri abagize mitwe politiki bagaragaza abantu bihugu bitandukanye bagomba gukurikiza amabwirizwa yashyizweho n’ingamba kwirinda bagira bati turahamagarira ibihugu byose gihe bafashe ingamba kurandura cyorezo banashyiraho uburyo buhamye gufasha bikorwa by’iterambere bagashyiraho uburyo bufatika bufasha abatishoboye n’ibigo bikiri bito bihe iyi mitwe politiki yahamagariye ibihugu byose gushyiraho uburyo mpuzamahanga buhuriweho bufasha guhangana n’ibiciro masoko n’ibindi gufasha ibikorwa by’ubucuruzi kugira harwanywe isi yazahura n’ihungabana ry’ubukungu basabye kandi hakomeza kubaho kungurana ibitekerezo gufashanya buryo igihugu gifite ibikoresho runaka gifasha ikindi kurengera abafite ibibazo coronavirus abagize mashyaka bagize bati tuzi neza cyorezo mupaka kigira gihugu cyahangana n’ingaruka z’iki cyorezo cyonyine ibihugu bigomba gushyira imbere uburyo bw’ubufatanye bashimiye kandi igihugu cy’u bushinwa uburyo cyarwanyije cyorezo kimwe n’ibindi bagishimira cyatanze ubumenyi bindi bihugu by’uburyo bwiza kurwanya bwabaho bwibasira igihugu runaka bihe ubwoko runaka inahamagarira ibihugu byose kurengera ubuzima bw’abakora bikorwa by’ubuvuzi kwita banyamahanga babirimo harimo n’abanyeshuri babyigamo iyi mitwe politiki ivuga ibihe isi irimo munsi iby’igihe gito umuryango mpuzamahanga nukomeza gushyira hamwe cyorezo kizatsindwa

title: bugesera nyuma y’inzara yaharanzwe karahahira utundi turere
content: mu myaka yashize cyane cyane umwaka w’ akarere bugesera kagaragayemo ikibazo cy’amapfa akabije hari abantu bicwaga n’inzara abandi bagasuhukamuri gihe uhatembereye ushobora kugira amateka cyangwa se amakabyankuru y’abantu abenshi baturage hari bahatuye nibo bivugira kibazo cy’inzara kihaherutseniyonzima joseph w’imyaka utuye murenge nyamata akagari maranyundo amaze imyaka aka karere avuga inzara yatangiye kugaragara bugesera mpera y’ ariko ikaza gukaza umurego mwaka w’ avuga gihe ibintu byose byari byarabuze biryo mvaruganda kugeza bijumba bihingiragaagira umva ibijumba ibijumba gihe inaha byaribwaga n’umuntu ufite imodoka ndakubwiza ukuri mukene wapfaga kubyigondera niyonzima yongeraho impamvu yateraga byose izuba ryari ryaracanye buryo batirirwaga bahinga n’uwahinganga ntiyeze avuga igihe ahantu hapfaga kwera ibijumba hari bishanga kandi byajyaga kubageraho byahenze yongeraho mwaka w’ abantu bishwe n’inzara buryo bukabije duce twa gashora ngenda gahembe maranyundo abandi barasuhuka ati gihe abagabo benshi barahungaga kubera kubura bagaburira imiryango abagore bakishyira migozi kubera kubura bagaburira abana mukanzaramba feresita umugore w’imyaka y’amavuko atuye murenge mayange avuga ikintu cyaje kubarokora bugesera haje imishinga n’imwe igatangira kubaha imfashanyo z’ibiribwaagira muri gihe tutarabona imfashanyo amahirwe yasekeraga yabonaga rukacarara icyo gihe twayitaga shira umuteto kuko mbere wasangaga hari abantu batarya umutsima w’amasaka gusa abatuye aka gace bavuga ibintu bisa n’ibyasubiye buryo kuko imyaka irera abantu bakabona ibiryo bavuga ufite inoti y’igihumbi urya amanywa n’ijoro nyirabitanga jolie utuye bugesera avuga nzara ikiharangwa aka karere gahagaze neza isoko ibintu biraboneka ibiboneka kurusha ibindi harimo imboga ibishyimbo imyumbati inanasi ibigori n’ibindi ugeze isoko nyamata gice gicururizwamo imboga abacuruzi bazo nabo bemeza imboga ziboneka bwinshi mukarwema annonciata umucuruzi soko nyamata umaze imyaka igera acuruza avuga ibicuruzwa byabonetse nyuma y’aho mbere gucuruza byasaga n’ibigoranye kubera baburaga barangurira agira ibintu biriho ikibigaragaza inyanya intoryi n’izindi kandi urabona hano isoko abacuruza imboga babaye benshi kandi n’abo tundi turere basigaye baza kurangura hano aganira kigalitodaycom rwagaju louis uyobora akarere bugesera avuga icyatumye inzara igabanuka aka karere leta yafashe ingamba gutera ibiti n’amashyamba hirya hino kariya gace avuga iterwa ry’ibiti ryatumye imvura itangira kugwa n’imyaka ikaboneraho gutangira kwera ati ubu hari ibicuruzwa abacuruzi b’ i kigali baza kurangura inaha ndetse nubu dufitanye ubuhahirane n’intara kirundo gihugu cy’u burundi yongeraho byose babigezeho bakangurira abaturage gukora cyane guhinga kuzigama gukora imirimo itegamiye buhinzi gusa muri ako karere hari igihe cyageze bitoroshye kubona n’igiti kubera izuba ryari ryarahibasiye umuntu yashoboraga gusanga amatungo yapfiriye nzira kubera kubura ubwatsi n’amazi kuko hendaga kuba ubutayu egide kayiranga

title: iyo akugara k’igitsina kangiritse hashobora kongera gusubirana nyuma y’igihe kinini kwifata
content: mu butumwa twohererejwe n’umukunzi wacu yatubazaga agahu kaba gakingirije igitsina cy’umugore hymen gacitse cyangwa kangiritse umukobwa akifata gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina igihe kirekire hashobora gusubirana iki ikibazo twasanze abakobwa benshi bibaza nyuma kubona ubutumwa bwinshi bubaza ngingo kuba umukobwa yaba yasubirana ubusugi nyuma kumara igihe kirekire adakora imibonano mpuzabitsina ubutumwa bwe bwagiraga buti muraho neza mfite ikibazo kinkomereye ndi umukobwa w’imyaka nakuze ntinya gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina kuko natojwe icyaha nkurana burere ariko nageze igihe nkajya nikinisha akenshi nakundaga gukoresha karoti nyuma umuntu aza kumbwira hymen yanjye ishobora kuba yarangiritse ikibazo kiri mfite ubukwe gihe vuba umusore tuzabana yansabye turyamana ndabyanga mubwira ntakunda ngeso ambajije nkiri isugi musore twigeze turyamana ndikiriza mubwira navuka ntarakora imibonano mpuzabitsina kandi koko nibyo uretse ngeso kwikinisha nagize none hashize igihe mpagaritse kwikinisha hymen izasubirana hazasubirana none se nituryamana ntazavumbura ntakiri isugi dufite ubukwe mezi atutu imbere

title: mata hashyizweho perefe bashya bagombaga kwihutisha jenoside
content: ku munsi nk’uyu w’itariki mata leta y’abicanyi ikomeje umugambi wayo mubisha gutsemba abatutsi hirya hino gihugu iyi nyandiko iragaragaza hamwe hantu hiciwe abatutsi tariki mata leta title: u bubiligi abanyarwanda bahuriye rugendo balade sant’’ nshuro gatanu amafoto
content: iki gikorwa ngarukamwaka gitegurwa igihe ishami ryo mugabane w’u burayi rikorera bubiligi nshuro yacyo gatanu cyabereye ahitwa chteau de la hulpe’’ cyumweru tariki kanama balade sant igizwe title: menya imitwe abakobwa b’ikigihe bakoresha babone amafaranga buryo bworoshye

title: byinshi banki yihariye izatera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije rwanda
content: iyi banki biteganywa izitwa rwanda catalytic green investment bank’ yitezweho kongera amafaranga yashorwaga mishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije gihugu izaba ikora nk’izindi banki ariko yibanda gusa gutanga inguzanyo gushora imari yayo mishinga igamije kurengera ibidukikije uru rwego rw’imari ruteganywa gushyirwaho ruzafasha gukangurira ibigo byigenga gushyigikira ishyirwa bikorwa ry’imishinga itangiza ibidukikije gihugu umukozi ushinzwe itumanaho kigega leta gisanzwe gitera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije fonerwa doreen nakure yabwiye igihe fonerwa ishinzwe gukurikirana by’umwihariko ishyirwaho ry’iyo banki cyamaze gushyiraho itsinda ry’inzobere rizatanga ishusho nyayo y’imiterere n’imikorere y’iyo banki gihe vuba ati ubu twamaze guha akazi umuryango coalition for green capital’ kizadusesengurira ndetse kikaduha imiterere y’ishusho y’iyo banki rwego mpuzamahanga ibijyanye n’ingano y’amafaranga banki izatangiza bizagaragazwa n’inyigo gukorwa n’icyo kigo gifatanyije n’abandi bafatanyabikorwa the coalition for green capital umuryango udaharanira inyungu wibanda cyane guteza imbere isoko ry’ingufu zidahumanya binyuze gushyiraho banki ziteza imbere imishinga irengera ibidukikije kuva mwaka muryango ufatanya n’ibihugu ndetse n’imiryango itari iya leta gushyiraho ibigo by’imari bishyigikira imishinga migari irengera ibidukikije kigakora ubuvugizi ndetse kigatanga ubujyanama n’ubugenzuzi mikorere y’ibyo bigo kugeza ntibirasobanuka neza banki izaba iya leta cyangwa iy’abikorera gusa nakure avuga bizaterwa n’ibintu byinshi bikiri kuganirwaho ariko akagaragaza byagakwiye kuba igikorwa cy’abikorera iyi banki nitangira izajya itera inkunga imishinga leta n’abikorera igamije kurengera ibidukikije habanje kurebwa yujuje ibisabwa nakure avuga gitekerezo gushyiraho banki kiri gushingira mahame yihariye ajyanye kugena uburyo kwifatira ibyemezo ishoramari ubushobozi kwiyongerera imari ivuye bigo by’imari ndetse bikorera hashingiwe cyane cyane bikorwa by’indashyikirwa banki mpuzamahanga zitera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije ubufasha fonerwa ndetse n’abandi bagira uruhare soko amakuru ajyanye n’itangizwa ry’iyi banki rwanda yatangarijwe mbere kiganiro cyatangiwe nama cop iherutse kubera espagne mpera z’umwaka ushize yigaga ruhare banki zigamije guteza imbere ibidukikije gutuma ibihugu bigera ntego zabyo igitekerezo gushyiraho banki nyarwanda itera inkunga imishinga irengera ibidukikije kije nyuma y’uko afurika y’epfo yashyizeho banki ifite imari shingiro miliyoni z’amadorali amerika umuyobozi ushinzwe ibijyanye n’imihindagurikire y’ikirere banki nyafurika itsura amajyambere afdb anthony nyon nama cop yatangaje hakenewe ingamba zihamye guhanga ikoranabuhanga rishya rigamije guhangana n’ibibazo by’imihindagurikire y’ibihe ati ku bw’iyo mpamvu banki nyafurika itsura amajyambere binyuze bufasha bw’ikigega kigamije kurengera ibidukikije gukorana n’ihuriro banki zigamije kurengera ibidukikije kureba uburyo butandukanye gushyira igishoro bikorwa bifasha kurengera ibidukikije rwego hasi tuzamura uruhare rw’abikorera leta yashyizeho ikigega fonerwa cyahawe inshingano gufasha u rwanda kugera bukungu butangiza ibidukikije binyuze gutera inkunga imishinga leta n’abikorera murongo kuva kigega cyashingwa hahanzwe imirimo itangiza ibidukikije mu habarurwaga ubutaka bungana hegitari bwatunganyijwe hagamijwe kwirinda butwarwa n’isuri ndetse hegitari z’inkombe n’imigezi n’ibiyaga zarasubiranyijwe hegitari ziterwaho amashyamba ndetse imiryango ifashwa kubona ingufu zikomoka mirasire y’izuba gihe toni miliyoni z’imyuka ihumanya ikirere zakumiriwe icyo gihe fonerwa imaze gutanga inkunga miliyoni z’amadorali nkunga ikaba ihabwa imishinga yatsinze binyuze marushanwa umushinga w’uruganda rw’amashanyarazi rutanga megawati ruri karere rwamagana urugero rwiza rw’ishoramari ryakozwe rwego kurengera ibidukikije u rwanda rwihaye intego ruzaba rwagabanyije umwuka uhumanya ikirere rugero rwifuzwa

title: obed ruvogera yatsinze isiganwa magare kigali-huye
content: obed ruvogera usiganwa akoresheje igare ryagenewe amasiganwa niwe wegukanye umwanya mbere akoresheje amasaha atatu n’iminota makumyabiri n’icyenda n’amasegonda makumyabiri n’atanu h’ akaba ikipe y’i huye cycling club for all obed ruvogera yakurikiwe emmanuel rudahunga ikipe rwamagana yakoresheje amasaha n’iminota n’amasegonda mwanya haza janvier hadi umukinnyi ubarizwa ikipe rubavu yakoresheje amasaha iminota n’amasegonda ku mwanya haje uwitwa innocent uwamungu ikipe rubavu akoresheje amasaha iminota n’amasegonda nathan byukusenge niwe waje mwanya akoresheje amasaha iminota n’amasegonda titus ndekezi wakoresheje amasaha iminota n’amasegonda niwe waje mwanya ku mwanya haje david nkurunziza mwanya haje jean de dieu rafiki mwanya haza emile bintunimana mwanya haza umunyatanzaniya mollel kaka meliyo mu bihembo byatanzwe wabaye uwa mbere basiganwa bakoresha amagare asanzwe yahembwe ibihumbi by’amafaranga y’u rwanda hamwe n’igare uwa kabiri yahembwe amafaranga ibihumbi n’igare uwa ahembwa ibihumbi n’igare mu basiganwa bakoresheje amagare cyiciro cy’abasanzwe makipe ikipe mbere yabaye iyitwa benediction club rubavu yahembwe ibihumbi by’amafaranga y’u rwanda title: imikino ikorwa abantu bategeranye yemerewe gusubukurwa rwanda
content: kuva tariki werurwe gikorwa siporo cyari cyemewe rwanda nyuma y’uko hari hashize umunsi umwe minisiteri y’ubuzima itangaje rwanda habonetse umurwayi mbere covid- mu kwezi gushize tariki gicurasi minisiteri siporo yagiranye inama komite olempike n’abahagarariye amashyirahamwe y’imikino n’ingaga siporo hemezwa kare imikino ishobora gusubukurwa rwanda nzeri haba amarushanwa gihe kanama hashobora gutangira imyitozo nk’uko bigaragaragara itangazo minisiteri yashyize ahagaragara kane tariki kamena imikino ikorwa abantu bategeranye irimo kunyoga igare gutwara imodoka tennis golf kugenda n’amagare hiking n’imikino ngororamubiri ishobora gusubukurwa ariko hakurikizwa amabwiriza kwirinda yagize iti hashingiwe myanzuro y’inama y’abaminisitiri kanama ngamba zafashwe gukumira ikwirakwira ry’icyorezo covid- minisiteri siporo bufatanye minisiteri y’ubuzima iratangaza ingamba zikurikira kubahiriza hasubukurwa ibikorwa siporo y’umuntu umwe cyangwa izindi zikorwa bategeranye ibikorwa siporo n’imikino byemerewe gusubukurwa kwiruka jogging imikino ngororamubiri kunyonga igare imyitozo kugenda n’amaguru hiking golf tennis umukino gutwara imodoka fencing barwanisha inkota isubukurwa ry’ibikorwa siporo zavuzwe bitangirana tariki kamena aya mabwiriza azavugurwa nyuma y’iminsi hashingiwe isesengura ry’inzego z’ubuzima amabwiriza azubahirizwa mikino izaba isubukuwe harimo kwambara agapfukamunwa mbere nyuma y’imyitozo kubahiriza intera metero n’igice hagati y’abakorera siporo n’imyitozo hanze kwitwaza imiti gusukura intoki gihe ukorera siporo kuyikoresha igihe cyose bibaye ngombwa hari kandi kwitwararira isuku y’ahakorerwa siporo n’imikino hakoreshejwe imiti yemewe yica udukoko gusukura ibikoresho byifashishwa kwita by’umwihariko ahakorwa kenshi nko nzugi buri mukinnyi azajya ashyira ibikoresho bye ukwe imikino yasubukuwe ntiyemewe gukoresha stade amahoro uretse hanze yayo umuzenguruko wayo gihe abagaragaje ibimenyetso birimo inkorora kuribwa umutwe ibicurane kwitsamura batemerewe gukorera imyitozo ngororamubiri ruhame ahubwo bagomba kwegera inzego z’ubuzima zikabakurikirana

title: kigali serena hotel nyungwe forest lodge hoteli zifite inyenyeri rwanda
content: mu gikorwa gutangaza uru rutonde cyabereye serena hotel i kigali tariki amahoteli yahawe inyenyeri zitandukanye eshanu hejuru kugera nyenyeri hagendewe ibipimo afurika y’iburasirazuba urwo rutonde ruvuga the manor lemigo mille collines lake kivu serena ziri gice cy’amahoteli afite inyenyeri enye top tower alpha palace virunga musanze amwe hoteli arindwi kigero cy’amahoteli afite inyenyeri eshatu amahoteli niyo yahawe inyenyeri ebyiri relay’s gorilla hoteli niyo yonyine yahawe inyenyeri igenzura n’ishirwa rutonde rw’amahoteli byakozwe n’ikipe y’impuguke by’amahoteri igizwe n’abakozi leta abacuruzi rwanda hamwe n’impuguke karere k’afurika y’iburasirazuba rica rwigamba ushinzwe ubukerarugendo n’ibidukikije rdb yasobanuye isuku umutekano gushimisha umurava kwakira abantu ndetse n’ingano y’ibyumba biri ingingo zakurikijwe gutanga nyenyeri rwigamba yavuze amahoteli atarashyizwe rutonde adahejwe kuko bazayashyiraho nyuma kuzuza ibyangombwa bayasabye birimo kuvugura inyubako yabijeje bazajya rutonde tw’ubutaha perezida w’amahoteli utubari n’amarestora denis karera yasobanuye inyenyeri zirutanwa ubukuru bw’amahoteli burutanwa yabigereranyije n’inyenyeri gisirikare umusirikare yongerwa inyenyeri bitewe n’ibikorwa byiza yakoze monique mukaruliza ministiri ushinzwe ibikorwa by’afurika y’iburasirazuba umushyitsi mukuru yavuze leta y’u rwanda ishyigikiye igikorwa guteza imbere amahoteli rwanda kuko ariyo nkingi y’ubukerarugendo yagize amahoteli soko y’ifaranga ryo hanze rituma amafaranga y’u rwanda agira igihagararo cyiza minisitiri mukaruliza yasobanuye ishyirwa rutonde ry’amahoteli rwanda hakurikijwe ibipimo by’afurika y’iburasirazuba birushaho guha amahoteli nyarwanda uburyo kumenyekana rwego rw’isi john gara umuyobozi w’ikigo cy’igihugu cy’iterambere rdb yavuze gutanga uru rutonde bizatuma amahoteli ahorana ishyaka ryo kunoza serivisi kugira azamuke ntera kandi n’abashyitsi bazajya babasha guhitamo ihoteli bitewe n’urwego bashaka mu byishimo byinshi afite jean luc ushinzwe imurikagurisha nyungwe forest lodge yavuze adatunguwe kuba bahawe inyenyeri eshanu yabivuze magambo twigisha abakozi bacu bihagije kandi tukanakora bwabaga gutanga serivisi nziza buri gace kose kagize nyungwe forest lodge nshimiyimana barthazar nyiri virunga hotel yahawe inyenyeri eshatu yavuze leta y’u rwanda yaramufashije cyane kuzamura serivisi hoteli ahiga mugaragaro agiye kuzamura serivisi ze kugira ubutaha azahabwe inyenyeri enye itangwa ry’inyenyeri ubwa mbere ribaye rwanda akaba n’ubwa kabari afurika y’iburasirazuba kuko tanzania iherutse gukora igikorwa nk’iki jovani ntabgoba

title: kaminuza nkuru y’u rwanda izashyingura abazize jenoside bagera

title: burera gutura kure y’imiyoboro ntibakibibona nk’imbogamizi kubona amashanyarazi
content: kuri gashyantare sosiyete y’u rwanda ishinzwe ingufu reg bukangurambaga bushishikariza abatuye kure y’imiyoboro gufata amashanyarazi akomoka zuba abatangiye kuyafata bavuze abafitiye akamaro kanini mu ngamba leta y’u rwanda yashyizeho zizafasha kugera ntego kugeza amashanyarazi zose bitarenze umwaka harimo gukoresha amashanyarazi adafatiye muyoboro munini arimo n’akomoka mirasire y’izuba mu gihe kugeza imiyoboro y’amashanyarazi duce twose gihugu bishobora gufata igihe hari uduce twagenewe kuzahabwa amashanyarazi adafatiye muyoboro munini bikazaba igisubizo kizafasha kugera ntego igihugu kiyemeje reg igenda ikora ubukangurambaga gushishikariza abaturage batuye bice byagenewe guhabwa amashanyarazi adafatiye muyoboro mugari kwitabira kugura gukoresha amashanyarazi akomoka mirasire y’izuba bakiteza imbere aya mashanyarazi kuyabona kuyashyira iwabo birihuta kandi ntibigoye igisabwa ukumva amashanyarazi meza kandi hari yakora nk’ayo muyoboro rusange munyaneza jean de la paix atuye mudugudu kabukoko yavuze mashanyarazi yamukijije kurira kizima nijoro yagize mbere nariraga kizima cyangwa nkagenda nijoro ngonga intebe n’ibindi biri nzu ariko ndacana hakabona abana bakareba makayi bakiga hakizimana emmanuel yunze munyaneza avuga ubuzima bwabaye bwiza kurushaho yagize uretse gutandukana n’ikizima ncaginga telefoni ntagombye gukora urugendo njya mucaca nkatanga inoti y’ijana nanayijyanayo sindare nyibonye ariko isaha n’isaha ndacaginga muriro wanjye uyu murasire rwose umfitiye akamaro amatara kwaka bimeze nko manywa kabagema anastasia ageze zabukuru atuye mudugudu kabukoko yavuze imirasire yatumye baca ukubiri n’ibishirira yagize kera bwariraga nkagenda nzunguza ibishirira mbone urumuri cyangwa nkacana akatadowa ubu mashanyarazi yamariye ngenda habona nkaryama ndeba mbese akatadowa n’itoroshi narabiretse anastasia avuga kera yajyaga abona amafaranga agatinya kugura telefoni ariko yabonye umurasire atazatinya kuyigura umunsi yongeye kubona amafaranga reg ivuga rwanda ingo zisaga zifite amashanyarazi izisaga zifite amashanyarazi adafatiye muyoboro rusange yiganjemo akomoka mirasire y’izuba

title: polisi y’igihugu yatangije ubukangurambaga ibyumweru mutekano muhanda
content: kuri gicurasi polisi y’u rwanda ifatanije n’abafatanyabikorwa bayo batangije ubukangurambaga bw’ibyumweru kwirinda impanuka muhanda bukaba ubukangurambaga bahaye insanganyamatsiko yiswe gerayo amahoro’ umuvugizi polisi y’u rwanda cp john bosco kabera yatangarije rba bukangurambaga buteguwe nyuma yuko bigaragaye by’impanuka muhanda ziterwa n’imyitwarire mibi y’abashoferi nko kugendera muvuduko ukabije gutwara imodoka basinzeuburangare kwica amategeko nkana y’umuhanda n’ibindi yakomeje atangaza binyuze bukangurambaga gerayo amahoro’ polisi y’u rwanda izigisha ibyiciro bitandukanye by’abanyarwanda uburyo bwiza butandukanye gukoresha umuhanda hagamijwe guhindura imyumvire ubu bukangurambaga burareba cyane cyane abanyamaguru abatwara ibinyabiziga ndetse n’abandi bakoresha umuhanda bose bazibutswa uburyo bwiza gukoresha umuhanda ku rwego rw’igihugu bukangurambaga bwatangirijwe mujyi kigali gare nyabugogo n’umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n’abantu bwana uwihanganye jean de dieu afatananyije digp marizamunda n’abafatanyabikorwa polisi y’igihugu ibikorwa gutangiza’ gerayo amahoro biri kubera gare zose hirya hino gihugu atangiza bukangurambaga umunyamabanga leta ushinzwe gutwara ibintu n’abantu minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo yatangaje gutangiza bukangurambaga atari umuhango gusa yagize ’ gutangiza ubukangurambaga bw’umutekano muhanda ntabwo umuhango gusa bugamije kwibutsa buri wese afite inshingano gutuma habaho umutekano muhanda buri mugenzi akagera ajya amahoro’’ yakomeje agira ati’’ mbere y’uko imodoka ihaguruka umushoferi agomba kubanza kwibwira abagenzipulaki z’imodoka atwaye akababwira bemerewe n’ibyo babujijwe abagenzi nabo bagomba gutanga amakuru cyatuma batagerayo amahoro’’ tubibutse bukangurambaga bw’umutekano muhanda buzamara ibyumweru bukaba bwatangirijwe gare zitandukanye hirya hino gihugu aho hazigishwa ibyiciro bitandukanye uburyo bwiza gukoresha umuhanda nkurunziza viateur bwizacom

title: ikipe y’u rwanda y’abagore izaserukira afurika brazil

title: mukore ibitunganiye imana n’igihugu cyacu- guv mufulukye abwira abayisilamu
content: guverineri w’intara y’iburasirazuba mufulukye fred yasabye abayisilamu ntara guharanira gukora ibyiza bitunganiye imana n’igihugu cyabo kuruta bakwishora bikorwa by’ubutagondwa nk’uko byagaragaye bamwe izi mpanuro guverineri mufulukye yazihaye abayisilamu ntara abereye umuyobozi mugoroba cyumweru tariki gicurasi yifatanyaga nabo gikorwa cy’ubusabane gusangira ifutari special if’tar cyabereye musigiti mukuru karere rwamagana guverineri mufulukye avuga iby’uko leta zabanje zakandamizaga abayisiramu byahindutse leta y’u rwanda irangajwe imbere perezida repubulika paul kagame yimakaje ubumwe banyarwanda bakaba basangiye igihugu abasaba kuba abayisilamu bakunda igihugu yagize ndabashimira buzima buri munsi muba mushyize igihugu imbere burya mbere kuba umukirisitu cyangwa umusilamu habanza kuba umunyarwanda n’iyo mpamvu gihugu imana yaduhaye tugomba kucyifuriza amahoro kandi tukakibanamo yashimiye abayoboke b’iri dini kuba baragize bakosora myitwarire yagaragaye gihe cyashize bamwe akaba abasaba kutirara ati kuba umusiramu cyangwa umukirisiti hari ikibihatse aricyo gukora ibintu byiza arinabyo imana izatubaza ndabakangurira gukora ibitunganiye imana n’igihugu cyacu ikibazo cy’ubutagondwa cyabayeho minsi ishize cyadusize isura mbi ariko turabashimira mwabikosoye twirinde kwirara twibagirwe kuko ababikoze n’ababibafashijemo baracyahari imam w’intara y’iburasirazuba sheikh kamanzi djumaine yavuze uku kwezi ramadhan abayisilamu turere tw’iyi ntara y’iburasirazuba baranzwe gusiba basabira abasilamu bagenzi n’abatari avuga kuba barahuriye hamwe basangira n’abandi umuco mwiza batojwe n’intumwa y’imana muhammad arashima ubufatanye bw’inzego leta n’iz’umutekano mu minsi ishize twahuye n’ikibazo cy’ubutagondwa ariko turashimira ubuyobozi gusibo basenga banaharanira kubanira neza abantu rukundo

title: barasaba guverinoma kugenza gahoro guca amakara kigali
content: abatuye ibice bitandukanye by’umujyi kigali barasaba guverinoma y’u rwanda gutwara gake guca burundu amakara mujyi kigali kuko basanga hari benshi ubuzima bwahita bugora kuko abatuye kigali batanganya ubushobozi ni nyuma y’uko minisiteri y’ibidukikije itangaje igiye guca burundu kigali amakara abatuye kigali bagakoresha gaze rwego kurengera ibidukikije abaturage kigali baganiriye nitangazamakuru barimo umugore uhagarariye abandi umwe mirenge mujyi kigali yavuze abagore ayoboye barimo kumusaba kubakorera ubuvugizi kugira guverinoma guhagarika amakara kuko ariyo ajyanye n’ubushobozi bwabo yagize kudakoresha amakara ikibazo twajyaga ducungana n’amakara ubuse wenda nihereyeho n’abaturage mpagarariye abagore kumbwira nibafunga amakara murabona tubazabaho gute namwe nk’itangazamakuru mutuvuganire rwose kuko ijwi rigera kure umwe bagabo bakorera mujyi kigali akazi gusana ibikoresho by’ikoranabuhanga yagize ariya makuru guhagarika amakara yangezeho kuko yanyuze binyamakuru dukurikirana ntabwo kudakoresha amakara twese bizatugiraho ingaruka rwego rumwe amakara ahendutse buri muturage wese mujyi kigali wajyanaga ibiceri byawe cyangwa bitewe n’uko wifite ukabasha kuyagura ukarya kumanywa nijoro ariko gaze uhereye icupa ryayo ryonyine birahenze bisaba amafaranga umuntu ashobora gupagasa ukwezi kose akomeza agira niba umuntu yabashaga kurya atekesheje amakara kugura icupa gaze ry’ibihumbi bizamusaba kwigomwa iminsi itari munsi ukibaza uti ese minsi azaba abayeho ate uyu mutenisiye tuvuye corona kandi corona yatwigishije kwizigamira leta yareka tukabanza tukizigamira ikanareba isomo ryinjiye ikabona guhagarika amakara kuko gukoresha gaze bisaba guterurira amafaranga menshi rimwe izo ngamba baramutse bahise bazishyira bikorwa aka kanya biragoye umucuruzi ufite butike murenge gitega akarere nyarugenge twaganiriye yavuze guhagarika amakara mujyi kigali byashoboka ariko byasaba leta iha abaturage igihe gihagije kwitegura uyu mugabo ucuruza ibintu bitandukanye birimo n’amakara agira hariho sisiteme y’ibyiciro urayizi kiciro kane n’uwo kiciro mbere ntabwo babayeho kimwe izo gaze nibyo kuzikoresha iterambere ariko ntabwo twese bitworoheye kimwe akomeza agira hari banyakabyizi nabonaga igihumbi munsi ngombwa kwiporogarama nkagikuramo amakara ntabwo bizankundira ngure gaze y’ibihumbi ibintu bihenze njyewe kiciro mbere aba baturage bahurizaho leta itahutiraho ihite ihagarika amakara burundu ahubwo basaba iterambere gaze ryaza gahorogahoro ubonye ubushobozi akayigura kuko abatayikoresha si bayobewe ibyiza byayo ahubwo ikibazo kiri kutabona ubushobozi kuyigura ku kane w’iki cyumweru tariki gicurasi nibwo minisitiri w’ibidukikije dr mujawamariya jeanne d’arc yatangaje amakara agiye gukumirwa burundu mujyi kigali dr title: minisitiri w’intebe arashima abikorera rusizi bagiye kuzuza inzu y’amagorofa ane
content: nubwo nzu kijyambere y’ubucuruzi rusizi rusizi commercial complex yenda kuzura minisitiri w’intebe yashyize itafari ry’ifatizo ry’ikimenyetso gutangiza kuyubaka mugaragaro mugoroba tariki minisitiri w’intebe yagize kugera gikorwa nk’iki kizatwara miliyari ebyiri z’amafaranga y’u rwanda nkunga hanze mwatse bitanga icyizere cy’ejo hazaza h’abanyarwanda ibi ukwihesha agaciro nk’uko umukuru w’igihugu akunda kubivuga ubuyobozi bw’ihuriro ry’abashoramari karere rusizi rusizi investment corporation bwasabye ubuyobozi leta kuba abikorera kugira bajye basoza inshingano bihaye ukuriye rusizi investment corporation kalisa jeremie yasabye minisitiri w’intebe kugeza ubutumwa bw’abagize iryo huriro mukuru w’igihugu kuzaza gutaha inzu niyuzura minisitiri w’intebe yijeje ubuvugizi n’ubufasha bishoboka bikorera giti cyabo karere rusizi yavuze gukorana n’abikorera giti cyabo biri gahunda guverinoma kandi imishinga nk’iyi guverinoma iyishyigikiye ihuriro ry’abashoramari karere rusizi rigizwe n’abanyamuryango rifite imari shingiro igera miliyari jean baptiste micomyiza

title: ibiribwa wagabanya kurya bituma ubura imbaraga n’ubushake gihe cy’imibonano mpuzabitsina bikaba byanatuma utarangiza
content: kenshi usanga amafunguro dufata buzima busanzwe atugiraho ingaruka gikorwa cy’imibonano mpuzabitsina usanga umugabo cyangwa umugore ananirwa gikorwa rimwe rimwe akanabura n’ubushakeisukari nyinshi ndetse n’amavuta mubiri ntabwo byiza buzima bw’ikiremwamuntu kuko itera umubyibuho ukabije iyo uriye bwoko bw’ibiribwa uba uzamura ibipimo glucose maraso nkuko abahanga by’ubuzima babivugaari nabyo biviramo umuntu kunanirwa vubagukora imibonano mpuzabitsina igihe gito gucika imbaraga mubiri urutonde rw’ibiribwa ukwiye kugabanya kurya ushaka kuzajya ukora imibonano mpuzabitsina neza ikinyobwa fanta hagarika kuzajya unywa fanta nyinshi none ho akarusho fanta ikonje ugomba kuyibagirwa abantu benshi bibwira fanta ikonje itera ubuzima bwiza ariko ukwibeshya cyane abahanga by’ubuzima bavuga fanta ikonje itera umubyibuho kandi ikagira ingaruka mutima kwandura indwara z’ibyuririzi kandi igatera n’indwara diabetebityo kunywa fanta byiza wayihagarika ukazajya unywa amazikandi udakunda amazi byibura ugafata fanta ukayifungura n’amazi cyangwa barafuifiriti y’ibirayiuku ukuriigaragara neza ndetse iranaryoha ariko ntabwo nziza buzima bw’umuntu niba wumva ushaka umubyibuho ukabije ndetse gucika intege gihe gukora imibonano mpuzabitsinawaguma ukirira ifiritiabahanga by’ubuzima bavuga ibiryo byose bitera umubyibuho byangiza n’imibonano mpuzabitsina kuko biribwa bituma intanga ziba amaziaho kurya ifiriti y’ibirayi wakwirira ifiriti y’ibijumba kuko ibijumba bifite ibintu intungamubiri nyinshi buzima bw’umuntu kuko bifasha amaraso kugira isukari gipimo cyiza ikindi kandi ibijumba bifite isukari karemano kuvanga kunywa bifite isukalikunywa ibisindisha byinshi ntabwo byizanoneho bikaba bibi kurushaho ufashe ibinyobwa bigizwe n’isukari y’ubwoko butandanye kuvanga ibinyobwa by’isukari y’ubwoko butandukanye bituma bwije bukeye ubifata ugenda ucika intege buryo gihe gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina ucika intege bikabije ndetse bikaba byanatuma utarangizaamakaronibiroroshye kugira ureke kuzajya urya amakaroni yonyine abahanga by’ubuzima bavuga amakaroni yongera isukari maraso akagenda akabyara ibinure bizagutera umubyibuho ukabije kandi umubyibuho ukabije umaze muntu ukumuca intege ndetse ukamutera n’umunaniro niba ushaka gukomeza kurya amakaroni gerageza ujye uyarya ariko nurangiza ufate salade wakoze irimo vinegere ihagije kugira igufashe kurinda mubyibuho makaloni ndetse ugomba kuyarisha isosi y’inyanya bisuits biscuit kimwe biribwa mbere bitera umubyibuho ukabije wawundi uzakubangamira mihumekere yawe niba wumva utasiba kurya biscuit ifunguro ryawe gitondo jya ugerageza uyishyireho marigarine ufate n’umureti hanyuma ubishyire mugati bizagufasha kukurinda mubyibuhokuko umubyibuho ntabwo mwiza gihe gukora imibonano mpuzabitsinahari n’ibindi bintu wakwirinda bitera umubyibuho shu flere avokaifiinyama z’inkokoamagi n’ibindi kubirya cyane bikaba byakugiraho ingaruka kubura ubushake bw’imibonano mpuzabitsinakutarangiza kunanirwa gukora gikorwayanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: polisi y’u rwanda igiye gutera ibiti buso burenga hegitari
content: ibi bikaba biri gahunda gushyira bikorwa amasezerano y’ubufatanye polisi y’u rwanda yasinyanye minisiteri y’ubutaka n’amashyamba ugushyingo umwaka ushize agamije kwita kubungabunga ibidukikije n’amashyamba umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe guhuza ibikorwa polisi n’iby’abaturage hagamijwe gukumira kwirinda ibyaha community policing department polisi y’u rwanda assistant commissioner of police acp damas gatare yavuze rusange bateganya kuzatera amashyamba mashya gusimbuza ashaje hegitari ibiti bivangwa n’imyaka bakazabitera hegitari yagize atigutera amashyamba gusimbuza ashaje igikorwa kurengera ubuzima bw’abaturage kandi polisi y’u rwanda igomba kubigiramo uruhare rugaragara kugira irinde abanyarwanda ibiza birimo amapfa inkangu isuri n’imyuzure kuko byose bigira ingaruka buzima bw’abaturage zirimo urupfu gihe cy’amapfa cyangwa cy’inkangu n’imyuzure acp gatare yavuze umwaka ushize gihugu hose amashyamba yatewe hegitari zingana hegitari zose zigomba kuba ziteweho amashyamba yakomeje agira muri myaka ibiri buri ntara ifite ubuso izateraho ibiti intara y’iburasirazuba izatera hegitari intara y’amajyaruguru itere hegitari iburengerazuba batere hegitari intara y’amajyepfo izatera hegitari ho mujyi kigali bazatera hegitari mu gutera mashyamba polisi izafatanya minisiteri y’ubutaka n’amashyamba ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kurengera ibidukikije rema uturere urubyiruko rw’abakorerabushake gukumira ibyaha rwanda youth volunteers in community policing -ryvcp n’abaturage rusange mu mwaka polisi y’u rwanda yasinyanye amasezerano n’uturere twose tw’u rwanda akaba agamije ubufatanye kubungabunga ibidukikije harimo gutera amashyamba mashya gufata neza asanzwe kuva polisi y’u rwanda yasinyana amasezerano y’ubufatanye minisiteri y’ubutaka n’amashyamba gukora umuganda bikorwa byinshi bakora munsi hakaba hanarimo gutera ibiti

title: bamwe baturage batuye bannyahe bishimiye guhabwa amafaranga atuma bimuka
content: bamwe baturage batuye kagari nyarutarama ahazwi bannyahe baravuga bishimiye guhabwa amafaranga atuma bimuka manegeka gihe biboneka ubuzima bwabo bwajya kaga mafaranga akazabafasha gukodesha gihe inzu bagenewe zitaruzura hari bamwe batekerezaga bazahabwa ingurane ariko ubuyobozi bw’akarere gasabo buvuga hari inzu bagomba guhabwa mezi imbere mu masaha mbere saa sita kagari nyarutarama abatuye midugudu kangondo mbere n’iya kabiri ndetse kibiraro barasobanurirwa ibirebana n’amafranga y’ubukode bagiye guhabwa baragenerwa ibihumbi buri kwezi bagahabwa ay’amezi ariko bagasiga icyangombwa cy’ubutaka maboko y’akarere bagasinya amasezerano batahana akazaba ikimenyetso guhabwa nzu barimo kubakirwa abamaze guhabwa mafaranga basobanura babanje kutumva neza impamvu yayo kuko usibye kuba bavuga make ntibiyumvishaka uburyo bavanwa bamaze imyaka igera batuye gusa icya mbere ukurengera ubuzima bwabo umwe manirakiza jean pierre yagize buri wese azi ibibazo afite bityo akwiye guhitamo gukora gikwiye amafaranga ayoboye wamaze kubona amafaranga n’inzu kubamo uba wayibonye na ho nyiraneza olive yagize turi visiyo baratubariye ariko kuko bihuye n’ibiza umuntu ahita afata umwanzuro hari hari icyumba salo chambrette byose hamwe imiryango turajya nkengero z’umujyi kuko bavuze batwubakira inzu nziza zijyanye n’umujyi kigali hari bamwe batekerezaga bazahabwa ingurane y’ubutaka n’imitungo iburiho kubera byose byabaruwe igisa nk’icyabateye urujijo kuko bazi neza hari umushoramari ukeneye ubutaka bwabo kandi bukaba bwarakorewe igenagaciro gihe intego mbere leta ukuvana abaturage ho hose hashyira ubuzima bwabo kaga mutsinzi pierre celestin twifuza batwimura baduhaye ingurane kuko ntidutsimbaraye kuguma hano twifuza umugi watera imbere turabyemera biragaragara manegeka gusenyuka kw’inzu byatewe n’ubukererwe kuko batubariye na ho kabera bercar aha nahatuye mwaka icyifuzo twabariwe tweretswe umushoramari arahari aracyacyeneye ubutaka bwacu nibatwishyure amafaranga twabariwe murakoze hasanzwe hariho gahunda kwimura abaturage batuye nabi kugira hirindwe bahura n’ingaruka zituruka biza byaniyongereye minsi ndetse hari n’abahasiga ubuzima umuyobozi nshingwabikorwa w’akarere gasabo umwali pauline avuga ngurane baturage bateganirijwe usibye kuzabaha inzu zigezweho zirimo kububakirwa buri muturage akazahabwa inzu hakurikijwe agaciro k’umutungo afite ati igikorwa turiho igikorwa cy’ibiza barabizi neza atimutse inzu yamugwaho agapfa mbere turimo kufasha bo amahirwe bafite barabaruriwe imitungo byabonekaga batuye buryo butubahirije igishushanyo cy’umujyi kigali babaruriwe imitungo bakazahabwa inzu zirimo kubakwa busanza muri rusange imiryango igomba kwimurwa kagari nyarutarama hagati iyihutirwa kwimurwa yanatangiye guhabwa amafranga yaba abafashije kubona ubukode bakazasaranganywa miliyoni inzu zirimo kubakwa murenge busanza karere kicukiro bakazazihabwa mezi imbere igihe zaba zitaruzura bimuwe bakazahabwa andi mafaranga y’ubukode muhaburarw

title: ikawa n’icyayi ibihingwa bifitiye runini u rwanda
content: nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille umuyobozi mukuru wungurije ushinzwe kuzamura umusaruro w’ibyoherezwa mahanga rwanda kigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe kwita byoherezwa mahanga naeb abitangaza bihingwa nibyo byinjiza amadevize menshi ugereranije n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga bivuye rwanda ibi bihingwa kandi bigirira akamaro kanini umuhinzi wabyo kuko bimuzanira amafaranga kugeza umuhinzi w’icyayi ahabwa amafaranga ijana kiro cy’amababi y’icyayi kigero cy’ubwiza kiri hagati naho cyayi kiri bwiza kugeza umuhinzi ahabwa amafaranga kiro ariko hari n’inganda zimwe zishobora kuyarenza muri mwaka igiciro cy’ikawa cyavuye mafaranga kiro cy’ibitumbwe kigera mafaranga ibi bikaba biterwa n’uko igiciro cy’ikawa cyagiye kizamuka masoko mpuzamahanga amafaranga avuye bihingwa afasha abahinzi kongera umusaruro ndetse kwikenura kuko umuhinzi aguriwe giciro cyiza agira umwete kongera umusaruro kugira yeze byinshibimwe bihugu kawa ikunze kugurishwamo harimo leta zunze ubumwe z’amarikaubuyapani ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi icyayi gikunze kubona amasoko bihugu by’abayisiramu iby’abarabu ndetse bimwe bihugu by’iburayi nk’uko corneille aritangaza abanyarwanda ntibitabira cyane kunywa icyayi n’ikawa avuga abanyanyarwanda bakwiriye kuba isoko ry’ibyo beza ntibatege amasoko banyamahanga gusa umwaka ushize umusaruro w’icyayi woherejwe hanze urenga toni zinjije akayabo kagera miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika umusaruro kawa woherejwe hanze ugera toni zinjije miliyoni z’amadorari y’amerika corneille avuga bihingwa bifasha cyane igihugu kuko bituma ubukungu bw’igihugu kuzamuka ndetse bigatuma u rwanda rugira ijambo rwego mpuzamahanga aya madevize kandi afasha u rwanda kugura ibicuruzwa rukura hanze rudahenzwe avuga u rwanda rweza umusaruro muke ugereranyije n’ibihugu duturanye ariko icyari n’ikawa by’u rwanda bifite uburyohe kurusha bihugu nk’uko ntakirutimana corneille yabidutangarije ikawa zihingwa gihugu hose ariko zibanze cyane ntara y’amajyepfo ndetse n’iy’iburengerazuba kuko ariho hari ubuso bunini bw’iki gihingwa icyayi kibanze ahanini ntara y’uburengerazuba misozi miremire y’isunzu congo nil ndetse n’iy’amajyepfo y’u rwanda cyane turere twa nyaruguru nyamagabe mu ntara y’iburengerazuba hari inganda esheshatu hakaba hanateganywa kubakwa izindi nganda eshatu rwego kuzamura ubwiza bw’umusaruro w’icyayi mu ntara y’amajyaruguru hari inganda z’icyayi mulindi gicumbi sorwathe karere rulindo mu rwego kongera umusaruro uturuka bihingwa ndetse n’ibindi byoherezwa mahanga imboga imbuto n’ibireti harateganywa kongerwa ubuso bihingwaho gihugu hose urugero ntara y’amajyepfo n’iy’iburengerazuba hegitali ziziyongera hegitali zisanzwe cyayi hari ubutaka gishwati bugera hegitali bugahingwaho icyayi ikawa hakazongerwaho hegitali zahingwaga iyi gahunda ikazakorwa title: bk group plc yemeje abagize inama y’ubutegetsi yizeza abakiliya kubaba bihe
content: byatangajwe gatatu tariki gicurasi abanyamigabane bayo bakoraga inama ngarukamwaka y’inteko rusange yabaye hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga barebeye hamwe umwaka ushize wagenze bafata n’ingamba kigo gikomeze gutera imbere umwaka ushize bk group plc yungutse miliyari frw bingana n’izamuka ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje inguzanyo zatanzwe ziyongereyeho ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje zigera miliyari frw ubwizigame bw’abakiliya bwiyongereyeho bugera miliyari frw gihe imigabane bk group plc nayo yiyongereyeho igera gaciro miliyari frw bk group plc ibumbiye hamwe ibigo birimo banki kigali bk techouse bk general insurance bk capital umuyobozi mukuru bk group plc dr diane karusisi yavuze ingamba kwirinda coronavirus zagize ingaruka banyarwanda barimo n’abakiliya buryo kigo cyishatsemo miliyoni frw gufasha bihe nk’ibi dr karusisi yijeje abakiliya n’abanyamigabane b’iki kigo nubwo hariho ibibazo by’ubukungu kizakomeza kubaba bikorwa byabo kuko banki kigali imaze gushinga imizi bijyanye n’imari shingiro mu minsi ishize guverinoma y’u rwanda yatangije ikigega miliyoni z’amadolari kizafasha kuzahura ubukungu hibandwa nzego zazahajwe cyane n’ingamba kwirinda coronavirus dr karusisi yavuze nabwo uburyo buzafasha bk group plc gukomeza gufasha abakiliya bayo kuko mafaranga azajya anyuzwa mabanki kandi agafasha abarimo abakiliya bk group plc gukomeza gukora ati izi nkunga zizatangwa binyuze banki hari nk’uburyo bwihariye buzafasha abakora rwego rw’ubukerarugendo n’amahoteli buzatuma bongera guhabwa inguzanyo nyungu ntoya bikazaba ubufasha bakiliya bukerarugendo n’amahoteli nka banki kigali yagiye ishyiraho uburyo korohereza abakiliya bayo bagizweho ingaruka coronavirus haba guhabwa inguzanyo kuzishyura abakiliya bafite ibikorwa byahungabanye bahawe uburyo kutishyura bushobora kugeza gihe cy’amezi atatu iyi banki kandi yashyizeho uburyo butandukanye bw’ikoranabuhanga bufasha abakiliya guhererekanya amafaranga gukora ubucuruzi badafashe amafaranga ntoki biri murongo guteza imbere ubukungu kugabanya ibyago kwandura coronavirus banki kigali kandi yashyizeho inguzanyo idasanzwe yise turi kumwe special loan’ igamije kugoboka abakiliya bayo bihe kurwanya coronavirus ndetse guhangana n’ingaruka z’iki cyorezo turikumwe special loan iboneka masaha gusa iguhesha inshuro ebyiri z’umushahara wemerewe gutangira kwishyura nyuma y’amezi atatu yishyurwa mezi nyungu kandi kuyisaba bizarangira gicurasi mu bindi byaganiriwe nteko rusange y’abanyamigabane bk group plc harimo kwemeza raporo y’umwaka raporo y’ubugenzuzi bw’imari yakozwe mwaka warangiye tariki ukuboza kwemeza iyishyurwa ry’inyungu ingana frw mugabane banyamigabane bk group plc iyi nyungu yabonetse umwaka ushize izishyurwa bimaze kwemezwa banki nkuru y’u rwanda bnr ikazaba igize by’inyungu ikigo cyabonye hemejwe kandi abagize inama y’ubutegetsi bk group plc bayobowe marc holtzman usanzwe ayobora inama y’ubutegetsi y’iki kigo mu bashya binjiye nama harimo umuyobozi mukuru rssb rugemanshuro rgis ahagarariye umunyamigabane munini kuko rssb ifitemo abandi bemejwe alline kabbatende lilian kyatengwa reuben karemera umwaka warangiye bk group plc ifite imitungo y’agaciro miliyari kiyongereyeho ugereranyije n’umwaka wabanje

title: abahanzi basuye urwibutso jenoside ntarama n’urwa nyamata
content: abahanzi batorewe gukomeza cyikiro kabiri bitabiriye urwo rugendo usibye knowless bubiligi kwitabira gahunda zijyanye kwibuka nk’uko umujyanama manager abitangaza abo bahanzi babanje gusura urwibutso ntarama basobanuriwe amateka yaho ndetse n’iyicwarubozo ryahabereye basobanuriwe ukuntu mbere jenoside abatutsi bahigwaga ariko uwabaga yahungiye kiriziya ntacyo yabaga ibyo byatumye jenoside benshi bahungira kiriziya bizeye gukira nk’uko byagendaga mbere ariko siko byagenze kuko bamaze kwirundiramo interahamwe zabasanzemo zibica urw’agashinyaguro abatutsi bahungiye kiriziya central ntarama babanje kwihagararaho ariko bigeze itariki nibwo abasirikare n’interahamwe baje banakoresha n’ibisasu kuburyo haguye abagera mu rwibutso ntarama hari imibiri y’abatutsi bazize jenoside kandi hagaragara bimwe bikoresho byifashishwa rugo baje bitwaje cyangwa se bahunganye kuko batekerezaga igihe kizagera bagasubira mungo zabo hagaragara kandi n’imyenda biteye agahinda buri munyarwanda wese ava akagera yagombye kugira ntibizongere ukundi nyangezi freddy umwe baherekeje abahanzi akaba uhagarariye bralirwa gikorwa yagize kwibuka igikorwa buri wese ku ruhande rwacu bralirwa igikorwa twubaha cyane uretse guteza imbere abahanzi tugomba kubigisha amateka bralirwa yubatse inzibutso ebyiri jenoside zishyinguwemo abakozi bakoraga bralirwa bazize jenoside gisenyi kigali bralirwa kandi ikorana n’urwibutso gisozi rwego kugira busitani bwarwo hahore hasukuye ikindi abana b’imfuzi ababyeyi bishwe jenoside bakoraga bralirwa bishyurirwa amafaranga y’ishuri mashuri mato kugera secondaire ariko hari gahunda gutangira kubishyurira kaminuza ku rwibutso nyamata ahantu hafite amateka yihariye nk’uko abahanzi babisobanuriwe niho ha mbere haguye abatutsi benshi cyane gihugu abatutsi baguye hano nyamata barashinyaguriwe bitavugwa nyamata ituwe n’abatutsi barakuwe turere dutandukanye tw’amajyaruguru gisenyi ruhengeri rwego kugira bapfe kuko hari ishyamba habagamo inyamaswa nyinshi ndetse n’amasazi yateraga indwara tsetse hapfiriye benshi gihe mu mwaka habaye ubwicanyi bumeze nk’aho byari igeragezwa jenoside buhitana abatutsi bagera kandi ntawigeze ahanirwa ukwicwa kw’abo batutsi hari umuzungu w’umutariyanikazi utuye witwaga tonia locatelli bamwishe tariki bamuziza yababwiraga adashyigikiye iyicwa ry’abatutsi bahatuye buryo ndetse yaranatangiye kubatabariza miryango mpuzamahanga mu mwaka w’ haguye abatutsi barenga hakaba hashyinguye abagera muri bahashyinguye harimo umubyeyi witwaga mukandori annonciata wishwe abanje gufatwa ngufu n’interahamwe z’abagabo nyuma bamujomba igisongo gitsina kirakomeza gitunguka mutwe uwo ashyinguwe ukwe isanduku wenyine rwego kugira harusheho kugaragazwa ubugome bw’indengakamere bwakorewe mubyeyinyuma gusobanurirwa byinshi kwirebera n’amaso abahanzi bagize babivugaho ntakirutimana danny uzwi izina danny nanone yagize hari ikiyongereyeho kuko ubwa mbere nsuye nyamata hiyongereye mateka narinzi nk’uko jenoside yagizwe uruhare n’abahanzi ndateganya gukora indirimbo irimo ubutumwa ubutumwa natanga kubagezweho jenoside ukwihangana gukurikiza gahunda z’icyunamo kudaheranwa n’agahinda tukiyubaka ikivi cy’abacu tuzacyusa kandi ibyabaye ntibizongere buri muhanzi cyangwa se itsinda bagize bavuga kubyo bamaze kubwirwa ndetse kwirebera n’amaso dore magambo make ubutumwa bwatanzwe n’abahanzi nyuma gusura urwibutso ntarama n’urwa nyamata riderman yagize igihe kirageze dutange ubutumwa bwibaka banyarwanda king james ngiye kurushaho gutanga ubutumwa bwunga abanyarwanda ndirimbo zanjye bull dog abahanzi batanze ubutumwa bwanganisha abanyarwanda bakwiye kubiryozwa dream boys ijwi platini iti umuhanzi indorerwamo rubanda duharanire gusiga isi nziza kurusha twayisanze just family ijwi jimmy iti dukwiye guhindura amateka y’umuziki tukirinda ubutumwa busenya emmy yagize ibyo mbonye birandenze dukwiye gukora bwabaga kugira bitazongera young grace atinjye nari muto mbyumva mateka ariko abafana banjye n’abanyarwanda rusange nabakangurira kunga ubumwe bagakundana bakaba ubumwe jay polly iyo mbonye ibintu nkibi birandenga abakoze bashyiraga bikorwa ibitekerezo by’abategetsi babi twe twongere ingufu gushyira bikorwa iby’abayobozi beza badusaba danny dukwiye guharanira bitongera kubaho ukundi umuyobozi mukuru east african promotors yasobanuye impamvu bazanye bahanzi gusura inzibutso magambo ukugira batazakora batazanatekereza n’umunsi rimwe kuba bakora ibikorwa nk’ibi bashyigikira cyangwa bakaririmba ibikorwa nk’ibi kuko byatugejeje ahantu nakwita habi cyane ndasaba urubyiruko rusange igikorwa cyabaye rwanda cy’ubwicanyi bumeze gutya bw’indengakamere kitabaho ukundi marie clemence cyiza uwimanimpaye

title: kwibuka abanyarwanda ghana bibutse jenoside urubyiruko rusabwa kwigira mateka
content: ni igikorwa cyabaye mata ghana gikorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga kubera icyorezo coronavirus ambasaderi w’u rwanda ghana dr aisa kirabo kacyira yavuze gihe abanyarwanda bakomeje kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi umwanya guha icyubahiro abatutsi barenga miliyoni bishwe yavuze n’umwanya guha icyubahiro abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi uburyo bagize umutima kubabarira nayo moteri y’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge u rwanda rwagezeho yagaragaje byose byashobotse kubera imiyoborere myiza perezida paul kagame dr kacyira yagize ndashimira kandi ingabo zahoze iza fpr-inkotanyi zari ziyobowe perezida kagame zahagaritse jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi gihe umuryango mpuzamahanga wareberaga bakiri bato batanze ubuzima bwabo bahagarike jenoside ntabwo tuzabibagirwa dukomeje kwibuka twakundaga ndetse twibuka ibihe by’umwijima twanyuzemo ariko duharanira ejo heza kandi duharanira jenoside izongera kuba ukundi twarababaye ariko tugomba gukomeza kurwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside n’ivangura kuko niyo ntandaro jenoside yahamagariye umuryango mpuzamahanga kurwanya ingengabitekerezo gufata ndetse kuburanisha abasize bakoze jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abanyarwanda bafashe ingamba zikomeye gushyira ubumwe imbere gushyiraho imbere ivangura kuko shingiro ry’iterambere yasabye urubyiruko kwigira mateka bubaka ejo hazaza hezaati turaboba ejo heza bakiri bato bihe turabasaba kubyigiraho kureba imiyoborere myiza ihari kwibuka twavuye ariko ntibatwarwe n’aho twanyuze hejuru y’ibyo bashyire imbere ubumwe kwihesha agaciro buri munyarwanda minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane bw’akarere ghana shirley ayorkor botchway yohereje ubutumwa bwihanganisha abanyarwanda kubizeza jenoside itazongera ukundi ati icyubahiro gikomeye twaha inzirakarengane ugushyira hamwe tugaharanira ubunyamaswa nk’ubwo butazongera ukundi lisa princess ikirezi wabuze bamwe muryango jenoside yakorewe abatutsi buhamya bwe yavuze yibuka bishwe jenoside n’ababuze bakundaga yashimiye abarokotse jenoside uburyo bakomeje kwihangana nyuma guhura n’ayo makuba asaba abavutse nyuma jenoside kubigira inshingano guharanira ibyabaye bitazongera kuba ambasaderi colombia ghana claudia turbay quintero witabiriye muhango buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga yavuze igihugu cye cyifatanyije n’u rwanda kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yagize turaha icyubahiro abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kandi dushimira ubuyobozi bwiza perezida paul kagame wahamagariye abaturage gushyira imbere ubumwe n’ubwiyunge nk’uburyo kuvana igihugu kaga cyari kimaze guhura nako yavuze isomo ryavuye rwanda ryerekana buri gihugu gifite inshingano kubahiriza uburenganzira muntu umuhango kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi wakozwe buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kubera ingamba zafashwe n’icyo gihugu guhashya icyorezo coronavirus kugeza mbere ghana imaze kugira abanduye coronavirus basaga barimo bapfuye

title: isereri kuruka rugendo byaba biterwa niki ese waba uzi wabyirinda
content: ibi bibazo byaba biterwa n’iki bibazo byibasira abari rugendo bakoresha imodoka gariyamoshi amazi bita mal de mer gifaransa indege mal de l’air byaba biterwa nikusanyamakuru ry’umubiri riba ritagenze neza biturutse bice bimwe bimwe by’umubiri nk’amaso n’amatwi iri kusanywa rizamo amakosa amaso afite ibindi bintu arangariyeho nibwo agace k’umubiri kitwa vestibule kaba gutwi gasanzwe kagira uruhare kurinda ihungabana ry’umubiri gatanga amakuru anyuranye n’ayo amaso gutanga kuko umubiri wose uba muvuduko iki kibazo kigaragara cyane kubagenziabatwara ibinyabiziga ntibahura nacyo impamvu yindi ikizira kuba utwara yarangarira ahandi hatari kwerekeza uko umuntu yabyirinda byaba byiza ugiye gufata urugendo aramutse afashe ibinini by’iseseme bisanzwe bicuruzwa pharmacie gusa uyifata asabwa kubyitondera kuko bishobora gutera ibitotsi bityo akaba yafata igice cy’isaha mbere kurira imodokaikindi ukugira ikintu urya kuburyo buri rugero ukuvuga igifu kitaremereye ariko nanone udashonje kwirinda amavuta n’ibisindisha ingenzi ku rundi ruhande gihe cy’urugendo ngombwa kwirinda imyambaro ifatiriye umubiri ubushyuhe mudoka impumuro mbi itabi lisansi amavuta ahumura cyane cyangwa imibavu ikabijeni byiza kugenda ureba ruhande kureba imbere cyangwa inyuma ndetse kwerekeza amaso kintu kiri kure hashoboka imisozi ifatanira n’ijuru cyangwa horizon ni byiza gufungura ikirahure cy’imodoka gatoya kugirango umwuka uhore uhinduka biba byiza gusohoka ugafata akanya gatoya hanze buri bishobotsesi byiza gusoma cyangwa guhunyiza rugendo bishobotse washaka ahantu wegama buryo usa n’uryamye umutwe umeze nk’aho uraramye bavuko ngombwa nanone gutuza ku bahura n’ibi bibazo ndege ngombwa kugisha inama abatanga ubufasha ngombwa kwayura rimwe rimwe rwego kugabanya icyuho cy’umwuka kiba kiri matwi gituma umuntu agirango yazibyekuruka ngombwa kubifata ikindi kintu cy’ingenzi kwitwaza amazi ahagije kunywa n’ibintu birimo isukari ihagije biscuit ukabifata buryo buhoraho nyuma buri minota burya kibazo gishobora kwiyongera cyangwa kikagabanuka bitewe n’aho umuntu yicaye biba byiza wicaye gice cy’imbere cy’ikinyabizigaabicaye myanya y’inyuma nibo bakunze guhangayika mari josee ikibasumba

title: nyabihu abashumba bahungabanya umutekano w’abaturage
content: bamwe baturage bamaze guterwa impungenge n’imyitwarire y’abo bashumba niyonzima justin umwe batuye ako gace avuga hari abaturage murenge bigogwe bamaze gukubitwa baranakomeretswa ndetse hari n’uwatemwe ajyanwa bitaro tariki abo bashumba akenshi bakunze guhungabanya umutekano w’abaturage usanga abimukira ako gace baraje bashaka akazi abaturage bavuga impamvu bashumba bakomeza gukora urugomo nk’urwo ababikora badahanwa nyabyo iyo hari ufashwe afungwa igihe gito kitarenze ibyumweru bibiri hanyuma bakongera bakamufungura usanga bashumba basa n’abamenyereye gihano kuko usanga bavuga nubwo babafunga bazabafungura abaturage barasaba ubuyobozi bw’umurenge bigogwe gukemura kibazo hataragira n’uwicwa cyangwa agakorerwa ikindi gikorwa cy’ubunyamaswa umuyobozi ushinzwe imibereho myiza y’abaturage murenge bigogwe rwisumbura gerard avuga kibazo cy’abashumba bakizi ariko hari ingamba zikomeye zigiye gufatirwa abashumba ndetse n’aborozi murenge zimwe ngamba zafashwe bagiye gushyiraho ishyirahamwe rihuza aborozi bigogwe buryo buri wese yerekana abashumba agatanga imyirondoro hanyuma bakayandika buryo uzajya akora amakosa azajya akurikiranwa n’amategeko kandi n’ibyo yangije bikabazwa yaragiriraga ikindi abashumba bazajya bagaragaraho imico igayitse nk’iyo uretse gufungwa bazajya basubizwa baturutse kuko usanga abahungabanya umutekano kenshi batanavuka bigogwe abaturage nabo barasabwa kwicungira umutekano gutanga amakuru muntu wese washaka kubahungabanyiriza umutekano kugirango afatirwe ibyemezo safari viateur

title: ese waba uzi impamvu kubaho utagira umukunzi bigira akamaro cyane cyane bakobwa
content: n’ubwo kubaho ufite umukunzi ibintu binezeza ariko akenshi usanga hari ingaruka bigira zitari nziza kimwe n’uko kwiberaho udafite umukunzi usanga nabwo hari biba byiza dukurikije ubushakashatsi bwakozwe n’impuguke bijyanye n’urukundo ndetse n’ibitekerezo tugenda duhabwa n’abakunzi b’urubuga rwacu twabateguriye bimwe byiza kubaho mubuzima butagira umukunzi kubaho utagira umukunzi burya bitandukanye kuba wenyine akenshi abantu batagira abakunzi ntago biba bisobanuye batagira inshuti ahubwo usanga aribo bakunze kugira inshuti nyinshi kuberako muntu uba abishisha wenda barafashwe cyangwa bafite abakunzi ubwigenge n’ubwisanzureiyo akenshi umuntu avuze kana arigenga usanga ashaka gusobanura muntu wamuntu urangwa n’ibikorwa bibi gusa kuko adafite umuntu umucunga ariko si bishatse gusobanura ahubwo ukuvuga uba ufite umwanya guha buri muntu wese nshuti zawe kuko utaba ugira ikibazo umwanya munini urawuha ukunda kurusha abandi kuko uba ubakunda buryo bungana kubaho mumudendezo wawe ntawe ukugenzura gusabana akenshi ujya usanga nk’umuhungu mukundana yirirwa agushinja mucs inyuma cyangwa ukumva ahora akubaza abahungu muziranye ndetse n’amasano mufitanye mwahuriye muba muganira n’ibindi byinshi ukumva wowe birakubangamiye ariko burya ikiza kutagira umukunzi ntaho uhurira n’uwo muruho kwirirwa usobanurira umuntu uriya dupfana cyangwa twiganye n’aha bikurinda guhora bagusaba kugaragaza kumbuga nkoranya mbuga mukundana kuko burya ufite umukunzi ntago ujya wemererwa gushyira cyangwa kwandika wishakiye cyangwa wumva bikurimo byose kuko uba wikanga wenda umukunzi wawe yabibona nabi cyangwa mubundi buryo butari bwiza kukijyanye gusohokana n’inshuti zawe uba ufite ubudakumirwa kuko wajyana n’abahungu ijana cyangwa ushaka ntawe uzakuryoza kumuca inyuma cyangwa kukugenzura muburyo aribwo bwosenubwo hari ibyiza kutagira umukunzi ariko ntitwakwirengagiza ahari ikiza n’ikibi gishobora kuhaboneka bivuze hari n’ibibi kutagira umukunzi tuzabibagezahomu nkuru yacu itaha by akayezu snappy

title: abashoye kigega rnit iterambere fund’ bagiye kumenyeshwa bungutse
content: ubuyobozi bw’ikigega rnit iterambere fund buratangaza byumweru bitageze bitatu buza gutangariza abanyarwanda icyiciro mbere gukusanya amafaranga cyagenze ndetse n’inyungu imaze mishinga title: amafoto mpangano y’abami batwaye u rwanda imyaka n’abagabekazi
content: hifashishijwe ibisigo by’abasizi bisingiza abami n’ingoma zabo ndetse n’abacurabwenge abarinzi b’amateka n’intekerezo z’igihugu hiyongereyeho n’abiru abanyamabanga n’abagaragu b’ingoma hakusanyijwe amateka y’u rwanda ntango yarwo gihanga i ngomijana yashyiragaho imfatiro z’igihugu kugera ingoma cyami yasimburwaga repubulika mu bakoreye ngata gihanga i ngomijana harimo ubuvivi bwe ndoba watwaye u rwanda ahasaga kugera arangwa n’ibitekerezo bihanitse bumenyi by’ibidukikije inyamaswa n’urusobe rw’ibinyabuzima muri make ndoba afite ubuhanga karemano siyansi dore dukesha ibirangamuryango nko kuba abasinga barangwa sakabaka abashambo bakarangwa n’intare abenengwe bakarangwa n’ingwe gihe abega barangwa n’ibikeri byose tubikesha hari kandi ruganzu bwimba watwaye u rwanda kugera wabaye imbimbuzi ndwanyi zaranze amateka y’u rwanda guhirimbanira ubuhangange bw’igihugu niwe wagabye igitero mbere atera gisaka yashakaga gusibanganya u rwanda arayitanga arayitera ni dukesha kurwanira ishyaka igihugu cyane cyane guhangana n’abagomera umurage gihanga w’igihugu gisangiwe nta n’uwarenza ingohe cyilima rugwe watwaye u rwanda kugera umutekerereza w’ubutabera bwunga mateka y’u rwanda ni washyizeho inkiko z’umuryango iz’abunzi n’iza gacaca agena n’uko ibihano bizajya bitangwa bagomye yashakaga u rwanda ruba igihugu kizira icyaha abyubakira guhana igihango nk’uburyo gukumira icyaha kitaraba nta n’uwakwibagirwa ruganzu ii ndoli watwaye u rwanda kugera indwanyi karundura wadukanye amatwara guhangana n’amahanga adakunda u rwanda akayagusha ruhabo akarwagura kurusha abandi bami dore yarwometseho ibihugu icyenda hari inzobere kandi dipolomasi mutara semugeshi watwaye u rwanda kugera mwami dukesha politiki mbere y’ububanyi n’amahanga yubatse kandi imiyoborere ihamye kwegereza ubuyobozi abaturage yashyizeho inzego zisaga nk’intebe y’abasizi abatware b’ubutaka abatware b’inyambo intebe y’abahaditsi abavuzi b’amatungo - vtrinaire intebe y’abahoryo agronome intebe y’abamotsi abari bashinzwe itangazamakuru ry’ibwami n’izindi ni washyizeho uburyo bw’imisimburanire y’abami ngoma bijyanye n’inshingano zabo nk’aho umwami mutara yabaga ashinzwe kwagura ubworozi bw’inka yakurikirwaga kigeli umwami w’intambara mibambwe ushinzwe uburumbuke yuhi umwami usigasira amahoro bityo bityo ntitwakwibagirwa n’abandi cyilima rujugira wadukanye intero y’u rwanda rutera rudaterwa yuhi gahindiro - wazanye gahunda z’ubugiraneza girinka kigeli rwabugili - wacecekesheje ibihugu byashakaga kwiyomora rwanda mu mateka y’isi n’ibihangange byayibayemo nk’abami b’u rwanda benshi baburiwe irengero amasura aribagirana kuko buryo bwariho gufata amafoto kuyashyingura ariko ibikorwa byabo bikaba bikibukwa kuko basize imusozi amavugwa y’ibikorwa bihanitse umushakashatsi mateka y’u rwanda nsanzabera jean de dieu yahereye akusanya ibitekerezo by’ubuzima bwaranze bakurambere yifashisha abahanga gushushanya bahanga amafoto y’abami b’u rwanda cyane umwami mbere wafotowe kigeli rwabugili abandi bamubanjirije ntawe uzi neza basaga aya mafoto mpangano y’abami b’u rwanda n’abagabekazi yakozwe n’umunyabugeni mugisha paul wize nyundo yashyizwe hanze mbere gitabo intwari z’imbanza zubatse u rwanda rugahamya igitinyiro cyasohotse gicurasi uko ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga bigenda bikwira isi abahanga bagiye bitabaza inyurabwenge bakazimbura amasura y’abo bantu babayeho myaka ibihumbi kugira bajye bayifashisha kubavuga ibigwi kubagiraho icyitegererezo ariko batari baringa cyangwa umuntu udashobora kubonwa ni urwo rwego hariho amafoto yesu mariya yozefu intumwa yesu musa wavanye abayisiraheli misiri n’abandi nsanzabera avuga abo bagize ibikorwa bakora isi n’ubu bikiri intangarirwa kandi amafoto mpangano akaba yaramamaye buryo buhanitse ndetse ntashidikanyweho aribo koko’’ nk’abakoze ishusho yezu bakoze ukureba bikorwa bye amateka yamuranze n’imyitwarire isi barema amafoto mpangano kugira buri wese ajye abasha kumubona buryo bugenekereje mu gushushanya amafoto mpangano agenekereje y’abami b’u rwanda hagendewe bushakashatsi bushingiye bikorwa byabaranze uruhererekane-mvugo rw’ibyabaye ngoma zabo imishyingiranire y’umuryango w’abami b’u rwanda n’indi miryango migari y’abanyarwanda igenantekerezo philosophie n’imyitwarire yaranze abami b’u rwanda ndetse n’ikigero cy’imyaka y’ubukure iyimikwa ryabo nsanzabera ese umwami runaka yarakoze ibikorwa
