title: abanyarwanda bahize kwegukana tour du rwanda ferwacy rwanda tea babizeza ishimwe amafoto
content: ni isiganwa kabiri tour du rwanda rigiye kuba riri rwego bitandukanye n’irya myaka yabanje birumvikana hari itandukaniro kuko haba harimo abakinnyi bakomeye ndetse itandukaniro ryagaragaye ikubitiro umwaka ushize ryegukanwaga n’umunya-erythree merhawi kudus astana gihe umunyarwanda waje areruya joseph wabaye uwa cyenda nyuma y’umwaka umwe hari ibyahindutse ndetse intego n’imihigo bakinnyi b’abanyarwanda bazakina rushanwa birakomeje nubwo bemezo urugamba rutoroshye muri rushanwa rizitabirwa n’amakipe u rwanda ruzaba rufitemo abanyarwanda babarizwa makipe atatu ikipe y’igihugu team rwanda benediction ignite y’i rubavu skol adrien cycling academy saca makipe abiri nyuma akaba akina amarushanwa mugabane abakinnyi hamwe mwiherero kigo cy’amagare i musanze africa rising cycling center ushatse wahita iwabo team rwanda nubwo atari bahari gusa kuko hari n’abandi bakinnyi bakomeye bazakina tour du rwanda y’uyu mwaka kuhitoreza nk’umunya-estonia rein taarame ukinira direct energie uyu yabaye uwa kabiri tour du rwanda iheruka ndetse byarashoboka yayegukana amaze gukina amasiganwa akomeye arimo giro d’italia tour de france vuelta espagne ari bahabwa amahirwe nshuro ibi ariko ntibikanga abakinnyi b’abanyarwanda uhereye mugisha samuel areruya joseph team rwanda byukusenge patrick uyoboye benediction ignite cyangwa mugisha mose saca kuri gatatu tariki gashyantare abakinnyi basuwe rwanda tea izajya yambika umwenda w’umuhondo umukinnyi uyoboye isiganwa nyuma kubashyikiriza icyayi kimwe bihingwa byera rwanda bikunzwe n’abatari bake haba rwanda mahanga uwacu cynthia uhagarariye rwanda tea yasabye bakinnyi kuzitwara neza umwenda w’umuhondo ukaguma rwanda abasezeranya nibabigeraho hari ishimwe bahishiwe bazahabwa ati twishimiye kuza kubareba hano gihe mwitegura gukina tour du rwanda nitwe tuzatanga umwambaro w’umuhondo bizadushimisha nituyiha umunyarwanda kugira tuyihe abandi twabazaniye impano ntoya ariko hari muzabona nimutwara maillot jaune kapiteni w’ikipe y’igihugu y’u rwanda mugisha samuel yavuze bazakora ibishoboka byose umwambaro w’umuhondo ugume rwanda ndetse bizeye imana izabibafashamo byukusenge patrick uzaba ayoboye abakinnyi benediction ignite yijeje tour du rwanda umwambaro w’umuhondo uwabo abakinnyi basuwe kandi n’ubuyobozi bw’ishyirahamwe ry’umukino w’amagare rwanda ferwacy burangajwe imbere perezida waryo murenzi abdallah kumwe nkuranga alphonse visi perezida kabiri ushinzwe amarushanwa n’umunyamabanga mukuru sekanyange jean lonard murenzi abdallah yasabye abakinnyi b’abanyarwanda makipe atatu kuzakorera hamwe baharanira ishema ry’igihugu umwambaro w’umuhondo ukazaguma rwanda niyonshuti adrien utoza saca watwaye tour du rwanda akaba n’umwe bafite izina rikomeye mukino w’amagare gihugu yabwiye bakinnyi bagomba gufatanyiriza hamwe kuko nibakorera hamwe kipe izabatsinda abakinnyi basabye ferwacy gihe bakorera hamwe nk’abanyarwanda bazashimirwa bingana kureba gusa ikipe y’igihugu nubwo makipe yandi aharanira amanota azayafasha yandi marushanwa abakinnyi babayeho gute mwiherero africa rising cycling center arcc ikigo kibamo ikipe y’u rwanda kikifashishwa kandi n’abakinnyi bavuye yandi makipe haba afurika yindi migabane baje kwitoreza rwanda ubuyobozi bwacyo buvuga gifite ubushobozi kwakira abakinnyi bagera icya rimwe bane babana nzu irimo ibitanda bine abakinnyi b’abanyarwanda kwitegura tour du rwanda babyuka gitondo saa moya bagafata amafunguro gitondo ashobora kubamo igikoma icyayi cyangwa ikawa imyitozo bayitangira saa yine bigaterwa n’iyateguwe n’abatoza n’aho bakorera gihe kingana n’amasaha abiri amafunguro saa sita bakayafata saa sita n’igice gihe saa kumi n’ebyiri z’umugoroba bakora imyitozo yoroheje kunanura imitsi amafunguro nijoro bakayafata saa moya salade umureti ibirayi inkoko ibijumba imboga capati imbuto imigati n’inyama z’inka bimwe bishyirwa mafunguro ahabwa bakinnyi babura iminsi mike bakore ibilometero gihe cy’iminsi umunani banyoga igare amafoto niyonzima mose

title: rulindo bavumbuye umuti ireme ry’uburezi bahereye mashuli y’inshuke
content: ku bufatanye kaminuza haute ecole provinciale de la condorse gihugu cy’ububiligi n’akarere rulindo binyuze ihuriro apemr association pour la promotion de l’ensegnement maternelle a rulindo hateguwe amahugurwa y’iminsi itatu agenewe abarimu bigisha abana b’inshuke aka karere rwego gukemura kuvugutira umuti ikibazo cy’ireme ry’uburezi apemr ihuriro ry’abarimu bigisha abana b’inshuke bakorera karere rulindo ryatangiye mwaka kugeza rikora mirimo kurere kwigisha abana b’inshuke bakaba barasinyanye amasezerano y’ubufatanye kaminuza haute ecole provinciale bubiligi rwego kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi hano rwanda bahereye bana b’inshuke mushinga apemr wateguwe kugira bajye batanga uburezi bwihariye bana b’inshuke umuyobozi w’iri huriro nkeshimana faustin yabwiye muhaburarw bafite gahunda guteza imbere kuzamura uburezi bw’abana b’inshuke hahugurwa abarimu bigisha bana bakiri batoya cyane faustin yagize nk’ubu hano rwanda ntago twari tumenyereye imyigishirize yifashisha ibikorwa practice mashuli abanza cyangwa ay’inshuke kuko ibintu twari tumenyereye mashuli makuru kaminuza bitewe n’ikibazo cy’ibikoresho n’izindi mfashanyigisho ziba ikibazo ariko twebwe dufite amahirwe kuko mahugurwa turi gusobanurirwa uburyo twakwishakira imfashanyigisho tutagombye gukoresha amafaranga tuzigura ikindi kandi gikorwa ingirakamaro buri mutura rwanda kuko nyuma kumara guhugura akarere rulindo tuzatangira kujya hanze yaho tundi turere tugize u rwanda gerrard waje uhagararariye kaminuza haute ecole provinciale bubiligi gerrard goterra uhagarariye iy kipe bazanye akaba n’umuyobozi w’iyi kaminuza yavuze hari bashimishijwe cyane gukorana leta y’u rwanda by’umwihariko akarere rulindo kiciro cy’uburezi bw’abana b’inshuke cyane nabo kazi bakora iwabo bubiligi anemeza hari byinshi bazunguka mpande zombi harimo kuba buri wese yakwigira mugenzi uburyo gufasha kwita bana b’inshuke kandi avuga gahunda itarangirira mahugurwa ahubwo hari gahunda kuzakomeza gukurikirana bahuguwe guhugura abandi nako harebwa umusaruro uzava bufatanye byose bishingiye kuzamura ireme ry’uburezi bahereye bana b’inshuke kuzamura impano zabo bakiri bato nkeshimana faustin umuyobozi apemr ihuriro ry’abarimu bigisha abana b’inshuke rikorera karere rulindo yanditswe akayezu snappymuhaburarw

title: inshingano gutanga imyambaro y’abamotari yambuwe sosiyete zamamaza ihabwa cooperative zabo
content: nk’uko byari bisanzwe wabonaga imyambaro iranga abamotari iriho amasosiyete atandukanye yamamaza ariko byamaze kuvaho kuko imwe myazuro yafatiwe nama y’abayobozi batandukanye n’abatwara abantu moto yabereye cyicaro gikuru polisi y’u rwanda kacyiru kabiri tariki matahemejwe imyambaro batazongera kuyihabwa sosiyete mamaza ahubwo bazajya bayihabwa koperative babamo iyi nama yahuje minisiteri y’ubucuruzi n’inganda minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo polisi y’u rwanda ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe imirimo n’imwe ifitiye igihugu akamaro rura ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe amakoperative rca n’abahagarariye amakoperative y’abamotari akorera turere dutandukanye tw’igihugu baganira barushaho kunoza akazi kabo kwigira hamwe ibibazo bigaragara makoperative y’abatwara abagenzi moto kubishakira umuti umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda igp emmanuel k gasana minisitiri w ’ubucuruzi n’inganda vincent munyeshyaka minisitiri w ’ubucuruzi n’inganda vincent munyeshyaka yashimye imikoranire myiza hagati y’izi nzego leta n’abamotari asaba mikoranire yagumaho minisitiri munyeshyaka yagize atiturifuza amakoperative mukoreramo mwayashyira murongo akarushaho gukora neza muharanira kwiteza imbere guteza imbere umuturage yakomeje avuga impanuka zihitana abantu nyinshi bakwiye kugira imyitwarire myiza impanuka zikagabanuka kandi bishoboka minisitiri munyeshyaka yasabye bayobozi b’amakoperative kunoza uburyo bw’icungamutungo makoperative minisitiri munyeshyaka yagize ni byiza abayobozi b’amakoperative bashyira inyungu z’abanyamuryango imbere kurusha izabo byose bigamije guteza imbere imibereho myiza yavuze nzego leta zigiye gufasha bamotari bagasubukura ivugurura ryihariye ry’amakoperative y’abamotari ndetse gihe vuba hagakorwa amatora y’inzego z’ubuyobozi n’abashinzwe imyitwarire basanzwe bitwa abashinzwe umutekano umuyobozi mukuru polisi y’u rwanda igp emmanuel k gasana yabanje gushimira abayobozi b’amakoperative y’abamotari igp emmanuel k gasana yagize atimwe abafatanyabikorwa polisi y’u rwanda duhurira byinshi bitandukanye birimo guhugura kwigisha guhanahana amakuru hagamijwe gukumira ibyaha kandi abamotari isonga kurwanya ibyaha gukumira impanuka muhanda yakomeje ababwira atiturabashima mwitwara mukanagira igenamigambi rinoze kandi mwitwaye neza umutekano muhanda uragaragara dore munsi abamotari bashobora gutwara abantu barenze ibihumbi makumyabiri yavuze ariko nubwo bitwara neza hari bamwe bagenzi bakirangwaho amakosa atandukanye arimo gutwara abantu barenze umwe gutwara badafite ibyangombwa gupakira ibirenze ubushobozi moto kimwe gutwara abanyabyaha nk’ababa batwaye ibiyobyabwenge n’andi makosa igp gasana yasoje ashimira ubufatanye bw’abamotari polisi y’u rwanda anabizeza bufatanye buzahoraho iyi nama yafashe imyanzuro ikurikira hemejwe umwambaro uranga abakora umwuga gutwara abantu moto waba uwa koperative gutangwa n’amasosiyeti yamamaza kwihutisha ikoreshwa ry’ikoranabuhanga gukomeza kongerera ingufu inzego z’amakoperative y’abamotari kuvugurura imikorere bijyanye kwakira imisanzu y’abanyamuryango hirindwa kuyakira ntoki ahubwo hakifashishwa banki muri nama minisiteri y’ibikorwa remezo ihagarariwe n’munyamabanga leta minisiteri ushinzwe gutwara abantu n’ibintu bwana uwihanganye jean de dieu ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe imirimo n’imwe ifitiye igihugu akamaro rura cyari gihagarariwe lt col patrick nyirishema ikigo cy’igihugu gishinzwe amakoperative gihagarariwe nzakunda joseph yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: abanyarwanda batuye canada bibutse abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro by’umujyi ottawa ahabereye imihango kwibuka nyuma y’indirimbo zubahiriza ibihugu byombi hakurikiyeho umunota kwibuka inzirikarengane zishwe jenoside padiri callixte kabalisa wayoboye isengesho yasabiye abahuye n’ibibazo binyuranye harimo abafashwe ngufu asaba imana gukomeza impfubyi n’abapfakazi n’abandi bagize ibibazo bikomeye uhagarariye u rwanda canada edda mukabagwiza perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bongeye guhura gitambo misa kwibuka cyabereye paruwasi mutagatifu yozefu gatineau quebec

title: ikipe y’u rwanda yasezerewe beach volleyball
content: muri mikino ikinwa n’abakinnyi babiri babiri buri gihugu gihagararirwa n’amakipe abiri buri kipe ikina imikino ibiri ibiri u rwanda rwari ruhagarariwe emilienne uwineza hakizimana judith bagize ikipe mbere hamwe mutatsimpundu denise nzayisenga charlotte mu mikino ine yahuje amakipe y’u rwanda n’aya afurika y’epfo u rwanda rwasabwaga gutsinda nibura imikino itatu ine kugira rwizere gukomeza cyiciro gikurikiyeho ariko ntibyakunze kuko afurika y’epfo kugeza mwanya kabiri afurika yatsinze imikino itatu ine bakinnye n’u rwanda emilienne uwineza umukinnyi w’ikipe mbere y’u rwanda yavuze gutsindwa byatewe n’uko afurika y’epfo ibarusha inararibonye yagize afurika y’epfo yaturushije kubera bamenyereye cyane amarushanwa buryo usanga bazi amayeri menshi gusa n’ubwo badutsinze natwe twageragaje kugaragaza ubuhanga bwacu kandi nk’uko byagaragaraga badutsindaga ariko dufite amanota menshi ibyo buvuze hari urwego rwiza natwe tugezeho gutsindwa afurika y’epfo bivuze u rwanda ruvuye ruhando guhatanira itike kuzakina imikino olympique ndetse n’igikombe cy’isi ariko christian hatuminana ushinzwe tekinike ishyirahamwe ry’umukino volleyball rwanda yadutangarije u rwanda rugifite amahirwe kwegukana umwanya mwiza rushanwa hatumimana avuga afurika y’epfo n’ibirwa maurice ariyo makipe ahabwa amahirwe kwegukana umwanya mbere kuko amateka y’ayo makipe yombi ndetse n’uko bakinnye kane bigaragaza isonga iyi volleyball ikinirwa mucanga yitabiriwe n’amakipe u rwanda kenya rdc afurika y’epfo ibirwa maurice mozambique algeria hagendewe buhanga buri kipe iheruka kwitwara n’amanota yakuye mikino iheruka nama tekinike yabaye mbere y’iyi mikino hemejwe amakipe akomeye akina n’adakomeye nk’uko bisazwe bigenda marushanwa ibyo byatumye u rwanda rukina afurika y’epfo repubulika iharanira demukarasi congo ikina n’ibirwa maurice algeria ihura mozambique kenya yahise ikomeza cyiciro gikurikiyeho kuko maroc bagombaga gukina ititabiriye marushanwa ikipe y’ibirwa maurice mwanya mbere afurika kuko ariyo iheruka kwegukana umwanya mbere mikino nyafurika yebereye i mputo mozambique umwaka ushize ikaba ikurikirwa afurika y’epfo yabaye iya kabiri gihe iyi mikino irakomeza gatanu tariki hakinwa imikino cy’irangiza afurika y’epfo ikina n’ibirwa maurice byasezereye rdc mozambique yasezereye algeria irakina kenya gihe u rwanda ruzahatanira umwanya gatanu rukina algeria iyi mikino izasozwa gatandatu ikipe izaba yabaye iya mbere izahita ibona itike kuzakina imikino olympique izabera bwongereza nyakanga mwaka iya kabiri n’iya gatatu zikabona itike kuzakina igikombe cy’isi kizabera butaliyani umwaka utaha theoneste nisingizwe

title: urubanza rw’ubujurire bagosora bagenzi ruzacibwa tariki ukuboza
content: bagosora nsengiyumva barajuririra igihano cy’igifungo burundu bahawe kubera ibyaha jenoside n’ibindi byaha byibasiye inyoko muntu ntawukulilyayo yajuririye igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka yakatiwe kubera uruhare yagize jenoside ku itariki ukuboza nibwo bagosora wahoze ayobora ibiro minisitiri w’ingabo yakatiwe nyuma guhamwa n’ibyaha jenoside ibyaha byibasiye ikiremwamuntu n’ibyaha by’intambara birimo kwica uwari minisitiri w’intebe agathe uwilingiyimana n’abandi basirikare b’ababiligi onu bagosora anashinjwa kugira uruhare ishyirwaho bariyeri hirya hino kigali gisenyi hagati y’itariki mata nsengiyumva ukuriye ibikorwa gisirikare gisenyi yahamijwe ubwicanyi bakorewe kaminuza mudende paruwasi nyundo ndetse n’ubwicanyi bwakorewe abasivili gice ayoboye yanahamijwe kandi kuba yarohereje ibitero by’interahamwe bisesero kwica abatutsi bagosora nsengiyumva baburanishirijwe igihe kimwe hamwe n’abandi basirikare babiri aribo brigadier-general gratien kabiligi major aloys ntabakuze kabiligi yahisevarekurwa ntabakuze ajurira rubanza rwabaye itariki werurwe urubanza ntabakuze rwaje gutandukanywa n’urwabandi nyuma y’aho uwamwunganiraga mategeko umunyamerika peter erlinder ananiriwe kwitaba urukiko tariki werurwe ubujurire bwe bwaje gusomwa tariki nzeri na nubu buracyakomeza ntawukulilyayo yakatiwe igihano cy’igifungo cy’imyaka kubera uruhare yagize bwicanyi bwakorewe kibuye n’i butare umunyamakuru kigali today

title: fanaf irakangurira abatanga ubwishingizi rwanda gushora imari bikorwa by’iterambere
content: mu biganiro yagiranye minisitiri w’intebe w’u rwanda gatatu tariki protais ayangma ayang yatangaje amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi akwiye kugira uruhare iterambere ry’igihugu kuko guverinoma y’u rwanda iyafasha gukora neza ayang yagize abanyamakompanyi bakwiye gukoresha umutungo wabo kuzamura ubukungu bw’igihugu uhagarariye ishyirahamawe nyarwanda ry’amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi assar marc rugenera yatangaje leta yabemereye inkunga irenzeho kugira ibikorwa byabo bikomeze bijye imbere yavuze nubwo u rwanda rukiri inyuma bijyanye n’ubwishingizi afite icyizere ariko abanyarwanda bagenda basobanurirwa bazarushaho byumva cote d’ivoire cameroun nibyo bihugu bihagaze neza bwishingizi afurika congo-brazzaville iza isonga bigo byinshi by’ubwishingizi byeguriwe abikorera u rwanda rugeze isoko ry’ubwishingizi gihe ibihugu byateye imbere bigeze ubwishingizi binyabiziga nibwo buri hejuru cyane rwanda kubera itegeko leta risaba ababitunze kubifatira ubwishingizi inama ihuje amasosiyete y’ubwishingizi afrika yibumbiye mpuzamashyirahamwe nyafurika y’uburenganzira bwishingizi fanaf iteraniye i kigali tariki - fanaf ihuriwemo n’ibigo by’ubwishingizi ikaba ifite icyicaro senegal emmanuel n hitimana

content: umuhanga by’imiti pharmacist jean damascne nsengeyukuri wamamaye izina mc philos usanzwe ufite impano n’ubuhanga bihanitse kuyobora imisango y’ubukwe adasobwa afatanyije mugenzi nyirimana title: uko umunsi w’umuganura wizihijwe bice bitandukanye by’igihugu amafoto
content: wari umunsi usobetse imihango n’imigenzo ikubiyemo byinshi bifite bivuze gikomeye buzima bw’igihugu n’abagituye umuganura watangiye kwizihizwa rwanda ngoma gihanga ngomijana kinyejana uza kongera guhabwa imbaraga ruganzu ii ndoli - yabohoraga u rwanda nyuma y’imyaka irenga ruri maboko y’abanyamahanga abanyoro abanyabyinshi n’abanyabungo uyu munsi wizihizwa buri mwaka kanama wizihirijwe karere nyanza rwego rw’igihugu mu butumwa minisitiri w’intebe dr ngirente edouard umushyitsi mukuru muhango yagaragaje umuganura umwanya kwishima gusubiza amaso inyuma kwisuzuma hagafatwa ingamba kunoza ibitaragenze neza kugira tuzarusheho gutera imbere ejo hazaza yagize mu kwizihiza umuganura turasabana tugasangira twejeje ariko kandi tukanafata ingamba gukomeza gukora neza kugira tugere majyambere arambye duharanira kwishakamo ibisubizo kwigira umunsi w’umuganura kandi wizihijwe n’abanyarwanda b’ingeri zose mfuruka enye z’igihugu n’umujyi kigali abanyamakuru igihe bakorera ntara zitandukanye z’igihugu bakusanyije iby’ingenzi byaranze munsi ufite amateka akomeye mibereho y’abanyarwanda ni umunsi waranzw gusangira amafunguro n’ibyo kunywa bitandukanye byavuye abaturage bejeje i rubavu bizihije umuganura bibutswa gukomeza kwirinda ebola mu karere rubavu ntara y’iburengerazuba umuganura wizihirijwe kagari buringo murenge bugeshi umuyobozi w’akarere rubavu habyarimana gilbert yasabye abaturage kwirinda ebola kuko bagezeho ihageze byaba impfabusa yagize ndabasaba kujya musuhuzanya mudakoranyeho kwirinda ebola kuko ibintu by’ibanze nubwo twizihiza umuganura twishimira ibirayi cyangwa ibigori byeze turimo kwishimira umusaruro wagenze neza ebola iramutse igeze hano ibintu byose byaba impfabusa imihigo duhiga n’icyerecyezo dufite byose ntibyakunda n’iyo mpamvu buri muturage gukumira agomba kubifata nk’ibye’’ abaturage burera baguze ibitanda bizagoboka abarwayi muganga abaturage basaga karere burera n’abaturutse bindi bice by’intara y’amajyaruguru umunsi mukuru w’umuganura bawizihije murenge kinyababa mu kwishimira munsi abaturage bishatsemo ibisubizo bagura ibitanda matelas bizifashishwa kigo nderabuzima kinyababa mu rwego kwigira bishatsemo ibisubizo bakusanya miliyoni n’ibihumbi frw yakoreshejwe kugoboka abarwariraga kigo nderabuzima bakaryama hasi matela zishaje umuyobozi w’akarere burera uwambajemariya florence yasabye abaturage kwimakaza umuco guhigurira gihe yagize umusi nk’uyu w’umuganura udufasha kuzirikana ibigwi mva rugamba twagezeho ariko ukaba n’umwanya w’imihigo njyarugamba muharanire umuco guhiga mugahigura uba mwe ariko mwibuke iterambere ryihuta dukoreye hamwe natwe tuzababa muzadukenera’’ iburasirazuba basabwe gusigasira umuco nyarwanda umunsi w’umuganura rwego rw’intara y’iburasirazuba wizihirijwe karere nyagatare murenge matimba witabiriwe guverineri mufulukye fred umuyobozi w’akarere nyagatare mushabe david claudien n’umuyobozi w’ingabo turere twa nyagatare gatsibo kayonza rwamagana col rugambwa albert guverineri mufulukye yashimiye abaturage bitabiriye munsi abasaba gukomeza kugira umuco kwishimira ibyiza bagezeho kandi bakanakomera muco nyarwanda yagize iyo turi ngaha tuba twasubiye isoko y’umuco wacu byerekana tugihagaze muco w’igihugu ndetse tukigikunda ikindi bitwereka ubumwe bwacu nk’abanyarwanda’’ yavuze munsi ukwiye gusigira abanyarwanda gukunda iby’iwabo bakareka kwizirika gukunda umuco w’ahandi mufulukye yanakomoje baturage bamwe batejeje imyaka ariko avuga hari bagenzi bagiye babagoboka bakabaha ibiribwa ati hari nk’uturere tumwe imirenge n’utugari byagiye bigira ibibazo by’izuba ariko tukagira imirenge n’imwe yagiye ifasha baturage batejeje neza bakabaha kurya turasaba abaturage gukomeza kugira muco gusangira n’abandi batagize umusaruro mwiza kuko aribyo biranga umunyarwanda muhaya simon utuye kagari matimba yavuze kuganura byari bikwiye bitewe gihembwe babonye imvura imyaka igakura neza ati uyu mwaka imvura yagwiriye gihe itinda guhita bituma ibishyimbo byacu byera neza ikindi ntabwo izuba ryavuye cyane buryo umusaruro w’amata ugabanuka cyane tumeze neza nubwo tutavuga ariko ntabwo dushonje mu mujyi kigali umunsi w’umuganura wabereye turere twose tuwugize abaturage bahuriye batuye basangira baranasabana ku rwego rw’akarere nyarugenge wabereye murenge mageragere gikorwa cyitabiriwe n’umuyobozi w’agateganyo w’umujyi kigali busabizwa parfait abitabiriye birori murenge kandi batashye ibiro by’akagari runzenze abaturage biyubakiye umuganura wizihijwe nsanganyamatsiko ivuga umuganura isoko y’ubumwe n’ishingiro ryo kwigira biteganyijwe uzanizihirizwa mashuri rwanda rwego gutoza abana umuco nyarwanda bakiri bato indi nkuru wasoma minisitiri w’intebe dr ngirente yagaragaje abanyarwanda bakwiye kwishimira munsi w’umuganura amafoto video

title: guverineri gatete arasaba ubufatanye gufasha abatishoboye
content: gatete yagize byiza ibikorwa gufasha abatishoboye byahurirwaho n’abatu benshi bityo gahunda y’icyerekezo ikazacyura ikivi abantu baramaze gutera imbere gatete arasaba abagenerwabikorwa abatishoboye ndetse n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere bukwiye kugira uruhare bikorwa kubateza imbere yabisobanuye magambo habaye bnr gusa ifasha miryango bantu bazagera bataragira bagera bnr yatangiye gufasha abatuye mudugudu mwaka babavugururira amazu icyo gikorwa cyatwaye amafaranga agera miliyoni esheshatu bnr kandi yabafasha kujyana abana mashuri y’imyuga none munsi hatashye umushinga w’ubworozi bw’inkoko bnr yatanzeho amafaranga asaga miliyoni bnr kandi yiyemeje kuzitaho gihe cy’amezi atandatu mbere y’uko zitangira gutanga umusaruro murekatete jacqueline umwana w’impfubyi wirera utuye mudugudu w’icyizere yavuze bnr ibakorera byose bibashimisha bakaba bayizeza nabo bazakora bashoboye umushinga babahaye bakazawutunganya neza bakoresheje amahugurwa bahabwa bijyanye n’ubworozi bw’inkoko murekatete asaba bnr n’abandi baterankunga gufasha abana barangije kwiga kubona akazi gufasha imiryango ituye mudugudu kubona umuriro w’amashanyarazi bnr ifasha imiryango igizwe n’impfubyi n’abapfakazi batuye mudugudu w’icyizere mu minsi imbere bnr irateganya bufatanye n’akarere bazafasha miryango mushinga w’ububoshyi kugira imyaka icyenda isigaye icyerekezo gicyure ikivi izasange abatuye umudugudu w’icyizere barateye imbere marie josee uwiringira

title: gakenke inkeragutabara n’abafasha barahuguwe mateka
content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko uretse bakoroni safali yakomeje avuga natwe ubwacu twabigizemo uruhare cyane cyane ubutegetsi butandukanye bwagiye busimburana bwahembereye macukubiri kugeza abanyarwanda barangajwe imbere n’ubutegetsi bubi bamburaga ubuzima abavandimwe basaga miliyoni asobanura ikigenderewe kwiga amateka yavuze kubaka ejo hazaza bwana safali yagize kumenya amateka yacu bidufasha kwirinda amabi jenoside tukubakira mateka meza bidufasha kandi kumenya twatsinzwe n’aho twatsinze nk’abanyarwanda ni byiza kwiga amateka kuko ushaka kwiyibagiza amateka ashaka kuyasubiramo ibyo bigamije kubaka ejo hazaza h’igihugu cyacu kizira amacakubiri n’ingengabiterezo jenoside umutekano isoko y’iterambere lt muhozi charles ubarizwa batayo ikorera karere gakenke watanze ikiganiro mutekano yavuze iterambere u rwanda rwagezeho rurikesha umutekano niyo mpamvu tugomba kuwubungabunga kugira tutazasubira inyuma yibukije abitariye amahugurwa batagomba kwirara bagomba gutanga amakuru gihe muntu wese ushobora kuhungabanya umutekano koloneli karegeya claudien komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe witandukanyije fdlr yabasabye gukangurira abavandimwe ndetse n’inshuti zabo zikiri mashyamba kongo gutahuka bagafatanya n’abandi banyarwanda kubaka igihugu cyabo kandi abizeza kuzabafasha kubagezaho butumwa izo nkeragutabara zitandukanyije fdlr zinjijwe gahunda zitandukanye z’iterambere barihirwa amashuri y’imyuga barubakiwe bavanwa nyakatsi ndetse baninjizwa gahunda gira inka mushimiyimana jeannette umwe mubakurikiranye mahugurwa avuga mahugurwa yayungukiyemo byinshi yavuze yasobanukiwe imvano jenoside amateka yagoretswe akaba agiye gufata iya mbere akayarwanya avuga amateka y’ukuri kandi agomba kubaka igihugu cy’u rwanda ayo mahugurwa yitabiriwe n’inkeragutabara hamwe n’abafasha basaga baturutse turere twa rulindo gakenke batahutse bava mashyamba repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo guhera kugeza mwaka turimo nshimiyimana leonard

title: itariki mata umwe minsi itazibagirana abatutsi biciwe kiliziya gahanga
content: itariki mata matariki yabayeho ubwicanyi bukomeye bice bitandukanye by’igihugu uhereye kigali nk’aho abatutsi basaga biciwe kiliziya gahanga abahoze barinda perezida habyarimana nabo ntibatinye kurasa bitaro faisal rusange munsi imirambo igera ikaba yarabaruwe y’abantu bishwe munsi kigali gusa mu bice bitandukanye tariki mata abatutsi bishwe buryo butagira ingano icyo gihe nibwo abasirikare barindaga perezida habyarimana barashe ibisasu bikomeye bitaro byitiriwe umwami faisal bica abarwayi abandi bagera barakomereka uyu munsi kandi abatutsi babarirwa biciwe kiliziya gatolika gahanga yahoze komini kanombe abarenga bicirwa i karembure gahanga komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe kurwanya jenoside cnlg ivuga ibitero byabishe byabaga biyobowe n’uwungirije burugumestri komini kanombe n’abapolisi komini hiyongeyeho uwari konseye gahanga akaba yarahoze gisirikare ndetse n’abandi bantu bavuye gisirikare aribo zirarushya kimonyo franois wongeyeho abasirikare barinze ikiraro kanzenze giciye gisenyi interahamwe zaho zishe abatutsi bagera bahungiye ngoro muvoma mrnd palace harokoka abantu babiri gusa abatutsi bahungiye ishuri ribanza gikumba bumbogo nabo barishwe tariki uyu munsi title: remdesivir umuti kugaragaza imbaraga kurwanya coronavirus
content: ubu hari ibihamya biboneka neza umuti remdesivir ushobora gufasha abantu gukira coronavirus nk’uko bivugwa n’abahanga by’ubuzima amerika baravuga muti ugabanya igihe ibimenyetso by’iyi ndwara bimara minsi kugera nk’uko ibyavuye bushakashatsi bwakozwe bitaro bitandukanye isi bibyerekana mu cyumweru gishize amakuru omswho yashyize internet yavugaga muti utari gukora gusa makuru bahise bayavanaho nyuma y’igihe gitoya amakuru arambuye muti ntabwo aratangazwa ariko inzobere zivuga cyaba igisubizo cyiza byemejwe uvura nubwo utaba uje kurangiza cyorezo bavuga muti ushobora gukiza ubuzima benshi kandi ukagabanyiriza ibitaro akazi kwakira kwita barwayi remdesivir ubundi yakozwe umuti kuvura ebola ni umuti urwanya virus wibasira utunyangingo virus ikenera kugira yiyongere turemangingo tw’umubiri wacu bbc dukesha nkuru itangaza ikigo amerika national institute of allergy and infectious diseases niaid cyakoze igerageza ryawo bantu bamwe bahawe muti abandi bahabwa utari neza placebo dr anthony fauci utegeka niaid agira ibyavuyemo remdesivir igaragaza neza igabanya igihe gukira ndwara nta muti cyangwa urukingo biraboneka bivurwa covid- kugeza kuyivura abaganga bavura ibimenyetso byayo ubwirinzi bw’umubiri nabwo bugahangana virus kugeza umuntu akize cyangwa byanze dr fauci yavuze ibyavuye igerageza byerekana muti ushobora kuzibira virus bikaba bifungura umuryango kuba hashobora kuboneka uburyo kuvura abayirwaye ntiharamenyekana neza muti ufasha niba abagombaga gukira n’ubundi ukiza vuba cyangwa unafasha abantu barembye bakoroherwa ntibiramenyekana kandi ukora cyane bakiri bato cyangwa abakuze ufasha abasanzwe bafite n’izindi ndwara cyangwa abatazifite cyangwa ufasha gusa virus itaraba nyinshi mubiri ibi ibibazo bizasubizwa gihe hazatangazwa amakuru muti prof mahesh parmar wayoboye igerageza ry’uyu muti burayi avuga mbere y’uko muti ukwirakwizwa hakiri gukora ati imibare n’ibyayivuyemo bigomba gusubirwamo n’abashinzwe ubugenzuzi kugira muti wemerwe kandi wongere ugenzurwe n’inzego zishinzwe iby’imiti bindi bihugu avuga gihe bikiri gukorwa bakomeza kubona amakuru yandi ava magerageza bareba muti ushobora kurengera abagiye kwicwa covid- prof peter horby kaminuza oxford bwongereza ayoboye itsinda rinini riri gukora igerageza ry’imiti itandukanye yavura covid- yagize tugomba kureba ibyavuye igerageza remdesivir byose gusa ubaye wemejwe yaba inkuru nziza rugamba ruriho covid- intambwe zakurikiraho ukubona amakuru kumenya muti remdesivir waboneka benshi mbere amakuru leta zunze ubumwe amerika muti yashyizwe hanze gihe kimwe n’ayo bushinwa kinyamakuru kivuga iby’ubuzima cy’ikigo lancet yavugaga utavura gusa igeregezwa ryari ryakozwe ntiryari rihagije nk’ako abahanga babivuga prof babak javid umuhanga ndwara z’ibyorezo bitaro kaminuza title: umunyamakuru arabie saoudite yiciwe ambasade
content: ubwoba bukomeje kwiyongera kubera umunyamakuru jamal khashoggi wandikiraga ikinyamakuru the washington post leta zunze ubumwe z’amerika abategetsi turukiya bemeza yiciwe ambasade arabie saoudite i istanbul khashoggi umuturage arabie saoudite yaburiwe irengero nyuma kujya biro by’uhagarariye arabie saoudite biri i istanbul umurwa mukuru turukiya kabiri umutegetsi turukiya yabwiye bbc amaperereza y’ibanze yagaragaje yiciwe biro ubuyobozi bw’ikinyamakuru the washington post bwasohoye itangazo buvuga makuru abaye impamo cyaba igikorwa kinyamaswa kandi kirenze ukwemera umunyamakuru bbc mark lowen i istanbul yavuze bigiye guhuhura umubano hagati arabie saoudite turukiya ukaba mubi cyane bitari bwigere bibaho mbere abategetsi turukiya batangije iperereza ndetse bakomeje kuganira n’itangazamakuru gihe cyose ryemeye kudatangaza amazina nkuko byatangajwe n’ibiro ntaramakuru reuters umutegetsi wungirije w’ishyaka ak riri butegetsi yabwiye televiziyo cnn ishami ritangaza amakuru rurimi rw’igituruki turukiya ifite ibimeyetso bifatika ariko kimenyetso kimwe kirashyirwa ahagaragara kugeza ni ryari bwana khashoggi aheruka kubonwa jamal khashoggi umuntu uzwi cyane banenga igikomangoma mohammed bin salman umutegetsi arabie saoudite akurikirwa n’abantu barenga miliyoni n’ibihumbi rubuga nkoranyambaga twitter akaba yandikira n’ikinyamakuru the washington post ishami ry’ibitekerezo bwite by’umwanditsi hatice witeguraga kubana jamal khashoggi ategerereje umukunzi hanze y’ambasade arabie saoudite gatatu ku kabiri yagiye ambasade arabie saoudite gufata ibyangombwa byemeza yatandukanye n’uwari umugore kugira ashobore gushakana n’umukunzi hatice cengiz w’umunyaturukiyakazi madamu cengiz yavuze yamutegereje amasaha hanze y’ambasade ariko ntasohokemo yavuze bwana khashoggi yasabwe kuba atanze telefone igendanwa nkuko bisanzwe bigenda ambasade zimwe zimwe yavuze yasize amusabye kuza guhamagara umujyanama perezida recep tayyip erdogan gihe yaramuka atagarutse ubwo amakuru gucyeka bwana khashoggi yaba yishwe yakomezaga gukwirakwira madamu cengiz yanditse ubutumwa rubuga nkoranyambaga twitter agira jamal ntabwo yapfuye ntabwo nshobora kubyemera yishwe yavuze agitegereje byemezwa mugaragaro n’abategetsi turukiya yatangaje yatangaje bwana khashoggi yiciwe ambasade arabie saoudite hanyuma umurambo ugahita uhavanwa abakora iperereza turukiya bavuze itsinda ry’abantu bageze ambasade kabiri kabiri bakarara basubiye murwa mukuru arabie saoudite riyadh turan kislakci umukuru w’ishyirahamwe ry’abanyamakuru turukiya n’abarabu yabwiye ikinyamakuru the new york times amerika abapolisi turukiya barinda ambasade arabie saoudite bagenzuye kamera z’umutekano ntibabone munyamakuru asohoka ambasade n’amaguru ariko yongeyeho imodoka ambasade zagaragajwe kamera z’umutekano zisohoka ndetse zininjira ambasade ni arabie saoudite yatangaje ku gatatu igikomangoma mohammed bin salman yabwiye igitangazamakuru bloomberg news amerika abategetsi turukiya bahawe ikaze babe basaka inyubako y’ambasade kubera ntacyo dufite guhisha abategetsi ambasade arabie saudite bavuze bwana khashoggi yahavuye amaze kuzuza ibisabwa igikomangoma mohammed bin salman yavuze arabie saoudite irajwe ishinga kumeya icyamubayeho avuga abyumva bwana khashoggi yasohotse ambasade hashize iminota micye cyangwa isaha abajijwe hari munyamakuru yashinjwaga arabie saoudite yasubije igihugu cye gicyeneye kumenya mbere mbere aherereye jamal khashoggi muntu ki ni umunyamakuru w’imyaka y’amavuko umwe banenga bikomeye igikomangoma mohammed bin salman - umutegetsi watangije gahunda z’amavugura ashimwa n’ibihugu by’uburayi n’amerika gihe akora igisa kwibasira abamunenga yahoze umwanditsi mukuru w’ikinyamakuru al-watan n’uwa televiziyo itaramaze kabiri arabie saoudite yamaze imyaka abonwa nk’umutoni muryango w’ubwami arabie saoudite yigeze kuba umujyanama w’abategetsi bakuru gihugu nyuma yaho inshuti ze nyinshi ziterewe yombi yahagaritswe kwandika kinyamakuru al-hayat televiziyo zimwe bihugu by’abarabu amerika n’uburayi mu kwezi karindwi mwaka ushize yanditse agira nataye iwanjye nsiga umuryango mpara akazi kanjye none ndikurangurura ijwi kutabikora byaba ukugambanira abakomeje kubabarira gereza nshobora kuvuga gihe abandi benshi cyane batabishoboye ku gatanu ikinyamakuru the washington post cyatangaje ipaji yajyaga yandikaho ibitekerezo bye iriho ubusa rwego kwifatanya yanditswe habarurema djamali

title: ibimenyetso byakwereka umuntu yasazwe n’agahinda gakabije gashobora kuvamo kwiyahura
content: kugira agahinda gakabije urwego ruri hejuru y’umubabaro kuko agahinda gakabije kamara igihe kinini ugereranyine n’umubabaro usanzwe abantu bagira kugira agahinda gakabije ariko bifitanye isano n’imiterera muntu n’uburyo yakira ibimubayeho bigoye si igitangaza hari umuntu uzirukanwa kazi kubera impamvu runaka akabirwara nk’ibyumweru bibiri afite agahinda hakaba n’undi uzavuga kundi n’i nyagasambu rirarema ubuzima bugakomeza agahinda gakabije agahinda gasaze indwara mutwe ituma imitekerereze muntu ihinduka ikarangwa n’umubabaro umara igihe kitari gito ibi bishobora guterwa n’imihindagurikire y’imibereho umuntu ashobora guhura nayo nko gupfusha gutandukana n’umukunzi ibibazo miryango n’ibindi bikora ndiba y’amarangamutiman’ubwo hari abagera gihe bakiyumanganya kuburyo utapfa kurabukwa guhura nabyo buzima niwitegereza neza ukumva n’imvugo zabo uzasanga umuntu ufite agahinda gakabije arangwa n’ibimenyetso bikurukira gutakaza icyizere kubaho ukanga ubuzima prof sezibera vincent umwarimu kaminuza y’u rwanda ishami ry’ubuzima n’ubuvuzi yabwiye igihe umuntu ufite agahinda gakabije arangwa guhora avuga kubaho ntacyo bimaze birutwa gupfa ati mu mvugo ushobora kumva iziganisha kwiheba guta icyizere akenshi umuntu agaragaza ubuzima ntacyo bumaze ejo hazaza cyizere hamuha ikindi ukumva ibitekerezo by’umuntu biganisha kuvuga gupfa bimurutira kubaho prof sezibera akomeza avuga iminsi ishira ugenda wumva umuntu ashyiraho n’uburyo bwamufasha kubura ubuzima kumva kintu kikigushishikaza ukazinukwa agahinda gakabije gashobora kuguhuza wakundaga biguha ibyishimo nko gukora siporo gusohokana n’inshuti zawe gusabana wagiraga kukagabanuka prof sezibera avuga mukobwa usanga uburyo yiyitagaho bihinduka akaba yasohoka atisize amavuta nkuko yabikoraga imyambarire n’uko agaragara bandi ugasanga ntacyo bikimubwiye umuhungu byabayeho usanga bimwe kuba yakwambara neza bishira ku muntu ufite akazi atangira gukererwa ndetse yaba yagiraga ibakwe rikagabanuka agatangira kujya asiba akazi mpamvu ikindi kandi ubushake gukora imibonano mpuzabitsina bashakanye bugabanuka kuburyo bishobora kuviramo umuntu kuba ikiremba umunaniro udashira guhorana ibitotsi imwe mpamvu ishobora gutera umuntu guhagarika yakoraga kandi yarabikunze ukuba yumva ananiwe cyane agahinda gakabije gashobora kurangwa n’uko umuntu ahorana umunaniro ndetse akumva atentebutse bikamutera guhorana ibitotsi buri gihe kugira ubwoba umuntu wese ashobora kugira ubwoba nko gihe agiye gukora ikizami cy’akazi cyangwa agiye guhura n’uwo yihebeye rimwe rimwe kandi hari igihe ubwoba bufasha umuntu kuba yakwitekerezaho bukamutera gufata n’ingamba z’umumaro iyo umuntu amaranye ubwoba igihe kirenze ibyumweru bibiri ntibiba bikiri ibisanzwe kuko biba byageze rundi rwego ibi bituma umuntu yahumeka insigane akagira guhangayika gukomeye gututubikana hato hato guhora utekereza hari ikintu kidasanzwe kigiye kukubaho umujinya udasanzwe bagabo agahinda gakabije kibasira abagabo n’abagore ariko buryo butandukanye ubushakashatsi bugaragaza abagabo bafite agahinda gakabije bakunze kugira umujinya udasanzwe imyitwarire iteye inkeke kunywa ibiyobyabwenge kugira uburakari batabasha kugenzura imihindagurikire bushake gufata amafunguro kwiyongera cyangwa kugabanuka kw’ibiro ingano y’ibiro n’ubushake gufata amafunguro bishobora kukwereka umuntu afite agahinda gakabije n’ubwo bishobora kugaragara buryo butandukanye hari abantu ubushake kurya buziyongera cyane bityo ibiro nabyo bikaba byinshi gihe hari abazumva gufata amafunguro ntacyo bikibamariye nabyo bituma batakaza ibiro kugira amarangamutima utabasha kugenzura iyo umuntu afite agahinda gakabije ntaba akibasha kugenzura amarangamutima mu kanya gato ushobora kumubona afite umujinya mwinshi ubundi ukamubona arimo kurira nyamara ruhare yabigizemo amarangamutima y’umuntu wahuye n’ikibazo kugira agahinda gakabije ahora ahindagurika umubonye minota mike ishize siko uza mubona masaha imbere kwifuza urupfu kumva urupfu ruruta kubaho kimwe bimenyetso by’agahinda gakabije bikajyana gushaka kwiyahura umuntu ajya kwiyahura ageze cyiciro kane nyuma y’ibindi bitatu yanyuzemo abantu ntibabibone cyangwa ntibabyiteho imibare y’ishami ry’umuryango w’abibumbye ryita buzima oms igaragaza y’abagerageza kwiyahura bafite agahinda gakabije bafite ndwara mutwe prof sezibera avuga umuntu yamenye icyamubabaje title: abanyarwanda batuye majyaruguru y’u burayi bibutse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: uyu muhango wateguwe ambasade y’u rwanda stockholm sude wakozwe bice bibiri birimo icyabaye mata n’icyo mata buryo budasanzwe hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga kubera ibihe isi irimo guhangana n’icyorezo covid- giterwa n’agakoko coronavirus ku mata umuhango wabaye wakozwe rurimi rw’icyongereza watumiwemo abayobozi nzego leta abahagarariye ibihugu byabo bihugu by’amajyaruguru y’uburayi abanyarwanda n’inshuti z’u rwanda watangiwemo ubuhamya umuhoza frida wavuze nzira kurokoka jenoside n’uko yiyubatse nyuma yayo abikesha ubuyobozi bwiza mu batanze ikiganiro harimo umuyobozi diapora nyarwanda mujyi copenhagen denmark teajen misago nkulikiyinka christine uhagarariye u rwanda bihugu scandinave ufite icyicaro i stockholm sude biyongeraho christelle charisse muhigana batanze ubutumwa bushimangira icyizere abakiri bato bafite nyuma jenoside yakorewe abatutsi mu batanze ubutumwa barimo abayobozi bakuru visi perezida kabiri w’inteko ishinga amategeko sude lotta johnsson fornarve minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga sude ann linde minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga finlande pikka haavisto n’umunyamabanga leta minisiteri y’ububanyi n’amahanga norvge marianne hagen bagarutse gushimira u rwanda intambwe rumaze gutera kwiyubaka nyuma y’ibihe by’akaga rwanyuzemo tariki mata nabwo habaye igikorwa kwibuka cyakozwe rurimi rw’ikinyarwanda kitabirwa n’abanyarwanda batuye sude denmark finland denmark abacyitabiriye basangijwe ubuhamya lyse umutoni wavuze akababaro yagize igihe atwite inda y’amezi umunani jenoside yakorewe abatutsi akaza kurokoka muri muhango ambasaderi nkulikiyinka wawutangije yenyegeza urumuri rw’icyizere nk’ikimenyetso cy’ejo hazaza heza hazira umwijima jenoside mu butumwa bwe yasangije abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo igisobanuro cy’umuhango kwibuka n’impamvu uhabwa agaciro yagize kwibuka kwibuka ugufata mugongo mbere mbere abarokotse ukwibukiranya indangagaciro z’umuco w’ibanze nyarwanda kuko uzikurikije ntiwakora abicanyi bakoze kwibuka kandi si uguheranwa n’agahinda gusa hagomba kubaho kwiyubaka kuko tutabikoze niho ababikoze bakwishima kwibuka gufatanya kurwanya abapfobya n’abahakana jenoside yakorewe abatutsi amb nkulikiyinka yashimiye kandi urubyiruko rwitabiriye ibikorwa kwibuka arusaba gukomeza kubakira bumwe yarusabye kwitabira ibikorwa birebana n’igihugu kumva icyabo bakakirwanira ishyaka christelle muhigana uhagarariye urubyiruko norvge yavuze hari igihango rukwiye kugirana n’igihugu yagize urubyiruko rurabizeza jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda rwiyemeje itazongera kubaho ukundi’’ ubu u rwanda rwariyubatse igihugu kiduteye ishema tuzaharanira ruhora rwubashywe’’ abitabiriye muhango baganirijwe mateka yimbitse itegurwa ishyirwa bikorwa n’ipfobya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kiganiro cyatanzwe n’umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa komisiyo y’igihugu ishinzwe kurwanya jenoside cnlg dr bizimana jean damascne wabakanguriye kurwanya abahakana n’abapfobya jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ababwira aricyo cyiciro kigezeho kuko utegura jenoside anategura uburyo azayihakana hanatanzwe ikiganiro ruhare diaspora kubungabunga amateka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kurwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside cyatanzwe alain ngirinshuti wabaye diaspora bufaransa wagaragaje inzira abakwiza ingengabitekerezo jenoside abapfobya n’abahakana banyuramo asaba urugamba kurwanya abapfobya rwaba urwa buri wese abitabiriye muhango bahawe title: gicumbiba rwiyemezamirimo kubaka ibigega by’amazi kubisondeka nyuma bigasandara hadakeye kabiri
content: abari kubakirwa ibibigega by’amazi mirenge shangashacyumba mukarange karere gicumbi barasaba ubuyobozi gukurikiranira imyubakire yabyo kuko birigusondekwa bigatuma nibyuzuye bidatanga amazi ndetse n’ibigo by’amashuri biri utwo duce uwineza onesphore umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe amasomo rwunge rw’amashuri cyumba avuga ibigega bitanu bujurijwe iby’ikitiriro gusa kuko bidakora atibyari byiza kubiduha kimwe ariko kuba bidakora icya kabiri barabiduhaye ariko nti bikora hakora bibiri bitatu ntabwo bikora bamwe batuye mirenge bavuga gihe hari ibigega bimaze imyaka ibiri byubatswe byuzurie bahawe amazi rimwe gusa ariko barimo kubisuzuma gusa aha ho ananias zirimwabagabo utuye murenge shangasha ahera asaba amakosa yakozwe kubaka bigega yakosorwa bagahabwa amazi meza ati bakwize mavomo bateguye bahe abaturage amazinkubu hari byamaze guturika hari bayafunguye bayatanga bagira barebe ukabona hamwe harasandayebyaba byarapfuye rwiyemezamirimo akabisubiramo umuyobozi w’akarere gicumbi felix ndayambaje ahamya koko amakosa nk’ayo akorwa barwiyemezamirimo bahawe amasoko bayabonagusa ndayambaje yizeza baturage akarere katazakira buryo burundu bigega gihe rwiyemezamirimo badakosoye amakosa yagaragara myubakire yabyo atiiyo utagize amaso areba gukurikirana nk’uko tubisabwa hari igihe habaho ngicyohari dukora turagenda tukareba ibidakwiye akabikora nk’abagize iryo hakiri karen’abayobozi b’inzego z’ibanze guhera isibo kuko ibikorwa by’amajyambere bihaza ntabwo iby’umuntu runaka ibyaboabayedi bahakora n’abafundi igihe kubaka bigega boniba kapita avuze nibavange ingorofani mufuka umwebagahita bavuga bintu ntabwo byujuje ubuziranenge kugirango tubibone byakozwe turi gusenyesha muntukuko ntabandi azana babaturage kandi bakaba aribo bazaba abagenerwabikorwa biteganyijwe ngengo y’imari y’akarere gicumbi y’uyu mwaka hazubakwa imiyoboro y’amazi hamwe ikazuzura itwaye miliyari frw imiyoboro akarere gicumbi kakaba kazayubaka nkunga y’umuryango ukora ibijyanye title: ibiribwa bitumizwa karere biri bituma ifaranga ry’u rwanda rikomeza guta agaciro
content: mu kiganiro n’abanyamakuru kabiri nyuma kugeza raporo y’ingengo y’imari yakoreshejwe umwaka ushize imbere y’inama y’abaminisitiri john rwangombwa yavuze ibituruka hanze bikomeza gutuma ibintu rwanda bizamba asubiza ikibazo abajijwe bantu benshi bakomeza kwibaza uburyo litiro lisansi hagabanutseho amafaranga ariko ibiciro bigakomeza kuzamuka yasubije n’ubwo lisansi yagabanyutse ariko ifaranga ryo ritigeze rireka guta agaciro ati ibiribwa bitumizwa hanze nko kenya bigira uruhare izamuka ry’ibiciro guta agaciro kw’ifaranga ryacu kuko nabyo biba byaguzwe mafaranga atagifite agaciro yagaragaje ingero z’uburyo u rwanda rufite ifaranga rikigerageza kugira agaciro karere n’ubwo umwaka ushize guta agaciro ifaranga ry’u rwanda byari uku kwezi bikaba bigeze nyuma y’u rwanda kenya nicyo gihugu kigerageza aka karere kuko ifaranga ryacyo ryataye agaciro kugeza hejuru muri kiganiro kizajya kibaho buri gihe minisitiri w’imari amaze gushyikiriza raporo inama y’abaminisitiri rwangombwa yasobanuye u rwanda rwabonye amafaranga angana miliyari ugereranyije miliyari rwabonye mwaka kuba mafaranga yariyongeryeho byaturutse bikorerwa imbere gihugu byatanze amafaranga y’u rwanda miliyari zingana y’inyungu miliyari z’ayaturutse hanze zingana by’inyungu emmanuel hitimana

title: qatar igiye gushora imari mahoteli rwanda kuki yahisemo u rwanda
content: mu nibwo ishoramari rikomeye ry’abanya-qatar ryatangiraga rwanda hatangizwa ingendo qatar airways nyuma yaho ibindi bikorwa byarakurikiye binyuze mubano mwiza hagati y’ibihugu ukuvuga perezida kagame emir qatar hari kandi amasezerano atandukanye hagati y’u rwanda qatar yibanda serivisi z’ubwikorezi kirere guteza imbere kurengera ishoramari bihuriweho n’ay’imikoranire by’ubukungu ubucuruzi tekiniki mu myaka itatu ishize umubano w’ibihugu byombi wafashe indi ntera binyuze ngendo z’abakuru b’ibihugu hasinywa amasezerano atandukanye azwi cyane ajyanye kubaka ikibuga cy’indege bugesera ndetse hitezwe n’andi kugura imigabane rwandair hari impamvu nyinshi qatar yahisemo gushora imari rwanda zimwe zirimo imiyoborere y’igihugu n’amahirwe y’ishoramari aruboneka bikajyana n’uko igihugu kiri mutima afurika byoroshye kugera zindi mpamvu igihe yahuye n’umuyobozi mukuru qatar airways akbar al baker i doha avuga kimwe byabakuruye gushora imari rwanda igihugu giherereye umutekano n’amahirwe y’ishoramari kiriya gihugu qatar igiye gushora imari mahoteli rwanda akbar yatangaje gihe cy’imyaka itatu abanyarwanda bazatangira kubona umusaruro ugaragara w’amasezerano amaze iminsi asinywa hagati y’u rwanda qatar dore gihe ikibuga cy’indege bugesera kizaba cyatangiye gukora ati mu myaka itatu imbere muzatangira kubona umusaruro umusaruro guhanga imirimo guhanga amahirwe y’ubukungu baturage kuzamura imibereho y’abaturage kuko ibijyanye n’indege umuyoboro mwiza guhanga imirimo abajijwe ibijyanye n’ingano y’amafaranga bazashora rwanda akbar yasubije ntabwo njya mbwira umuntu ariwe wese ibijyanye n’imibare magingo usibye ikibuga cy’indege bugesera n’imigabane qatar airways igiye kugura rwandair hari gahunda gushora imari bindi bikorwa cyane ibijyanye n’amahoteli umuyobozi qatar airways yabwiye igihe qatar airways irashaka gushora imari bijyanye n’amahoteli urabizi ukura bijyanye n’indege ukenera ibyumba kuraramo by’abakozi ukenera kuzana abantu b’inzobere uzakenera kandi ibyumba by’abakozi ndege biri n’ikibuga cy’indege rero hazabaho amahirwe y’irindi shoramari riturutse zindi nzego guverinoma zikora ibijyanye n’ibikorwa remezo kuki qatar ikomeje ishoramari hanze y’igihugu qatar kimwe bihugu burengerazuba bw’isi gifite buri kimwe cyose umuntu yakenera kiri buso buto cyane bungana n’intara y’uburengerazuba hamwe n’umujyi kigali ubiteranyije kuko kiri kilometero kare qatar ntabwo ituwe cyane magingo ibarirwa abaturage bagera miliyoni gusa igitangaje abanyagihugu kavukire barenga gato ibihumbi gusa abandi abanyamahanga binjira gihugu bashaka akazi mu habarwaga umuturage qatar yinjizaga nibura ibihumbi by’amadolari asaga miliyoni frw mwaka gusa ariko mafaranga aturuka kintu kimwe ubukungu bushingiye mutungo kamere qatar ifite gaz nyinshi bihambaye ndetse iya gatatu isi nyuma y’u burusiya iran intego qatar ntabwo ugukomeza gushingira ubukungu mutungo kamere gusa ikora n’ibishoboka byose igashora imari ariko hanze y’igihugu mu gihe ubukungu bwari bwifashe nabi burayi amerika qatar yarahagurutse ibibyaza amahirwe igura imiturirwa myinshi burayi by’umwihariko i londres z’inyubako zaguzwe qatar cyangwa se izifitemo imigabane mu habarurwaga ishoramari qatar bwongereza ringana miliyari z’ama-pound ndetse myaka itanu hazaba hamaze gushorwa andi miliyari eshanu z’ama-pound agace kabonekamo inganda nyinshi bwongereza canary wharf aka qatar umuturirwa witwa the shard olympic village n’izindi ndetse qatar ifite imigabane ingana barclays bank aha hamwe henshi qatar yashoye imari kandi birayihira ni uburyo bumwe qatar yahisemo kutarambiriza mutungo kamere gusa ahubwo igashaka n’uko ikorera andi mafaranga ariko binyuze ishoramari ryo hanze

title: inkomoko y’imvugo rubanda abahanya
content: rubanda abahanya umugani baca bashaka gutsindira umuntu ubugome badasobanuye bagira bati rubanda abahanya wakomotse muja mibambwe sekarongoro witwaga nyirabihanya muka buyoyo w’i nyarusave title: ingengo y’imari iziyongeraho arenga miliyari frw
content: minisitiri w’imari n’igenamigambi dr ndagijimana uzziel yatangaje ingengo y’imari iziyongera ikava miliyari frw yariho ikagera miliyari frw bigaragaza inyongera miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda dr ndagijimana uzziel yabigarutseho mbere tariki gashyantare yagezaga nteko rusange y’umutwe w’abadepite impinduka z’ingenzi zikubiye ivugururwa ry’ingengo y’imari yabwiye inteko rusange basaba ingengo y’imari ingana miliyari ibihumbi z’amafaranga y’u rwanda yemejwe n’inteko ishinga amategeko kwezi kamena yiyongera ikagera miliyari ibihumbi z’amafaranga y’u rwanda bivuze yiyongeraho agera miliyari frw yabwiye inteko impinduka zihari amafaranga yinjizwa isanduku leta ava imbere gihugu azava miiliyari akagera miliyari frw bivuze yiyongeraho agera miliyari frw avuga nyongera izaturuka mafaranga ava misoro ateganyijwe kwiyongera kubera izamuka ry’ubukungu ndetse yandi mafaranga yinjizwa ngego y’imari atari imisoro ati amafaranga aturuka nkunga z’amahanga ateganyijwe kugabanukaho miliyari z’amarafarnga y’u rwanda akava miliyari frw akagera miliyari frw dr ndagijimana yavuze nyongera izafasha kwishyura imishahara y’abaganga bashya kubazamura ntera kubonera ambasade nshya arizo accra ghana doha qatar rabat marocco n’izindi nzego zirimo minisiteri y’umutekano gihugu amafaranga gukoresha yavuze hari kandi amafaranga afasha bwisungane kwivuza ndetse n’amafaranga afasha gutanga amata bana n’ibindi yatangaje amafaranga agenewe imishinga azava miliyari agere miliyari frw amafaranga agenewe ishoramari leta azava miliyari frw agere miliyari aziyongeraho miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda uko ubukungu bwari bwifashe muri rusange yavuze mezi icyenda mbere y’umwaka ubukungu bw’u rwanda bwazamutse kigero ugeranyije n’igipimo kingana cyari cyagezweho mezi icyenda mbere y’umwaka yavuze byaturutse izamuka rishimishije ry’ubuhinzi inganda serivisi dr ndagijimana yavuze mezi icyenda mbere y’umwaka ubuhinzi bwazamutse inganda serivisi ati ku bijyanye n’igipimo cy’izamuka ry’ibiciro rusange masoko ibiciro byazamutse byari hasi gihembwe mbere n’icya kabiri cy’umwaka kuko byari ariko bitangira kuzamuka gihembwe gatatu mpuzandengo n’igihembwe kane mpuzandengo gusa yavuze ukuboza zamuka ry’ibiciro ryazamutseho gato rigera yagaragaje hitezwe izamuka rusange ry’ibiciro rizagabanuka gihembwe mbere kubera umusaruro w’ubuhinziyagaragaje urwgeo rw’imari n’imicungire nyakanga ingengo y’imari itangira kugeza ukuboza hari hateganyijwe kwinjizwa amafaranga agera miliyari z’amafaranga y’u rwanda isanduku leta hinjiye miliyari bivuze yarenzeho miliyari ateganyijwe avuga amafaranga yiyongereye yaturutse mafaranga yinjizwa akomoka gihugu harimo imisoro n’amahoro n’andi y’abaterankunga

title: rusizi ubushobozi guhanga imirimo buracyari ingorabahizi bize amasiyansi

bakabyicarana kubera kubura igishoro babibyaze umusaruro ibi babitangaje berekaga ababyeyi n’abayobozi batandukanye bamaze gukura bumenyi bahabwa byahaye ababyeyi icyizere cy’uko imbaraga bashyira kubafasha kwiga zidapfa ubusa ahubwo ikibazo kivuka bageze hanze y’ishuri mu baberetse harimo gukora umuti gusiga inkweto ukoresheje amakara imirayirayi peteroli gukora imitobe gukora serumu amasabune byabashimishije cyane kandi banabivuzeho benshi nk’uko n’iyo tubikoze abarezi bacu n’abandi baturage babigura amafaranga akatugirira akamaro ariko ikibazo tugeze hanze ubushobozi buba buke twize title: ibihugu bihuriye muhora ruguru byumvikanye guhererekanya imfungwa
content: kuri gatanu taliki ugushyingo i nyamata karere bugesera hashojwe inama y’iminsi itatu yigaga mahoro n’umutekano yahuje abashinzweabaminisitiri b’ umutekano mubihigu bihuriye mushinga w’umuhora ruguru aribyo u rwanda rwakiriye inama kenya uganda iyi nama yarangijwe gushyira umukono masezerano y’ubufatanye hagamijwe guhererekanya abanyabyaha ndetse n’abamaze gukatirwa bahungiye kimwe bihugu minisitiri w’umutekano w’u rwanda sheikh musa fazil harerimana uyoboye bagenzi gihe yasobanuye masezerano ruhande rumwe aje korohereza imiryango y’abanyabyaha bafungiye bindi bihugu bikazagabanya indendo bakoraga bajya kubasura yagize atiturashaka bafungwa imiryango ibabona bitayigoye ariko ishyirwa bikorwa ry’aya masezerano rizabaho minsi vuba habanje kunonosorwa bazajya bajyanwa n’ibihugu bafungiyemo cyangwa bazajya batwarwa n’ibihugu bavukamo bagezwe bagomba gufungirwa hakigwa n’igihe byose bigomba gukorwamo iyi nama kandi yanzuye ishyirwamubikorwa ryo gushakira umutekano w’umushinga w’iterambere ry’ibihugu bihuriye muhora ruguru akaba igitekerezo cy’ibihugu by’u rwanda kenya uganda ukaba ugamije kwihutisha iterambere ry’akarere biherereyemo biciye bikorwa remezo ubucuruzi n’ubukungu rusange hafashwe umwanzuro kandi ngamba z’ihuzabikorwa by’umutekano hagenzurwa abanyabyaha n’ibikorwa byabo bihugu guhanahana amakuru kurwanya ibyaha bishingiye bukungu butagondwa ndetse guha umutekano imipaka y’ibi bihugu mu bindi hizwe kwita basaba ubuhungiro bihugu bufatanye kurwanya gukoma imbere ibiza ndetse n’ingamba kurwanya impanuka muhanda havuzwe hazahyirwaho amategeko ahuriweho n’ibi bihugu u rwanda akaba arirwo ruzakora imbanzirizamushinga y’ayo mategeko gihe uganda yahawe kuziga birebana n’impunzi ambasaderi james baba minisitiri wumutekano uganda ijambo rye yashimye u rwanda iterambere rwagezeho yagize natangajwe n’uburyo u rwanda rurimo gutera imbere kandi gihugu hose atari i kigali gusa gihugu kiragenda kiba ahantu heza ho gushora imaridukeneye umutekano w’iyo mari iba yashowe niyo mpamvu hatabayeho ngamba z’umutekano ntacyakorwa uhagarariye kenya rwanda bwana john mwengemi yavuze nama ishingiro ry’ibikorwa by’ahazaza kandi igihugu cye cyumva impamvu yabyo inama y’abaminisitiri yakurikiye iyari yahuje abakuru polisi z’ibi bihugu nayo yize ikanafata imyanzuro byari byizwe n’impuguke zivuye biriya bihugu bitatu ibyemezo byayifatiwemo bikaba byari murongo w’ibyari byizweho nama yabereye i nairobi kwezi gushize kuri kane umuyobozi polisi y’u rwanda igp emmanuel k gasana yayoboye inama yahuje abayobozi polisi z’u rwanda kenya uganda n’izindi nzego zishinzwe umutekano bihugu yavuze kugera nshingano kw’ inzego duhagarariye bizaba umusemburo kugira akarere k’amahoro kandi kabereye gukoreramo gushoramo imari niyo mpamvu tugomba guha agaciro dutegerejweho inzego zishinzwe umutekano zirimo polisi iperereza iz’abinjira n’abasohoka hamwe n’izishinzwe amagereza bihugu bitatu zirangaje izindi imbere gushyira bikorwa ubufatanye hagamijwe iterambere ry’ibihugu bihuriye muhora ruguru nzego gika kabiri cy’imyanzuro yafashwe hagati yazo harimo kurwanya ibyaha guha umutekano ababituye kurinda icyahungabanya iterambere n’umutekano rusange w’ibihugu bihuriye muhorarnp news yanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura
content: umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’umurenge bwishyura niyonsaba cyriaque wifatanyije n’abaturage b’imidugudu nyarurembo karutete yagize ishavu ry’abanyarwanda ritubere umusingi kwiyubaka aha niyonsaba yungaga nsanganyamatsiko yahariwe mwaka igira iti twigire mateka turusheho kubaka ejo hazaza niyonsaba yaboneyeho akanya kunenga politike yazanywe n’abazungu gushyamiranya abantu yatunze agatoki ababiligi baje rwanda bagasanga abanyarwanda babanye neza bagasiga barukongeje n’ikintu kigaragara barusigiye umuyobozi w’umurenge bwishyura yagize urugero nk’aha kibuye basize bubatse gereza yonyine nk’aho abanyakibuye bakeneye hatanzwe ubuhamya bw’umwe bacitse icumu kibuye mukangoga emelita ufite imyaka gusa igihe jenoside yabaga yari afite ikiniga kinshi ariko yabashije kuvuga make byamugendekeye yabisobanuye magambo ikintu ntazigera nibagirwa igihe papa yampamagaye arangije guteka inkono y’ibijumba nituze aduhe ifunguro nyuma namubajije impamvu atubwiye atyo ambwira bagiye kutwica kuva bahise badutera turatatanangenda nomongana ntazi ngana hashize akanya gato mbona iwacu barahatwitse narinihishe mbona interahamwe zizanye papa kumwe murumuna papa afite bibiliya barayimwaka barayica amanika amaboko hejuru agira mana bantu ubababarire ntibazi barimo gukora ako kanya bahita bamutema amaboko murumuna babatsinda ahonanjye bashatse kunyica inshuro nyinshi buryo nageze mera nk’ikinya nkajya mbabwira nabi nti nimukore mushakaibyambayeho birebire mbivuze bwakwira bugacyagusa ndashimira imana nkiriho nk’uko mukangoga yakomeje abitangamo ubuhamya mukangoga emelita yasigaye wenyine muryango w’abana nyina bamwishe atwite inda cyenda se n’abavandimwe barabamaze ubu umubyeyi w’abana babili umuhungu w’imyaka n’imfura y’umukobwa w’imyaka ubura umwaka umwe angane mama igihe jenoside yabaga nyuma y’ubuhamya mukangoga hatanzwe n’ikiganiro ruhare leta yagize jenoside umwe bacitse icumu watanze ikiganiro yasobanuye ukuntu abatutsi kibuye kimwe n’ahandi hose rwanda bagiye bahezwa gahunda leta y’icyo gihe umuntu akabaho atazi bucya kugeza igihe jenoside ibereye n’uwo bitaga inshuti n’umuturanyi arabahinduka umuhango wabimburiwe n’urugendo rwahereye rwibutso jenoside ruri iruhande rw’ahahoze sitade gatwaro mujyi kibuye kugera mudugudu nyarurembo ahabereye ibiganiro gukurikira ijambo ry’umukuru w’igihugu yahariye munsi radiyo televiziyo abari babashije gukusanya amafaranga ibihumbi gutera inkunga abacitse icumu mu rwego rw’akarere gutangiza icyunamo byabereye murenge mubuga umuyobozi w’akarere karongi kayumba bernard n’abandi bayobozi title: umunyamakuru yasabye abagize uruhare kwihisha kabuga bakurikiranwa by’umwihariko
content: umunyamakuru witwa john allan namu kenya yavuze n’ubwo itabwa yombi kabuga felicien wagize uruhare rukomeye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ryagezweho n’abamufashije kwihisha myaka bakwiye gukurikiranwa bakaburanishwa ukwabo kuwa gatandatu tariki gicurasi nibwo urwego rwasigariyeho urukiko mpuzamahanga mpanabyaha irmct rwatangaje kabuga felicien yafatiwe bufaransa nyuma y’amasaha make ubushinjacyaha bufaransa bwatangaje nyuma rwanda yagiye bihugu bitandukanye birimo u budage u bubiligi congo-kinshasa kenya ndetse busuwisi umunyamakuru john allan namu usanzwe uzwiho gukora inkuru zicukumbuye kenya yabwiye bbc kabuga yagiye yihisha buryo bukomeye ariko akaba afite abamukingira ikibaba kandi bakomeye allan namu yavuze uburyo yagiye akurikirana kabuga kugeza yamwanditseho inkuru icukumbuye bikarangira bimukozeho buryo n’umwana n’umugore bagiye bwihisho bahunga abashakaga kubagirira nabi allan namu yakoze icukumbura ashakishe kabuga yaba aherereye anakora inkuru ishingiye bushakashatsi bwari bwizewe ndetse igera kure ariko haza kuba umwe bamuhaye amakuru amuha ifoto itari iya kabuga ahubwo iy’undi muturage usanzwe kenya ibintu avuga byamubabaje cyaneyagize nabishyize hamwe byose inkuru icukumbuye nakoze mbona ariyo yageze kure kurusha izindi zose zageragejwe mbere ariko buryo bubabaje nahawe ifoto nizezwa n’abampaye amakuru iya kabuga kandi atari namu avuga foto ariyo yonyine yatumye iperereza rye riteshwa agaciro buryo n’ibyari birikubiyemo byabaye imfabusa ahubwo ahangayikishwa kuba yakoresheje umuturage kenya usanzwe nk’umunyabyaha ushakishwa kandi arengana mu mwaka munyamakuru witwa william manuhe kichugi yishwe yageragezaga gutanga amakuru yatuma urwego rw’iperereza amerika fbi rufata kabuga ariko kugeza hakaba cyakozwe abamwishe bakurikiranwe nk’uko umuryango wabitangaje nyuma y’ifatwa kabuga john allan namu yavuze urukiko rwagombye kuzamuburanisha ariko ntirukurikirane ibyaha aregwa gusa birangirire ahubwo rugakurikirana igihugu n’undi wese wagize uruhare kumuhisha yagize ikibazo urukiko rumurega ariho bizagarukira ku bijyanye n’abamufashije gihe cyose numva baburanishwa ukwabo kandi ntibibuze hari igihugu u bufaransa cyangwa ikindi aricyo cyose kibazwa yabashije kwihisha n’ababimufashijemo mu bashobora gukurikiranwa cyaha kumuhisha harimo n’abana bamufashije kwihisha nyubako i paris bufaransa guhindura amazina yakoreshaga nk’uko iperereza ryabigaragaje akimara gufatwa

content: rimwe mashami riherereye mujyi rwagati y’isoko irindi shami riri mupaka muto petite barriere w’u rwanda repubulika iharanira demokarasi kongo kevin mukotanyi ushinzwe ibikorwa tigo i rubavu yatangaje gufungura amashami ukwegereza abanyarubavu serivisi batajyaga babona telefoni sim swap tigo cash n’ibindi ngo bikorwa byatinze kubageraho kuko tigo ikiri nshya mikorere mukotanyi yagize hehe n’ingendo kigali-rubavu bafatabuguzi tigo bitegure serivisi batigeze babona ahandi nyuma gufungura mugaragaro ishami ryo mupaka hakurikiyeho igikorwa gutanga amasaha n’amakaramu baturage bitabiriye gahunda binyuze tombola igikorwa gufungura amashami tigo cyari kirangajwe imbere n’umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe ubukungu karere rubavu ezechiel buntu n’umuyobozi mukuru ceo tigo rwanda diego camberos matthew dutrisac ushinzwe ibicuruzwa n’amasoko kugeza tigo imaze kugira abafatabuguzi miliyoni ebyiri nabyo byagaragajwe n’abakozi bayo bazaga bambaye imipira byanditseho ndetse kuzamura intoki ebyiri bivuga miliyoni ebyiri tigo izakomereza gufungura amashami ntara y’iburengerazuba nk’uko mukotanyi yabitangaje pascaline umulisa

cyacitse igaparika hagashakwa indi ituruka hakurya abakarani bagapakurura ibicuruzwa bishyirwa irya ije kubireba ugasanga harishyurwa amafaranga y’imodoka ebyiri icyarimwe ndetse hakishyurwa n’abakarani igihombo kikaba kirabonetse yakomeje ashimangira leta itabatabaye bazisanga amaduka bayakinze kubera ibihombo ndetse n’ibigo by’imari bikabatereza cyamunara iby’abo dore bakoresha amafaranga y’inguzanyo bafashe bigo by’imari imiryango ikahatikirira soma inkuru bifitanye isano rusizi ikibazo cy’ibiraro byacitse bikomeje guhitana ubuzima bw’abantu nsabimana cleophas umumotari ukorera zone nyakabuye ahamya nubwo batarakomorerwa gutwara kubera ibihe bikomeye igihugu kirimo ndetse n’isi guma rugo kubera covid- asanga gucika biriya biraro byarabaye inzitizi ikomeye kwiteza b’ingeri zose boherejwe bitaro mibirizi ukibaza ngobyi zirajya zica bikakuyobera sinzi kandi bazabigenza nk’abacuruzi bashaka amakamyo abiri bakakukanwa ibicuruzwaku barwayi numva bitashoboka dore usanga ahenshi barira mubare uhagije w’ ngombyi z’abarwayi bafite abahinzi b’imiceri kano gace nabo usanga barira bavuga barigutinda kubona amafaranga bitewe koperative itunganya umusaruro w’umuceri itinga kubapakirira umusaruro wabo callixte nzaramba umuhinzi w’umuceri gishanga bugarama ariko avuga ukwangirika kw’ibyo biraro usanga bibangamiye iyishyurwa ryabo yagize usanga imodoka zibura zica kugirango zidupakirire umusaruro wacu bigatuma tubura uburyo bwihuse kwishyurwa bityo tugasaba ikorwa biriya biraro ryakwihutishwa kugirango ubuhahirane bukomeze dutere imbere ku ruhande rw’ubuyobozi nama yahuje inzego zitandukanye harimo ubuyobozi bw’ingabo karere ubuyobozi polisi karere rusizi ndetse guverineri w’intara y’uburengerazuba bwana munyentwari alphonse ntawutagarutse kibazo cy’ibyo biraro kayumba ephrem umuyobozi w’akarere rusizi mbwirwaruhame y’uwo munsi yihanganishije abaturage ababwira leta ibatekereza kandi kibazo barikugishakira umuti bihe vuba yagize atiikibazo cy’ibiraro turakizi kandi leta yacu irabatekereza gusa twizeye turikugikoraho kandi tubahaye icyizere vuba turacyabishakira umuti urambye ibi kandi byashimangiwe guverineri w’iyi ntara y’uburengerazuba bwana munyentwari alphonse yashimangiye biraro bigomba kwihutishwa rwego gushyigikira ibikorwa by’iterambere yagize atiibi biraro bibafatiye runini niyo mpamvu iby’iki kibazo tugomba kubyitaho tugafatanya n’inzego zitandukanye ibiraro bikubakwa buryo burambye ubuhahirane bugakomeza mwiteza imbere iyi nama yahuje ingeri zitandukanye ingabo polisi ubuyobozi bw’akarere rusizi ubuyobozi bw’intara y’uburengerazuba ndetse n’abavuga rikijyana murenge nyakabuye nama ikaba yarakozwe hubahirizwa amabwiriza kurwanya icyorezo covid- hakarabwa intoki n’amazi n’isabune kwambara udupfukamunwa ndetse hubahirizwa n’intera metero hagati y’umuntu n’undi denis fabrice nsengumuremyimuhaburarw

title: umwaka fashion rwandaabakomeye barimbye imideri y’abanyarwanda
content: umwaka waranzwe n’iterambere ry’abari ruganda rw’imideri rwanda cyane inzu z’imideri kuko zagurishije cyane ndetse n’ibyo bakora bimenyekana rwego mpuzamahanga kuruta myaka yabanje bamwe bayobozi n’ibyamamare bikomeye isi barimbye imideri yakozwe n’abanyarwanda iri terambere ryagaragajwe n’izi nzu z’imideri ahanini byagizwemo uruhare politike guteza imbere ibikorerwa rwanda izwi made in rwanda’ nzego zitandukanye zirimo leta bashishikarijwe kurimba ibikorerwa rwanda ubu minisiteri n’ibigo leta hari amabwiriza asaba abakozi kwambara imyambaro ikorerwa rwanda nibura rimwe cyumweru ibyamamare bitandukanye isi byasuye u rwanda bagaragaje ikirezi batewe kurimba imyambaro yakozwe n’abana b’abanyarwanda harimo nk’icyamamare ne-yo warimbye umukenyero wakozwe n’inzu y’imideri izwi uzi abayobozi bakomeye perezida kagame paul madamu jeannette kagame bagaragaye bikorwa bitandukanye bambaye imyenda yakozwe n’inzu y’imideri rwanda inzu z’imideri zigaragaje n’abo zambitse moshions iyi inzu y’imideri yashinjwe n’uwitwa moses turahirwa umwaka ushize yagaragaje iterambere ndetse n’imideri bakora yarambawe cyane iriya mideri yakozwe moshions yambawe n’abantu batandukanye barimo muryango nyakubahwa kagame paul ndetse ubwe akaba yarahisemo kurimba iriya mideri yavugaga ijambo risoza umwaka madamu jennette kagame yambaye imideri y’iyi nzu by’umwihariko nama icasa yayambaye iminsi ibiri yikurikiranya imideri moshions kandi yambawe n’ikibumbano gifite amateka akomeye bubiligi kizwi manneken pis ndetse ayambika n’igisamuntu cyangwa robot yenda gukora nk’abantu izwi cyane isi ikaba ifite n’ubwenegihugu arabie saoudite yitwa sophia yitabiriye transform africa summit uzuri ky iyi nzu y’imideri yashinzwe n’abakobwa babiri barimo uwitwa kevine ysolde bombi bakaba bakora inkweto bifashije ibikoresho bitandukanye birimo n’amapine y’imodoka umwaka ushize iriya nzu ikora inkweto yarigaragaje cyane by’umwihariko inkweto bakora zashimwe n’abatundukanye barimo perezida kagame paul gikorwa youth entrepreneurship town hall’ uzi collections iyi nzu y’imideri yashinzwe remera nathalie hamwe rwema laurene bombi basanzwe bakora imideri itandukanye ariko cyane iyiganjemo ikozwe bitenge umwaka ushize bambitse abantu batandukanye by’umwihariko batoranywa kuba bahanzi b’imideri bambika abari bitabiriye igikorwa kwita izina abana b’ingagi cyari kibaye nshuro muri kiriya gikorwa umuhanzi w’ikirangirire w’umunyamerika ne-yo yambaye imyenda yakozwe n’iyi nzu tanga designs iyi inzu y’imideri yashinzwe n’uwitwa niyitanga olivier by’umwihariko akaba akora imideri yiganjemo iyambarwa n’abakoze ubukwe umwaka ushize bambitse umubare munini w’abakobwa birori by’ubukwe bw’abo undi mwihariko w’iyi nzu y’imideri imideri myinshi bakora ahanini bayirimbisha imitako yunganira umuderi bakoresheje intoki ktsobe iyi nzu yashinzwe n’uwitwa sarah legrand bakora ibikoresho byose by’imirimbo y’abagore n’abagabo birimo amaherena inigi ijosi impeta n’ibindi umwaka ushize imirimbo yambawe n’abantu batundukanye barimo n’ibyamamare binyuranye isonga hari uwitwa umuhanzi liliane mbabazi mubakomeye uganda jidenna uheruka gutaramira rwanda robert kayihuraumusekerw

title: ibintu by’ibanze bituma umugore aryoherwa gihe gutera akabariro
content: abagore baryoherwa n’ imibonano mpuzabitsina ariko usanga uburyo bishima atari bumwe tugiye kubabwira bimwe bituma umugore aryoherwa ndetse bikaba byatuma ahora yishimiye umugabo umugore aryoherwa n’ imibonano umugabo barimo kuyikora amweretse amwitayeho kandi akabikora amubwira utugambo twinshi twiza kuko abagore benshi bemeza badakunda umugabo ubarongora atavuga cyangwa avuge ibintu bigaragaza yishimye nko kuniha gahoro cyangwa gushishira kwishima mugabo menya guhindurira umugore wawe position kugirango murusheho kwishimirana umugabo kandi agomba kumenya imiterere y’ umugore ndetse akanamenya uburyo butamuvuna gihe gutera akabariro bityo akaba aribyo akunda kumukorera kandi akibuka agomba gukora ibishoboka byose amushimishe igihe umugabo arimo gutera akabariro akananirwa ntagomba kubyereka umugore kuko bituma ibyiyumvo bishira ububobere bukagabanyuka umugabo afite inshingano kunyaza umugore igihe cyose kuko bituma umugore amukunda kandi agahora yumva ashaka yamurongora umugabo kandi agomba kwiga kunyaza igihe atabizi neza kandi akamenya uburyo abikoramo kugirango umugore agire amazi menshi kuko akenshi abagabo bakunda umugore unyara ariko bakirengagiza bibaho umugabo wabigizemo uruhare igihe cyose umugore wawe utamuryohereza yiganyiriza kuryama ndetse bikamutera n’ agahinda atekereje agiye kuryama inyuma ni byiza umugabo yiga akanahimba udushya twa buri munsi two gukorera umugore kugirango umugore yishime ibi kandi binagabanya irari umugore ashobora kugirira abandi bagabo kuko yumva ntacyo abandi bagabo barusha umugabo nabyo bikaba bituma umugore yishima kurushaho kandi n’ umugabo ntiyifuze kuba yaryamana n’ mugore umugabo afite inshingano guha umugore impano zimushimisha kugirango umugore abone amwitayeho mbere gukora imibonano umugabo agomba kubanza kugira umugore cyangwa yaba ntacyo afite akagira amusezeranya ni byiza gukora imibonano mwishimiranye kuko bibafasha mwembi abagabo bagomba kubahiriza inshingano zabo kandi bakereka abagore ntawundi gore ubaruta bameze kose nk’ bemera bibiliya byanditse mugabo ukunde umugore wawe mugore wubahe umugabo wawe yanditswe sarongo richardmuhaburarw

title: kwicuza ntitwari kwemera ibihugu by’i burayi n’amerika bitera libya - perezida museveni
content: mu gihe bimwe bihugu bikomeye isi bikomeje kwivanga bibera libya umuryango w’ubumwe bw’afurika au wisanze wahejwe gahunda zigamije kurangiza amakimbirane amaze imyaka gihugu gikize bikomoka peteroli ikimenyetso vuba kigaragaza afurika ikomeje gutakaza ijambo bijyanye n’ikibazo libya cyagaragariye bikorwa by’amahanga byabereye mijyi instanbul moscow berlin ni ibikorwa bigamije kurangiza kibazo cyavutse habereye impinduramatwara ishyigikiwe n’umuryango w’ubwirinzi w’ibihugu by’i burayi n’amerika otannato bikavanaho ubutegetsi muammar gaddafi jalel harchaoui umusesenguzi libya ukora kigo cy’ubushakashatsi mibanire y’ibihugu buholandi yagize ibihugu by’afurika birinuba kandi reka byinube libya yahindutse igikinisho cy’ibihugu bimwe bikomeye yongeyeho ikibazo libya kiri kureberwa ndorebwamo y’i burayi kigobe perse ndetse kiri kurushaho kureberwa ndorerwamo y’uburusiya turukiya hirengagijwe ikintu cy’ukuri cy’ingenzi cyuko libya igihugu cy’afurika abateye b’i burayi n’amerika agaragaza kutishimira umugabane w’afurika wahejwe perezida yoweri museveni yabwiye bbc ducyesha iyinkuru k uhagarariye au kibazo libya perezida denis sassou nguesso congo-brazzaville yatumiwe munota nyuma nama itariki y’ukwezi mbere yabereye i berlin butumire bw’umukuru w’ubudage angela merkel museveni avuga gutumira nguesso byari gusa kwiyerurutsa berekana n’afurika ibirimo perezida museveni yongeyeho ntitwagakwiye kuba twaremereye ibihugu by’i burayi n’amerika gutera libya twashoboraga kuba twarabyinjiyemo niyo byari kuba rwego gisirikare afurika yashoboraga kubyinjiramo igaha isomo bariya bantu niba afurika ishaka kwirukana abayitera dushobora kubirukana twatsinze abanyaportugali n’ aba-boers abo boers bakaba bwoko ’afrikaners’ butegetsi afurika y’epfo kugera mwaka ariko abasesenguzi bavuga nubwo afurika yahejwe n’ibihugu by’i burayi n’amerika nayo ubwayo atari shyashya nguesso akuriye akanama au kiga libya kamaze gukora inama zitandukanye zigamije gukemura ikibazo libya - iya vuba ikaba yarabaye nyuma y’iyo yabereye i berlin - ariko kugeza byinshi kari bwagereho gaddafi umuntu wubashywe cyane au akaba yarateraga muryango inkunga nyinshi y’amafaranga yaharaniye ibihugu by’afurika byagira ubumwe ndetse yamamara cyane kubera kwibasira gashakabuhake imyivumbagatanyo yaje kuvamo ihirikwa n’iyicwa rye yavuzweho cyane afurika kandi libya habaye ibintu bishingiye kuronda ubwoko cyane banyafurika b’abirabura libya bashinjwaga kuba abacanshuro bageragezaga kugumisha gaddafi butegetsi tarek megersi umusesenguzi ukomoka libya ukora kigo cy’ubushakashatsi bubanyi n’amahanga cy’akanama k’uburayi gifite icyicaro bwongereza yavuze magambo bwana museveni agaragaza bamwe bategetsi afurika bagiheranwe n’urupfu gaddafi yagize mu gihe cy’impinduramatwara au yagaragaye nk’ishyigikiye gaddafi ndetse banya-libya hari abatarayishimiye abantu babonaga nkaho au yaraguzwe gaddafi rero amagambo bwana museveni asuzuguza uruhare afurika ishobora kugira nk’umuhuza udafite uruhande abogamiyeho nyamara ariko hari hacyenewe afurika igira uruhare rwisumbuyeho kurangiza ikibazo libya kuko ubukungu bw’umugabane w’afurika bwashegeshwe n’ihirikwa butegetsi gaddafi ndetse n’umutekano mucye libya wagize uruhare kuzonga ubukungu bw’icyo gihugu megersi yagize hari igihe hari miliyoni z’amadolari zibarirwa magana zinjiraga afurika nk’ishoramari ry’ubutegetsi gaddafi nyuma zirakama hari n’amafaranga yoherezwaga n’abimukira bagiye gukora libya bavuye bihugu nigeria kuko imishahara libya n’ibijyanye kuvunjisha byari byiza ibyo nabyo byarahagaze megersi yavuze buryo buteye impungenge bimwe bihugu by’afurika byahindutse impande zirwana libya zisigaye zikura zijyana kurwanisha urugero vuba amakuru yuko abagabo sudani bashutswe bagiye guhabwa akazi k’uburinzi leta zunze ubumwe z’abarabu uae kandi by’ukuri bajyanwe libya kurinda amariba y’ibikomoka peteroli yafashwe n’abarwanyi b’inyeshyamba jenerali khalifa haftar izo nyeshyamba mutwe libyan national army lna ziri kurwana zishaka gufata umurwa mukuru tripoli ahakorera leta libya yemewe n’umuryango w’abibumbye libya gihugu mbere gifite amariba menshi y’ibikomoka peteroli afurika ndetse gifite n’umwuka kamere ukoreshwa nk’igitanga ingufu - ibintu bituma hari ibihugu by’amahanga bishishikazwa n’ibibera gihugu ahanini cy’ubutayu kiri nkengero y’inyanja mditerrane amakimbirane libya yagize ingaruka zikomeye masururo w’ibikomoka peteroli kuba jenerali haftar yaragose amariba byatumye mariba afungwa n’ibyambu nabyo birafungwa umusaruro w’utugunguru miliyoni munsi uragabanuka ugera tugunguru nkuko bitangazwa n’ibiro ntaramakuru reuters ni bande bivanze kibazo libya ibihugu uae n’ubufaransa by’ingenzi bishyigikiye jenerali haftar gahunda gushaka gufata ubutegetsi bufitwe leta ikorera i tripoli izwi government of national accord gna igizwe n’imitwe politiki itandukanye harchaoui yagize bahuje uae misiri n’ubufaransa ingengabitekerezo haftar bashyize imbere ubutegetsi bw’igitugu rwego hejuru brotherhood perezida mbere misiri utowe buryo demokarasi harchaoui misiri ishyigikiye haftar politiki ariko mafaranga imushoraho abandi barabikora arabie saoudite imaze kumuha miliyoni z’ama-euro zibaribwa mirongo kwezi gatatu yagabaga igitero gushaka gufata tripoli umutekano mucye libya wageze majyepfo yayo ikibazo cy’umutekano mucye libya ahanini cyashinjwe kuba umuyoboro ucamo intwaro n’abarwanyi mitwe igendera mahame akaze y’idini kisilamu ikorera karere k’ubutayu sahara bihugu mali niger burkina faso harchaoui yongeyeho ubufaransa bwari bwaragerageje gutuma ibihugu bwahoze bukoloniza bishyigikira jenerali haftar ariko bukamaganwa perezida idriss dby tchad igihugu gifite igisirikare gikomeye kandi kikaba ingenzi kurwanya imitwe y’intagondwa ifitanye isano n’umutwe wiyita leta kisilamu is al-qaeda burengerazuba bw’afurika karere sahel akarere igice cyako cyumagaye kari n’ubutayu sahara harchaoui yagize mu bijyanye n’ibikoresho dby haftar bagakwiye kuba inshuti ariko si bimeze impamvu jenerali haftar ngabo gaddafi gihe yayoboye igitero cyagabwe tchad mpera y’imyaka icyo gihe yafashwe mpiri ahindura uruhande ariho afatanya hissne habr perezida tchad kandi inshuti bwana dby hamwe n’amerika gikorwa kitagize kigeraho gushaka guhirika gaddafi harchaoui haftar rimwe yasohoje ubutumwa kandi dby ntiyigeze rimwe amukunda ariko nanone dby yakunda yagarura umutekano majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba libya ariko ako karere ntabwo kari byihutirwa cyane haftar kuko nubwo karimo ibikomoka peteroli mafaranga gatanga shema butegetsi ashishikajwe tripoli hamwe mali niger burkina faso igihugu tchad cyemeza ingenzi kugira igisirikare gikomeye majyepfo ashyira uburengerazuba libya kurinda ako karere kagari kadafite umutekano kakoreshwa kugaba ibitero butaka bwabyo ati mu gihe utwo turere twakoreshwaga n’intagondwa nk’ahantu ho kuruhukira kongera kwisuganyiriza kugurira intwaro hanyuma zikongera gusubira guteza ibyago majyaruguru mali ariko imitwe ikorera sahel irihagije mikorere urubyiruko rwaho rudafite akazi ruyijyamo ku gice kimwe ukubera amakosa ahanini leta zifite intege nke kandi zamunzwe ruswa ako karere ntabwo ukubera libya amasomo afurika yaha
