title: kamonyi bamwe babyeyi bafite abana bafite ikibazo cy’imirire mibi bacumbikiwe bitaro
content: ikigo nderabuzima rukoma giherereye murenge rukoma karere kamonyi gicumbikiye ababyeyi n’abana bafite imirire mibi ikabije kugira babashe kwitabwaho by’umwihariko kuri kigo nderabuzima rukoma hubatswe igikoni batekera bana iyo winjiyemo uhasanga ibiribwa bitandukanye birimo imboga ibijumba ibishyimbo igikoma n’ibindi iki igikoni cyubatswe ababyeyi bigishirizwa uburyo bategura amafunguro y’abana baboinzu bacumbikiwemo uwiduhaye jeannette kagali mwirute afite umwana mutuku avuga yabitewe n’ubukene kujya gushakisha amafaranga bigatuma umwana arya igihe kidakwiriye aganira kigali post yagize atiubu ndabona ntakibazo umwana yiyongera twabyakiriye neza nanjye nimpava nzamukurikirana kuburyo atazongera gusubira inyuma kuko nabonye agaciro kabyo yongeraho umwana twamusigaga tukagenda akageza saa sita atararya ariko kubera umuntu amwitayeho amwicaye iruhande ubona hari kwiyongeraho ingamba mfite gukurikirana umwana nzajya ndeba ukuntu namukurikirana byihariye ntabwo nzongera title: chorale adepr namur yasohoye indirimbo mu bwihisho’ itanga ihumure
content: kolari chorale adepr namur igizwe n’abanyarwanda n’abarundi bubiligi yashyize hanze amashusho y’indirimbo mbere bise mu bwihisho’ itanga ihumure bantu kubera icyorezo covid- indirimbi mu bwihisho’ ije gihe isi ihanganye coronavirus abaririmba ndirimbo bashimira imana uburyo yabarinze bakabasha kubona ubwihisho bihe bigoye hari baririmba bagira bati waduhaye amahoro yawe mana udukiza ubwoba bw’ibiteye ubwoba ibitero by’umubi wabitesheje agaciro abantu igihumbi baragwa turacyira usumba byose twagize ubuturo ihema ryawe kibi cyatugezeho jean pierre ndayisenga ureberera inyungu z’iriya chorale yabwiye umuseke amagambo ndirimbo akubiye gitabo zaburi igice ati ikaba zaburi ihumuriza kandi ivuga ukuntu uwiteka arinda abantu bakaba amahoro bihura kandi neza n’ibihe turimo dukeneye ihumure riva mana niba turiho si imbaraga zacu uwiteka yarahabaye akwiye kubishimirwa yaraturinze kandi yatubereye ubwihisho akomeza avuga bifuza umunsi umwe baza gutaramira rwanda gusa nyuma y’uko isi yaba yongeye kuba nyabagerwanda ati igihe bizaba bishoboka cyorezo covid gicika tuzicara nk’abaririmbyi tubiganireho kuko buri wese yifuza kugaruka rugo namur chorale ishinzwe vuba imaze imyaka ibiri gusa ikora umurimo w’ivugabutumwa ibinyuze ndirimbo igizwe n’abaririmbyi ikaba ikorera bubiligi mujyi namur murwa mukuru wallonie igice cy’u bubiligi gikoresha igifaransa iriya chorale irateganya kandi gushyira hanze indirimbo kabiri shya yitwa yego’ minsi mike imbere jean paul mugabeumusekerw

title: miliyoni z’amadolari zigiye gushorwa mushinga kwita bidukikije i gicumbi
content: umushinga wiswe uwa gicumbi green gicumbi project uzamara imyaka itandatu uhereye ukwakira ukora ibikorwa kwita bidukikije karere gicumbi arenga miliyoni miliyoni azakoreshwa mushinga wose azajya bikorwa kubungabunga ibishanga inkengero z’imigezi n’ibindi bikorwa byerekeye ubuhinzi umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’akarere gicumbi epimaque mpayimana avuga kubera imiterere y’ako karere imvura igira ingaruka zikomeye buhinzi kubera imisozi itarwanyijeho isuri ati twe tugira umwihariko kuko imisozi miremire ahantu hari imisozi miremire cyane cyane itarwanyijeho isuri duhura n’imyuzure isuri imihanda ikangirika ibiraro bigacika n’amazi menshi ingaruka by’ukuri nyinshi ugereranyije tundi turere imyaka kumanurwa n’isuri abaturage bagahinga ariko bamara gutera isuri ikaza ikabitwara avuga by’ibanze mushinga uzabafasha ugutunganya imisozi ihanamye agira mu buryo bw’ikubitiro azabanza kujya kudufasha gutunganya imisozi ihanamye ukuvuga utunganyije misozi mirima bishanga yajyaga itwikirwa n’isuri uba ukoze buryo itakwangirika ibihinzwemo uba ufite icyizere kuko wahinze ushobora kweza suri ibitwaye ni umushinga ashimangira uziye igihe kuburyo n’abaturage bitezweho kugaragaza ubufatanye bikorwa byawo mu mwaka w’ingengo y’imari ushize akarere gicumbi kabashije gutunganya hegitari z’amaterasi y’indinganire icyakora n’ubundi kugeza hari imisozi itarakorerwaho ubuhinzi kubera imiterere yayo amaterasi namara kugera misozi bizaba byongereye ubutaka buhingwa n’umusaruro uva buhinzi ukaziyongere nkuko mpayimana abisobanura agira ni ukuvuga tubonye izindi hegitari ziyongera zirwanyijeho isuri ziriho amaterasi y’indinganire byukuri kiba igisubizo kirambye baturage bacu kubera ubutaka guhinga buba bwiyongeye hari ahantu imisozi ihanamye kuburyo udashobora gukoreraho imirimo y’ubuhinzi ngubu iyo ukoze amaterasi uba wongeye ubuso buhingwa kandi kongera ubuso buhingwa bisobanuye uba wongereye umusaruro imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare rwanda yerekena karere gicumbi amaterasi buso bungana hegitari ubutaka burwanyijeho isuri rusange bungana uyu mushinga wanyujijwe kigega cyita bidukikije n’imihindagurikire y’ibihe rwanda fonerwa umuyobozi w’icyo kigega hubert ruzibiza avuga uzita bindi bikorwa bireba imibereho y’abatuye gicumbi ndetse gutera ibiti ikindi kandi ukazafatwa nk’icyitegererezo kwigiraho kuburyo wazakomereza tundi turere tw’igihugu ati uyu mushinga gicumbi dufatanyije n’ikigega cy’isi cyita bidukikije twafatanyije gushyira amafaranga gicumbi tumaze kubona ibibazo yanyuzemo cyane cyane bireba ibidukikije dushaka kuzamura ubuzima bw’abaturage kureba babaho rusange gutera ibiti icyiciro mbere tuzayifata nk’icyitegererezo gutuma ukomereza tundi duce tw’u rwanda imibare y’ikigo cy’ibarurishamibare rwanda y’igihembwe cy’ihinga -b yerekana buryo kurwanya isuri gicumbi ifite amaterasi y’indinganire kigero y’ubutaka bwahinzwe gihembwe ahateye ibiti n’imiringoti mu buhinzi akarere gicumbi kibanda bishyimbo bishingirirwa ingano ibirayi ibigori n’imyumbati butaka buhujwe burenga hegitari bahinga kawa buso bungana hegitari n’icyayi buso bungana hegitari

title: ko inkuba zikomeje gutwara ubuzima bw’abantu wakora uzirinde

nk’inkuba n’imirabyo ibi nibyo bikomeretsa cyangwa bikica bihuye nyamara nubwo ibiza bidateguza hari uburyo twakwitwara kugira tugabanye ubukana n’ingaruka bishobora kutugiraho mu gihe hagwa imvura ivanze n’inkuba n’imirabyo abaturage barasabwa bikurukira kwirinda kugama munsi y’igiti kiri cyonyine ahantu hari amazu telefoni rusange ndetse misozi hejuru kuko byose byagira uruhare gukubitwa n’inkuba kwirinda gukorakora gutwara ibintu bizwiho gutwara umuriro vuba ukuvuga ibyuma binyuranye nk’amakanya umutaka ferabeto n’ibindi gihe byuma bisumba umutwe w’ubitwaye igihe modoka ibuka gufunga ibirahure byose kwirinda gukorakora gushyira intoki madirishya arimo ibyuma giriyaje kwirinda kuba cyangwa gukorakora ahantu hari senyenge cyangwa se ibindi bikoresho bikoze byuma niba wumvise inkuba ishyamba ibyiza ukuguma hagati ukirinda kujya nkengero zaryo kwirinda koga kuguma cyangwa kugenda mazi gihe cy’inkuba abana bakunda gukinira bidendezi by’amazi bakabyirinda ndetse n’abandi mukirinda gihe utizeye neza inyubako yawe ifite akarindankuba paratonerre kwirinda kuryama hasi butaka kuko byakurura gukubitwa n’inkuba niba igare cyangwa moto ibyiza ukubivaho kuko bishobora gutuma inkuba title: itorero angilikani ry’ u rwanda riri gushaka miliyoni gushyigikira diyosezi nshya karongi
content: iri torero ryagaragaje rikeneye nibura miliyoni frw gushyigikira imirimo y’iyo diyosezi nshya gihe cy’imyaka itatu kugira nayo itangire kwibeshaho kuri gatandatu iryo torero ryatangije ubukangurambaga bwiswe km walking challenge in suppot of karongi missionary diocese’ rugendo rw’ibirometero abarwitabiriye bagiye n’amaguru guhera i nyanza karere kicukiro kugera i nyamata karere bugesera intego y’urwo rugendo kwari ugukusanya ubushobozi gushyigikira diyosezi nshya karongi izatangizwa tariki gicurasi mwaka ni urugendo rw’amasaha atanu rwatangijwe n’umwepisikopi mukuru w’itorero angilikani ry’u rwanda drlaurent mbanda rukitabirwa n’abakristo b’itorero angilikani iri torero rigaragaza mwaka mbere diyosezi karongi hakenewe byibura frw buri diyosezi angilikani zisanzweho yiyemeje gutanga frw ayo mafaranga azafasha gushaka imodoka y’umwepiskopi umushahara gukodesha inzu gihe diyoseze itaragira inyubako zayo ibikoresho by’ibanze biro gufasha paruwasi n’amakanisa gusana kubaka insengero zitujuje ibisabwa kwigisha guhugura abapasitoro revprof ndikumana viateur umwe bitabiriye urugendo gushakira amikoro diyosezi karongi yagize uru rugendo rwatunejeje urugendo rw’amateka rugaragaza ubumwe gukora umurimo w’imana biratwereka tuzagera kure nidufashanya kandi tugatahiriza umugozi umwe kubaka ubwami bw’imana revrukundo jean pierre methode watowe n’inama y’abepisikopi kuzayobora diyosezi nshya karongi yavuze diyosezi karongi niboneka izafasha gukomeza iyogezabutumwa rikagera benshi yagize iyo diyosezi izunganira abandi basanzwe bakora kariya gace kwamamaza inkuru nziza y’ agakiza yesu kuzana iterambere ryuzuye dore kariya gace nyamasheke rutsiro turi duce tubarizwamo abaturage bakennye kurusha abandi rwanda umwepisikopi mukuru w’itorero angilikani ry’u rwanda drlaurent mbanda yavuze bakeneye inkunga gushyigikira diyosezi nshya karongi gutegura umunsi nyirizina kuyitaha yavuze gatandatu hakusanyijwe miliyoni zirenga enye bakaba bagiye gukomereza zindi diyosezi kugira amafaranga akenewe aboneke diyosezi nshya karongi izaba ifite imbibi z’icyahoze perefegitura kibuye ikaba igizwe paruwase zabarizwaga diyosezi kivu

title: uko wagaragariza umugabo wawe umwishimira
content: iyo umugabo mwashakanye umwishimira ukifuza kubimugaragariza hari uburyo bwinshi ubinyuzamo bamwe batekereza uburyo bwiza ukubibabwira abandi bakabyandika mbuga nkoranyambaga n’ahandi uburyo bwose wakoresha bikuvuye mutima buba bwiza ariko hari ububa bwiza kurushaho butuma umugabo agaciro kuba umwishimira nkuko bitangazwa n’urubuga elcrema gushaka guhinduka abagore bamwe bakoresha uburyo guhindura uburyo bitwaraga rwego kereka abagabo babishimira kandi babubaha gusa none bakabikora bushoshozi buryo badapfa guhinduka bintu byose bashaka gushimisha abagabo kwitangira urugo kugirango ibitagenda bigende neza rimwe rimwe kugaragariza umugabo wawe umwishimira kandi bikamugera mutima bisaba kwitanga ni cyimwe kwiyemeza guhinduka ariko ukaba uziko ugambiriye gusigasira urukundo rwanyu niba wumva wishimiye umugabo wawe ntuzatinye kwitanga kintu cyose cyatuma urukundo rwanyu rusagamba kwiyitaho ukurikije umugabo wawe akunda uburyo wiyitaho wisiga wambara ubikora ugambiriye gushimisha umugabo wawe kuruta wowe kwishimisha bituma umugabo yumva umuha agaciro kandi ukamwishimira uzasanga ahanini abagore n’abagabo bapfa uburyo bw’imyambarire n’imisokoreze kuko umwe ashaka kubikor auko atabishaka ntibivuze uzabikora buri munsi kuko ukeneye kugira uwmanya gukora ukunda ariko mugiye nko gusura ababyeyi cyangwa se musohokanye ukamuha umwanya kuguhitiramo akunda kukubonamo wambaye bizamushimisha kurushaho kugisha inama umugabo wawe mbere gufata icyemezo runaka iyo ugisha inama umugabo wawe mber eyo gufata icyemezo bimugaragariza wishimiye kuba kumwe u buzima bwawe bwose ariko niyo byaba kantu gato ufasheho umwanzuro utabanje kumugisha inama gihe bimugaragariza mutari cyerecyezo kimwe guhora ushaka icyamushimisha umugore uha agaciro umugabo kandi akumva yishimye kuba kumwe uzasanga ahora ashaka icyumunezeza amenya umugabo yanga akabigendera kure yakosa agasaba imbabazi kwihagararaho kumushyigikira bitekerezo bikorwa ni byiza wishimira umugabo wawe akora umugaragariz ako umushyigikiye haba bitecyerezo akora abantu banga babasenya ariko bigeze bagabo biba akarusho niyo waba ubona igitecyerezo umugabo wawe afite utagishyigikiye ujye ubinyuza bundi buryo butamwereka umusenye kumushimira jya ukunda gushimira umugabo wawe kintu runaka yakoze gifite ingaruka nziza rukundo rwanyu muryango mur rusange usibye kuba bizamwereka umwishimira bizanatuma arushaho gukora neza kuko uzirikana akora ukabimushimira ntugatinye kubigaragaza ibi nibyo abantu benshi bakora bashaka kugargariza abagabo babishimiye ariko byuzuzanya n’izindi ngingo twavuzeho mbere aha niho ushobora kubigaragaza bantu mbuga nkoranyambaga kubimubwira kuganira n’ubundi buryo butuma ahita abyumva cyangwa se akabibona bitanyuze bindi bikorwa ruhande niba ukunda umugabo wawe ukaba wumva wishimiye kuba mubana nk’umugore n’umugabo bumwe buryo wakoresha kugaragariza umugabo wawe umwishimira bikaba byatuma arushaho kugukunda kukwiyumvamo

title: inzira z’ubukerarugendo gakondo zitezweho gukuba kabiri umubare w’abasura i nyanza
content: byatangajwe gatandatu muganda rusange hakozwe ibikorwa by’isuku nzira iherereye murenge busasamana hasobanuwe nzira ziswe the nyanza cultural trials’ eshatu zitandukanye ariko zuzuzanya iya mbere yitwa royal trail’ ifite kilometero izenguruka umujyi nyanza igakikiza ingoro z’umurage ebyiri zihari ingoro y’abami rukari n’ingoro y’umurage kwigira iherereye rwesero ahahoze hatuye umwami mutara iii rudahigwa iyo nzira kandi izanyura ahari ibindi byiza biranga amateka y’u rwanda karere nyanza nk’umusezero w’abami i mwima hatabarijwe umwami mutara iii rudahigwa tariki nyakanga umwami kigeli v watabarijwe mutarama ndetse n’umwamikazi gicanda rosalie wahatabarijwe tariki mata inzira kabiri yitwa big view’ y’ibirometero umunani ituruka mujyi nyanza ikagera musozi remera iyo musozi remera uba ushobora kureba ntera y’umurambararo kilometero ubasha kureba imisozi itandukanye ikikije nyanza ndetse waterera amaso kure ukaba wabona ibindi bice by’u rwanda birimo n’ibirunga biri majyaruguru y’igihugu inzira gatatu yitwa gatagara trail’ y’ibiromtero ituruka mujyi nyanza ikagenda ikikiza ibishanga ikagera i gatagara ahari ibikorwa by’ububumbyi biteye imbere ndetse n’ikigo cyita bafite ubumuga izo nzira zose eshatu zifite umwihariko w’uko utuyira twa kinyarwanda tunyura misozi ibibaya abantu batunyuramo bagenda bareba ahantu hateye indabyo ahahinze imyaka itandukanye ahatuwe urutoki n’ibindi byiza bitandukanye bihaboneka umuyobozi mukuru w’ingoro z’igihugu z’umurage w’u rwanda amb masozera robert yavuze nzira ziyongera bindi byiza biranga amateka karere nyanza bigatuma mukerarugendo bahasura biyongera ati twazanye ubundi bwoko bw’ubukerarugendo bushingiye kugenda n’amaguru baciye nzira gakondo kinyarwanda ni ukuvuga bantu nibajya baza kugira bamare amasaha abiri nibura bazajya bamara iminsi itatu cyangwa barenzeho kandi batinda bituzanira inyungu kudusigira amafaranga amb masozera yashimiye abaturage bitabiriye umuganda rusange gukora isuku nzira abararikira kuzaza kuzitaha mugaragaro tariki ukuboza ati ni igikorwa gikomeye cyane kizatuma hano i nyanza cyifuzo mwari mufite cy’uko haba igicumbi cy’umuco kiba impamo dutekereza nzira zizatuma abantu basura nyanza bava bihumbi nibura bakagera bihumbi mwaka amb masozera yasobanuye inzobere bijyanye n’ubwo bukerarugendo zimaze iminsi zisura nzira nako zitanga amanota hakaba hari icyizere zizaza mbere nziza ziri isi muri nzira bagiye bashyiraho ibyapa byerekana ibyerekezo ariko abazajya bazinyuramo hari bazajya bakenera ababasobanurira amateka y’uduce dutandukanye duhari umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu karere nyanza kajyambere patrick yasabye abaturage kwirinda kongera kumena imyanda y’izo nzira yabibukije bagomba kugira isuku byose buri rugo rukagira kujugunya imyanda habugenewe ntibongere kuyishyira babonye ati nahoze mbona umwanda hano nzira umuntu arava rugo akaza kumena ibishingwe hano cyangwa akagajugunya ibishishwa by’ibitoki kubera atumvaga agaciro k’iyi nzira bamwe baturage karere nyanza bawiye igihe nyuma kumenya agaciro k’izo nzira bagiye kuzitaho buryo hatazongera kugaragara umwanda mukankunzi jeannette twishimiye ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo bikomeje kwiyongera hano iwacu nzira ntabwo zizongera kugaragaramo umwanda kuko buri wese agiye kuba ijisho mugenzi buryo muntu uzongera kuza kuhamena imyanda kalisa jmv yavuze bishimiye ubusobanuro bahawe bijyanye n’izo nzira kandi yumvise bizagirira akamaro akarere kabo nyanza akarere nyanza kabumbatiye amateka menshi yiganjemo hambere kuko nyanza yabaye umurwa mukuru w’ubwami kugeza i nyanza hahoze umurwa w’ubwami kuko hatuwe n’abami bane kigeli iv rwabugiri utuye misozi mwima mushirarungu yuhi iv musinga watuye i mwima gakenyeri mutara iii rudahigwa watuye rukali ndetse n’umwami kigeli v ndahindurwa watuye i busasamana muri nyanza kandi haboneka amariba mutende yafukuwe ngoma y’umwami mutara iii rudahigwa inyambo ze ndetse n’inka z’abaturage ziturutse imihanda zashokaga hari kandi icyuzi nyamagana cyafukujwe n’umwami mutara iii rudahigwa afatanyije n’agoronome w’umubiligi witwaga dubois i nyanza kandi hafatwa nk’igicumbi cy’ubutabera kuko hahoze urukiko umwami yaciragamo imanza content: kubakira byiza mateka y’u rwanda kugira uruhare kubungabunga umutekano hatangwa amakuru gihe muntu wese wahungabanya umutekano bimwe byagarutsweho mahugurwa yateguwe komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe agenewe inkeragutabara n’abafasha yabereye biro by’akarere gakenke ukwakira afungura mahugurwa umuyobozi komisiyo gusubiza buzima busanzwe abahoze rugamba ntara y’amajyaruguru madamu niyonteze clemence yasabye abitabiriye mahugurwa kuyakurikirana neza kuko ingirakamaro mibereho n’abaturanyi yakomeje avuga mahugurwa agamije guhugura cyane cyane abagore b’inkeragutabara bagahugukirwa gahunda leta dore batigeze bahugurwa bagaruka rwababyaye ndetse kumenya ibibazo bafite bwana safali wilson watanze ikiganiro mateka y’u rwanda mahugurwa yasobanuriye abitariye amahugurwa imvano y’amateka yateye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abazungu banditse kandi bakigisha amateka y’u rwanda bayagoreka nkana kugira bacemo ibice abanyarwanda babashe kubategeka bise cyongereza divide and rule by’umwihariko ababiligi banditse amateka y’abanyarwanda bagendeye mateka y’amacakubiri gihugu cyabo hagati y’abafurama flamands n’abawaru wallons dore iwabo byacikaga hagati yayo moko title: imikino shampiyona liverpool idatsindwa yasojwe watford
content: icyizere liverpool gukomeza kudatsindwa mwaka wose w’imikino cyaraye gisojwe neza watford yarubiye kibuga cyayo vicarage road ismala sarr umukinnyi watford ukina ruhande ukomoka sngal yatsinze bibiri kapiteni troy deeney watford ashyiramo icya gatatu gice kabiri kiryoheye ijisho cy’umukino akagozi k’intsinzi liverpool kayicikanye mbere y’uwo mukino w’ejo gatandatu liverpool yaratsinze imikino iheruka ndetse iza gutsinda mukino watford kuba yanditse amateka kuba ikipe mbere premier league imaze igihe kirekire itsinda ariko ntiyari gukoraho watford yateye umupira unogeye ijisho ntangiriro y’uwo mukino kugeza urangiye ndetse yahise iva cyiciro cy’amakipe ashobora kumanuka ava premier league intsinzi watford ntabwo igiye gukoma nkokora kuba liverpool izatwara igikombe shampiyona kuko irusha manchester city kabiri amanota ariko ntibibujije yabaye intsinzi itari yitezwe kandi watford itazibagirwa mateka benshi bagiye kibuga vicarage road biteze kubona liverpool yandika amateka kumara imikino yikurikiranya idatsindwa shampiyona mu by’ukuri byari byitezwe n’ikimenyimenyi banyamakuru ibyangombwa gutara amakuru mukino byari byasabwe birenze urugero ibitangazamakuru bibarirwa magana byiteguye gutara kuba ibaye inkuru yanditse amateka mupira w’amaguru w’ubwongereza ariko watford ifite ikindi kiyiraje ishinga abatoza bavuze nigel pearson umutoza watford yagize ni intsinzi y’ingenzi twe kugeza mwaka w’imikino waratugoye cyane dutsindwa cyumweru gishize ndetse kudakina neza twashakaga kwisubiraho liverpool ni ikipe nziza cyane byadusabye kwitwara neza - buryo bushoboka bwose - kandi ntekereza twari dukwiye intsinzi iyo twabaga dufashe umupira twatezaga ibibazo kandi tukarinda izamu n’ubwitonzi ingufu n’umuhate ubwo butumwa nakomeje gutanga bakinnyi munsi mbere ni ibintu dushoboye kandi tugomba kujya twitwara neza kuriya buri cyumweru naho umutoza jurgen klopp liverpool yagize bakoze neza neza bashakaga gukora uko umupira w’amaguru uteye ugomba kubyakira ntabwo byoroshye cyane ariko gihamya yuko tutari tumeze neza bihagije iteka biba bigoye kubyakira niyomugabo albert muhaburarw

title: umunyeshuri kaminuza y’u rwanda gukora indege itagira umupilote
content: nteziryayo olivier ahamya inzozi afite akiri umwana gukora indege yatangiye kuzikabya kuko yabonye ubumenyi buzamufasha kuyikora uyu munyeshuri wiga kaminuza y’u rwanda ur koleji y’ubumenyi n’ikoranabuhanga atangaza gihe yatangiye gukora indege nto itagira umupilote izwi izina ’drone’ nteziryayo w’imyaka uvuka karere rwamagana wiga mwaka kabiri ishami ry’ibijyanye n’iby’ingufu mechanical engineering and energy yabwiye kigali today dukesha nkuru inzozi gukora indege yazigize afite imyaka umunani y’amavuko agira igitekerezo gukora indege cyatangiye bwana gihe ngakora imodoka ariko nkumva sinyuzwe aho ngereye kaminuza nibwo nashatse gukabya nzozi nkora indege nto idagira umupilote akomeza avuga mwaka mbere kaminuza yakoze indege nto itagira umupilote iraguruka ariko kubera hari yaburagaho byatumye atangira umushinga gukora indi iteye imbere ikoranabuhanga ariyo gukora ibyo byose abifashwamo n’abafatanyabikorwa yagejejeho umushinga barimo ikigo kitwa fab lab gikorera rwanda abo nibo bamufasha kubona ibikoresho byose akoresha drone ubundi bumenyi gukora ndege akabubona yifashishije interineti ibikoresho bimwe yifashisha harimo ibikarito amadebe dinamo n’ibindi nteziryayo ahamya ndege itagira umupilote gukora azayimurika mpera z’umwaka ati mbere ntangira gukora iriya ndege nto naje kongera nkavugurura baterankunga nari mfite kandi narayikoze mbigeraho akomeza agira ubu mfite abaterankunga kandi nizeye neza inzozi zanjye zizaba impamo ngakora indege nagambiriye bwana bwanjye dusabe miriam umuyobozi mukuru w’ikigo fab lab gikorera rwanda nacyo gikurikiranira musore avuga bafasha ababagana bafite imishinga y’ikoranabuhanga agira kugeza dufite imishinga ubona ifatika tuyitera inkunga y’ibikoresho ndetse tukabashakira n’abantu b’impuguke kugira bazagere kubyo bashaka batagize ikibazo cy’ubuhsobozi buke drone gukora igeze aracyashyiraho ibikoresho bimwe bikoresho azashyira drone iyo drone yakoze mbere

title: basketball kipe izajya irenza abanyamahanga babiri kibuga shampiyona
content: iryo tegeko n’ubusanzwe ryari ririho ariko ugasanga amakipe amwe n’amwe ataryubahiriza ariko shampiyona y’uyu mwaka ikipe itazabyubahiriza izafatirwa ibihani nk’uko twabitangarijwe n’umunyamabanga mukuru ferwaba richard mutabazi mutabazi yagize mu nama twakoze twagarutse cyane mategeko agenga abakinnyi b’abanyamahanga rwanda twasanze byiza twakemerera abanyamahanga babiri gusa aribo bazajya bajya rupapuro rw’umukino w’umunsi rwego kongerera abanyarwanda umwanya gukina ikindi cyibanzweho bijyanye n’abakinnyi b’abanyamahanga umunyamahanga uzaba amaze imyaka itanu akina shampiyona y’u rwanda yindi kipe hanze y’u rwanda arakinamo azajya yemererwa gukina nk’umunyarwanda abakinnyi b’abanyamahanga bakinira ikipe y’igihugu barahawe pasiporo nyarwanda nabo bazajya bakina shampiyona bitwa abanyarwanda ishyirahamwe ry’umukino basketball rwanda ryakunze gutungwa agatoki rikunze kwemera gukinisha abakinnyi benshi b’abanyamahanga ndetse benshi bagashyirwa ikipe y’igihugu nyuma kubona musaruro urambye byatanze ikipe y’igihugu ferwaba bufatanye minisiteri siporo yatangije gahunda guha amahirwe abakinnyi b’abanyarwanda bahereye bana hashyizweho ikipe y’igihugu y’abatarengeje imyaka ndetse hari gahunda gushinga ibigo hirya hino turere bizajya bikusanyirizwamo abana bafite impano basketball abatoza bakabafasha kuzamuka theoneste nisingizwe

title: urubyiruko rurakangurirwa kugira uruhare rugaragara gahunda z’icyunamo

title: bugesera umurego kurwanya ibiyobyabwenge
content: ibi baturage babitangaje cyumweru polisi y’igihugu bufatanye n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere bagiye kariya gace guta yombi abaturage bacuruza ibinyobwa bitemewe n’amategeko abaturage batuye aka gace mirambi bavuga gakunda kugaragaramo ikibazo cy’umutekano muke bikururwa n’ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ubujura n’icuruzwa ry’ibiyobyabwenge kanyanga irimo cyane mezi abiri ashije hiciwe abantu babiri karemera sam umuyobozi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba witabiriye igikorwa guta yombi abaturage bakoze uruganda gucuruza kanyanga kariya gace yatangarije abaturage gihe kitari gito polisi igiye gushyira bikorwa icyifuzo cyabo gufungura ishami ryayo aka gace icyakora ariko karemera yababwiye icyihutirwa kurusha ibindi ukugira ubushake gufatanya n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere guhangana n’ibikorwa bibahungabanyiriza umutekano rwagaju louis umuyobozi w’akarere bugesera kubufatanye n’abari bahagarariye inzego z’umutekano bitabiriye gikorwa yabwiye abaturage bagomba kwirinda ibikorwa gucuruza kanyanga n’ibindi biyobyabwenge byose kuko nyir’abayazana w’umutekano muke karere bugesera rwagaju kandi yavuze ubuyobozi bw’akarere bwari busanzwe buzi ibihakorerwa icyari gisigaye ukuza guta yombi abacurizi kanyangaati’’twari tubizi icyari gisigaye cyari umwanya kuza kubafata iyo uhamwe n’icyaha gucuruza kanyanga inzoga itemewe n’amategeko y’u rwanda uhanishwa igihano cy’igifungo kiri hagati y’amezi atatu n’imyaka itanu cyangwa ihazabu y’amafaranga ibihumbi byaba ngombwa ukabihanishwa byombi mimi rachel mukandayisenga

title: minisitiri w’intebe arashima abikorera rusizi bagiye kuzuza inzu y’amagorofa ane
content: nubwo nzu kijyambere y’ubucuruzi rusizi rusizi commercial complex yenda kuzura minisitiri w’intebe yashyize itafari ry’ifatizo ry’ikimenyetso gutangiza kuyubaka mugaragaro mugoroba tariki minisitiri w’intebe yagize kugera gikorwa nk’iki kizatwara miliyari ebyiri z’amafaranga y’u rwanda nkunga hanze mwatse bitanga icyizere cy’ejo hazaza h’abanyarwanda ibi ukwihesha agaciro nk’uko umukuru w’igihugu akunda kubivuga ubuyobozi bw’ihuriro ry’abashoramari karere rusizi rusizi investment corporation bwasabye ubuyobozi leta kuba abikorera kugira bajye basoza inshingano bihaye ukuriye rusizi investment corporation kalisa jeremie yasabye minisitiri w’intebe kugeza ubutumwa bw’abagize iryo huriro mukuru w’igihugu kuzaza gutaha inzu niyuzura minisitiri w’intebe yijeje ubuvugizi n’ubufasha bishoboka bikorera giti cyabo karere rusizi yavuze gukorana n’abikorera giti cyabo biri gahunda guverinoma kandi imishinga nk’iyi guverinoma iyishyigikiye ihuriro ry’abashoramari karere rusizi rigizwe n’abanyamuryango rifite imari shingiro igera miliyari jean baptiste micomyiza

title: afurika ntizatakaze amahirwe ifite kagame
content: perezida paul kagame avuga igihe kigeze umugabane w’afurika usobanukirwe neza imbaraga ndetse n’amahirwe ufite asaba ibihugu by’afurika umugabane wabo utakomeza gutakaza amahirwe ufite ibyo perezida paul kagame yabivugiye i kigali cyumweru tariki ukuboza yatangizaga ihuriro ryiswe kusi ideas festival’’ ryateguwe n’u rwanda bufatanye n’ikigo nation media group kenya kizobereye bijyanye n’itangazamakuru iki kiganiro kitabiriwe bamwe bakuru b’ibihugu barimo umukuru w’igihugu kongo flix antoine tshisekedi uwahoze minisitiri w’intebe kenya raila odinga perezida komisiyo au moussa faki mahamat n’abandi bahanga isi ihuriro kusi ideas festival ribaye nshuro mbere ryiga hazaza h’afurika myaka imbere nkuko bikubiye nsanganyamatsiko y’iyo nama y’iminsi ibiri ihuje abasaga baturutse mugabane w’afurika n’ahandi isi mu butumwa bwe perezida kagame yagarutse bikenewe gukorwa n’ibihugu by’afurika birimo ubufatanye kugira isoko rusange ibihugu by’afurika biherutse kwiyemeza gushyiraho rikore neza yibutsa ibihugu bishyize umukono ishyirwaho ry’iryo soko hari ibyiza bimaze gukorwa nubwo asanga hari ibigikenewe gukorwa ati tugomba kumenya nk’abanyafurika twifitemo imbaraga n’amahiwe tutagomba gutakaza hari byinshi bihari tugomba kubakiraho byatangiye kandi biragenda neza bimwe byakozwe byashobotse kubera itsinda ry’impuguke ryafashije mavugurura y’afurika yunze ubumwe isinywa ry’amasezerano ashyiraho isoko rusange yakomeje agira hari bivuze byinshi birebana gucuruzanya hagati y’ibihugu by’afurika ukwihuza hagati y’ibihugu kugira kwezi nyakanga umwaka utaha gihe rizaba ryatangiye hazagire intambwe afurika itera nubwo ikiri inyuma ugereranyije n’ibindi bihugu byateye imbere ubwo abanyafurika bahisemo hagiye kugira igikoreka nubwo hakiri ibikenewe gukorwa ariko hari umusingi mwiza kubakiraho abantu batangiye perezida repubulika iharanira demokarasi flix tshisekedi yizeza azakomeza gufatanya n’ibindi bihugu bazamure imbaraga z’urubyiruko rw’afurika ndetse gukangurira abanyekongo bindi bihugu diaspora gutanga umusanzu guteza imbere igihugu cyabo ati ni koko indoto zange ziri bushobozi bw’uburenganzira muntu ndabizi neza urubyiruko bukungu natwe gihugu cyacu dufite kandi ubushobozi bwabo bwatuma afurika itera imbere kandi tuzakomeza guteza imbere uburenganzira kwishyira ukizana ukwishyira hamwe uburenganzira guhanga imirimo n’ibindi umuyobozi mukuru ikigo nmg wilfred kiboro butumwa yohereje bwasomwe azim yibanze ntambwe ikomeye u rwanda rwagezeho gihe gito birebana guha ubushobozi abagore asanga myaka gusa ishize u rwanda rutangiye kwiyubaka ibihugu by’uyu mugabane byagombye kujya biza kwigira rwanda nkuko raila odinga yabigarutseho avuga nubwo kongera ubushobozi abagore biri itegeko nshinga ryabo ribisaba ariko kugeza kirakorwa kubishyira bikorwa naho iterambere ry’afurika raila odinga akaba intumwa yihariye ashinzwe guteza imbere ibikowa remezo avuga igihe kigeze afurika itangire kwandika amateka yayo guharanira kwishyira hamwe ati ugushyirahe hamwe guteza imbere imishinga n’ibikorwa remezo bihari bizateza imbere mugabane nk’ubu hari urugomero rukomeye ruri congo rwitwa inga ruramutse rubyajwe umusaruro zirebana n’imbaraga rufite megawati rwabasha gucanira amashanyarazi umugabane w’afurika wose ihuriro kusi ideas festival ryitabiriwe n’impuguke burezi abacuruzi abanyamakuru n’abandi baganirira hamwe ahazaza h’afurika myaka imbere baganiriye guhanga udushya n’amahirwe afurika ifite byafasha gukemura bimwe bibazo byugarije mugabane nk’ihindagurika ry’ibihe ukwihaza biribwa ubwiyongere bw’abaturage ubushomeri n’ibindi

title: kwibuka abanyarwanda ghana bibutse jenoside urubyiruko rusabwa kwigira mateka
content: ni igikorwa cyabaye mata ghana gikorwa hifashishijwe ikoranabuhanga kubera icyorezo coronavirus ambasaderi w’u rwanda ghana dr aisa kirabo kacyira yavuze gihe abanyarwanda bakomeje kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi umwanya guha icyubahiro abatutsi barenga miliyoni bishwe yavuze n’umwanya guha icyubahiro abarokotse jenoside yakorewe abatutsi uburyo bagize umutima kubabarira nayo moteri y’ubumwe n’ubwiyunge u rwanda rwagezeho yagaragaje byose byashobotse kubera imiyoborere myiza perezida paul kagame dr kacyira yagize ndashimira kandi ingabo zahoze iza fpr-inkotanyi zari ziyobowe perezida kagame zahagaritse jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi gihe umuryango mpuzamahanga wareberaga bakiri bato batanze ubuzima bwabo bahagarike jenoside ntabwo tuzabibagirwa dukomeje kwibuka twakundaga ndetse twibuka ibihe by’umwijima twanyuzemo ariko duharanira ejo heza kandi duharanira jenoside izongera kuba ukundi twarababaye ariko tugomba gukomeza kurwanya ingengabitekerezo jenoside n’ivangura kuko niyo ntandaro jenoside yahamagariye umuryango mpuzamahanga kurwanya ingengabitekerezo gufata ndetse kuburanisha abasize bakoze jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yavuze abanyarwanda bafashe ingamba zikomeye gushyira ubumwe imbere gushyiraho imbere ivangura kuko shingiro ry’iterambere yasabye urubyiruko kwigira mateka bubaka ejo hazaza hezaati turaboba ejo heza bakiri bato bihe turabasaba kubyigiraho kureba imiyoborere myiza ihari kwibuka twavuye ariko ntibatwarwe n’aho twanyuze hejuru y’ibyo bashyire imbere ubumwe kwihesha agaciro buri munyarwanda minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga n’ubutwererane bw’akarere ghana shirley ayorkor botchway yohereje ubutumwa bwihanganisha abanyarwanda kubizeza jenoside itazongera ukundi ati icyubahiro gikomeye twaha inzirakarengane ugushyira hamwe tugaharanira ubunyamaswa nk’ubwo butazongera ukundi lisa princess ikirezi wabuze bamwe muryango jenoside yakorewe abatutsi buhamya bwe yavuze yibuka bishwe jenoside n’ababuze bakundaga yashimiye abarokotse jenoside uburyo bakomeje kwihangana nyuma guhura n’ayo makuba asaba abavutse nyuma jenoside kubigira inshingano guharanira ibyabaye bitazongera kuba ambasaderi colombia ghana claudia turbay quintero witabiriye muhango buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga yavuze igihugu cye cyifatanyije n’u rwanda kwibuka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yagize turaha icyubahiro abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kandi dushimira ubuyobozi bwiza perezida paul kagame wahamagariye abaturage gushyira imbere ubumwe n’ubwiyunge nk’uburyo kuvana igihugu kaga cyari kimaze guhura nako yavuze isomo ryavuye rwanda ryerekana buri gihugu gifite inshingano kubahiriza uburenganzira muntu umuhango kwibuka nshuro jenoside yakorewe abatutsi wakozwe buryo bw’ikoranabuhanga kubera ingamba zafashwe n’icyo gihugu guhashya icyorezo coronavirus kugeza mbere ghana imaze kugira abanduye coronavirus basaga barimo bapfuye

title: allain jupp avuga atahakanye jenoside ahubwo yayemeye kuba
content: jupp avuga mwaka w’ butumwa bw’inteko ishinga amategeko yasobanuye yakoresheje ijambo jenoside kuya gicurasi nama y’abagize akanama k’abaminisitiri b’u burayi yabereye i buruseli bubiligi ikinyamakuru survie dukesha nkuru gitangaza alain jupp yaba yaratangaje nyuma y’uko uwari umunyamabanga mukuru loni gihe boutros boutros ghali yatangaje ibiri kuba rwanda atari ubwicanyi busanzwe ahubwo jenoside iki kinyamakuru gikomeza gitangaza minisitiri jupp yaba yaratangaje gihe jenoside rwanda igeze hagati ikorwa kandi n’igihe cyari gishize kikaba cyari gihe gikomeye cyane kuko aricyo cyishwemo abantu benshi aha bakaba bibaza bitaba ugusubiza ubwenge gihe igihe cyarenze prise de conscience tardive aha bavuga guverinoma y’u bufaransa rwanda gihe jenoside iriho itegurwa kandi ntacyo yakoze ibe yahagarika ubwicanyi bwatangiye tariki mata survie ikomeza ivuga gihe jenoside yakorerwaga abatutsi iriho kuba itariki mata jupp minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u bufaransa hamwe l’lyse ingoro perezida w’u bufaransa bakiriye jrme bicamumpaka minisitiri w’ububanyi n’amahanga w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jean-bosco barayagwiza umurwanashyaka w’ishyaka cdr aha bakaba bavuga icyiswe opration turquoise yazanywe n’ingabo z’abafaransa itariki kamena yafashije abari bamaze gukora jenoside guhungira cyahoze cyitwa zare akaba repubulika iharanira demokarasi congo muri babashije guhungishwa n’abafaransa havugwamo thodore sindikubwabo umukuru w’u rwanda gihe jenoside ndetse jrme bicamumpaka umaze amezi abiri yakiriwe jupp mu gihe cy’uruzinduko mbere perezida kagame yagiriye title: abanyarwanda batuye canada bibutse abazize jenoside yakorewe abatutsi
content: igikorwa kwibuka kitabiriwe kandi n’abahagarariye ibihugu byabo canada n’izindi nshuti uyu muhango watangijwe n’urugendo walk to remember rwatangiriye nteko ishingamategeko canada rugera biro by’umujyi ottawa ahabereye imihango kwibuka nyuma y’indirimbo zubahiriza ibihugu byombi hakurikiyeho umunota kwibuka inzirikarengane zishwe jenoside padiri callixte kabalisa wayoboye isengesho yasabiye abahuye n’ibibazo binyuranye harimo abafashwe ngufu asaba imana gukomeza impfubyi n’abapfakazi n’abandi bagize ibibazo bikomeye uhagarariye u rwanda canada edda mukabagwiza perezida w’ishyirahamwe ry’abacitse kw’icumu rizwi kw’izina humura alain ntwali bagaragaje bibuka amateka jenoside yabaye rwanda bagamije gufata ingamba ibyabaye ntibizongere kuba ukundi nk’uko itangazo ambasade y’u rwanda canada ribivuga berekanye umuhango ukorwa ugamije kwibuka ariko abantu bakanatekereza uburyo gufasha abacitse icumu bagarutse nsanganyamatsiko y’uyu mwaka twigire mateka twubaka ejo hazaza bavuga genoside yakorewe abatutsi mateka y’ubu n’ejo hazaza itazibagirana mu muhango kwibuka kandi hatanzwe ibiganiro bibiri l’historique de l’impunit des crimes haineux au rwanda et les signes avant-coureurs du gnocide contre les tutsis cyatanzwe bwana richard nsanzabaganwa les mots qui tuent cyatanzwe prof philippe basabose nsanzabaganwa yerekanye ubwicanyi bwagiye buba ariko ubutegetsi ntibuhane abakoze ibyaha kwica aha yavuze uduce tunyuranye ubwoko bw’abatutsi bwagiye bwicwa yerekanye kwica byagiye bishyigikirwa n’ubutegetsi kurengera abatutsi babaga bibasiwe prof basabose yerekanye amagambo yagiye akoreshwa rwanda yagize uruhare ishyirwa bikorwa ry’ubwicanyi yakoze isesengura ry’ijambo ryavuzwe leon mugesera i kabaya yakanguriye abanyamuryango mrnd abereka umwanzi wabo umututsi n’abahutu mashyaka ataravugaga rumwe mrnd gahunda ziteganijwe zijyanye kwibuka zizagera kwezi gatanu zirimo amasengesho ikiriyo n’ibiganiro bizatangwa taliki mata abanyarwanda n’inshuti zabo bongeye guhura gitambo misa kwibuka cyabereye paruwasi mutagatifu yozefu gatineau quebec

title: u rwanda rukinguye imiryango bashoramari ngufu z’amashyanyarazi

title: amafoto y’ibirori kigali fashion week byaranzwe n’imyambarire ihebuje
content: ni nshuro karindwi kigali fashion week ibaye nyuma y’izabaye myaka itandatu ishize ibirori by’uyu mwaka byabaye minsi itatu byerekaniwemo imodoka imyambaro isanzwe n’itamenyerewe ndetse n’ibindi bikorwa bitandukanye bigaragaza umwihariko n’intera ibijyanye kumurika imideli bimaze kugeraho rwanda ibirori bisoza byabaye ijoro ryo gatandatu tariki gicurasi byitabiriwe n’abantu b’ingeri zitandukanye barimo abanyamahanga n’abayobozi nzengo nkuru z’igihugu minisitiri w’imicungire y’ibiza n’impunzi seraphine mukantabana waje gushyigikira gikorwa imyiyereko y’abanyamideli n’imyambarire yagaragaye kigali fashion week byanyuze benshi bitabiriye hashimwa cyane uburyo u rwanda rugeze ntera kugirana imikoranire n’abatunganya imideli bakomeye baturuka bihugu hanze uwitwa gatesi yvette bitabiriye birori waganiriye igihe yagize ibirori nabikunze cyane njye nabonye imyambaro ihebuje buryo nanjye nifuza kuyambara ikindi nishimiye kubona abakora imideli hanze baza bakambika abamurika imideli rwanda ibi birori byari biyobowe n’umushyushyarugamba makeda mahedeo byagaragayemo imyiyereko y’abamurika imideli bagera bambitswe n’abayikora barimo n’abaturutse hanze y’u rwanda barindwi kigali fashion week y’uyu mwaka yitabiriwe n’abakora imyuga ijyanye n’imideli bihugu cameroun sudani kenya uganda u buhinde nigeria u bwongereza u bubiligi afurika y’epfo ethiopia u buyapani u burundi n’ahandi inzu z’imideli zirimo ’delphine house of fashion’ ’tanga designs’ ’christa bella’ ’hakym reagan’ ’lupita collection’ ’cynthia rupari’ ’patrick inkanda’ ’fathia’ zimwe zerekanye imyambaro zikora birori byatangijwe mbere rwanda bifite intego kuzamura abanyamideli

content: ibi baturage babitangaje cyumweru polisi y’igihugu bufatanye n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere bagiye kariya gace guta yombi abaturage bacuruza ibinyobwa bitemewe n’amategeko abaturage batuye aka gace mirambi bavuga gakunda kugaragaramo ikibazo cy’umutekano muke bikururwa n’ibibazo bitandukanye birimo ubujura n’icuruzwa ry’ibiyobyabwenge kanyanga irimo cyane mezi abiri ashije hiciwe abantu babiri karemera sam umuyobozi polisi ntara y’iburasirazuba witabiriye igikorwa guta yombi abaturage bakoze uruganda gucuruza kanyanga kariya gace yatangarije abaturage gihe kitari gito polisi igiye gushyira bikorwa icyifuzo cyabo gufungura ishami ryayo aka gace icyakora ariko karemera yababwiye icyihutirwa kurusha ibindi ukugira ubushake gufatanya n’ubuyobozi bw’akarere guhangana n’ibikorwa bibahungabanyiriza umutekano rwagaju louis umuyobozi w’akarere bugesera kubufatanye n’abari bahagarariye inzego z’umutekano bitabiriye gikorwa yabwiye abaturage bagomba kwirinda ibikorwa gucuruza kanyanga n’ibindi biyobyabwenge byose kuko nyir’abayazana w’umutekano muke karere bugesera rwagaju kandi yavuze ubuyobozi bw’akarere bwari busanzwe buzi ibihakorerwa icyari gisigaye ukuza guta yombi abacurizi kanyangaati’’twari tubizi icyari gisigaye cyari umwanya kuza kubafata iyo uhamwe n’icyaha gucuruza kanyanga inzoga itemewe n’amategeko y’u rwanda uhanishwa igihano cy’igifungo kiri hagati y’amezi atatu n’imyaka itanu cyangwa ihazabu y’amafaranga ibihumbi byaba ngombwa ukabihanishwa byombi mimi rachel mukandayisenga

content: pasteur antoine rutayisire arakebura bamwe bakirisito binubira zimwe ngamba zafashwe gihugu zigamije gukumira icyorezo koronavirusi covid- harimo gufunga amateraniro y’abantu benshi basenga ntidutinya urupfu ndamusubiza nti ariko utarutinya wirugemurira abarutinya wowe rwigumanire ariko kugenda ukwirakwiza indwara ashimira ubuyobozi bw’igihugu cy’u rwanda uburyo buri kwita babanyarwanda title: abanyabugeni b’abagore bahawe umwihariko kwizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga w’ingoro ndangamurage
content: buri mwaka tariki gicurasi isi yizihiza umunsi mpuzamahanga wahariwe ingoro ndangamurage hazirikanwa umuco amateka n’imibereho gakondo by’abatuye isi u rwanda narwo rwifatanya n’amahanga kwizihiza munsi ushimangira agaciro guhererekanya amateka guteza imbere umuco ufatwa nk’umusingi w’imibereho y’igihugu urwa gasabo rubarizwa muryango mpuzamahanga w’ingoro ndangamurage icom uhuriyemo abanyamuryango basaga bakora ngoro ndangamurage bihugu muri mwaka munsi wahawe insanganyamatsiko ivuga kugira ingoro ndangamurage zigamije uburinganire ubudasa kudaheza’’ kuri nshuro gikorwa cyateguwe title: udukingirizo dusaga miliyoni eshatu twiganjemo utw’abagore tuzakwirakwizwa rwanda
content: ni itangazo ryatanzwe gihe u rwanda rwakiriye inama mpuzamahanga yiga cyorezo sida n’indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina afurika icasa iyi nama kuba nshuro yatangiye ukuboza izasozwa ukuboza buri mwaka udukingirizo turenga miliyoni dukwirakwizwa rwanda bigizwemo uruhare guverinoma n’indi miryango y’ubuzima muri two miliyoni zigurishwa maduka miliyoni eshanu zigakoreshwa bajyanama b’ubuzima n’amavuriro miliyoni n’igice tugafatirwa tuzu twabugenewe dutangirwa ubuntu ahf isanzwe itanga udukingirizo miliyoni eshatu buri mwaka yavuze izatwongera ndetse mwaka utaha izaha umwihariko utw’abagore umuyobozi ahf rwanda dr brenda asiimwe kateera yabwiye kt press muri mwaka twarengeje intego yacu gutanga udukingirizo miliyoni eshatu twahisemo kongera umubare w’udukingirizo by’umwihariko twibanda tw’abagore kuko aritwo tubura gihugu’’ ahf itangaza ubwitabire bw’abagabo bagura udukingirizo bugera gihe abagore ubushakashatsi kaminuza y’u rwanda bwasanze impamvu mbere ituma udukingirizo tw’abagore tudakoreshwa cyane iterwa n’uko tugira urusaku igihe cy’imibonano mpuzabitsina ndetse kugakoresha bisaba kugafata buryo ukarekuye gashobora kumuhera gitsina icyemezo kongera udukingirizo ahf yagifashe nyuma yuko nyakanga urubyiruko rwihariye umubare munini w’abafashe udukingirizo imurikagurisha mpuzamahanga ryabereye i gikondo ryitabiriwe n’abasaga mu byumweru bibiri ryamaze urubyiruko rwafataga udukingirizo turenga buri munsi gihe hari hateganyijwe udupaki mu kongera uburyo bw’ubwirinzi sida ahf yafunguye ahantu hatanu hatangirwa udukingirizo tw’ubuntu mujyi kigali harimo nyamirambo remera-migina gikondo nyabugogo ubusanzwe udukingirizo tugurishwa frw frw farumasi utubyiniro hoteli nubwo gukoresha agakingirizo bumwe bwirinzi sida imibare igaragaza ubwandu y’imyaka bageze iyo nyigo igaragaza abagore aribo banduye kurusha abagabo abahanga by’ubuzima bagaragaje usibye kuba agakingirizo kifashishwa kurinda inda zitateguwe kanarinda indwara zandurira mibonano mpuzabitsina

title: umuyobozi w’abapolisi unmiss arashima abapolisi b’u rwanda kuba bakora neza akazi
content: ishami loni rishinzwe kubungabunga amahoro sudani y’epfo unmiss ryashimye itsinda ry’abapolisi fpu b’u rwanda gihugu bikorwa kubungabunga amahoro kuba bakora neza akazi kabo gace kitwa malakal kubashimira byabaye basurwaga matariki - ukuboza n’abayobozi unmiss barimo umuyobozi w’abapolisi bihugu biri butumwa bw’amahoro cp fredrick yiga akaba aherekejwe n’umuyobozi ushinzwe ibikorwa unmiss cp emmanuel butera ndetse n’ushinzwe guhuriza hamwe ibikorwa by’amatsinda y’abapolisi fpu eko budiman ndetse n’uyoboye abapolisi bakora akzi kihariye mujyi juba ariwe olivia adiku mu ruzinduko rwabo basuye ibice bitadukanye bareba ibikorwa by’itsinda ry’abapolisi fpu b’u rwanda bakaba barirebeye bamaze kugeraho bageze butumwa umuyobozi w’itsinda ry’abapolisi b’u rwanda fpu acp rogers rutikanga yasobanuriye bayobozi bakora ndetse abereka uduce dutandukanye abapolisi b’ u rwanda bakoreramo dukikije inkambi malakal irimo impunzi cp fredrick yiga yashimiye kandi abandi bapolisi yandi matsinda bindi bihugu kuba bafatanya bagenzi rwanda bityo asaba mikoranire myiza yakomeza bimwe bibazo bamugaragarije ibyerekeranye n’ibikoresho by’akazi byaheze juba mumbasa cp yiga yashimiye abapolisi b’u rwanda kubera gukora cyane bagaragaza n’ubwitange abizeza kuzakemura kibazo cy’ibikoresho buryo bizabageraho gihe kitarambiranye yatemberejwe inkambi malakal yagiye asura ibice bitandukanye harimo abapolisi bakoreraaho bahera impunzi imfashanyo zirimo ibiryo imyenda ibikoresho by’abanyeshuri n’ibindi byinshi nyuma kuzenguruka inkambi cp fresdrick yiga n’abamuherekeje berekeje cyicaro cy’ubutumwa bw’amahoro unmiss yagiranye ikiganiro n’abayobozi batandukanye malakal bakaba barabahaye ibikoresho bitandukanye birimo imyenda n’ibindi yasabye abapolisi gukomeza ubufatanye kubungabunga umutekano neza nkambi cp yiga yakomeje uruzinduko rwe asura umuhuzabikorwa leta upper nile malakal yamusobanuriye bijyanye n’ubufatanye hagati y’ibiro byeabapolisi butumwa ndetse n’itsinda ry’abapolisi b’u rwanda fredrick yiga yagiranye kandi inama n’abapolisi bihugu bitandukanye bakora akazi kihariye unpol ndetse n’abayobozi b’amatsinda y’abapolisi fpu yatangiye abashimira akazi bakora ntara malakalanabasaba gukomeza kugira umurava n’umuhate mwinshi kazi ndetse anaboneraho kubifuriza noheri nziza n’umwaka mushya cp emmanuel butera ijambo rye yashimiye inzego zose polisi ntara malakal kubera umurava n’ubwitange bafite kazi kabo ndetse bagaragaza gukora akazi kinyamwugayanditswe ubwanditsimuhaburarw

title: u rwanda ruratera ntiruterwa- menya inkomoko y’umugani intambara y’ibihugu
content: uwo mugani ufite inkomoko mwami cyilima ii rujugira wategetse ahasaga w kugeza w’ uwo mwami amaze kwima ingoma se yuhi iii mazimpaka abantu benshi bakunda guca imigani miremireiy’imigenurano ndetse n’insigamigani abandi bakibaza inkomoko yayo bikababera urujijo uyumugani ufite inkomoko mwami cyilima ii rujugira wategetse ahasaga w kugeza w’ uwo mwami amaze kwima ingoma se yuhi iii mazimpaka ngoma yahuye n’urugamba rukomeye u burundi u bugesera i gisaka n’i ndorwa byibumbiye hamwe byagirize u rwanda rwari urugamba rukomeye cyane kuko byose byari ibihugu by’abaturanyi b’u rwanda birutaye hagati dore ibitero ngoma byagenze aribyo byabaye imvano y’uwo mugani cyilima rujugira yarwanye intambara itoroshye yahuruje u burundi u bugesera n’i gisaka cy’abazirankende arayitsinda gutsinda urwo rugamba byamuteye akanyabugabo kurushaho kwiha intego gutsinda ingoma y’i ndorwa y’abashambo iherereye majyaruguru y’u rwanda igihugu ndorwa cyari icy abashambo bakomokaga mushambo kanyandorwa i sabugabo babarizwaga komini giti rutare muhura muvumba ho byumba ni ukuvuga makomini n’uduce tw’umutara twose turi majyaruguru y’ u rwanda kugeza mupaka warwo n’igihugu uganda turere twa gatsibo nyagatare babarizwaga none komini kivuye cyumba cyungo ho byumba ubu karere gicumbi kubera urugamba amaze gutsinda rukomeye rw’ibyo bihugu u burundi gisaka n’u bugesera yahise yohereza umuhungu w’igikomangoma ndabarasa gutera ndorwa ndabarasa ntiyatindiganyije acuze inkumbi mushambo gahaya i muzora umwami w’ i ndorwa bigarurira ingabe murorwa ubwami ndorwa butangira kuyoboka u rwanda n’impugu zayo zirimo mpororo ho uganda umutara n’umubari abashambo baho isanga n’ingoyi n’abanyiginya b’i gasabo ingoma ndorwa izima ityo icyo gihe yifashishije rubanda yashoboye kwanamiza urwo rugamba ahigika u burundi atsinda i gisaka n’u bugesera n’i ndorwa kubera gikorwa cy’ikirenga yakoze kurwanya ibihugu bine bikomeye akabitsinda niho kuvuga yihanukiriye agira u rwanda ruratera ntiruterwa ku ngoma cyilima rujugira n’uko u bugesera bwongeye gutera u rwanda ahasaga w’ intambara irarema urugamba rurakomera rujugira ingabo z’u bugesera zimukubita umwambi yambuka kigali bwanacyambwe agwa i ntora hariya hubatse isoko ry’imbaho gisozi hasigaye hitwa gisozi n’ubundi arimo azamuka ajya rugo rwe rwari ruhubatse n’ubwo urwo rugamba rwabaye injyanamuntu rugatuma n’umwami title: muhanga ihungabana rikomoka jenoside si iry’abacitse icumu gusa
content: mu biganiro yagiranye n’abanyamuhanga tariki nyirabahire yasobanuye ihungabana imihindukire y’imyitwarire imiterere iterwa n’ikintu kibi kibaye muntu bimutunguye avuga ihungabana riterwa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ritagirwa gusa n’abacitse icumu kuko n’abandi bashobora kurigira kubera babonye bakoze cyangwa bumvise gihe jenoside umunyamabanga w’inama njyanama y’akarere muhanga avuga n’abatarahigwaga bashobora guhura n’ikibazo cy’ihungabana gihe cy’icyunamo yagize umuntu ashobora guhungabana bitewe n’ibyo yabonye bakorera abicwaga yarahetse intumbi cyangwa imirambo cyangwa yaragize uruhare bwicanyi umuntu wagize uruhare kwica abantu cyangwa kandi karengane arangwa kwiheba agahora yicira imanza ndetse agahora yifuza uwamubaza byabaye kugira abashe kubivuga abyikurimo nk’uko nyirabahire yakkomeje abisobanura yongeyeho benshi banyarwanda bahuye n’ihungabana ariko ngero zitandukanye abanyarwanda hanze y’igihugu hari ababa bumva buri munyarwanda wese umwicanyi ikaba byatera ihungabana rikomeye nk’uko umunyamabanga w’inama njyanama y’akarere muhanga abyemeza gerard gitoli mbabazi

title: pasiteri antoine rutayisire agiye kujya kiruhuko cy’izabukuru
content: itorero angilikani riteganya pasiteri cyangwa musenyeri wujuje imyaka munsi yizihirijeho isabukuru y’imyaka ahita ajya kiruhuko cy’izabukuru hashize iminsi mbuga nkoranyamabaga hacicikana amakuru y’uko rev past dr antoine rutayisire agiye kujya kirihuko cy’izabukuru ariko ugasanga abantu batabivugaho rumwe benshi bavuga agikenewe murimo w’imana mu kiganiro yagiranye igihe rutayisire yavuze makuru ukuri kandi agenda abyibutsa abantu avuga ubutumwa materaniro atandukanye ati ibyo ukuri kinyoma kirimo kubera twebwe buriya itorero angilikani wujuje imyaka ujya kiruhuko cy’izabukuru nta muntu wabimpimbiye njye wabivuze nkunze kubivuga minsi kugeza rev past dr antoine rutayisire afite imyaka yavuze itariki gicurasi azaba asoje imirimo ahabwa n’itorero gusa avuga atazahagarika ivugabutumwa ati ku itariki z’ukwezi gatanu nzabyuka ntakiri umukozi diyoseze ntabwo nzaba nahagaritse ubutumwa ariko nzaba nahagaritse kuyobora paruwasi n’indi mirimo uyu mugabo wize imiyoborere avuga umuntu asigaje imyaka itanu ajye kiruhuko cy’iza bukuru agomba gutegura ubuzima bwe buri imbere kandi yarabirangije yavuze kwigisha ijambo ry’imana bimunezeza ariko hari n’undi munezero yumva ategereje kandi ntibizamubuza gutanga umusanzu itorero atari buyobozi ati mfite munezero numva ntegereje imbere imana nintiza ubuzima burenga imyaka namaze gukora gahunda y’akazi k’ubuzima bwanjye nzasaza ntabwo nzasaza nsaziye biro ntabwo mbyifuza akomoza azibandaho kiruhuko cy’izabukuru yavuze azakomeza kwandika ibitabo akarushaho kwishimana n’umuryango cyane abuzukuru ati maze kugira abuzukuru byanezeza nicaye hamwe nkajya njyana abuzukuru ishuri nyina se bagiye kazi nkajya kubabafatira bakaza nkabagaburira nkicarana nabo nkasekana nabo nkagira igihe kunezerwa rev past dr antoine rutayisire yatangiye ivugabutumwa akimara gukizwa mu yaretse akazi kuba mwalimu igihe cye agiharira kwigisha ijambo ry’imana icyo gihe yahise ajya kuyobora umuryango w’ivugabutumwa rishingiye bibiliya w’abanyeshuri kaminuza akaba ariwe wabaye umunyamabanga mukuru wawo mbere kugeza nyuma jenoside yakorewe abatutsi yayoboye umuryango w’ivugabutumwa aee mu ayobora paruwasi saint etienne biryogo ahava ajya kuyobora paruwasi remera arimo kugeza

title: amavubi azatangira kwitegura erithrea tariki
content: bitewe n’umwanya mubi u rwanda ruherereyeho rutonde fifa amavubi kimwe n’andi makipe adahagaze neza urwo rutonde azabanza gukina umukino w’ijonjora ry’ibanze mbere kujya matsinda u rwanda ruzakina umukino ubanza eritrea tariki ugushyingo i asmara nyuma y’iminsi ine tariki bakine umukino kwishyura i kigali ikipe izatsinda mikino yombi izahita yerekeza itsinda f rizaba ririmo algeria mali benin nyuma y’iryo jonjora hazakorwa amatsinda amakipe azaba mbere buri tsinda azasigara ahatanira amatike atanu atangwa fifa bihugu afurika bigomba kuzakina igikombe cy’isi ayo makipe azaba yasigaye azatomborana azahura abiri abiri hagati yayo mukino ubanza n’uwo kwishyura amakipe atanu atsinze azabe yerekeza gikombe cy’isi brazil hagato u rwanda ntiruramenya umutoza uzatoza amavubi guhatanira tike kuko nyuma gusezera sellas tetteh hataraboneka umutoza kumusimbura biteganyijwe batoza barenga basabye gutoza amavubi hazatoranywamo uzahabwa ako kazi uzatoza amavubi azashyirwaho nyuma y’itariki ukwakira kuko tariki hazatorwa umuyobozi w’ishyirahamwe ry’umupira w’amagru rwanda ferwafa afatanyije minisiteri y’urubyiruko umuco siporo n’izindi nzobere mupira w’amaguru zizifashishwa akazagira uruhare guhitamo umutoza uzatoza amavubi theoneste nisingizwe

title: umuhanzi fulgence nzira kugaruka ruhando rw’umuziki
content: mu kiganiro cyihariye twagiranye yadutangarije amafaranga amaze iminsi akorera kongo-kinshasa azamufasha gusohora indirimbo sitidiyo mu ikubitiro arashaka gukorana lick lick cyangwa masota indirimbo nyampinga ntibishoboka minsi vuba akomeza avuga azanye umuziki w’umwimerere njyana afrobeat idasondetse uzamuhesha itike guhiga abahanzi bakunzwe minsi kamichi kitoko king james knowless yadutangarije n’ubwo atagaragaraga ruhando rw’umuziki amaze iminsi akora indirimbo z’ibigo n’amasosiyete zamuhaga amafaranga atari make ku mpamvu zatumye ava ruhando rw’umuziki gihe gisaga imyaka ibiri avuga mwaka mafaranga muziki none abona abanyarwanda batangiye gukunda umuziki yagize icyanshimisha ugushimisha abakunzi banjye nanjye nkagira mbona birababaje kujya scene ukaririmba ugashishimisha abantu ejo ukaba usaba ababyeyi tike fulgence afite indoto gukora umuziki akamenyekana rwego mpuzamahanga kandi ukamuteza imbere fulgence amaze ibyumweru bitatu gihugu kongo-kinshasa yakoraga ikiraka kuririmba komisiyo y’amatora ifatanyije n’ishami loni rikorerayo nk’uko abivuga kiraka cyari icya meddy wamenyekanye cyane i goma kubera indirimbo amayobera ariko bw’amahirwe meddy yarabuze fulgence akibonye gutyo nshimiyimana leonard

title: inzira z’ubukerarugendo gakondo zitezweho gukuba kabiri umubare w’abasura i nyanza
content: byatangajwe gatandatu muganda rusange hakozwe ibikorwa by’isuku nzira iherereye murenge busasamana hasobanuwe nzira ziswe the nyanza cultural trials’ eshatu zitandukanye ariko zuzuzanya iya mbere yitwa royal trail’ ifite kilometero izenguruka umujyi nyanza igakikiza ingoro z’umurage ebyiri zihari ingoro y’abami rukari n’ingoro y’umurage kwigira iherereye rwesero ahahoze hatuye umwami mutara iii rudahigwa iyo nzira kandi izanyura ahari ibindi byiza biranga amateka y’u rwanda karere nyanza nk’umusezero w’abami i mwima hatabarijwe umwami mutara iii rudahigwa tariki nyakanga umwami kigeli v watabarijwe mutarama ndetse n’umwamikazi gicanda rosalie wahatabarijwe tariki mata inzira kabiri yitwa big view’ y’ibirometero umunani ituruka mujyi nyanza ikagera musozi remera iyo musozi remera uba ushobora kureba ntera y’umurambararo kilometero ubasha kureba imisozi itandukanye ikikije nyanza ndetse waterera amaso kure ukaba wabona ibindi bice by’u rwanda birimo n’ibirunga biri majyaruguru y’igihugu inzira gatatu yitwa gatagara trail’ y’ibiromtero ituruka mujyi nyanza ikagenda ikikiza ibishanga ikagera i gatagara ahari ibikorwa by’ububumbyi biteye imbere ndetse n’ikigo cyita bafite ubumuga izo nzira zose eshatu zifite umwihariko w’uko utuyira twa kinyarwanda tunyura misozi ibibaya abantu batunyuramo bagenda bareba ahantu hateye indabyo ahahinze imyaka itandukanye ahatuwe urutoki n’ibindi byiza bitandukanye bihaboneka umuyobozi mukuru w’ingoro z’igihugu z’umurage w’u rwanda amb masozera robert yavuze nzira ziyongera bindi byiza biranga amateka karere nyanza bigatuma mukerarugendo bahasura biyongera ati twazanye ubundi bwoko bw’ubukerarugendo bushingiye kugenda n’amaguru baciye nzira gakondo kinyarwanda ni ukuvuga bantu nibajya baza kugira bamare amasaha abiri nibura bazajya bamara iminsi itatu cyangwa barenzeho kandi batinda bituzanira inyungu kudusigira amafaranga amb masozera yashimiye abaturage bitabiriye umuganda rusange gukora isuku nzira abararikira kuzaza kuzitaha mugaragaro tariki ukuboza ati ni igikorwa gikomeye cyane kizatuma hano i nyanza cyifuzo mwari mufite cy’uko haba igicumbi cy’umuco kiba impamo dutekereza nzira zizatuma abantu basura nyanza bava bihumbi nibura bakagera bihumbi mwaka amb masozera yasobanuye inzobere bijyanye n’ubwo bukerarugendo zimaze iminsi zisura nzira nako zitanga amanota hakaba hari icyizere zizaza mbere nziza ziri isi muri nzira bagiye bashyiraho ibyapa byerekana ibyerekezo ariko abazajya bazinyuramo hari bazajya bakenera ababasobanurira amateka y’uduce dutandukanye duhari umuyobozi wungirije ushinzwe iterambere ry’ubukungu karere nyanza kajyambere patrick yasabye abaturage kwirinda kongera kumena imyanda y’izo nzira yabibukije bagomba kugira isuku byose buri rugo rukagira kujugunya imyanda habugenewe ntibongere kuyishyira babonye ati nahoze mbona umwanda hano nzira umuntu arava rugo akaza kumena ibishingwe hano cyangwa akagajugunya ibishishwa by’ibitoki kubera atumvaga agaciro k’iyi nzira bamwe baturage karere nyanza bawiye igihe nyuma kumenya agaciro k’izo nzira bagiye kuzitaho buryo hatazongera kugaragara umwanda mukankunzi jeannette twishimiye ibikorwa by’ubukerarugendo bikomeje kwiyongera hano iwacu nzira ntabwo zizongera kugaragaramo umwanda kuko buri wese agiye kuba ijisho mugenzi buryo muntu uzongera kuza kuhamena imyanda kalisa jmv yavuze bishimiye ubusobanuro bahawe bijyanye n’izo nzira kandi yumvise bizagirira akamaro akarere kabo nyanza akarere nyanza kabumbatiye amateka menshi yiganjemo hambere kuko nyanza yabaye umurwa mukuru w’ubwami kugeza i nyanza hahoze umurwa w’ubwami kuko hatuwe n’abami bane kigeli iv rwabugiri utuye misozi mwima mushirarungu yuhi iv musinga watuye i mwima gakenyeri mutara iii rudahigwa watuye rukali ndetse n’umwami kigeli v ndahindurwa watuye i busasamana muri nyanza kandi haboneka amariba mutende yafukuwe ngoma y’umwami mutara iii rudahigwa inyambo ze ndetse n’inka z’abaturage ziturutse imihanda zashokaga hari kandi title: ni gute wakwirinda cyangwa ukivura uburwayi kunuka kanwa
content: buri gitondo ubyutse wisangana impumuro iteye ubwoba ituruka kanwa kawe ariko ntibikwiye kuguhangayikisha kuko ariko abatuye isi bibagendekera gusa sibyo burwayi kunuka kanwa akenshi abafite indwara kunuka kanwa ntibabimenya kuko burya badashobora kubyumva burya kumva ubusharire kanwa cyangwa ibindi byatuma ukeka unuka kanwa ntaho bihurira n’ukuri ahubwo mpumuro mbi yumvirwa mazuru gusa bihuriye n’uburwayi nyirizina ubundi munuko ukabije kanwa uterwa n’indwara kanwa nk’iryinyo ryangiritse bityo rikaba ririmo udukoko dutuma kanwa hanuka bishobora guturuka bundi burwayi butandukanye title: cnlg irasanga ubufaransa buri guhakana bukanapfobya jenocide akorewe abatutsi
content: iyi komisiyo ivuga ubutabera bw’u bufaransa bwongeye gukora igikorwa cyerekana bushyigikiye abantu bagize uruhare jenoside yakorewe abatutsi ibi bitangajwe nyuma y’aho ubushinjacyaha bw’i paris busabiye padiri munyeshyaka wenceslas atakurikiranwa n’ubutabera tariki kanama urukiko narwo rwemejwe kudakurikiranwa n’amategeko cnlg ivuga padiri wenceslas munyeshyaka akurikiranyweho icyaha jenoside ubwe nk’umuntu wayiteguye washishikarije abandi kuyikora wayikoze cyangwa wafashije kuyikora buryo aribwo bwose akanashishikariza abandi gucura umugambi gutegura gushyira bikorwa jenoside yakorewe abatutsi kudakurikiranwa n’ubutabera munyeshyaka wenceslas cnlg ivuga icyemezo giteye isoni ngo icyemezo nk’iki kirerekana ubutabera bw’u bufaransa bumeze ngo nubwo buvuga bwigenga biragaragara bukingira ikibaba igice cy’abanyapolitiki n’abasirikare bagize uruhare jenoside yakorewe abatutsi igahitana abantu barenga miliyoni atari gusa ahubwo guhera hagati u bufaransa bwateraga inkunga ingoma y’abicanyi haba rwego politike rw’amafaranga gisirikare ndetse n’urwa dipolomasiiyi komisiyo ivuga u bufaransa bwihutiye gusaba iyimurwa ry’imanza munyeshyaka bucyibaruta kandi ubushake buke bwabwo gucira munyeshyaka urubanza bwatumye urukiko rw’i burayi rureba uburenganzira muntu rubuhamya mwaka icyaha kudaca urubanza gihe ngombwa ku cnlg cyemezo kudakurikiranwa munyeshyaka wenceslas ikinamico y’ubutabera yuzuye ihakana jenoside ngo birerekana ndetse hashobora kuzaba kudahanwa kugirwa abere kw’abantu benshi bakoze jenoside batuye bufaransa bakaba abenshi banafite bihugu bihana imbibi rishyira mategeko ahana y’u bufaransa ibyaha byose bikurikiranwa n’urukiko mpanabyaha mpuzamahanga rwashiriweho u rwanda tpir ikindi kandi ububasha bw’uru rukiko buhera tariki title: nzeyimana isidore yahimbye ishyiga kijyambere tekutangije
content: iyo mbabura ishobora guteka ibintu byinshi inshuro ibiryo mashyiga inyotse ziba zashyizwe ifuru ndetse n’amazi umuntu ashobora gushyushya gasiterine uretse kuba tekutangije ishobora guteka ibintu bitandukanye icyarimwe ifite akarusho kurondereza inkwi tekutangije ifite amashyiga abiri kandi buri shyiga rifite bashyira inkwi hagati y’amashyiga hari ifuru inyuma y’ibyo byose hakaba agasiterine gashyushya amazi nyezimana sobanura buri shyiga rijyamo ingeri sentimetero yemeza ingeri esheshatu zigahisha inkono enye ebyiri mashyiga ifuru siterine ikindi cyiza tekutangije umutetsi aticwa n’imyotsi kuko ifite uruhombo rurerure rujyana umwotsi kure akandi karusho shyiga riba riri kumwe n’ubwogerezo bumwe cyangwa bubiri lavabos bitewe n’icyifuzo cy’uyishaka hamwe n’ameza guteguriraho guteka ibyo byose imbabura n’ibiyiherekeje bikoze aluminium nzeyimana asobanura amashyiga akora arimo ibyiciro bitatu bitewe n’ingano y’amazi ashobora gushyushya irinini rishobora gushyushya litiro rikaba rigura hagati irikurikiyeho rishobora gushyushya litiro rikagura hagati y’amafaranga iritoya rishobora gushyushya litiro rikaba rigura hagati y’amafaranga uretse tekutangije nzeyimana isidore akora muvero zifashishwa gutekera abanyeshuri shodiyeri chaudire zikora vaperi vapeurs n’ibindi intego ukurengera ibidukikije nzayimana umwe bitabiriye ibiganiro bushakashatsi mpuzamahanga gukoresha ingufu tubungabunga ibidukikije yateguwe kaminuza nkuru y’u rwanda iherereye karere huye ibi biganiro byatangiye tariki bikazarangira tariki ugushyingo kakunze alfred

title: uruganda bmw rwavuguruye ikirango cyarwo
content: impinduka zakozwe kirango cyari gisanzwe ugusimbuza uruziga ruri ibara ry’umukara rwagaragara kirango cyari gisanzwe hagashyirwamo ibara ribonerana ibindi bisanzwe kirango cyari gisanzwe byarushijeho kugaragazwa neza kirango gishya ariko amabara y’ubururu n’umweru imbere ruziga amenyerewe n’abazi ikirango cy’uru ruganda ntiyahinduwe visi-perezida w’ishami rishinzwe abakiliya n’iyamamazabirango bmw jans thiemer abinyujije rubuga internet rw’iyi sosiyete yavuze ikirango gishya kizakoreshwa bikorwa by’itumanaho bmw harimo imbuga nkoranyambaga ndetse n’urubuga internet hagamijwe kurushaho kukimenyekanisha kugaragaza umucyo wacyo yongeyeho isura nshya igaragaza igisobanuro n’akamaro bmw gukora ingendo n’umunezero gutwara ibinyabiziga bihe biri imbere umuvugizi w’uru ruganda yavuze gahunda ijyanye gushyira kirango gishya modoka gukora nubwo bmw yagishyize modoka ikoresha amashanyarazi igenewe uruganda tesla yatangiye gukoreshwa kabiri uru ruganda rwavuze ibara ribonerana ryashyizwe kirango gishya riha ibara ryiza ry’inyuma imodoka ndetse rigatuma imenyekana cyane ikirango cyari gisanzwe cyatangiye gukoreshwa uru ruganda rumaze guhinduranya ibirango byarwo inshuro esheshatu myaka rumaze rushinzwe kandi byose bijya gusa abakunzi b’uru ruganda bamaze igihe kinini bavuga imbere kirango cyari gisanzwe hagaragaza ishusho y’icyuma gikoreshwa kurema ingufu zitwara ubwato cyangwa indege propeller ariko bmw yasobanuye amabara y’umweru n’ubururu by’ukuri agaragaza umujyi bavaria ufatwa nk’igicumbi cy’uru ruganda umuyobozi mukuru w’ishami rishinzwe guhanga udushya kigo gikora ibishushanyo siegelgale doug sellers yatangarije cnn ikirango gishya iterambere kandi gituma uruganda rwumva rwuguruye amarembo rukanorohereza abakiliya bakiri bato bafite ubumenyi bw’ikoranabuhanga bmw ruganda kabiri rukora imodoka budage rumaze guhindura ibirango byarwo mezi atandatu ashize volkswagen nayo iherutse kugaragaza ikirango gishya imurikagurisha ry’imodoka ryabereye mujyi frankfurt ruvuga gihe kwereka isi imiterere mishya y’ikirango cyarwo

title: abagore n’abakobwa bihariye by’abanyarwanda bahuye n’icuruzwa ry’abantu
content: ubushakashatsi kibazo cy’icuruzwa ry’abantu rwanda bwamuritswe nyakanga bwakozwe n’ umuryango never again rwanda hagati imibare yatanzwe n’urwego rw’abinjira n’abasohoka yagaragaje rwanda ahanini abacuruzwa bahanyuzwa bajyanwe bindi bihugu kuko abahakurwa bake mu bantu bacurujwe higanjemo abarundi bagera bingana harimo kandi abanye-congo abanyarwanda n’abantu bindi bihugu urebeye gitsina abagore n’abakobwa ab’igitsina gabo ku ruhanda rw’u rwanda bushakashatsi bwerekana bacurujwe ab’igitsina gore urubyiruko munsi y’imyaka ubushakashatsi bwerekanye inzira abanyarwanda banyuzwamo bajyanwa gucuruzwa izegereye imipaka nko turere twa rusizi burera nyagatare rubavu gicumbi kirehe ibihugu bakunze kujya gucururizwamo harimo arabie saoudite uganda kenya mozambique tanzania malawi afurika y’epfo zambia malaysia omar qatar kuwait leta zunze ubumwe z’abarabu n’ahandi abakoze ubushakashatsi basobanuye abajya gucuruzwa akenshi babeshywa bagiye guhabwa akazi keza kwiga n’ibindi bagezwayo ntibabibone cyangwa bagashorwa bikorwa by’urukozasoni n’ibindi bigira ingaruka buzima bwabo zimwe mpamvu zituma ubucuruzi bw’abantu bwiyongera harimo imibereho mibi ubukene ubushomeri rubyiruko igitutu cy’umuryango ababeshywa bagiye kurihirwa amashuri n’ibindi umuyobozi never again dr nkurunziza ryarasa joseph yavuze hakenewe ubuvugizi kugira abanyarwanda bamenye icuruzwa ry’abantu rikorwa ingaruka rigira n’uko baryirinda ati icyo dusaba ukugira habeho ihanahana ry’amakuru cyane cyane kigo gishinzwe abinjira n’abasohoka urwego rw’ubugenzacyaha polisi n’urw’ubutabera kuko kugira kibazo gikemuke abantu bafite amakuru yuzuye yasabye hakwiye kujyaho ikigo gifasha isanamitima bantu bahungabanyirijwe icuruzwa ry’abantu abateshejwe ishuri bagafashwa kurisubiramo umuyobozi w’ishami rishinzwe ubutabera mpuzamahanga minisiteri y’ubutabera umurungi providence yavuze icuruzwa ry’abantu atari ikibazo cy’u rwanda gusa ahubwo cyugarije isi ati ibivuye bushakashatsi bizadufasha gushyira gahunda guteganye icyakorwa rwego kurwanya icuruzwa ry’abantu umurungi yavuze imiryango ariyo ifite uruhare rukomeye kuko bigaragara abajya gucuruzwa bajyanwa n’abo bafitanye isano ishyirahamwe mpuzamahanga ryita murimo ilo riheruka kugaragaza abantu barenga miliyoni barimo abagabo abagore n’abana bashowe bucuruzi bw’abantu

title: umuganda inyunganizi ngengo y’imari y’igihugu
content: kimwe n’indi myaka yashize mwaka - wakozwemo ibikorwa binyuranye by’umuganda gihugu hose birimo guhanga imihanda y’imigenderano gutinda amateme kubaka amazu y’abatishoboye kubaka amashuli y’uburezi bw’ibanze bw’imyaka ybe kubaka ubwiherero kubaka ibigega guhunikamo imyaka gucukura imyobo guteramo ibiti gutera ibiti kubaka ibiro by’utugari gucukura ibyobo bifata amazi n’ibindi ibikorwa byose byakozwe bikaba byarahawe agaciro kangana y’amafaranga y’u rwanda nk’uko bigaragara rapport yashyizwe ahagaragara minaloc italiki mbere nzeli n’ubwo ibikorwa byakozwe bifite agaciro kanini gihugu hose ariko ntibyabujije hakorwa ibarura rigamije kumenya ubwitabire buri ntara muri raporo baragaragaza umujyi kigali hamwe n’intara y’uburengerazuba ziri mwanya nyuma n’ubwitabire bungana akaba nazo zifite ubwitabire buri hasi ugereranyije n’izindi ntara gihe intara y’amajyaruguru mwanya mbere n’ubwitabire igakurikirwa n’intara y’amajyepfo ifite intara y’uburasirazuba ikaza mwanya gatatu n’ubwitabire bungana aha intara zititwaye neza zikaba zisabwa kwikubita agashyi nyuma kumenya ubwitabire buhagaze gihugu hose barebye intara yakoze ibikorwa bifite agaciro kanini intara y’iburasirazuba iza isonga n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amafaranga y’u rwanda gihe umujyi kigali uza mwanya nyuma n’ibikorwa bifite agaciro kangana z’amanyarwanda aha kugira agaciro k’ibikorwa by’umuganda karusheho kuzamuka abakoze raporo berekanye hari ibintu by’ingenzi bitatu bigomba kwitabwaho ubwitabire bw’abaturage umurava buri wese witabiriye igenamigambi rinoze kandi risesengura neza ibikorwa by’ingenzi bifitiye abaturage n’igihugu rusange akamaro si gusa ariko byakozwe kuko mpera z’ukwezi werurwe minisiteri y’ubutegetsi bw’igihugu yatangije amarushanwa y’ibikorwa by’umuganda nshuro kabiri akaba yarashyiriweho kugirango atere imbaraga n’ubushake abaturage barusheho gukunda kwitabira ibikorwa by’umuganda benshi binyuze muco guhiga guhanga udushya umurenge kavumu karere ngororero intara y’uburengerazuba akaba waje mwanya mbere rwego rw’igihugu ubikesha urugomero rw’amashanyarazi rwubatswe n’abaturage bakabasha kwivana icuraburindi ku mwanya kabiri haje umurenge musange karere nyamagabeintara y’amajyepfo wahinze inanasi buso bungana ha bikazabafasha kwikura bukene ku mwanya gatatu hari umurenge manyagiro karere gicumbi intara y’amajyaruguru abaturage bawutuyemo bubatse amazu y’abahejwe inyuma n’amateka rwego kubafasha kwiteza imbere batura heza uretse ibikorwa byakozwe muganda rusange kandi raporo irerekana ibindi byakozwe n’ingabo polisi cyumweru title: rulindo barasaba kugabanyirizwa umusoro bigori bacuruza
content: jean pierre ngerageze umwe bacuruza ibigori avuga amafaranga y’ inyungu bakura bucuruzi bwabo bahita bayatanga byinshi bigatuma babona kamaro gafatika bubafitiye agira ngunguru y’ ibigori nshobora kungukaho amafaranga nkishyura umusoro ndetse n’inkwi ngasigarana gusa mukanyindo berancille avuga amafaranga babona bucuruzi bw’ibigori adahwanye n’imirimo bakoze kubitegura agira batwaka umusoro uhanitse twakuramo amafaranga y’ishyiramwe ndetse n’ayo kugura inkwi ugasanga usigaranye ubusa umunyamabanga nshingwabikorwa w’ umurenge base mwigira antoine avuga batari bazi kibazo ariko bagiye kugikurikiranira akarengane kazagaragara kagakemuke mwigira avuga kandi bazitonda bakareba gukabya birimo kuko umuntu ashobora kuba asoreshwa bijyanye n’agaciro k’ibyo acuruza jean noel mugabo

title: shoah foundation igiye kubika amateka jenoside buryo bugezweho
content: aba basore bakora akazi kubika gushyingura neza inyandiko n’ibindi bivuga mamateka jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda bagiye kwiga uburyo amateka jenoside rwanda yashyingurwa buryo bugezweho cyane cyane kubika amateka buryo bw’amashusho n’amajwi iki kigo gifite uburambe kubika ubutumwa bw’amajwi amashusho ndetse n’inyandiko birebana n’amateka jenoside umuyobozi w’iyi fondasiyo karen jungblut ukurikirana mushinga gukusanya amateka jenoside rwanda yatangajeko mubyo umubano w’ibi bigo uzibandaho harimo guhana ubuhamya kugirango amateka jenoside amenyekane kw’isi bateganya gushaka amajwi n’amashusho bijyanye jenoside yakorewe abatutsi rwanda nayo ashyirwe bubiko bw’iki kigo kuko kugeza bafite ubuhamya bwanditse gusa nabwo bwaje kinyarwanda bikagerageza kubushyira zindi ndimi ikigo mpuzamahanga shoah foundation ntigiharanira inyungu kikaba gikora ubushakashatsi bijyanye n’amateka jenoside ibikorwa kwibuka abaguye ntambara kabiri y’isi iki kigo kivuga kigamije ukugerageza gufasha abantu kurenga ibibazo by’urwikekwe kugira imitima ibababarira hagati y’umwaka w’ muryango wabashije kwakira ubuhamya bw’abantu bihugu bagiye barokoka buryo butandukanye marie jose ikibasumba
